descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Logistik Mitarbeiter (m/w/d)

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Abteilung und unsere Mission
Innerhalb des Unternehmensbereichs „Supply Chain“ verantwortet die Abteilung „Logistics“ die Versorgung der Standorte im Netzwerk und Kunden mit Gütern und logistischen Dienstleistungen. Kompetenz, Zuverlässigkeit, Flexibilität, kontinuierliche Qualitätsverbesserung und Kostenoptimierung sind die Werte, an denen wir unser Handeln ausrichten.
Der Logistikbereich 551/552 im Werk Penzberg verwaltet bestandsgeführte Materialien (Wareneingang / Bevorratung / Versand) und versorgt die Produktion und Kunden im Netzwerk oder außerhalb.

Angetrieben durch unsere Vision „Home for your success“ tragen wir tagtäglich dazu bei, dass am Roche-Standort Penzberg die Anliegen unserer Partner nachhaltig umgesetzt werden. Dafür ergreifen wir erfolgreich die Initiative und handeln leidenschaftlich und eigenverantwortlich.
Um diese Mission bestmöglich zu erfüllen, brauchen wir nun einen Logistik Mitarbeiter (m/w/d), der es versteht, durch Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen unseren Leistungen ein Gesicht zu geben.

Verantwortlichkeiten und was Dich erwartet
In der Logistik Penzberg umfasst dein Aufgabengebiet jegliche Art von Warenflüssen und die Verwaltung derer. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team stellst du die Versorgung der Produktionsbetriebe und Kundenbelieferungen sicher.

• Du bist zuständig für die Warenvereinnahmung eingehender Lieferungen von Rohstoffen, Gefahrstoffen, Zukaufs- & Handelswaren, sowie Ablieferungen aus den internen Produktionsbetrieben

• Wichtig bei deiner Tätigkeit ist die Feststellung der Chargen, die Kennzeichnung und Etikettierung der Waren und Einlagerung der Paletten unter Berücksichtigung der gültigen Arbeitsvorschriften, insbesondere von Temperatur- und Raumbedingungen, sowie den Umgang mit Gefahrstoffe/ Gefahrgut

• Du führst in verschiedenen SAP- Logistiksystemen Tätigkeiten durch und bearbeitest Aufträge für die Einlagerung und Kundenbelieferung.

• Du führst die Bedienung und Handhabung der logistischen Anlagen und deren Fehlerbehebung durch, auch der Transport mit Flurförderzeugen gehört zu deinen Aufgaben

• Du bist verantwortlich für die termingerechte Bereitstellung bestellter Waren aus den Logistikbereichen sowie die korrekte Verpackung und Auslieferung (die Tätigkeiten erfordern zeitweises Heben und Tragen von Lasten über 25 kg)

• Vorbereiten und Verpacken der Waren unter Berücksichtigung der Roche Verpa­ckungsvorschriften und der gesetzlichen Vorschriften für das In- und Ausland

• Vervollständigen des Packstückes mit den Speditionspapieren, Bereitstellen und Über­geben der Sendungen an die beauftragten Transportunternehmen

• Nach gründlicher Einarbeitung übernimmst du den Einsatz von Rufbereitschaften

Wer bist Du und welche Qualifikationen bringst Du mit

• Du verfügst idealerweise über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Umfeld Logistik m

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、臨床検査センターなどを対象に、新規開拓を中心としたコンサルティング営業をお任せします。 まだ自社製品を導入していない医療施設へアプローチし、医療現場や検査室が抱える課題をヒアリングから抽出、解消に導くことが最優先のミッションです。自社製品をただ売り込むのではなく、お客様の課題解決に向けた最適なソリューションを提供していただきます。

【業務内容】
1. 新規開拓・コンサルティング提案営業（メインミッション）

• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。

• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。

2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携

• すでに導入いただいているお客様に対して運用面の課題解消もサポートしますが、業務の主軸は新規開拓となります。

• 学術やエンジニアリングなど社内の専門部署と緊密に連携し、どうすればお客様にとって最適なサポートができるかを常に考え、関係各所を巻き込んでプロジェクトを推進していただきます。

【応募資格（必須要件）】

• 医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験 （対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等） 具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

• 普通自動車第一種運転免許 （AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】

• 医療業界における新規開拓営業の経験。

• 臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　営業職（DMR）
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 営業手当：月70,000円～
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
（※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙
募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities,
descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、臨床検査センターなどを対象に、新規開拓を中心としたコンサルティング営業をお任せします。 まだ自社製品を導入していない医療施設へアプローチし、医療現場や検査室が抱える課題をヒアリングから抽出、解消に導くことが最優先のミッションです。自社製品をただ売り込むのではなく、お客様の課題解決に向けた最適なソリューションを提供していただきます。

【業務内容】
1. 新規開拓・コンサルティング提案営業（メインミッション）

• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。

• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。

2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携

• すでに導入いただいているお客様に対して運用面の課題解消もサポートしますが、業務の主軸は新規開拓となります。

• 学術やエンジニアリングなど社内の専門部署と緊密に連携し、どうすればお客様にとって最適なサポートができるかを常に考え、関係各所を巻き込んでプロジェクトを推進していただきます。

【応募資格（必須要件）】

• 医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験 （対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等） 具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

• 普通自動車第一種運転免許 （AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】

• 医療業界における新規開拓営業の経験。

• 臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　営業職（DMR）
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 営業手当：月70,000円～
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
（※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙

The opportunity As a Technical Support Partner for Lab-IT, you are responsible for carrying out field service functions for Roche Diagnostics Digital Products. Your primary duties include digital product troubleshooting, installation, commissioning, and performing preventive maintenance procedures. Reporting to the Technical Support Lead for Lab-IT, you will respond promptly to all service calls and handle various after-sales service issues to ensure customer satisfaction and optimal instrument performance. • Respond promptly and effectively to all service calls from customers.
• Conduct preventive maintenance according to the established schedule to ensure instrument & digital product reliability.
• Manage and resolve other issues related to digital solution after-sales service to maintain high levels of customer support. Who you are Experience and Competencies:
• Strong in analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Able to drive and travel in upcountry areas and be flexible to work outside of normal working hours.
• Independent, a team player, flexible, and solution-driven with an agile mindset.
• Good command of spoken and written English.
• Good communication skills.
• Demonstrates a desire to influence your own development and pursue interests across functions.
• Industry Experience:
• Bachelors or Masters in IT or related fields.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche. This is a post-sales position in which predominant job responsibilities and requirements occur after the sale of the company’s product to the client. This role provides post-sales technical expertise during the installation, implementation and maintenance of company products, and may be involved in implementing detailed customer installation requirements. Key purpose of the role is to ensure that client’s needs have been met and that the product/solution is fully functioning according to specification and provide follow-up support to company sales staff and customer personnel by disseminating technical information on specific applications. As a member of our Service and Support Community / Field Applications Specialists team, you will be primarily responsible for providing technical support and expertise to existing and potential customers across NSW & ACT, but also occasionally nationally. In this Sydney based full time permanent position, you will be using your previous experience and training to install, train and provide troubleshooting assistance for Roche instrumentation, software and reagent systems, in hospitals, private pathology and medical research laboratories. Who you are You are someone who wants to influence your own development, is passionate about making a difference and comfortable with a constant changing environment. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across the functions and geographies, and where a job title is not considered the final destination of who you are, but the starting point. You will ideally possess a relevant degree / diploma in Science / Laboratory Science plus minimum 3 years’ experience within a Clinical Chemistry/ Hematology Laboratory . You will have demonstrable ability to diagnose applications and operational issues on analytical systems and to successfully resolve issues in a timely manner. You will have excellent communication skills with the ability to present to groups. Also required is an ability to work independently or as part of a team, and exceptional planning and organizational skills. Your strong computer literacy with a working knowledge of MS Office, experience in Laboratory workflow assessment / LIS with desirable experience in Digital Imaging and superior customer service skills are pivotal to the success of Roche, therefore we expect our new team member to be customer focused, self motivated and enjoy working in a team environment. A valid driver’s license is essential. In return, you will be provided with a rewarding and challenging role, a supportive work environment in which you can grow and develop your skills, the opportunity to work for a market leading organisation, and a competitive remuneration package. This role is only open to candidates that have full eligibility to live and work in Australia. We do not accept any unsolicited resumes or enquiries from recruitment agencies. Roche has a dedicated in-house Talent Acquisition team.
• What we offer Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel emp

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position IT Infrastructure Engineer - Digital Presence Platform Reliability Engineer (d/f/m) Introduction Digital Presence Platform & Solutions (DPPS) is a part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and provides the foundational capabilities for Roche’s global internet ecosystem - encompassing web content publication, social media integration, external content repositories and web domains management . While the development and operations of individual, use case specific solutions remains decentralized, DPPS team provides a common layer that is being leveraged by business facing IT teams, in order to drive consistency and avoid duplication . As a Digital Presence Platform Reliability Engineer, you will lead the evolution of our Platform Toolchain . You will be responsible for engineering tools supporting maintenance of our platforms as well as applications hosted upon them . Ensuring they are robust, scalable, and secure . Your mission is to deliver a world-class Developer Experience and platform stability through advanced automation, AI, deep observability and baked-in compliance . The Opportunity:
• Lead Toolchain Evolution: Autonomously lead the evolution of the Digital Presence Platforms toolchain by applying state-of-the-art practices and defining the roadmap and implementation strategy .
• Drive DevSecOps Principles: Abstract complexity across domains by applying DevSecOps principles and providing robust self-service tools for platform and application teams .
• Architect Reliability Solutions: Lead the end-to-end design, build, and implementation of reliability, observability, self-service, and advanced automation solutions .
• Partner for Velocity: Partner closely with platform and application teams to optimize service reliability and accelerate application development velocity .
• Deploy AI-Powered Operations: Design and implement robust monitoring and AIOps solutions to proactively detect anomalies, predict capacity constraints, and enable self-healing capabilities .
• Manage Key Initiatives: Lead small-to-medium technical teams on key initiatives, solving complex, interdisciplinary problems across the whole Digital Presence Platforms area .
• Ensure Framework Compliance: Align all technical designs and solutions with internal Quality, Security, and Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) policies .
• Coordinate Global Dependencies: Manage complex issues and variable factors across different organizational boundaries while coordinating multiple teams and moving parts . Who you are:
• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a closely related technical field .
• Experienced Technical Leader: You bring 7+ years of progressive infrastructure experience, with a proven track record of leading geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship .
• Core Domain Expert: You possess extensive technical expertise with in-depth knowledge in at least two domains, such as Site/Service Reliability Engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, or Cloud Architecture .
• Automation & AI Innovator: You are highly skilled in leveraging AI tools and scripting languages to systematically eliminate manual tasks and drive self-healing automated operations .
• Systems & Observability Proficient: You are familiar with containerization, major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), and observability tools like DataDog, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry .
• Agile Strategy Practitioner:

The Position Roche Pharma is seeking a Senior Regulatory Affairs Pharmacist/Associate to join their team in Johannesburg. Your main purpose is to effect registration of medicines and obtain approval for new indications of products according to the business strategy, as well as maintain current product dossiers Key Challenges Strategic /Tactical/Planning
• Advising on the most suitable time for submitting dossiers/new indications according to Roche Global timeframes and ensuring registration/ approval by the health authority in the shortest possible time.
• Coordinate, monitor and supervise timeous submission and maintenance of dossiers in accordance with corporate and local directives, guidelines, SOP’s and legislative requirements.
• Gather, analyse and communicate internal and external regulatory intelligence.
• Provide regulatory expertise and input into cross-functional Affiliate business strategies (e.g. market access, medical affairs, promotional activities, public policy, technical assessments, technical agreements, local manufacturing/packaging activities, legal issues, etc.)
• Develop innovative, risk-based registration plans and submission strategies for Affiliate products with limited guidance from DRA Management.
• Represent Affiliate Regulatory in cross-functional teams.
• Handling more complex or larger-scale products to support, take a lead on special projects, and help on-board and train less experienced DRA colleagues in the assigned affiliate Operational
• To monitor that Roche Pharma complies with all aspects of local legislation relating to medicines and pharmacy practice as well as other internal guidelines, directives and SOP’s, identify anomalies and implement corrective action.
• Review and prioritise the product registration portfolio and align it with the business needs and objectives, in line with market trends and developments.
• Compile dossiers and submit in accordance with corporate, legislative and health authority requirements and are executed timeously.
• Manage complex or larger scale products to support, take a lead on special projects, and help on-board and train DRA colleagues.
• Assist the Product Teams with the approval of advertising materials and reviewing and aligning with the legal advertising requirements.
• Collaborate with Quality Assurance in the final approval of packaging materials for the commercial pack Customer Focus and Stakeholder Management
• Provide advice and guidance to relevant Roche departments regarding local medicine, pharmacy legislation and pharmacy practice, internal guidelines, directives and SOP’s.
• Support local market access activities from a regulatory perspective
• Influence internal and external stakeholders for successful regulatory outcomes Filings
• Adapt global product dossiers to local requirements.
• Prepare and manage regulatory registration filings across product lifecycles.
• Monitor and communicate all regulatory filings status and respond to internal and external questions, or other needs.
• Prepare and submit regulatory filings and approvals Information and Document Management
• Manage regulatory activities on relevant Roche systems
• Review SOPs and compile new and update existing documents in line with requirements Regulatory Compliance
• Develop and maintain current knowledge of international and local regulations and other governing regulatory practices, policies, procedures, processes, systems and standards.
• Prepare for regulatory inspection-readiness

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Role: As a member of FiCoE, you are accountable to deliver short-term financial targets while creating sustainable value in the long term. Other duties include providing insights, enabling enterprise and functional outcomes through financial and business analysis, and steering and monitoring of holistic company performance. You will also drive finance processes, delivering high quality and compliant financials required to support short and long-term planning, reporting, and decision-making. You will collaborate across the broader Roche organization to co-create solutions that ensure broad and equitable access of our diagnostics to patients and provide value to our customers. The Opportunity: As the Finance Rebate Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the accurate and timely processing of customer rebates (including admin fees and chargebacks), lead technical support solutions, and provide financial insights. This is done through collaboration with customers and internal stakeholders to retrieve and thoroughly analyze various data sets from external systems, provide explanations for rebate payments and rejections and interpret terms and agreements within our customer contracts. Through timely processing of our customer rebates submissions, you will ensure compliance to our customers core agreements while providing great customer service. You will provide consultation and insights regarding open rebates disputes, tactics, best practices, policies and procedures. Duties are varied and complex, often involving massive data set processing, researching historical trends, and analysis to ensure proper and time-critical rebate payments. You are responsible for achieving quality objectives through daily actions needed to meet our monthly/quarterly deadlines. The following requirements will be needed for this position: Technical Lead to ensure tools functioning to support business requirements Create Innovative Solutions to increase efficiency and reporting accuracy Ability to Lead projects to support initiatives such as ASPIRE and/or Data Enablement This position is based on-site at our Indianapolis campus and uses a hybrid (3 days per week) working model. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. Who You Are:
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field Key Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with external stakeholders to retrieve data from external websites and systems.
• Review and analyze rebates and identify outliers to determine the validity of claims based on contract stipulations; create new outlier rules as needed.
• Provide external stakeholder insights explaining rebate approvals and rejections.
• Research and analyze historical rebate data to determine trends and ensure proper rebate payments.
• Collaborate with the contracts team to resolve and provide recommendations regarding contract issues.
• Support of other financial projects as needed.
• Assists with the forecast and budget process by performing analysis, setting estimated targets, and partnering with internal departments and stakeholders
• Prepares month, quarter and year-end analyses, reporting projections and closing process
• Documents current processes at all times Pref

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position En Roche Bolivia nos encontramos en búsqueda de un/a Patient Journey Partner (PJP) para el área terapéutica de Oncología idealmente basado en Santa Cruz, Bolivia , quien es un líder empoderado y referente de contacto local con Roche, que se vincula con todos los actores del ecosistema de salud involucrados directamente a la jornada del paciente (en determinadas áreas de enfermedades o terapéuticas), de manera de co-crear soluciones significativas para su mejora, conectando con las capacidades que todo Roche puede disponer para ello. La oportunidad:
• Siendo un aliado confiable y punto de contacto primario (pero no exclusivo), se conecta con todos los actores involucrados en la jornada del paciente, buscando identificar las oportunidades para mejorarla lo más efectiva y rápidamente posible. Para lograrlo, además conecta y pone a disposición del ecosistema toda la capacidad, la ciencia y el conocimiento del que Roche dispone.
• Al velar por la jornada del paciente en su totalidad, el/la PJP actúa como un pensador sistémico, con la capacidad de identificar un propósito compartido entre las partes interesadas y para co-crear soluciones en el ecosistema.
• En alianza con todos los actores que participan en la jornada del paciente (incluidos los pacientes), busca remover barreras y desbloquear oportunidades para ofrecer soluciones valiosas a los pacientes y a la comunidad.
• Comparte internamente las necesidades de los pacientes y los actores directamente vinculados, prioriza, asegura recursos y desarrolla soluciones que busquen mejorar los resultados lo más pronto posible.
• Vela por el uso apropiado de los productos de Roche a lo largo de todo su ciclo de vida, lo que incluye entre otros, compartir información al respecto con profesionales de la salud en una forma veraz y balanceada.
• Está facultado para disponer de recursos a nivel local y de la red según sea necesario, incluida la colaboración con otros PJP y HSP.
• Busca garantizar una excelente experiencia, cada vez que las partes interesadas se relacionen con los empleados, los productos y los servicios de Roche.
• Como empleado de Roche, comprende y respeta todas las políticas, programas, procedimientos e instrucciones relacionados a SHE, farmacovigilancia y compliance (esto incluye reportar incidentes e informar a quien sea apropiado en cada situación). Quién eres
• Grado universitario (ciencias, economía o negocios) es altamente deseable. Un grado avanzado en ciencias de la vida y / o MBA es valorado.
• Experiencia y conocimiento en el mercado de enfermedades raras, hematología y/o neurología del país.
• Experiencia comercial, representación y/o visita médica, líder de cuentas claves entre otras.
• Profundo conocimiento de la jornada del paciente y procedimientos médicos relacionados en determinada área de enfermedad, que permita el relacionamiento con especialistas en el tema.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As the R2R Period-End Close Senior Analyst based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be an integral part of our Global Shared Services organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert, delivering advanced accounting support and complex financial analysis while driving process improvements and automation initiatives. You will act as a key point of contact for accounting and reporting matters, serving as a trusted advisor for our supported affiliates. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Accounting Expertise & Audit Leadership: Lead complex accounting analyses and audit activities for assigned areas. You will serve as a subject matter expert for affiliates and internal stakeholders, ensuring technical accounting excellence.
• Financial Reporting & Close Activities: Prepare and review complex financial statements and reports. You will manage month-end close activities, including journal entries, cost allocations, and reconciliations, while maintaining a proper audit trail and compliance with standards.
• Analysis, Commentary & Advisory: Analyze financial results to investigate variances and provide clear, actionable insights to management. You will interpret and communicate financial data effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.
• Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Team Development: Support the growth of the team through coaching, reviewing work, and contributing to cross-functional initiatives and global projects.
• Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements and support automation initiatives to increase the efficiency of the Record-to-Report flow. Who you are: You are a highly analytical finance professional with a strong attention to detail, capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment to meet tight deadlines. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance , or a related field. A professional certification ( CPA, ACCA , or equivalent) is preferred.
• Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of experience in accounting or finance. Prior experience in a Finance Shared Services environment is preferred. Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is a plus.
• Technical Skills: * Strong knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS .
• Experience with ERP systems, specifically SAP (FI, CO/PA, MM, FA, FCC) and BlackLine is highly desirable.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace.
• Languages: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English and Spanish .
• Core Competencies: * Strong stakeholder management and collaboration abilities.
• Problem-solving mindset with a focus on process automation and continuous improvement.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, toget

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is within Biostatistics, a core function within Product Development Data Science and Analytics (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. Biostatistics identifies opportunities to apply the full breadth of data, digital, and design capabilities to deploy innovative methods across PDD, PD and the broader Roche Pharma organization. As trusted analytical partners in end-to-end drug development, Biostatistics leverages data to drive scientifically rigorous programmatic decisions across Roche’s Development portfolio; Biostatistics designs robust trials and analysis plans that increase the probability of technical success, accelerating timelines to advance Roche’s clinical pipeline and promote regulatory success — ultimately bringing medicines to our patients faster. The Opportunity:
• Independently drive statistical contributions to clinical trial design, ensuring strict alignment with scientific objectives and study endpoints.
• Deliver and quality-review critical statistical study documents, including comprehensive statistical analysis plans and protocols.
• Design and perform sophisticated data analyses, proactively identifying potential challenges and implementing robust statistical solutions.
• Serve as the functional expert for Biostatistics and PDD at the Study Team level, ensuring scientific and statistical rigor across all deliverables.
• Partner proactively with global cross-functional teams to align project deliverables, timelines, and strategic clinical goals.
• Interpret, contextualize, and clearly communicate analysis results to cross-functional stakeholders, directly influencing study-level decisions.
• Provide functional guidance, scientific leadership, and informal mentoring to less experienced statisticians within a matrix organization. Who you are: You are a strategic, independent thinker who thrives on solving complex technical challenges while keeping the bigger picture in mind. You enjoy collaborating in multicultural global environments and possess a unique ability to translate intricate data concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• An MSc or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a closely related quantitative field.
• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in clinical trial statistics within a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO setting, ideally spanning multiple phases of drug development (early and late stage).
• A solid understanding of regulatory expectations, statistical methodologies for clinical development, and familiarity with CDISC standards.
• Hands-on experience and proficiency in SAS and/or R programming languages.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to present complex technical concepts clearly and influence senior stakeholders.
• Demonstrated agility, problem-solving skills, and a track record of working autonomously while fostering strong, inclusive relationships in a global workplace. Relocation Benefits are not available for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 115,328.00 and 151,368.00 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role. This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Dies ist eine aufregende Zeit, um dem Roche Support Network beizutreten. Wenn Sie sich für Problemlösungen begeistern, ist dies die richtige Position für Sie! Als forschungsorientiertes Gesundheitsunternehmen entdeckt, entwickelt und bietet Roche innovative Diagnostik- und Therapieprodukte und -dienstleistungen an, die Patienten und medizinischem Fachpersonal erhebliche Vorteile bieten - von der Früherkennung und Prävention von Krankheiten bis hin zu Diagnose, Behandlung und Behandlungsüberwachung. Roche ist ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen, das spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten bieten kann. Wir fördern und unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung in Bereichen Ihres Interesses, die Sie auf die nächste Stufe Ihres Karrierewegs vorbereiten. Wir wissen, dass Menschen für unseren Erfolg verantwortlich sind und schätzen unsere Mitarbeiter. Unser Engagement ist es, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem das Gefühl, geschätzt, respektiert und ermächtigt zu werden, eine tägliche Erfahrung ist. Als Spezialist für Feldanwendungen sind Sie ein wichtiges Mitglied unseres Kundensupport-Teams als primärer wissenschaftlicher und technischer Vertreter im Gebiet Memphis/Nord-Missippi für Roche-Systeme in Kundenlabors im Bereich Core Lab. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung eines erstklassigen Kundensupports vor Ort, einschließlich Aktivitäten wie Anwendungsimplementierung, Bedienerschulungen und Fehlerbehebung für Diagnosegeräte und Assays während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Die Gelegenheit:
• Aufbau und Pflege starker, kooperativer Beziehungen zu den Kundenstakeholdern, um ein hohes Maß an Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten und Wert im Laborbetrieb des Kunden zu schaffen. Konsultieren Sie die Kunden zu den Laboranforderungen und agieren Sie als Partner, indem Sie den Kunden während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus unterstützen, was die Unterstützung von Produktupgrades und anderen Änderungen umfassen kann.
• Durchführung und/oder Unterstützung bei der Installation komplexer Diagnoseinstrumente, Software und Reagenzanwendungen in Kundenlabors. Validierung der Systemleistung, um sicherzustellen, dass sie den Herstellerspezifikationen entspricht. Gewährleistung einer effektiven und kohärenten Anwendung der neu installierten Lösungen.
• Bereitstellung und in einigen Fällen Entwicklung einer umfassenden Schulung des Laborpersonals vor Ort zur ordnungsgemäßen Verwendung und Wartung von Roche-Systemen, einschließlich Betriebstheorie, Workflow, Qualitätskontrolle und Dateninterpretation.
• Handeln Sie als primäre Vor-Ort-Ressource zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Instrumentierung, Software und Assay-Leistung. Führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse durch und implementieren Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen, um die Ausfallzeiten der Instrumente zu minimieren. Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Roche-Teammitgliedern bei der Implementierung und Unterstützung von Gesamtlösungen wie Automatisierung, digitalen Tools usw.
• Bereitstellung von wissenschaftlicher und anwendungsbezogener Expertise für Laborbeteiligte (darunter könnten Vorgesetzte, Manager, Direktoren, Technologen) und medizinische Fachkräfte (darunter Pathologen, Ärzte) und Unterstützung bei der Sicherstellung eines zusammenhängenden Laborbetriebs durch Optimierung von Workflows, Implementierung neuer Assays und Interpretation der Ergebnisse für das Roche-Portfolio.
• Als Kundenverbindung dienen und Feedback von Kunden zu Produktleistung, Funktionen und Benutzerfreundlichkeit sammeln und diese Informationen dann an Support- und Vertriebsteams weiterleiten, um einen Wettbewerbsvorteil zu erhalten.
• Partnerschaft mit dem Verkaufsteam und Nutzung von fundiertem technischem Wissen während Pre-Sales-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Produktdemonstrationen, technischer Beratungen, Menüoptimierung und anderer Möglichkeiten zur Umsatzgenerierung nach dem Verkauf.
• Gewährleistung einer konsistenten Kundenerfahrung, indem Sie Roche folgen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position C'est une période passionnante pour rejoindre le réseau de soutien Roche. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes alors c'est la position pour vous! En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre succès et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne. En tant que spécialiste des applications sur le terrain, vous serez un membre clé de notre équipe de soutien à la clientèle en tant que principal représentant scientifique et technique dans la région de Memphis/Northern Mississippi pour les systèmes Roche dans les laboratoires clients de l'espace Core Lab. Vous serez responsable de fournir le meilleur en classe de soutien à la clientèle sur place, y compris des activités telles que la mise en œuvre d'applications, la formation des opérateurs et le dépannage pour l'instrumentation diagnostique et les essais tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. La possibilité :
• Établir et maintenir des relations solides et collaboratives avec les parties prenantes du client, en assurant un niveau élevé de satisfaction du client et en créant de la valeur dans les opérations du laboratoire du client. Consulter les clients sur les besoins des laboratoires et agir en tant que partenaire en appuyant le client tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, ce qui pourrait inclure des améliorations du produit et d'autres changements.
• Effectuer et/ou aider à l'installation d'instruments de diagnostic complexes, de logiciels et d'applications de réactif dans les laboratoires clients. Valider la performance du système pour s'assurer qu'il répond aux spécifications du fabricant. Assurer l'application efficace et cohérente des solutions nouvellement installées.
• Fournir et, dans certains cas, développer une formation complète sur place au personnel de laboratoire sur l'utilisation et la maintenance correctes des systèmes Roche, y compris la théorie de l'exploitation, le flux de travail, le contrôle de la qualité et l'interprétation des données.
• Être la principale ressource sur place pour résoudre les problèmes techniques complexes liés à l'instrumentation, aux logiciels et aux performances d'essai. Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt des instruments. Partenaire avec d'autres membres de l'équipe Roche pour mettre en œuvre et soutenir des solutions complètes, telles que l'automatisation, les outils numériques, etc.
• Fournir une expertise scientifique et des applications aux parties prenantes du laboratoire (y compris les superviseurs, les gestionnaires, les directeurs, les technologues) et aux professionnels de la santé (y compris les pathologistes, les médecins), les aider à assurer la cohérence des opérations de laboratoire en optimisant les flux de travail, en mettant en oeuvre de nouveaux tests et en interprétant les résultats pour le portefeuille de Roche.
• Servir de liaison avec le client et recueillir les commentaires des clients sur les performances, les caractéristiques et la facilité d'utilisation du produit, puis transmettre ces informations aux équipes de soutien et commerciales, en maintenant un avantage concurrentiel.
• S'associer à l'équipe de vente et tirer parti de connaissances techniques approfondies lors des activités préventes, y compris les démonstrations de produits, les consultations techniques, l'optimisation des menus et d'autres occasions de générer des revenus après les ventes.
• Assurer une expérience client cohérente en suivant Roche

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como parte de la cadena de suministro local de Roche Diagnostics, el especialista, la planificación y optimización de la cadena de suministro desempeña un papel importante en la entrega al garantizar a nuestros clientes niveles superiores de disponibilidad de productos y, al mismo tiempo, cumplir con los objetivos financieros de Roche (inventario, niveles de cancelación y costos de logística). Entiende los requisitos del cliente dentro de un entorno de mercado en constante cambio y, en consecuencia, crea o redefine procesos mediante la incorporación de soluciones innovadoras de cadena de suministro, con el fin de ofrecer una ventaja competitiva y ejecutar los diversos planes de acción con base en los requerimientos comerciales y de mercadotecnia así como en las políticas locales y globales con el objetivo de facilitar el abastecimiento del producto y la toma de decisiones a la coordinación y áreas relacionadas de las divisiones Diagnóstica. (IVD) Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
• Proporcionar el estimado de la demanda de los reactivos y consumibles planeados por logística en conjunto con el área comercial y mercadotecnia, analizando los reportes estadísticos previos del comportamiento de ventas.
• Crear el forecast para el área comercial y mercadotecnia previamente planeado en meses anteriores, analizando mensualmente reportes DP Light forecast accuracy por producto
• Actualizar el ERP (SAP) Maestro de Materiales módulo de planificación (MPS/MRP), analizando cada 4 o 6 meses los reportes para los productos mediante DP Light, revisando los atributos de ABC code, reorder point, safety stock, rounding value, quantity per tray.
• Ejecutar las estrategias de abastecimiento realizadas por el área, elaborando la requisición de compra y dando seguimiento al embarque con el área de compras hasta su llegada al almacén.
• Programar la Demanda de Instrumentos de acuerdo al programa anual de Instrument Placement, así como la coordinación de rutas de entrega a nivel nacional a usuarios finales.
• Liderar la gestión de la demanda de estándares, introducción/salida, lanzamientos/discontinuaciones, instalaciones/desinstalaciones.
• Optimizar la disponibilidad del producto (parte del cálculo de OTIF), la precisión de las previsiones, el inventario y los niveles de cancelación.
• Asegurar una información constante y transparente flujo entre las áreas comerciales locales y la cadena de suministro global
• Investiga continuamente las tendencias y las causas raíz de los problemas de suministro por área comercial, centro de ganancias y nivel de producto.
• Identifica soluciones, brinda recomendaciones e inicia iniciativas de mejora.
• Asegurar la configuración óptima de los parámetros de planificación. Tu perfil:
• Licenciatura en carreras de logística / planeación o Ingeniero Industrial
• Experiencia en Planeación de Demanda y Gestión de Materiales dentro de la industria de IVD (In Vitro Diagnostica), BOMs Maquilas
• Conocimientos básicos en compras, procesos de importación, trato con almacén, conocimiento en estratégias de abastecimiento, conocimiento de S & OP.
• Conocimiento en altas y mantenimientos de Datos maestros de Materiales.

• Optimizar la disponibilidad del producto (parte del cálculo de OTIF), la precisión de las previsiones, el inventario y los niveles de cancelación.

• Investiga continuamente las tendencias y las causas raíz de los problemas de suministro por área comercial, centro de ganancias y nivel de producto.
• Identifica soluciones, brinda recomendaciones e inicia iniciativas de mejora.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione Unisciti al team di piccole-molecole all'interno di AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), precedentemente Prescient Design, presso il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Roche e Genentech come scienziato di apprendimento della macchina / scienziato di apprendimento della macchina senior nella pianificazione e ottimizzazione della sintesi. Costruirete metodi ML che progettano molecole che possiamo effettivamente fare — chiudendo il ciclo tra progettazione generativa e sintesi automatizzata. L'opportunità:
• Sviluppare e avanzare metodi di apprendimento automatico per la progettazione molecolare di sintesi-aware attraverso la retrosintesi, la pianificazione della sintesi, la generazione molecolare e la ricerca in spazi chimici sintetizzabili.
• Integrare la reazione proprietaria e i dati biochimici per progettare la prossima generazione di modelli e flussi di lavoro per la ricerca e l'ottimizzazione dei risultati.
• Costruire tubazioni robuste e scalabili per loop di apprendimento attivo che si interfacciano direttamente con piattaforme di sintesi automatizzate e ad alto rendimento.
• Progettare nuovi algoritmi di sintesi batch che massimizzano la copertura chimica-spazio, il guadagno di informazioni e l'efficienza sperimentale.
• Guidare l'impatto scientifico attraverso pubblicazioni, comunicati open source e conferenze. Chi sei:
• Porti una profonda esperienza di machine-learning con una forte base in algebra lineare, probabilità e ottimizzazione, e l'esperienza hands-on in moderni approcci di machine learning come reti di grafi-neurali, modelli di sequenza/lingua e apprendimento di rinforzo.
• Conosci i concetti di chimica rilevanti per la pianificazione della sintesi e l'ottimizzazione molecolare, nonché i piccoli strumenti di dati molecolari e cheminformatics come RDKit o Openeye.
• Sei fluente in Python e hai esperienza con i moderni framework ML come PyTorch o JAX e lo sviluppo di software scientifico.
• Ha una profondità di ricerca di dottorato o equivalente nell'apprendimento automatico, nella chimica computazionale, nell'ingegneria chimica o in un campo quantitativo correlato come la fisica o le statistiche.
• Hai un record di eccellenza scientifica evidenziato da pubblicazioni di riviste e conferenze o un portafoglio pubblico di progetti rilevanti (ad esempio ospitato su GitHub/GitLab). Preferito:
• Esperienza con modelli di retrosintesi o di sintesi.
• Esperienza con sintesi automatizzata/alta produttività. Se la progettazione di molecole che si spostano dallo schermo alla sintesi di pazienti ti eccita, applica ora e aiuta a costruire scoperta auto-guida a Roche. L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione primaria della California per l'Ingegnere di Apprendimento della Macchina è di $147.600, - $274,000, e l'Ingegnere di Apprendimento Della Macchina Senior per la California è di $167.400 - $310,800. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione si qualifica anche per i benefici dettagliati al link sottostante. Vantaggi #ComputationCoE #tech4lifeComputationalScienza #tech4lifeAI Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è San Francisco. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Genentech è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra politica e la nostra pratica di impiegare, promuovere e trattare in altro modo tutti i dipendenti e i richiedenti sulla base del merito, delle qualifiche e delle competenze. La politica dell'azienda vieta la discriminazione illecita, inclusa ma non limitata, la discriminazione sulla base dello status di Veteran protetto, degli individui con disabilità, e coerente con tutte le leggi federali, statali o locali. Se hai una disabilità e hai bisogno di un alloggio in relazione al processo di applicazione online, contattaci compilando questo modulo Alloggi per i candidati .
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Position Join the small-molecule team within AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), formerly Prescient Design, at Roche and Genentech’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Synthesis Planning and Optimization. You will build ML methods that design molecules we can actually make — closing the loop between generative design and automated synthesis. The Opportunity:
• Develop and advance machine learning methods for synthesis-aware molecular design across retrosynthesis, synthesis planning, molecular generation, and search in synthesizable chemical spaces.
• Integrate proprietary reaction and biochemical data to design the next generation of synthesis-aware models and workflows for hit finding and optimisation.
• Build robust, scalable pipelines for active-learning loops that interface directly with automated and high-throughput synthesis platforms.
• Design novel batch synthesis-planning algorithms that maximise chemical-space coverage, information gain and experimental efficiency.
• Drive scientific impact through publications, open-source releases, and conference talks.
• Collaborate widely with computational and experimental researchers at Roche and with academic partners. Who you are:
• You bring deep machine-learning expertise with a strong foundation in linear algebra, probability and optimization, and hands-on experience in modern machine learning approaches such as graph-neural networks, sequence/language models and reinforcement learning.
• You are familiar with chemistry concepts relevant to synthesis planning and molecular optimisation as well as small molecule data and cheminformatics toolkits such as RDKit or Openeye.
• You are fluent in Python and have experience with modern ML frameworks like PyTorch or JAX as well as scientific software development.
• You hold a PhD or equivalent research depth in machine learning, computational chemistry, chemical engineering or a related quantitative field such as physics or statistics.
• You have a record of scientific excellence evidenced by journal and conference publications or a public portfolio of relevant projects (e.g. hosted on GitHub/GitLab).. Preferred:
• Experience with retrosynthesis or synthesis-planning models.
• Experience with automated/high-throughput synthesis. If designing molecules that move from screen to synthesis to patients excites you, apply now and help build self-driving discovery at Roche. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California for the Machine Learning Engineer is $147,600, - $274,000, and the Senior Machine Learning Engineer for California is $167,400 - $310,800. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Position Treten Sie dem Small-Molekül-Team von AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), ehemals Prescient Design, bei Roche und Genentechs Computational Sciences Center of Excellence als Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Synthesis Planning and Optimization bei. Sie werden ML-Methoden entwickeln, die Moleküle entwerfen, die wir tatsächlich herstellen können - die Schleife zwischen generativem Design und automatisierter Synthese schließen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung maschineller Lernmethoden für synthesebewusstes molekulares Design über Retrosynthese, Syntheseplanung, molekulare Erzeugung und Suche in synthetisierbaren chemischen Räumen.
• Integrieren Sie proprietäre Reaktions- und biochemische Daten, um die nächste Generation synthesebewusster Modelle und Workflows für die Treffersuche und -optimierung zu entwerfen.
• Bauen Sie robuste, skalierbare Pipelines für aktive Lernschleifen, die direkt mit automatisierten und hochdurchsatzfähigen Syntheseplattformen verbunden sind.
• Entwicklung neuartiger Algorithmen zur Batchsyntheseplanung, die die Abdeckung des chemischen Raums, den Informationsgewinn und die experimentelle Effizienz maximieren.
• Förderung der wissenschaftlichen Wirkung durch Publikationen, Open-Source-Veröffentlichungen und Konferenzgespräche. Wer du bist:
• Sie bringen tiefes Machine-Learning-Know-how mit einer starken Grundlage in linearer Algebra, Wahrscheinlichkeit und Optimierung sowie praktische Erfahrung in modernen Machine-Learning-Ansätzen wie Graphen-Neuronalen-Netzwerken, Sequenz- / Sprachmodellen und Verstärkungslernen mit.
• Sie kennen chemische Konzepte, die für die Syntheseplanung und Molekularoptimierung relevant sind, sowie niedermolekulare Daten und Cheminformatik-Toolkits wie RDKit oder Openeye.
• Sie sprechen fließend Python und haben Erfahrung mit modernen ML-Frameworks wie PyTorch oder JAX sowie wissenschaftlicher Softwareentwicklung.
• Sie haben einen Doktortitel oder eine gleichwertige Forschungstiefe in maschinellem Lernen, Computerchemie, Chemietechnik oder einem verwandten quantitativen Bereich wie Physik oder Statistik.
• Sie haben eine Aufzeichnung wissenschaftlicher Exzellenz, die durch Zeitschriften- und Konferenzpublikationen oder ein öffentliches Portfolio relevanter Projekte belegt ist (z. B. gehostet auf GitHub / GitLab). Bevorzugt:
• Erfahrung mit Retrosynthese- oder Syntheseplanungsmodellen.
• Erfahrung mit automatisierter/Hochdurchsatzsynthese. Wenn das Entwerfen von Molekülen, die sich vom Bildschirm über die Synthese bis hin zu Patienten bewegen, Sie begeistert, bewerben Sie sich jetzt und helfen Sie bei Roche, selbstfahrende Entdeckungen zu machen. Die erwartete Gehaltsspanne für diese Position basiert auf dem primären Standort von Kalifornien für den Machine Learning Engineer ist $ 147.600, - $ 274.000, und der Senior Machine Learning Engineer für Kalifornien ist $ 167.400 - $ 310.800. Die tatsächliche Bezahlung wird auf der Grundlage von Erfahrung, Qualifikationen, geografischer Lage und anderen gesetzlich zulässigen arbeitsbezogenen Faktoren festgelegt. Ein diskretionärer Jahresbonus kann auf der Grundlage der Leistung des Einzelnen und des Unternehmens verfügbar sein. descriptionByLocale.fr:
La position Rejoignez l'équipe de petites molécules de l'IA for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), anciennement Prescient Design, au Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles Roche et Genentech, en tant que scientifique en apprentissage automatique / scientifique en apprentissage automatique senior en planification et optimisation de synthèse. Vous allez construire des méthodes ML que nous pouvons réellement faire pour concevoir des molécules, en fermant la boucle entre conception générative et synthèse automatisée. La possibilité :
• Développer et faire progresser les méthodes d'apprentissage automatique pour la conception moléculaire de synthèse-sensibilisée à travers la rétrosynthèse, la planification de synthèse, la génération moléculaire, et la recherche dans les espaces chimiques synthésisables.
• Intégrer les données de réaction exclusive et biochimiques pour concevoir la prochaine génération de modèles et de flux de travail synthétisés pour la recherche et l'optimisation des résultats.
• Construisez des pipelines robustes et évolutifs pour les boucles d'apprentissage actif qui s'interfacent directement avec les plateformes de synthèse automatisées et à haut débit.
• Concevoir de nouveaux algorithmes de planification de synthèse par lots qui maximisent la couverture de l'espace chimique, le gain d'information et l'efficacité expérimentale.
• Conduire l'impact scientifique au moyen de publications, de publications en libre accès et de conférences. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous apportez une expertise en apprentissage machine profonde avec une base solide en algèbre linéaire, probabilité et optimisation, et une expérience pratique dans les approches modernes d'apprentissage machine comme les réseaux graph-neuraux, les modèles de séquence/langue et l'apprentissage du renforcement.
• Vous connaissez les concepts de chimie pertinents pour la planification de la synthèse et l'optimisation moléculaire, ainsi que les données sur les petites molécules et les outils de chimie tels que RDKit ou Openeye.
• Vous maîtrisez couramment le Python et avez de l'expérience avec des cadres ML modernes comme PyTorch ou JAX ainsi que le développement de logiciels scientifiques.
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat ou d'une recherche équivalente en apprentissage automatique, en chimie informatique, en génie chimique ou dans un domaine quantitatif connexe, comme la physique ou la statistique.
• Vous disposez d'un record d'excellence scientifique attesté par des publications de revues et de conférences ou d'un portefeuille public de projets pertinents (par exemple hébergés sur GitHub/GitLab). Préféré:
• Expérience des modèles de rétrosynthèse ou de planification de synthèse.
• Expérience de la synthèse automatisée/haut débit. Si la conception de molécules qui passent de l'écran à la synthèse vous excite, appliquez maintenant et aidez à construire la découverte autoconduite à Roche. L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste en fonction de l'emplacement principal de la Californie pour l'ingénieur d'apprentissage automatique est de 147 600 $, - 274 000 $, et l'ingénieur principal d'apprentissage automatique pour la Californie est de 167 400 $ - 310 800 $. La rémunération réelle sera déterminée en fonction de l'expérience, des qualifications, de l'emplacement géographique et d'autres facteurs liés à l'emploi permis par la loi. Avantages #CoE de calcul #tech4lifeScience computationnelle #tech4lifeAI Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est San Francisco. La politique de l'entreprise interdit la discrimination illégale, y compris, sans s'y limiter, la discrimination fondée sur le statut d'ancien combattant protégé, le statut de personne handicapée et conforme à toutes les lois fédérales, nationales ou locales. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Deine Abteilung Wir als Roche Pharma AG wollen den Wandel der Gesundheitsbranche aktiv mitgestalten, Patient:innen schnellen Zugang zu unseren Therapien ermöglichen und Menschen helfen, gesund zu bleiben. Dafür gestalten wir die Art und Weise unserer Zusammenarbeit anders, um Ressourcen und Kompetenzen übergreifend und schnell dort einzusetzen, wo der größte Bedarf besteht. Unsere Satellite Community ist der zentrale Dreh- und Angelpunkt für alle administrativen Ressourcen der Roche Pharma AG. Wir bilden ein dynamisches Netzwerk, das sich als aktiver Mitgestalter versteht und die Fachbereiche als kompetente Lösungspartner unterstützt. Unser Ziel ist es, durch unternehmerisches Denken und eine konsequente Kundenorientierung die Fachabteilungen zu entlasten und zu stärken. In der Satellite Community bündeln wir Expertise, fördern den Wissensaustausch und setzen durch den Einsatz neuer Technologien neue Standards in der Prozessoptimierung. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
• Selbständige Bearbeitung komplexer administrativer und operativer Vorgänge (z. B. Einkauf, Vertragswesen, Materialmanagement etc.) sowie deren kontinuierliche Optimierung
• Konzeption und Koordination von komplexen Meetings und Agenden sowie Begleitung von lokalen und globalen Initiativen und Team-Onboardings
• Erstellung von Analysen, Dashboards und Entscheidungsvorlagen in Deutsch und Englisch zur Unterstützung der Maßnahmenumsetzung
• Professionelle Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen internen und externen Partnern sowie proaktive Beantwortung von Kundenanfragen
• Einsatz von KI-Tools zur Effizienzsteigerung, eigenständige Leitung und Moderation von Projekten und Teilprojekten sowie Impulsgeber für neue digitale Tools Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit mind. einjähriger Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position; Branchenkenntnisse (Pharma, Digital Health) sind ein starkes Plus
• Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Leitung von Projekten oder Workstreams sowie in der Anleitung von Kolleg:innen
• Schnelle Auffassungsgabe für komplexe Sachverhalte sowie verhandlungssichere Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch
• Hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative, Flexibilität und Teamgeist gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld eigenständig Entscheidungen zu treffen
• Sicherer Umgang mit der G-Suite sowie Erfahrung mit KI-Tools; Kenntnisse in Systemen wie SAP, Veeva PromoMats sind vorteilhaft Diese Position ist eine Teilzeitstelle auf 18 Monate befristet. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life

title: Web Access Management Engineer - RDT Identity & Access Management

titleByLocale.it: Web Access Management Ingegnere - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.en: Web Access Management Engineer - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.de: Web Access Management Ingenieur - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.fr: Web Access Management Ingénieur - RDT Identity & Access Management

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Web Access Management Engineer specializing in Authentication, you will be a core member of our Identity and Access Management product team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining secure and seamless authentication experiences for our enterprise on-prem and SaaS platforms. You will play a crucial role in integrating and implementing various authentication and authorization protocols, ensuring our applications are protected against evolving cyber threats while delivering a frictionless user experience. The Opportunity Responsibilities Authentication & Authorization Implementation
• Design, test, and deploy reusable authentication and authorization components across the enterprise while adhering to security best practices and architectural guidelines
• Implement enterprise IAM solutions and integrate with identity providers (IdPs) using protocols like SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) to support Single Sign-On (SSO)
• Implement and manage secure MFA mechanisms, including exploring and deploying passwordless authentication solutions to enhance user security
• Develop hands-on experience with token-based authentication (JWT), session management, and secure communication via RESTful APIs and HTTP/HTTPS API Security & Backend Integration
• Collaborate with backend developers to define and implement robust API security measures, including token validation and authorization mechanisms
• Ensure secure integration across authentication flows and establish security standards for token handling and authorization frameworks Production Support & Incident Management
• Apply ITIL principles to troubleshoot authentication issues in production environments and participate in change management processes
• Work with security teams to mitigate authentication vulnerabilities and perform root-cause analysis on authentication-related incidents
• Investigate security incidents and perform vulnerability assessments on authentication systems Continuous Learning & Evolution
• Stay updated on cutting-edge authentication technologies, security threats, and industry best practices to continuously improve security systems
• Demonstrate a mindset of continuous improvement with a proactive approach to identifying solution-level issues, gaps, or inefficiencies
• Contribute to minor process improvements within your immediate scope and identify opportunities for technical refinement Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication
• Work closely with product managers, security engineers, and developers to create secure and user-friendly authentication flows that meet business and technical requirements
• Identify key business, technical, and security stakeholders for assigned tasks, analyzing their needs and interests regarding security posture and risk
• Develop and deliver tailored communication for security tasks and incident updates
• Facilitate meetings and proactively engage with stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and validate security requirements Feature Development & Reliability
• Develop and maintain reliable and scalable authentication and authorization features to ensure the adoption of security best practices across the organization
• Contribute to projects by providing well-analyzed requirements and supporting the design of solutions that align with business objectives
• Translate requirements into strategic plans with appropriate oversight and demonstrate growing autonomy within your domain Who You Are Experience & Education
• 3-5 years o

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. That’s what drives us. We are looking for a Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP) at Roche Diagnostics to serve as key business partner to the commercial organization and report to Finance Enterprise Partner Lead. As a FEP, you leverage your in-depth business understanding combined with financial expertise in driving initiatives forward that are critical to delivering our commercial strategy. The FEP builds networks across the organization (including the Finance Excellence Partner), to share best practices and co-create solutions that generate value for the affiliate, the enterprise and the customer. As FEP, you are a trusted thought partner to business stakeholders and have close contact with customers, where you will ensure efficient resource allocation and maximum impact along the customer journey. Key Responsibilities
• You partner with the business and support or co-lead touchpoints alongside the customer journey with an enterprise mindset.
• You balance resource allocation across competing priorities and provide advice on financial implications of proposed business activities.
• You are a key partner for developing a coherent affiliate commercial strategy as well as commercial business related processes such as business planning, opportunity prioritization and creative strategies for revenue generation.
• You ensure financials are on track to achieve targeted business results and metrics, or advise on deviations and corrective actions.
• You participate in FEP communities to learn, share and implement best practices across markets.
• You support the business and customers in co-creating new business models, quantifying value, and providing pricing transparency. Who You Are
• You possess advanced controlling and reporting skills and expertly manage SAP Finance, as well as BO Analysis and/ or BEx Analyzer and Tableau Software.
• You have an entrepreneurial, commercial and customer centric mindset with an ability to put all available financial and operational information into a holistic picture.
• You have strong business and financial acumen and experience working with and for the customer.
• You are actively seeking input and building relationships with other stakeholders in the ecosystem.
• You are able to navigate a complex, challenging environment based on agile principles.
• You are fluent in English and Turkish. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
