descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a skilled and motivated Technical Scrum Master to support the delivery and continuous improvement of complex technology services and products within an enterprise environment. The successful candidate will combine strong Scrum Master capabilities with solid technical understanding, enabling effective delivery across cross-functional teams including engineering, business analysis, testing, architecture, infrastructure, and operations. This role focuses on agile delivery excellence, dependency management, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement in technically complex landscapes. Key Responsibilities Agile Delivery Leadership
• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
• Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, fostering accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.
• Support teams in delivering high-quality outcomes aligned with business priorities and roadmap commitments.
• Promote predictable delivery through effective planning, estimation, and capacity management. Technical Delivery Coordination
• Work closely with developers, testers, architects, analysts, product owners, and support teams to coordinate delivery across technical workstreams.
• Understand technical dependencies across applications, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems.
• Help teams manage blockers, risks, release readiness, and cross-team dependencies.
• Support delivery of infrastructure, integration, CIAM, platform, and application initiatives where required. Stakeholder Management and Governance
• Communicate progress, risks, impediments, milestones, and delivery options to technical and business stakeholders.
• Prepare concise status reporting, dashboards, and governance materials.
• Facilitate alignment between product, engineering, operations, security, and business functions.
• Drive action tracking and decision follow-up across multiple stakeholder groups. Operational and Service Management Alignment
• Coordinate with support and operational teams to ensure smooth releases and post-deployment readiness.
• Support change, release, incident, and problem management processes where applicable.
• Help ensure delivery aligns with enterprise controls, documentation, and audit expectations.
• Promote DevOps and operational ownership mindsets across teams. Continuous Improvement
• Identify delivery inefficiencies, recurring blockers, and improvement opportunities.
• Use metrics such as velocity, lead time, cycle time, defects, and predictability to improve team performance.
• Foster a culture of learning, accountability, and engineering excellence.
• Support scaling Agile practices across multiple teams where relevant. Qualifications Education
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued. Experience
• Proven experience as a Scrum Master, Technical Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or similar role.
• Experience working with software engineering, testing, infrastructure, integration, or digital product teams.
• Experience operating in complex enterprise environments with multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
• Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, finance, or similar sectors is highly valued. Technical Skills
• Strong understanding of Agile frameworks including

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The CXSD (Customer Experience and Solution Design) team at Roche Diagnostics is seeking a passionate Product Designer Intern. The ideal candidate will possess knowledge of Graphical User Interface Design and experience with electronics integration in physical products (e.g., Arduino/Electronics). As an Interaction Designer Intern, you will support product design teams on different projects and design tasks. You will learn how senior designers translate business/technical requirements and user needs into design decisions. You will experience how to navigate and apply a complex design system to Graphical User Interfaces. You will grasp how to design for customer centricity by validating your design output through continuous user testing. Last but not least, you will be part of a design team of more than 80 professionals who aim to transform the healthcare industry for the better. The Opportunity
• Working on projects with focus on making healthcare professionals work life more safe and easy
• Building and orchestrating user experiences beyond screens
• Being involved in ideating, building, iterating and preparing user experiences until hand-over stage for engineers to integrate it in a product
• Support usability testings with planning, preparation, conducting and analyzing activities
• Learn how to involve different persons from business roles to engineering to test participants and more to build the best UX ever
• Building software and Arduino prototypes
• Integrate electronics for human interaction and machine feedback into medium-high-ultra fidelity physical prototypes/mockups
• Joining a highly motivated and very kind team
• There will be at least one business trip to Germany Who You Are
• EU/EFTA Students: You are currently enrolled in your Bachelor's studies or a Master’s program in Computer Science, UX design, Human Computer Interaction Design, visual design or technical science or similar
• Non-EU/EFTA students: Due to regulations, you have to provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory and upload it together with your application documents. Furthermore, you have to be enrolled during the entire internship period.
• You have experience with Figma (showcasing a project is required)
• You have experience with Arduino and processing (showcasing a project is required)
• You have skills in design for User Experience, User Interfaces and User Interaction with hardware and software projects,
• You are fluent in English Additional Information
• The internship will take place in Rotkreuz, Switzerland.
• The preferred start date of the internship is August 2026 or upon availability for 12 months.
• Part-time employment is not possible.
• This internship is not suitable for a Master's thesis.

title: Technical CIAM Tester - RDT Identity & Access Management

titleByLocale.it: Tester tecnico CIAM - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.en: Technical CIAM Tester - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.de: Technischer CIAM Tester - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.fr: Testeur technique CIAM - RDT Gestion de l'identité et de l'accès

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Tester with experience in Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) to support the quality assurance and continuous improvement of customer identity services. The successful candidate will be responsible for validating secure, scalable, and seamless CIAM solutions across customer registration, authentication, consent, profile management, integrations, and access journeys. This role combines technical testing, defect analysis, stakeholder collaboration, compliance awareness, and delivery support within a complex enterprise environment. Key Responsibilities Test Planning and Execution
• Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, and test data.
• Execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing for CIAM services and connected applications.
• Validate customer journeys such as registration, login, password reset, profile updates, consent capture, MFA, and account recovery.
• Support release readiness through structured planning, execution, and reporting of test activities. Technical and Integration Testing
• Validate APIs, webhooks, SSO flows, federation integrations, and downstream system interactions.
• Test identity protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
• Verify data flows, profile synchronization, consent records, and access behavior across integrated systems.
• Support testing of CIAM platform changes in SAP Customer Data Cloud (SAP CDC) and connected enterprise environments.
• Support non-functional testing activities such as reliability, resilience, and performance coordination where required. Defect Management and Quality Assurance
• Identify, document, reproduce, and track defects with clear evidence and technical detail.
• Work closely with engineers, analysts, and product teams to prioritize and resolve issues efficiently.
• Perform retesting and regression validation following defect remediation.
• Promote quality standards, traceability, and risk-based testing practices. Governance, Compliance, and Service Processes
• Support testing activities aligned with GxP expectations, Computer System Validation (CSV) frameworks, and internal quality standards where applicable.
• Contribute to audit evidence, validation documentation, and control traceability.
• Work within IT service management processes including incident, problem, change, and release management.
• Support operational workflows and testing coordination through ServiceNow. Collaboration and Delivery Support
• Work closely with developers, architects, business analysts, product owners, and support teams.
• Participate in sprint ceremonies, planning sessions, refinement meetings, and release activities.
• Communicate testing progress, quality risks, blockers, and recommendations to stakeholders.
• Support production validation activities after deployments where required. Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, test data management, and testing efficiency.
• Contribute to automation initiatives and reusable testing assets.
• Stay informed on CIAM trends, identity standards, and evolving customer expectations. Qualifications Education
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued. Experience
• Proven experience as a Technical Tester, QA Engineer, Test Analyst,

Position summary : As a Quote to Contract (Q2C) Business Support Analyst, you provide global end-user support on systems, applications, information management, and Q2C business processes, resolving process-related support requests (e.g., tool handling, business logic, workflow, content availability, and consistency issues). The Opportunity:
• Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of incidents, requests, and tasks in line with global processes, keeping end users informed, monitoring applications/systems daily, and proactively identifying and resolving issues.
• Collaborate closely with business/end users, internal/external teams, Business Process Management, Service Owners, Product Owners and global resolver teams to deliver the fastest, best-quality fixes and minimize impact on operations, end users, and patients.
• Drive continuous improvement by contributing to process optimization and innovation, resolving complex technical issues, handling escalations, and creating, updating, and decommissioning knowledge articles and SOPs and other internal documentation, including organizing trainings and knowledge transfer.
• Commit to continuous self-learning to stay current with new services and technologies, enhance technical expertise as business needs evolve, and consistently meet individual and team KPIs and metrics to ensure a seamless customer experience and act on feedback for improvement. Who you are
• University/College education (preferably Business, Business Informatics, Engineering or similar) and 1–2 years’ experience in customer service-related roles, with strong English communication skills (additional languages an asset) and comfort working autonomously in virtual, global teams.
• Strong customer-oriented mindset with high accountability and results/goal orientation: takes ownership of end-to-end resolution, manages multiple priorities in a fast-paced, changing environment, and maintains composure, persistence, and proactivity.
• Good understanding of IT solution components, their interactions, and data flows; familiarity with Q2C/O2C management processes and workflows; ITIL Service Management knowledge and/or experience with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) strongly preferred.
• Excellent organizational and communication skills, able to prioritize tasks and produce clear, well-structured documentation; co-create in a complex, team-oriented global environment with strong cultural awareness and intercultural communication skills.
• High learning agility with the ability to develop cross-departmental skills, comply with process requirements and all relevant laws/regulations, and consistently demonstrate resourcefulness, autonomy, and a strong drive for continuous improvement. descriptionByLocale.it:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality. The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here . Here's what we're looking for: We’re seeking an innovative and proactive IT Workplace Experience Expert who can empower employees with the tools, resources, and knowledge they need to do their jobs effectively and reach their full potential. You continuously evaluate and improve the employee experience through subject matter expertise in the digital workplace, focusing on efficiency, employee satisfaction and ensuring business continuity. This is a varied role and can give you a springboard into other careers in Informatics and beyond. Within this position you will frequently travel between our 2 affiliates in Vienna. Your upcoming mission:
• Providing technical consultancy for enterprise and business applications to business colleagues
• Adoption and Training to foster digital enablement
• Providing consultancy for specific groups and work with them how to leverage the existing tool for their benefit

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Purpose ● This position is primarily responsible for advocating the value of diagnostic products, formulating and executing marketing strategies and tactics. This position will more focus on Liver disease& navify Algosuite portfolios The area includes Liver diseases portfolio(IM Infectious Diseases, HBV, HCV,HDV, Other Virology and future related ) & navify Algosuite portfolio(GAAD, PROC3ADAPT, and other algorithms such as LGIFlag and Klinrisk in the pipeline) Role Scope Develop and execute Marketing plans, business strategies and marketing tactics across the Liver disease& navify Algosuite portfolios to maximize its commercial success
• Identify business opportunities and challenges in the market that addresses customer pain points
• Maintain market intelligence, monitor and analyze product and competitors; and pivot market strategies where necessary.
• Shape reimbursement policies and communicate the value of our product.
• Influence lab and clinician behavior to drive adoption
• Establish annual sales forecast and 3-year business planning for the products assigned in line with the developed strategies.
• Identify executable strategies and translate them into concrete next steps that can be trialed with CST (Sales)
• Explore and experiment with new innovative commercial business models to further support market development efforts
• Organize and carry out marketing events to engage users, clinicians and other healthcare professionals.
• Launch preparation fundamentals based on Launch Power House framework
• Lead cross-functional teams to develop, execute and monitor product launch plan and key milestones, to ensure a successful product commercialization.
• Ability to craft customer specific and compelling product messaging. Includes internal and external public communications on digital , in-person and paper channels
• Clear price and product positioning in identified customer segments, with an understanding of the market dynamics and competitor landscape.
• Ensure that all marketing materials (promotional content, product info, manuals, etc) are compliant with Roche and local regulatory requirements; and available for the CST (sales) team to promote the products effectively.
• Work and prioritize registration requirements with QRA to ensure that requirements are met in regards to local registration, performance and evaluation.
• Develop internal and external training plans and ensuring optimal training execution
• Create and align on the go-to-market strategy with the commercial and support teams, including key performance indicators, segmentation, and account/customer targets.
• Develop and engage Key Opinion Leaders (KOL) in relation to focus product portfolio and marketing initiatives, including healthcare professionals, professional societies, government officials, payers and patients.
• Plan and execute effective product life-cycle management
• Manage marketing and product notifications
• Cross functional collaboration (CST, CSS, SPB&CE, SCM, QRA) during product version changes or phase-out. Understanding regulation update impact with QRA, including product in catalog and pricing, ensuring sufficient inventory with SCM, understanding customer impact and managing this process with CST
• Product pricing management: List price and ASP management..
• Work closely with Customer Service & Support (CSS) and Medical teams to ensure product related technical and medical issues are well handled
• Enterprise thinking to work across pr

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As an Automation Intern, you will be part of our Data Science & Automation (D&A) team within the Business Analytics function. This internship is designed as a hands-on learning experience, where you will explore automation technologies, support ongoing initiatives, and contribute fresh ideas to improve how we work. You will gain exposure to real-world business challenges, automation tools, and emerging AI capabilities, while working alongside experienced Business Analysts, Automation Developers, and Business Partners. This role is ideal for someone who is curious about technology, enjoys simplifying complex ideas, and is eager to learn how automation and data-driven solutions can create business impact. You will be part of RSS Business Analytics - a global team with regional presence in Switzerland, India, Costa Rica, Hungary, Latvia and Malaysia. We operate in an agile organizational set-up without extensive hierarchical structure, where all our employees lead from every seat. Inspirational leadership, service oriented behavior and entrepreneurial customer centric mindset are our core values. As part of your 6-month journey, you will have the chance to dive into one or more of these core areas:
• Hands-on Development: Work on internal automation projects using UiPath, Python, or scripting to streamline our own team's workflows.
• MS migration analysis: Research our upcoming move to Microsoft 365, evaluating the effects on existing automations and proposing best practices for a smooth bot migration.
• Solution Strategy & Showcase: Develop an "Automation Toolkit" (decision trees and tool matrices) to match business problems with the right tech (AI vs. RPA). You’ll then bring this to life by curating a digital "Solution Catalogue" to showcase our team’s capabilities and toolkit.
• Ad-hoc Exploration: Stay agile! You’ll support various team initiatives as they arise, giving you a 360-degree view of Business Analytics. Require:
• Basic understanding of programming or scripting concepts
• Familiarity with any language such as Python, JavaScript, or similar (academic or personal projects is sufficient)
• Strong curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies
• Ability to break down complex ideas into simple, structured formats
• Good communication and presentation skills (written and verbal in English) Nice to have (not mandatory)
• Exposure to automation tools (e.g. UiPath, Power Automate, Google Apps Script)
• Experience creating presentations, documentation, or visual content What we offer:
• Mentorship: Regular 1:1s with experienced Data Scientists and Automation Developers.
• Real Impact: Your projects (like the Tool Matrix or Solution Catalogue) will be used by the team long after your internship ends.
• Global Exposure: Experience how a leading healthcare company uses technology to impact patients' lives.
• Flexible Environment: A culture that values "leading from every seat" and prioritizes your development over a rigid job title. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-

# Roche - Global Talent Marketing Internship ## Mansioni In questo ruolo, ti unirai al team globale di Marketing del Talento, con l'obiettivo di posizionare Roche come il datore di lavoro preferito per i candidati chiave attraverso approcci mirati e innovativi per soddisfare e affrontare le esigenze di assunzione e del mercato. - Crea contenuti video, sui social media e visivi coinvolgenti che mostrano Roche come il datore di lavoro preferito per i talenti in tutto il mondo. - Acquisisci esperienza attraverso il supporto di campagne di contenuti ad alto impatto su LinkedIn, Instagram e sulla pagina delle carriere globale di Roche. - Gestisci i contenuti a livello globale, acquisendo esperienza pratica con le piattaforme globali di Roche, garantendo la qualità del marchio in tutti i canali. - Collabora con le funzioni di recruiting, comunicazione e creative per portare alla vita storie autentiche del datore di lavoro. - Produci contenuti che rappresentano autenticamente la cultura di Roche, aiutando a ispirare e aumentare le candidature dei candidati. - Innovare con nuovi formati sperimentando con le tendenze e gli strumenti digitali emergenti per mantenere il nostro linguaggio visivo all'avanguardia. - Esperienza una cultura di fiducia in cui le tue idee creative sono apprezzate e sei autorizzato a prendere il controllo dei tuoi progetti. ## Chi sei
• Stiamo cercando un narratore creativo appassionato di media digitali e collaborazione globale. - Narratore Visivo: Hai esperienza dimostrabile nella ripresa e nel montaggio video, indipendentemente dal fatto che sia attraverso progetti accademici, un portfolio personale o lavoro professionale. La familiarità con gli strumenti come Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) o piattaforme simili è un vantaggio. - Consapevole del Marchio: Capisci come il linguaggio visivo coerente rafforza un messaggio e ti piace lavorare all'interno delle linee guida del marchio per garantire la qualità. - Curioso e Autodriven: Prendi l'iniziativa, ti piace sperimentare con nuovi formati di contenuti e prosperi in un ambiente che incoraggia la crescita continua. - Comunicatore Forte: Sei fluente in inglese e ti senti a tuo agio nel collaborare con team internazionali diversi in diversi fusi orari. - Background Educativo: Sei uno studente o un neolaureato in Comunicazione, Marketing, Media o un campo creativo correlato. Si prega di notare che la data di laurea non deve superare i 12 mesi dalla data di inizio. ## Processo di applicazione Carica un CV aggiornato e una Lettera di Motivazione, in cui si indica la data preferita per l'inizio del tirocinio. ## Informazioni aggiuntive Si prega di notare che, a causa dei regolamenti, i cittadini non UE/EEA devono fornire un certificato dall'università che attesti che un tirocinio è obbligatorio come parte dei documenti di applicazione e devono essere costantemente iscritti all'università per tutta la durata di questo tirocinio. Se sei entusiasta di contribuire e senti di avere la dedizione al lavoro di squadra e all'innovazione che cerchiamo, allora Roche è l'organizzazione per te. Ogni ruolo in Roche gioca un ruolo nel fare la differenza per le vite dei pazienti. Se vuoi lavorare in un team appassionato, lasciare il tuo segno e migliorare le vite, applica ora! ## Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge all'innovazione. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati ad avanzare la scienza, garantendo che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri medicinali e più di 30 miliardi di test effettuati utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity In this role, you join the global Talent Marketing team which aims to position Roche as the employer of choice for key candidates with targeted and innovative approaches to meet & address hiring and market needs.
• Shape our global brand by creating engaging video, social media, and visual content that showcases Roche as an employer of choice to talent worldwide.
• Gain experience through the support of high-impact content campaigns across LinkedIn, Instagram, and our global careers webpage.
• Master content management at scale by gaining hands-on experience with our global platforms, ensuring brand quality stays consistent across all channels.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Recruiting, Communications, and creative teams to bring authentic employer storytelling to life.
• D rive engagement by producing content that authentically represents Roche culture, helping to inspire and increase candidate applications.
• Innovate with new formats by experimenting with emerging digital trends and tools to keep our visual language at the cutting edge.
• Experience a culture of trust where your creative ideas are valued and you are empowered to take ownership of your projects. Who you are We are looking for a creative storyteller who is passionate about digital media and global collaboration.
• Visual Storyteller: You have demonstrable experience with video filming and editing , whether through academic projects, a personal portfolio, or professional work. Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) or similar platforms is an advantage.
• Brand-Aware: You understand how consistent visual language strengthens a message and enjoy working within brand guidelines to ensure quality.
• Curious and Self-Driven: You take initiative, enjoy experimenting with new content formats, and thrive in an environment that encourages continuous growth.
• Strong Communicator: You are fluent in English and feel comfortable collaborating with diverse, international teams across different time zones.
• Educational Background: You are a student or recent graduate in Communications, Marketing, Media, or a related creative field. Please note that your graduation date must not be more than 12 months prior to your start date. Application process: Please upload a current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship. Additional Information: Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship. If you are eager to contribute and feel you have the dedication to teamwork and innovation that we are seeking, then Roche is the organization for you. descriptionByLocale.de: Roche - Global Talent Marketing Praktikanten In dieser Rolle werden Sie dem globalen Talent Marketing Team beitreten, mit dem Ziel, Roche als bevorzugten Arbeitgeber für Schlüsselanwärter durch gezielte und innovative Ansätze zu positionieren, um die Bedürfnisse von Aufnahme und Markt zu erfüllen. - Erstellen Sie Videoinhalte, auf Social Media und immersive Visuals, die Roche als bevorzugten Arbeitgeber für Talente auf der ganzen Welt zeigen. - Erkundigen Sie sich durch die Unterstützung von hochwirksamen Content-Kampagnen auf LinkedIn, Instagram und Roches globaler Karriereseite. - Content global verwalten, praktische Erfahrungen mit Roches globalen Plattformen sammeln und Markenqualität auf allen Kanälen gewährleisten. - Zusammenarbeit mit Rekrutierung, Kommunikation und kreativen Funktionen, um authentische Arbeitgebergeschichten zu leben. - Produzieren Sie Inhalte, die die Kultur von Roche authentisch repräsentieren und helfen, die Bewerbungen zu inspirieren und zu erhöhen. - Innovieren Sie mit neuen Formaten, indem Sie mit neuen digitalen Trends und Tools experimentieren, um unsere visuelle Sprache avantgarde zu halten. - Erleben Sie eine Vertrauenskultur, in der Ihre kreativen Ideen geschätzt werden und Sie sind berechtigt, die Kontrolle über Ihre Projekte zu übernehmen. Wer sind Sie auf der Suche nach einem kreativen Erzähler leidenschaftlich über digitale Medien und globale Zusammenarbeit. - Visive Narrator: Sie haben Erfahrung in Videoaufnahmen und -bearbeitung, unabhängig davon, ob es sich um akademische Projekte, ein persönliches Portfolio oder eine professionelle Arbeit handelt. Die Vertrautheit mit Tools wie Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) oder ähnlichen Plattformen ist ein Vorteil. - Achtung der Marke: Verstehen Sie, wie konsistente visuelle Sprache eine Nachricht stärkt und Sie gerne in den Richtlinien der Marke arbeiten, um Qualität zu gewährleisten. - Kurios und Autodriven: Nehmen Sie die Initiative, Sie möchten mit neuen Inhaltsformaten und -reifen in einer Umgebung experimentieren, die ein kontinuierliches Wachstum fördert. - Pressemitteilung: Sie sind fließend in Englisch und fühlen sich wohl, mit verschiedenen internationalen Teams in verschiedenen Zeitzonen zu arbeiten. - Bildungshintergrund: Sie sind Student oder Absolventen in Kommunikation, Marketing, Medien oder einem verwandten kreativen Bereich. Bitte beachten Sie, dass das Abschlussdatum 12 Monate ab dem Startdatum nicht überschreiten sollte. Bewerbungsprozess Hochladen eines aktualisierten Lebenslaufs und eines Motivationsschreibens, in dem Sie das bevorzugte Datum für den Beginn des Praktikums angeben. Zusätzliche Informationen Bitte beachten Sie, dass Nicht-EU/EWR-Bürger aufgrund der Verordnungen ein Zertifikat der Universität zur Verfügung stellen müssen, dass ein Praktikum im Rahmen der Bewerbungsunterlagen obligatorisch ist und für die Dauer dieses Praktikums an der Universität ständig eingeschrieben werden muss. Wenn Sie sich freuen, einen Beitrag zu leisten und das Gefühl haben Sie Engagement für Teamwork und Innovation, die wir suchen, dann ist Roche die Organisation für Sie. Jede Rolle in Roche spielt eine Rolle bei der Differenzierung des Patientenlebens. Wenn Sie in einem leidenschaftlichen Team arbeiten wollen, verlassen Sie Ihre Marke und verbessern Sie das Leben, bewerben Sie sich jetzt! Wer wir eine gesündere Zukunft sind, führt uns zu Innovation. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass alle heute und für zukünftige Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung haben. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren diagnostischen Produkten durchgeführt werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Roche - Stage en marketing de talents mondiaux Expéditions Dans ce rôle, vous rejoindrez l'équipe mondiale Talent Marketing, dans le but de positionner Roche comme employeur privilégié pour les candidats clés grâce à des approches ciblées et innovantes pour répondre aux besoins de l'accueil et du marché. - Créer du contenu vidéo, sur les médias sociaux immersifs et les visuels qui montrent Roche comme l'employeur préféré pour les talents partout dans le monde. - Acquérir de l'expérience grâce au soutien de campagnes de contenu à fort impact sur LinkedIn, Instagram et la page de carrière mondiale de Roche. - Gérer le contenu à l'échelle mondiale, acquérir une expérience pratique avec les plateformes mondiales de Roche, assurant la qualité de la marque sur tous les canaux. - Collaborer avec le recrutement, la communication et les fonctions créatives pour donner vie à des histoires d'employeurs authentiques. - Produire du contenu qui représente authentiquement la culture de Roche, aidant à inspirer et à augmenter les candidatures. - Innovez avec de nouveaux formats en expérimentant les nouvelles tendances et outils numériques pour garder notre langage visuel avant-gardiste. - Vivez une culture de confiance dans laquelle vos idées créatives sont appréciées et vous êtes autorisé à prendre le contrôle de vos projets. Qui êtes-vous ? Nous recherchons un narrateur créatif passionné par les médias numériques et la collaboration mondiale. - Visive Narrator: Vous avez prouvé votre expérience dans le tournage et l'édition vidéo, que ce soit par des projets académiques, un portfolio personnel ou un travail professionnel. La familiarité avec des outils comme Adobe Creative Suite (Premier Pro, After Effects) ou des plateformes similaires est un avantage. - Connaissance de la marque: Comprenez comment un langage visuel cohérent renforce un message et vous aimez travailler dans les lignes directrices de la marque pour assurer la qualité. - Curious et Autodrived: Prenez l'initiative, vous aimez expérimenter de nouveaux formats de contenu et prospérer dans un environnement qui encourage la croissance continue. - Communiqué de presse: Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais et vous sentez à l'aise de travailler avec différentes équipes internationales dans différents fuseaux horaires. - Contexte éducatif: Vous êtes étudiant ou diplômé en communication, marketing, médias ou un domaine de création connexe. Veuillez noter que la date du diplôme ne doit pas dépasser 12 mois à compter de la date de début. Processus de demande Télécharger un CV mis à jour et une lettre de motivation, en indiquant la date préférée pour le début du stage. Informations complémentaires Veuillez noter que, en raison de la réglementation, les citoyens non européens/EEE doivent fournir un certificat de l'université qui certifie qu'un stage est obligatoire dans le cadre des documents de candidature et doit être constamment inscrit à l'université pour la durée de ce stage. Si vous êtes heureux de contribuer et de vous sentir dévoué au travail d'équipe et à l'innovation que nous recherchons, Roche est l'organisation pour vous. Chaque rôle de Roche joue un rôle dans la vie des patients. Si vous voulez travailler dans une équipe passionnée, laissez votre marque et améliorez vos vies, appliquez maintenant! Qui sommes-nous ? Un avenir plus sain nous conduit à l'innovation. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés du monde entier se consacrent à faire progresser la science, en veillant à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations futures. Nos efforts mènent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests effectués avec nos produits de diagnostic.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Deine Abteilung In der Abteilung Manufacturing, Science & Technology (MSAT) stellen wir die technische und strategische Kompetenz für die Bereitstellung der klinischen Pipeline, die Einführung und die Unterstützung der kommerziellen Produktion sicher. Unser technischer Support, Engineering, Systeme, Daten und Dokumente sind essentiell für die Herstellung, Bewertung und Freigabe hochwertiger Produkte. MSAT Process Science ist u.a. am Troubleshooting von pharmazeutischen Proteinwirkstoffen, bei der Bewertung von Einsatzstoffen sowie an lokalen und globalen Gremien beteiligt. Dein Team Wir sind ein souveränes Team aus Biotechnologie-Ingenieuren, Labortechnikern, Labormitarbeitern und Managern im Bereich Aufreinigung (Downstream-Processing). Modernes Aufreinigungsequipment, innovative Analysemethoden und diverse Dokumentations- und Auswerte-Tools stehen uns zur Verfügung. Selbständiges und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten sind für unsere Aufgaben essentiell, doch der Teamzusammenhalt und der Spaß an der Arbeit sind für uns genauso wichtig. Ein offener und ehrlicher Umgang miteinander, geprägt durch Respekt und Wertschätzung, ist uns besonders wichtig. Deine Aufgaben Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeiten im Bereich:
• Fehlersuche, -analyse und -behebung im Umfeld des Downstream Processings
• Planung, Bearbeitung und Auswertung von Laborversuchen zur Optimierung, Skalierung und Validierung von Aufreinigungsverfahren (Downstream Processing)
• Anwendung diverser chromatographischer (ÄKTA, HPLC) und spektroskopischer Verfahren sowie Filtration im Labormaßstab Dein Profil
• Du aktuell für ein naturwissenschaftliches oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium immatrikuliert bist
• Du das Thema Proteinaufreinigung nicht nur aus der Theorie kennst
• Dir auch die analytischen Anwendungen der Chromatographie und Spektroskopie vertraut sind
• Du sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift hast
• Selbstständiges und eigenverantwortliches Planen und Arbeiten für dich selbstverständlich sind
• Du ein wahrer Teamplayer bist, ein hohes Durchsetzungsvermögen besitzt und auch in Belastungssituationen immer den Überblick behältst und den Spaß an der Arbeit nicht vergisst
• Erfahrung mit statistischen Methoden (z.B. DoE, multivariate Datenauswertung) und dem systematischen Umgang mit großen Datenmengen ist von Vorteil Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung
• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum
• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)
• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine
• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus
• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge
• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what ma kes us Roche. This role is based in the Diagnostics division where we focus on sustaining and increasing market share in existing accounts through high-value medical solutions. We operate with a customer-centric and holistic approach, delivering innovative proposals to our key stakeholders, clients, and patients to drive long-term business growth and sustainability. The Opportunity As the Direct Sales Manager, your main focus will be to achieve commercial objectives by innovating, co-creating, and identifying new business opportunities. You will build deep relationships with key accounts to implement comprehensive, high-value medical diagnostic solutions.
• You plan and execute commercial growth strategies in existing and new markets by interpreting data and utilizing market insights.
• You build and maintain strategic networking relationships with high-level account stakeholders, including C-level executives, presidents, financial directors, medical directors, and laboratory heads.
• You monitor and manage institutional budgets, expenditures, and revenues to protect and maximize organizational profitability.
• You design effective commercial strategies, tailored sales presentations, and communication action plans that address specific client needs.
• You collaborate cross-functionally with internal departments such as Logistics, Production, and Finance to ensure solutions align with operational capabilities.
• You analyze the competitive landscape, target markets, and public/private market data to identify differentiators and increase overall market share.
• You manage and lead engagement spaces with potential new clients to expand relationships and secure new business opportunities.
• You negotiate commercial conditions, evaluate operational or legal risks, and implement continuous improvement actions to maximize customer satisfaction. ​ Who you are
• You hold a University Degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Health Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.
• You possess years of professional experience within the Diagnostic Industry.
• You possess years of successful experience in commercial, sales management, or marketing functions & p roven track record of leading high-performance teams.
• You have a strong strategic and systemic vision, with the proven ability to interpret complex market data and translate it into successful action plans.
• You demonstrate excellent interpersonal and communication skills, allowing you to easily build environments of trust and manage stress effectively.
• You are highly motivated, adaptive to change, resilient, and thrive in an Agile and collaborative team environment.
• Advanced English and Spanish are required for this role. Location: Based in Quito, Ecuador. Reporting to: Commercial Director of Diagnostics. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. title: Vice President Customer Experience and Commercial Operations

titleByLocale.it: Vicepresidente Customer Experience e Operazioni commerciali
titleByLocale.en: Vice President Customer Experience and Commercial Operations
titleByLocale.de: Vice President Customer Experience und Commercial Operations
titleByLocale.fr: Vice-président Expérience client et opérations commerciales

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: Vice President Customer Experience and Commercial Operations Reporting directly to the President & CEO, the Vice President Customer Experience and Commercial Operations is a high-impact executive position designed to shape the future of our customer experience and portfolio commercialization. As a vital member of the Canadian Network Enabling Team (CNET), you will bridge global vision with local execution, mapping out the agile strategies and corporate policies that drive Canada Pharma forward. You will lead and inspire a sophisticated, multidisciplinary team—encompassing Marketing, Customer Experience, Squad Leaders, and Patient Journey Partners—to deliver seamless, value-driven engagement. Actively collaborating with internal executives and major external stakeholders, you will champion high-level partnerships and high-stakes negotiations that move the needle. Beyond commercial strategy, you will embody the Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) leadership model, intentionally cultivating a workplace culture of deep trust, innovation, and peak performance. If you are ready to steer a world-class portfolio and develop the industry leaders of tomorrow, this is your opportunity to leave a defining legacy at Roche Canada. What you’ll do: People Leadership
• Strategic Alignment: Apply a "OneRoche Canada" lens to commercial opportunities, collaborating across Chapters, Squads, and Roche Dx to enable fluid, priority-aligned resourcing.
• Integrated Operations: Build and evolve an integrated team structure that unifies all elements of customer engagement and commercial operations into a single strategic function.
• Talent Development & Mentorship: Coach, mentor, and develop employees by managing onboarding, career planning, and supporting global talent initiatives like rotation hosting and mentorship.
• Empowerment & Accountability: Lead through effective delegation, establishing clear frameworks for accountability, feedback, and empowering employees to own their goals.
• Culture & Values: Foster an open, honest, and unified workplace culture rooted in teamwork, commercial excellence, and the corporate values of integrity, courage, and passion.
• Compliance & Capability Building: Drive a strong compliance culture, develop local SOPs, and define best practices and tools to scale communication capabilities and functional expertise. Strategy and Vision - Executive Team & Leadership
• Executive Leadership & Alignment: Serve as a core member of the Canadian Network Enabling Team (CNET), working directly with the CEO and senior executives to align organizational goals with overall business strategy.
• Strategic Agenda & Governance: Map long-term strategies and short-term priorities into an agile agenda for Canada Pharma, while collaborating to establish corporate policies, objectives, and evaluation criteria.
• Executive Partnership & Collaboration: Interact regularly with internal and external executives, as well as major customers, to drive high-level partnerships, negotiations, and collaborations.
• Deliverable Execution: Drive actions, follow-ups, and key Pharma Canada deliverables, including the execution of annual goal-setting and strategic planning in partnership with executive leadership.
• Global Representation & Knowledge Sharing: Represent Canada on global commercial operations and customer engagement leadership teams, actively driving the exchange of experiences and learnings across the global Roche network. Ecosy

• Drive Governance Strategy: Define and execute the global MRoQ governance strategy, ensuring full alignment with enterprise quality objectives, business priorities, and global regulatory expectations.

• Standardize Frameworks and Tools: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve standardized MRoQ frameworks, templates, and digital tools to enable scalable, efficient, and consistent execution across the network.
• Manage Forum Outputs: Orchestrate governance review forums to ensure clear, documented outcomes, and establish robust systems for tracking accountability, actions, and risk-mitigation commitments.
• Foster Collaboration & Community: Build and lead a highly connected, cross-functional MRoQ governance community that champions transparency, process harmonization, and a strong culture of quality.
• Support Inspection Readiness: Act as a key delegate for MRoQ and quality governance responsibilities, providing vital support and presentation-ready documentation during regulatory inspections and internal audits. Who you are You are a disciplined, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a matrixed multinational environment. You bring the following qualifications, skills, and experience to the team:
• Educational Background: You possess a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline.
• Industry Experience: You bring 7 years++ of dedicated experience in a Quality (GxP) environment, with specific expertise in Quality Governance, QA, or Compliance within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
• Regulatory & Domain Knowledge: You maintain a strong working knowledge of GMP, GCP, and/or GDP regulations across multiple domains, such as clinical supply or commercial manufacturing.
• Governance Expertise: You have hands-on experience supporting, coordinating, or facilitating management reviews, quality council forums, or complex multi-tiered corporate governance processes.
• Analytical & Communication Capability: You are skilled at analyzing complex quality data and translating these insights into clear, actionable executive reporting and strategic me

Joining Roche means bringing your purpose to a team that values integrity, courage, and passion, ensuring that the right treatment reaches the right patient at the right time. The Opportunity
• Drive System Strategy: Serve as the global Technology PT Product Owner for Learning Management technologies (specifically Cornerstone on Demand), effectively translating complex business requirements into standardized technical solutions.

• Optimize Processes & Systems: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, manage deviations and CAPAs, and oversee master data validation within validated quality systems.

• You possess deep technical expertise: You bring 7+ years of experience in Learning Management technology and platform management—specifically Cornerstone on Demand—ideally with Roche Super Admin-level competency.
• You are an expert in regulated environments: You possess a strong understanding of database management, data analytics, and software validation within validated or controlled pharmaceutical/healthcare environments (GMP, FDA, GxP).

We leverage external partners in order to offer flexibility to our internal capacity at the right cost and quality. We enable our external partners to reliably deliver compliant, quality products to our supply chain customers, so that we can deliver to patients worldwide. We do this through cross-functional collaborations ensuring quality process excellence and continuous improvement. The Opportunity:
• Provide quality and compliance oversight of CDMOs, CROs/PET centers, and in-licensing partners to ensure compliance with cGMP and quality agreement requirements
• Must have expertise and experience in the clinical product development lifecycle, production oversight, and release of clinical supply
• Execute all required activities to assess and release clinical supply. This includes but is not limited to review and approval of specifications, master batch records, methods, method validation reports, and executed batch records.
• Lead resolution of complex investigations, changes and risk assessments.
• Perform disposition of outsourced investigational medicinal products in SAP, including API and Drug Product of Synthetic Molecules and Biologics ​
• Serve as the Quality Point of Contact for CDMOs, CROs and in-licensing partners, and participate as a key member of cross-functional management teams to enable site selection, qualification and implementation, management, and decommissioning
• Oversee and execute all required quality activities during the lifecycle of these GMP suppliers, especially CDMOs, including but not limited to:
• Develop, negotiate and maintain Quality Agreements and associated documents
• Monitor cGMP compliance and report quality performance. Ensure Key Performance Indicators such as on time closure of records are met.
• Identify and mitigate quality risks. Assess impact to Roche clinical product.
• Support Roche audits, ensuring audit responsiveness and CAPA implementation. For Due Diligence audits, directly manage mitigation of findings prior to site implementation
• Tech transfers and process validation, and Inspection readiness for commercial CDMOs as applicable
• Serve as Quality Point of Contact to the technical development team, and lead the Quality subteam as required. Execute the Product Specification File (PSF), intra-company agreements, approve the control system, review CMC sections of Health Authority submissions and related activities. Who you are:

• At least 8 - 10 years Manufacturing and Quality experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.

• Sound knowledge of cGMP, ISO standards and international regulations for pharmaceuticals. Must have the ability to interpret regulatory requirements and quality standards as they relate to clinical GMP product operations.
• Excellent Quality decision making skills in complex environments
• Proven ability to influence across cultures and functional reporting lines, and to drive continuous improvement initiatives

• Provide quality and compliance oversight of CDMOs, CROs/PET centers, and in-licensing partners to ensure compliance with cGMP and quality agreement requirements
• Must have expertise and experience in the clinical product development lifecycle, production oversight, and release of clinical supply
• Execute all required activities to assess and release clinical supply. This includes but is not limited to review and approval of specifications, master batch records, methods, method validation reports, and executed batch records.
• Lead resolution of complex investigations, changes and risk assessments.
• Perform disposition of outsourced investigational medicinal products in SAP, including API and Drug Product of Synthetic Molecules and Biologics ​
• Serve as the Quality Point of Contact for CDMOs, CROs and in-licensing partners, and participate as a key member of cross-functional management teams to enable site selection, qualification and implementation, management, and decommissioning
• Oversee and execute all required quality activities during the lifecycle of these GMP suppliers, especially CDMOs, including but not limited to:
• Develop, negotiate and maintain Quality Agreements and associated documents

• Tech transfers and process validation, and Inspection readiness for commercial CDMOs as applicable
• Serve as Quality Point of Contact to the technical development team, and lead the Quality subteam as required. • Sound knowledge of cGMP, ISO standards and international regulations for pharmaceuticals. Must have the ability to interpret regulatory requirements and quality standards as they relate to clinical GMP product operations.
• Excellent Quality decision making skills in complex environments
• Proven ability to influence across cultures and functional reporting lines, and to drive continuous improvement initiatives

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. The Opportunity: Please note it is a fixed term opportunity until 14/06/2027. As an Employee Lifecycle Management Specialist - German speaking​ you are part of a dynamic, vivid and spiritful Employee Lifecycle Management team supporting our Headquarters in Basel and our Swiss affiliates . The Employee Lifecycle Management teams deliver customer service and advisory support to HR and business partners on global HR systems and processes, ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with our customer-focused principles. As a qualified expert, you are:
• Providing support, insight and explanation on HR systems as well as advisory and administrative activities in one or more main area of HR business processes and employee lifecycle events (eg. onboarding: recruitment and requisition support, offering, pre-employment and reference checks, hiring/onboarding, contract creation; employee changes: contract modifications, contingent workforce management, employee changes/moves, payroll & personal data changes; offboarding: terminations & offboarding support, retirement process, etc.)
• Providing customer service on HR related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting
• Supporting the embedding of the new ways of working, actively participating in the development and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives
• Behaving as role model to team members, showing positive and flexible attitude
• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way
• Building relationships with HR colleagues within the PSS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness. In Exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate Compensation & Benefits This position also offers an attractive benefits package . descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Pharma Technical Fall Student Analyst position, based in Mississauga, offers undergraduate students a valuable opportunity to delve into the heart of Roche's Technical Operations, crucial for manufacturing their medicines. By collaborating closely with stakeholders across various Pharma functions, students gain practical exposure to process implementation, project management, and innovative technological applications that enhance business productivity and profitability. This role involves diverse project assignments and rotations across key areas such as Global Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Biologics Manufacturing, Strategy & Engineering, Technical Development, and Operations Procurement. Roche emphasizes cross-functional collaboration and strict adherence to laws, regulations, and company policies, ensuring a comprehensive learning environment for budding professionals. The Opportunity:
• Participate in Pharma Technical projects, process improvements, and support activities.
• Contribute to system and process design under supervision, ensuring goals and timelines are met.
• Work with peers and cross-functional teams to achieve desired outcomes.
• Build experience in Pharma Technical Operations project management, organizational skills, and interaction with specialists.
• Practice self-management, time management, and goal-setting; work with Pharma Technical mentors to develop career goals. Who You Are:
• Must be pursuing a Bachelor's Degree In Industrial Engineering, Operations, Business/Commerce or related fields.
• Excellent organizational, oral and written communication skills
• Strong attention to detail including the ability to accomplish a task while demonstrating a thorough concern for all the areas involved
• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work well with others in a proactive, positive and constructive manner
• Proven critical thinking and creativity skills; solve problems by applying technical and functional experiences
• Highly motivated, self-driven individual with passion working within pharmaceutical industry Additional Information:
• Duration: (4 months), work term (Full time) and will begin in (Sept 2026)
• Location: Based in Mississauga, Ontario.
• Our team follows a hybrid work structure (majority of days in the office). This position is not eligible for relocation support. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 57 416,00 and 75 358,50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role. This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambition

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Value Pricing & Reimbursement Intern, you will be part of a strategic engine dedicated to navigating the complex intersection of healthcare policy and data analytics to ensure life-changing therapies reach patients. You will join a fast-paced, collaborative, and forward-thinking team that actively embraces data-driven insights and modern technology like AI to optimize workflows. This unique opportunity allows you to see the direct impact of health economics on patient access and corporate strategy while shaping the future of our innovative pipeline. The Opportunity:
• Support the strategic preparation, adaptation, and formatting of reimbursement submissions for Health Technology Assessment (HTA) bodies and provincial files.
• Conduct detailed data analysis on market access metrics with a specific focus on tracking and measuring "time to access" for innovative therapies.
• Extract, clean, and synthesize data from diverse and complex databases to support pipeline product research, health economic modeling, and market access strategies.
• Review and modernize Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to enhance divisional efficiency, operational excellence, and overall compliance.
• Collaborate within a hybrid work environment to drive continuous improvement, leveraging advanced environmental scanning and literature research to support the team's objectives. Who You Are:
• You are currently enrolled in and pursuing a Master's Degree in Health Economics, Public Health, Pharmacy, Epidemiology, Data Analytics, Health Administration, or a related quantitative/scientific discipline.
• You possess advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and data manipulation) and strong quantitative skills for analytical modeling and extracting data.
• You have experience or strong literacy using AI tools—such as Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering—to synthesize research, format documents, and optimize workflows.
• You are an excellent communicator and collaborator who can translate complex data into clear, actionable visual insights while exemplifying our core values of Integrity, Courage, and Passion.
• You bring (or have a strong academic interest in) exposure to the Canadian pharmaceutical reimbursement landscape and HTA processes. Additional Information:
• Duration & Schedule: 12-month, full-time (35 hours per week), work term beginning in September 2026.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics Hungary, our mission is to ensure that our innovative tools, solutions, and methodologies are accessible to all patients. As the Head of Sales and Key Account Management, you will be a key member of our Diagnostics Division Leadership Team, playing a critical role in shaping and executing the commercial and sales strategy of the affiliate. The Opportunity As the Head of Sales and Key Account Management , you will lead all sales-related activities and sub-functions—including Sales, Key Account Management, Business Development, Business Consultancy, and Tender Management. Your focus will be to ensure these functions operate in a customer-centric, compliant, and highly impactful manner , translating global and regional strategies into actionable local plans that drive sustainable growth. As a People Leader, you will embody our VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leadership model. Core Responsibilities and Impact
• Sales & Key Account Excellence: Lead, coach, and mentor Sales Managers and sub-functions to ensure market-leading performance, deep account engagement, and long-term partnerships with healthcare decision-makers.
• Strategic Execution: Translate global and regional directions into clear, business-aligned action plans for Hungary, managing the team's backlog to focus on high-impact commercial goals.
• End-to-End Tendering & Growth: Oversee Tender Management with full accountability for flawless execution, and guide Business Development to unlock future growth opportunities.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing, Product Management, Professional Services, and Customer Service & Logistics to deliver seamless, coherent customer journeys.
• Financial & Operational Oversight: Manage financial sales target setting, budget planning, revenue tracking, and reporting on key performance indicators (KPIs).
• Compliance: Ensure full alignment with MedTech regulations, legal requirements, and ethical Roche policies across all commercial activities. Who You Are We are looking for a visionary, results-oriented leader who possesses a blend of strategic commercial foresight and a passion for people development. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• Experience : A proven track record of managerial leadership in Sales and Key Account Management within the healthcare or diagnostics industry. You have demonstrated success in driving sales growth, managing complex change initiatives, and steering end-to-end tendering activities.
• Industry & Strategic Acumen: A deep understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, customer pathways, and hospital/laboratory operations from a commercial perspective.
• Leadership Mindset: Strong capabilities as a servant leader, with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex environments, and foster a culture of experimentation and psychological safety.
• Skills: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and system-thinking capabilities. You have an entrepreneurial attitude, are comfortable using digital tools (CRM systems, sales dashboards) , and have a strong ethical mindset.
• Education & Languages: A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Life Sciences, or a related field. Fluency in both Hungarian and English is required.
• Mobility: A valid driver's license and willingness to travel as required. Location: This position is based in Budapest. Relocation Assistance is not available Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together,

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Procurement Intern, you will play a key role in accelerating our goal of bringing innovative healthcare solutions to patients quickly and efficiently through strategic business and supplier partnerships,. You will join a dynamic, global team focused on continuous transformation, working collaboratively to explore needs, create tailored solutions, and proactively partner with diverse stakeholders. This unique opportunity allows you to dive deep into end-to-end sourcing processes and actively shape our future by exploring the application of AI to optimize our daily ways of working. The Opportunity:
• Collaborate within a diverse, global team environment to gain hands-on experience and an appreciation for cross-cultural knowledge and expertise,.
• Explore end-to-end core procurement processes, developing a comprehensive understanding of sourcing, category management, negotiations, contracting, and supplier relationship management,.
• Participate in operational sourcing activities to gain valuable market insights across both indirect and direct procurement categories.
• Innovate by actively supporting current AI pilot initiatives, identifying exciting opportunities to evolve, optimize, and streamline our processes.
• Drive internal communication efforts by supporting the content development and continuous updates of our internal team knowledge platforms. Who You Are:
• You are currently enrolled in and pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Life science, engineering or a similar educational area of focus.
• You possess strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to comfortably collect, translate, and explain moderately complex data to others.
• You bring excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, alongside business-level fluency in English.
• You have a foundational understanding of (or strong interest in) negotiating, contracting, and procurement systems and an understanding of Supply Chain, Direct Materials or Research & Lab categories.
• You are a passionate learner who embodies our core values of Integrity, Courage, and Passion, ready to thrive in a transformative environment. Additional Information:
• Duration & Schedule: 4-month, full-time work term beginning in September 2026.
• Location: Based in Mississauga, Ontario. Our team follows a hybrid work structure requiring the majority of time in the office.
• Full time (35 hours per week). This position is not eligible for relocation support. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 57 416,00 and 75 358,50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role. This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportuni

The Position Funciones principales y responsabilidades Dirección Técnica /Asuntos Regulatorios
• Realizar La revisión de los CDS publicados vigentes de todos los productos farmacéuticos comercializados por Roche.
