title: Senior Research Engineer, Microfluidic Systems, R&D

titleByLocale.it: Senior Ricerca Ingegnere, Microfluidic Systems, R&D
titleByLocale.en: Senior Research Engineer, Microfluidic Systems, R&D
titleByLocale.de: Senior Forschung Ingenieur, Microfluidic Systems, R&D
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Recherche Ingénieur, Microfluidic Systems, R&D

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample-in, result-out workflow. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking an enthusiastic, team-oriented Senior Research Engineer to join the effort. In this role, you will tackle a variety of tasks and projects that will help us advance our technology, hardware, and workflows related to our next-generation DNA sequencing systems. We are looking for candidates with a proven track record of excellence in developing novel technology for biological applications. This is a hands-on, interdisciplinary role with a mix of responsibilities. The Opportunity
• Prototyping & Fabrication : You will design, fabricate, and assemble custom devices, fixtures, and breadboards using CNC machining, laser cutting, 3D printing, and advanced shop tools.
• Microfabrication & Metrology : You will develop and implement microfabrication processes, including photolithography, etching, drilling, bonding, and dicing - and utilize precision metrology instruments to characterize components and evaluate manufacturing methodologies.
• Workflow Development & Troubleshooting : You will test, characterize, and troubleshoot complex fluidic systems and devices. Develop new workflows, protocols, and assays, while collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to drive technical progress.
• Documentation & Reporting : You will generate comprehensive test plans, experimental protocols, and technical reports to document findings and methodology.
• Equipment Maintenance : You will operate, repair, and maintain lab equipment and custom instrumentation, ensuring optimal performance of breadboards and fixtures.
• Collaboration: You will partner with a small, agile team of scientists and engineers, as well as the broader organization, to advance next-generation sequencing and diagnostic workflows. A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company. This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA. Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role. Who You Are: (Required)
• You have a Ph.D. in Bioengineering or a closely related discipline with 2–5 years of relevant research and early development experience in the life science industry.
• You have demonstrated expertise in library preparation and target enrichment workflows.
• You have a demonstrated level of proficiency in operating and interpreting data from bioanalytical instruments, including qPCR, dPCR, Bioanalyzer/TapeStation, Qubit Fluorometer, and NanoDrop UV-Vis Spectrophotometer.
• You have significant experience with nucleic acid extraction methodologies and purification techniques.
• You have demonstrated success in building, operating, and troubleshooting hardware, fixtures, and breadboards integrated with fluidic, pneumatic, thermal, and optical subsystems.
• You have experience with workflo

Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking an enthusiastic, team-oriented Senior Research Engineer to join the effort. In this role, you will tackle a variety of tasks and projects that will help us advance our technology, hardware, and workflows related to our next-generation DNA sequencing systems. We are looking for candidates with a proven track record of excellence in developing novel technology for biological applications. This is a hands-on, interdisciplinary role with a mix of responsibilities. The Opportunity
• Prototyping & Fabrication : You will design, fabricate, and assemble custom devices, fixtures, and breadboards using CNC machining, laser cutting, 3D printing, and advanced shop tools.
• Microfabrication & Metrology : You will develop and implement microfabrication processes, including photolithography, etching, drilling, bonding, and dicing - and utilize precision metrology instruments to characterize components and evaluate manufacturing methodologies.
• Workflow Development & Troubleshooting : You will test, characterize, and troubleshoot complex fluidic systems and devices. Develop new workflows, protocols, and assays, while collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to drive technical progress.
• Documentation & Reporting : You will generate comprehensive test plans, experimental protocols, and technical reports to document findings and methodology.
• Equipment Maintenance : You will operate, repair, and maintain lab equipment and custom instrumentation, ensuring optimal performance of breadboards and fixtures.
• Collaboration: You will partner with a small, agile team of scientists and engineers, as well as the broader organization, to advance next-generation sequencing and diagnostic workflows. A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company. This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA. Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role. Who You Are: (Required)
• You have a Ph.D. in Bioengineering or a closely related discipline with 2–5 years of relevant research and early development experience in the life science industry.
• You have demonstrated expertise in library preparation and target enrichment workflows.
• You have a demonstrated level of proficiency in operating and interpreting data from bioanalytical instruments, including qPCR, dPCR, Bioanalyzer/TapeStation, Qubit Fluorometer, and NanoDrop UV-Vis Spectrophotometer.
• You have significant experience with nucleic acid extraction methodologies and purification techniques.
• You have demonstrated success in building, operating, and troubleshooting hardware, fixtures, and breadboards integrated with fluidic, pneumatic, thermal, and optical subsystems.
• You have experience with workflo

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity As a Cluster Section Lead, you will inspire and empower a dedicated accounting team to deliver high-quality financial services. Operating within our dynamic global shared services hub, you will oversee day-to-day operations, drive accurate financial reporting, and ensure the highest standards of internal controls and regulatory compliance. In this impactful leadership role, you will:
• Drive Financial Operational Excellence: Plan, lead, and oversee the execution of comprehensive financial tasks, ensuring complete and timely general accounting operations.
• Master Closing Activities: Coordinate and execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities, ensuring accurate account closures in compliance with financial instructions and timelines.
• Lead and Inspire: Foster a positive and open team environment where communication thrives. You will delegate tasks, establish clear completion goals, and motivate team members to achieve their operational targets.
• Nurture Talent and Careers: Identify the skills needed to meet business objectives and actively develop your staff's capabilities, helping them map out and achieve their long-term career goals.
• Establish Strategic Goals: Collaborate with the operations teams to set annual performance objectives, ensuring team results align perfectly with our global shared services goals.
• Champion Governance and Compliance: Ensure all business activities adhere strictly to internal financial reporting controls, corporate policies, local statutory legal requirements, and high ethical standards.
• Optimize Documentation and Processes: Maintain up-to-date work documentation and process flows, resolving operational issues or conflicts proactively through constructive feedback. Who You Are You are an experienced finance professional and an empathetic leader who excels at motivating teams, managing performance metrics, and defining robust operational procedures in a complex corporate landscape. Your Qualifications:
• Educational Background: You hold a Degree, Diploma, or equivalent professional qualification in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.
• Professional Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of working experience in corporate finance, with a strong emphasis on general accounting and management accounting.
• People Leadership: You possess at least 3 - 5 years of experience managing, leading, and developing high-performing accounting or finance teams.
• Industry Context: Experience working within a global shared services center (SSC) or business process outsourcing (BPO) environment is highly preferred.
• Systems and Technical Savvy: You have strong working knowledge of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) accounting systems (such as SAP) alongside advanced proficiency in standard business tools (MS Office/Google Workspace).
• Communication & Analytical Strength: You possess exceptional presentation, analytical, and communication skills, with absolute professional fluency in English.
• Autonomy and Collaboration: You are comfortable working with minimal direction to determine methods on new assignments, while collaborating effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. Let’s thrive together in a culture built on trust, collaboration, respect, and high performance. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tem po com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roch e. Como Analista de Compras Sênior , você terá uma atuação altamente estratégica na divisão Diagnóstica, sendo fundamental para impulsionar a eficiência, a inovação e o impacto na otimização de custos. Com foco significativo em serviços de alta complexidade em categorias diversas, você liderará projetos desafiadores e atuará como um parceiro estratégico para os nossos usuários internos, gerenciando desde o ciclo de vida das aquisições complexas até a gestão de contratos de longo prazo e o relacionamento com fornecedores-chave. Além disso, desempenhará um papel importante no alinhamento dos processos locais com a estrutura de Global Procurement e na mentoria de analistas juniores/plenos. Sobre a Oportunidade:
• Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras específicas para as categorias sob sua responsabilidade, atuando com visão profunda de Strategic Sourcing, matriz de Krajlic e TCO.
• Liderar processos de contratação de bens e serviços de alta complexidade, incluindo a elaboração de RFx, análise crítica de propostas, negociação de contratos e intermediação entre fornecedores e clientes internos.
• Atender e colaborar ativamente com stakeholders internos e externos, compreendendo expectativas, mitigando riscos e alinhando processos operacionais e estratégicos.
• Comunicar-se e negociar com fornecedores para obtenção das melhores condições comerciais, redução de custos, revisão de escopos contratuais e identificação de oportunidades de poupança ( savings ).
• Garantir proficiência na gestão e implementação de contratos de longo prazo, bem como no suporte para auditorias internas e externas através do envio de evidências e relatórios solicitados.
• Monitorar índices de inflação e tendências de mercado que envolvam processos complexos de negociações, garantindo a eficiência orçamentária da empresa.
• Gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente (indo além das atividades específicas de compras), demonstrando liderança, adaptabilidade e agilidade na resolução de problemas. Quem você é:
• Graduação completa em Administração de Empresas, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
• Pós-graduação ou especialização na área de Compras, Gestão de Projetos ou Gestão Empresarial será considerada um diferencial.
• Inglês avançado para atuação em contextos corporativos.
• Trajetória mínima comprovada de 5 anos na área de Compras, com sólida vivência em negociações de alta complexidade e gestão de categorias de compras.
• Experiência prévia com negociações voltadas para Logística e Supply Chain será considerada um grande diferencial.
• Proficiência em sistemas de compras (conhecimento em SAP será um diferencial) e domínio da plataforma Google (Gsuite: Gsheet, Google Slides e Google Docs).
• Excelentes competências comportamentais, incluindo comunicação escrita e oral diferenciada, proatividade, senso de urgência, habilidade de negociação técnica, liderança de processos e foco em resultados.
• Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido (3x por semana presencialmente em nosso escritório localizado na Zona Sul de São Paulo) Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição. Atenção: Esta posição é exclusiva para pessoas com deficiência (PCD). Na Roch

Como Analista de Compras Sênior , você terá uma atuação altamente estratégica na divisão Diagnóstica, sendo fundamental para impulsionar a eficiência, a inovação e o impacto na otimização de custos. Com foco significativo em serviços de alta complexidade em categorias diversas, você liderará projetos desafiadores e atuará como um parceiro estratégico para os nossos usuários internos, gerenciando desde o ciclo de vida das aquisições complexas até a gestão de contratos de longo prazo e o relacionamento com fornecedores-chave. Além disso, desempenhará um papel importante no alinhamento dos processos locais com a estrutura de Global Procurement e na mentoria de analistas juniores/plenos. Sobre a Oportunidade:
• Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras específicas para as categorias sob sua responsabilidade, atuando com visão profunda de Strategic Sourcing, matriz de Krajlic e TCO.
• Liderar processos de contratação de bens e serviços de alta complexidade, incluindo a elaboração de RFx, análise crítica de propostas, negociação de contratos e intermediação entre fornecedores e clientes internos.
• Atender e colaborar ativamente com stakeholders internos e externos, compreendendo expectativas, mitigando riscos e alinhando processos operacionais e estratégicos.
• Comunicar-se e negociar com fornecedores para obtenção das melhores condições comerciais, redução de custos, revisão de escopos contratuais e identificação de oportunidades de poupança ( savings ).
• Garantir proficiência na gestão e implementação de contratos de longo prazo, bem como no suporte para auditorias internas e externas através do envio de evidências e relatórios solicitados.
• Monitorar índices de inflação e tendências de mercado que envolvam processos complexos de negociações, garantindo a eficiência orçamentária da empresa.
• Gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente (indo além das atividades específicas de compras), demonstrando liderança, adaptabilidade e agilidade na resolução de problemas. Quem você é:
• Graduação completa em Administração de Empresas, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
• Pós-graduação ou especialização na área de Compras, Gestão de Projetos ou Gestão Empresarial será considerada um diferencial.
• Inglês avançado para atuação em contextos corporativos.
• Trajetória mínima comprovada de 5 anos na área de Compras, com sólida vivência em negociações de alta complexidade e gestão de categorias de compras.
• Experiência prévia com negociações voltadas para Logística e Supply Chain será considerada um grande diferencial.
• Proficiência em sistemas de compras (conhecimento em SAP será um diferencial) e domínio da plataforma Google (Gsuite: Gsheet, Google Slides e Google Docs).
• Excelentes competências comportamentais, incluindo comunicação escrita e oral diferenciada, proatividade, senso de urgência, habilidade de negociação técnica, liderança de processos e foco em resultados.
• Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido (3x por semana presencialmente em nosso escritório localizado na Zona Sul de São Paulo) Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição. Atenção: Esta posição é exclusiva para pessoas com deficiência (PCD). Na Roch

titleByLocale.fr: Stage en biologie moléculaire/R-D en biotechnologie (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Would you like to help develop solutions for tomorrow’s healthcare? At Roche in Penzberg—Europe’s largest biotechnology center near Munich—you’ll work at the intersection of research, development, and production for Diagnostics and Pharma. During your internship, we offer you the opportunity to actively contribute to innovative projects in research and development, get to know different business areas, and gain valuable insights into the day-to-day operations of a global healthcare company. The Team You’ll be joining the CoreLab Development research and development network within Roche Diagnostics. Our small, independent, and diverse team currently consists of 10 members. We focus on molecular diagnostics, biopharma analytics, and biopharma reagents. We accompany new product developments from the initial concept through to market launch and beyond. Additionally, we contribute to technology evaluations, troubleshooting, and support marketing by creating promotional materials. Your Challenges
• You will play an active role in various work packages, sub-projects, and projects aimed at developing and optimizing bioreagents such as enzymes, nucleotides, and enzyme kits. As part of this, you’ll also be introduced to method and assay development as well as statistical experimental design (DoE) in an industrial setting
• You’ll research, plan, implement, and conduct analyses and experiments in close collaboration with your team and supervisor
• Furthermore, you will help prepare reports and present your findings within the team, as well as to colleagues in related departments and interface partners Your Profile
• You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biochemistry, (Molecular) Biology, Biotechnology or a comparable university program, or you are in a gap year
• You enjoy lab work and experimental tasks, including evaluating complex series of experiments
• You are enthusiastic about engaging with people and working together in a team to develop concepts and discuss our work scientifically
• You have an open-minded, inclusive, and authentic nature.
• Curiosity, enthusiasm, and joy are essential companions on your journey Your Skills
• Your studies have equipped you with a solid theoretical foundation in disciplines such as Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, or related areas
• You have practical experience with molecular biology techniques (e.g., qPCR, cloning, working with nucleic acids), biochemistry (enzyme activity, proteins), or analytical chemistry (homogeneous assays, HPLC, photometry, fluorometry, electrophoresis). Ideally, you have gained lab experience through internships, student assistant jobs, or during thesis projects
• You are able to organize and structure your work independently
• You approach challenges and ideas enthusiastically, working systematically and solution-oriented, while remaining open to creative and flexible approaches
• You communicate confidently with your team and our partners in English, both spoken and written. German is helpful but not required Your Benefits
• Flexible working hours and possible flexitime, arranged with the team
• €2268/month compensation for a full-time internship (37.5 h/week)
• Networking with other interns and students
• 50% discount in our cafeteria
• Sport Center on campus
• Option for paid accommodation in the Roche Boarding House
• Convenient transport to Munich with our subsidized Roche shuttle Your Application Please note: This internship is f

titleByLocale.it: Guida commerciale e operativa della Libia

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Summary
• The Commercial & Operations Lead is an integral part of the Extended Enabling Team. She/he will be responsible for developing and implementing commercial and strategic relationships with the Libya agent, organizations and stakeholders in accordance with the company's overarching objective, goals and strategies. She/he will evolve our commercial operations in Libya from reactive tender management to proactive shaping of the end-to-end tendering, procurement, supply chain, products consumption and quantification processes, systematically leveraging best practices and opportunities while developing and testing scalable & high impact innovative tendering solutions to ensure long-term, sustainable partnership. Your responsibilities
• Developing and implementing commercial strategies according to company goals and objectives aiming to accelerate growth while building and maintaining strong, trusted, long-term partnerships with key stakeholders
• Together with local Agent, Roche DA Squads and relevant functions, conducting market research and analysis to create detailed business plans on commercial opportunities (expansion, business development etc.)
• To explore the risk / opportunities of the tender landscape in regards to realising our portfolio ambitions , co-creation of solutions and shape alternative procurement pathways
• Develop solutions to enhance our competitiveness in strategic tendering including through long term value driven partnerships
• Take the end-to-end lead for the preparation, response and submission to tenders
• Assist in setting financial targets and budget development and monitoring
• Sourcing new partners and executing exciting partnership solutions
• Negotiating attractive partnership deals and ensuring mutually beneficial partnership terms that are in line with business objectives and strategy
• Ensure effective partner collaboration by supporting established governance processes, timely facilitation and decision making, relationship management and Channels for communication.
• Act as a role model and coach for each of the functions involved in day to day management of partnership with Libya
• Ensure compliance with all applicable internal policies and procedures, regulations and contractual obligations with partners
• Build and maintain trusting collaborative relationships and alliances with internal and external partners, focused on addressing key business objectives and processes Working closely with other functions to foster strategies and drive high impact for the Business Who You Are
• We are looking to hire an energetic, highly motivated, can-do attitude individual who enjoys networking and establishing relationships in a VUCA environment.
• You hold a University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, Economics or any relevant education
• You have prior experience in similar position and a strong record of success in building strategic partnerships
• In-depth understanding of market research methods and analysis
• Solid knowledge of tender management, performance reporting and financial/budgeting processes
• Commercial awareness partnered with a strategic mindset
• Excellent organizational and leadership skills
• Outstanding communication and interpersonal abilities
• You are able to foster positive partnerships through effective influencing, negotiation and conflict management skills to achieve alignment up and down the organization
• You have strong Project Management experience a

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Hast du eine Leidenschaft für die Sicherstellung der Patientensicherheit und die Einhaltung von höchsten Qualitätsstandards im dynamischen Umfeld der Arzneimittel- und Diagnostikaproduktion? Als IT Compliance Manager (m/w/d) in Penzberg bist du ein zentraler Ankerpunkt für unser Team und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, unsere Computersysteme GMP-, Security- und Legal-konform zu halten. Deine Chance | Das erwartet Dich In dieser Position bist du maßgeblich daran beteiligt, die Qualität unserer Computersysteme sicherzustellen. Wir vertrauen dir wichtige Aufgaben an, die den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Systeme betreffen. Deine Tätigkeit hat einen direkten Einfluss auf die Qualität der Roche-Produkte, die das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern.
• Qualitätssicherung : Du erstellst, bearbeitest und schließt Änderungen, Abweichungen, Korrekturen und Vorbeugemaßnahmen ab. Du führst Qualitätssicherungsaufgaben für Labor-, IT- und Automatisierungssysteme durch und stellst die Datenintegrität sicher.
• Risiko - und Dokumentenmanagement : Du erstellst Risikoanalysen im Quality Risk Management Umfeld und stellst sicher, dass alle GMP-relevanten Dokumentationen den Vorschriften entsprechen.
• Audit & Validierung : Du bereitest Audits und Inspektionen vor, begleitest diese und unterstützt Validierungs- und Qualifizierungsprojekte. Du wirkst aktiv bei der Etablierung neuer Systeme mit.
• Wissenstransfer : Du bleibst durch interne und externe Weiterbildungen auf dem neuesten Stand und teilst dein Wissen aktiv mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Das bist Du Du bist ein:e proaktive:r Teamplayer:in, der/die sich mit hohem Engagement für Compliance im Produktions- und Laborumfeld einsetzt. Du behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick, verfügst über Durchsetzungsvermögen und hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Erfahrung : Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder diagnostischen Industrie mit, speziell mit dem Schwerpunkt Qualitätssicherung von Computersystemen (GMP Support). Kenntnisse in GMP, GAMP, Softwareentwicklungsprozesse und CSV sind für dich somit selbstverständlich.
• Ausbildung : Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Naturwissenschaften, Biotechnologie, Bioinformatik, Informatik oder ein Technikerabschluss mit relevanter Berufserfahrung sind die Grundlage für diese Position.
• Fachwissen : Du besitzt tiefgreifendes konzeptionelles und praktisches Wissen in der Qualitätssicherung von Computersystemen und bringst Grundwissen in Bereichen wie Automatisierungstechnik oder komplexen IT-Systemen mit.
• Kommunikation & Stakeholdermanagement : Du kommunizierst ausgezeichnet auf Deutsch und Englisch, über alle Hierarchieebenen hinweg. Stakeholdermanagement ist für dich selbstverständlich - so stellst du z.B. sicher, dass alle relevanten Parteien eingebunden sind.
• Proaktivität : Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit, packst Dinge selbstständig an und hast eine Affinität zur Verbesserung von Prozessen.
• Reisebereitschaft : Gelegentliche Reisen zwischen den Standorten Basel, Kaiseraugst, Mannheim und Penzberg sind für dich kein Problem. Die Position ist bis 31.08.2028 befristet. Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf
• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns! Your contact to us! With people. For peop

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Die Rolle Als Pharmafacharbeiter Ansatz / Abfüllung (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine verantwortlich. Verantwortlichkeiten In dieser Rolle bist Du für die sichere Durchführung von Standardaufgaben und komplexen Prozessen in der Wirkstoffverarbeitung verantwortlich:
• Du gewährleistest den reibungslosen Ablauf der Abfüllung von sterilen Lösungen in Vials unter Berücksichtigung aseptischer Arbeitsweise nach Herstellanweisung und Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften
• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen an der Abfüll- und Gefriertrocknungsanlage
• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.
• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du Geräte und Kleinteile
• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)
• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe
• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln. Das bringst du mit
• Du hast idealerweise eine dreijährige abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Pharmakant oder Pharmazeutisch-technischer Assistent (PTA) (m/w/d).
• Deine mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, ggf. in der Parenteralia Herstellung zeichnet Dich aus.
• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Hygienebereich und in der Einhaltung der GMP-Richtlinien sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit Dokumentationsarbeiten und gängigen IT-Anwendungen (insbesondere MS Office, MES, Unilab).
• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für die Bedienung und Kenntnis von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.
• Du arbeitest gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
• Fähigkeit und Offenheit, die Chancen und die Vorteile von Veränderungen zu erkennen und das Warum zu vermitteln.
• Du begegnest allen Mitarbeitenden offen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung.
• Es besteht die Bereitschaft, in flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen (ggf. auch an Samstagen) eingesetzt zu werden. Darüber hinaus bist Du bereit, in Schichtsystemen mit Früh/Spät/Nacht zu arbeiten. Bei der Schichtplanung ist uns Deine Gesundheit wichtig und wir achten ebenso auf faire Zulagen Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens 18.06.2026 (Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist) Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Responsable de análisis y elaboración de estrategias sobre el acercamiento a las actores de la esfera política, legislativa y sus asesores, además de la sociedad civil organizada, de manera de asegurar una fuerte colaboración con ellos en la construcción de un sistema de salud más eficiente, sustentable y con foco en el paciente. The Opportunity:
• Entender el entorno local de salud y promover los beneficios de las terapias de Roche, su cultura y valores, y su enfoque frente a los grandes temas de política sanitaria ante los principales stakeholders.
• Identificar y analizar los aspectos de políticas de salud que afectan a Roche y a la industria a nivel nacional, liderando la estrategia de Policy local alineada con las prioridades de la red global y regional.
• Fomentar la reputación de Roche como actor que busca generar un impacto positivo en el sistema de salud.
• Influir en la agenda pública y legislativa para impulsar conversaciones estratégicas sobre la transformación del sistema de salud y la priorización de la salud pública en los programas de gobierno.
• Liderar el relacionamiento con stakeholders de la esfera política que influyen en el sistema de salud. Who you are:
• Título universitario en Ingeniería Comercial, Ciencias Políticas, Derecho, carreras científicas o afines.
• Deseable Maestría en Ciencias Políticas, Relaciones Internacionales o disciplinas similares.
• Dominio fluido del idioma inglés.
• Formación académica alineada con entornos de política pública, relaciones internacionales, regulación o negocio en salud es altamente valorada. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. Your Opportunity: As a Junior Graphic Designer you will collaborate with senior designers, clients, and team members to understand design requirements and objectives. They'll assist in developing design solutions that effectively communicate messages and align with project goals. By leveraging their creative skills and design software knowledge, they contribute to the production of various design assets across different mediums, including print, digital, and social media. Junior Graphic Designers work under the guidance of senior designers to ensure consistency and adherence to brand guidelines in their design deliverables. They assist in the creation of layouts, selecting appropriate typography, and incorporating visual elements to enhance the overall visual appeal. Support the design team in creating visually compelling designs, gaining hands-on experience, and developing their skills in various design aspects. Junior Graphic Designers play a crucial role in assisting the team to deliver high-quality designs that effectively communicate messages and contribute to the overall success of design projects. Responsibilities
• ● Assist in the creation and production of various marketing collateral outputs through AI tools, delivering high-quality and visually appealing designs.
• ● Support the development of visually appealing and on-brand designs that effectively communicate the organization's message and objectives.
• ● Collaborate with senior designers and cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver design solutions that meet stakeholder expectations.
• ● Execute design tasks with attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and adherence to brand guidelines.
• ● Perform administrative tasks using Google Sheets, Google Drive and other tools, ensuring accurate documentation and project alignment for design requests.
• ● Contribute to brainstorming sessions and provide creative input to generate new ideas and concepts.
• ● Stay updated on design trends, techniques, and software tools to enhance design capabilities and suggest innovative ideas.
• ● Take ownership of assigned design projects, managing time and resources effectively to meet deadlines.
• ● Seek feedback from senior designers and incorporate revisions to rene design concepts and deliver high-quality work.
• ● Develop a strong understanding of the organization's brand identity and apply it consistently across all design projects.
• ● Utilize design software and tools, such as Adobe Creative Suite (Adobe Express, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), to help create and renew designs.
• ● Actively participate in design critiques, team meetings, and professional development opportunities to continuously improve skills and knowledge.
• ● Adapt to changing priorities and work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Who you are You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You love to stay abreast of the latest digital updates in order to provide partners with cutting-edge design capabilities, being fully aware of the most current design trends. Further requirements
• ● 1-2 years of professional experience in graphic design, either through internships, freelance work, or entry-level positions.
• ● Prof

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity As the APAC Regional Customer Service Centre (RCSC) Lead, you will be the primary architect of Roche Diagnostics’ first-ever centralized customer service operation in the Asia-Pacific region. Based in our Kuala Lumpur hub, you will lead a world-class digital transformation, shifting traditional support into a proactive, AI-driven ecosystem that serves as a commercial differentiator. In this high-impact leadership role, you will:
• Architect a Digital Future: Build and evolve a centralized Customer Service Centre (CSC) by integrating Generative AI and automation to deliver a seamless, predictive customer experience.
• Drive Strategic Transformation: Transition the region from reactive support to a high-efficiency hub, utilizing data-driven strategies to optimize the "cost to serve" while maximizing value.
• Lead with Vision & Purpose: Act as a Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach. You will move beyond traditional management to foster a culture of psychological safety, creative thinking, and extreme accountability.
• Master Resource Architecture: Take full accountability for regional budgeting and ROI. You will design intelligent workforce strategies that balance AI-assisted capacity planning with the diverse needs of different markets.
• Catalyze Data-Driven Excellence: Shift the organization from retrospective reporting to predictive analytics, establishing KPIs that measure customer sentiment and systemic resolution quality.
• Bridge the Global-Regional Ecosystem: Serve as a high-influence connector between global product teams and regional stakeholders, ensuring the APAC hub is an integral part of our Global 2030+ strategy. Who You Are You are a strategic leader who thrives on ambiguity and is passionate about redefining the intersection of technology and human-centric service. You possess the "courageous authenticity" required to challenge the status quo and build high-trust relationships at all levels. Your Qualifications:
• Proven Leadership: You bring 15+ years of experience in operations leadership, with at least 10 years specifically leading centralized service environments (e.g., large-scale contact centers or shared service hubs).
• Educational Excellence: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or Biological Sciences. An MBA or advanced degree is highly preferred.
• Digital & Analytical Savvy: You have a strong background in leveraging data and emerging technologies (like AI/automation) to influence business decisions and build future-ready teams.
• Systems Thinking: You are an expert at "connecting the dots" across complex geographies and cross-functional business areas to drive systemic alignment.
• Exceptional Influence: You are an elite communicator capable of influencing senior executives and building strategic partnerships across Sales, Marketing, and Quality.
• Global Mobility: You are energized by working in a global environment and are willing to travel up to 25% to stay connected with our affiliates and global partners. Let’s thrive together in a culture built on trust, collaboration, respect, and high performance. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach. Leads and facilitates the scope definition process, aligning with strategic objectives, stakeholder expectations, and team dependencies. Proactively identifies, analyzes, and mitigates scope-related risks, manages scope changes, and champions the adoption of scope management best practices within the Chapter.

Accountable for comprehensive improvement plans and contributes to solution design and validation. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Regional Installation Specialist you will mainly operate within Kuwait and beyond, and will be accountable for the relocation and de-installation of legacy Serum Work Area (SWA) systems, and the installation of new generation platforms (cobas pro, cobas pure and cobas smart e) for existing customers, in order to achieve a high level of service excellence within the Middle East region. Your core purpose is to successfully accelerate the PiPo program (Phase-in Phase-out) by bridging temporary capacity gaps during installation peaks.

Your Responsibilities

• Installation/relocation/de-installation of analytical laboratory instruments of Roche Diagnostics.

• Technical release of analytical systems for laboratory use.

• Focus on preparations of the customer sites that require additional attention based on the continuous increase of customer demands and specifications of the instruments that we deliver.

• Independently analyze and resolve most questions and problems and refer only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Timely and accurate logging of data according to work instructions and agreements, with regard to activities in the CRM system. Ensure all activities are documented in a manner compliant and keeping records in accordance with the company’s applicable procedures.

• Timely performance of tasks, maintaining order in the workplace as well as the most effective use of working time.

• Continuous improvement of professional qualifications and participation in company meetings and trainings as well as all forms of vocational education organized by the Employer. Actively gathering information in preparation for meetings, delivering an active part in these meetings and give feedback of outcome of these meetings to others

• Develop and monitor local reports and documents to ensure the efficient and productive delivery of services.

• Actively monitor costs for own Service activities

• Awareness of new service bulletins, Global Customer Support (GCS) hot news and other forums

Who You Are
You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

• You obtained a BSc degree in Bio-Medical Engineering, Precision Mechanics, Electronics, Information Technology, Medical Technology or related

• You built 1 year of work experience in a related field. We also welcome fresh graduates to apply

• You have basic knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and networking

• You have excellent analytical, problem analysis and decision-making skills

• Effective planning, organizational and time management skills

• Effective customer service, written/verbal communication, organization and prioritization skills

• Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English. Mastering Arabic language will be preferred

Important note:
Depending on the workload there will be a need for frequent traveling to neighboring countries in the Middle East to support the PiPo program but Kuwait being the first priority. You are expected to be flexible and willing to travel outside of Kuwait for those periods of time.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generatio
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Come Regional Installation Specialist si opera principalmente all'interno del Kuwait e oltre, e sarà responsabile per il trasferimento e la de-installazione dei sistemi legacy Sirum Work Area (SWA) e l'installazione di piattaforme di nuova generazione (cobas pro, cobas pure e cobas smart e) per i clienti esistenti, al fine di raggiungere un alto livello di eccellenza di servizio all'interno della regione del Medio Oriente. Il vostro scopo principale è quello di accelerare con successo il programma PiPo (Phase-in Phase-out) colmando lacune di capacità temporanee durante i picchi di installazione.

Le tue responsabilità

• Installazione/delocalizzazione/deinstallazione di strumenti di laboratorio analitici di Roche Diagnostics.

• rilascio tecnico di sistemi analitici per uso di laboratorio.

• Concentrati sui preparativi dei siti dei clienti che richiedono un'attenzione aggiuntiva basata sul continuo aumento delle richieste dei clienti e delle specifiche degli strumenti che forniamo.

• Analizzare e risolvere in modo indipendente la maggior parte delle domande e dei problemi e riferire solo i problemi più complessi a livelli più elevati.

• Registrazione tempestiva e accurata dei dati in base alle istruzioni di lavoro e agli accordi, per quanto riguarda le attività del sistema CRM. Assicurarsi che tutte le attività siano documentate in modo conforme e mantenendo i record in conformità con le procedure applicabili dell’azienda.

• Esecuzione tempestiva dei compiti, mantenimento dell'ordine sul posto di lavoro e l'uso più efficace del tempo di lavoro.

• Miglioramento continuo delle qualifiche professionali e della partecipazione alle riunioni e alle formazioni aziendali, nonché di tutte le forme di istruzione professionale organizzate dal datore di lavoro. Raccogliere attivamente informazioni in preparazione per le riunioni, fornire una parte attiva in questi incontri e dare feedback dei risultati di queste riunioni ad altri

• Sviluppare e monitorare relazioni e documenti locali per garantire la consegna efficiente e produttiva dei servizi.

• Monitoraggio attivo dei costi per le proprie attività di Servizio

• Consapevolezza di nuovi bollettini di servizio, Global Customer Support (GCS) notizie calde e altri forum

Chi sei
Sei qualcuno che vuole influenzare il tuo sviluppo. State cercando una società in cui avete la possibilità di perseguire i vostri interessi attraverso funzioni e geografie. Dove un titolo di lavoro non è considerato la definizione finale di chi sei, ma il punto di partenza.

• Hai ottenuto una laurea in Ingegneria Bio-Medical, Meccanica di Precisione, Elettronica, Tecnologia dell'Informazione, Tecnologia Medica o correlati

• Hai costruito 1 anno di esperienza lavorativa in un campo correlato. Accettiamo anche laureati freschi da applicare

• Hai conoscenza di base di elettronica, sistemi elettromeccanici, tecnologia dell'informazione e networking

• Hai eccellenti analitiche, analisi dei problemi e competenze decisionali

• Efficace capacità di pianificazione, organizzazione e gestione del tempo

• Efficace servizio clienti, comunicazione scritta/verbale, organizzazione e competenze di priorità

• Capacità comunicative verbali e scritte fluide in inglese. Mastering lingua araba sarà preferito

Nota importante:
A seconda del carico di lavoro ci sarà una necessità di frequenti viaggi nei paesi vicini del Medio Oriente per sostenere il programma PiPo, ma il Kuwait è la prima priorità. Si prevede di essere flessibili e disposti a viaggiare al di fuori del Kuwait per quei periodi di tempo.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per generitio
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Als regionaler Installationsspezialist werden Sie hauptsächlich in Kuwait und darüber hinaus tätig sein und für die Verlagerung und Deinstallation von bestehenden Serum Work Area (SWA) -Systemen und die Installation von Plattformen der neuen Generation (cobas pro, cobas pure und cobas smart e) für bestehende Kunden verantwortlich sein, um ein hohes Maß an Service-Exzellenz in der Region Naher Osten zu erreichen. Ihr Hauptzweck ist es, das PiPo-Programm (Phase-in-Phase-out) erfolgreich zu beschleunigen, indem Sie temporäre Kapazitätslücken während der Installationsspitzen überbrücken.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Installation/Umsiedlung/Deinstallation analytischer Laborgeräte von Roche Diagnostics.

• Technische Freigabe von Analysesystemen für den Laborgebrauch.

• Konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Vorbereitung der Kundenstandorte, die zusätzliche Aufmerksamkeit erfordern, basierend auf der kontinuierlichen Zunahme der Kundenanforderungen und den Spezifikationen der von uns gelieferten Instrumente.

• Analysieren und lösen Sie die meisten Fragen und Probleme unabhängig und verweisen Sie nur die komplexesten Probleme auf höhere Ebenen.

• Zeitnahe und genaue Protokollierung der Daten gemäß Arbeitsanweisungen und Vereinbarungen, in Bezug auf Aktivitäten im CRM-System. Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Aktivitäten in einer Weise dokumentiert sind, die konform ist, und führen Sie Aufzeichnungen gemäß den geltenden Verfahren des Unternehmens.

• Rechtzeitige Durchführung von Aufgaben, Aufrechterhaltung der Ordnung am Arbeitsplatz sowie die effektivste Nutzung der Arbeitszeit.

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der beruflichen Qualifikationen und Teilnahme an Betriebssitzungen und Schulungen sowie an allen vom Arbeitgeber organisierten Formen der beruflichen Bildung. Aktives Sammeln von Informationen in Vorbereitung auf Meetings, aktive Teilnahme an diesen Meetings und Feedback zum Ergebnis dieser Meetings an andere

• Entwicklung und Überwachung lokaler Berichte und Dokumente, um die effiziente und produktive Erbringung von Dienstleistungen zu gewährleisten.

• Kosten für eigene Serviceaktivitäten aktiv überwachen

Sensibilisierung für neue Service Bulletins, Global Customer Support (GCS) Hot News und andere Foren

Wer du bist
Du bist jemand, der deine eigene Entwicklung beeinflussen will. Sie suchen ein Unternehmen, in dem Sie die Möglichkeit haben, Ihre Interessen über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu verfolgen. Wo eine Berufsbezeichnung nicht als die endgültige Definition dessen gilt, wer Sie sind, sondern als Ausgangspunkt.

• Sie haben einen BSc-Abschluss in Bio-Medizintechnik, Präzisionsmechanik, Elektronik, Informationstechnologie, Medizintechnik oder verwandten

• Sie haben 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung in einem verwandten Bereich aufgebaut. Wir begrüßen auch frische Absolventen zu bewerben

• Sie haben Grundkenntnisse in Elektronik, elektromechanischen Systemen, Informationstechnologie und Vernetzung

• Sie haben ausgezeichnete analytische, Problemanalyse und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten

• Effektive Planungs-, Organisations- und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten

• Effektiver Kundenservice, schriftliche/verbale Kommunikation, Organisation und Priorisierung

• Fließende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch. Beherrschung der arabischen Sprache wird bevorzugt

Wichtiger Hinweis:
Abhängig von der Arbeitsbelastung wird es notwendig sein, häufig in die Nachbarländer des Nahen Ostens zu reisen, um das PiPo-Programm zu unterstützen, aber Kuwait ist die erste Priorität. Es wird erwartet, dass sie flexibel und bereit sind, für diese zeiträume außerhalb von kuwait zu reisen.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung und Generatio hat.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
En tant que spécialiste régional de l'installation, vous opérerez principalement au Koweït et au-delà, et serez responsable de la réinstallation et de la désinstallation des anciens systèmes Serum Work Area (SWA) et de l'installation de plates-formes de nouvelle génération (cobas pro, cobas pure et cobas smart e) pour les clients existants, afin d'atteindre un haut niveau d'excellence de service dans la région du Moyen-Orient. Votre objectif principal est d'accélérer avec succès le programme PiPo (phase d'élimination progressive) en comblant les lacunes de capacité temporaire pendant les pics d'installation.

Vos responsabilités

• Installation/relocalisation/désinstallation d'instruments de laboratoire analytique de Roche Diagnostics.

• Publication technique de systèmes d'analyse pour usage en laboratoire.

• Se concentrer sur la préparation des sites clients qui nécessitent une attention supplémentaire basée sur l'augmentation continue des demandes des clients et des spécifications des instruments que nous livrons.

• Analyser et résoudre la plupart des questions et des problèmes de façon indépendante et ne renvoyer que les questions les plus complexes à des niveaux plus élevés.

• Enregistrement rapide et précis des données conformément aux instructions et accords de travail, en ce qui concerne les activités dans le système CRM. S'assurer que toutes les activités sont documentées d'une manière conforme et tenir des registres conformément aux procédures applicables de l'entreprise.

• Exécution en temps voulu des tâches, maintien de l'ordre sur le lieu de travail et utilisation la plus efficace du temps de travail.

• Amélioration continue des qualifications professionnelles et participation aux réunions et formations de l'entreprise ainsi qu'à toutes les formes de formation professionnelle organisées par l'employeur. Collecte active d'informations en préparation des réunions, participation active à ces réunions et retour d'information sur les résultats de ces réunions

• Élaborer et suivre les rapports et documents locaux pour assurer la prestation efficace et productive des services.

• Surveiller activement les coûts de ses activités de service

• Sensibilisation aux nouveaux bulletins de service, au service clientèle mondial (GCS) et aux autres forums

Qui vous êtes
Vous êtes quelqu'un qui veut influencer votre propre développement. Vous êtes à la recherche d'une entreprise où vous avez la possibilité de poursuivre vos intérêts à travers des fonctions et des géographies. Lorsqu'un titre d'emploi n'est pas considéré comme la définition finale de qui vous êtes, mais comme le point de départ.

• Vous avez obtenu un baccalauréat en génie biomédical, mécanique de précision, électronique, technologie de l'information, technologie médicale ou connexe

• Vous avez construit 1 an d'expérience dans un domaine connexe. Nous accueillons également les nouveaux diplômés à postuler

• Vous avez une connaissance de base de l'électronique, des systèmes électromécaniques, des technologies de l'information et des réseaux

• Vous avez d'excellentes compétences en analyse, analyse de problèmes et prise de décision

• Compétences efficaces en matière de planification, d'organisation et de gestion du temps

• Service à la clientèle efficace, communication écrite/verbale, organisation et priorisation

• Compétences en communication orale et écrite. Maîtriser la langue arabe sera préféré

Remarque importante:
Selon la charge de travail, il faudra se rendre fréquemment dans les pays voisins du Moyen-Orient pour soutenir le programme PiPo, mais le Koweït est la première priorité. Vous devez être flexible et disposé à voyager en dehors du Koweït pendant ces périodes.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dédiés à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour generatio

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Diese Vision treibt unsere Innovationen an. Unser Engineering-Team trägt hierzu mit der Planung und Umsetzung von Investitionsprojekten bis zu einem dreistelligen Millionenbereich, wie z.B. Labor-/Produktionsgebäuden oder Produktionsanlagen in Pharma und Diagnostik, maßgeblich bei. Deine Aufgaben Als Senior Projektleiter / Projektingenieur HVAC (m/w/d) arbeitest du in interdisziplinären Teams und fokussierst dich auf alle Themen rund um die TGA / HVAC sowie angrenzende Gewerke. Als Teil der Roche Community arbeitest du sowohl an fachlichen Themenstellungen als auch an der Weiterentwicklung der Einheit und berätst unsere Business Partner. Klingt spannend? Dann steige tiefer mit uns ein:
• Eigenverantwortliche Planung und Abwicklung von Teilprojekten innerhalb komplexer Großprojekte oder auch fachspezifischer Gesamtprojekte als Projektleiter
• Verantwortung in großen Bauprojekten bzw. einem entsprechenden Portfolio kleinerer Projekte mit ausgeprägter Komplexität und Entwicklung innovativer sowie wirtschaftlicher technischer Lösungen
• Erstellung zielgenauer Leistungsbeschreibungen und Beauftragung und Koordination qualifizierter Fachingenieure, Dienstleister und Lieferanten unter Berücksichtigung verschiedener Abwicklungsmodelle (z.B. EPC, TÜ, GU, Einzelvergaben) sowie Sicherstellung der Qualität
• Inbetriebnahme und Unterstützung bei der Qualifizierung von technischen Einrichtungen sowie deren Übergabe an die Betreiber Das bringst Du mit:
• Ein Ingenieurstudium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung in den Fachrichtungen Versorgungstechnik, Energie- und Gebäudetechnik, Gebäudeklimatik, Maschinenbau o.ä. hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen
• Du verfügst über langjährige praktische Erfahrungen in relevanten Funktionen für die integrative Planung und Realisierung komplexer Bauvorhaben/Projekte mit überwiegend industriellem Hintergrund.
• Deine tiefe Expertise im Umgang mit Projektmanagement-Methoden konntest du bereits in größeren CAPEX-Projekten unter Beweis stellen
• Dabei runden fundierte Kenntnisse in allen Bereichen der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung dein Profil ab
• Du freust dich darauf, zukunftsweisende Arbeitsmethoden wie z. B. BIM anzuwenden
• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten und Präsentationsstärke
• Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, die verschiedenen Stakeholder zu beraten, komplexe Zusammenhänge in Projekten verständlich zu vermitteln und verstehst es, bei Zielkonflikten unterschiedlichster Stakeholder, pragmatische Lösungsvorschläge zu erarbeiten.
• Einsatzort ist am Standort Penzberg und bei Bedarf im Rahmen von Dienstreisen (bis zu ca. 30%) auch in Mannheim. Das sind wir: Das Chapter Engineering RDG ist mit 170 Mitarbeitenden für die erfolgreiche Planung und Umsetzung aller großen Investitionsprojekte im dreistelligen Millionenbereich, wie z.B. Labor-/Produktionsgebäuden oder Produktionsanlagen, verantwortlich. Durch unsere Arbeit sichern wir die Versorgung unserer Patienten mit innovativen Produkten und die Weiterentwicklung der Standorte Penzberg und Mannheim. Wir sind eine selbstorganisierte Einheit mit flachen Hierarchien und legen viel Wert auf Eigenverantwortlichkeit, eine offene Unternehmenskultur und Spaß an der Arbeit. Teamarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung der Kollegen und Freiheitsgrade bei der Projektbearbeitung sind bei uns selbstverständlich. Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefi

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt. Description of the area Senior Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) with a focus on Technical Extensibility and Automation. Responsible for the strategic design and operational excellence of the "Requirements to Deploy" process. This role bridges the gap between high-level ALM frameworks and the underlying technical architecture. You will lead the design of custom extensions, workflows, and integrations within the SAP ALM ecosystem (Solution Manager and Cloud ALM), ensuring that the toolset is not just "out-of-the-box" but optimized through advanced development patterns to meet complex enterprise needs. You will provide the technical vision for how ABAP-based ALM tools evolve to support modern DevOps and agile delivery. Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.
• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.
• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.
• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring. Qualifications
• Deep Technical Mastery: Extensive experience (8+ years) in SAP development, including ABAP, Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS), Web Dynpro, and SAP CRM technical frameworks.
• ALM Toolset Expert: Expert-level knowledge of SAP Solution Manager (Focused Build, ChaRM, Solution Documentation, Test Management, Project management

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position PSS Transformation and Solution Partner Position Summary As a Transformation and Solution Partner , you will engage and partner primarily with People & Culture (P&C) colleagues across all Chapters and business stakeholders globally. Your mission is to govern M&A and transformation data management frameworks with right solution expertise while driving global P&C solution improvements. You will serve as a centre of excellence for transformation ideation, navigating complex business transformations to ensure a seamless partner experience in collaboration with Transformation and Solution Advisor. You help translate business goals into P&C priorities, leveraging holistic data and historical learning to iterate and improve the overall global transformation flow. Your opportunity as Transformation & Solution Partner
• M&A / Transformation Framework Governance: Lead the governance of transformation frameworks to ensure consistency and excellence across global initiatives.
• Transformation Solution & Framework Expertise: Provide expert guidance and implementation support for digital transformation tools. Serve as a Centre of Excellence for transformation improvement ideations, capturing historical learnings to further iterate and enhance existing transformation experience.
• Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with Business Partners and business leaders of globally-scaled transformations to provide framework consultancy, from preliminary until embedment stages.
• Cross P&C Solution Improvement: Drive improvements for the overall global transformation flow, identifying gaps and implementing proactive solutions across the P&C network. Collaborates on complex P&C challenges and demands, connecting with the right P&C chapters to develop an end-to-end solution, determine ownership and drive effective change management.
• Continue Improvement : Proactively identifies customer needs or P&C solutions’ gaps, and translates these needs to change requests and builds cross-functional squads to implement continuous improvements within our P&C network.
• Collaboration & Innovation: Share best practices for emerging technologies, such as AI-driven org design and job design to build Transformation and solution advisory team knowledge and capability. Who you are You bring the following skills and competencies:
• Passion for Change: Deep interest in project management, process improvement, and change management.
• Digital Proficiency: Strong expertise in digital solutions like Airtable and Workday, with the ability to lead the transition from manual spreadsheets to integrated technology platforms.
• Exceptional Stakeholder Management: Ability to represent the P&C/PSS vision and articulate the strategy and “the why” behind complex transformations.
• Agility: Ability to work independently and deliver results in a matrixed, fast-paced environment while balancing competing priorities.
• Influencing Skills: Exceptional communication, consulting, and negotiation skills, with the ability to coach colleagues and lead without direct authority. Further requirements
• Education: University degree or equivalent, HR preferred.
• Experience: Extensive experience (typically 7–8 years) with HR processes, HR shared services, or HR functional expertise, ideally in a global environment.
• Transformation Expertise: Proven track record in managing large-scale global transformations and M&A activities.
• Languages: Fluent in English required; additional languages are a plus.
• Certi

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Computer System Validation (CSV) is part of the ITOT organization located in Singapore with primary focus on CSV strategy and validation activities for site ITOT products. Scope of CSV activities for ITOT product covers Local software instances qualification for Global/Core system such as MES, local vendor product software qualification, IT infrastructure (eg. server/workstation/network switches).
• Work closely with site CSV Lead in on to generate CSV deliverables for product software, IT infrastructure (eg. server/workstation/network switches) during projects for systems that are maintained by ITOT team.
• Work with local ITOT and cross functional teams (eg. Quality Validation, MSAT Automation, Manufacturing, Quality Control etc) for assessment such as System Impact Assessment, Critical Assessment, Data Integrity Assessment, Audit Trail Assessment etc.
• Manage the maintenance of life cycle documentation.
• Generate protocols for commissioning and qualification activities for ITOT products.
• Adhere to the requirements specified in Automation and ITOT related Roche & quality policies/quality standards or related SOP.
• Adopt Roche’s good engineering practice documents as guidance documents when performing the work function. Safety, Health & Environment:
• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.
• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately. Lean Production System:
• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives. Who You Are
• Diploma or B.S in Computer Science, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent degree and relevant work experience/training.
• Experience/familiar with IT/Automation system support in biotech/pharmaceutical manufacturing GMP environment is a plus
• Knowledge on CSV activities is a plus
• Candidates must be able to work well with others as a team member in an in a results-oriented work environment.
• Self-driven. Must have good communication skills (both verbal and written), and be able to work collaboratively with colleagues. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
