descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Bei der Roche Pharma AG arbeiten wir täglich an der Vision, die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft zu gestalten. Als Customer Partnering Manager (d/w/m) für Multiple Sklerose (RRMS) bist Du das Bindeglied zwischen medizinischer Innovation und der realen Versorgung in Deiner Region. Du verstehst die Patient Journey wie eine Landkarte und setzt Deine Energie dort ein, wo Du echten Mehrwert für Menschen, das Gesundheitssystem und unser Portfolio schaffen kannst. Dein neues Team: Du wirst Teil einer dynamischen EcoUnit, in der wir Silos hinter uns lassen und gemeinsam an einem Strang ziehen. Unser Team besteht aus Expert:innen, die eine offene Feedbackkultur leben und sich gegenseitig inspirieren. Hier triffst Du auf Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und die Freiheit schätzen, neue Wege in der Kundeninteraktion zu gehen. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich In dieser Rolle bist Du der/die Regisseur:in für regionale Strategien und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Lösungen genau dort ankommen, wo sie gebraucht werden.
• Patient Journey Navigator: Du analysierst Hürden in der Diagnose und Behandlung und leitest daraus mutige Handlungsoptionen ab.
• Wissenschaftlicher Partner: Du berätst medizinisches Fachpersonal auf Augenhöhe und stellst eine transparente, rechtmäßige Anwendung unserer Produkte sicher.
• Event-Gestalter: Du planst und moderierst Fortbildungsveranstaltungen sowie wissenschaftliche Produktschulungen, um Wissen direkt erlebbar zu machen.
• Beziehungs-Architekt: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für Deine Stakeholder und baust ein starkes, crossfunktionales Netzwerk auf.
• Impulsgeber: Du bringst Markttrends proaktiv ins Team ein und gestaltest die Disease Area Strategie aktiv mit. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit, die es liebt, komplexe Netzwerke zu knüpfen und durch Fachwissen zu überzeugen.
• Hintergrund: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Medizin, Naturwissenschaften oder BWL) und bringst Erfahrung aus der Pharmaindustrie mit.
• Expertise: Du besitzt tiefes Wissen im Bereich der Neuroscience sowie Kenntnisse zur Gesundheits Regulatorik, Gesundheitswesen und -organisationen (inkl. Krankenhausmanagement)
• Digitaler Mindset: Der Umgang mit digitalen Kommunikationstools (z.B. Zoom, Google Suite) ist für Dich so natürlich wie das Atmen.
• Persönlichkeit: Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Mehrwert und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.
• Zulassung: Du erfüllst die Voraussetzungen als Pharmaberater:in nach AMG und besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein. Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil
• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns! Your contact to us! With people. For people. title: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integrations

titleByLocale.it: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integration
titleByLocale.en: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integrations
titleByLocale.de: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integrations
titleByLocale.fr: Propriétaire principal de la solution technique – Application et intégration de Cornerstone

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integration serves as the ultimate technical authority for our Cornerstone platform as a core enterprise solution supporting learning, talent, and people development processes. You are the “subject matter expert”, responsible for technical integrity, exploiting Cornerstones functionalities maximising the platform's business value while ensuring technical stability. This role provides clear ownership of the technical realization and integration ecosystem, leading data migration initiatives, with a strong outcome oriented mindset and ability to translate requirements into acceptance criteria and ensure successful solution delivery. In this role, you serve as a high-level sparring partner to other seniors IT stakeholders, contributing with your deep-dive Cornerstone expertise. You bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution, ensuring that every integration - whether upstream from Core HR or to downstream systems - is seamless, scalable, and robust. Your span of control ranges from license management, platform performance and stability, compliance and audit readiness, release feature prioritization, to driving medium- to large-scale initiatives that enhance the value, adoption, and impact of the platform. As a senior leader in this space, you shape the technical evolution of the Cornerstone platform based on business priorities and the platform’s technical dept, guide decision-making delivering respective change impact assessments, and ensure that platform capabilities are translated into meaningful business outcomes. You work closely with business stakeholders, product and technical teams, architects, and external partners to ensure the solution is scalable, user-centered, and fit for purpose. With your in depth Cornerstone expertise and your learning process acumen, you understand the context of changes and how they relate to business needs to proactively shape the learning landscape. This role goes beyond operational delivery. It requires a strong understanding of stakeholder ecosystems, enterprise platforms, and business transformation, with a particular focus on ensuring that Cornerstone capabilities are aligned to strategic priorities, integrated into end-to-end people processes, and optimized to deliver measurable value . Key Responsibilities Audit & Compliance
• Validation & Audits : Ensure fully documented and validated system including change control and ensure compliant change administration on GXP application. Orchestrate audits and periodic reviews to ensure compliance resolving respective findings.
• Security & Access Control: Oversee tenant access, and perform Cornerstone account reviews, oversee and control access provisioning. Accountable for access provisioning, training assignment and training completion of workforce operating and using Cornerstone platform.
• Documentation : Lead delivery and regular update of Data Migration Plans, Operational Support Plans and Information Risk Assessment and Mitigation System documents such as security risk assessments, data processing agreements. Technical Solution Ownership
• Functional Design & Innovation : Evaluate Cornerstone features, platform developments and integration requests to provide expert recommendations on how to simplify, harmonize, and innovate people-processes through technical enablement, understanding overall business change impact. Ensure the solution design supports end-to-end business process

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. You will manage the Reagent and Health Performance (RHP) team, overseeing headcount, budget, and logistics to ensure products are robust and sustainable. By setting high standards for efficiency, you’ll drive the seamless transition of complex assays across their entire lifecycle. The Opportunity:
• Team Development: Hire, train, mentor, and develop team members to support individual career growth and team success.
• Technical Leadership: Manage commercialization of new products and post-launch monitoring of on-market products, risk evaluation of the on market portfolio, designing fit for purpose testing to assess product risks, and drive failure investigations.
• Program Management: Ensure milestones, timelines, and deliverables are met for development and on-market support projects.
• SAFe Agile Execution: Serve as a Product Owner in a SAFe Agile environment, driving team execution and priorities.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Partner cross-functionally to ensure alignment with company objectives and project commitments. You are highly effective at translating complex technical data into actionable insights for stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
• Collaborative Focus: Foster an open, innovative, and collaborative environment during process and assay development efforts.
• Operational Excellence: Refine team procedures, maintain key laboratories and equipment, and ensure compliance with health, safety, and Roche standards.
• Strategic Oversight: Actively explores new methodologies, processes, and new ways of working to improve reagent quality and overall efficiencies.
• Leadership Participation: Actively contribute to the ACT and OAD Leadership Team and other strategic initiatives. ​ Who you are:
• You have a BS (with 8+ yrs), or a MS (with 6+ yrs), or PhD (with 4+ yrs) in relevant scientific disciplines (e.g. Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology).
• You have 3 years of hands-on experience in scientific research and product development
• You have 1+ years of direct management and/or project management experience
• You maintain a deep understanding of principles in chemistry, biochemistry, and molecular biology, while exhibiting exceptional verbal and written communication skills to present complex information clearly.
• You showcase comprehensive knowledge in developing, implementing, and supporting reagent-based products in FDA/IVDR regulated environments.
• You demonstrate strong leadership capabilities to effectively motivate, guide, and manage within both matrixed and direct-line environments. ​ Preferred Qualifications:
• You have experience with SAFe Agile methodologies is highly valued. ​ The expected salary range for this position is 116,500-216,300 based on the primary location of Tucson, AZ. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. Relocation benefits are available for this posting. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed here: Benefits Compensation & Benefits This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As the supervisor of Histology, you will lead the Operations team that generates control slides for internal and external customers. This team sections all tissue used for titering of raw materials, final release testing for instruments and reagent quality control, and all finished goods produced containing tissue. You will be responsible for obtaining procured tissue and ensuring all work is compliant with quality policies and procedures as they apply to material traceability, grossing, processing, embedding, microtomy, and kitting in operations. You will oversee both full-time and contingent Histology professionals ranging from entry-level staff with minimal histology experience to senior Histotechnicians and cell culture technicians across multiple shifts. Your main responsibilities include ensuring employee safety, maintaining quality standards for finished goods, and guaranteeing that all departmental output is completed on time and in full according to organizational demand. Additionally, you will be regarded as the expert in tissue-related processes, including tissue identification and use in design transfer, troubleshooting quality control issues, and providing feedback on tissue quality and availability in operations. The Position People Leadership/Development - 50%
• You will lead and empower direct reports through coaching, training, and ongoing constructive feedback; applies VACC principles (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coaching) for effective team leadership and development.
• You will manage team time, attendance, and performance through the annual review process, corrective actions as needed, and ensure compliance with corporate policies and training requirements.
• Hires, onboards, trains, and develops new team members while optimizing staffing and conducting workforce planning to match current and future production demands.
• You will assign workload strategically, motivate the team to meet or exceed customer expectations, and provide necessary guidance for career development of direct reports.
• Ensures team members operate within corporate policy guidelines by monitoring training, competency, and delivering additional training when needed.
• Collaborates with support functions to drive value stream, lean manufacturing improvements, and participates in global projects and initiatives. Production - 30%
• You will serve as the primary contract for the Histology department and all tissue-related topics within the operations organization, ensuring competence and proficiency in all aspects of GMP-regulated laboratory operations.
• You will oversee production, testing, maintenance, and release of tissue-related finished goods within established schedules and budget targets while ensuring production factory adherence.
• Set daily, weekly, and monthly goals; align deliverables across shifts and processes; and identify scheduling conflicts, production issues, and equipment maintenance needs, collaborating with support functions for resolution.
• Interface with other functional groups to gain alignment on new process implementation and problem resolution; identify improvement opportunities and obtain approvals for process changes.
• Determine and manage KPIs relevant to departmental performance including resource management, budget/spending, safety, quality, and delivery performance.
• Participate as a stakeholder in project-based activities (e.g., new product transfers, inventory reduction, scale-up) and collaborate with Finance and

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di coordinatore RCC stai fornendo supporto al Roche Career Center con varie attività operative come la creazione di eventi, lo sviluppo di descrizioni dei processi, la gestione della proprietà del processo, il mantenimento dell'impegno e del supporto del cliente, nonché varie attività di comunicazione come la creazione e il mantenimento di materiali promozionali sui canali Roche, che rappresentano il RCC negli eventi, l'aggiornamento del sito web RCC, ecc. Ci sono anche molte opportunità per partecipare come consulente per 1:1 offerte, per facilitare workshop ed eventi, e per svolgere attività di onboarding e train-the-trainer per i volontari. E 'una fantastica opportunità di contribuire ad un approccio agile di sostenere l'occupabilità a Roche e l'abilitazione e l'impegno dei dipendenti a prendere la responsabilità per i loro viaggi professionali. L'opportunità
• Coordinare e facilitare workshop e eventi di networking
• A bordo e formare nuovi volontari
• Tenere informata, impegnata e motivata la comunità dei volontari
• Mantenere le attività di comunicazione, incluse le newsletter mensili e la manutenzione del gSite
• Raccogli feedback dai clienti
• Valutare le statistiche e supportare la comunicazione degli aggiornamenti regolari dei dati
• Organizzare, organizzare e eseguire diversi workshop
• Impegnarsi con la comunità e gestire le relazioni con gli stakeholder Chi sei
• Attualmente iscritta come studente o si è recentemente laureata (nel corso degli ultimi 12 mesi), con un diploma di laurea o di master, preferibilmente in psicologia, business o sociologia.
• Hai un forte senso di proprietà e una mentalità imprenditoriale con forti capacità organizzative.
• È possibile motivare, coinvolgere e influenzare gli altri.
• Hai esperienza nella gestione degli stakeholder.
• Possiedi forti capacità di facilitazione e consulenza.
• Hai una forte conoscenza inglese; tedesco e/o altre lingue sono un plus. Informazioni aggiuntive
• La data di inizio preferita per lo stage è agosto 2026. Si prega di indicare la data di inizio preferita e la durata desiderata dello stage nella vostra applicazione.
• Durata: 12 mesi
• Carico di lavoro: 100% Processo di applicazione
• Per i cittadini non UE/non AELS: A causa delle normative, è necessario presentare un certificato rilasciato dalla vostra università, affermando che un tirocinio è obbligatorio per i vostri studi. Senza questo documento, la domanda non può essere considerata.
• Per applicare, si prega di inviare il pacchetto completo della domanda, compreso il vostro CV, lettera di copertura e qualsiasi certificato rilevante Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As an RCC Coordinator you are providing support to the Roche Career Center with various operational activities such as setting up events, developing process descriptions, taking over process ownership, maintaining customer engagement and support, as well as various communication activities such as creating and maintaining promotional materials on Roche channels, representing the RCC in events, updating the RCC website, etc. There are also many opportunities to step in as an advisor for 1:1 offers, to facilitate workshops and events, and to run onboarding and train-the-trainer activities for the volunteers. It’s a fantastic opportunity to contribute to an agile approach of supporting employability at Roche and empowering and engaging employees to take accountability for their professional journeys. The Opportunity
• Coordinate and facilitate workshops and networking events
• Onboard and train new volunteers
• Keep the volunteer community informed, engaged, and motivated
• Handle communication activities, including monthly newsletters and maintenance of the gSite
• Gather feedback from customers
• Evaluate statistics and support the communication of regular data updates
• Organize, set up, and run different workshops
• Engage with the community and manage stakeholder relationships Who You are
• Currently enrolled as a student or have recently graduated (within the last 12 months), with a bachelor's or master's degree, preferably in Psychology, Business or Sociology.
• You have a strong sense of ownership and an entrepreneurial mindset with strong organizational skills.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Partner

Location: Warsaw, Poland, hybrid, work travel required

We are looking for a Medical Partner who will play a key role in identifying unmet medical needs and driving innovative solutions. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, healthcare professionals, and external partners to shape medical strategy, support clinical research, and ensure the highest standards of medical ethics and compliance. If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in the healthcare ecosystem, we’d love to hear from you!

The Opportunity:

• Identifying unmet medical needs and implementing innovative solutions in collaboration with Healthcare Ecosystem members and cross-functionally with other teams.

• Preparing a medical strategy for a specific area or product group in partnership with other Squad members.

• Supporting reimbursement, registration, and medical information activities.

• Co-creating information and educational materials.

• Approving promotional and informational materials from a medical perspective.

• Communicating medical knowledge and insights from the medical community to teams involved in strategy development and execution.

• Designing and preparing local clinical trials, overseeing their progress, and providing medical reporting.

• Collaborating with medical compliance partners on pharmacovigilance while ensuring the highest standards of GCP, GVP, and medical ethics.

• Working closely with the Clinical Research team.

• Building strong scientific and professional relationships with HCPs, HCOs, and the Roche network.

• Providing medical and scientific support while delivering training to internal teams.

• Ensuring consistency and alignment in all interactions with external partners, including experts and key opinion leaders.

Who you are:

• Deep knowledge and insights into Evidence-Based Medicine principles.

• More than 2 years of relevant experience in medical affairs or similar roles.

• A relevant medical university degree e.g. MSc or pharmacist.

• A demonstrated passion for improving patient pathways and driving better healthcare outcomes.

• Proven experience in managing relationships with high-level KOLs and maintaining a strong network within your therapeutic areas; neurology preferred.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive insights from complex data.

• Passion for innovative health solutions in the area of medical devices.

• Strong medical compliance mindset.

• Proficiency in Polish and English, with excellent communication skills in both languages.

What you get:

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.);

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available)

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice)

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Stock share purchase additions;

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

The controller of your personal data is Roche Polska Sp. z o.o., ul. Domaniewska 28, 02-672 Warsaw. The data is processe

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a Enterprise Identity Management Engineer to serve as a senior primary architect of our Enterprise Identity Management (IGA) future. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will design, build, and deliver next-generation identity solutions operating at global scale. Positioned at the intersection of security engineering and business enablement, you'll create resilient frameworks that protect critical systems while enabling seamless, automated access. As a technical visionary, you'll tackle the most complex identity challenges within our large-scale enterprise ecosystem. The Opportunity In this pivotal role, you will act as a primary architect driving the evolution of our Enterprise Identity Management strategy. You'll own the complete technical lifecycle, from designing scalable solutions to delivering resilient implementations across our global infrastructure. Main Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end technical design of EIM solutions aligned with enterprise standards and security policies
• Define and standardize architecture patterns, best practices, and reusable frameworks
• Conduct design reviews and provide technical governance for scalable, high-quality implementations
• Translate security and business requirements into actionable technical solutions
• Architect, build, test, and deploy SailPoint-based IAM solutions from the ground up
• Deliver resilient identity solutions across complex, distributed environments
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation and production rollout
• Own delivery lifecycle end-to-end, including planning, estimation, timelines, and risk management
• Act as Tier 3 escalation point, leading root cause analysis and long-term fixes
• Drive innovation through PoCs and adoption of modern EIM Integrations (APIs, cloud integrations) Who You Are Core Expertise & Experience
• Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in Identity Management within large-scale, global environments.
• 3+ years experience working in a multinational work environment (Healthcare Industry experience a plus) as an Engineer/Technical team member
• Strong customer engagement and presentation skills with the ability to communicate across all levels (senior and/or small audiences)
• Deep technical expertise in SailPoint, specifically in design, custom development, troubleshooting, and architecture.
• Ability to work effectively with team members and virtual teams from different locations and different cultural background
• Ability to function independently with little supervision
• Advanced programming proficiency in Java for developing custom connectors, rules, and complex workflows.
• Proven experience implementing Integration solutions with Active Directory and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, and modern architecture (APIs, microservices, cloud)
• Strong understanding of RBAC, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and access governance frameworks. Education
• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.
• Professional Information Security certifications (e.g., CISSP) is a plus. If you're an experienced identity architect with deep SailPoint expertise, a passion for solving complex security challenges, and the drive to own end-to-end technical delivery in a multinational environment, we want to hear from you. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posti

The Position As a Policy and Value Partner (PVP) , you will be a key driver in delivering life-changing healthcare to patients by strategically influencing stakeholder perceptions and decision-making. You will engage with both internal and external stakeholders to shape the broader policy ecosystem and demonstrate the immense value of our innovative medicines. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As an EHS Technician, you support the Manufacturing and R&D functions of GenMark Diagnostics across all Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) matters. Under general supervision, you perform technical duties including hazardous waste disposal, office ergonomics, and the maintenance of site SHE documentation. You serve as a key resource, providing safety expertise and guidance to site leadership The Opportunity
• Assisting in maintaining corporate safety standards and policies, adapting to changes, and ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations by creating and maintaining safety records, data, and files.
• Supporting the safety supervisor in implementing policies, procedures, and training, including ergonomic assessments, industrial hygiene surveys, evacuation drills, facility inspections, and handling and disposal of hazardous chemicals and medical waste.
• Coordinating, conducting, and participating in regular safety meetings, such as Emergency Response Team meetings, while managing and maintaining required documentation.
• Utilizing and updating company-specific SHE Data Management Software, Work Order systems, and Preventive Maintenance software to support safety operations efficiently.
• Assisting with incident investigations, follow-up on corrective actions, and thorough documentation of safety/environmental/equipment-related incidents.
• Developing metrics, creating data summaries, and preparing communications for leadership reporting to facilitate informed decision-making.
• Performing additional tasks as assigned, contributing to a wide range of safety and environmental health responsibilities essential to the position. Who You Are
• You bring a minimum of 1 year of experience in an EHS-specific role.
• If you have two years of college courses completed in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or another technical degree, that's preferred
• CPR, AED and First Aid Instructor Certification are preferred Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.
• Knowledge of Emergency Action and Emergency Response Plans, including recurring training and drills
• Self-directed and demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple projects and prioritize. You are a trusted partner and can influence within a complex and collaborative organization.
• You bring technical skills with the ability to explain complex issues and requirements verbally and in writing in an easily understood manner. Proficient in computer skills.
• Interpersonal and cross-cultural skills; willingness to work flexible hours Relocation Benefits are not offered for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position, based on California is 40,200.00.- 74,600.00 USD annually. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. Benefits Who we are GenMark is now a proud member of the Roche Group, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. As a global leader in healthcare, Roche Diagnostics offers a broad portfolio of products, tools and services that help in the prevention, diagnosis and management of diseases like HPV, HIV, hepatitis and diabetes as well as other medical conditions, such as fertility and blood coagulation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Information Security & Privacy By Design team is the engine behind Roche’s security governance. We design, deliver, and support the digital frameworks that protect our organization, including IRAAM (Information Risk Assessment And Mitigation), PETRA (Policy Exceptions Tool for Risk Asse ssment ), OIA ( Outsourcing Impact Assessment), and our cutting-edge GenAI security agents. As a Process Operations Coordinator , you are the "Chef d’Orchestre" of our technical execution. Your mission is to facilitate the seamless flow of our security frameworks, ensuring that process deliverables are triggered on time, users are supported, and reporting is accurate. You are the operational backbone that ensures our security processes are not just defined, but are actively understood, automated, and data-driven. You are a proactive facilitator who enjoys "connecting the dots" between complex technical systems and human workflows. You believe that security governance only works when the user experience is smooth and the data is reliable. Description of the Area The Information Security & Privacy By Design team makes Roche’s information security governance accessible through actionable processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate information risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee third-party and personal data processing risks. Our processes are primarily instantiated in the ServiceNow IRM Platform . We work closely with Information Security, Privacy, Risk & Compliance, and IT teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s information risk posture. You’ll be working within the Information Security Governance (ISG) area. ISG is responsible for defining the strategic agenda for information security and privacy topics at the Roche Group level. This is realized within the global Information Security Management System (ISMS) which aligns business and IT strategies, business and technical projects, policies, standards, directives, procedures, governance, legal / regulatory, compliance, and other requirements at a global level. The Information Security & Privacy by Design area is accountable for co-developing, in collaboration with key stakeholders, and stewardship of the strategic direction of the Information Risk Assessment processes based on organizational objectives, industry practices and legal / regulatory requirements - e.g IRAAM, PETRA, OIA. This includes oversight, awareness, direction and continuous improvement to the end-to-end processes and their relevant risk modules in alignment with the global ISMS, corporate directives and Roche management systems (e.g. privacy, quality, risk). Job Responsibilities 1. Operational Facilitation & Workflow Orchestration
• IRAAM Fulfillment: Actively "chase" and monitor the delivery of critical artifacts, such as control attestations, to ensure the process flow remains uninterrupted.
• SER Triage Management: Facilitate the Security Expert Review (SER) Triage process, prioritizing and coordinating the assignment of Information Security & Privacy Advisors (ISPA) to execute reviews.
• Process Lifecycle Oversight: Monitor the end-to-end execution of IRAAM, PETRA and OIA processes, ensuring milestones are met and bottlenecks are addressed proactively. ​ 2. Request Management & Platform Support
• ServiceNow Orchestration: Manage and maintain the service request management tool and its related artifacts within ServiceNow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Join us at a pivotal moment in healthcare—one driven by our market-leading success and expansion strategy." As the UK market leader in immunohistochemistry (IHC) and Digital Pathology for Cellular Pathology/Histology, we work directly with healthcare partners to deliver essential products and solutions globally. We have a strong product portfolio, a clear pipeline for future success, and an excellent team. Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, you will be joining our expanding sales team at an exciting time of growth. Due to our continued market success and expansion plans, we are recruiting an additional highly motivated individual to to play a vital part in reshaping the healthcare landscape. Your deep understanding of customer needs and our collaborative environment will ensure continued success in a highly impactful field. The role Thanks to our strong history of success we have an exciting opportunity for an additional highly motivated individual to join our Tissue Diagnostics sales team in the Central UK region, covering the West of Central England or Wales . You will be promoting the value proposition of our products with key clinical, procurement and finance stakeholders in West of Central England or Wales. As part of your remit, you will mainly focus on:
• Taking a lead in the account sales strategy and execution for the product portfolio on you territory, you will work closely with Customer Account Managers, Product Specialists, Managed Laboratory Service Team and Workflow IT Specialists.
• Managing and coordinating complex pan pathology procurements, utilising self-discipline and a creative approach to ensure sales methodology is delivered on time and in full. This will involve engagement with all levels of the key decision making team, including senior management.
• Identifying market development and changes in NHS landscape on your territory (payment,procurement, tendering, and NHS processes) to maximise opportunities/minimise threats.
• Developing innovative strategies to retain existing Roche sites and acquire new sites. Your profile
• Educated to BSc (Hons) /BA Degree or equivalent in a life science or with related experience such as a biomedical scientist background and preferably with previous experience of field sales/or knowledge of laboratories and the Roche Tissue Diagnostics product portfolio.
• You will be skilled in defining customer needs and building strong and effective relationships and have knowledge of best practices in Cellular pathology (especially IHC) and cancer pathways.
• In order to be effective in this role you will need to be resilient, tenacious and both adaptable and flexible to work within a changing environment.
• You have the blend of discipline to follow best practice and creativity to re-define what that looks like. You will understand barriers to acceptance of new solutions and be able to drive positive sales outcomes.
• You will be self-motivated, focused and methodical, with the ability to work alone, yet readily communicate and share knowledge to the team.
• You will have the ability to sell with high credibility and be able to turn strategy into actionable implementation.
• You will drive commercial excellence in your territory by using the latest digital sales engagement tools. Why Join Us? This is a fantastic opportunity to work within an exciting and diverse industry and within a highly successful team whilst developing and gaining invaluable knowledge and experiences in the process.

The Position As Team Lead in Network Security Edge Defense you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible. Description of the area The Edge Defense team belongs to the Network Security organization, a cornerstone of Information Security. We provide the technologies and services that protect the entire network against IT Security incidents and digital threats. The core stack of this team includes:
• Perimeter Defense: Network Firewalls and DDoS Mitigation
• Modern Architecture: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) services
• Cloud Network Security in AWS, Azure, GCP ​ Job Responsibilities
• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Define the digital roadmap for Perimeter Defense (Firewalls, DDoS) and Modern Architecture (Zero Trust) across the most external facing network segments, both on-premise and in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Operational Excellence & Automation: Drive an "Automation First" mindset for external network security, leveraging APIs and scripting to replace manual work with scalable security code ("Shift Left").
• Cloud-Native Security: Lead the security strategy for the complex multi-cloud footprint (AWS, Azure, GCP), focusing on securing the perimeter and network edge in the cloud.
• Lifecycle Management & Compliance: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Edge Defense technologies, from discovery to global scale, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, excluding GxP for non-manufacturing focus).
• Business Translation: Connect technical security performance of the external network to broader business outcomes, ensuring security is an accelerator for R&D and other non-manufacturing environments.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Deeply understand customer and business needs to shape the strategic direction and digital roadmap for the Edge Defense product, focusing on delivering high-value outcomes. Who You Are Experience
• 5+ years of experience in Information Security is an asset
• 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry is an asset
• 5+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management, program management or a similar role, with a proven track record of building high performing teams ​ Education

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche in 50 Worten Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Beschreibung Abteilung/Team Wir sichern die Exzellenz der Klinischen Chemie bei Roche Diagnostics. Im Bereich R&D Testentwicklung sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere etablierten Diagnostik-Lösungen weltweit Tag für Tag präzise Ergebnisse liefern. Wir sind die Experten für Product Quality: Wenn komplexe technische Herausforderungen auftreten oder Produkte nachhaltig optimiert werden müssen, finden wir im Labor die Antwort. Kurz gesagt: Wir garantieren die Qualität, auf die sich Millionen von Menschen verlassen. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten/Position Als R&D Laborant Assay Development (w/m/d) bist Du maßgeblich an der Entwicklung und Sicherung der Produktqualität unserer vollautomatisierten In-vitro-Diagnostika beteiligt.
• Analytisches Detektivspiel: Du widmest Dich der tiefgreifenden Analyse von Qualitätsproblemen. Statt kurzfristiger Fehlerbehebung entwickelst Du fundierte, nachhaltige Lösungen und sicherst so die langfristige Produktstabilität sowie die kontinuierliche Optimierung unserer Diagnostik-Lösungen.
• Experimentelle Arbeit: Du planst und führst komplexe Messreihen, Analysen und Serienansätze eigenständig durch, um Fehlerursachen präzise zu identifizieren und Produkte gezielt zu verbessern.
• Entwickler-Mindset: Du arbeitest aktiv bei der strategischen Optimierung und Überarbeitung von In-vitro-Diagnostika für die Klinische Chemie mit.
• System-Adaption: Du passt Methoden fachgerecht an verschiedene Analysegeräte (z. B. cobas c Systeme) an und programmierst EDV-gesteuerte Versuchsabläufe.
• Datenauswertung: Du wertest experimentelle Daten aus, beurteilst diese mittels statistischer Methoden und bereitest die Ergebnisse grafisch sowie schriftlich auf.
• Labororganisation: Du verantwortest die Gerätewartung, die Herstellung von Lösungen nach stöchiometrischen Berechnungen sowie die strikte Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Umweltschutzvorschriften (S2-Material). Hinweis: Diese Tätigkeit erfordert die Bereitschaft zum Umgang mit Humanmaterial der Klasse S2. Wer bist Du Du bist eine technisch versierte Persönlichkeit mit dem Anspruch, bestehende Produkte bis ins Detail zu verstehen und bei komplexen Problemen nachhaltige Lösungen im Labor zu erarbeiten.
• Qualifikation: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene naturwissenschaftliche Ausbildung als Techniker:in (Chemie/Biologie) mit relevanter Berufserfahrung oder ein Bachelor-Studium im Bereich Chemieingenieurwesen, Biochemie oder Biotechnologie.
• Leidenschaft für das Labor: Du hast echte Freude an der praktischen Arbeit und der Steuerung komplexer Anlagen. Dein Ziel ist der Aufbau von tiefem Expertenwissen zu unseren Produkten.
• IT-, Daten- & KI-Affinität: Du bist sehr IT-affin und bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in der Datenanalyse mit. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an modernen Technologien und KI-basierten Lösungen zur Prozessoptimierung.
• Erfahrung: Idealerweise verfügst Du über Kenntnisse in der klinischen Chemie sowie der analytischen Chemie. Erfahrung mit cobas c Geräten, eLN und OASEpro ist ein deutliches Plus.
• Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst in dynamischen Phasen den Überblick und legst Wert auf eine lückenlose, präzise Dokumentation.
• Kommunikation: Du bist ein Teamplayer und

The Position El equipo de Supply Chain de la División Diagnóstica busca un Warehouse & Distribution Lead enfocado en asegurar que nuestra operación logística se ejecute bajo los más altos estándares globales y locales . En este rol, liderarás la coordinación con proveedores de la cadena de suministro para ofrecer un servicio excepcional a nuestros clientes . Te unirás a un entorno dinámico enfocado en la excelencia operativa y la optimización continua de la distribución . La Posición:

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Sobre Roche: Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche. Oportunidad: En Roche LATAM Training Center , buscamos un/a Becario/a de Entrenamiento altamente motivado/a para apoyar en la gestión operativa y digital de las iniciativas de capacitación para personal interno y clientes. Esta posición ofrece una oportunidad única para desarrollarte en un entorno regional, colaborando en proyectos estratégicos de formación, adopción digital y mejora continua de la experiencia de aprendizaje. Responsabilidades:
• Gestión y Soporte: Actuar como apoyo de contacto para la revisión de incidencias técnicas en el sistema de entrenamiento interno y asegurar el correcto uso de la plataforma estándar para clientes.
• Soporte a Usuarios: Brindar acompañamiento a usuarios internos (afiliadas de LATAM) en el uso de plataformas de entrenamiento como Cornerstone u otras.
• Comunicación: Apoyar en la difusión de comunicados, convocatorias, recordatorios y cápsulas informativas, utilizando herramientas digitales e IA en el día a día.
• Gestión de Agendas: Coordinar calendarios de entrenamientos, seguimiento de registros, confirmaciones, listas de espera y gestión de cancelaciones.
• Actualización de Contenidos: Mantener actualizada la información de cursos, materiales y sesiones dentro de las plataformas.
• Análisis: Generar reportes de uso de plataformas, métricas de participación, tasas de cancelación y análisis de feedback de los usuarios.
• Mejora Continua: Recopilar insights de usuarios para proponer mejoras en procesos, contenidos y experiencia de entrenamiento.
• Materiales y Cápsulas: Apoyar en la creación de cápsulas informativas, guías rápidas y materiales de apoyo para usuarios.
• Apoyo a Entrenamientos: Colaborar en la logística y ejecución de entrenamientos dirigidos a personal interno y clientes finales.
• Colaboración: Trabajar de manera cross-functional con equipos de Training, Digital, Comercial y Soporte. Quién eres:
• Formación: Estudiante activo/a de últimos semestres en Administración, Comunicación, Sistemas o afines. No buscamos un perfil egresado.
• Perfil: Interés en el sector salud, entrenamiento, adopción digital y experiencia de usuario.
• Habilidades: Capacidad analítica, organización, atención al detalle y manejo de Excel (intermedio) y PowerPoint.
• Idiomas: Inglés intermedio (deseable manejo de portugués).
• Competencias: Proactividad, enfoque en el usuario, comunicación efectiva, aprendizaje ágil y trabajo colaborativo. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Comunicación: Apoyar en la difusión de comunicados, convocatorias, recordatorios y cápsulas informativas, utilizando herramientas digitales e IA en el día a día.
• Gestión de Agendas: Coordinar calendarios de entrenamientos, seguimiento de registros, confirmaciones, listas de espera y gestión de cancelaciones.
• Actualización de Contenidos: Mantener actualizada la información de cursos, materiales y sesiones dentro de las plataformas.
• Análisis: Generar reportes de uso de plataformas, métricas de participación, tasas de cancelación y análisis de feedback de los usuarios.
• Mejora Continua: Recopilar insights de usuarios para proponer mejoras en procesos, contenidos y experiencia de entrenamiento.
• Materiales y Cápsulas: Apoyar en la creación de cápsulas informativas, guías rápidas y materiales de apoyo para usuarios.
• Apoyo a Entrenamientos: Colaborar en la logística y ejecución de entrenamientos dirigidos a personal interno y clientes finales.
• Colaboración: Trabajar de manera cross-functional con equipos de Training, Digital, Comercial y Soporte. Quién eres:
• Formación: Estudiante activo/a de últimos semestres en Administración, Comunicación, Sistemas o afines. No buscamos un perfil egresado.
• Perfil: Interés en el sector salud, entrenamiento, adopción digital y experiencia de usuario.
• Habilidades: Capacidad analítica, organización, atención al detalle y manejo de Excel (intermedio) y PowerPoint.
• Idiomas: Inglés intermedio (deseable manejo de portugués).
• Competencias: Proactividad, enfoque en el usuario, comunicación efectiva, aprendizaje ágil y trabajo colaborativo. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Who We Are At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Development Services & Integration (DSI) , we maximize value in product development by delivering efficient services and integrated solutions that enable standardization, increase efficiency, and ensure compliance. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalization and new technologies, we work in close alignment with business teams to provide timely support that meets our customers' real-world needs. We see ourselves and our partners as a team that can only reach its full potential together. Driven by this collaborative spirit, our expertise, and an enterprise mindset, we create an environment where ideas grow and new ways of doing things are realized—accelerating the DIA strategy and delivering competitive products to patients faster. The Opportunity We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented UX / Frontend Engineer to help build the next generation of our digital products in the life sciences sector. In this role, you will work closely with our Lead UX Designer / Frontend Engineer to implement complex user interfaces and dashboards that empower our Machine Learning and Data Science teams. You will focus on writing clean, scalable frontend code, translating complex bioinformatics workflows into intuitive web applications, and contributing to a seamless user experience. If you are passionate about Vue.js, clean UI design, and want to help visualize critical scientific data, this is the perfect opportunity to grow your skills in a highly specialized environment. Key Responsibilities:
• Develop, test, and maintain responsive, high-performance web applications using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS frameworks.
• Collaborate directly with senior designers and engineers to translate complex workflows and wireframes into highly functional, user-centric code.
• Develop and optimize interactive data visualizations using D3.js to represent large-scale datasets across complex dashboards.
• Contribute to our internal component design system, ensuring reusable, accessible, and visually consistent UI elements across our platforms.
• Integrate frontend applications seamlessly with backend services via RESTful and GraphQL APIs in a cloud environment.
• Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, working cross-functionally with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to deliver features iteratively. Who You Are You are a talented, detail-oriented frontend professional who is passionate about clean UI design, modern web technologies, and data visualization. You excel at bridging the gap between design concepts and technical execution, and you thrive in collaborative environments where your work makes critical scientific data accessible. Qualifications & Skills:
• 2–4 years of hands-on software development experience using modern JavaScript frameworks, with a strong, demonstrable focus on Vue.js.
• Solid proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, SASS, and modern utility-first styling frameworks like Tailwind CSS. The Nice-to-Haves:
• A background, previous experience, or strong interest in the life sciences domain (e.g., Sequencing, PCR, Bioinformatics, or digital healthcare).
• Experience using design hand-off tools (like Figma or Sketch) and contributing to component libraries or design systems.
• • Experience with or a strong interest in data visualization libr

You will join a collaborative and high-performing team environment where your ideas drive meaningful change. Key Responsibilities:
• Drive the full software development lifecycle from feasibility studies and design to testing, bug fixing, and continuous software maintenance.
• Design, implement, and test clean, high-quality code utilizing C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks.
• Formulate and implement comprehensive architectural visions, defining development standards, robust workflows, and coding methodologies for the engineering team.
• Translate complex functional and non-functional requirements into highly scalable, secure, and extensible system architectures.
• Provide continuous technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to developers, empowering team members to reach their full potential.
• Leverage cutting-edge AI-supporting tools throughout the development lifecycle to optimize efficiency and accelerate innovation.
• Collaborate proactively within self-organizing Agile teams (Scrum/Kanban) to estimate, plan, and deliver impact-driven software packages. Who You Are You are a proactive and collaborative technical leader who thrives when navigating ambiguity. You possess an analytical mindset, are passionate about mentoring others, and are eager to apply modern technology to solve complex healthcare challenges. Qualifications & Skills:
• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of designing and overseeing complex, scalable architectures.
• Strong proficiency in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0, alongside hands-on experience with SQL Server, database design, and ORMs like Entity Framework.
• Deep knowledge of modern development practices, including Agile methodologies, Git/GitHub version control, and establishing build environments.
• Natural capability to coach, mentor, and elevate the skills of fellow engineering team members.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and collaborate across cross-functional teams.
• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to exc

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione
• Stiamo cercando un Responsabile di Studio Clinico per condurre l'esecuzione operativa dei nostri dati secondari utilizzare le attività di Real World Evidence (RWE) e studi clinici internazionali. In questo ruolo, coordinare le operazioni di studio end-to-end su siti globali, assicurando che i nostri programmi clinici forniscono dati di alta qualità in modo sicuro, efficiente ed eticamente. Potrai lavorare all'interno di un ambiente di team altamente collaborativo e matrice dove la tua leadership ci aiuta direttamente a portare innovazioni mediche ai pazienti più velocemente. Le tue responsabilità - Lead Study Teams: Costruisci e guida team di studio interfunzionali e senza confini, stabilendo chiare responsabilità, consegnabili e un ambiente psicologicamente sicuro dove tutti possono prosperare. - Gestione delle operazioni di prova end-to-End: Mantenere piani di studio completi, strategie di mitigazione del rischio, procedure di selezione del sito e protocolli di supervisione del fornitore dall'attivazione fino alla chiusura clinica. - Oversee Financials & Accordi: Gestire budget di studio, metriche di traccia, rivedere gli ordini di lavoro e negoziare accordi di studio per garantire operazioni altamente convenienti con variazioni minime. - Compliance regolamentare globale Drive: Assicurare l'assoluta adesione alle linee guida di sperimentazione clinica internazionale (come Buone Pratiche di Farmacovigilanza e Buone Pratiche di Farmacoepidemiologia), regolamenti locali pertinenti e la disponibilità di ispezione. - Direct Vendor & Site Deliveryables: Mantenere la stretta supervisione di fornitori esterni, tracciare metriche di performance, risolvere problemi operativi sistematici e organizzare la formazione necessaria. - Sviluppare piani di reclutamento strategici: Analizzare i dati di fattibilità di prova in più paesi per fare raccomandazioni basate sui dati sulla distribuzione del sito, numeri dei pazienti e strategie di ritenzione. Chi sei Sei un leader operativo attivo e strategico con una passione per l'eccellenza clinica e la collaborazione interfunzionale. Porti una mentalità di crescita, eccelle nella risoluzione di problemi operativi complessi sotto scadenze strette, e possiedi competenze di ascolto e di empatia profonde che ispirano i tuoi team. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta: - Proven Clinical Leadership: esperienza dimostrata leader team di studio di successo attraverso tutte le fasi operative di studi clinici o progetti di utilizzo dei dati secondari. - Competenza normativa: una chiara comprensione e un'esperienza pratica che applicano requisiti di qualità clinica globale, regolamenti e standard di farmacovigilanza. - Strategic Planning & Risk Management: Forte consapevolezza organizzativa con una mentalità proattiva di pianificazione, compresa la capacità di incorporare contingenze operative. - Financial & Vendor Acumen: L'esperienza di gestire con successo i bilanci di prova, l'elaborazione degli accordi dei fornitori e la gestione delle integrazioni di sistema esterne. - Comunicazione eccezionale: competenze di comunicazione scritte e verbali ben sviluppate, con una comprovata capacità di presentare chiare direzioni, influenzare trasversalmente e risolvere i conflitti. Compensazioni e vantaggi Questa posizione offre anche un pacchetto di benefici interessanti. Scopri di più su come premiamo i nostri dipendenti a Roche. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a Clinical Study Manager to lead the operational execution of our secondary data use Real World Evidence (RWE) activities and international clinical studies. In this role, you will coordinate end-to-end study operations across global sites, ensuring that our clinical programs deliver high-quality data safely, efficiently, and ethically. You will work within a highly collaborative, matrixed team environment where your leadership directly helps us bring medical innovations to patients faster. Your Responsibilities
• Lead Study Teams: Build and guide cross-functional, borderless study teams, establishing clear accountabilities, deliverables, and a psychologically safe environment where everyone can thrive.
• Manage End-to-End Trial Operations: Maintain comprehensive study plans, risk mitigation strategies, site selection procedures, and vendor oversight protocols from activation through to clinical closure.
• Oversee Financials & Agreements: Manage study budgets, track metrics, review work orders, and negotiate study agreements to ensure highly cost-effective operations with minimal variances.
• Drive Global Regulatory Compliance: Ensure absolute adherence to international clinical trial guidelines (such as Good Pharmacovigilance Practices and Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices), relevant local regulations, and inspection readiness.
• Direct Vendor & Site Deliverables: Maintain strict oversight of external vendors, tracking performance metrics, resolving systematic operational issues, and organizing necessary training.
• Develop Strategic Recruitment Plans: Analyze trial feasibility data across multiple countries to make data-driven recommendations on site distribution, patient numbers, and retention strategies. Who You Are You are a proactive, strategic operational leader with a passion for clinical excellence and cross-functional collaboration. You bring a growth mindset, excel at solving complex operational problems under tight deadlines, and possess deep listening and empathy skills that inspire your teams. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• Proven Clinical Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading successful study teams through all operational stages of clinical studies or secondary data use projects.
• Regulatory Expertise: A clear understanding and practical experience applying global clinical quality requirements, regulations, and pharmacovigilance standards.
• Strategic Planning & Risk Management: Strong organizational awareness with a proactive planning mindset, including the ability to embed operational contingencies.
• Financial & Vendor Acumen: Experience successfully managing trial budgets, processing vendor agreements, and handling external system integrations.
• Exceptional Communication: Well-developed written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to present clear directions, influence cross-functionally, and resolve conflicts. Together, we’ll advance along the whole patient journey with the aspiration to prevent, stop and cure diseases. Join us in building a healthier future! Compensation & Benefits This position also offers an attractive benefits package . Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche. This job is posted in multiple locations. If you're applying for the role in an alternative location where pay transparency regulations apply, the Talent Acquisition Partner will share the local pay information with you ahead of any business interview. descriptionByLocale.de:
Descrizion Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wir suchen einen Clinical Study Manager, der die operative Durchführung unserer Aktivitäten zur Nutzung von Real World Evidence (RWE) und internationalen klinischen Studien leitet. In dieser Rolle koordinieren Sie den gesamten Studienbetrieb an globalen Standorten und stellen sicher, dass unsere klinischen Programme qualitativ hochwertige Daten sicher, effizient und ethisch liefern. Sie arbeiten in einer hochgradig kooperativen, matrixförmigen Teamumgebung, in der Ihre Führung uns direkt hilft, medizinische Innovationen schneller zu Patienten zu bringen.
• Ihre Aufgaben Leitende Studienteams: Aufbau und Führung funktionsübergreifender, grenzenloser Studienteams, Festlegung klarer Rechenschaftspflichten, Ergebnisse und einer psychologisch sicheren Umgebung, in der jeder gedeihen kann. - Manage End-to-End Trial Operations: Pflegen Sie umfassende Studienpläne, Risikominderungsstrategien, Standortauswahlverfahren und Vendor-Überwachungsprotokolle von der Aktivierung bis zum klinischen Abschluss. - Überwachen von Finanzen und Vereinbarungen: Verwalten Sie Studienbudgets, verfolgen Sie Metriken, überprüfen Sie Arbeitsaufträge und verhandeln Sie Studienvereinbarungen, um einen kostengünstigen Betrieb mit minimalen Abweichungen zu gewährleisten. Globale Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Vorschriften: Gewährleistung der absoluten Einhaltung internationaler Richtlinien für klinische Studien (wie Good Pharmacovigilance Practices und Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices), einschlägiger lokaler Vorschriften und Inspektionsbereitschaft. Direct Vendor & Site Deliverables: Behalten Sie eine strenge Aufsicht über externe Anbieter, verfolgen Sie Leistungskennzahlen, lösen Sie systematische Betriebsprobleme und organisieren Sie notwendige Schulungen. - Entwicklung strategischer Rekrutierungspläne: Analysieren Sie Machbarkeitsdaten für Studien in mehreren Ländern, um datenbasierte Empfehlungen für die Verteilung von Websites, Patientenzahlen und Aufbewahrungsstrategien abzugeben. Wer du bist Sie sind eine proaktive, strategische Führungskraft mit einer Leidenschaft für klinische Exzellenz und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit. Sie bringen eine wachstumsorientierte Denkweise mit, zeichnen sich durch die Lösung komplexer operativer Probleme unter engen Fristen aus und besitzen tiefe Zuhör- und Empathiefähigkeiten, die Ihre Teams inspirieren. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie: Nachgewiesene klinische Führung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung, die erfolgreiche Studienteams durch alle operativen Phasen klinischer Studien oder sekundärer Datennutzungsprojekte führt. Regulatory Expertise: Ein klares Verständnis und praktische Erfahrung mit der Anwendung globaler klinischer Qualitätsanforderungen, Vorschriften und Pharmakovigilanz-Standards. Strategisches Planungs- und Risikomanagement: Starkes Organisationsbewusstsein mit proaktiver Planungsmentalität, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, betriebliche Eventualitäten einzubetten. - Financial & Vendor Acumen: Erfahrung in der erfolgreichen Verwaltung von Testbudgets, der Verarbeitung von Lieferantenvereinbarungen und dem Umgang mit externen Systemintegrationen. Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation: Gut entwickelte schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, klare Richtungen zu präsentieren, funktionsübergreifend zu beeinflussen und Konflikte zu lösen. Entschädigung und Vorteile Diese Position bietet auch ein attraktives Leistungspaket. Erfahren Sie mehr darüber, wie wir unsere Mitarbeiter bei Roche belohnen. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous cherchons un gestionnaire d'études cliniques pour diriger l'exécution opérationnelle de nos données secondaires en utilisant les activités Real World Evidence (RWE) et les études cliniques internationales. Dans ce rôle, vous coordonnerez les activités d'étude de bout en bout dans tous les sites mondiaux, en veillant à ce que nos programmes cliniques fournissent des données de haute qualité de façon sûre, efficace et éthique. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement d'équipe fortement collaboratif et matricielle où votre leadership nous aide directement à apporter des innovations médicales aux patients plus rapidement.
• Vos responsabilités - Équipes d'étude principales : Construisez et guidez des équipes d'étude interfonctionnelles et sans frontières, établissant des responsabilités claires, des produits livrables et un environnement psychologiquement sûr où chacun peut prospérer. - Gérer les opérations d'essai de bout en bout : Maintenir des plans d'étude approfondis, des stratégies d'atténuation des risques, des procédures de sélection des sites et des protocoles de surveillance des fournisseurs, de l'activation jusqu'à la fermeture clinique. - Superviser les finances et les ententes : gérer les budgets d'étude, suivre les paramètres, examiner les ordres de travail et négocier des ententes d'étude pour assurer des opérations hautement rentables avec des écarts minimes. - Assurer la conformité à la réglementation mondiale : assurer le respect absolu des lignes directrices internationales sur les essais cliniques (comme les bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance et les bonnes pratiques de pharmacoépidémiologie), les règlements locaux pertinents et la préparation à l'inspection. - Produits livrables directs : maintenir une surveillance stricte des fournisseurs externes, suivre les mesures de rendement, résoudre les problèmes opérationnels systématiques et organiser la formation nécessaire. - Élaborer des plans stratégiques de recrutement : analyser les données sur la faisabilité des essais dans plusieurs pays afin de formuler des recommandations axées sur les données sur la distribution des sites, le nombre de patients et les stratégies de rétention. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader opérationnel proactif et stratégique avec une passion pour l'excellence clinique et la collaboration interfonctionnelle. Vous apportez un état d'esprit de croissance, excellez dans la résolution de problèmes opérationnels complexes dans des délais serrés, et possédez des compétences d'écoute et d'empathie profondes qui inspirent vos équipes. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez : - Leadership clinique prouvé : Expérience démontrée menant des équipes d'étude réussies à toutes les étapes opérationnelles des études cliniques ou des projets d'utilisation de données secondaires. - Expertise en matière de réglementation : Une compréhension claire et une expérience pratique en appliquant les exigences mondiales en matière de qualité clinique, les règlements et les normes de pharmacovigilance. - Planification stratégique et gestion des risques : Une forte sensibilisation organisationnelle avec un état d'esprit de planification proactif, y compris la capacité d'intégrer les imprévus opérationnels. - Accumen financier et fournisseur : Expérience de la gestion réussie des budgets d'essai, du traitement des accords avec les fournisseurs et du traitement des intégrations externes. - Communication exceptionnelle : Compétences bien développées en communication écrite et verbale, avec une capacité prouvée de présenter des orientations claires, d'influencer interfonctionnellement et de résoudre des conflits. Rémunération et avantages sociaux Cette position offre également un ensemble attrayant d'avantages. Découvrez comment nous récompensons nos employés à Roche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain.
