At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As Team Lead Engineering Commercial Pharma International Engagement Lead (CRM, Field, VOC, Events) (Senior Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible. Description of the area This role serves as the engagement lead for end-to-end customer engagement within the Pharma International region, encompassing the strategic oversight of CRM, Voice of Customer (VoC), and field integration. As a specialized ecosystem, the CRM space is designed to streamline relationships with healthcare professionals and patients while ensuring strict regulatory compliance across global markets. The system centralizes stakeholder data to enable personalized, omnichannel engagement across digital and in-person channels, supported by automated processes such as strategic account planning and sample management. By integrating VoC insights directly into these workflows, the platform ensures that field teams can refine their account strategies based on real-time customer feedback and preferences. Beyond execution, the CRM acts as a strategic hub for data-based insights, utilizing dashboards to monitor how effectively the organization is delivering on its customer-centricity goals while maintaining audit-ready documentation for legal requirements. Ultimately, this environment breaks down departmental silos to foster seamless collaboration between sales, marketing, and medical teams through a unified source of truth. Job responsibilities
• Team Member Capability and Career Development 
• Proactively identifies and develops future-focused engineering team capabilities, aligning with long-term strategic goals.
• Mentors team members on long-term career paths, creating new opportunities and roles within the organization to support their growth.
• Addresses and helps resolve complex, systemic roadblocks that impact multiple development teams, and coaches other managers on effective performance management.
• Oversees the technical and soft skill development, ensuring a balanced and high-performing talent portfolio. ​
• Team Health and Sustainability 
• Establishes and monitors metrics for team health and sustainability across several development teams, implementing strategies to ensure long-term balance.
• Designs and implements initiatives to improve collaboration and psychological safety across multiple related development teams or a whole product area.
• Proactively identifies and resolves systemic impediments that affect multiple development teams, improving the overall work environment.
• Manages the talent composition for own and related teams, planning for future needs and ensuring a healthy pipeline of skills. ​
• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️
• Responsible for co-creating the long-term technical vision and strategy for a product portfolio, partnering with Product Managers and Leaders who are overall responsible for the roadmaps.

Il sistema centralizza i dati degli partner per consentire un impegno personalizzato, omnicanale attraverso i canali digitali e in presenza, supportato da processi automaticizzati come la pianificazione strategica degli account e la gestione delle forniture di campioni. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next. The Procurement Manager - Clinical Laboratories role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers. The Opportunity:
• You will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying both general procurement and specialized knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.
• You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.
• You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.
• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Clinical Laboratories conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.
• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.
• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency. Who you are:
• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a scientific related discipline like Biological/Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry or related field.
• You have proven procurement experience in strategic sourcing, category strategy building and strategic project execution with general contracting understanding and proficiency or relevant related commodity experience, preferably in the Pharmaceutical industry.
• You have experience in procurement systems, processes and skills in project management.
• You possess knowledge and experience in the Clinical Laboratories commodity area (Genomics and Genetics, Bio

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This is a pivotal leadership role within our UK Pharma Commercial team. You join at a moment of radical healthcare transformation — where market access, government affairs, and health economics converge to determine whether life-changing therapies reach the patients who need them. You lead a multidisciplinary function that shapes the UK's position as a priority destination for global pharmaceutical investment. The Opportunity:
• Shape the future of UK pricing and reimbursement by leading the organisation's strategy across NICE, SMC, and AWMSG — ensuring our portfolio remains commercially viable and accessible to patients
• Lead high-stakes negotiations for Commercial Access Agreements that protect and grow a billion-pound revenue stream through sustainable, innovative funding models
• Influence government policy at the highest levels maintaining strategic relationships across the Department of Health and Social Care, HM Treasury, and the broader political landscape
• Build a world-class Access engine that serves as the gold standard for our global headquarters — proving that the UK is a priority launch market
• Drive health equity and system transformation by leading initiatives that improve patient outcomes, enhance population health, and reduce per-capita costs in partnership with the NHS
• Pioneer innovative access models including outcome-based agreements, value-based pricing, and real-world evidence frameworks that can be exported globally Who you are:
• You bring extensive senior leadership in market access, health economics, or government affairs within the pharmaceutical or life sciences sector
• You have deep expertise in UK HTA processes and the commercial mechanics of industry-government pricing frameworks
• You are a proven political advocate, comfortable engaging at ministerial and senior civil servant level to shape policy outcomes
• You are an enterprise thinker who balances access decisions against commercial, medical, and supply chain considerations across a complex portfolio
• You lead with purpose — translating strategic patience into tactical urgency to deliver patient access today while building frameworks for tomorrow Preferred:
• Experience navigating the post-Brexit regulatory and trade landscape as it impacts pharmaceutical operations
• Background in Real-World Evidence generation and its application to HTA submissions and lifecycle management
• International or global headquarters experience demonstrating cross-market strategic influence If you're ready to shape the future of patient access in the UK, we'd like to hear from you. Apply today. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer plus tôt, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA) stimule l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous voyons nous-mêmes et nos clients comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel ensemble. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins et en tirant parti de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous nous rapprochons de leurs besoins réels. Cet esprit de collaboration crée un environnement où les idées peuvent croître et de nouvelles façons de faire peuvent être essayées - ce qui donne lieu à des produits compétitifs qui parviennent plus rapidement aux patients. Notre travail couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la découverte à la post-lancement. En collaborant avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales cruciales, conçoit et exécute des études cliniques et offre un soutien sur le marché. En fin de compte, nous produisons des preuves cliniques exhaustives qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique des produits - facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits dans le monde entier afin que nous puissions sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous serez le moteur de la conception et de l'exécution de nos études cliniques mondiales. En tant que responsable d'une étude mondiale, vous veillez à ce que l'innovation scientifique atteigne les patients grâce à une génération de preuves cliniques méticuleusement planifiée et de haute qualité.

• Stratégie de mise en forme des données probantes : Collaborer avec des partenaires interfonctionnels pour élaborer des scénarios novateurs de production de données probantes, y compris des données factuelles et des stratégies cliniques mondiales.
• Conception de l'étude principale : Élaborer des protocoles d'étude de haute qualité, des plans de validation et des documents essentiels pour guider la réussite de la recherche clinique.
• Encourager la collaboration : établir et maintenir des relations solides avec des experts internes, des partenaires pharmaceutiques et des chercheurs internationaux pour apporter un savoir-faire externe dans notre processus d'innovation.
• Superviser l'excellence opérationnelle : assurer une supervision stratégique des activités externalisées, y compris la gestion des CRO et les relations avec les consultants, afin d'assurer une exécution transparente des études.
• S'assurer de l'état de préparation: Champion respect des normes mondiales (comme ICH-GCP) et assurer l'état de préparation à l'audit et à l'inspection à chaque étape du cycle de vie de l'étude. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur stratégique et un leader collaboratif qui prospère dans un environnement matriciel et rapide. Vous êtes passionné par la mise en avant des patients et vous êtes déterminé à maintenir les plus hautes normes d'intégrité dans la recherche clinique.
• Leader expérimenté : vous apportez une expérience reconnue en opérations cliniques ou en développement de produits au sein de l'industrie de la santé, avec une expérience éprouvée de projets complexes.
• Fondation académique: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en sciences de la vie ou d'un domaine connexe (un diplôme avancé est un plus).

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer plus tôt, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA) stimule l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous voyons nous-mêmes et nos clients comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel ensemble. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins et en tirant parti de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous nous rapprochons de leurs besoins réels. Cet esprit de collaboration crée un environnement où les idées peuvent croître et de nouvelles façons de faire peuvent être essayées - ce qui donne lieu à des produits concurrentiels qui s'adressent plus rapidement aux patients. Notre travail couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la découverte à la post-lancement. En collaborant avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales cruciales, conçoit et exécute des études cliniques et offre un soutien sur le marché. En fin de compte, nous produisons des données cliniques exhaustives qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique des produits - ce qui facilite l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits à l'échelle mondiale afin que nous puissions sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. L'opportunité
• Diriger les équipes d'études mondiales avec la pleine responsabilité pour les résultats d'essais cliniques de haute qualité, la gestion des délais, l'exécution des étapes et des budgets cliniques de plusieurs millions de dollars.
• Concevoir et exécuter des stratégies d'études opérationnelles globales innovantes en collaboration avec des équipes de développement clinique, de réglementation et de recherche et développement.
• Élaborer et valider la documentation fondamentale de l'étude, y compris les protocoles cliniques, les plans de validation de la conception et les modèles de chercheurs essentiels.
• Assurer une surveillance opérationnelle solide pour divers programmes cliniques, y compris les études entreprises par les chercheurs, les programmes d'adoption précoce et les collaborations de partenaires stratégiques.
• Gérer les portefeuilles de fournisseurs cliniques internationaux (CRO, consultants fonctionnels, conseillers médicaux), diriger les processus de sélection et conduire l'exécution de haute performance.
• Mettre en place des partenariats collaboratifs à fort impact avec des chercheurs médicaux internationaux, des leaders d'opinion et des partenaires de l'alliance mondiale afin d'intégrer une expertise médicale de pointe dans les conceptions opérationnelles. Qui vous êtes
• Vous apportez un minimum d'un baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, santé, ou un domaine étroitement lié, combiné avec une expérience établie dans les rôles opérationnels cliniques mondiaux.
• Vous possédez une expertise solide et pratique en gestion des phases de développement des études cliniques (de la planification initiale et du démarrage jusqu'à la clôture active des études).
• Vous faites preuve d'une connaissance approfondie des règlements et normes cliniques internationaux (tels que ICH-GPC, IVDD/IVDR, MDR, ou lignes directrices de la FDA) afin de maintenir l'état de préparation aux inspections.
• Vous êtes un communicateur agile et un chef de file collaboratif capable de résoudre des problèmes complexes, d'établir un consensus interfonctionnel et de guider les équipes de projet à travers des environnements matriciaux rapides.
• Vous êtes profondément passionné par la promotion d'un environnement d'appartenance, en travaillant de façon transparente dans diverses régions, cultures et fuseaux horaires pour mettre les besoins des patients en premier. Ensemble, nous progresserons tout au long du parcours patient avec l'aspiration à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Who We Are At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally. We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalization and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster. Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life. The Opportunity As a Global Study Lead, you are at the heart of our clinical research efforts. You will lead cross-functional global study teams with full accountability for delivering high-quality clinical studies that transform patient care.
• Lead with Impact: Take full ownership of study deliverables, ensuring quality, budget, and timelines are met while fostering a culture of excellence and collaboration.
• Shape the Strategy: Partner with Program Leadership to develop innovative evidence-generation scenarios, including real-world evidence and global clinical strategies.
• Design the Future: Create essential study documents, including protocols and reports, ensuring the highest standards of scientific rigor.
• Drive Collaboration: Oversee operational aspects of Investigator Initiated Studies, Research Collaborations, and companion diagnostics studies in partnership with Pharma leaders.
• Ensure Operational Excellence: Manage study-level budgets and provide strategic oversight to external partners and CROs to ensure seamless execution.
• Advocate for Compliance: Maintain audit and inspection readiness by adhering to global regulations and standard operating procedures. Who You Are You are a strategic thinker and a collaborative leader who thrives in a dynamic, international environment. You are passionate about clinical research and dedicated to bringing innovative solutions to patients.
• Experienced Leader: You bring a proven track record in global clinical study management, with the ability to lead diverse teams through all study phases from planning to close-out.
• Strategic Communicator: You excel at building and maintaining strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external experts to drive business goals.
• Detail-Oriented & Results-Driven: You have a sharp eye for quality and a commitment to delivering projects on time and within budget.
• Regulatory Savvy: You possess a deep understanding of global clinical trial regulations and guidelines (e.g., GCP).
• Educational Foundation: You hold a university degree in a scientific or healthcare-related field, or have equivalent professional experience in clinical operations. Ready to help us lead the way in healthcare? Together, we’ll advance along the whole patient journey w

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Dans notre équipe Développement de tests de R-D Qualité des produits dans le domaine de la chimie clinique, nous vous offrons la chance de maximiser votre impact sur la santé des patients dans le monde entier. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Customer Specialist Precision Diagnostics, based in Northern Italy (with availability to travel nationwide) and operating within the Solution Experience Department reporting directly to the Solution Experience Lead, you will play a strategic role in providing technical and application support for our Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) solutions. Your mission will be to promote our Precision Diagnostics portfolio, serving as the key interface between Roche and our customers. You will ensure the optimization of installed solutions and drive the adoption of innovative technologies in the market, balancing technical expertise with a strong commercial mindset. Key
• Responsibilities - Technical & Application Support: Provide detailed consultancy and training to customers on the implementation and use of NGS solutions, ensuring technologies operate according to the highest quality standards. - Commercial Synergy: Actively collaborate with the Sales team to promote Precision Diagnostics solutions to current and potential customers, identifying new business opportunities. - Relationship Management: Build strong, long-lasting relationships with laboratory and hospital staff, ensuring their technical and commercial needs are met. - Optimization & Troubleshooting: Manage the resolution of technical issues and support customers throughout the entire product lifecycle. - Training: Responsible for internal training and staying updated on the latest developments within the portfolio. Who You Are We are looking for a dynamic professional with strong interpersonal skills and a deep customer focus. The ideal candidate possesses: - Education: Master’s Degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biology, or equivalent. - Experience: At least 2 years of practical experience in the IVD (In Vitro Diagnostics) or medical device industry. - Technical Skills: Deep knowledge of NGS technologies and precision diagnostics. - Languages: Excellent proficiency in both Italian and English is required (written and spoken). - Soft Skills: Ability to work in a team, proactivity, and autonomy in achieving goals within set timelines. - Location & Mobility: Based in Northern Italy, with the availability to travel approximately 90% of the working time across the country. Why Join Roche At Roche, we work every day with the goal of "doing now what patients need next." You will join a stimulating environment where innovation and patient-centricity are at the heart of everything we do. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position As Finance Excellence Partner (FxP) you collaborate with Commercial Finance colleagues across Diagnostics and beyond geographical boundaries in a networked team, to streamline finance operations by simplifying, standardizing, automating, and utilising insights for enhanced decision making. You also collaborate closely with local Finance Enterprise Partners, finance colleagues across the global Roche finance network and local commercial business partners. You contribute to fostering a culture of innovation and experimentation as well as drive automation and digitalization across finance. Your key responsibilities Your main responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Being the liaison to various stakeholders across the global Roche finance network (e.g. local Finance Enterprise Partners, Roche Shared Service Center, Finance Excellence Partner chapter) on several major finance processes (Month End Closing, Budget, Forecasting, Performance Tracking).
• Leveraging technology and automation to drive digitalization as well as exploring and applying new technologies and tools in the fields of automation and Artificial Intelligence.
• Ownership of reporting solutions (sales, P&L, Headcount, Balance sheet) and providing key insights to local commercial affiliate on major KPIs.
• Identifying and implementing opportunities for efficiency gains, promoting continuous improvement through standardised processes and tools in order to be brilliant at the basics.
• Collaborating closely with Finance Enterprise Partners and internal commercial stakeholders to enable increased customer experience and business impact along the customer journey.
• Acting as an enabler for the adaption of the new ways of working by shifting from affiliate focused finance operations towards an above country-cluster level Your profile
• Ability to work and thrive in a networked environment, cross-departments, stakeholders, hierarchies and geographies in order to work successfully across affiliates, sub-regions and regions with an enterprise perspective combined with an agile mindset.
• Capability to constantly challenge the status quo and successfully influence stakeholders to implement key change initiatives.
• Profound understanding and experience of key financial processes (Month End Closing, Annual Closing, Budgeting, Forecasting and Actual Performance Monitoring) and financial accounting principles.
• Demonstrated problem-solving abilities, effective communication skills, and a growth mindset.
• Actively seeking input and building relationships with other stakeholders in the ecosystem.
• Robust analytical skills, including business process improvement expertise.
• A strong business understanding to drive innovation effectively.
• An inclusive and collaborative approach to how you work.
• Growth mindset and living the Roche Operating Principles.
• English and French - written and spoken. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As a Patient Safety Partner, you will be responsible for supporting the implementation, maintenance and oversight of the local PV system for the assigned affiliate(s)/country(ies), to ensure an efficient and effective PV system that complies with global Roche and local legal/regulatory authority PV requirements, safeguarding our License to Operate. You will also Support the execution of Affiliate’s Patient Safety (APS) strategies, ensuring high-quality implementation of global and local safety solutions, while demonstrating leadership in ownership, collaboration, and decision-making within assigned responsibilities. Your Responsibilities: PV System:
• Act as the Local QPPV Deputy in Saudi Arabia, and be responsible for the Execution of safety-related activities relevant to the PV (Pharmacovigilance) system through partnership with key stakeholders guaranteeing adherence to global Roche requirements and requirements mandated by the local Regulatory Authority. Key areas of activities include the following in line with Roche standard operating procedures (where applicable): Individual Case Safety Reports, Signal Detection & Signal Management for Local Products, Aggregate safety reports, Pharmacovigilance Agreements (PVA, SDEAs), Risk Management and Safety Communication (e.g., Direct Healthcare Professional Communication, Risk Minimization Measures, emerging safety issues), Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications, Safety Labeling and PV Commitments and (Local) Pharmacovigilance System Master File
• Contribute to shaping country PV regulations and the broader country pharmacovigilance ecosystem as applicable. Local Safety Risk Management:
• Collaborate and support in the implementation of safety solutions and launch readiness activities to ensure that patient safety risk management needs are addressed for Roche portfolio in the country.
• As applicable, support in Identifying and sharing safety insights by understanding disease areas and engaging with key stakeholders.
• Support risk management and safety communication: Support the country-level risk management strategy to optimize patient outcomes in collaboration within relevant networks and ensure compliant and transparent PV communications (e.g., DHPCs) to relevant external stakeholders. Who you are?
• Degree in healthcare-related discipline (e.g., PharmD, Pharmacy. etc.).
• Licensed pharmacist by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties.
• 1-3 years experience in pharmacovigilance, ideally in an affiliate setting.
• Understanding of decision-making in the local & global PV ecosystem.
• Advantage: Experience in other affiliate medical functions (e.g., Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, Medical Information) or global functions such as Clinical Safety.
• A Saudi national is preferred Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position As a Learning Intern , you will join our Global Learning Services (GLS) team within the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization in Roche. In this role, you will assist with executing routine administrative and system data maintenance activities in our Learning Management System ( Cornerstone ). You will gain hands-on learning experience in a shared service environment, supporting learning processes and ensuring high-quality, customer-focused support for our global learning community. Your Key Responsibilities
• System Administration : Execute routine data maintenance and system administrative tasks within Cornerstone and other relevant learning systems in a timely and accurate manner.
• Process Support : Assist with the administrative coordination of various training events, including new employee orientation, leadership training, professional training, and other training requests.
• Customer Support : Help provide customer service and troubleshooting support regarding training records, learning processes, and system inquiries to internal HR experts and business partners.
• Documentation : Assist in keeping team knowledge up to date by contributing to and updating Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Continuous Improvement : Actively participate in team meetings, workshops, and work-related events to help identify process improvements and support new ways of learning.
• Compliance & Integrity : Perform daily duties with high integrity, adhering to global and local guidelines, including strict data privacy rules and safety, security, and environmental (SHE) regulations. Who You Are We are looking for an analytical, proactive and collaborative university students who bring the following skills and competencies:
• Education : Currently enrolled in a university program with active/passive full-time student status in Hungary (studies in HR, Business, or Social Sciences are preferred).
• Able to work 25-30 hrs/week .
• Languages: Fluent English (C1) is required. German (B2-C1) also required.
• System & IT Skills : Experience with standard IT applications (Google Suite or Microsoft) and an eagerness to learn cloud-based learning management software (like Cornerstone).
• Growth Mindset : An agile learner who is open to seeking and giving feedback, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and capable of navigating complex data.
• Customer Centricity : Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on delivering reliable support and managing customer expectations.
• Collaboration : A supportive team player who enjoys working in a multicultural, cross-border matrix environment. What We Offer
• Hands-on experience operating Cornerstone and various other tools.
• Deep exposure to a global Shared Service Center environment.
• Competitive salary.
• A collaborative and supportive team environment that values your development and continuous learning.
• Flexible working hours according to your studies. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position The PSS Global Learning Services (GLS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated training solutions tailored to their needs. The PSS GLS teams deliver customer service and advisory support to Learning Experts and business partners on global learning / training systems and processes, ensuring end-to-end process completion and training compliance across Roche. The Opportunity You as a Global Learning Team Lead, are responsible for leading the respective Learning team and performing all people leadership related activities in line with Roche People Practices. Managing respective Learning business strategies processes and tools, ensuring KPIs are met on team and individual level, and regular operations reviews are held internally and externally with relevant stakeholders.
• Lead and manage a Learning - team by delivering best services and solutions towards the clients. Ensuring delivery of services in accordance with agreed performance levels (KPI) and in line with legal/regulations (compliance), continuously driving improvement activities/projects (simplification, standardization, automation) for service excellence and consistent customer experience.
• Work with GLS Customer Lead, as required, to develop future service portfolio in the area of Learning in line with overall People Support Solutions strategy, Area of Practice (AoP) and GLS goals, seeking better/creative solutions to support business needs, as well as leveraging advanced technology to continually drive team work efficiency and enhance customer experience.
• Apply data analytics & reporting based on received customer queries/questions, to provide Learning insights to business & Learning community for proactive policy/program design/review, end user behavior change and improved employee relationship management, etc.
• In line with Roche People Practices develop team member’s knowledge, skill, competency, etc. in order to retain and develop talented staff, drive overall team performance & quality levels, and build up the team talent pipeline.
• Sustain a win-win relationship with external vendors, as well as monitor the vendor performance through routine and /or project work.
• Initiate or participate in squad teams based on business needs to deliver required business outcomes.
• In line with GLS Area of Practice vision and goal, drive key initiatives, projects or workstreams and actively participate in the co-creation of the AoP strategy. Who you are In this role you will be working with stakeholders from various functions and across levels within the organization. Your team may not physically be in the same location as you, therefore your ability to work across borders and to lead virtually is important. Strong leadership competencies and demonstrated success in change management are also critical.

• Experience with Cornerstone or other cloud-based learning management solutions preferred
• Proven experience in Instructional Design , with a solid understanding of adult learning theories and digital learning content development.
• Strong service management skills and experience in streamlining processes and eliminating waste; Work hard but smart
• Analytical thinking and pragmatic approach to deal with requests and experienced and efficient handling of standard IT-applications, pre

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Technical Job Responsibilities
• Oversee all required quality activities during the lifecycle of a GxP supplier (Source & Select, Implement, Manage and Decommission), including but not limited to: process or method validations, Roche audits, Health Authority inspections, complex investigations, product complaints, and regulatory submissions, as assigned.
• Develop, negotiate and maintain Quality Agreements and Product Specific Requirements (as appropriate) with GxP suppliers, as well as with Partners, Collaborators and External Sponsors as applicable, and ensure compliance with agreements.
• Collaborate with GxP suppliers to address any gaps in audit responsiveness, CAPA implementation, deviation reporting and management, complaint management, investigation closure, and change implementation with regards to quality and timeliness with the supplier; and escalate as appropriate.
• As applicable, manage all required quality activities to support Make Assess Release (MAR) of Roche products including approval of master process documentation, batch documentation review, resolution of investigations, assessment of changes, and monitor and report GxP Supplier quality performance.
• As applicable, release, reject or quarantine Roche products (drug substance or API, bulk drug product, and semi-finished and finished products) and medical devices produced within the area of responsibility per applicable Roche requirements, cGMP and the schedule. Support RP and QP Declaration and Certification requirements as applicable.
• As applicable, collaborate with GxP suppliers to maintain the manufacturing processes and the Specifications and Analytical Methods (SAM) in a validated state and compliant with the regulatory dossier, including stability testing programs. Also includes quality oversight for direct material changes, certifications, supplier specifications and internal release specifications, and other documentation.
• As applicable, develop and maintain quality risk management plans; utilize risk management tools to identify and mitigate supplier quality and compliance risks, ensuring suppliers are in a state of compliance.
• As applicable, manage or lead quality deliverables supporting technical transfers for manufacturing, testing, packaging and product launches at external sites
• As applicable, engage in supplier improvement initiatives to solve complex manufacturing or quality problems. Functional Job Responsibilities
• Collaborate and manage relationships across internal and external partners to ensure quality expectations are aligned with Roche objectives.
• Notify Senior Management of potential quality or regulatory issues that may impact product quality or regulatory compliance.
• Troubleshoot and drive the resolution of quality issues, fostering effective interdepartmental and cross-functional partnerships.
• Approve documents as authorized and described by Roche policies, procedures and job descriptions.
• Be accountable for behaviors described in Roche Code of Conduct.
• Deliver business outcomes in support of departmental objectives.
• Maintain and communicate work priorities to meet goals and timelines.
• Ensure timely completion of all job-related training requirements prior to performing GMP-job functions and strive to continuously improve on knowledge and skills in quality, compliance and technology.
• Communicate new and updated regulatory requirements and applicable Roche expectations to GxP suppliers as applicable and evaluate systems

You are strongly collaborating with Hiring Managers and senior management in the full lifecycle recruitment of talent - individually managing a portfolio of requisitions and focusing on meeting and exceeding hiring manager's expectations and ensuring a positive candidate experience.
• Manage the end-to-end recruitment and selection process , including sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessing, and processing offers in Workday
• Execute strategic sourcing and pipelining to engage passive talent for current and future complex role demands
• Identify, manage, and coordinate with appropriate recruitment vendors and partner agencies

• Deliver exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience by acting as the primary point of contact and resolving issues proactively
• Coordinate and mentor Talent Acquisition Interns to support the department's hiring capacity and needs

• University or College Degree in Human Resources (or equivalent work experience) with 3+ years of Talent Acquisition experience, preferably with agency background
• Demonstrated expertise managing entire recruitment cycles and recruitment projects from concept to completion
• Strong customer centricity with end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, and a growth/agile mindset for ambiguous situations
• Multi-cultural awareness and adaptability to thrive in fast-paced, changing matrix environments
• Excellent communication, influencing, and networking skills with strong stakeholder management capabilities to influence and manage expectations

• Proficiency in English (and other languages as applicable) In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Developing enzymes for Roche internally as well as externally means for us the development of tailor-made biocatalysts and biological targets for creating the best-in-class molecules for Roche and our clients. Combining several biotechnological methods such as expression profiling, cell cultivation, enzyme purification portfolio, enzyme engineering and biochemical investigations, we always try to improve, to maintain or to design new enzymes. Mandatory, the complete value chain as a platform thought of Roche is given. We are working cross-functional for both the diagnostic and pharma division of Roche worldwide. Being an R&D function we always try to keep close contacts with our clients as with our production for ensuring a fast, but qualitatively high development which should result in functional Roche products finally. As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. Become part of an innovative research team that consolidates a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab to develop customized enzymes for our diagnostics. We offer you a unique opportunity to translate your scientific ideas into practice and thus contribute to the improvement of patient health. The opportunity
• You ensure the development of new enzymes using a combination of biotechnological and bioinformatic methods
• You are responsible for the independent production of tailored proteins/enzymes using molecular biological methods or the establishment of new production and screening methods for protein variants
• You support the consolidation of a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab, suitable for the protein engineering of novel enzymes
• You implement new biochemical and biophysical readouts suitable for the screening and development of tailored enzymes
• You pursue scientific and technical education by continuously following and reading the relevant scientific literature Who you are
• You possess a university degree (Dr. / Ph.D.) in a relevant field
• You have specialized knowledge in the areas of protein engineering, bioinformatics, and molecular biology
• Experience in microbiology, downstream and upstream processing, as well as chemistry, is an advantage
• You demonstrate knowledge and expertise in recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and the development of protein analytical methods for protein characterization
• You are willing to provide consultation and troubleshooting regarding enzyme challenges in Research & Development and Production This position is limited to 2 years. Application documents To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only a motivation letter and your updated CV . References and certificates are not required at this stage. We look forward to receiving your application! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Are you interested in developing novel reagents and workflows for next generation sequencing? We are looking for a highly talented and motivated postdoctoral fellow (m/f/d) to join our team on this mission. The Chemistry Technologies department provides the full spectrum of chemical diagnostic reagents, ranging from small molecules to biooligomers and polymers. Leveraging modern synthetic and analytical methods we design and develop tailor-made molecules to find the right solutions for diagnostic questions and beyond. We work as a team, are driven by passion for science and commitment to continuous learning to stay at the forefront of research. Our culture is defined by trust, transparency, and a strong collaborative spirit. We are looking for a proactive colleague who balances independent critical thinking with team spirit and the flexibility to collaborate across diverse departments and interdisciplinary teams. Your tasks
• Design and synthesize complex oligonucleotide-conjugates by contemporary bioconjugation techniques and small molecular entities by chemical synthesis
• Establish DNA templated proximity reactions for initial testing of your new reagent classes
• Collaborate proactively with project partners from biology, analytics and the sequencing test development teams to gain a deep insight into the relationship of structural design and assay performance
• Independently plan, execute and analyze experiments to effectively advance the projects
• Present scientific progress through internal meetings and visit scientific conferences to ensure the state-of-the-art knowledge in the field of bioorganic synthesis, chemical biology and surface chemistry
• Be part of a highly motivated and cross-functional team Your profile
• You hold a PhD in the field of (bio)organic chemistry, chemical biology or life science.
• You possess profound knowledge in the synthesis of oligonucleotide-conjugates, preferably in context of biomolecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids)
• You are well experienced in organic synthesis
• Hands-on experience in the field of DNA-templated reactions, proximity reactions and nucleic acid detection completes your profile.
• Your qualification should be clearly demonstrated by at least one first author paper published or accepted in a high impact journal.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are your strength. You are sensitive to intercultural and interdisciplinary matters - working in a team comes natural to you.
• You are a proactive individual with passion and commitment to innovate healthcare through our Roche Diagnostics Postdoc Program.
• Excellent English skills are required, German is not mandatory. When does it start? This position will be filled with effect Septmber 2026 and is limited to 2 years. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. This is your chance to shape the future of healthcare by leading the development and execution of our evolving Safety sourcing and outsourcing strategy. In this pivotal global role, you will manage external business partner alliances and vendors supporting Pharma Development Safety (PDS) globally, ensuring high-quality oversight of existing services while expanding into automated and augmented delivery through cutting-edge technologies. In the Alliance Management Principal position, you will be the vital link between internal teams and external partners, providing subject matter expertise and fit-for-purpose governance to ensure optimal delivery in accordance with robust Service Level Agreements. By collaborating across a matrix organisation and partnering with key stakeholders in Procurement, Finance, and Digital Technology, you will drive continuous improvement, manage budgets, and foster a culture of innovation to navigate an shifting safety systems landscape. The Opportunity:
• Lead the development and implementation of holistic global safety sourcing and outsourcing strategies that maximise value, increase productivity, and reduce operational complexities.
• Define, implement, and maintain robust vendor governance and performance management frameworks across a diverse human resource and technology vendor landscape.
• Partner with vendors and internal teams to design, manage, and adopt automated or augmented solutions, leveraging artificial intelligence and new technologies within an innovation framework.
• Oversee service provider budgets, spend analytics, and forecasting solutions to proactively manage resource and budget demand in partnership with Procurement and Finance.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The mission of the Global Clinical Supply Chain Organisation (PTDS) is to ensure that no patient is left without treatment and no clinical trial is delayed. Our vision is to provide innovative and sustainable clinical supply solutions to anyone, anywhere, at any time. By joining our team, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s diverse and robust biopharmaceuticals pipeline, encompassing over 100 molecules in approximately 500 clinical trials across seven disease areas in more than 80 countries. The Opportunity As our Global Clinical Master Data Specialist, you will serve as the backbone of our clinical supply chain, ensuring that global production and distribution systems run seamlessly by managing the critical data that fuels our operations. In this role, your impact and responsibilities will include:
• End-to-End Data Stewardship: Manage GMP/Quality-relevant master data lifecycle processes, creating and updating Material Masters, Classifications, and business partner/vendor data.
• Production Data Management: Oversee production-related data architectures, including the precise maintenance of Master Recipes, Bills of Materials (BOM), and Production Versions.
• System Integration & Synchronization: Ensure flawless data alignment across SAP R3P Clinical, S/4HANA, APO, and OMP landscapes to fully support global distribution and production planning.
• Lifecycle Governance & Change Management: Lead Engineering Change Management (ECM) workflows and coordinate Engineering Change Requests (ECR) alongside MDGM workflows with global requestors.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Production, Supply Chain, Quality, and Pharma Affiliates to successfully translate operational needs into accurate system configurations.
• Technical & Operational Administration: Act as the single point of contact for master data troubleshooting, while managing system user accounts and roles via the Corporate Identity Management (CIDM) platform.
• Compliance & Continuous Improvement: Oversee Quality Records within VEEVA (Deviations, CAPAs), update SOPs/SPTs, and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to lead process optimization initiatives. Who you are You are a detail-oriented professional with a passion for data integrity within the life sciences, looking to make a meaningful impact on global clinical trials. To be successful in this role, you bring the following qualifications and skills:
• Educational Background: You possess a University degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
• Industry Expertise: You have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Master Data Management, with a strong preference for background knowledge in Clinical Supply within the pharmaceutical industry.
• Regulatory Knowledge: You demonstrate a deep, foundational understanding of GMP and GCP guidelines, ensuring all data meets rigorous corporate and industry quality standards.
• Advanced Technical Proficiency: You are highly skilled in navigating and maintaining complex enterprise systems, specifically expert-level knowledge of SAP R3P Clinical, S/4HANA, MDGM, APO, and OMP.
• Quality Systems Management: You are proficient with VEEVA pla

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche Diagnostics, ridefiniamo il percorso globale del cliente attraverso la supply chain end-to-end integrata e l'eccellenza operativa. Il nostro team si concentra sulla guida della consulenza di eccellenza attraverso le nostre affiliate commerciali e regioni, stabilendo best practice globali, e migliorando la visibilità e le prestazioni in tutta la rete di affiliazione. Utilizzando dati, approfondimenti di processo e sistemi IT, collaboriamo all'interno del Comitato O2C Customer Journey / Value Stream per supportare la priorità del portafoglio, la definizione della roadmap e il processo decisionale strategico che offre risultati reali e misurabili in tutta la nostra divisione. Stiamo cercando un Lead Customer Success Manager Order-to-Cash per entrare in un ruolo cruciale, ad alto impatto. In questa posizione, si agirà come consulente strategico di fiducia e partner sparring per la nostra leadership executive senior e rappresentanti O2C Value Stream. Condurrai impegni di consulenza ad alto impatto, identificherai le efficienze strategiche e guiderai l'implementazione sostenibile delle best practice globali, trasformando direttamente il modo in cui Roche gestisce le operazioni Order-to-Cash a livello globale. • Lead Strategic Consulting Engagements: Guidare gli impegni di consulenza O2C ad alto impatto su affiliati e regioni commerciali per ottimizzare i processi, valutare le prestazioni attuali e tradurre intuizioni su roadmap eseguibili e orientate alle prestazioni.
• Servire come consulente fiducioso: agire come consulente primario e partner di sparring per regioni, affiliati e stakeholder senior; i titolari di iniziative di consulenza mentor per garantire un impegno ottimale, aspettative allineate e la consegna di priorità aziendali di successo.
• Champion Continuous Improvement: Guidare l'innovazione coinvolgendo attivamente gli affiliati per migliorare tutti gli abilitatori, tra cui Process Design, People & Organization, Policy & Guidelines, Measurement & Motivation (ad esempio, Process Insights), Business Data e IT Systems & Technology.
• Rappresentare il viaggio clienti di O2C: Servire come volto del flusso di valore verso regioni e affiliati, facilitare l'accesso agli abilitatori, fornire una guida esperta sulle migliori pratiche, e riportare le esigenze di affiliazione alla più ampia rete globale di O2C.
• Sviluppare Quadri Scalabili: fornire consulenza di eccellenza sviluppando pacchetti di consulenza O2C orientati al mercato, casi aziendali e roadmap di implementazione che guidano miglioramenti misurabili delle prestazioni attraverso processi, persone, dati, sistemi e governance.
• Monitorare le Performance & Solve Sfide: Leverage Customer & Process Insights per monitorare proattivamente le prestazioni, consigliare miglioramenti e collegare gli affiliati con le reti interne giuste per risolvere complesse operazioni aziendali e sfide funzionali.
• Drive Governance & Capability Building: Contribuisci attivamente al Comitato O2C Value Stream per sostenere la priorità del portafoglio e il processo decisionale strategico, servendo al tempo stesso come punto di riferimento primario per la formazione O2C, il contenuto di creazione di capacità e l'escalation di esperti. • Professionista istruito ed esperto: Si possiede un Master in Business Administration, Information Technology, o un campo correlato, con 10+ anni di consulenza e di esperienza sanitaria (idealmente nel settore Diagnostica), tra cui un minimo di 5 anni in operazioni commerciali, Supply Chain, o Business Process Management.
• O2C e Supply Chain Expert: Possiedi una comprensione approfondita delle operazioni di business O2C, dei framework di customer experience e delle operazioni della supply chain di Diagnostics end-to-end, inclusi

Unser Team konzentriert sich auf die treibende Beratung Exzellenz in unseren kommerziellen Affiliate und Regionen, die Schaffung globaler Best Practices und die Verbesserung der Sichtbarkeit und Leistung im gesamten Affiliate-Netzwerk. Durch die Nutzung von Daten, Prozess-Einsichten und IT-Systemen arbeiten wir im O2C Customer Journey / Value Stream Committee zusammen, um Portfoliopriorisierung, Roadmap-Definition und strategische Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen, die reale Auswirkungen und messbare Ergebnisse in unserer Division liefert. Wir suchen einen Lead Customer Success Manager Order-to-Cash, um in eine zentrale, leistungsstarke Rolle zu treten. In dieser Position werden Sie als vertrauenswürdiger strategischer Berater und Sparring-Partner unserer leitenden Führungskräfte und O2C Value Stream-Vertreter fungieren. Sie werden wirkungsstarke Beratungsengagements durchführen, strategische Effizienzen identifizieren und die nachhaltige Umsetzung globaler Best Practices vorantreiben, indem Sie direkt transformieren, wie Roche Order-to-Cash-Operationen global verwaltet. Die Chance
• Lead Strategic Consulting Engagements: Fahren Sie hocheffiziente O2C-Beratungsengagements über kommerzielle Affiliate und Regionen hinweg, um Prozesse zu optimieren, aktuelle Leistung zu bewerten und Einblicke in ausführbare, leistungsfähige Roadmaps zu übersetzen.
• Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater fungieren: Gesetz als primärer Berater und Sparring-Partner für Regionen, Affiliate und Senior Stakeholder; Mentor-Consulting-Initiative-Besitzer, um ein optimales Engagement, ausgerichtete Erwartungen und erfolgreiche Lieferung von Geschäftsprioritäten sicherzustellen.
• Champion Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Antriebsinnovation durch aktiv engagierte Partner, um alle Enabler zu verbessern, einschließlich Process Design, People & Organization, Politik & Guidelines, Measurement & Motivation (z.B. Process Insights), Business Data und IT Systems & Technology.
• Repräsentieren Sie die O2C Customer Journey : Servieren Sie als Gesicht des Value Streams in Richtung Regionen und Affiliate, erleichtern Sie den Zugang zu den Enablern, bieten kompetente Beratung über bewährte Praktiken, und bringen Affiliate braucht zurück zum breiteren globalen O2C-Netzwerk.
• Entwicklung skalierbarer Rahmen: Beratung durch die Entwicklung marktorientierter O2C-Beratungspakete, Geschäftsfälle und Implementierungs-Roadmaps, die messbare Leistungsverbesserungen über Prozess, Menschen, Daten, Systeme und Governance hinweg antreiben.
• Überwachen Sie Performance & Solve Challenges: Verlassen Sie Kunden- & Prozess-Insights, um die Leistung proaktiv zu überwachen, Verbesserungen zu empfehlen und Verbindungen mit den richtigen internen Netzwerken zu verbinden, um komplexe Geschäftsvorgänge und funktionelle Herausforderungen zu lösen.
• Drive Governance & Capability Building : Mit dem O2C Value Stream-Komitee aktiv zur Unterstützung von Portfoliopriorisierung und strategischer Entscheidungsfindung bei gleichzeitigem Einsatz als primärer Bezugspunkt für O2C-Ausbildung, fähigkeitsaufbauende Inhalte und Experteneskalation. Wer bist du?
• Educated and Experienced Professional: Sie halten einen Master-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Informationstechnologie oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit 10+ Jahren Beratungs- und Gesundheitserfahrung (ideal im Diagnostics-Geschäft), einschließlich mindestens 5 Jahre in kommerziellen Betrieben, Lieferkette oder Business Process Management.
• O2C und Supply Chain Expert: Sie verfügen über ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis von O2C-Geschäften, Kundenerfahrungs-Frameworks und end-to-end Diagnostics Supply Chain Operationen – inklud
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche Diagnostics, nous redéfinissons le parcours client mondial à travers une chaîne d'approvisionnement intégrée de bout en bout et l'excellence opérationnelle. Notre équipe met l'accent sur l'excellence en matière de consultation dans nos filiales commerciales et nos régions, l'établissement de pratiques exemplaires à l'échelle mondiale et l'amélioration de la visibilité et des performances dans l'ensemble du réseau des filiales. En utilisant les données, les connaissances sur les processus et les systèmes de TI, nous collaborons au sein du Comité du cheminement client/flux de valeur de l'O2C pour appuyer l'établissement des priorités du portefeuille, la définition de la feuille de route et la prise de décisions stratégiques qui produisent un impact réel et des résultats mesurables dans notre division. Nous recherchons un chef de file en matière de réussite client, Order-to-Cash, pour entrer dans un rôle central à fort impact. Dans ce poste, vous agirez à titre de conseiller stratégique et de partenaire de confiance auprès de nos cadres supérieurs et représentants de O2C Value Stream. Vous effectuerez des missions de consultation à fort impact, identifierez les gains d'efficacité stratégiques et dirigerez la mise en œuvre durable des meilleures pratiques mondiales, transformant directement la façon dont Roche gère les opérations de l'ordre à la caisse à l'échelle mondiale. L'opportunité
• Lead Strategic Consulting Engagements : Diriger les engagements de consultation O2C à haut impact dans les filiales commerciales et les régions pour optimiser les processus, évaluer les performances actuelles et traduire les idées en feuilles de route exécutables et axées sur les performances.
• Servir de conseiller fiable : agir en tant que conseiller principal et partenaire principal pour les régions, les filiales et les parties prenantes de haut niveau; conseiller les responsables d'initiatives pour assurer un engagement optimal, harmoniser les attentes et assurer la bonne exécution des priorités opérationnelles.
• L'amélioration continue du champion : stimuler l'innovation en engageant activement les affiliés à améliorer tous les facilitateurs, y compris la conception des processus, les personnes et l'organisation, les politiques et les lignes directrices, la mesure et la motivation (p. ex., les données sur les processus), les données d'affaires et les systèmes et technologies informatiques.
• Représenter le parcours client de l'O2C : servir de visage au Stream de valeur pour les régions et les filiales, faciliter l'accès aux facilitateurs, fournir des conseils d'experts sur les meilleures pratiques et ramener les besoins des filiales au réseau mondial plus large d'O2C.
• Élaborer des cadres évolutifs : Offrir l'excellence en matière de consultation en élaborant des trousses de consultation axées sur le marché, des analyses de rentabilisation et des feuilles de route de mise en oeuvre qui permettent d'améliorer les performances de façon mesurable dans les processus, les personnes, les données, les systèmes et la gouvernance.
• Surveiller les performances & Résoudre les défis : Tirer parti de Customer & Process Insights pour surveiller les performances de façon proactive, recommander des améliorations et connecter les affiliés aux bons réseaux internes pour résoudre les opérations complexes et les défis fonctionnels.
• Favoriser la gouvernance et le renforcement des capacités : contribuer activement au comité de suivi de la valeur de l'OC2C pour appuyer la hiérarchisation des portefeuilles et la prise de décisions stratégiques, tout en servant de point de référence principal pour la formation de l'OC2, le contenu du renforcement des capacités et l'escalade des experts. Qui vous êtes
• Professionnel formé et expérimenté: Vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise en administration des affaires, technologie de l'information, ou un domaine connexe, avec 10+ ans d'expérience en conseil et en soins de santé (idéalement dans le domaine du diagnostic), y compris un minimum de 5 ans en opérations commerciales, chaîne d'approvisionnement, ou gestion de processus d'affaires.
• O2C et Supply Chain Expert : Vous possédez une compréhension approfondie des opérations commerciales d'O2C, des cadres d'expérience client et des opérations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de bout en bout Diagnostics – inclus

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 主要职责 市场研究与分析
• 协助进行HCC治疗市场调研，收集和整理竞争对手信息
• 支持市场数据分析，制作市场现状报告
• 跟踪行业动态和医疗政策变化 医学沟通支持
• 协助整理医学信息和产品数据
• 参与学术会议的准备和后期总结工作
• 支持医学沟通材料（幻灯片、单页等）的制作 项目支持
• 协助组织产品培训、医学讲座等市场活动
• 整理和管理项目文档、数据和资料库
• 协助追踪市场活动的执行进展
• 协助医生咨询和信息反馈的汇总分析
• 参与市场活动现场的支持工作 其他协助性工作
• 完成主管交派的其他临时性工作任务
• 参与部门会议和项目讨论 任职资格 必须具备：
• 本科及以上学历（应届毕业生或在校学生均可）
• 医学、药学、生物学、市场营销或相关专业背景优先
• 良好的中文书面和口头沟通能力
• 熟练使用Microsoft Office（Word、Excel、PowerPoint）
• 学习能力强，工作主动认真，有团队合作精神 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future drives us to innovate, continuously advance science, and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. We want to build a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As the Analytics & Insights Manager (AIM) you will be focused on delivering advanced market and customer analytics, expert insights and recommendations to internal partners on a range of business issues. These include: health care system dynamics and challenges, customer and patient journeys, market and customer segmentation, engagement and channel content and strategies, key assumptions for sales forecasting efforts, and overall business performance via KPI measurement at the product, franchise and patient impact level. The AIM is responsible for primary (Qualitative & Quantitative) & secondary market research, specifically, managing the end-to-end process from business issue/problem identification, vendor selection, design, execution, analysis, reporting to delivery of strategic recommendations based on research insights. The AIM will act as a strategic business partner to integrated disease area teams and functional teams by providing key insights gathered via research, analytics and competitive intelligence. The AIM will act as the steward of insights for strategy teams, integrating data from all relevant sources to support the development and measurement of business and customer strategies, tactics and outcomes. The Opportunity
• A subject matter expert in research methodologies and data sources relating to the health care system, pharmaceutical marketplace and stakeholders within these environments.
• Lead the process for integrating data from multiple sources to provide deep business insights, proactively identify and communicate trends (issues and opportunities) through analytics, keeping them aligned with current company assets, needs, goals and strategies.
• Perform complex analyses, translating the results in a way that can be intuitively understood and leveraged in business discussions and decision-making, while maximizing the value of data assets and providing insights into the impact of commercial strategies and activities.
• Designs primary market research studies (i.e. establishes actionable objectives, selects vendor, approves methodology and survey instrument, etc); manages vendors in implementation of said studies to yield relevant market and/or customer insights and recommendations; and, manages market research budgets.
• Identify and integrate relevant secondary research resources with primary research (including competitive intelligence) to generate insights and recommendations that support decision making.
• Effectively landscapes health system, market, customer and competitor environments and delivers insights to inform customer engagement strategies and measures effectiveness of the activities and tactics employed
• Actively contribute/participate in business planning and implementation to develop/revise customer segmentation, commercial effectiveness in delivering a unified Roche customer experience and providing/communicating information, insights and recommendations to drive effective, efficient and data-informed decision-making Who you are
• You hold a minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in life sciences or biotechnology and +5 years experience in analytics and/or Market Research in the pharmaceutical industry or health care sector
• You take pride in

• Installation/relocation/de-installation of analytical laboratory instruments of Roche Diagnostics.
• Technical release of analytical systems for laboratory use.
• Focus on preparations of the customer sites that require additional attention based on the continuous increase of customer demands and specifications of the instruments that we deliver.
• Independently analyze and resolve most questions and problems and refer only the most complex issues to higher levels.
