• Timely performance of tasks, maintaining order in the workplace as well as the most effective use of working time.
• Continuous improvement of professional qualifications and participation in company meetings and trainings as well as all forms of vocational education organized by the Employer. Actively gathering information in preparation for meetings, delivering an active part in these meetings and give feedback of outcome of these meetings to others
• Develop and monitor local reports and documents to ensure the efficient and productive delivery of services.
• Actively monitor costs for own Service activities
• Awareness of new service bulletins, Global Customer Support (GCS) hot news and other forums Who You Are You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sostenibilità in Roche significa operare con una mentalità a lungo termine, garantendo che sempre più persone possano beneficiare della nostra scienza e innovazione oggi senza compromettere il mondo in cui vivranno domani. Lo facciamo espandendo la portata dei nostri farmaci e della nostra diagnostica, riducendo al contempo il nostro impatto ambientale e costruendo un’organizzazione inclusiva e resiliente per sostenere il progresso per le generazioni a venire. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare qui: https://www.roche.com/about/sustainability In qualità di Junior Corporate Sustainability Manager, riferirai al Chief Sustainability Officer e svolgerai un ruolo nello sviluppo, nell'implementazione e nel supporto dell'implementazione di iniziative e progetti strategici che contribuiscono ai nostri obiettivi aziendali e di sostenibilità. Farai parte di un team ad alte prestazioni, composto dal Chief Sustainability Officer, dai responsabili della strategia di sostenibilità aziendale e dai responsabili della sostenibilità. Il mandato del team è quello di sviluppare la strategia di sostenibilità per il Gruppo Roche e supervisionarne l’attuazione. Lavorerai in rete con i team di sostenibilità di diverse funzioni e unità di Roche per garantire priorità allineate, una roadmap strategica integrata e un'implementazione coerente delle stesse. Questa posizione richiede un individuo dinamico con esperienza nella gestione di progetti, esperienza in materia di sostenibilità aziendale e una passione per guidare un cambiamento positivo in un'organizzazione globale. L'opportunità: Coordinare ed eseguire lo sviluppo di presentazioni esecutive sulla sostenibilità
• Tradurre contenuti di sostenibilità in narrazioni chiare e di alto livello e messaggi strategici che dimostrino il valore aziendale della sostenibilità
• Monitorare e consolidare i progressi e i risultati delle priorità di sostenibilità del Gruppo Roche
• Condurre ricerche approfondite e benchmarking esterno sulle tendenze di sostenibilità specifiche del settore per generare approfondimenti per le nostre posizioni di sostenibilità.
• Trasformare i dettagli tecnici dei flussi di lavoro degli esperti in riepiloghi chiari e concisi a livello esecutivo. Eccellenza nella fornitura e nei processi
• Supportare iniziative e progetti strategici che contribuiscono ai nostri obiettivi aziendali e di sostenibilità.
• Gestire le tempistiche, le mappe delle parti interessate e le tappe fondamentali per le attività chiave, garantendo che i progetti strategici chiave rimangano sulla buona strada. Porta le parti interessate necessarie lungo il viaggio.
• Facilitare riunioni e progetti a livello di esperti, rappresentando il punto di vista della sostenibilità aziendale e garantendo l'allineamento con la nostra tabella di marcia strategica più ampia. Chi sei: Cerchiamo un professionista motivato, versatile e altamente organizzato in grado di affrontare la complessità tecnica degli argomenti di sostenibilità mantenendo una forte attenzione all'impatto strategico di alto livello.
• Possiedi una laurea (laurea o master) in sostenibilità, scienze ambientali, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato.
• Porta una comprovata esperienza lavorativa nella consulenza di alto livello incentrata sulla sostenibilità e/o sull'assistenza sanitaria (idealmente nel settore farmaceutico e/o MedTech)

Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Nachhaltigkeit bei Roche bedeutet, mit einer langfristigen Denkweise zu agieren und sicherzustellen, dass heute mehr Menschen von unserer Wissenschaft und Innovation profitieren können, ohne die Welt, in der sie morgen leben werden, zu gefährden. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir die Reichweite unserer Medikamente und Diagnostika erweitern, gleichzeitig unseren ökologischen Fußabdruck verringern und eine integrative, widerstandsfähige Organisation aufbauen, um den Fortschritt auch für kommende Generationen aufrechtzuerhalten. Weitere Informationen finden Sie hier: https://www.roche.com/about/sustainability Als Junior Corporate Sustainability Manager berichten Sie an den Chief Sustainability Officer und spielen eine Rolle bei der Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Unterstützung der Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen und Projekte, die zu unseren Geschäfts- und Nachhaltigkeitszielen beitragen. Sie werden Teil eines leistungsstarken Teams, bestehend aus dem Chief Sustainability Officer, Corporate Sustainability Strategy Leads und Sustainability Managern. Der Auftrag des Teams besteht darin, die Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie für die Roche-Gruppe zu entwickeln und deren Umsetzung zu überwachen. Sie arbeiten in einem Netzwerk mit den Nachhaltigkeitsteams verschiedener Funktionen und Einheiten bei Roche zusammen, um abgestimmte Prioritäten, eine integrierte strategische Roadmap und deren konsequente Umsetzung sicherzustellen. Für diese Position ist eine dynamische Person mit einem Hintergrund im Projektmanagement, Fachkenntnissen in der Unternehmensnachhaltigkeit und einer Leidenschaft für die Förderung positiver Veränderungen in einer globalen Organisation erforderlich. Die Gelegenheit: Koordinieren und führen Sie die Entwicklung von Präsentationen für Führungskräfte zum Thema Nachhaltigkeit durch.
• Übersetzen Sie Nachhaltigkeitsinhalte in klare, hochrangige Narrative und strategische Botschaften, die den Geschäftswert der Nachhaltigkeit veranschaulichen.
• Verfolgen und konsolidieren Sie die Fortschritte und Erfolge der Nachhaltigkeitsprioritäten der Roche-Gruppe.
• Führen Sie tiefgreifende Untersuchungen und externes Benchmarking zu branchenspezifischen Nachhaltigkeitstrends durch, um Erkenntnisse für unsere Nachhaltigkeitspositionen zu gewinnen.
• Fassen Sie technische Details aus Expertenarbeitsabläufen in klare, prägnante Zusammenfassungen auf Führungsebene zusammen. Lieferung und Prozessexzellenz
• Unterstützen Sie strategische Initiativen und Projekte, die zu unseren Geschäfts- und Nachhaltigkeitszielen beitragen.
• Verwalten Sie Zeitpläne, Stakeholder-Karten und Meilensteine ​​für wichtige Aktivitäten, um sicherzustellen, dass wichtige strategische Projekte auf Kurs bleiben. Bringt die notwendigen Stakeholder mit auf die Reise.
• Ermöglichen Sie Treffen und Projekte auf Expertenebene, vertreten Sie den Standpunkt der Unternehmensnachhaltigkeit und stellen Sie die Übereinstimmung mit unserer umfassenderen strategischen Roadmap sicher. Wer Sie sind: Wir suchen einen motivierten, vielseitigen und gut organisierten Fachmann, der sich mit der technischen Komplexität von Nachhaltigkeitsthemen auseinandersetzen kann und dabei einen klaren Fokus auf die strategische Wirkung auf hoher Ebene behält.

• Sie verfügen über ein solides Verständnis des Gesundheitssektors.
• Fähigkeit, komplexe Details in überzeugende, für Führungskräfte geeignete Botschaften und Präsentationen zu übersetzen.
• Sehr ausgeprägte zwischenmenschliche und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, abteilungsübergreifend effektiv zusammenzuarbeiten und Vertrauen mit Experten und Stakeholdern auf verschiedenen Ebenen aufzubauen.
• Strukturiertes, systematisches Denken und PR
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Le développement durable chez Roche signifie agir dans une perspective à long terme – garantir que davantage de personnes puissent bénéficier de notre science et de notre innovation aujourd'hui sans compromettre le monde dans lequel ils vivront demain. Nous y parvenons en élargissant la portée de nos médicaments et de nos diagnostics, tout en réduisant notre empreinte environnementale et en bâtissant une organisation inclusive et résiliente pour soutenir le progrès pour les générations à venir. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez consulter ici : https://www.roche.com/about/sustainability En tant que responsable junior du développement durable d'entreprise, vous relèverez du directeur du développement durable et jouerez un rôle dans le développement, la mise en œuvre et le soutien à la mise en œuvre d'initiatives et de projets stratégiques qui contribuent à nos objectifs commerciaux et de développement durable. Vous ferez partie d'une équipe hautement performante, comprenant le directeur du développement durable, les responsables de la stratégie de développement durable de l'entreprise et les responsables du développement durable. Le mandat de l’équipe est d’élaborer la stratégie de développement durable du Groupe Roche et de superviser sa mise en œuvre. Vous travaillerez en réseau avec les équipes de développement durable de différentes fonctions et unités de Roche pour garantir des priorités alignées, une feuille de route stratégique intégrée et une mise en œuvre cohérente de celles-ci. Ce poste requiert une personne dynamique avec une expérience en gestion de projet, une expertise en matière de développement durable d'entreprise et une passion pour la conduite de changements positifs au sein d'une organisation mondiale. L'opportunité : Coordonner et exécuter l'élaboration de présentations exécutives sur la durabilité
• Traduire le contenu sur la durabilité en récits clairs et de haut niveau et en messages stratégiques qui démontrent la valeur commerciale de la durabilité
• Suivre et consolider les progrès et les réalisations des priorités de durabilité du groupe Roche
• Mener des recherches approfondies et des analyses comparatives externes sur les tendances spécifiques au secteur en matière de durabilité afin de générer des informations sur nos positions en matière de durabilité.
• Transformez les détails techniques des flux de travail d'experts en résumés clairs et concis destinés à la direction. Excellence de la livraison et des processus
• Soutenir les initiatives et les projets stratégiques qui contribuent à nos objectifs commerciaux et de développement durable.
• Gérer les délais, les cartes des parties prenantes et les jalons pour les activités clés, en garantissant que les projets stratégiques clés restent sur la bonne voie. Amene les parties prenantes nécessaires tout au long du voyage.
• Faciliter les réunions et les projets de niveau expert, représentant le point de vue de la durabilité de l'entreprise et assurant l'alignement avec notre feuille de route stratégique plus large. Qui vous êtes : Nous recherchons un professionnel motivé, polyvalent et hautement organisé, capable de gérer la complexité technique des sujets liés au développement durable tout en restant concentré sur l'impact stratégique de haut niveau.
• Vous détenez un diplôme universitaire (baccalauréat ou maîtrise) en développement durable, en sciences de l'environnement, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
• Vous apportez une expérience professionnelle avérée dans un conseil de haut niveau axé sur le développement durable et/ou les soins de santé (idéalement dans le secteur pharmaceutique et/ou MedTech).
• Vous avez une compréhension pratique des thèmes fondamentaux du développement durable et/ou de l'industrie Pharma/MedTech.
• Vous avez une solide compréhension du secteur de la santé.
• Capacité à traduire des détails complexes en messages et présentations convaincants et prêts à l'emploi des dirigeants.
• Très solides compétences en matière de gestion interpersonnelle et des parties prenantes, vous permettant de collaborer efficacement entre les divisions et d'établir un climat de confiance avec les experts et les parties prenantes à différents niveaux.
• Pensée et pr structurées et systématiques

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Dein Team Als Nurse Liaison Manager:in (NLM) wirst Du Teil unserer Disease Area Neuroimmunologie. In Deiner Rolle als Expert:in im Außendienst gestaltest Du die Zusammenarbeit mit der Nurses-Community sowie unseren Teams in Vertrieb, Medical und Marketing aktiv mit. Wir verstehen uns als verlässliche Partner für Behandelnde, um gemeinsam die bestmögliche Versorgung von Patient:innen mit Multipler Sklerose zu fördern. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
• Beratung & Schulung: Du informierst und schulst Nurses und Ärzte zur Anwendung von B-Zell- und IL6-Therapien, inkl. Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Komplikationsmanagement.
• Organisationsberatung: Du berätst Praxen und Kliniken bei der Optimierung von Ablauforganisationen rund um unsere Neuroimmunologie-Produkte.
• Digitale Lösungen: Du begleitest die Implementierung unserer CE-zertifizierten Medizinprodukte (z.B. Brisa) zur Therapieunterstützung.
• Eventmanagement: Du planst und gestaltest aktiv lokale Anwendertreffen, Best-Practice-Sharing-Konzepte und moderierst Workshops.
• Netzwerkarbeit: Du identifizierst Kundenbedürfnisse vor Ort und bringst Deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in das Disease Area Squad ein.
• Crossfunktionale Kooperation: Du arbeitest eng mit allen Vertretern der Customer Pacing Functions, Medical, Marketing und Patient Partnership Bereichen zusammen und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Account Plänen. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger:in, Medizinische Fachangestellte oder vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 4 Jahre), idealerweise in der Neurologie.
• Erfahrung in der Therapie der Multiplen Sklerose (MS),insbesondere im Umgang mit MS-Patienten und Erfahrung im Management von Praxisabläufen und der Anleitung von Pflegekräften (Praxisanleiter:in)
• Medizinische Praxis: Sicherer Umgang mit Venenverweilkanülen, Durchführung von Infusionstherapien und Komplikationsmanagement.
• Zusatzqualifikation: Kenntnisse im Qualitätsmanagement (QSM) und Ausbildung zum Medizinprodukteberater sind von Vorteil.
• Hohe Sozialkompetenz, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist.
• Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace/MS Office sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis. Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente: Aktueller Lebenslauf. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme! Combinando i nostri punti di forza unici, ridefiniamo la salute attraverso l'azione sostenibile e l'innovazione. Per uno sguardo dietro le quinte, controllare questo video per vedere come siamo a Roche stanno rendendo l'assistenza sanitaria personalizzata una realtà. La mySugr GmbH è stata acquisita da Roche nel 2017 e il nostro ufficio di Vienna è uno dei siti globali di Roche. Ti troverai qui, nel cuore di Vienna, non importa se lavori su mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® o qualsiasi altro prodotto o soluzione Roche. Potete leggere di più sulla storia di mySugr & Roche qui . Ecco cosa stiamo cercando: Come Ingegnere di Software presso mySugr, lavorerai su un prodotto che aiuta le persone con la cosa più preziosa che hanno - la loro salute. In team collaborativi di sviluppatori, architetti, proprietari di prodotti e esperti QA, sperimenterete quotidianamente pratiche di sviluppo di software migliori in classe e contribuire a software che soddisfa le più alte aspettative - non mettiamo la vita dei nostri utenti a rischio! Siamo alla ricerca di esperti, motivati Junior Backend Software Engineers che lavoreranno a stretto contatto con i loro colleghi Backend, così come sostenere i nostri team di prodotto. Contribuirai con la tua conoscenza di Java, Spring, Hibernate, database relazionali & REST all'interno dei nostri team agili e interfunzionali. Come una persona flessibile e aperta con una passione per il codice pulito sarete un'aggiunta perfetta al nostro team. Ci impegniamo a qualità, dedicando tempo a recensioni di codice, copertura di test, giorni di qualità e principi CI/CD. Se questo risuona con voi, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi! Capacità essenziali per questa missione:
• Ti piace sviluppare codice backend pulito, stabile, testabile e performante, servendo le nostre belle applicazioni mobili
• Hai almeno 1 anno di esperienza a tempo pieno come Backend Engineer
• Ti piace lavorare e sostenere un team interdisciplinare, insieme a architetti, ingegneri di frontend, QAs e proprietari di prodotti
• Sei appassionato di design tecnico solido, codice pulito e architetture a prova di futuro
• Hai familiarità con Java 17+ e quadri come primavera, ibernato, o JAX-RS
• Hai esperienza con database SQL e relazionali come PostgreSQL
• Hai esperienza con Amazon Web Services (AWS) o qualsiasi altro provider cloud
• Si desidera imparare nuove tecnologie e sono in grado di adottarle rapidamente
• Grande comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese
• Sei un cittadino dell'UE o hai un permesso di lavoro austriaco valido Competenze bonus:
• Esperienza con norme mediche, di sicurezza e di privacy
• Conoscenza dell'industria del diabete o di altre industrie sanitarie paragonabili
• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti agili Ecco cosa potete aspettarvi da noi:
• Persone ambiziose e appassionate che costruiscono prodotti significativi
• Un ambiente di lavoro agile innovativo che consente la collaborazione con persone davvero intelligenti e la condivisione di conoscenze in team interfunzionali
• Un'organizzazione in crescita con spazio per lo sviluppo
• Non un ambiente aziendale, ma la leva di un leader di mercato globale (famiglia Roche)
• Carico di benefici (brand nuovo hardware Apple, fitness, trasporto pubblico, indennità di pranzo, lezioni di lingua, budget di formazione professionale, possibilità di partecipare a conferenze globali...)
• Orario di lavoro flessibile e politica di ufficio domestico, 5 settimane di vacanza
• Un meraviglioso ufficio con una terrazza sul tetto, cucina completamente fornita e incredibili macchine da caffè barista in mezzo a Vienna... oh, e abbiamo menzionato la migliore squadra del mondo! Imparerai sulla vasta gamma di tecnologie che utilizziamo, dallo sviluppo mobile nativo al codice infrastrutturale nel nostro ambiente cloud, acquisendo una ricca comprensione dei requisiti specifici del software medico, sia esso sicurezza, gestione del rischio medico, programmazione sicura e resiliente, o certificazioni e audit. Avrai un contatto diretto con i nostri utenti, imparando le loro lotte quotidiane che vivono con il diabete, così come clienti e partner, comprendendo il bisogno unico
descriptionByLocale.en:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality. The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here . Here's what we're looking for: As a Software Engineer at mySugr, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of developers, architects, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices on a daily basis and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk! We are looking for experienced, motivated Junior Backend Software Engineers who will work closely with their Backend colleagues, as well as support our product teams. You will contribute with your knowledge of Java, Spring, Hibernate, relational databases & REST within our agile and cross-functional teams. As a flexible and open-minded person with a passion for clean code you will be a perfect addition to our team. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to code reviews, test coverage, quality days and CI/CD principles. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you! Essential skills for this mission:
• You enjoy developing clean, stable, testable and performant backend code, serving our beautiful mobile applications
• You have at least 1 year of full-time experience as a Backend Engineer
• You love working in and supporting an interdisciplinary team, together with architects, frontend engineers, QAs, and product owners
• You are passionate about solid technical design, clean code and future-proof architectures
• You are familiar with Java 17+ and frameworks like Spring, Hibernate, or JAX-RS
• You have experience with SQL and relational databases like PostgreSQL
• You have experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or any other cloud provider
• You want to learn new technologies and are able to adopt them quickly
• Great written and verbal communication in English
• You are either an EU citizen or hold a valid Austrian work permit Bonus skills:
• Experience with medical, security, and privacy regulations
• Knowledge of the diabetes industry or other comparable health industries
• Experience working in agile environments Here's what you can expect from us:
• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products
• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with really smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
• A growing organization with room for development
• Not a corporate environment, but the leverage of a global market leader (Roche family)
• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget, chance to join global conferences...)
• Flexible working hours and home office policy, 5 weeks vacation
• A wonderful office with a rooftop terrace, fully stocked kitchen and amazing barista coffee machines in the middle of Vienna… oh, and did we mention the best team in the world! You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits. You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique need

title: D2P Data & Analytics Solution Consultant - RDT ERP

titleByLocale.it: D2P Data & Analytics Solution Consulente - RDT ERP
titleByLocale.en: D2P Data & Analytics Solution Consultant - RDT ERP
titleByLocale.de: D2P Data & Analytics Solution Berater - RDT ERP
titleByLocale.fr: D2P Data & Analytics Solution Consultant - RDT ERP

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The ERP Solution Consultant leads complex ERP data analytical solution delivery independently, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to architecture. In this role, you will guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product or product line level. By bringing advanced SAP DataSphere knowledge, in-depth expertise in key areas, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and team development. Description of the area The Demand to Pay (D2P) Data & Analytics area is responsible for driving the end-to-end Procurement, Accounts Payable and Travel & Expense Management Data & AI strategies by translating Functional strategies into measurable business outcomes. We are looking for an experienced SAP BW / SAP Datasphere Developer & Reporting Business Analyst to join our team. This hybrid role combines strong technical expertise in SAP data warehousing and reporting with the ability to understand business needs and translate them into scalable analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience across SAP BW/4HANA , SAP Datasphere , and SAP S/4HANA with deep knowledge of CDS View modeling and strong stakeholder-facing business analysis skills. Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): .Leads and executes complex ERP solution design and product delivery, ensuring alignment with requirements and priorities. The role proactively identifies issues, proposes solutions, and drives continuous improvement. This consultant documents and evolves architecture, spearheads standardization across product teams, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and adopts new technologies, providing key technical oversight.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: .Guides team activities, determines methods, and champions accountability (e.g., as tech lead/product owner) to drive program success. Solves complex problems creatively, applying new perspectives and analyzing multiple sources. Makes independent, impactful decisions at the squad/product level with limited oversight.
• Stakeholder Management: Communicates information, issues, and solutions to the product team, squad, and external stakeholders. Proactively fosters teamwork, resolves confusion, and facilitates discussions across project workstreams.
• Technical Development: Applies advanced knowledge of ERP IT concepts, with general and deep expertise in one or two ERP/technology areas. For example, designs, develops, and maintains data models and ETL processes in SAP Datasphere (and SAP BW/4HANA).
• Develop and optimize S/4HANA CDS (Core Data Services) views for extracting and consuming analytical data by BW, Datasphere, and reporting tools.
• Implement data pipelines, data flows, and transformations to support enterprise analytics and KPIs.
• Support BI tools (e.g., SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, or Tableau) connected to BW and Datasphere data models.
• Conduct testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of data models, CDS views, and queries.
• Ensure data consistency, governance, and security across all layers of the data architecture.
• Business Analysis: Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, process owners, and analysts to gather and analyze reporting requirements across functional areas (Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, etc.). Translate business reporting and KP

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we believe every employee can make a mark. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will join our Legal, Compliance and Group Communication (LCG) team to lead the architectural evolution of our Product Data, Analytics, and AI portfolio. Reporting to the Head of Product Data, Analytics and AI, you will act as a visionary change agent, challenging business requirements and proposing AI-driven efficiencies to design complex, global compliance solutions. The Opportunity In this role, you will have the chance to influence the strategic direction of our data landscape through the following priorities:
• Lead the strategic migration of legacy SAP BW systems to SAP Datasphere, ensuring high performance and data integrity.
• Drive the Roche corporate Data strategy by aligning architectural transitions with global enterprise standards.
• Act as a high-level consultant to senior business stakeholders, proactively challenging requirements to ensure genuine business value.
• Define the architectural roadmap for data modeling, analytics, and integration patterns (APIs, ETL) within the LCG domain.
• Implement cutting-edge AI efficiencies using Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI frameworks to automate compliance.
• Ensure robust information architecture and provide expert guidance across the broader Data & AI product suite.
• Govern architecture standards to maintain a scalable and secure data fabric/mesh environment for global operations.
• Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams to lead virtual architecture organizations and foster a culture of technical excellence. Who you are We are looking for a proactive negotiator and technical expert who meets the following qualifications:
• You possess 15+ years of professional experience, with at least 10 years specifically in Architecture leading complex migrations.
• You hold a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
• You are an expert in the SAP Ecosystem, specifically with deep, hands-on knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA and SAP Datasphere.
• You demonstrate AI/ML mastery through a proven track record of implementing GenAI and Agentic AI within an enterprise context.
• You have extensive Data Engineering experience with Big Data systems, modern data fabric, and cloud stacks like Snowflake and SAP BTP.
• You bring a proactive mindset, with the ability to anticipate business needs and "look around corners" before requirements are articulated.
• You are a preferred expert in compliance reporting, such as the Sunshine Act or similar global regulatory data standards. Call to Action Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare. #RDT2026 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Territory Manager - New Delhi A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche . As a Territory Manager - New Delhi , you are responsible for managing the sale of the organization’s products through distribution and retail channels across the New Delhi geographic area. You serve as a strategic partner to the Area Sales Manager (ASM), providing critical market insights to estimate product demand and drive the organization’s growth. You apply new approaches to merchandising and field activation to increase brand visibility and ensure that our life-changing products reach the customers and patients who need them. You work collaboratively with distributors and dealers to break down barriers to access, ensuring that our sales plans are executed with precision and operational excellence. Your Opportunity
• Territory Planning & Execution: You drive business results by providing information on the market environment to help estimate yearly product demand. You ensure the monthly achievement of SKU-wise sales plans and targets by generating secondary sales in the market.
• Distribution Management: You monitor distributor performance, reviewing the existing network to propose the appointment of new partners or the termination of non-performing ones. You motivate distributors and dealers through regular communication, sorting out issues regarding accounts, pricing, and schemes.
• Sales Promotion & Merchandising: You prepare and execute sales promotion plans through field activation and merchandising activities designed by the Marketing Team. You maintain rigorous records of these activities, tracking expenses and sales generated to provide feedback on program efficacy.
• Market Intelligence: You monitor competitor information and feedback within your category. You provide regular reports to the ASM on competitor activities and stock availability of promotional materials to ensure Roche remains competitive in the landscape.
• Customer Excellence: You address all complaints and suggestions from distributors and customers by coordinating with customer care. You organize dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies to ensure brand consistency and strong partnerships.
• Financial Oversight: You ensure timely monthly collections through continuous follow-ups and submit inventory requirements at the distributor level as per the sales plan. You maintain disciplined daily reporting of customer visits as per established work norms. Who You Are
• Qualified Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Pharmacy . A post-graduate qualification is considered an additional advantage.
• Industry Experience: You have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience with a proven track record in OTC, Surgical Equipment or Pharmaceutical Product.
• Regional Expert: You possess a deep understanding of the Goa market environment and have experience managing independent representatives, distributors, or agents.
• Strategic Partner: You have demonstrated the ability to assist leadership in planning and executing complex sales promotion plans with a focus on productivity and efficiency.
• Analytical & Disciplined: You rely on data to track sales performance and inventory, with a high degree of accountability for daily reporting and meeting monthly s

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Position Summary and Purpose The Patient Access Partner is a strategic role responsible for driving and executing the integrated access, pricing, and policy strategy for an assigned Disease Area (DA) Ecosystem. This role translates national policy into tangible access and pricing decisions at the disease level, focusing on improving and accelerating access to innovation. As a key player in the integrated access strategy, the Partner identifies shared purpose and value, co-creates flexible pricing solutions with DA Squads, and implements them across the ecosystem to ensure better health outcomes for more patients faster. Core Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities 1. Ecosystem & Disease Area Policy Strategy
• Strategic Alignment : Execute and develop Disease Area Policy activities that support the strategic outcomes of the Squad. This involves ensuring all access strategies are aligned with current and anticipated national legislative trends.
• Integrated Planning : Manage the end-to-end patient access process for assigned therapeutic areas, coordinating strategy from monitoring early-stage portfolios to achieving final reimbursement.
• System Shaping : Catalyze the ability to see broader trends in healthcare systems, bringing external insights into Roche to influence DA strategy and sharing Roche’s expertise with the external ecosystem.
• Pricing Strategy: Responsible for defining the Pricing Strategy (e.g., target price, discount caps, and risk-share structures) based on commercial ambition 2. Pricing, Negotiation, and Technical Execution
• Reimbursement Journey: Acts as the Strategic Project Lead for the reimbursement journey, responsible for the overall timeline, squad alignment, and final negotiation outcome.
• Strategic Negotiation : Serves as the Primary Point of Contact (PPOC) for strategic therapy area payer dialogue, pricing negotiations, and policy-level external meetings.
• Value Proposition: Accountable for translating the technical value proposition into a commercial narrative and negotiation strategy tailored to the specific payer or Disease Area Squad needs.
• External Relationship Management : Maintain and foster a relevant network with pricing and reimbursement decision-makers within the healthcare system to support favorable commercial conditions. 3. Cross-Functional Squad Partnership
• Core Squad Member : Act as a primary member of Disease Area Squads, connecting Market Access strategy, Policy, and Pricing directly to commercialization excellence and field execution.
• Evidence Generation : Responsible for identifying strategic evidence gaps required to support negotiation and commercial goals (e.g., 'We need to prove X to the payer').
• Enterprise Partnership: Work as a strategic bridge between high-level market access strategy and operational reality, partnering with Finance and Brand teams to recommend and shape national access strategies.
• Collaboration : Partner cross-functionally with Healthcare System Partners and Patient Journey Partners to leverage internal networks and pull in resources needed for the therapeutic area. Skills, Knowledge, and Capabilities
• Strategic Agility : Ability to maintain focus on long-term strategy while successfully adapting to changing environmental and legislative conditions.
• System Thinking : Capability to think from an enterprise level to bring the best possible outcomes to the local health environment and the broader Roche global network.
• Impactful Communication : Skilled in

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo affari medici. Stiamo trasformando insieme la pratica medica. Siamo responsabili per la prospettiva medica esterna a Roche e per garantire che la scienza dietro i nostri prodotti sia comunicata e compresa tra gli HCP rilevanti a livello globale, per i quali siamo un partner affidabile. Collaboriamo in un ambiente di lavoro integrato con le affiliate, lo sviluppo globale e la strategia globale. Aiutiamo a guidare lo sviluppo, l'introduzione, l'assunzione e l'uso informato dei nostri farmaci e servizi innovativi nella pratica clinica e nella cura dei pazienti in tutto il mondo. Creiamo ed evolviamo competenze, capacità e opportunità per la nostra rete medica globale. Pensiamo in anticipo e facciamo leva digitale ogni volta che possibile. L'opportunità
• Fornire competenze mediche per il cancro al seno e contribuire a componenti di strategia medica come la generazione di prove, la diffusione e le intuizioni mediche come parte di una strategia integrata.
• Contribuisci a o guidare la pianificazione e l'esecuzione di strategie di generazione di prove rilevanti nell'area del cancro al seno, in base a lacune di accesso medico e di mercato, tra cui studi clinici, studi iniziati da Investigator (IIS), dati del mondo reale e collaborazioni di ricerca scientifica costruendo reti mirate con stakeholder sanitari in più culture e paesi.
• Generi informazioni mediche integrate per informare strategie e piani e fornisci competenze mediche e funzionali alle strategie di accesso al mercato e ai relativi piani operativi.
• Condurre la collaborazione con specialisti accademici e clinici chiave in tutto il mondo per garantire un input scientifico e strategico ai nostri programmi di sviluppo clinico e per risparmiare con loro sull'interpretazione dei nostri risultati di prova clinica in modo che questi possano potenzialmente creare valore per HCP e beneficio pazienti. Chi sei Hai un grado di MD che è un grado di vita altamente preferito o avanzato (ad esempio PhD o PharmD). Un grado di specializzazione o esperienza nel settore del cancro al seno è un must. Inoltre, si dispone di robusti affari medici e / o medicina farmaceutica esperienza. Più lontano, si porta:
• High Ethical Standards: Lei dimostra l'integrità e la conformità in tutte le attività professionali.
• Agility strategica: Hai la capacità di prendere decisioni consapevoli e strategiche in modo efficace.
• Approccio paziente-critico: priorità ai pazienti nelle attività di sviluppo clinico e di pratica medica.
• Esperienza di lancio: la tua esperienza con il lancio di prodotti medici o indicazioni guiderà l'introduzione di prodotti di successo. La vostra esperienza nel cancro al seno può guidare il cambiamento. Fai il passo successivo e aiutaci a fornire farmaci innovativi ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Applichi subito. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are Medical Affairs. We are transforming Medical practice together. We are accountable for the medical outside-in perspective at Roche and for ensuring that the science behind our products is communicated and understood amongst relevant HCPs at global scale, for whom we are a trusted partner. We collaborate across and strive in an integrated work environment with the affiliates, global development and global strategy. We help in driving the development, introduction, uptake and informed use of our innovative medicines and services in clinical practice and patient care worldwide. We create and evolve competencies, capabilities, and opportunities for our global Medical Network. We think ahead and leverage digital whenever possible. The Opportunity
• You provide medical expertise to Breast Cancer and contribute to medical strategy components such as evidence generation, dissemination and medical insights as part of an integrated strategy.
• You contribute to or lead the planning and execution of evidence generation strategies relevant in the Breast Cancer area, based on medical and market access gaps, including clinical studies, Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS), real-world data, and scientific research collaborations by building purposeful networks with healthcare stakeholders across multiple cultures and countries.
• You generate integrated medical insights to inform strategies and plans and you provide medical and functional expertise to market access strategies and related operational plans.
• You lead the collaboration with key academic and clinical specialists worldwide to secure scientific and strategic input to our clinical development programs and to spar with them on the interpretation of our clinical trial results so that these can potentially create value for HCPs and benefit patients. Who You Are You hold an MD degree which is a highly preferred or advanced life-science degree (e.g. PhD or PharmD). A specialization degree or industry experience in Breast Cancer is a must. In addition, you have robust medical affairs and/or pharmaceutical medicine experience. Further, you bring:
• High Ethical Standards: You demonstrate integrity and compliance in all professional activities.
• Strategic Agility: You have the ability to make informed, strategic decisions effectively.
• Patient-Centric Approach: You prioritize patients in clinical development and medical practice activities.
• Launch Experience: Your experience with the launch of medical products or indications will drive successful product introduction. Your expertise in Breast Cancer can drive change. Take the next step and help us deliver innovative medicines to patients worldwide. Apply now. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Sie bieten medizinisches Know-how für Brustkrebs und tragen als Teil einer integrierten Strategie zu Komponenten der medizinischen Strategie wie Beweiserzeugung, Verbreitung und medizinische Erkenntnisse bei.

• Sie generieren integrierte medizinische Erkenntnisse, um Strategien und Pläne zu informieren und bieten medizinische und funktionale Expertise für Marktzugangsstrategien und damit verbundene Betriebspläne.

• Hohe Ethische Standards: Sie zeigen Integrität und Compliance in allen professionellen Aktivitäten.
• Strategische Agilität: Sie haben die Fähigkeit, fundierte, strategische Entscheidungen effektiv zu treffen.
• Patient-Centric Approach: Sie priorisieren Patienten in der klinischen Entwicklung und in der medizinischen Praxis.
• Launch Experience: Ihre Erfahrung mit der Einführung von Medizinprodukten oder Indikationen wird die erfolgreiche Produkteinführung vorantreiben. Ihr Know-how im Brustkrebs kann sich ändern. Nehmen Sie den nächsten Schritt und helfen Sie uns, innovative Medikamente an Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Bewerben Sie sich. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes des affaires médicales. Nous transformons la pratique médicale ensemble. Nous sommes responsables de la perspective médicale externe à Roche et de veiller à ce que la science derrière nos produits soit communiquée et comprise parmi les HCP pertinents à l'échelle mondiale, pour lesquels nous sommes un partenaire de confiance. Nous collaborons dans un environnement de travail intégré avec les affiliés, le développement mondial et la stratégie mondiale. Nous contribuons au développement, à l'introduction, à l'adoption et à l'utilisation éclairée de nos médicaments et services innovants dans la pratique clinique et les soins aux patients dans le monde entier. Nous créons et développons des compétences, des capacités et des opportunités pour notre réseau médical mondial. Nous pensons à l'avenir et puisons dans le numérique chaque fois que possible. L'opportunité
• Vous fournissez une expertise médicale au cancer du sein et contribuez à des composantes de la stratégie médicale telles que la production de preuves, la diffusion et les connaissances médicales dans le cadre d'une stratégie intégrée.
• Vous contribuez ou dirigez la planification et l'exécution de stratégies de production de données pertinentes dans le domaine du cancer du sein, basées sur des lacunes médicales et d'accès au marché, y compris des études cliniques, des études entreprises par des chercheurs (SII), des données réelles et des collaborations de recherche scientifique en créant des réseaux ciblés avec les intervenants des soins de santé dans plusieurs cultures et pays.
• Vous produisez des informations médicales intégrées pour éclairer les stratégies et les plans et vous fournissez une expertise médicale et fonctionnelle aux stratégies d'accès au marché et aux plans opérationnels connexes.
• Vous dirigez la collaboration avec des spécialistes universitaires et cliniques clés du monde entier afin d'obtenir une contribution scientifique et stratégique à nos programmes de développement clinique et de les analyser avec eux sur l'interprétation de nos résultats d'essais cliniques afin que ceux-ci puissent potentiellement créer de la valeur pour les HCP et bénéficier aux patients. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme MD qui est un diplôme hautement préféré ou avancé en sciences de la vie (p. ex. doctorat ou pharmD). Un diplôme de spécialisation ou une expérience de l'industrie dans le cancer du sein est un must. De plus, vous avez une solide expérience médicale et/ou pharmaceutique. En outre, vous apportez:
• Hautes normes éthiques: Vous démontrez l'intégrité et la conformité dans toutes les activités professionnelles.
• Agilité stratégique : Vous avez la capacité de prendre des décisions stratégiques éclairées et efficaces.
• Approche patient-chercheur : Vous priorisez les patients dans les activités de développement clinique et de pratique médicale.
• Expérience de lancement: Votre expérience avec le lancement de produits médicaux ou d'indications conduira à une introduction réussie du produit. Votre expertise en cancer du sein peut conduire au changement. Prenez la prochaine étape et aidez-nous à fournir des médicaments innovants aux patients du monde entier. Demande maintenant. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Internship | Medical & Health Policy Chapter Roche Diagnostics, Portugal The Opportunity We are looking for a dedicated and self-motivated talent to join Roche Diagnostics Portugal for a 1-year professional internship with the Medical Affairs and Health Policy team, ideally starting in September 2026. As part of a dynamic team, during the internship you will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced business partners and stakeholders on meaningful projects related to Roche high medical value areas, offering you the opportunity to gain valuable experience in the diagnostics industry! Your role will allow you to develop your skills and grow in the following areas:
• Provide support in medical review for materials like brochures, websites, learning centers, etc. Ensure these materials, targeted at Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), are scientifically and medically accurate, balanced, and compliant.
• Assist in the planning of educational events by providing support for both logistical and content-related elements, ensuring adherence to defined procedures and guidelines and the smooth execution of these events.
• Assist the Medical & Health Policy chapter by supporting the preparation of Advisory Boards and Focus Groups. This involves coordinating and supporting interactions with experts to gather valuable insights that will be used to refine our strategy and tactics, which is crucial for strategic decision-making.
• Assist in creating educational content for internal and external audiences, including webinars, training materials (slides and presentations), e-learning modules, infographics, fact sheets, etc.
• Support internal training activities, ensuring our teams have the required knowledge and resources, and are properly equipped.
• Understand local clinical and economic evidence needs and how to translate those into action, driving the implementation of local studies and initiatives to close the evidence gaps.
• Participate in the development of disease awareness and patient advocacy campaigns Who you are You excel in building successful working relationships with colleagues and external partners, and you demonstrate curiosity, eagerness to learn, strategic thinking, and a strong enthusiasm for how science can lead to improved outcomes for patients:
• You recently completed your Medical Degree (MD) or a master in Public Health (MPH) and have an healthcare related background.
• You are passionate about health innovation
• You enjoy collaborating with others, thriving in a fast-paced team environment.
• You embrace challenges in a positive way and feel confident and comfortable in sharing your views and ideas.
• Your ability to communicate in both Portuguese and English, combined with your interpersonal skills, makes you a highly effective communicator.
• Your strong analytical skills allow you to turn data into actionable insights.
• You are proficient in Google workspace. If you are eager to start your career in Roche, have a look at this opportunity to join us! Applications close by 16th June, 2026. What we offer: Hybrid and flexible work practices, competitive internship subsidy, meal allowance, health insurance, life and personal accident insurance, subsidised restaurant in the office and free access to Roche gym and wellbeing program, among many other, in a highly dynamic, collaborative, agile and innovative environment. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position Affiliate: Roche Pharma Korea Cluster: Access & Policy Work Location: Hanam City, Gyeonggi-do Worker Type: Regular Your key responsibilities
• Advanced QC Testing: Perform QC testing for biological/chemical drug products utilizing various compendial and in-house validated methods (e.g., ID/Purity by CE, HPLC & UPLC, Content by UV/Vis, Cell-based Assays), ensuring strict adherence to SOPs and test protocols.
• QC Material & Cell Bank Management: Manage and maintain critical QC materials including QC/retention samples, critical reagents, and cell banking.
• Method Transfer (SME): Lead or support internal/external analytical method transfer activities, providing technical expertise on key analytical methods as a Subject Matter Expert.
• Investigation & Quality Management: Handling of deviations, OOS/OOT investigations, change controls, CAPA, and risk assessments, identifying root causes and implementing effective actions.
• Audit & QMR Leadership: Act as an internal or external GxP auditor/co-auditor and represent the QC function as a member of the local QMR (Quality Management Review) Meeting.
• Data Integrity & Review: Conduct technical review of QC raw data and analytical results, adhering strictly to the current GxP good documentation practices and data integrity requirements.
• Equipment Lifecycle Management: Execute and coordinate qualification, calibration, and preventive maintenance of QC equipment ensuring intended use.
• Documentation & Regulatory Collaboration: Draft, review, and revise various QC SOPs, work instructions, protocols, and reports. Collaborate closely with RA for the preparation of specifications and test methods for drug product registration. Who you are
• Basic qualification: Bachelor of Science majoring in biotechnology or related science.
• A minimum of 4 years experience in developing and executing quality control operation, and laboratory experience in pharmaceutical company.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Internship in Innovation & Sustainability For students in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences fields Our Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to gain hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry while making a positive impact on the world. Are you ready to join a global network spanning 20+ countries, where bright minds collaborate to tackle real-world challenges in Innovation & Sustainability? Do you want to work on impactful projects, shape the future, and drive change from within? The Position As an intern, you will contribute to a project focused on research on assessing & reducing the environmental impact of synthetic polymer excipients in the Pharmaceutical Industry by identifying and evaluating safer biodegradable alternatives. The project explores how polymers used in pharmaceutical formulations may contribute to microplastic pollution in municipal water systems and aims to support more sustainable product design in light of evolving regulatory expectations such as EU REACH 2026. Within your first 3 months, you are expected to assess target polymers, research promising biodegradable substitute materials, analyze supplier and production feasibility, and contribute to a final technical report and strategic roadmap. Your work will support Roche’s sustainability ambitions by addressing biodiversity and water-related impacts, advancing sustainable products, and encouraging the use of more environmentally responsible raw materials. This internship offers a high-impact opportunity to work on an innovative topic at the intersection of pharmaceutical science, sustainability, and environmental protection. The Opportunity
• Conduct a product-based preliminary analysis of target polymers
• Research and evaluate potential biodegradable alternatives for relevant synthetic polymer excipients
• Assess production feasibility and supply landscape for alternative materials, including scalability, supplier availability, quality standards, and regulatory considerations
• Compare synthetic and biodegradable options across environmental impact, ecotoxicity, pharmaceutical performance, and compliance criteria
• Explore how polymer choice influences product life cycle sustainability, from raw material sourcing through use and disposal
• Support the development of a strategic roadmap for improving or replacing selected synthetic polymers with more sustainable alternatives
• Prepare a final technical report and presentation summarizing findings, trade-offs, and recommendations
• Collaborate with stakeholders across functions to gather input and support a multidisciplinary evaluation process Who You Are You are enrolled or have completed your Master’s or PhD studies at a university, preferably in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences within the last 12 months and are interested in applying your knowledge in a modern working environment as part of an internship of at least 3 months. Preferred Qualifications Are
• Familiar with bioprocesses, biochemical or biological

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Die Customer Area Near Patient Care (NPC) vereint die Portfolios Point of Care und Diabetes Care von Roche. Mit unserer Leidenschaft bringen wir Tests näher an Patienten und befähigen Menschen, ihre eigene Gesundheit besser zu überwachen. Innerhalb von NPC Operations sind wir global für die End-to-End-Produktion von Lösungen für die kontinuierliche Glukose-Überwachung (CGM), die Blutzuckermessung (BGM) und Insulin Delivery (IDS) sowie für Point-of-Care (POC)-Produkte verantwortlich. Unsere wichtigsten internen Produktionsstätten sind Mannheim in Deutschland und Indianapolis in den USA. Das Umfeld Als CxM Finished Goods sind wir mit rund 25 Kolleg:innen in Mannheim und Rotkreuz Teil von Manufacturing Science and Technology im Bereich NPC Operations. Für unser CGM Accu-Check SmartGuide verantworten wir den globalen Auf- und Ausbau sowie das Betreiben der externen Fertigungsstufe. Zusammen mit unseren strategischen Equipment- und Produktionspartnern entwickeln wir robuste Prozesse und Anlagen. Durch eine hohe Standardisierung sichern wir wettbewerbsfähige Herstellungskosten und eine zuverlässige Produktion. Wir stellen damit die Versorgung mit konformen Produkten in Qualität, Zeit und Kosten für die aktuellen und zukünftigen Produktgenerationen sicher und pflegen das Produkt über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Die Position Als Head of CxM Finished Goods - Projects leiten Sie ein globales Team von technischen Projektleiter:innen. Ihr Team verantwortet die Industrialisierung von R&D-Konzepten in standardisierte und robust skalierbare Anlagendesigns, die für die globale Massenproduktion geeignet sind und gewährleisten herstellbares Produktdesign (Design for Manufacturability). Dabei agieren Sie an den Schnittstelle zwischen Equipmentherstellern, externen Betreiber (Contract Manufacturer) und internen Fachbereichen (z.B. R&D, Einkauf, Quality, interne Produktion) und verantworten Kapazitätserweiterungsprojekte speziell für Spritzgussteile und die finale Assemblierung unserer CGM-Produkte. Sie sind massgeblich am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung des Lieferantenökosystems beteiligt, pflegen aktiv ein externes Netzwerk aus Technologiepartnern und sind mit den relevanten industriellen Standards und Trends bestens vertraut. Zudem setzt Ihr Team Product Care Projekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktteam zur Proudukt-, Prozess und Kostenoptimierungen. Sie definieren effiziente Ablaufprozesse und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter, um zuverlässig und effizient Projektinhalte abzuliefern und die Fähigkeiten der Zulieferindustrie optimal zu nutzen. Deine Aufgabe
• Teamführung und lokale Ansprechperson: Du leitest das Teams „CxM Finished Goods - Projects“ diziplinarisch und fachlich. Durch eine vorausschauende Bedarfsplanung formst du eine leistungsstarke Einheit, identifizierst und förderst Talente gezielt und stellst durch eine kontinuierliche Qualifizierung der Mitarbeitenden sicher, dass die Kompetenzen im Team stetig mit den technologischen Anforderungen wachsen. Als lokale Ansprechperson in Mannheim schaffst du ein vertrauensvolles und motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld und pflegst ein Netzwerk mit den lokalen Schnittstellen.
• Exzellenz in der Projektabwicklung: Du verantwortest die professionelle Steuerung des gesamten Projektportfolios von CxM Finished Goods. Dabei stellst du eine transparente Planung und zuverlässige Einhaltung der Qualität der Inhalte und Timelines sicher. Durch effizientes Risiko- und Ressourcenmanagement stellst du die Kosteneffizienz üb

The Position Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary) The OE & BPM Lead within the Manufacturing Department is responsible for driving a culture of Continuous Improvement on the shop floor. By utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies and other optimization tools, this role identifies and eliminates waste, optimizes production business processes, and ensures the achievement of departmental KPIs. This position serves as both a catalyst for production efficiency and a critical bridge for cross-functional process synergy. Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 1. Lean Leadership & Project Management
• Lead Core Projects: Spearhead major Lean improvement projects on the front line (e.g., OEE enhancement, SMED/changeover reduction, yield loss mitigation, etc.).
• Capability Building: Design and implement internal Lean training systems; coach production supervisors and staff in applying Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, VSM, etc.).
• Culture Promotion: Foster a "Continuous Improvement" atmosphere, ensuring Lean thinking is deeply embedded in shop floor operations. 2. KPI & Workshop Management
• KPI Setting & Cascading: Coordinate the setting of annual/quarterly production goals, cascading site-level objectives into measurable departmental KPIs.
• Performance Review: Organize and facilitate departmental Management Reviews and Workshops, ensuring early warning of performance deviations.
• Action Tracking: Responsible for tracking the execution of production improvement action plans to ensure closed-loop management. 3. Business Process Management & Optimization
• Process Mapping: Identify redundancies in production management and enhance administrative and operational efficiency through Business Process Reengineering.
• Site-level Collaboration: Represent the Production Department in site-level optimization initiatives, such as Digital Transformation and Supply Chain synergy.
• Compliance Balance: Ensure all process optimization solutions strictly adhere to GMP requirements, mitigating compliance risks while improving efficiency. Qualification and Experience Education/Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or above in Science, Engineering, or Management Majors in Pharmacy, Bio-engineering, or Industrial Engineering are preferred Job Required Competencies Work Experience:
• 5+ years of experience in Operational Excellence (OE) or Lean improvement within large-scale manufacturing, with at least 2 years in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
• Familiar with Change Control and Deviation Management processes under GMP environments. Professional Skills:
• Proficient in Lean Manufacturing tools; certification as a Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt is preferred.
• Data Visualization & Presentation: Exceptional data visualization and presentation skills. Ability to translate complex data into intuitive dashboards and deliver compelling narratives to stakeholders at all levels. Proficiency in Minitab, Power BI/Tableau, Excel，and PowerPoint is required. Soft Skills:
• Change Management: Proven ability to navigate resistance to change, with excellent cross-functional communication and interpersonal influence.
• Project Management: Ability to manage multiple project priorities simultaneously with a strong result-oriented mindset. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Global Digital Hub has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting, and Creative Design. As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of content creation priorities. As a Senior Medical writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners across various therapeutic areas and play a crucial role in business development and stakeholder engagement As a Senior Medical Writer, you will be at the forefront of creating high-quality content for medical communications tailored solutions. The Senior Medical Writer is an experienced subject matter expert, advisor and leader within the chapter. Focusing on specific therapeutic areas in dedicated service teams, Senior Medical Writers are responsible for training and mentoring medical writers, copywriters and content editors within their assigned team - also driving cross-team upskilling and knowledge transfer to grow the capabilities of the chapter overall. This critical position has a global scope and a key component of the role involves acting as a trusted advisor and knowledgeable consultant to our business teams on the topic of medical writing and communications. The Opportunity:
• Apply broad knowledge of medical writing to develop effective scientific content for digital implementation in collaboration with cross-functional partners and clients.
• Manage multiple concurrent projects across therapeutic areas, ensuring delivery on agreed timelines and proactively managing your workload and capacity.
• Ensure that all content, format, and structure comply with regulatory guidelines, Roche best practices, and diligently follow applicable company SOPs.
• As a Senior Medical Writer, you will provide mentorship and technical coaching to team members and new writers joining the team.
• Serve as a Subject Matter Expert in pharmaceutical and medical communications, leading the team in assigned specific therapeutic areas.
• Take ownership for upholding the highest standards of scientific accuracy, quality, and compliance with all applicable industry guidelines.
• Exercise excellent communication skills for professional liaison with internal teams and external stakeholders to obtain comprehensive briefs and lead cross-functional initiatives. Who you are:
• You have an advanced degree in a biological science or medical discipline and 7+ years of medical writing experience, ideally within an agency setting.
• You have native-level written and spoken English and additional languages are an advantage.
• You possess excellent attention to detail, consistency, clarity, and scientific rigor, demonstrating an accountable, focused, and precise attitude.
• You must be able to effectively coordinate people across multiple organizations and countries while demonstrating strong stakeholder management and a customer-centric mentality.
• You thrive in a fast-paced and changing environment, utilizing a continuous improvement and growth mindset to effectively prioritize tasks.
• You have experience with standard IT applications, with a preference
