The Position The Opportunity The Data and Analytics Governance (DAG) Lead is a key role responsible for establishing and maintaining effective data & analytics governance practices for Roche’s Digital Backbone (Enterprise Resource Planning environment) and the Finance, Procurement and Roche Solution and Services Domain, working closely with cross-functional teams in ASPIRE program (implementing and deploying the Digital Backbone to all Roche affiliates), Roche Data Office, Informatics and Enterprise Master Data Management (EMDM) to ensure the consistent application of Functional DAG policies, standards and controls derived out of the Global Guidelines from the Roche Data Office.
• Align, Develop and implement a comprehensive DAG Framework, including data policies, standards, and procedures in alignment with the Roche Data Council's policies, standards and procedures.
• Implement and further develop the Framework`s data and analytics -related roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities
• Develop and implement a comprehensive DAG Cookbook, including metadata management guidance
• Build and maintain up to date metadata repository, data lineage, monitor data quality, integrity, and security measures in collaboration with data stewards, data owners, and Informatics teams
• Facilitate DAG meetings, Stakeholder alignment meetings and closely collaborate with the Roche Data Council
• Manage Business Data Stewardship from a Product Owner perspective, including Strategy, Roadmap and Objectives for Data Analytics and Governance (DAG), aligned with Group Data Strategy Who you are
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Management, or a related field
• 5+ years of experience in data management, governance, or analytics roles
• Strong understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts
• Familiarity with data governance frameworks and standards (e.g., DAMA)
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
• Effective communication and facilitation skills to engage stakeholders at all levels
• Project management experience and the ability to juggle multiple priorities
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging data and analytics governance frameworks to continuously improve DAG Roche’s Digital Backbone approach
• Excellent understanding of Data & Analytics, Pharmaceutical Business Processes, Data Governance Solutions (e.g. Collibra) In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive cult

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role At Diagnostics Insights Software, we are collaborating in digitalizing diagnostics and revolutionizing how data is accessed and utilized in Laboratories and Point of Care settings. Building software products is great, but working on software with a purpose is even better! As a Software Engineer in Test, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and UX experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software engineering practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users’ lives at risk! Main responsibilities:
• Confirm the correctness of requirements-driven tests, utilizing diverse testing approaches such as exploratory, white box, and black box testing.
• Execute tests across multiple testing levels , including end-to-end, system, integration, and unit testing.
• Perform various testing types , such as functional, performance, resiliency, and scalability testing, to ensure robust product quality.
• Automate and execute front-end and back-end tests for platforms and web applications .
• Develop and automate deployment and testing pipelines, supporting multiple project branches and stages.
• Track and report quality metrics , contributing to the maintenance and improvement of quality dashboards .
• Conduct root cause analyses of defects and newly discovered issues to continuously improve testing practices.
• Design and implement automation frameworks and validate toolchains to support testing processes.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory standards for all quality engineering deliverables.
• Collaborate closely with Test Architects, Test Leads, Test Managers, as well as designers, architects, and developers.
• Share, coach, and train the built-in quality mindset throughout the organization. How would your day to day look like? You will work closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software in a fast-paced, iterative environment. You will deep dive on ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products by performing thorough testing activities throughout the development lifecycle. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to design reviews, thorough test coverage, focused quality days and CI/CD principles. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you Who are you?
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• You are familiar with integration of automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to ensure continuous testing.
• You are familiar with the testing processes: design, plan, execution and reporting.
• Great written and verbal communication in English.
• Technologies & Tools: Kubernetes-based applications, AWS, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Typescript, Javascript, Playwright, Cypress, Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux. This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love, that is what makes us Roche. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, Roche Diagnostics Australia is looking for a Field Service Engineer, ideally with specific experience working with Mass Spectrometry. As a Field Service Engineer, you are responsible to perform the field service activities for all our Diagnostics portfolios with a primary focus on Mass Spectrometry, by provision and coordination of all activities relating to instrument installation, instrument preventative maintenance, instrument troubleshooting, software and hardware modifications, relating to both pre, during, and post sales requirements. Service will need to be performed locally, interstate, and including travel overseas to support Roche Diagnostics New Zealand when needed. This service is provided on the basis of hours of employment typically being from 9 am to 5 pm Monday to Friday. In addition, you will be asked to participate in an on-call roster to cover the out of hours’ service requirements from 5 pm to 9 am Monday to Friday and 24 hours Saturday and Sunday. Field Service Engineers are required to actively collaborate with the local account management teams and to participate in local and national team meetings. We are looking for an experienced engineer with a proactive mindset, who enjoys working collaboratively in a close team environment, and is capable of working fully independently. Key responsibilities include:
• Provide outstanding quality instrument service and support, in a timely manner, to meet the high standards expected by our customers of Roche and the products we supply and support.
• Responsible for the timely pre-installation inspection and installation of Roche and other analytical systems working with Regional Engineering Manager, Application Specialist, Project Lead, Solutions Manager, and Local Account Management Team to ensure successful installations occur.
• Ensure all Preventative Maintenance is carried out in a timely manner as per the manufacturer's guidelines.
• Ensure any ongoing instrument problems or issues are communicated to Regional Engineering Manager, Head of Service & Support, Local Account Manager, Solutions Team and or manufacturer.
• Accurately capture and report all field activities undertaken, including all labour and travel incurred via CRM system in a timely manner.
• Compliance with all Roche processes as documented in policies and procedures- complete all mandatory training by the due date.
• Ensures compliance and promotion of all safety, health, and environmental policies and procedures to ensure the safety, health and wellbeing of all employees and visitors. Who You Are:
• Tertiary biomedical engineering or equivalent qualification with 3+ years of experience in field services engineering, ideally with specialist Mass Spectrometry knowledge and hands-on experience.
• Experience with Lab IT and middleware systems.
• Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple projects.
• Availability to travel locally, regionally, nationally and internationally as required.
• Able to build and maintain strong internal and external partnerships
• Exhibit a passion for digital transformation and process enhancem

Vous serez : En tant que spécialiste des processus opérationnels mondiaux Conformité financière – Vous serez responsable des approbations suivantes :
• Maintenance et exécution des processus : Appuyer la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de gestion des processus opérationnels E2E (BPM) dans le domaine des approbations financières mondiales et de la délégation de pouvoirs.
• Configuration multiplateforme : assurer le fonctionnement du moteur d'approbation financière dans un réseau intégré de systèmes d'appel, y compris myBuy, SAP S/4HANA, Fieldglass et MeetingSelect.

• Suivi des processus et établissement de rapports : Revoir régulièrement les paramètres de performance des processus (p. ex., délais d'exécution des systèmes, exceptions au flux de travail) afin d'identifier les domaines à améliorer en permanence et d'optimiser le maigre. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui est motivé par lui-même, qui est vraiment passionné par son travail et qui comprend que la prestation d'un service de haute qualité est cruciale pour l'organisation. Afin de fournir des solutions de santé innovantes à nos patients, nous avons besoin des meilleurs talents de notre organisation. En tant que membre idéal de l'équipe, vous êtes ouvert d'esprit, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert à un développement constant. De plus, vous auriez :
• Baccalauréat en finance, administration des affaires, informatique, ingénierie ou une formation comparable . 5-7 ans d'expérience professionnelle, de préférence en gestion des processus d'affaires, gestion de l'information / TI, finances / achats, gestion des risques / contrôle interne, comptabilité, audit
• Une connaissance solide des processus dans les flux de travail financiers et d'approvisionnement de bout en bout, avec une expérience pratique ou une forte connaissance technique de SAP FI/CO ou SAP S/4HANA. Compétences méthodologiques éprouvées en amélioration continue et en gestion des processus (p. ex. BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) et expérience de travail dans un cadre agile (SAFe/Scrum).
• Excellente collaboration, communication et influence des compétences pour gérer efficacement les besoins des acteurs financiers locaux, des acteurs mondiaux et des équipes modèles mondiales. Une pensée analytique forte et un état d'esprit innovant pour stimuler l'amélioration des processus créatifs, jumelé w

The Portfolio Management team works as part of the Portfolio and Project Management group to help each of these areas track and manage their portfolio from a strategic vantage point. Cross-Portfolio Managers work closely with colleagues from the broader Portfolio Management team including our Business Insights & Analytics Maangers to to develop tools and derive insights relevant for effective portfolio management. • You work closely with Customer Area Portfolio Managers, Business Analytics & Insights Managers, Project Managers and Finance to drive portfolio transparency and generate relevant portfolio insights for decision making
• You improve available portfolio tools and generate relevant reports to support strategic portfolio management
• You ensure excellent portfolio management by placing individual portfolio decisions in the context of the broader pipeline
• You enable overview of critical portfolio interdependencies
• You lead dedicated strategy initiatives across and within the different Roche Diagnostics customer areas
• You maintain expert knowledge of industry trends, competition, and current/emerging technologies to guide overall portfolio management
• You coach other members of the team, develop new skills and provide ongoing, constructive feedback on performance and progress toward goals and expectations Who you are
• You hold an advanced degree in life sciences, medicine, or business (ideally a PhD, MD, or MBA)

• You have a proven track record of influencing and presenting complex strategic topics to senior management and key stakeholders

• You are skilled at distilling complex or abstract problems into succinct strategic frameworks and tactical plans

• You can clearly articulate critical analytical findings to senior leadership and drug development teams

The Position We are currently seeking a Finance Enterprise Partner to join our team at Roche Diagnostics Austria. As an FEP (Finance Enterprise Partner) you leverage your in-depth business understanding combined with financial expertise in driving initiatives forward that are critical to delivering our commercial strategy. The FEP builds networks across the organisation to share best practices and co-create solutions that generate value for the affiliate, the enterprise and the customer. As an FEP, you are a trusted thought partner to business stakeholders and have close contact with customers, where you will ensure efficient resource allocation and maximum impact along the customer journey. Main Responsibilities
• Strategic Partnership: Serve as a key business partner, co-leading customer journey touchpoints with an enterprise-wide mindset.
• Financial Advisory: Balance resource allocation across competing priorities and advise on the financial impact of business initiatives.
• Commercial Strategy: Collaborate on developing affiliate strategies, business planning, and creative revenue-generation models.
• Knowledge Sharing: Engage with FEP communities to adopt and implement global best practices locally.
• P&L Optimization: Drive profitability by identifying upsell opportunities, reducing risks, and improving operational efficiency.
• Executive Communication: Translate complex financial data into compelling "storyboard" presentations for executive decision-making.
• Culture & Collaboration: Lead and facilitate cross-functional workshops and events to strengthen team engagement.
• Process Innovation: Apply end-to-end thinking to radically simplify workflows, from deal calculation to contract monitoring. Competencies
• Commercial and customer centric mindset with an ability to put all available financial and operational information into a holistic picture.
• Understanding of Corporate Finance, Financial Modelling, Insights Collection & Trend Prognosis.
• Understanding of data modeling to guide decision-making, solve problems, provide analytical insight and business judgment to support strategic and tactical initiatives across the affiliate.
• Strategic thinking and ability to translate business goals into financial plans.
• High level of social competence and ability to accurately record and efficiently communicate in English. (German is a plus but not a must)
• You have 2-5 years of experience in finance (ideally in a sales-focused or commercial role) and are familiar with SAP or equivalent ERP systems We offer a gross salary starting at € 56.000 per year and attractive benefits. • Expérience dans une organisation de lumière bleue
• Volonté pour des changements flexibles
• Excellentes manières et convivialité dans les rapports avec les invités ainsi qu'une compréhension technique et un œil de contrôle
• Fiabilité et discrétion absolues, ainsi qu'une réputation impeccable et la volonté de travailler pour changer les heures de travail
• Compétences de communication et d'équipe ainsi que la résilience même sous une pression accrue

Ensuite, veuillez télécharger vos documents de candidature complets (le curriculum vitæ, les certificats d'études et d'emploi ainsi qu'une lettre de motivation significative) sur notre portail. Un casier judiciaire impeccable est une condition préalable à l'emploi et est demandé au cours de la suite du processus de demande. Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature! Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur à chances égales.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. Position Overview: As Project Enablement Manager, you will be part of an in-house project management pool, reporting to the Chapter Lead Project Enablement, and accountable for delivering project services and deliverables within your area of expertise, supporting DDA Insights and Analytics initiatives through structured execution, cross-functional coordination, and transparent reporting to ensure timely delivery and alignment with organizational priorities. The Opportunity:
• Oversee end-to-end project and program management across multiple Insights and Analytics initiatives, ensuring clear definition, sequencing, tracking, and achievement of objectives, milestones, and success criteria.
• Drive execution by coordinating cross-functional teams (product owners, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders), ensuring alignment across workstreams and program priorities.
• Maintain and evolve integrated dashboards, timelines, and reporting frameworks to provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and overall program health.
• Proactively manage risks, issues, and interdependencies across initiatives, ensuring timely escalation and resolution to support on-time delivery and continuity across project phases.
• Enable scalable and consistent delivery by establishing governance models and execution frameworks and facilitating stakeholder alignment through structured working sessions, clear communication, and effective decision tracking. Who you are:
• Apply and tailor methodologies, tools, and techniques (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid, Design Thinking, and Lean) to solve complex business problems, including leading pre-project phases and developing qualitative and quantitative business cases.
• Demonstrate strong project and program management expertise, including facilitation of sprints, stakeholder workshops, and cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to manage ambiguity and calculated risks.
• Operate as an enterprise and systems thinker, identifying interdependencies, risks, and synergies across projects and portfolios while ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives.
• Leverage data-driven decision-making through performance measurement, gap analysis, and insights generation, maintaining clear documentation, reporting standards, and best practices for transparency and continuity.
• Bring a bachelor’s degree in business or related fields with 5–7 years of experience, strong stakeholder management and communication skills, experience in complex environments, and familiarity with organizational change management and cross-functional delivery models. Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position As an IT Business Analyst, you will act as a crucial catalyst for our digital transformation, empowering effective decision-making and continuous improvement across our end-to-end quality operations You will join a forward-thinking, collaborative team dedicated to creating and implementing robust IT infrastructure solutions that directly enable high-performing business processes. This unique role allows you to serve as an ambassador for digitization, turning complex challenges into streamlined, user-friendly solutions that ensure the highest standards of product quality and regulatory compliance. The Opportunity:
• Drive comprehensive business analysis to outline problems, identify opportunities, and deliver pragmatic software solutions to process owners
• Implement and maintain critical quality management tools—such as the Global List of Approved Suppliers and Supplier Risk Scorecards—while performing necessary testing and validation
• Design visually engaging training documentation by translating and mapping complex business processes to ensure cross-functional stakeholder alignment
• Champion lean and agile ways of working by supporting process owners in troubleshooting issues and enhancing overall reliability and simplicity
• Analyze large data sets to evaluate existing databases, extracting actionable insights that support external quality decisions and supplier-customer relationships
• Act as an organizational change agent and digitization ambassador, proactively identifying, applying sound judgment to, and escalating potential quality or regulatory issues Who You Are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Sciences (such as Pharmacy or Chemistry), or possess equivalent professional experience
• You have demonstrated experience managing large datasets, utilizing advanced computer skills including Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and data visualization software like Tableau
• You possess an agile, analytical mindset with a proven ability to synthesize complex topics into clear, pragmatic overviews and actionable recommendations
• You are an exceptional communicator and quick thinker with strong organizational and time-management skills, allowing you to effectively collaborate with diverse teams
• You bring a strong foundation in problem-solving and IT infrastructure, with any additional knowledge of Python and R being a distinct advantage for this 12-month opportunity. Additional Information:
• Duration: This is a 12-month position.
• Location: Based in Mississauga, Ontario. Our team follows a hybrid work structure requiring the majority of time in the office.
• Full time (35 hours per week). This position is not eligible for relocation support. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams. Your tasks and Responsibilities
• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.
• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.
• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.
• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness. Who you are
• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.
• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.
• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.
• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position Impacto sostenible Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones. La Oportunidad La posición de Coordinador de Almacén lidera la operación segura y eficiente del área de reacondicionamiento como soporte clave del Line Manager. Responsable de garantizar el cumplimiento del cronograma, los niveles de servicio y los estándares de calidad (BPA, BPM, BPD) mediante la supervisión autónoma del desempeño del equipo. Responsabilidades
• Gestión de Equipos y Recursos: Coordinar y asignar tareas, personal (interno y subcontratado), equipos y tiempos en el área de Reacondicionamiento para garantizar la productividad y la ejecución oportuna de los pedidos.
• Aseguramiento de Calidad y GxP: Verificar el cumplimiento irrestricto de las Buenas Prácticas (GxP/BPA) y los estándares de seguridad en todos los procesos y colaboradores bajo su responsabilidad.
• Gestión de Desviaciones y CAPA: Soportar el Sistema de Gestión de Calidad (SGC) mediante la documentación, investigación y análisis de desviaciones, incidentes o eventos operacionales, proponiendo y ejecutando acciones correctivas y preventivas (CAPA).
• Control Documental y Capacitación: Revisar y actualizar los Procedimientos Operativos Estándar (SOP) y asegurar que todo el personal a su cargo cumpla con los entrenamientos técnicos y normativos requeridos.
• Monitoreo y Mejora Continua: Evaluar la eficiencia y el desempeño de las operaciones para proponer e implementar proactivamente proyectos de mejora continua que optimicen el flujo de trabajo y el uso de recursos. Quién Eres
• Profesional graduado o en etapa final de carrera en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas o afines, con dominio de inglés intermedio-avanzado (conversación, lectura y redacción técnica).
• Trayectoria previa en operaciones de manufactura o logística, idealmente en roles de coordinación como Líder de Línea o Supervisor de Producción.
• Dominio requerido de SAP EWM (gestión de almacenes), análisis de datos y manejo de herramientas informáticas (hojas de cálculo); conocimiento en Gestión de Proyectos es deseable.
• Conocimiento sólido y requerido en Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura, Almacenamiento y Distribución de Productos Farmacéuticos (BPM/BPA/BPD), así como en Seguridad y Salud Ocupacional.
• Dominio de metodologías Lean Manufacturing , Six Sigma y herramientas de Análisis de Causa Raíz (RCA). Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Purpose The PSM is accountable for the end to end strategy, design, execution, monitoring, shut down (as necessary) and overall success of Patient Support Programs (PSPs) in alignment with the squad/therapeutic area strategy. In this role, the PSM will be a key partner to the squads, responsible for translating the Therapeutic Area/Brand Strategy into a comprehensive PSP Strategy. This accountability spans the entire program lifecycle, from managing the initial setup and implementation with relevant vendors to proactively driving the performance, efficiency, and continuous improvement of all active PSPs. The PSM will rigorously monitor programs to ensure optimal patient uptake and access, deliver a best-in-class customer/patient experience, and champion robust data collection to generate actionable insights. This is all conducted while maintaining strict oversight to ensure all PSPs are compliant, effective, and adhere to all contractual/financial agreements. The PSM will also be responsible, when required, for developing and executing a PSP shutdown strategy. The PSM will work closely with the PSP Excellence Lead on implementing best practices, process improvements, vendor management, etc. The Opportunity: PSP Strategy, Design & Shut Down
• Lead the end-to-end strategy, design, execution, and overall success of Patient Support Programs (PSPs) in alignment with therapeutic area and squad strategies.
• Partner closely with squads to translate complex disease area and product strategies into comprehensive PSP strategies.
• Consult and collaborate with external customers and patients to design best-in-class programs that optimize patient uptake, access, and overall experience.
• Develop and execute strategic PSP shutdown strategies when required by the product lifecycle. Data, Digitalization & Monitoring
• Act as the primary source for analytics and insights generation, providing actionable data to inform key stakeholder decisions and ensure program optimization.
• Identify, generate, and facilitate Real-World Evidence (RWE) to continuously improve the patient and customer journey.
• Implement advanced digitalization solutions, automation, and technology (including AI) to drive operational efficiencies and experiential excellence.
• Lead rigorous program monitoring and regular business reviews with vendors and cross-functional partners to track KPIs, SLAs, and financial metrics (budgets, forecasts, invoices). Compliance & Stakeholder Collaboration
• Maintain strict oversight to ensure all active programs are fully compliant, adhere to SOPs, and remain financially sustainable.
• Collaborate seamlessly with internal teams (commercial, medical, legal, compliance, finance) and external vendors to resolve issues and manage contractual changes.
• Work closely with the PSP Excellence Lead to champion and scale best practices and process improvements across the portfolio. Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare, or a Life Science-related field; a Master’s degree is considered an asset.
• You possess 5+ years of relevant PSP (including reimbursement) experience alongside 5+ years of experience within the Healthcare and/or Pharmaceutical industry .
• Demonstrated experience successfully leading complex programs, managing large operating budgets, and steering vendor relationships.
• Strong business acumen with proven capabilities in strategic visioning, financial management, and end-to-end strategy

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Da Roche puoi mostrarti come te stesso, accolto per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei valorizzato, accettato e rispettato per ciò che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La Posizione Nel nostro Centro Regionale di Assistenza Clienti (RCSC), supportiamo clienti provenienti da laboratori diagnostici e ospedali in diversi paesi europei con questioni tecniche, applicative e IT relative ai sistemi diagnostici in vitro di Roche. In questo ruolo, il tuo focus sarà sull'interfaccia tra diagnostica molecolare, processi di laboratorio e sistemi IT. In particolare, fornirai supporto in argomenti come la connessione LIS, la connettività, il middleware e i flussi di lavoro di laboratorio digitale. Per il nostro RCSC internazionale cerchiamo un Junior Application Specialist (m/f/d) a Mannheim (DE), Almere (NL) o Vilvoorde (BE). Mansioni - Elaborazione delle richieste di clienti relative ad applicazioni e sistemi - Supporto nell'analisi di problemi nell'interazione tra sistemi diagnostici, IT di laboratorio e processi clienti - Collaborazione su soluzioni per problemi di connettività e interfaccia, ad esempio nell'ambiente di LIS, middleware e connettività remota - Documentazione attenta di casi e soluzioni nel sistema CRM - Implementazione di formazione per clienti e dipendenti - Preparazione e trasferimento di prodotto e comunicazione Informazioni rilevanti per il sistema - Supporto occasionale dei colleghi del servizio sul campo durante incarichi nel laboratorio del cliente
• Requisiti - Parli e scrivi fluentemente in olandese e inglese. Tedesco, turco o greco sono un vantaggio. - Hai una laurea, idealmente in biologia molecolare, biochimica, informatica medica, ingegneria biomedica o una disciplina comparabile. In alternativa, hai una formazione scientifica o medico-tecnica e vorresti svilupparti ulteriormente in un ambiente applicativo e informatico. - Hai conoscenze iniziali o un forte interesse nel campo della diagnostica molecolare. - Ti piacciono i contesti tecnici e hai una forte affinità per l'IT. - Idealmente, hai già ottenuto il primo contatto con LIS, IT di laboratorio, middleware, connettività o integrazioni di sistema. - Ti piace lavorare con sistemi complessi e affrontare le questioni in modo strutturato e orientato alla soluzione. - Sei caratterizzato da orientamento al cliente, forti capacità comunicative e spirito di squadra. - Vivi vicino a Mannheim, Almere o Vilvoorde e sei disposto a viaggiare regolarmente a Mannheim. Candidatura - Vi chiediamo i seguenti documenti: CV attuale. Al momento non sono assolutamente necessari ulteriori documenti. - Prima di inviare la domanda, si prega di notare che non possono essere aggiunti ulteriori documenti successivamente. Informazioni aggiuntive Quando è richiesta trasparenza salariale, forniamo le informazioni in base alla posizione principale del lavoro. La sede principale di questa posizione è Mannheim. Se sei interessato a un'altra sede dove la posizione potrebbe essere disponibile, ti forniremo le informazioni salariali rilevanti nel corso successivo del processo di candidatura. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a far avanzare la scienza, garantendo a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a oltre 26 milioni di persone curate ogni anno. Contatta: il tuo contatto con noi! Con le persone. Per le persone. - Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto? Consulta le FAQ su https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

The Position Department In our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC), we support customers from diagnostic laboratories and hospitals in several European countries with technical, application, and IT-related questions regarding Roche in-vitro diagnostic systems. In this role, your focus is at the interface of molecular diagnostics, laboratory processes, and IT systems. You will provide support particularly on topics such as LIS connection, connectivity, middleware, and digital laboratory workflows. For our international RCSC, we are looking for a Junior Application/Technical Specialist (m/f/d) based in Mannheim (DE), Almere (NL) or Vilvoorde (BE). Your key responsibilities
• Handling application-related, technical, and system-related customer inquiries
• supporting the analysis of issues involving diagnostic systems, laboratory IT and customer workflows
• contributing to solutions for connectivity and interface topics, for example in the areas of LIS, middleware and remote connectivity
• carefully documenting cases and solutions in the CRM system
• delivering customer and employee trainings
• preparing and sharing product- and system-related information
• occasionally supporting field service colleagues during on-site visits to customer laboratories Who you are
• You speak and write fluently in both Dutch and English. German, Turkish or Greek would be an advantage but not a must.
• You hold a university degree, ideally in molecular biology, biochemistry, medical informatics, medical technology, or medical engineering, or a comparable field of study. Alternatively, you have a scientific or medical-technical background and are looking to grow in an application-focused and IT-related environment.
• You bring initial knowledge or a strong interest in molecular biology.
• You enjoy technical topics and have a strong affinity for IT.
• Ideally, you have had first exposure to LIS, laboratory IT, middleware, connectivity or system integration.
• You enjoy working with complex systems and approach challenges in a structured and solution-oriented way.
• You are customer-focused, communicative and a strong team player.
• You live close to Mannheim, Almere, or Vilvoorde and are willing to travel regularly
• to Mannheim. Application documents To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only your updated CV. References and certificates are not required at this stage. Descrizione Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer tel que vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l’expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où l’on est valorisé, accepté et respecté pour ce qu’on est, ce qui vous permet de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies, et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Dans notre Centre régional de support client (RCSC), nous soutenons les clients issus de laboratoires de diagnostic et d’hôpitaux dans plusieurs pays européens sur des questions techniques, applicatives et informatiques liées aux systèmes de diagnostic in vitro de Roche. Dans ce rôle, votre priorité sera portée sur l’interface entre le diagnostic moléculaire, les processus de laboratoire et les systèmes informatiques. En particulier, vous apporterez un soutien sur des sujets tels que la connexion LIS, la connectivité, le middleware et les workflows de laboratoires numériques. Par il nostro RCSC internazionale cerchiamo un Junior Application Specialist (m/f/d) a Mannheim (DE), Almere (NL) ou Vilvoorde (BE). Mansioni - Traitement des demandes clients liées aux applications et systèmes - Soutien à l’analyse des problèmes liés à l’interaction des systèmes de diagnostic, de l’informatique de laboratoire et des processus clients - Collaboration sur des solutions pour les problèmes de connectivité et d’interface, par exemple dans l’environnement de SIL, middleware et connectivité à distance - Documentation minutieuse des cas et solutions dans le système CRM - Mise en œuvre de formations clients et employés - Préparation et transfert de produits et de communication Informations pertinentes pour le système - Soutien occasionnel des collègues de service de terrain lors de missions dans le laboratoire client
• Requirements - Vous parlez et écrivez couramment en néerlandais et en anglais. L’allemand, le turc ou le grec sont un plus. - Vous avez un diplôme, idéalement en biologie moléculaire, biochimie, informatique médicale, génie biomédical ou dans une discipline similaire. Sinon, vous avez une formation scientifique ou médico-technique et souhaitez vous développer davantage dans un environnement applicatif et lié à l’informatique. - Vous avez des connaissances initiales ou un intérêt marqué pour le domaine du diagnostic moléculaire. - Vous aimez les contextes techniques et avez une forte affinité pour l’informatique. - Idéalement, vous avez déjà obtenu un premier contact avec le LIS, l’informatique de laboratoire, le middleware, la connectivité ou les intégrations système. - Vous aimez travailler avec des systèmes complexes et aborder les problèmes de manière structurée et orientée vers la solution. - Vous vous caractérisez par une orientation client, de solides compétences en communication et un esprit d’équipe. - Vous habitez près de Mannheim, Almere ou Vilvoorde et êtes prêt à vous déplacer régulièrement à Mannheim. Candidature - Nous vous demandons les documents suivants : CV actuel. D’autres documents ne sont pas absolument requis pour le moment. - Avant d’envoyer la demande, veuillez noter qu’aucun autre document ne pourra être ajouté par la suite. Informations aggiuntive Lorsque la transparence salariale est requise, nous fournissons les informations en fonction de la localisation principale du poste. Le principal emplacement de ce poste est Mannheim. Si vous êtes intéressé par un autre lieu où le poste pourrait également être disponible, nous vous fournirons les informations pertinentes sur le salaire lors de la suite du processus de candidature. Chi siamo Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dévoués à faire progresser la science, garantissant à tous l’accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts permettent de traiter plus de 26 millions de personnes chaque année. Contactez votre contact avec nous ! Avec des gens. Pour les gens. - Hai besoin di oculte supporto ? Consulte le FAQ su https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Cybersecurity Analyst investigates security incidents, performs vulnerability assessments, and contributes to improving security operations You will be capable of independent work on defined tasks, independently handling less complex tasks and contributing to various stages of the analysis lifecycle By taking ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible security solutions, you will proactively identify solution-level issues and maintain a mindset of continuous improvement within the security domain Description of the area Job Responsibilities Scope
• Lead Privileged Access tools CyberArk SelfHosted & SaaS feature implementation, integration and automation. Provide consultations with stakeholders to identify security requirements, provide systems integrations, record and develop roadmap and implementation plans for strategic initiatives.
• Actively work in an enterprise environment as part of the Privileged Access Management (PAM) team to collectively manage, automate and improve the PAM capabilities for business users and security staff.
• Promptly respond to product needs and customer requests, implementing changes and enhancements.
• Support and provide evidence for audits and compliance reviews teams.
• Actively focus on self-development and create actionable plans to grow.
• Occasional international travel is required.
• Independently handles less complex tasks and provides input to solution design by defining and managing requirements for small-scale problem areas
• Focuses on understanding the problem domain, recommending solution options, and proactively identifying solution-level issues, gaps, or inefficiencies to improve products or processes Accountability/Problem Solving
• Participate and lead troubleshooting efforts as part of 2nd or 3rd level support duties.
• Provide 24x7 on-call support for major and critical issues, demonstrating flexibility regarding working hours.
• Takes ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible solutions for specific features or components
• Independently analyzes less complex security technical problems, defines problem scope, contributes to identifying root causes, and provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems
• Evaluates change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, diagnoses gaps, and applies analytical and logical reasoning independently to identify discrepancies and challenge assumptions Stakeholder Management
• Identifies key business, technical, and security stakeholders for assigned tasks, analyzing their needs and interests regarding security posture and risk
• Primarily interacts within security product teams/squads and across Security Operations functions, while establishing rapport and managing realistic security expectations
• Develops and delivers tailored communication for security tasks and incident updates, facilitates meetings, and proactively engages with stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and validate security requirements Impact/Strategy
• Contributes to projects or workgroups by providing well-analyzed requirements and supporting the design of solutions that align with business objectives within their specified area
• Demonstrates growing autonomy and expertise within their specific domain by translating requirements into a strategic plan with supervision, and may identify opportunities for minor process improvements within their immediate scope Complexity
• Works

You ensure customer centric approach, by being clear on customer needs, promoting customer propositions at all levels. • You hold a BSc in Medical Science, Biomedical Engineering or similar
• You possess a commercial experience in the medical industry with a demonstrated account management experience
• You have excellent communication skills
• You are able to manage stakeholders
• You possess a high strategic mindset
• You have the ability of managing complexity and adapting to different situations
• You demonstrate Excellent Command of English language Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position As a senior team member within the Talent Acquisition group, you will foster a team environment and demonstrate collaborative leadership. You will partner with TA colleagues, Human Resource Business Partners, clients and Talent Acquisition Management to develop and implement staffing plans and strategies. The Opportunity: As a Senior Talent Partner, you will partner with hiring managers and senior management in the full lifecycle recruitment of talent in the Americas- individually managing a portfolio of requisitions and focusing on meeting and exceeding hiring manager's expectations and ensuring a positive candidate experience. Your responsibilities include:
• Strategic Recruitment: Drive hiring processes and develop complex recruiting strategies within assigned requisitions and organizations.
• Full Lifecycle Execution: Recruit talent by sourcing, reviewing applications, screening candidates, and processing offers within Workday.
• Consultative Coaching: Manage stakeholder expectations and coach managers on providing feedback, developing offers, and determining competencies.
• Process Innovation: Contribute to staffing process improvements and ensure recruiting solutions remain consistent with Corporate Talent Acquisition objectives.

Continually assesses daily process flows with the goal of implementing improvements to increase efficiency, improve customer experience, and meet the Supply Chain “On Time and In Full” (OTIF) KPIs. Collaborates and aligns with manager on direction and improvement of team processes to ensure objectives, timelines, and all requirements are achieved (including but not limited to local, regional, & global regulations, finance, tax, safety, environmental, transportation, Customs, and internal company standard requirements). Devotes a significant amount of time to leading employees, overseeing both the day-to-day operations and long term goals for assigned team. Provides feedback to the manager on employees' work performance and has input into employment decisions. Responsible for managing to a prescribed budget, training and development of staff, resource management, work assignments, interprets and ensures consistent application of organizational policies. Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. Demonstrate strong customer focused skills. May have responsibilities that covers multiple shifts, warehouses and/or team leads. Responsible for hiring and onboarding of new employees. What You Do:
• Lead shift activities across Inbound and Storage operations, driving inventory replenishment efforts for effective global distribution while ensuring the proper handling of sensitive materials.
• Participate in project teams as both a functional subject matter expert and an operational representative to drive site logistics success.
• Maintain hands-on operational agility by mastering the functional responsibilities of the team, ensuring the ability to step in and support daily business continuity when needed.
• Collaborate with management and key stakeholders to align daily execution with broader organizational requirements, milestones, and strategic goals.
• Develop and monitor operational KPIs to ensure optimal team performance, inventory accuracy, and workflow efficiency.
• Schedule: 1st Shift, Monday through Friday, 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM Who You Are:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Science, Technology, Supply Chain, or a related field (or 4 years of related experience while actively pursuing a degree).
• Demonstrated leadership skills in managing key project objectives to achieve high-level organizational benefits and continuous improvement.
• Excellent communication (oral and written), interpersonal, and organizational skills.
• Proficient with Google Workspace/Office Suite and analytical tools. Preferred Experience:
• 2+ years of supervisory or leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to motivate teams and foster collaboration.
• Experience with SAP, EWM, and other warehouse management systems (WMS).
• Strong cultural awareness and the ability to work effectively across multi-cultural and cross-functional teams.
• Customer service-oriented with the ability to support clients within a complex, global, and regulated environment.

La posizione Stiamo cercando un Principal Test Automation Engineer (IA - primo ) di possedere la strategia di ingegneria di qualità e l'automazione per il nostro prodotto di screening prenatale di campo verde - una soluzione diagnostica clinica regolamentata per la trisomia del primo trimestre e la valutazione del rischio preeclampsia. Questa non è una tela vuota: gli obblighi di qualità e di tracciabilità sono integrati nella fondazione dal primo giorno. Man mano che la piattaforma matura, potrebbe esserci l'opportunità di espandere ulteriormente la tua portata all'interno del portafoglio. Questo non è un ruolo di gestione QA - è un ruolo di ingegneria pratico. Come contributore individuale di livello principale, creerai automazione, defini e applica gli standard, istituirai i quadri di base, e incorpora la qualità nel flusso di lavoro di ingegneria quotidiana - lavorando con l'intero team attraverso la revisione del codice, l'utensile e la guida tecnica. Si applicheranno gli approcci di tooling AI e test agentic per consentire la qualità sostenibile in scala, in un ambiente in cui la qualità del software è un requisito di sicurezza del paziente. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità:
• Progettare e implementare una strategia di test basata sul rischio, a strati - minimizzare il rischio attraverso la copertura attraverso test di unità, integrazione e API, riservando l'automazione E2E per i viaggi di utenti critici
• Utilizzare gli strumenti AI come driver primario di qualità - generazione di test agentic, analisi di copertura assistita da AI, automazione resiliente e manutenbile. Spostare l'equilibrio dallo sforzo di test manuale all'automazione intelligente e scalabile
• Pratica di ingegneria della qualità della forma attraverso il portafoglio soluzioni diagnostiche definendo standard condivisi, modelli e strumenti che sollevano la barra di qualità al di là della squadra di prodotto immediata
• Definire e applicare standard di prova, modelli e best practice, consentendo agli sviluppatori di possedere qualità come parte del flusso di lavoro quotidiano
• Bootstrap e definire modelli di automazione Playwright e implementazioni di riferimento che i team di sviluppo adottano e si estende
• Integrare i test nelle tubazioni CI/CD per un feedback veloce e affidabile su ogni commit
• Sostenere il team nel soddisfare gli obblighi di qualità del software medico contribuendo a tracciabilità, verificabilità e processi di conformità
• Valutare e adottare selettivamente strumenti di test basati su AI applicabili al software sanitario regolamentato Chi sei? Il “AI-first” Mindset Oltre alla padronanza tecnica, apprezziamo gli ingegneri di qualità che trattano l'IA come partner principale nel loro flusso di lavoro:
• Testazione Agentica: consentire ai team di sfruttare gli agenti dell'IA di automatizzare i compiti di qualità di routine, ad esempio la generazione di test, il triage di guasto, la manutenzione di test sfacciata, quindi lo sforzo di ingegneria si concentra su ciò che richiede il giudizio umano.
• Ottimizzazione SDLC: l'utilizzo di strumenti AI (Claude Code, Cursor o equivalente) per accelerare la progettazione di test, l'analisi della copertura e i miglioramenti della pipeline di qualità.
• Consapevolezza regolamentata: Capire che gli artefatti di prova generati dall'IA in un contesto software medico richiedono la validazione, la tracciabilità e la supervisione umana - e la costruzione che nel flusso di lavoro dall'inizio. Competenze tecniche:
• Profonda comprensione dei progetti di strategia di test - testare il pensiero piramidale, pratiche a turni, strategie di isolamento di prova, parallelismo di prova, parametrizzazione
• Esperienza pratica con test altamente scalabili
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a Principal Test Automation Engineer ( AI - first ) to own quality engineering strategy and automation for our greenfield Prenatal Screening product - a regulated clinical diagnostic solution for first-trimester trisomy and preeclampsia risk assessment. This is not a blank canvas: quality and traceability obligations are built into the foundation from day one. As the platform matures, there may be an opportunity to expand your scope further within the portfolio. This is not a QA management role - it is a hands-on engineering role. As a Principal-level individual contributor, you will create automations, define and enforce the standards, establish the foundational frameworks, and embed quality into the daily engineering workflow - working with the whole team through code review, tooling and technical guidance. You will apply AI tooling and agentic testing approaches to enable sustainable quality at scale, in an environment where software quality is a patient safety requirement. At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events. The Opportunity:
• Design and implement a risk-based, layered testing strategy - minimizing risk by coverage through unit, integration and API tests, reserving E2E automation for critical user journeys
• Use AI tooling as a primary driver of quality - agentic test generation, AI-assisted coverage analysis, resilient and maintainable automation. Shifting the balance from manual testing effort to intelligent, scalable automation
• Shape quality engineering practices across the diagnostic solutions portfolio by defining shared standards, patterns, and tooling that raise the quality bar beyond the immediate product squad
• Define and enforce testing standards, patterns, and best practices, enabling developers to own quality as part of their everyday workflow
• Bootstrap and define Playwright automation patterns and reference implementations that the development teams adopt and extends
• Integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines for fast, reliable feedback on every commit
• Support the team in meeting medical software quality obligations by contributing to traceability, auditability and compliance processes
• Evaluate and selectively adopt AI-driven testing tools applicable to regulated healthcare software Who You Are: The “AI-first” Mindset Beyond technical mastery, we value quality engineers who treat AI as a core partner in their workflow:
• Agentic Testing: Enabling teams in leveraging AI agents to automate routine quality tasks, e.g. test generation, failure triage, flaky test maintenance, so engineering effort focuses on what requires human judgment.
• SDLC Optimization: Using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) to accelerate test design, coverage analysis, and quality pipeline improvements.
• Regulated Awareness: Understanding that AI-generated test artifacts in a medical software context require validation, traceability, and human oversight - and building that into the workflow from the start. Technical skills:
• Deep understanding of testing strategy designs - test pyramid thinking, shift-left practices, test isolation strategies, test parallelism, parametrization
• Hands-on experience with highly scalable testing

Als Principal-Level-Individuum erstellen Sie Automatisierungen, definieren und durchsetzen die Standards, etablieren die Grundlagen und Embed-Qualität in den täglichen Engineering-Workflow - die Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Team durch Code-Review, Tooling und technische Beratung. Sie werden KI-Tooling- und Agenten-Testansätze anwenden, um eine nachhaltige Qualität im Maßstab in einer Umgebung zu ermöglichen, in der Softwarequalität ein Patientensicherheitsbedarf ist. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Wir verlangen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter in unseren Büros durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Bedarf variieren, z.B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathause, Teamtreffen und andere kollaborative Veranstaltungen. Die Möglichkeit:
• Entwerfen und implementieren eine risikobasierte, geschichtete Teststrategie - Minimierung des Risikos durch Deckung durch Einheits-, Integrations- und API-Tests, Erhaltung der E2E-Automatisierung für kritische Nutzerfahrten
• Verwenden Sie KI-Tooling als primärer Treiber von Qualität - agentische Testgeneration, AI-gestützte Deckungsanalyse, widerstandsfähige und pflegefähige Automatisierung.
• Erstellen von Qualitäts-Engineering-Practice-Practice-Verfahren im gesamten diagnostischen Lösungen-Portfolio durch die Definition von gemeinsamen Standards, Mustern und Werkzeugen, die die Qualität Bar über die unmittelbare Produktgruppe erhöhen
• Definieren und Durchsetzung von Teststandards, Muster und Best Practices, so dass Entwickler eine eigene Qualität als Teil ihres täglichen Workflows
• Boots-Retrap und definieren Playwright-Automatisierungs-Prozesse
• SDLC-Optimierung: Verwendung von AI-Tools (Claude Code, Cursor oder gleichwertig) zur Beschleunigung von Testdesign, Deckungsanalyse und Qualitätspipeline Verbesserungen.
• Geregelte Awareness: Verstehen, dass KI-generierte Testartefakte in einem medizinischen Software-Kontext Validierung, Rückverfolgbarkeit und menschliche Aufsicht erfordern - und das Gebäude in den Workflow von Anfang an. Technische Fähigkeiten:
• Tiefes Verständnis der Teststrategie-Designs - Testpyramid Denken, Schicht-Link-Practice, Test Isolationsstrategien, Testparallelismus, Parametrierung
• Hands-on Erfahrung mit sehr skalierbaren Tests
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous recherchons un ingénieur principal d'automatisation des tests (IA - d'abord ) pour posséder la stratégie d'ingénierie de qualité et l'automatisation pour notre produit de dépistage prénatal de terrain vert - une solution de diagnostic clinique réglementée pour la trisomie de premier trimestre et l'évaluation des risques de prééclampsie. Ce n'est pas une toile blanche : les obligations de qualité et de traçabilité sont intégrées dans la fondation dès le premier jour. À mesure que la plateforme arrive à maturité, il peut y avoir une occasion d'élargir votre portée au sein du portefeuille. Ce n'est pas un rôle de gestion de l'AQ - c'est un rôle pratique d'ingénierie. En tant que contributeur individuel principal, vous créerez des automatismes, définirez et appliquerez les normes, établirez les cadres fondamentaux et intégrerez la qualité dans le flux de travail quotidien de l'ingénierie - en travaillant avec toute l'équipe par l'examen de code, l'outillage et l'orientation technique. Vous appliquerez des méthodes d'outils d'IA et de tests d'agents pour permettre une qualité durable à l'échelle, dans un environnement où la qualité des logiciels est une exigence de sécurité du patient. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. La possibilité :
• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie d'essais en couches basée sur les risques - minimiser les risques par la couverture par le biais de tests d'unités, d'intégration et d'API, réserver l'automatisation E2E pour les trajets critiques des utilisateurs
• Utiliser l'outil d'IA comme moteur principal de la qualité - génération de tests d'agents, analyse de couverture assistée par l'IA, automatisation résiliente et durable. Passer de l'effort d'essai manuel à l'automatisation intelligente et évolutive
• Des pratiques d'ingénierie de la qualité de la forme dans le portefeuille de solutions diagnostiques en définissant des normes, des modèles et des outils partagés qui élèvent la barre de qualité au-delà de l'équipe de produits immédiate
• Définir et faire respecter les normes, les modèles et les meilleures pratiques de test, permettant aux développeurs de posséder la qualité dans le cadre de leur travail quotidien
• Bootstrap et définir les modèles d'automatisation de Playwright et les implémentations de référence que les équipes de développement adoptent et prolongent
• Intégrer les essais dans les pipelines CI/CD pour obtenir une rétroaction rapide et fiable sur chaque engagement
• Aider l'équipe à s'acquitter de ses obligations en matière de qualité des logiciels médicaux en contribuant aux processus de traçabilité, d'audit et de conformité
• Évaluer et adopter de manière sélective les outils d'essai axés sur l'IA applicables aux logiciels de soins de santé réglementés Qui vous êtes : L'esprit d'initiative Au-delà de la maîtrise technique, nous valorisons les ingénieurs de qualité qui traitent l'IA comme un partenaire clé dans leur workflow:
• Tests d'agents: permettre aux équipes de tirer parti des agents d'IA pour automatiser les tâches de qualité courante, par exemple la génération d'essais, le triage d'échecs, la maintenance d'essais flasques.
• Optimisation SDLC : Utilisation d'outils AI (Claude Code, Cursor, ou équivalent) pour accélérer la conception des essais, l'analyse de couverture et l'amélioration des pipelines de qualité.
• Sensibilisation réglementée : comprendre que les artefacts d'essai générés par l'IA dans un contexte de logiciel médical exigent la validation, la traçabilité et la surveillance humaine - et intégrer cela dans le flux de travail dès le début. Compétences techniques:
• Compréhension approfondie des modèles de stratégie d'essai - réflexion sur la pyramide d'essai, pratiques à gauche, stratégies d'isolement d'essai, parallélisme d'essai, paramétrisation
• Expérience pratique avec des tests très évolutives

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Digital Campaign Delivery Intern in the Global Digital Hub, you support the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion. The Digital Campaign Delivery Intern will collaborate closely with the Campaign Delivery Specialists to support affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines. Responsibilities
• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.
• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.
• Incorporates feedback on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area
• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility Who you are You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse teams and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations. Further requirements
• Proficient in English and German language
• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University/college
• You are available at least 20-25 hours per week
• You are passionate about project management
• You're organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, with the ability to easily transition between multiple tasks and problem solve thoughtfully
• You have highly developed interpersonal and communication skills
• You are a quick learner, proactive, flexible and curious with an an innovative mind
• You are a strong team player with ability to work in a virtual team environment In exchange we provide you with: Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As the Legal & Compliance Manager at Roche Latvia Pharma Division , you will play a critical role in ensuring that our operations and business interactions comply with all relevant requirements and internal Roche policies, and will also support the organization in day-to-day legal matters. As the Legal & Compliance Manager at Roche Latvia Pharma Division, you will be:
• Strategic Partner: Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the fulfillment of all Roche divisional and local requirements.
• Role Model: Serve as a role model in ethical behavior and decision-making, promoting a culture of integrity and compliance across the organization.
• Strategic Influence: Drive compliance integration into business processes and decision-making.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work proactively with various departments to help them achieve their business goals in compliance with Roche policies and guidelines.
• Culture Building: Lead the development and nurturing of a robust compliance culture within the Roche Latvia Pharma organization to ensure business processes align with legal requirements and internal policies. Legal support: support Roche Latvia Pharma organization and Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster with day to day legal matters, which includes legal advice, drafting and reviewing contracts, etc. Compliance support to Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) Riga: you will extend, scale and apply compliance work done for Pharma also to the Roche Services & Solutions site in Riga (e.g. joint SOPs & training). Serve as Compliance Officer for RSS Riga and report to the Head of RSS Riga in this capacity. Key Compliance Responsibilities Under the oversight of and in collaboration with the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster, perform the following tasks in the Compliance Manager capacity:
• Guidance and Support: With a solution-oriented mindset, provide clear and actionable guidance to other departments to enable them to achieve their business goals in a compliant manner and in accordance with policies and guidelines. Escalate more complex inquiries to, and work with, the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster to address these.
• Global Standardization: Ensure adherence to Roche global standards such as the Code of Conduct and all Pharma Compliance-related Directives and guidelines, relevant Latvian legislation and local industry association Code of Ethics and any other relevant global and local regulations.
• Process Enhancement: Identify opportunities for efficiency in the compliance function and implement improvement initiatives. Develop compliance SOPs or policies and provide targeted training to employees. Strive for simplification & user-friendliness while maintaining a robust compliance system that adequately protects the organization’s license to operate and reputation.
• Strategic Risk Assessment: Identify, assess, and manage compliance risks associated with business operations, products, and services using data-driven approaches.
• Monitoring Activities: Conduct periodic monitoring activities, including spot checks and approvals, to confirm compliance with company policies.
• Comprehensive Training Programs: Design and deliver training on directives, guidelines, standards, and industry regulations. Customize training for different organizational levels. Conduct compliance onboarding training for new employees, tailored to their function and role.
• Promoting Compliance
