Legal support: support Roche Latvia Pharma organization and Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster with day to day legal matters, which includes legal advice, drafting and reviewing contracts, etc. Compliance support to Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) Riga: you will extend, scale and apply compliance work done for Pharma also to the Roche Services & Solutions site in Riga (e.g. joint SOPs & training). Serve as Compliance Officer for RSS Riga and report to the Head of RSS Riga in this capacity. Key Compliance Responsibilities Under the oversight of and in collaboration with the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster, perform the following tasks in the Compliance Manager capacity:
• Guidance and Support: With a solution-oriented mindset, provide clear and actionable guidance to other departments to enable them to achieve their business goals in a compliant manner and in accordance with policies and guidelines. Escalate more complex inquiries to, and work with, the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster to address these.
• Global Standardization: Ensure adherence to Roche global standards such as the Code of Conduct and all Pharma Compliance-related Directives and guidelines, relevant Latvian legislation and local industry association Code of Ethics and any other relevant global and local regulations.
• Process Enhancement: Identify opportunities for efficiency in the compliance function and implement improvement initiatives. Develop compliance SOPs or policies and provide targeted training to employees. Strive for simplification & user-friendliness while maintaining a robust compliance system that adequately protects the organization’s license to operate and reputation.
• Strategic Risk Assessment: Identify, assess, and manage compliance risks associated with business operations, products, and services using data-driven approaches.
• Monitoring Activities: Conduct periodic monitoring activities, including spot checks and approvals, to confirm compliance with company policies.
• Comprehensive Training Programs: Design and deliver training on directives, guidelines, standards, and industry regulations. Customize training for different organizational levels. Conduct compliance onboarding training for new employees, tailored to their function and role.
• Promoting Compliance

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Da Roche puoi mostrarti come te stesso, accolto per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei valorizzato, accettato e rispettato per ciò che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. L'organizzazione "Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst", parte della funzione globale di gruppo "Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites", fornisce l'infrastruttura e i servizi per l'intera sede di Basilea e Kaiseraugst e li sviluppa continuamente in modo innovativo. Lavoriamo con tutti gli stakeholder lungo tutta la catena del valore, dalla ricerca iniziale alla cura dei pazienti. Con noi, potrai aspettarti un modello organizzativo moderno in cui potrai mettere a disposizione i tuoi talenti in un lavoro significativo sotto la tua responsabilità. Garantiamo libertà creativa e di scelta nella nostra organizzazione. Non troverai superiori classici con noi. Il team "Energies and Media" garantisce l'implementazione affidabile e lo sviluppo ulteriore dei nostri sistemi esistenti e futuri nel sito di Kaiseraugst. Ti offriamo l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente al miglioramento e alla riprogettazione della nostra infrastruttura come stagista e di acquisire una conoscenza approfondita di GxP nel processo. Durante il tirocinio, lavorerai all'interfaccia tra l'ingegneria classica e la tecnologia all'avanguardia. Il tuo obiettivo è garantire un database coerente per i nostri sistemi multimediali nell'ambiente GMP. Mansioni - Ottimizzazione basata sull'IA: Nella tua valutazione, utilizzerai strumenti moderni di IA per rendere questi processi di abbinamento più efficienti e identificare le incongruenze dei dati. Inoltre, sosterrete l'uso e l'istituzione di strumenti di IA nel settore dell'ingegneria. - Miglioramento dei processi: parteciperai attivamente all'ottimizzazione degli asset infrastrutturali e dei processi per aumentare l'efficienza operativa. - Fasi di progettazione: ci supporterai nella concezione e nell'esecuzione del progetto all'interno di tutte le fasi di progettazione dell'ingegneria. - Audit dei punti di misurazione e confronto dati: Verificherai le designazioni dei punti di misurazione a diversi livelli di documentazione (diagrammi di flusso P&ID / diagrammi E / liste dei punti di misurazione / sistema di gestione degli edifici). - Gestione del ciclo di vita: sarai coinvolto nella creazione e nell'archiviazione di documenti ingegneristici (documentazione di fabbrica).
• Requisiti - Sei attualmente studente/ssa iscritto/a (Bachelor/Master) o hai concluso con successo gli studi in Ingegneria, Ingegneria di processo o discipline affini negli ultimi 12 mesi. - Alta affinità con i temi digitali e interesse per l'applicazione pratica di strumenti KI in ambito tecnico. - Approccio lavorativo accurato, strutturato e attento ai dettagli. - Entusiasmo per soluzioni di visualizzazione innovative (es. 3D-Scanning, Digital Twins). - Buone capacità comunicative per lo scambio in un team interdisciplinare. - Conoscenza fluente della lingua tedesca (scritto e parlato) è requisito indispensabile; Una buona conoscenza dell'inglese è un vantaggio. Processo di Candidatura - La data di inizio è il 1 settembre 2026 (100% del carico lavorativo), per una durata di 6 mesi. - Per essere considerata, la candidatura deve includere un curriculum vitae aggiornato e una lettera di motivazione. - I/le candidati/e non UE/non SEE devono allegare un certificato dell'università che attesti che il tirocinio è parte obbligatoria del percorso di studi. - La posizione offerta non è adatta per lo svolgimento di una tesi o di un lavoro di diploma. Contatto Pronto per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Chi siamo Chi siamo

• Das Startdatum ist 1. September 2026 (100% Pensum), für 6 Monate.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer tel que vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l’expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où l’on est valorisé, accepté et respecté pour ce qu’on est, ce qui vous permet de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies, et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. L’organisation « Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst », faisant partie de la fonction mondiale du groupe « Stratégie d’entreprise, durabilité & sites », fournit l’infrastructure et les services pour l’ensemble du site de Bâle et de Kaiseraugst et les développe continuellement de manière innovante. Nous travaillons avec toutes les parties prenantes tout au long de la chaîne de valeur, de la recherche précoce aux soins aux patients. Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à un modèle organisationnel moderne dans lequel vous pouvez apporter vos talents dans un travail significatif sur votre propre responsabilité. Nous garantissons la liberté créative et la liberté de choix dans notre organisation. Vous ne trouverez pas de supérieurs classiques chez nous. L’équipe « Énergies et médias » veille à la mise en œuvre fiable et au développement futur de nos systèmes actuels et futurs de site et énergétiques sur le site de Kaiseraugst. Nous vous offrons la possibilité de participer activement à l’amélioration et à la refonte de notre infrastructure en tant que stagiaire et d’acquérir une connaissance approfondie de GxP dans le processus. Pendant votre stage, vous travaillerez à l’interface entre l’ingénierie classique et la technologie de pointe. Votre objectif est d’assurer une base de données cohérente pour nos systèmes médias dans l’environnement GMP. Mansioni - Optimisation alimentée par l’IA : Dans votre évaluation, vous utiliserez des outils d’IA modernes pour rendre ces processus de correspondance plus efficaces et identifier les incohérences des données. De plus, vous soutiendrez l’utilisation et le développement d’outils d’IA dans le secteur de l’ingénierie. - Amélioration des processus : Vous participerez activement à l’optimisation des actifs et processus d’infrastructure afin d’accroître l’efficacité opérationnelle. - Phases de conception : Vous nous accompagnerez dans la conception et l’exécution du projet dans le cadre de toutes les phases de conception au sein de l’ingénierie. - Audit des points de comptage et comparaison des données : Vous vérifierez les désignations des points de mesure à différents niveaux de documentation (diagrammes de flux P&ID / diagrammes électroniques / listes de points de comptage / système de gestion de bâtiment). - Gestion du cycle de vie : Vous serez impliqué dans la création et le stockage des documents d’ingénierie (documentation d’usine).
• Requirements - Sei attualmente studente/ssa iscritto/a (Bachelor/Master) o hai conclu con successo gli studi in Ingegneria, Ingegneria di processo o discipline affini negli ultimi 12 mesi. - Alta affinità con i temi digitali e interesse per l’application pratica di strumenti KI in ambito tecnico. - Approccio lavorativo accurato, strutturato e attento ai dettagli. - Entusiasmo per solutions di visualizzazione innovative (es. 3D-Scanning, Digital Twins). - Buone capacità comunicative per lo scambio in un team interdisciplinare. - Conoscenza fluente della lingua tedesca (scritto e parlato) est requisito indispensabile ; Una buona conoscenza dell’anglais est un avantage. Processo di Candidatura - La data di inizio è il 1 settembre 2026 (100 % del carico lavorativo), per una durata di 6 mesi. - Per être considérée, la candidatura doit inclure un curriculum vitae aggiornato e una lettera di motivazione. - I/le candidati/e non UE/non SEE doivent allegare un certificato dell’università che attesti que il tirocinio est parte obbligatoria del percorso di studi. - La posizione offre non est adatta per lo svolgimento di una tesi o di un lavoro di diploma. Contact, prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte d’avoir de vos nouvelles avec impatience. Chi Siamo Qui sommes-nous

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Senior Data Management & Governance Specialist is a data-minded professional preferable with IT business operations and IT strategy & portfolio experience.. In this role, you're excited about using data governance and quality foundations to unlock the next generation of IT maturity: agentic AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven IT decision-making. The position involves actively managing data assets, ensuring data quality, lineage, and metadata accuracy, and supporting data stewardship programs. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to define data definitions, resolve data issues, and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations, contributing significantly to a trusted and well-managed data environment. Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership):
• Leads, develops, and enforces data governance policies aligned with IT4IT value streams. Works independently on specific governance projects to ensure organizational alignment and data integrity.
• Accountability/Problem Solving:
• Develop Data Standards and data models for critical IT data entities across the IT4IT value streams.
• Diagnose root cause of poor data quality in IT operations.
• Implement proactive data quality frameworks following Enterprise Data Strategy guidelines.
• Stakeholder Management:
• Collaborates extensively with various departments to ensure compliance. Communicates effectively and clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to build trust and alignment.
• Impact/Strategy:
• Handles big-sized data governance projects. Develops and executes strategies that significantly improve data quality and overall organizational compliance.
• Align data governance with agentic AI readiness: Define data quality, trust, and compliance standards.
• Complexity / (Product Size):
• Oversees more complex data governance systems. Ensures critical data integrity and security across multiple business units.
• Create data lineage and ownership maps for IT operations data across the IT4IT system landscape, establishing clear accountability for data quality and currency.
• Manage data governance across complex IT operations ecosystems including ServiceNow, Data Warehouses, monitoring platforms, asset management tools, and emerging automation/AI systems
• Business / Technical ability:
• Applies high proficiency in data management tools and practices. Demonstrates and leverages a strong, comprehensive knowledge of data privacy laws and regulations to safeguard data assets.
• Apply knowledge of IT service management frameworks (e.g. IT4IT) to contextualize governance within ITSM processes. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Data-first mindset
• Demonstrated experience handling big-sized data governance projects and overseeing complex data governance systems.
• Proven track record of independently leading, developing, and enforcing data governance policies and standards across multiple business units.
• Experience actively managing data assets, ensuring data quality, lineage, and metadata accuracy.
• Familiarity with IT4IT framework and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) - strongly preferred Technical / Business Skills
• Proficiency in utilizing data management tools and implementing data stewardship practices.
• Strong, in-depth knowledge of data privacy laws, regulatory requirements, and compliance standards.
• Understanding of IT service management frameworks: ITIL, IT4IT, or equivalent; ability to map gover

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Location: Vilnius (Artery Business Center, Konstitucijos pr. 18B). We love the office energy, so we’re looking for someone to join us 5 days a week! Duration: 3-6 months Type: Paid Internship (Full-time), 925 EUR gross/month As our Business Support Intern, you aren’t just handling tasks—you’re the heartbeat of our Vilnius office. Working side-by-side with our Site Business Partner, you’ll contribute to making our workplace “great place to work”. You’ll experience how global corporations, operating based on Agile principles, actually function. Your engagement will span from event planning to data governance, all while networking with our Pharma and Diagnostics colleagues in Lithuania and Baltics. The Mission By the time you wrap up your internship, you’ll have learnt about document archiving, understood the personal data compliance and GDPR governance in Lithuania, hosted several epic events, and mastered the art of creating an office environment people actually want to show up for. What You’ll Be Doing:
• Owning front-of-house operations and keeping the daily office flow smooth.
• Curating the pantry & stationery—ensuring the coffee is flowing and the supplies are stocked.
• Being the main point of contact for incoming calls and general emails inbox.
• Logistics wizardry: Managing couriers and making sure every parcel finds its home.
• Being the office guru for parking and general "how-to" questions. What Will You Learn:
• Organizing internal events and what’s related to operational excellence around event execution (from idea generation to invoice management).
• Implementing and upgrading data governance and archiving frameworks.
• Running wellness initiatives like the Children Walk across the Baltic states. Is This You?
• You’re a student (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Business, Marketing, Economics, HR, or similar field.
• You’ve got strong interpersonal skills and an eye for detail.
• You enjoy interacting with people and have a positive attitude.
• You can work independently but also enjoy collaboration with colleagues from cross-functional areas.
• Fluent English is non-negotiable. Ready to level up? Join us and let’s make an impact together! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Owning front-of-house operations and keeping the daily office flow smooth.
• Curating the pantry & stationery—ensuring the coffee is flowing and the supplies are stocked.
• Being the main point of contact for incoming calls and general emails inbox.
• Logistics wizardry: Managing couriers and making sure every parcel finds its home.
• Being the office guru for parking and general "how-to" questions. What Will You Learn:
• Organizing internal events and what’s related to operational excellence around event execution (from idea generation to invoice management).
• Implementing and upgrading data governance and archiving frameworks.
• Running wellness initiatives like the Children Walk across the Baltic states. Is This You?
• You’re a student (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Business, Marketing, Economics, HR, or similar field.
• You’ve got strong interpersonal skills and an eye for detail.
• You enjoy interacting with people and have a positive attitude.
• You can work independently but also enjoy collaboration with colleagues from cross-functional areas.
• Fluent English is non-negotiable. Ready to level up? Join us and let’s make an impact together! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Team Lead Clinical Trial Payment Operations Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions Hyderabad The Team Lead Clinical Trail Payment Operations will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating the payment-related activities for our Clinical Studies within the team. This includes managing the team, ensuring efficient operations, handling people management tasks, and cultivating relationships with stakeholders and customers. The role demands a combination of payment expertise and leadership competencies to drive the team's performance and meet organizational standards and objectives. Your Opportunity Team Coordination and Management:
• Coordinate and manage the team’s daily activities in payment processing and related tasks
• Perform people management activities, including onboarding, offboarding, training, and development of team members
• Facilitate regular team meetings to ensure smooth communication and collaboration
• Provide functional expertise and guidance to the team, sharing knowledge and best practices Payment Processing Activities:
• Oversee the regional processing of payments, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies
• Monitor payment-related KPIs, quality, and budget adherence
• Track performance, compliance, costs, and deviations in payment processes
• Actively participate in the day-to-day operations of payment processing Stakeholder and Relationship Management:
• Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships to ensure satisfaction and alignment with business objectives
• Act as a primary point of contact for stakeholder inquiries and concerns
• Manage outsourcing activities and relationships with external service providers Regulatory and Compliance:
• Ensure all payment activities are in line with legal, regulatory, and company standards and codes of practice
• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant regulations and compliance requirements
• Implement and monitor compliance measures within the team Who You Are:
• The ideal candidate should be motivated and skilled professional with a solid background in financial processes, particularly in calculating and processing complex payments and team leadership
• You should thrive in dynamic environments, have exceptional problem-solving abilities, and possess a strong commitment to both team and stakeholder satisfaction
• You should bring a collaborative approach, excellent communication skills, and a validated track record of leadership success
• You are someone who holds University degree in Finance, Accounting, or related business discipline with 2-3 years of team management and practical experience in payment processing or related financial activities
• Proficiency in SAP, MDMS, and other approval tools Leadership Competencies:
• Strong leadership skills with demonstrated success in team coordination and stakeholder management. Alternatively, you are an identified talent showing high growth potential in leadership and are ready to take the first steps into leadership
• Proven ability to provide guidance and support to team members in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, and a growth mindset Skills:
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Proficiency in English
• Ability to interpret and analyze payment-related data and performance metrics
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities Personal Attributes:
• Agile mindset to adapt to changing circumstances and handle ambiguou

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity Join Roche Diagnostics as the National Sales Lead for the Lusophone territory, based in our Midrand, Johannesburg hub. In this role, you will lead the territory team and define the business strategy to accelerate growth and expand our market share within the Southern Africa network. Key Challenges Strategic Planning
• To develop the business plan to support delivery of the affiliate strategic direction and budget targets by supporting the development of allocated account and account business plans, aligning with the overall strategy annually
• To manage sales of key customers by reviewing and analyzing key customers sales in conjunction with sales team, identifying any issues, gaps in performance or other anomalies, providing support to develop solutions and overseeing implementation with sales team as required
• To optimally manage resources (sales team, budgets, etc.) by utilizing and deploying resources in order to achieve the set targets daily
• To provide input to the definition of the action plans for the specific business area by managing that all sales plans and objectives are aligned to the overall strategic vision and direction as required
• To develop and implement new tools and local KPI’s by interpreting global tools and KPI’s, customizing as per local needs and business requirements and implementing as required
• To create additional tools and KPI’s when required by identifying need, engaging with business, developing and implementing as required
• To monitor market and customer movements by maintaining awareness and reacting effectively and proactively to these changes through the application of market intelligence and alignment of the sales strategy as required Operations Planning and Management
• To manage effective and professional service delivery in line with the set Roche business principles to all customers by monitoring, mentoring and coaching sales team on an ongoing basis.
• To manage, coordinate and partake in the strategic aspects of specific key accounts, stakeholders and executives by participating in meetings, engaging with individuals and providing input to sales team as required
• To manage customer engagement and communications by tracking sales team activities, reviewing metrics and addressing any issues as and when required and quarterly
• To manage sales and profitability target achievement by tracking sales team activities, reviewing metrics and addressing any issues as and when required and monthly
• To manage the budget and expenditure by reviewing expense requests, authorizing expense claims and tracking against budget and Roche policies and procedures monthly
• To manage the Sales Conferences and Cycle Meetings by planning meetings and informing the key priorities, contributing to the meeting quarterly and as required
• To monitor and manage the Sales teams’ territory knowledge and understanding by reviewing and analyzing information, identifying trends and patterns, identifying areas for improvement, addressing issues and implementing corrective action as required
• To manage sales performance by identifying performance trends and anomalies, managing the implementation of corrective actions timeously and limiting

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity Join Roche Diagnostics as the National Sales Lead for the Lusophone territory, based in our Midrand, Johannesburg hub. In this role, you will lead the territory team and define the business strategy to accelerate growth and expand our market share within the Southern Africa network. Key Challenges Strategic Planning
• To develop the business plan to support delivery of the affiliate strategic direction and budget targets by supporting the development of allocated account and account business plans, aligning with the overall strategy annually
• To manage sales of key customers by reviewing and analyzing key customers sales in conjunction with sales team, identifying any issues, gaps in performance or other anomalies, providing support to develop solutions and overseeing implementation with sales team as required
• To optimally manage resources (sales team, budgets, etc.) by utilizing and deploying resources in order to achieve the set targets daily
• To provide input to the definition of the action plans for the specific business area by managing that all sales plans and objectives are aligned to the overall strategic vision and direction as required
• To develop and implement new tools and local KPI’s by interpreting global tools and KPI’s, customizing as per local needs and business requirements and implementing as required
• To create additional tools and KPI’s when required by identifying need, engaging with business, developing and implementing as required
• To monitor market and customer movements by maintaining awareness and reacting effectively and proactively to these changes through the application of market intelligence and alignment of the sales strategy as required Operations Planning and Management
• To manage effective and professional service delivery in line with the set Roche business principles to all customers by monitoring, mentoring and coaching sales team on an ongoing basis.
• To manage, coordinate and partake in the strategic aspects of specific key accounts, stakeholders and executives by participating in meetings, engaging with individuals and providing input to sales team as required
• To manage customer engagement and communications by tracking sales team activities, reviewing metrics and addressing any issues as and when required and quarterly
• To manage sales and profitability target achievement by tracking sales team activities, reviewing metrics and addressing any issues as and when required and monthly
• To manage the budget and expenditure by reviewing expense requests, authorizing expense claims and tracking against budget and Roche policies and procedures monthly
• To manage the Sales Conferences and Cycle Meetings by planning meetings and informing the key priorities, contributing to the meeting quarterly and as required
• To monitor and manage the Sales teams’ territory knowledge and understanding by reviewing and analyzing information, identifying trends and patterns, identifying areas for improvement, addressing issues and implementing corrective action as required
• To manage sales performance by identifying performance trends and anomalies, managing the implementation of corrective actions timeously and limiting

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In alignment with our core corporate purpose—"Doing now what patients need next"—the Solution Architect provides strategic technical leadership and architectural governance to optimize our global supply chain and logistics systems. This critical role acts as the primary conduit between complex operational requirements and enterprise digital ecosystems, ensuring our warehouse management, material tracking, and cold-chain infrastructure remain scalable, resilient, and fully compliant.

The Opportunity
This position champions an integrated, system-wide approach focused on three core imperatives:

• Architectural Blueprinting: Design and govern the end-to-end technical architecture for warehouse operations, integrating ERP, WMS, and automated data monitoring tools.

• Operational Integrity: Ensure all technical platforms satisfy regulatory compliance boundaries while safeguarding the continuity of supply.

• Digital Transformation: Catalyze the modernization of legacy supply chain systems, introducing advanced automation, predictive data models, and unified communication matrices across local and external partner networks.

What You Do

• Formulate and articulate a compelling, long-term technical vision for our supply chain infrastructure, ensuring software systems scale seamlessly with product portfolio growth.

• Actively monitor and anticipate shifts in enterprise cloud capabilities, digital compliance requirements, and IoT tracking frameworks to engineer future-proof architectures.

• Author comprehensive architectural blueprints that seamlessly unify operational warehouse management systems (Exacta, Syncro, SAP) with global material planning frameworks (ERP / SAP), optimizing data synchronization and transaction velocity

• Partner with the Data Insights team to design well structured and real-time metric dashboards, enabling automated reporting.

• Act as an enterprise technical advisor to cross-functional teams, translating complex architectural choices into practical, operational realities for business stakeholders.

• Influence internal development teams and third-party vendors to adhere to rigid architectural standards, prioritizing continuous system refinement and robust cyber-security posture.

• Serve as the core technical connector bridging Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Global Logistics, and Corporate IT networks to eliminate digital friction.

• Lead the technical risk mitigation strategies required during the deployment of automated high-density storage platforms, cloud migrations, or shifting network structures.

• Design and maintain scalable system architectures that integrate core warehouse operations with peripheral data layers, emphasizing system uptime, data redundancy, and robust API frameworks.

• Evaluate, select, and manage relationships with enterprise software vendors and external integrators, ensuring deliverables satisfy rigorous service level agreements (SLAs).

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Supply Chain Systems, or a related technical discipline.

• 5-8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise solution architecture and/or data engineering with documented success designing integrations for ERP (e.g., SAP) and modern Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) within high-density logistics networks.

Preferred Technical Credentials & Skills

• Architectural Frameworks: Certified in TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, or

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
In this role you will be accountable for setting the direction and strategy for assigned team. Continually assesses daily process flows with the goal of implementing improvements to increase efficiency, improve customer experience, and meet the Supply Chain “On Time and In Full” (OTIF) KPIs. Collaborates and aligns with manager on direction and improvement of team processes to ensure objectives, timelines, and all requirements are achieved (including but not limited to local, regional, & global regulations, finance, tax, safety, environmental, transportation, Customs, and internal company standard requirements). Devotes a significant amount of time to leading employees, overseeing both the day-to-day operations and long term goals for assigned team. Provides feedback to the manager on employees' work performance and has input into employment decisions. Responsible for managing to a prescribed budget, training and development of staff, resource management, work assignments, interprets and ensures consistent application of organizational policies. Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. Demonstrate strong customer focused skills. May have responsibilities that covers multiple shifts, warehouses and/or team leads. Responsible for hiring and onboarding of new employees.

What You Do:

• Lead shift activities across Inbound and Storage operations, driving inventory replenishment efforts for effective global distribution while ensuring the proper handling of sensitive materials.

• Participate in project teams as both a functional subject matter expert and an operational representative to drive site logistics success.

• Maintain hands-on operational agility by mastering the functional responsibilities of the team, ensuring the ability to step in and support daily business continuity when needed.

• Collaborate with management and key stakeholders to align daily execution with broader organizational requirements, milestones, and strategic goals.

• Develop and monitor operational KPIs to ensure optimal team performance, inventory accuracy, and workflow efficiency.

• Schedule: 2nd Shift, Monday through Friday, 13:30 - 22:00

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Science, Technology, Supply Chain, or a related field (or 4 years of related experience while actively pursuing a degree).

• Demonstrated leadership skills in managing key project objectives to achieve high-level organizational benefits and continuous improvement.

• Excellent communication (oral and written), interpersonal, and organizational skills.

• Proficient with Google Workspace/Office Suite and analytical tools.

Preferred Experience:

• 2+ years of supervisory or leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to motivate teams and foster collaboration.

• Experience with SAP, EWM, and other warehouse management systems (WMS).

• Strong cultural awareness and the ability to work effectively across multi-cultural and cross-functional teams.

• Customer service-oriented with the ability to support clients within a complex, global, and regulated environment.

• Proven ability to work in a fast

Role Overview
We are seeking a motivated and organized Working Student to join our Marketing department. In this part-time role, you will support our team across various marketing initiatives, from administrative tasks to digital media campaigns and creative coordination. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic diagnostics environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Administrative Support:

• Purchase Order (PO) creation and new vendor setup.

• General administrative support.

• Marketing Coordination:

• Coordinating product-related updates and communications across the Product Management team.

• Coordinating Marketing Team Meetings and corresponding tasks.

• Digital & Social Media:

• Creating content for social media channels and influencer campaigns.

• Facilitating communication with agencies and external partners.

• Marketing Materials Creation:

• Executing simple graphic design tasks.

• Performing translation checks.

Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a university degree program (e.g., Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field).

• Interested in healthcare and diagnostics.

• Fluent in English.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to balance administrative tasks with creative projects.

• Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected minimum hourly rate for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is From 7 EUR gross / hour. Pay for this position will be pro-rated for the contracted working hours. Role Overview
We are seeking a motivated and organized Working Student to join our Marketing department. Key Responsibilities

• Administrative Support:

• Purchase Order (PO) creation and new vendor setup.

• General administrative support.

• Marketing Coordination:

• Coordinating product-related updates and communications across the Product Management team.

• Coordinating Marketing Team Meetings and corresponding tasks.

• Digital & Social Media:

• Creating content for social media channels and influencer campaigns.

• Facilitating communication with agencies and external partners.

• Marketing Materials Creation:

• Executing simple graphic design tasks.

• Performing translation checks.

Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a university degree program (e.g., Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field).

• Interested in healthcare and diagnostics.

• Fluent in English.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to balance administrative tasks with creative projects.

• Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected minimum hourly rate for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is From 7 EUR gross / hour. Pay for this position will be pro-rated for the contracted working hours. The Position

• The mission of the GPC Training & Service Quality Specialist is to collaborate with local and
• global colleagues to design and deliver comprehensive training for both new and existing team
• members.

• This role is also responsible for executing Service Quality Assurance in line with
• the GPC Training and Quality Framework involving case, channel and documentation reviews,
• to ensure that customer interactions meet established GPC standards . While maintaining
• awareness of the regulated environment, the focus is on driving continuous improvement in
• advisor performance, soft skills, and documentation accuracy.

The Opportunity:
• ● Service Quality Optimization: Develop measures for the continuous maintenance and
• optimization of service quality standards.
• ● Monitoring & Review: Monitor customer interactions and documentation (calls, cases,
• and chats) to ensure they correspond to set GPC quality standards and service
• guidelines.
• ● Soft Skills Coaching: Lead activities to increase the quality of advisor documentation
• and soft skills through regular feedback and targeted coaching sessions.
• ● Proactive Training: Train team members on service quality issues and quality
• concepts, involving internal or external partners as needed to close identified gaps.
• ● Interface Participation: Act as an active contact person for quality, knowledge, and
• product launch topics; participate in GPC projects and initiatives.
• ● Information Flow: Ensure all relevant information (e.g., product launches, quality
• notifications) is delivered and communicated to the organization in a timely manner.
• ● Knowledge Management: Maintain and further develop the customer services
• knowledge database in partnership with local and global colleagues.
• ● Training Coordination: Act as the recipient of “Train the Trainer” instruction and
• coordinate the rollout of training for internal and external team members.
• ● Onboarding & Side-by-Sides: Coordinate and deliver training for new advisors,
• including classroom sessions and side-by-side (buddy-up) training/monitoring.
• ● External Partner Certification: Responsible for Train the Trainer for external partners,
• including the formal certification of external trainers to ensure they are fully qualified
• and compliant with all Roche service quality requirements.
• ● Content Maintenance: Create, review, and maintain training content and
• documentation for job-oriented training.

Who you are:
• ● Associate Degree with at least 2 years’ industry-related experience.
• ● Specialized in-depth knowledge and experience in call center operations
• ● Good understanding of knowledge management solutions and the specific requirements
• of a multiskilled, matrix organized contact center.
• ● Experience in Training and Learning Management.
• ● Understanding of documentation compliance within a medical environment, though the
• primary focus is on service quality.
• ● Excellent listening, communication, and presentation skills.
• ● Proactive and results-oriented with a strong team-player attitude.
• ● Agile and flexible to adapt to changes in a fast-paced environment.
• ● Strong organization and planning skills with an ability to work autonomously.
• ● Role model in IT navigation and a fast learner of new technologies and support tools.
• ● Fluent on English & Spanish

The Position
xt

En Roche estamos buscando talento dispuesto a tomar retos innovar con proyectos, e interactuar con la diversidad con la que cuenta nuestro equipo multidisciplinar.

Si eres estudiante de últimos semestres de Derecho consideras que tienes un nivel de inglés B2 - C2 y te interesa explorar el área de Legal & Compliance ( Derecho Corporativo); te invitamos a que hagas parte de este equipo.
Donde harás parte de proyectos críticos y de impacto para el negocio, en temas de Compliance, apoyando en elaboración de documentos legales, apoyo en investigaciones legales y monitoreo del cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas, regulaciones locales y Códigos de ética de la industria.

¿Qué harías?

• Elaborar documentos legales atendiendo la operatividad del negocio y regulaciones locales.

• Apoyar al Legal & Compliance Business Partner Pharma en diversas tareas incluidas la realización de investigaciones legales, redacción y revisión de documentos.

• Preparar sesiones de capacitación en asuntos legales, regulatorios y de compliance, cuando sea requeridas.

• Apoyar a los diferentes Legal & Compliance Business Partners Pharma/DIA/DC en la implementación de los mandatos legales y éticos aplicables en Colombia, a través de herramientas innovadoras.

• Realizar y acompañar las labores de monitoreo y seguimiento al cumplimiento de las acciones correctivas y preventivas que correspondan para el cabal cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas, regulaciones locales y código de ética de la industria farmacéutica de AFIDRO y normas vigentes.

• Soportar las labores que tengan impacto legal corporativo y comercial que requiera el negocio tales como elaboración de Actas de Junta directiva, modificaciones estatutarias, otorgamiento de poderes generales y especiales y sus correspondientes trámites ante las Autoridades.

• Apoyar en entrenamiento y consultas relacionadas con la herramienta de contratos ECML y el procedimiento de contratación.

¿Quién eres?

• Eres estudiante de últimos semestres de la carrera de Derecho.

• Tienes manejo de paquete de Microsoft Office.

• Tienes manejo de Inglés Intermedio - avanzado.

descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche arbeiten wir an wegweisenden Innovationen. Als Surgical Device Liaison Manager (m/w/d) für unsere innovative "Port Delivery Platform" in der Ophthalmologie bist Du die entscheidende Schnittstelle zwischen bahnbrechender Technologie und dem operativen Einsatz am Patienten. Du bist nicht nur ein:e Expert:in – Du bist ein:e Wegbereiter:in für eine neue Ära der Behandlung.

Dein neues Team:
Dich erwartet eine Gruppe von Pionier:innen und Fachexpert:innen, die eine gemeinsame Mission verbindet: die erfolgreiche und sichere Etablierung einer revolutionären chirurgischen Technologie in Deutschland. Obwohl oft eigenständig in den Regionen gearbeitet und direkt vor Ort im OP unterstützt wird, ist das Team sehr eng vernetzt.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Du begleitest Operateure und ihre Teams direkt im Operationssaal, stellst eine reibungslose Anwendung unserer "Port Delivery Platform" sicher und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle chirurgischen Fragen.

• Du konzipierst und führst Anwendungstrainings durch – von modernen Virtual-Reality-Schulungen bis hin zu praxisnahen Workshops – und befähigst so medizinisches Personal, unsere Technologie sicher und effektiv zu nutzen.

• Du agierst als wissenschaftliche:r Partner:in auf Augenhöhe mit führenden Expert:innen, teilst Dein Wissen auf Kongressen und generierst wertvolle Einblicke aus der Praxis, die direkt in unsere globale Strategie einfließen.

• Du identifizierst strategische Exzellenz-Zentren und baust ein nachhaltiges Netzwerk aus wichtigen Meinungsbildner:innen und Anwender:innen in der Ophthalmochirurgie auf und pflegst dieses.

• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der klinischen Forschung betreust Du klinische Studien vor Ort und sorgst für die Einhaltung höchster Qualitätsstandards.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Dein Fundament ist ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem naturwissenschaftlichen, (veterinär-)medizinischen oder pharmazeutischen Bereich. Du bringst bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Medizintechnik, idealerweise in der Ophthalmochirurgie, mit. Darüber hinaus hast du sehr gute Kenntnis über das Arbeiten nach Studienprotokollen und entsprechend der GCP- und ICH-Regularien

• Du bewegst Dich sicher im operativen Umfeld und die Kommunikation mit Ärzt:innen sowie medizinischem Fachpersonal ist für Dich selbstverständlich.

• Als kommunikationsstarke und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit überzeugst Du in Diskussionen, präsentierst souverän und nutzt digitale Kanäle geschickt zur Interaktion und Wissensvermittlung.

• Du arbeitest eigenständig und strukturiert , hast eine proaktive Lernhaltung und die nötige Reisebereitschaft, um unsere Partner:innen in ganz Deutschland bestmöglich zu betreuen.

• Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und bringst sehr gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit unseren globalen Teams und für globale Trainings mit.

Folgende Gebiete sind zu besetzen:
West 2: Münster, Göttingen, Kassel, Braunschweig, Wolfsburg

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr herau s: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebe

So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position In der Pharma- und Early Development-Organisation (pRED) von Roche machen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der weltweit härtesten ungenutzten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED sind wir vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen. Diese Position befindet sich in Preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing und Control (pCMC), einer Abteilung innerhalb der Synthetic Molecule Research Organisation in pRED Therapeutic Modalities, wo wir in einer vielfältigen, ambitionierten und innovativen Umgebung den Weg ebnen, um Drogenkandidaten aus der frühen Forschung in die Entwicklung zu bringen. Wir sind CMC-Experten und bauen unsere Stärke auf einer breiten Vielfalt von technischen Know-how in der Chemie, Formulierungsdesign, Materialwissenschaft und analytische Chemie, liefern und innovieren im Raum der kleinen Moleküle, Peptide und Nukleinsäure basierte Medikamente. Die Chance Wir bieten eine spannende Gelegenheit für einen erfahrenen CMC-Profi, unser Analytical Molecular Characterization (AMC) Team zu führen, während wir als Hand-on Maß Spectrometry (MS) Fachexperte dienen. In dieser Rolle werden Sie die Entdeckungsforschung und technische Entwicklung überbrücken und fortschrittliche analytische Strategien vorantreiben, um unser Portfolio über die Wertschöpfungskette hinweg zu unterstützen. Sie führen ein multidisziplinäres Team, das NMR, MS und Chromatographie umfasst, bei der Entwicklung und Anwendung hochauflösender MS-Methoden zur Charakterisierung synthetischer Moleküle. Diese Rolle verbindet strategische Führung mit einem praktischen wissenschaftlichen Beitrag, der sowohl Teamrichtung als auch analytische Exzellenz prägt. Ihre Aufgaben beinhalten: Führung und Strategie
• Führen und entwickeln Sie ein Team von analytischen Experten über MS, NMR und Chromatographie
• Festlegung und Durchführung von mittel- bis langfristigen AMC-Strategien, die auf Projekt- und Portfolioziele ausgerichtet sind
• Foster-Zusammenarbeit über Entdeckung, technische Entwicklung und externe Partner Analytische und wissenschaftliche Expertise
• Entwicklung und Anwendung fortgeschrittener hochauflösender MS-Methoden für Strukturaufklärung und Unreinheitlichkeitscharakterisierung
• Übersehen Sie komplexe analytische Aktivitäten, einschließlich Stereochemie-Bestimmung und Interaktionsstudien (API–Excipient)
• Antriebsanalytische Methodenentwicklung über SFC, HPLC und GC für kleine Moleküle und Peptide Innovation und Zusammenarbeit
• Partner mit Data-, Digital- und KI-Teams, um Daten-Workflows, Automatisierungs- und Analysefunktionen voranzutreiben
• Branchentrends identifizieren und akademische Kooperationen pflegen, um wissenschaftliche Führung zu gewährleisten
• Stellen Sie eine qualitativ hochwertige analytische Unterstützung für IPCs, Zwischenprodukte und APIs über Entwicklungsstufen sicher Wer bist du?
• PhD in der Analytischen Chemie (oder verwandten Bereich) mit 5+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder MSc mit 10+ Jahren
• Starkes Know-how in chromatographischen und spektroskopischen Techniken mit tiefem MS-Erlebnis in der Struktur elucidation
• Kenntnisse der API-Synthese, des unreinen Profilings und der Trenntechnologien (U/HPLC, SFC)
• Proven Führungserfahrung (≥3 Jahre) Verwaltung multidisziplinärer Teams
• Vertraulichkeit mit GMP und regulatorischen Anforderungen
• Starker Mitarbeiter in der Lage, technische Tiefe mit strategischen Zielen zu verbinden Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir würden gerne von Ihnen hören. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt, um diese spannende Gelegenheit zu erkunden! Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam mehr als 100’000 em
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED) de Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Ce poste est situé dans la chimie préclinique, la fabrication et le contrôle (pCMC), un département de l'organisme de recherche sur les molécules synthétiques dans les modalités thérapeutiques pRED, où nous posons, dans un environnement diversifié, ambitieux et innovateur, la voie pour amener les candidats aux médicaments des premières recherches au développement. Nous sommes des experts du CMC et nous bâtissons notre force sur une vaste gamme d'expertises techniques en chimie, conception de formulation, science matérielle et chimie analytique, fournissant et innovant dans l'espace de petites molécules, peptides et médicaments à base d'acide nucléique. L'opportunité Nous offrons une occasion passionnante à un professionnel expérimenté du CMC de diriger notre équipe de caractérisation moléculaire analytique (CMA) tout en servant d'expert pratique en spectrométrie de masse (MS). Dans ce rôle, vous établirez un lien entre la recherche et le développement technique, en menant des stratégies analytiques avancées pour soutenir notre portefeuille dans toute la chaîne de valeur. Vous dirigerez une équipe multidisciplinaire couvrant la RMN, la MS et la chromatographie, tout en développant et en appliquant des méthodes MS à haute résolution pour la caractérisation des molécules synthétiques. Ce rôle combine leadership stratégique et contribution scientifique pratique, façonnant à la fois la direction de l'équipe et l'excellence analytique. Vos responsabilités comprennent : Leadership et stratégie
• Diriger et mettre sur pied une équipe d'experts en analyse à travers le MS, le RMN et la chromatographie
• Définir et exécuter des stratégies AMC à moyen et à long terme alignées sur les objectifs du projet et du portefeuille
• Favoriser la collaboration entre les chercheurs, le développement technique et les partenaires extérieurs Expertise analytique et scientifique
• Élaborer et appliquer des méthodes avancées de MS à haute résolution pour l'élucidation des structures et la caractérisation des impuretés
• Superviser les activités analytiques complexes, y compris la détermination stéréochimique et les études d'interaction (API-excipient)
• Diriger le développement de méthodes d'analyse à travers SFC, HPLC et GC pour les petites molécules et les peptides Innovation et collaboration
• Partenaire avec les équipes Data, Digital et AI pour faire progresser les flux de données, l'automatisation et les capacités d'analyse
• Identifier les tendances de l'industrie et maintenir les collaborations universitaires pour assurer le leadership scientifique
• Assurer un soutien analytique de haute qualité pour les IPC, les intermédiaires et les IPA à tous les stades de développement Qui vous êtes
• Doctorat en chimie analytique (ou domaine connexe) avec plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie, ou MSc avec plus de 10 ans
• Forte expertise en techniques chromatographiques et spectroscopiques, avec une profonde expérience de l'EM dans l'élucidation des structures
• Connaissance de la synthèse des API, du profilage des impuretés et des technologies de séparation (U/HPLC, SFC)
• Expérience de leadership éprouvée (≥ 3 ans) en gestion d'équipes multidisciplinaires
• Connaissance des BPF et des exigences réglementaires
• Collaborateur fort capable de relier la profondeur technique aux objectifs stratégiques Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 em

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Die Position In dieser Führungsposition innerhalb von Pharma Technical Regulatory (PTR) verfügst du über ein breites Verständnis der regulatorischen Landschaft und setzt dein Wissen gezielt ein, um Ergebnisse im Einklang mit unserer „North Star“-Vision zu erzielen. Als Führungskraft bist du dafür verantwortlich, Veränderungen in der gesamten Organisation voranzutreiben und unsere Mitarbeitenden in einem globalen Umfeld zu unterstützen. Du hast ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für Prioritäten und Bereiche mit hoher Hebelwirkung, vernetzt die richtigen Personen und Ressourcen mit den entsprechenden Aufgaben und hilfst der Organisation, sich an veränderte regulatorische Anforderungen anzupassen. Du inspirierst unsere Teams zu mutiger Innovation und Zusammenarbeit, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die für Patienten, Stakeholder und das Unternehmen von entscheidender Bedeutung sind. In der Rolle des Regulatory Group Director verantwortest du sowohl das Portfolio-Management (mit Schwerpunkt im Bereich Biologics / ADCs) als auch die personelle Führung . Dabei unterstützt und befähigst du Teams und Einzelpersonen innerhalb dieses Betriebsmodells, die übergeordneten Geschäftsziele zu erreichen. Deine Chancen
• Strategische Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Aufsicht und Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Implementierung von End-to-End-Regulierungsstrategien und -initiativen auf Portfolio-Ebene.
• Portfolio-Steuerung: Du definierst Strategien für ein spezifisches Portfolio (z. B. Produktportfolio innerhalb einer Modalität, cross-funktionale Initiativen für Innovation, Operational Excellence oder Policy) und übersetzt diese in konkrete Ergebnisse. Dabei sicherst du die Transparenz über Squads und Teams hinweg, priorisierst Aufgaben und steuerst die Ressourcenplanung sowie das Budgeting.
• Globale Kollaboration: Du arbeitest auf globaler Ebene eng mit anderen Führungskräften zusammen, um Prioritäten abzustimmen und die Organisationsziele durch punktuelle Unterstützung von Projekten und Initiativen zu fördern.
• Trend-Monitoring: Du hältst dich über interne und externe Entwicklungen sowie Trends auf dem Laufenden, um die Auswirkungen auf alle Programme bewerten zu können, und stärkst das Bewusstsein hierfür im Unternehmen.
• Behördenmanagement: Du leitest Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden (Health Authorities) sowie die Überprüfung von Einreichungen (Submissions) für zugewiesene Projekte mit erweitertem Umfang. Du vertrittst den Bereich Technical Regulatory in multidisziplinären Terminen mit Behörden. Zudem bist du zentraler Ansprechpartner für einen oder mehrere regulatorische Kompetenzbereiche (z. B. CTA, NDA, LCM, Datenmanagement, Systeme) und treibst dort Effizienz und Exzellenz voran.
• Kommunikation & Stakeholder-Management: Du fungierst als Sprachrohr der Organisation und stellst sicher, dass Herausforderungen, Chancen und Maßnahmen der Führungsebene den Mitarbeitenden strukturiert und transparent vermittelt werden. Du baust Beziehungen zu internen Stakeholdern auf und räumst organisatorische Hindernisse aus dem Weg.
• Modern Leadership: Als Führungskraft befähigst du selbstverwaltete Teams, indem du als Visionär, Architekt, Coach und Katalysator agierst. Du bist für das Performance-Management deiner Direct Reports verantwortlich, gibst zeitnahes Feedback und förderst die individuelle Entwicklung durch regelmäßige Gespräche und Check-ins. Dein Profil Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverha

The Position Deine Abteilung Unser 18-köpfiges Team, bestehend aus Analytikern, Projektleitern und Gruppenleiter im Bereich der chemischen und biochemischen Analytik, freut sich auf tatkräftige Unterstützung von einem hilfsbereiten und flexiblen neuen Teammitglied. Du solltest Spaß an neuen Herausforderungen haben und Dich in unsere positive Arbeitsatmosphäre einfügen. Wir möchten Dir als Praktikant (m/w/d) einen Einblick in das „ daily business “ in der Abteilung Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) geben. Dabei wirst Du auch die Möglichkeit haben, Dich selbstständig mit Projektarbeiten zu befassen, um bestehende Prozesse zu optimieren. Deine Aufgaben
• Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeiten im Bereich Design Transfer & Product Care
• Analytik von chemischen, biochemischen und biologischen Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld Dein Profil
• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (Bachelor oder Master in Chemie / Biochemie / Molekularbiologie / Lebensmittelchemie / Life Science oder vergleichbar) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year
• Du bringst Kenntnisse in der chemischen und/oder biochemischen Analytik mit
• Du bist motiviert, neugierig und möchtest Deine Ideen einbringen

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity As the Team Lead for Design Control Excellence (DCE) in Sant Cugat, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how we develop life-saving diagnostic solutions. You will build and inspire a team of Process Managers dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency. This is an opportunity to lead a digital and cultural transformation, fostering a high-performance environment where agile mindsets drive better outcomes for patients. Empower and Grow Talent: Coach and mentor a team of six Process Managers, focusing on their technical growth, strategic thinking, and long-term career journeys. Champion Process Governance: Lead the optimization of critical system, software, and assay projects across Risk,
• Requirements, Configuration, Defect Management and Verification & Validation. Drive Operational Excellence: Ensure all development documentation meets rigorous global regulatory standards (such as ISO 13485) while championing radical simplification. Foster Global Collaboration: Act as a key bridge between Development, Quality, Regulatory, and Customer Service teams to ensure seamless information flow and project success. Model Agile Leadership: Serve as a catalyst for cultural change by encouraging experimentation, trust, and cross-functional collaboration within a matrixed organization. Strategic Vision: Accelerate knowledge transfer and upskill your team to meet the evolving needs of a global diagnostics landscape. Who You Are You are a people-oriented leader who excels at navigating complex organizations through influence and collaboration. You are passionate about developing others and bring a strategic vision to technical process management. To be successful in this role, you bring: Strong Educational Foundation: An advanced university degree in Life Sciences, Natural Sciences, or Engineering. Industry Expertise: At least five years of experience in Product Development or Process Management, ideally within the Diagnostics or Medical Device sector. Leadership Track Record: Proven experience leading people in a line capacity with a focus on building networks and inspiring teams through change. Analytical & Influencing Skills: A deep understanding of design control processes and the ability to resolve conflicts and align stakeholders across global locations. Effective Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills to partner with global teams; proficiency in Spanish or German is a valuable asset. At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is an opportunity to join a growing innovation hub where you will work in a cross-functional environment to ensure compliant execution while continuously optimizing efficiency to meet evolving organizational needs.

• Master Requirements & Traceability: Support multi-level requirements traceability and ensure all data is maintained within a streamlined, database-driven approach across projects.

• Drive Radical Simplification: Proactively identify opportunities for process optimization and simplification to improve time-to-market without compromising quality.
• Collaborate Globally: Thrive in an agile, multicultural setting where we experiment, learn, and trust each other to deliver the best results for patients. • Advanced Academic Foundation: A Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Natural Sciences, or a related field.
• Experience : Minimum of three years of experience in a regulated environment within product development or process management (Medical Device or Diagnostics industry preferred).

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il programma RiSE (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) è un programma di ricerca studentesca altamente competitivo a Roche. Offre agli studenti di laurea e di laurea più talentuosi la possibilità di essere pienamente integrato nel nostro ambiente R&D interdisciplinare e internazionale del settore. Come studente RiSE, aumenterai le tue competenze, acquisirai una preziosa esperienza lavorativa con noi, e alla fine diventerai parte di una rete mondiale di RiSE Alumni. La Neuroscienza e Malattie Rare Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) sta sviluppando farmaci per una serie di gravi malattie neurologiche, tra cui sclerosi multipla, malattia di Alzheimer, malattia di Parkinson, autismo, atrofia muscolare spinale, e la malattia di Huntington. Come studente di RiSE nel NRD DTA vi unirete al nostro gruppo nel gruppo di laboratorio Neuromuscular Disorders (NMD), situato all'interno della sezione Neurotechnologies presso il Roche Innovation Center di Basilea, Svizzera. Il nostro team multidisciplinare riunisce competenze in biologia neuromuscolare, medicina genomica vettorizzata, ingegneria genetica e modelli 3D complessi. L'opportunità Nel vostro ruolo di studente RiSE, avrete l'opportunità di:
• Cultura del tessuto e manutenzione di modelli 2D (ad esempio cellule HEK-blue, mioblasti di derivazione hiPSC, ecc.), organoidi di giunzione neuromuscolare 3D e tessuti muscolari umani ingegnerizzati
• Pianificare, progettare, eseguire e analizzare saggi farmacologici di interesse (ad esempio piccoli trattamenti molecolari, espressione reporter, bioenergetica cellulare con sistema Seahorse di Agilent, valutazioni 3D twitch/tetanic force con configurazione Mantarray di CuriBio, live imaging e registrazioni di contrattilità di organoidi 3D, ecc.)
• Lavorare a stretto contatto all'interno di un team composto da 3-4 scienziati, collaboratori di ricerca, altri studenti, e coordinarsi con strutture interne (ad esempio imaging) e team interfunzionali (ad esempio neurogenomica e gruppi di metabolismo muscolare)
• Mantenere un quaderno di laboratorio elettronico dettagliato (ELN) e record di dati
• I risultati attuali della ricerca nelle riunioni interne
• Summarizzare il lavoro e redigere un manoscritto scientifico
• Sarete ospitati e guidati da scienziati Roche che forniranno una guida completa. Chi sei
• Ti sei laureato in un Master nell'ultimo anno o ti sei iscritto in un dottorato o in un corso di laurea in medicina presso un'università e hai portato un'esperienza dimostrabile in una o più delle seguenti aree:
• Coltura di modelli cellulari complessi e/o organoidi (ad esempio cellule derivate dal paziente, iPSC umani, ecc.)
• Elettrofisiologia in vitro (ad es. in vitro misure di forza utilizzando attrezzature Mantarray di CuriBio)
• In vitro tecniche / assaggi di cellule vive (ad esempio piattaforma Agilent Seahorse, microscopia di fluorescenza, indicatori di calcio, contrattilità, ecc.)
• Familiarità con software avanzato di analisi delle immagini (ad esempio, Armonia, FIJI/ImageJ, MuscleMotion, metriche funzionali Pulse, o simili)
• Tecniche di biologia molecolare di base (ad esempio attività segreta del reporter, qPCR/dPCR, WB, immunofluorescence, DNA/RNA/protein isolamento)
• Proficienza nel software statistico (ad es. R, R e/o GraphPad) per l'analisi dei set di dati biologici, comprese le curve di risposta dose e l'uscita di elettrofisiologia
• Un forte interesse per espandere le tue capacità di biologia muscolare, in particolare utilizzando piccole tecnologie basate sulle molecole nei sistemi di modelli 2D e 3D. Informazioni aggiuntive Lo stage può iniziare tra agosto 2026 e ottobre 2026 – si prega di indicare chiaramente la data di partenza preferita nella vostra lettera di motivazione. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The RiSE program (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) is a highly competitive student research program at Roche. It offers the most talented graduate and medical degree students the opportunity to be fully integrated into our interdisciplinary and international industry R&D environment. As a RiSE student, you will enhance your competencies, gain valuable work experience with us, and eventually become part of a worldwide network of RiSE Alumni. The Neuroscience and Rare Diseases Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) is developing medicines for a range of serious neurological diseases, including multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, autism, spinal muscular atrophy, and Huntington’s disease. As a RiSE student in the NRD DTA you will join our group in the Neuromuscular Disorders (NMD) lab group, situated within the Neurotechnologies Section at the Roche Innovation Center Basel, Switzerland. Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise in neuromuscular biology, vectorized genomic medicine, genetic engineering, and complex 3D models. The Opportunity In your role as a RiSE student, you will have the opportunity to:
• Tissue culture and maintenance of 2D models (e.g. HEK-blue cells, immortalized and hiPSC-derived myoblasts, etc.), 3D neuromuscular junction organoids, and engineered human muscle tissues
• Actively plan, design, perform, and analyze pharmacological assays of interest (e.g. small molecule treatments, reporter expression, cellular bioenergetics with Agilent’s Seahorse system, 3D twitch/tetanic force assessments with CuriBio’s Mantarray setup, live imaging and contractility recordings of 3D organoids, etc.)
• Work closely within a team composed of 3-4 scientists, research associates, other students, and coordinate with internal core facilities (e.g. imaging) and cross-functional teams (e.g. neurogenomics and muscle metabolism groups)
• Maintain a detailed electronic lab notebook (ELN) and data records
• Present research findings at internal meetings
• Summarize work and draft a scientific manuscript
• You will be hosted and mentored by Roche scientists who will provide comprehensive guidance. Who You Are
• You graduated from a Master's program within the last year or you are enrolled in a PhD or medical degree program at a university and you bring demonstrable experience in one or more of the following areas:
• Culturing complex cell models and/or organoids (e.g. patient-derived cells, human iPSCs, etc.)
• In vitro electrophysiology (e.g. in vitro force measurements using CuriBio’s Mantarray equipment)
• In vitro live cell techniques/assays (e.g. Agilent Seahorse platform, fluorescence microscopy, calcium indicators, contractility, etc.)
• Familiarity with advanced image analysis software (e.g., Harmony, FIJI/ImageJ, MuscleMotion, Pulse functional metrics, or similar)
• Basic molecular biology techniques (e.g. secreted reporter activity, qPCR/dPCR, WB, immunofluorescence, DNA/RNA/protein isolation)
• Proficiency in statistical software (e.g. R, R and/or GraphPad) for analyzing biological data sets, including dose-response curves and electrophysiology output
• A strong interest in expanding your muscle biology skills, particularly using small molecule-based technologies in 2D and 3D model systems. Additional Information The internship can start between August 2026 and October 2026 – please clearly indicate your preferred starting date in your motivation letter. Application Process Application
