Mansioni Descrizione A Roche, puoi mostrare il tuo vero io, apprezzato per le tue unicità. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei valorizzato, previsto e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. Questo è il modo in cui miriamo a comandare, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. L'Opportunità Come Lead Clinical Site Manager specializzato in IVDR e Study Start-Up, sarai responsabile della progettazione, pianificazione, coordinamento e conduzione indipendente di tutte le attività necessarie nell'avvio, monitoraggio e dimostrazione degli studi di ricerca clinica. Giocarai un ruolo fondamentale nell'assicurarti che gli studi siano consegnati, registrati e segnalati in conformità ai protocolli, alle procedure operative standard e alle linee guida normative globali. In questo ruolo, preoccupatevi: - Guidare le attività di avvio dello studio dall'inizio alla fine, guidando la selezione del sito, l'attivazione e le probabilità di qualifica per garantire il lancio efficiente e il rispetto dei requisiti normativi degli studi clinici. - Gestire le presentazioni alla Commissione Etica (EC) e all'autorità Competente (CA), assicurando che tutta la documentazione degli studi, i contratti locali e le approvazioni istituzionali rispettino i rigorosi tempi normativi. - Fornire una robusta vigilanza sui fornitori esterni, monitorando i loro risultati, tracciando i progressi e assicurando che le prestazioni dei fornitori siano in linea con gli standard di qualità di Roche. - Fare da punto di contatto principale e esperto di studio per il personale del sito assegnato, formazione, assistenza tecnica e coordinamento le certificazioni necessarie. - Piattaformare la documentazione critica dello studio, inclusi i piani di monitoraggio dello studio, i documenti di consenso informato, le guide per l'istruzione del paziente e i moduli di registrazione dei boss per i protocolli diagnostici. - Eseguire attività di monitoraggio del sito e convalida dei dati, eseguendo visite al sito in tutte le fasi dello studio, dalla fase di avvio alla chiusura finale. - Collaborare con team globale, locali e virtuali, attraverso Ricerca e Sviluppo, Gestione dello Studio e Biometria per rilevazione clinica soluzionihe di primo livello. - Leadership & Coaching: Dedicherai del tempo a coachare i allenatori, aiuta gli altri a sviluppare le loro competenze e agendo come risorsa per i membri del team meno esperti.
• Requisiti Chi sei? Sei un professionista di ricerca clinica proattivo, collaborativo e altamente organizzato che prospera in un ambiente di matrice veloce. Possiedi forti competenze di risoluzione dei problemi, prendi decisioni indipendenti e eccelli nella gestione dei rapporti con i fornitori esterni. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti con te: - Istruzione & Esperienza: Un titolo di studio in un campo scientifico
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally. We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster . Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption, and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life . The Opportunity As a Lead Clinical Site Manager specialising in IVDR and Study Start-Up, you will be responsible for designing, planning, coordinating, and independently conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies. You will play a vital role in ensuring studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocols, standard operating procedures, and global regulatory guidelines In this role, you will:
• Lead end-to-end study start-up activities , driving site selection, activation, and qualification assessments to ensure clinical trials launch efficiently and are compliance-ready.
• Manage Ethics Committee (EC) and Competent Authority (CA) submissions , ensuring all trial documentation, local contracts, and institutional approvals meet stringent regulatory timelines.
• Provide robust CRO oversight , monitoring external partner deliverables, tracking milestones, and ensuring vendor performance aligns with Roche quality standards.
• Act as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, providing training, technical assistance, and coordinating necessary certifications.
• Develop critical study documentation , including Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent documents, patient instruction guides, and case report forms tailored to diagnostic protocols.
• Deliver comprehensive site monitoring and data validation activities, executing site visits throughout all study phases from early start-up to final close-out.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with global, local, and virtual teams, across Research & Development, Study Management, and Biometrics to deliver top-tier clinical diagnostic solutions.
• Leadership & Coaching : You will dedicate time to coaching colleagues, helping others develop their skills, and acting as a resource for less-experienced team members. Who You Are You are a proactive, collaborative, and highly organised clinical research professional who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess strong problem-solving skills, make sound independent decisions, and excel at managing external vendor relationships. To be successful in this role, you bring:

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni A Roche, ogni voce conta e ogni persona è valorizzata per le sue unicità. La cultura nostra promuove l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei rispettato e preciso per che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. Questo è il modo in cui miriamo a comandare, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche e fai la differenza. Descrizione Al Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), la nostra missione è chiara: diagnosticare prima, sviluppare più velocemente e personalizzare il trattamento perché ogni paziente è unico. Il nostro team di Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) guida l'innovazione per migliorare i risultati sanitari a livello globale. Ci consideriamo una squadra che può raggiungere il suo pieno potenziale solo lavorando insieme ai nostri clienti. Ascoltando attentamente i pazienti e i medici e sfruttando la digitalizzazione e le nuove tecnologie, ci avviciniamo alle loro esigenze reali. Questo collabora spirito creativo in cui le idee possono crescere e provare nuovi modi di fare le cose - con il risultato di prodotti competitivi che arrivano ai pazienti più velocemente. Il nostro lavoro copre l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla scoperta al lancio post. Collaborando con i team interni, i partner esterni e i pazienti, il capitolo CDMA fornisce preziose informazioni mediche, pianifica ed esegue gli studi clinici e offre il supporto sul mercato. Infine, generiamo le prove cliniche complete che visualizza la sicurezza, l'efficacia e la potenza scientifica del prodotto - facilitando la registrazione, l'adozione e il rimborso del prodotto a livello globale per salvare vite e migliorare la qualitÃ della vita dei pazienti.
• Stiamo cercando un Global Study Lead ed esperto da unire al nostro team. In questo ruolo chiave, guiderai i team di studio globale per garantire l'esecuzione degli studi clinici. Sarai responsabile della consegna di progetti di studio di alta qualità, dell'aderenza ai tempi e ai budget e della collaborazione con i team multifunzionali per supportare le strategie di generazione delle prove. Se hai una passione per lontano avanzare gli studi clinici nell'area cardiovascolare/metabolica, ordinati nell'Assistenza Vicina al Paziente, impossibilitati di sentirti! Responsabilità Chiave - Guida e supervisiona il team di studio globale, garanzia la piena responsabilità per le consegne dello studio, inclusi qualità, budget e tempi. - Collabora con la Direzione del Programma per preparare diversi scenari per generazione delle prove (ad esempio, studio, prove del mondo reale) e garantire la cooperazione multifunzionale con gli Affari Regolatori, R&D, Biostatistica, Gestione dei Dati, Medi Affarico e i Team di Progetto CDMA. - I documenti chiave dello studio, come i Piani di Validazione del Design, i protocolli dello studio, i materiali di formazione, i moduli dello studio, i template e i rapporti dello studio. - Mantiene la responsabilità del budget a livello di studio degli studi assegnati. - Garantisce il rispetto delle normative, delle linee guida e delle procedure operative standard, mentre garantisce la prontezza all'audit/ispezione. - Supervisa l'esecuzione degli studi finanziati per scopi registrativi e non registrativi attraverso tutte le fasi dello studio (pianificazione, avvio, condotta e chiusura). - Gestisce le attività dello studio delegato ai fornitori di servizi, inclusi i CRO, garantendo l'esecuzione tempestiva e di qualità. - con il Team di Pubblicazione per garantire che i risultati dello studio legale. - Monitora le prestazioni del progetto e garanzie che i progetti si completano nei tempi, nella portata e nel budget. - Costruisce e mantiene relazioni collaborative forti con i stakeholder interni ed esterni, inclusi i team multifunzionali, i CRO, i leader del settore, gli investigatori e i clienti chiave. Profilo - Forte esperienza nella gestione degli studi clinici, in particolare nell'indicazione cardiovascolare/metabolica e nell'Assistenza Vicina al Paziente o al Punto di Cura. L'esperienza con gli studi in un setting del Pronto Soccorso è un plus. - Hai un titolo di studio in Scienze della Vita, Sanità o un campo affine. Un background in ricerca clinica o sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici è un vantaggio. - Conoscenze approfondite delle normative e delle linee guida internazionali per gli studi clinici. - Esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi e nella collaborazione con team multifunzionali. - Capacità di comunicazione efficace e di costruzione di relazioni con stakeholder interni ed esterni. - Capacità di prendere decisioni e risolvere problemi in modo autonomo e in ambienti incerti. - Disponibilità a viaggiare internazionalmente per incontri di progetto e visite ai siti degli studi. Cosa somministra - Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e collaborativo che valorizza la diversità e l'inclusione. - Opportunità di crescita professionale e sviluppo delle competenze in un'azienda globale leader nel settore della salute. - No. Un pacchetto retributivo competitivo e vantaggi sociali. - L'opportunità di contribuire a fare la differenza nella vita delle persone attraverso il nostro lavoro. Contatto Se sei interessato a questa opportunità di carriera, ti compete a candidarti online attraverso il nostro sito web. Ti ringraziamo per l'interesse dimostrato per Roche e il nostro team di Clinical Development & Medical Affairs.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally. We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster . Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life . We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Global Study Lead to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will lead global study teams to ensure the successful execution of clinical studies. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality study designs, adhering to timelines and budgets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation strategies. If you have a passion for advancing clinical trials in the cardiovascular/metabolic disease area (CVMD), specifically in Core Lab SWA (Serum Work Area) Systems and Automation, we would love to hear from you! Key Responsibilities :
• Lead and oversee the global study team, ensuring full accountability for study deliverables including quality, budget, and timelines.
• Collaborate with Program Leadership to prepare different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g., study, real-world evidence) and ensure cross-functional cooperation with Regulatory Affairs, R&D,Biostatistics, Data Management and CDMA Project Teams.
• Develop key study documents such as Design Validation Plans, study protocols, training materials, study forms, templates, and study reports.
• Maintain responsibility for the study-level budget of assigned studies.
• Ensure compliance with regulations, guidelines, and standard operating procedures, while ensuring audit/inspection readiness.
• Oversee execution of sponsored studies for registrational and non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up, conduct, and close-out).
• Manage study activities outsourced to service providers, including CROs, ensuring timely and quality execution.
• Work with the Publication Team to ensure study results are effectively published.
• Track project performance and ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.
• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including cross-functional teams, CROs, opinion leaders, investigators, and key customers. Who are you:
• Strong experience in clinical trial management, particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication. Experience with IVD clinical and analytical system studies in the Core Lab Serum Work Area setting is a plus.
• You have a degree in Life Sciences, Healthc

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally. We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster . Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life . The Opportunity As a Clinical Site Manager specialising in IVDR and Study Start-Up, you will be responsible for designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies at assigned sites. You will work independently to ensure studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocols, standard operating procedures, and global regulatory guidelines. In this role, you will:
• Lead end-to-end study start-up activities , driving site selection, activation, and qualification assessments to ensure clinical trials launch efficiently and are compliance-ready.
• Manage Ethics Committee (EC) and Competent Authority (CA) submissions , ensuring all trial documentation is available, local contracts, Ethics Committee and Competent Authority approvals meet stringent regulatory requirements.
• Provide robust CRO oversight , monitoring external partner deliverables, tracking milestones, and escalation of any issues..
• Act as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, for execution of the study - including training and coordinating certification of study site personnel, and provide technical assistance, as necessary.
• Develop critical study documentation , including informed consent documents, patient instruction guides, and key documents for EC/CA submissions
• Collaborate cross-functionally with global, local, and virtual teams, demonstrating diversity, cultural awareness, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners to achieve business goals and ensure operational excellence. Who You Are You are a proactive, collaborative, and highly organised clinical research professional who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess strong problem-solving skills, make sound independent decisions, and excel at managing external vendor relationships. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• Education & Experience : A degree in a scientific discipline or related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience) combined with a proven track record in clinical operations or clinical trial coordination.
• Study Start-Up & Sub

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories and doctors’ offices. The company employs nearly 3000 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics’ main sites. The Opportunity
• Support the Systems Engineering team with process optimization for medical device development
• Create and develop use cases of AI for design analysis, system performance, and documentation
• Contribution to department specific tasks (maintenance of product specific records, such as requirements or risks using a Lifecycle Management tool (RETINA from codebeamer)
• Collaborate in interdisciplinary development teams
• Status reporting to the respective stakeholder according to project specific requirements Who You are:
• You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program or have recently graduated (within the last 12 months prior to the start date) in one of the following fields: biomedical, electrical or mechanical engineering, systems engineering, biotechnology, chemistry, etc.
• You are interested in new technologies, such as Artificial Intelligence
• You are excited to start your professional career in the medical diagnostics industry
• You should have the ability to communicate clearly with different target groups
• You are motivated to build, manage and foster relationships and networks
• Quick grasp and understanding of complex issues, conceptual and creative thinking
• You have good knowledge of spoken and written English, German is a plus Application process:
• Please upload a current CV, a copy of your diploma certificate, an enrollment certificate, and a motivation letter indicating your preferred start date for the internship.
• Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship. If you are eager to contribute and feel you have the dedication to teamwork and innovation that we are seeking, then Roche is the organization for you. Every role at Roche plays a part in making a difference to patients’ lives. If you want to work in a passionate team, make your mark & improve lives, apply now! Additional Information Start date: August 2026, or upon availability Workload: 100% Duration: 6-12 months Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il dipartimento finanziario di Roche Pharma Schweiz AG combina specialisti di vari settori, come finanza, approvvigionamento, supply chain e approfondimenti strategici e analisi. Insieme, siamo responsabili di analizzare i dati da diverse fonti e generare intuizioni e quindi creare la migliore base possibile per il nostro business. La possibilità Siamo alla ricerca di uno stagista per il nostro Cluster Finance and Business Partnering nella filiale con sede a Basilea, Svizzera. Si lavorerà a stretto contatto con vari membri del team per acquisire preziosa esperienza nella catena di fornitura, sondaggi di soddisfazione del cliente, finanze e appalti. Chi sei:
• Sei attualmente iscritto a un corso di laurea magistrale in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato, o hai completato i tuoi studi ad un massimo di 12 mesi prima dell'inizio dello stage.
• Hai forti capacità analitiche e di problem solving.
• Lavorate in modo affidabile e preciso.
• Hai una comunicazione eccellente e competenze interpersonali.
• Sei sicuro nel gestire Google cSuite e Microsoft Office.
• È possibile lavorare in modo indipendente e in una squadra.
• È possibile padroneggiare perfettamente la lingua tedesca, la conoscenza dell'inglese che è sicuro dalla negoziazione è un vantaggio.
• Supporti la gestione dei dati master.
• Supporti l'implementazione di ricerche di mercato e studi di soddisfazione del cliente per comprendere meglio i nostri clienti e trarre le giuste raccomandazioni da loro.
• Sostenere la finanza nel bilancio mensile, nonché analisi finanziarie, pianificazione e reporting.
• Parteciperete a vari progetti multi-team assegnati dal Finance and Business Partnering Team. Processo di applicazione: La vostra domanda deve contenere un CV e una lettera di motivazione. Informazioni aggiuntive:
• Si prega di notare che, nell'ambito dei documenti di richiesta, i cittadini non UE/EFTA devono presentare un certificato universitario che indica che uno stage è obbligatorio e la durata dello stage obbligatorio.
• Questo stage non è adatto per una tesi master. Se si desidera sviluppare in un ambiente che promuove il lavoro di squadra e l'innovazione, Roche è la società giusta per voi. Qualsiasi ruolo in Roche aiuta a migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Contatta subito! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

titleByLocale.it: Senior Security Ingegnere (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Security Engineer (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms Location: Pune Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud—supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment. As part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we provide the hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support required to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable. As a Senior Security Engineer , you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor, acting as a trusted advisor across distributed teams to drive improvements independently. In this role, you will navigate the complexities of on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure to ensure our security solutions meet strict regulatory requirements while maintaining a highly responsive service delivery ethic. The Opportunity
• Engineer Zero Trust Solutions: Design and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions to protect global corporate resources.
• Manage VPN Infrastructure: Administer and support Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including complex policy management and lifecycle operations.
• Automate Security Workflows: Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and ensure consistency across all security configurations.
• Drive Infrastructure-as-Code: Lead the management of security infrastructure using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations within GitHub.
• Ensure Operational Compliance: Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and strict change management adherence.
• Solve Complex Security Incidents: Independently lead the analysis of cybersecurity incidents, defining problem scopes and driving root cause analysis for vulnerabilities.
• Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated capabilities that support a global, regulated workforce.
• Mentor and Standardize: Provide technical guidance to junior team members and contribute to the development of enterprise-wide security best practices. Who you are
• Experienced Security Engineer: You bring 5–7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, specifically focused on network security and secure access.
• Cloudflare & VPN Expert: You possess demonstrated experience with Cloudflare (Access, Gateway, WAF) and Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN deployment and troubleshooting.
• Infrastructure-as-Code Proficient: You are highly proficient with Terraform and GitHub for version control, collaboration, and automated deployments.
• Regulated Industry Veteran: You have a proven track record working in healthcare, pharma, or finance, with a deep understanding of compliance and audit requirements.
• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
• Automation Mindset: You are skilled in building automation (scripts, workflows, or CI/CD pipelines) to support and scale global security operations.
• Strategic Problem Solver: You are a self-motivated leader capable of owning work end-

You will own the end-to-end insights value chain: from data quality and automation (leveraging AI where it adds value), through dashboard and reporting solutions, to proactive identification of emerging risks and strategic advisory to senior leadership. • Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or equivalent experience.
• Extensive experience providing data-driven insights and strategic recommendations to senior business leaders, ideally within large transformation programs (ERP/SAP context a strong plus).
• Proven track record of building and running performance management or business intelligence solutions in complex, global organizations.
• Experience with program/portfolio reporting, financial planning data, or workforce analytics is an advantage. Technical Skills
• Expertise in data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent) and advanced analytical methodologies.
• Strong capability in managing, integrating, and analyzing enterprise-level datasets from multiple sources.
• Hands-on experience applying AI and automation to data quality, reporting, or insight generation; productive use of AI tools in daily work.
• Ability to design, implement, and own end-to-end reporting frameworks — from data pipeline to executive-level presentation. Additional Qualifications
• Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to distill complex data into clear, decision-ready narratives for senior leadership.
• Deep understanding of how data-driven decision-making supports program steering and business strategy.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• The Head of Customer Engagement & Marketing is a pivotal executive role within the Roche Turkey Leadership Team, entrusted with holistically architecting, leading, and executing the commercial vision and go-to-market strategies for the company's entire pharmaceutical portfolio. This role functions as the "Chief Commercial Conductor," orchestrating and unifying both the strategic business units (Disease Area Teams) and the central marketing capabilities that serve them (Marketing Leads / Marketing Chapter) under a single, cohesive vision. This leader directly manages and develops two distinct leadership groups: the Disease Area (DA) Leads and the Marketing Leads. Through the DA Leads, they hold ultimate accountability for the therapeutic area strategies and full P&L outcomes. Concurrently, through the Marketing Leads, they are responsible for embedding marketing excellence, fostering state-of-the-art capabilities, and ensuring the agile, strategic allocation of marketing resources across the entire Organization. The fundamental purpose of this role is to build a seamless bridge between high-level strategy and flawless execution. By leveraging a deep strategic partnership with the Medical, Access, Regulatory & Government affairs, as well as the Business Excellence Division, this leader will ensure Roche achieves its ambitious market leadership and patient impact goals. Core Responsibilities and Accountabilities 1. Integrated Commercial, Access, Medical, and Government Affairs strategy & execution:
• Architect and drive the overarching commercial strategy for all Disease Areas, ensuring the creation of integrated, omnichannel marketing and sales plans that are executed with excellence in the field.
• Lead portfolio-level strategic planning, including lifecycle management, competitive readiness, and new asset launch sequencing to maximize the long-term commercial value and patient impact of Roche’s portfolio.
• Assume ultimate ownership of commercial forecasting in partnership with finance, resource allocation, and budget management to ensure financial targets are met, and investments yield maximum ROI.
• 2. Disease Area (DA) P&L and Performance Leadership:
• Provide strategic direction, coaching, and empowerment to the DA Leads, holding full P&L accountability for the entire commercial organization. Drive the achievement of ambitious revenue growth, market share, and profitability targets.
• Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and urgency within the DA teams, ensuring they remain laser-focused on overcoming obstacles and achieving their strategic objectives.
• Ensure DA teams have the necessary resources, capabilities, and cross-functional support to win in their respective markets.
• 3. Marketing Capability & Excellence (Marketing Lead) Leadership:
• Lead and cultivate the central Marketing Leads (Marketing Chapter) team, acting as the chief steward of marketing talent and capability within the organization.
• Take direct responsibility for the professional development, career progression, performance management, and succession planning for the marketing talent pool.
• Implement a dynamic resource allocation model, ensuring marketing expertise is deployed fluidly and effectively to the highest-priority strategic initiatives within the DA teams.
• Champion and embed a culture of marketing excellence across the organization, setting the gold standard for brand planning, digital marketing, data analytics, customer journey mapping,

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is initially for a fixed-term contract 12 months. The employment contract will be concluded by our vendor/third party for outsourcing services. We have a fantastic and challenging opportunity to fully combine your recruiting and consulting skills to seek, attract, and bring in the very best talent into Roche. This is with a focus on supporting the demand for talent within our Roche EMEA region. As a Talent Acquisition Partner you will play a pivotal role in ensuring we are hiring the best talent to meet our business ambitions. Make Your Mark. Improve Lives. You will be part of the Roche EMEA Recruiting team, a group of highly skilled professionals in our Integrated Workforce Strategies organization. The geographic focus will be Extended Eastern Europe (EEE) & CIS countries, however you will also be collaborating closely within the Region EMEA where we swarm our capacities to achieve our region’s goals as one team, and also within our global network. This position reports to the Recruiting Lead EEE & CIS countries. Your Impact
• Be a professional and consultative partner for our business leaders regarding all talent acquisition aspects
• Expertly drive end-to-end recruiting processes and provide customized talent acquisition strategies and solutions, including active candidate sourcing & pipelining, talent marketing, talent selection, candidate experience, and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
• Manage the offer process with all necessary stakeholders (create an offer proposal following our Roche compensation and benefits framework and pay equity considerations, obtain approvals, extend offers, and negotiate with the candidate if required)
• Closely collaborate with the other People and Culture colleagues in-country, particularly the Business Partners to have insight about the coming business priorities, and the People Relations Partners to ensure a high confidentiality of recruitment-related topics
• May lead recruitment transformation projects across functions/countries Who You Are
• University degree in Human Resources Management, Business Management, Economics, Marketing, Finance is preferred
• You are fluent in English but also having additional language skills are an advantage
• You are preferably working in the Life Science/Tech industry and have a high passion for People and Culture, particularly for Talent Acquisition with proven success as a recruiter or head-hunter
• You are well-versed in talent attraction, sourcing, and assessing across multiple geographies and varied levels of complexity and expert in applicant tracking and sourcing tools such as Workday, Phenom People, LinkedIn
• You excel at building and maintaining relationships with stakeholders across all levels, both within our business and the People and Culture team, leveraging excellent communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills to collaborate, negotiate, and innovate effectively
• You have excellent coaching and advising skills, and thus are a trusted partner to your business clients and enable them in their hiring decisions
• You can work in a multinational matrix organization with the dexterity to participate in or lead recruiting squads across regions or globally Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/month. Final salary will depend on the level of experience and skills. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns bewegt, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft ständig voran und sorgen dafür, dass alle Menschen heute und in Zukunft Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung haben, die sie brauchen. Eine Welt zu schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das ist es, was uns zu Roche macht. In der R&D-Abteilung Process Technologies and Material Science (Teil von Roche Diagnostics Solutions) entwickeln wir chemische Einsatzstoffe für das gesamte diagnostische Produktportfolio. Das Team Bioorganic Development & Transfer besteht aus 8 Mitarbeitenden mit wissenschaftlichem und technischem Hintergrund. Wir arbeiten an organisch-chemischen Synthesen und Up-scale Projekten und gehen dabei flexibel und zielorientiert vor, um maßgeschneiderte Moleküle für unsere Projektpartner zu entwickeln. Dabei legen wir Wert auf eine hohe Qualität und den Spaß an der gemeinsamen Arbeit. Deine zentralen Aufgaben In dieser Rolle bringst Du Deine fundierte Labor-Expertise direkt in die Entwicklung innovativer Diagnostika ein:
• Synthese & Herstellung: Du planst und führst eigenständig organisch-präparative Synthesen im Bereich niedermolekularer Verbindungen und deren funktionellen Bausteinen durch
• Up-Scale Arbeiten: Darüber hinaus bist Du für die Maßstabsvergrößerung chemischer Reaktionen vom Milligramm- bis in den Multigramm-Bereich verantwortlich
• Chromatographie & Downstream Prozesse: Du bringst Deine Expertise in die Aufreinigung komplexer Reaktionsmischungen ein (z. B. Flash-Chromatographie, HPLC) und optimierst Downstream-Prozesse
• Charakterisierung : Du isolierst die Zielverbindungen und nutzt moderne analytische Methoden (z. B. NMR, MS, HPLC/UV) zur Strukturaufklärung und In-Prozess-Kontrolle
• Prozessoptimierung & Transfer: Du optimierst etablierte Syntheseprozesse, um einen reibungslosen Transfer in die Produktion vorzubereiten und erstellst die entsprechenden Verfahrensanweisungen
• Dokumentation & Innovation: Du dokumentierst Deine Ergebnisse präzise, präsentierst diese im Team und setzt Dein Spezialwissen ein, um Projekte innerhalb von Roche Diagnostics voranzutreiben Dein Profil
• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Chemie (Bachelor) mit Schwerpunkt Organische Chemie oder eine Ausbildung zum Chemielaborant mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Darüber hinaus bringst Du tiefgreifende Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung in der klassischen präparativen organischen Synthese mit
• Auf Dein fundiertes Know-how in der präparativen Chromatographie sowie auf Deine Erfahrung beim Up-scale von chemischen Prozessen können wir uns voll und ganz verlassen
• Ein sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Charakterisierungsmethoden (NMR, MS, HPLC) zeichnet Dich aus
• Du hast Freude an der Lösung komplexer chemischer Fragestellungen und am Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Team
• Zuverlässigkeit, Gewissenhaftigkeit und eine strukturierte Vorgehensweise sind für Dich selbstverständlich
• Außerdem bist Du ein Teamplayer mit sicherem Kommunikationsstil in Deutsch und Englisch Diese Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet. Deine Bewerbung Wir machen es Dir leicht: Bitte lade lediglich Deinen aktuellen, aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf sowie das Zeugnis Deines höchsten Abschlusses hoch. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global

title: Record to Report Period End Close Senior Analyst

titleByLocale.it: Record to Report Period End Close Senior Analista
titleByLocale.en: Record to Report Period End Close Senior Analyst
titleByLocale.de: Record to Report Period End Close Senior Analyst
titleByLocale.fr: Record to Report Period End Close Senior Analyste

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As a R2R Period-End Close Senior Analyst based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be an integral part of our Global Shared Services organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert, delivering advanced accounting support and complex financial analysis while driving process improvements and automation initiatives. You will act as a key point of contact for accounting and reporting matters, serving as a trusted advisor for our supported affiliates. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Accounting Expertise & Audit Leadership: Lead complex accounting analyses and audit activities for assigned areas. You will serve as a subject matter expert for affiliates and internal stakeholders, ensuring technical accounting excellence.
• Financial Reporting & Close Activities: Prepare and review complex financial statements and reports. You will manage month-end close activities, including journal entries, cost allocations, and reconciliations, while maintaining a proper audit trail and compliance with standards.
• Analysis, Commentary & Advisory: Analyze financial results to investigate variances and provide clear, actionable insights to management. You will interpret and communicate financial data effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.
• Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Team Development: Support the growth of the team through coaching, reviewing work, and contributing to cross-functional initiatives and global projects.
• Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements and support automation initiatives to increase the efficiency of the Record-to-Report flow. Who you are: You are a highly analytical finance professional with a strong attention to detail, capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment to meet tight deadlines. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance , or a related field. A professional certification ( CPA, ACCA , or equivalent) is preferred.
• Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of experience in accounting or finance. Prior experience in a Finance Shared Services environment is preferred. Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is a plus.
• Technical Skills: * Strong knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS .

The Position The Opportunity: The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a CyberSecurity Analyst -Monitoring & Incident Response , you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems. Note: As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents. Responsibilities:
• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment
• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information
• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts
• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents
• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations
• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team
• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group
• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management
• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes
• Mentor newer team members Who You Are:
• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment
• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices
• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience
• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents
• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts
• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)
• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)
• Excellent organization and communication skills.
• Fluent spoken and written English Preferred Qualifications:
• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment
• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring
• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)
• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)
• A passion for the field of computer and network security
• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As a Cash Applications & Accounts Receivable Accountant based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be a key driver of financial accuracy within the Roche Services Americas team. This center provides critical Finance and Procurement services to various countries across the Americas region. Your primary mission is to ensure that all incoming payments are identified, matched, and applied to customer accounts with precision, effectively "closing the loop" on the Invoice-to-Cash cycle. Key Responsibilities:
• Cash Application: Execute daily posting of incoming payments (Wire, ACH, Checks) and accurately match remittances to customer invoices.
• Reconciliation: Manage bank account reconciliations and clear AR/bank suspense accounts to ensure zero unexplained variances.
• Operational AR: Handle manual invoicing, corrections, and customer credit analysis to support regional financial health.
• Dispute Management: Identify and code payment discrepancies (short-pays/over-payments) and resolve inquiries from affiliates and customers.
• Process Improvement: Propose automation and system enhancements (SAP/BlackLine) to improve "auto-match" rates and SSC efficiency. Who You Are: You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong understanding of accounting flows and a commitment to high-integrity financial reporting. Qualifications:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or related field .
• Experience: 3+ years in Finance/Accounting; Shared Services experience is a plus.
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP, BlackLine , or similar ERPs, and advanced Excel/G-Suite skills.
• Languages: Intermediate Portuguese is required for the role. Intermediate English is required for the role.
• Competencies: Strong ability to prioritize under tight deadlines and a focus on proactive problem-solving. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Technology Transfer Group plays a crucial role in guaranteeing a steady supply of medications to patients by expertly managing and executing projects and transfers within the Roche Pharma portfolio. As a key component of the Pharma Technical Strategy organization, we drive product strategies by seamlessly transferring processes and knowledge across different sites. Our End-to-End project leadership, from sourcing to registration, ensures optimal speed, coordination, and flexibility, thereby enhancing the agility and resilience of the Roche Pharma supply chain. Collaborating closely with other teams within the Pharma Technical organization, we are committed to continuous improvement and implementation. The Opportunity:
• As a Technology Transfer Associate Intern, you will be a key player in empowering our Technology Transfer Team. Your mission will be to examine and improve our current processes, templates, systems, and tools. Working closely with the Technology Transfer Portfolio Manager, you will supervise Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and support the development, analysis, and reporting of valuable business insights to a diverse range of stakeholders. Additionally, you will partner with Global Technology Transfer Leaders (GTTLs) on key projects and handle various administrative tasks as needed. Your contributions will drive innovation and efficiency within our team.
• Collaborate with Tech Transfer Leads to maintain and improve Database (Airtable) and Dashboard (Tableau) for efficient data Assist in onboarding new Tech Transfer Leads, generate key reports for stakeholders and leadership teams, and develop onboarding materials.
• Process Standardization: Work with the Portfolio Manager and various stakeholders to streamline and standardize the End-to-End Tech Transfer Portfolio Management Processes.
• Lead the update of the Tech Transfer Academy’s content, including GSP078, and author the Quarterly Newsletter.
• Manage team drives, sites, processes, templates, systems, and tools, and support the organization, facilitation, and documentation of Tech Transfer for Future (TF) meetings. Who You Are:
• You hold an undergraduate degree in sciences, digital healthcare, life sciences, or related fields.
• You are currently enrolled in a Masters program in the fields of Biotechnology or closely related fields. Preferred Skills and Experience:
• Knowledge and experience in project management principles, Agile methodologies, data analytics, and visualization tools.
• Experience working with cross-functional and virtual teams.
• Ability to build positive relationships with stakeholders, excellent facilitation, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
• Capability to communicate optimally across all organizational levels.
• High drive to manage multiple priorities and a willingness to handle tasks of varying complexity.
• Continuous learning demeanor and proficiency in Microsoft and Google Suites, with a willingness to learn gSites and SharePoint. Additional Information: Location: Hybrid, Based in Mississauga (minimum 3 days in the office) Hours: full-time (35 hours per week) Length: This position is a 12-month work term (full-time) and is expected to begin in September 2026. Please note that relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 57 416,00 and 75 358,50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualification

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Join our diverse, open, and friendly team as an Intern – Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer in Mississauga, where we leverage technology to revolutionize the practice of medicine. You will have the unique opportunity to collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams to design and deploy high-quality data solutions, focusing heavily on Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve patient outcomes. Bring your enthusiasm for technological advancements to help us achieve our mission: to do now what patients need next. The Opportunity:
• Collaborate with experienced Data Scientists, engineers, and cross-functional teams to address complex problems using modern NLP technologies and LLMs.
• Assist in building robust data and deployment pipelines for machine learning models.
• Contribute to the development, deployment, and performance tuning of innovative machine learning models based on business and functional requirements.
• Document and communicate design and implementation details effectively while assisting the AI team in making key technical decisions.
• Partner with clients and informatics departments to deploy scalable solutions, actively participating in troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
• Thrive in a knowledge-sharing team environment that deeply values diverse experiences and a variety of perspectives. Who You Are:
• You are a passionate, customer-focused, and enthusiastic individual with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. You communicate effectively and enjoy working with diverse, virtual teams from different locations and cultural backgrounds.
• Your minimum qualifications and experience include:
• You are currently pursuing a Master's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., mathematics, statistics, computer science) or a Life Sciences degree with significant computational experience.
• You have programming capabilities in languages such as Python or R, alongside an awareness of good coding practices and test-driven development.
• You bring experience or coursework related to Large Language Model (LLM) applications development (e.g., RAG, code interpreter) and a basic understanding of building LLM data/deployment pipelines.
• You possess exposure to ML/AI toolkits (such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, AWS SageMaker) and basic knowledge of cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) and MLOps technologies.
• You hold basic knowledge of development tools like git, bash, Linux, and CI/CD tools, with proven scripting and automation skills. Additional Information:
• Location: Mississauga, ON.
• Modality: Hybrid (majority of days in the office).
• Full time (35 hours per week)
• Duration 12 months with an approximate start date in September 2026. Please note that relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 57 416,00 and 75 358,50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. This position partners with customers and internal stakeholders (sales, global Roche Consulting teams, RSN, marketing, IT, and other teams) to address customers' unique priorities, challenges, and needs through continuous improvement efforts, including (but not limited to) collecting and reviewing customer feedback, refining methods/tools, performing complex analyses, and recommending solutions. This position utilizes a consultative approach and technical expertise to ensure the customer is prepared and the Roche solution is verified to be implemented and deliver expected results. The Opportunity:
• Verify and validate that the proposed Roche solution still meets or exceeds customers' expected results before Implementation
• Provide implementation support to customers and installation teams; collaboratively develop detailed customer installation requirements with customers, Roche Support Network, Workflow Consulting, and other teams
• Responsible for identifying opportunities to optimize the implemented Roche solution and collaborating with appropriate Roche partners to take action to accomplish optimization
• Collaborate with RC team members to develop metrics that provide data for process measurement; identify indicators for future improvement opportunities; collect data to identify root causes of problems; measure performance against process requirements; align improvement to performance targets
• Collaborate with fellow Roche Consulting colleagues to use, refine, and evolve proprietary tools and techniques to generate high-value deliverables, best practices, and methods delivering differentiated, value-creating consulting services and position Roche’s portfolio of solutions
• Perform related administrative duties such as creating and submitting expense, reports, and status reports and adhere to any additional regulatory requirements Who You Are: The ideal candidate is a seasoned laboratory professional with wide-ranging experience addressing complex issues, requiring in-depth analysis and evaluation of many factors. Exercising appropriate judgment in selecting evaluation methods and determining solution criteria is critical. The ideal candidate demonstrates agility in a rapidly changing, matrixed organization and is comfortable operating in an evolving, ambiguous environment. Additionally, the ideal candidate is comfortable coordinating the activities of others, networking with internal and external senior personnel in areas of expertise, and networking with key contacts outside the area of expertise. • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, Sciences or closely related scientific/technical discipline.
• Experience with process mapping, statistical and reporting tools
