descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo è un momento emozionante per aderire alla rete di supporto Roche. Se siete appassionati di problem solving allora questa è la posizione per voi! In qualità di società di assistenza sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche scopre, sviluppa e fornisce prodotti e servizi diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi che forniscono benefici significativi ai pazienti e ai professionisti sanitari - dalla rilevazione precoce e prevenzione delle malattie alla diagnostica, al monitoraggio del trattamento e del trattamento. Roche è una società di successo che può offrire interessanti opportunità di carriera. Incoraggiamo e sosteniamo il vostro sviluppo in aree di vostro interesse che vi preparerà per il prossimo livello nel vostro percorso di carriera. Sappiamo che le persone sono responsabili del nostro successo e apprezziamo i nostri dipendenti. Il nostro impegno è quello di creare un ambiente di lavoro in cui sentirsi valorizzati, rispettati e potenziati è un'esperienza quotidiana. In qualità di specialista di applicazioni sul campo, sarai un membro chiave del nostro team di assistenza clienti come principale rappresentante scientifico e tecnico in Austin, TX per i sistemi Roche nei laboratori dei clienti all'interno dello spazio Core Lab. Sarete responsabili di fornire il miglior supporto clienti in loco, tra cui attività come, l'implementazione delle applicazioni, la formazione dell'operatore e la risoluzione dei problemi per la strumentazione diagnostica e le analisi durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. L'opportunità:
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e collaborative con le parti interessate del cliente, garantendo un elevato livello di soddisfazione del cliente e creando valore nelle operazioni di laboratorio del cliente. Consultare i clienti sulle esigenze del laboratorio e agire come partner supportando il cliente durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto che potrebbe includere aggiornamenti di prodotto e altre modifiche.
• Eseguire e/o assistere con l'installazione di strumenti diagnostici complessi, software e applicazioni reagente nei laboratori del cliente. Convalida le prestazioni del sistema per garantire che soddisfi le specifiche del produttore. Assicurare un'applicazione efficace e coesa delle soluzioni appena installate.
• Fornire e, in alcuni casi, sviluppare una formazione completa in loco al personale di laboratorio sul corretto uso e manutenzione dei sistemi Roche, tra cui teoria del funzionamento, flusso di lavoro, controllo della qualità e interpretazione dei dati.
• Agire come risorsa principale in loco per risolvere problemi tecnici complessi relativi alla strumentazione, software e prestazioni di analisi. Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice e implementare azioni correttive per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo dello strumento. Partner con altri membri del team Roche per implementare e supportare soluzioni totali, come l'automazione, gli strumenti digitali, ecc.
• Fornire competenze scientifiche e applicative agli stakeholder di laboratorio (questo potrebbe includere supervisori, manager, direttori, tecnici) e professionisti medici (questo potrebbe includere patologi, medici), aiutandoli a garantire operazioni di laboratorio coesi ottimizzando i flussi di lavoro, implementando nuovi saggi e interpretando i risultati per il portafoglio di Roche.
• Servire come collegamento al cliente e raccogliere feedback da parte dei clienti sulle prestazioni, le caratteristiche e l'usabilità del prodotto, e poi relay queste informazioni di supporto e team commerciali, mantenendo un vantaggio competitivo.
• Partner con il team di vendita e sfruttare le conoscenze tecniche approfondite durante le attività pre-vendita, tra cui dimostrazioni di prodotto, consultazioni tecniche, ottimizzazione dei menu e altre opportunità post-vendita, generazione di ricavi.
• Assicurare esperienze di cliente coerenti seguendo protocolli e procedure Roche.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience. As a Field Applications Specialist, you will be a key member of our Customer Support team as the primary scientific and technical representative in Austin, TX for Roche systems in customer laboratories within the Core Lab space. You will be responsible for providing best-in-class on-site customer support, including activities such as, application implementation, operator training, and troubleshooting for diagnostic instrumentation and assays throughout the entire product life cycle. The Opportunity:
• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with customer stakeholders, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and creating value within the customer’s lab operations. Consult with customers on lab needs and act as a partner by supporting the customer throughout the product lifecycle which could include supporting product upgrades and other changes.
• Perform and/or assist with the installation of complex diagnostic instruments, software, and reagent applications in customer laboratories. Validate system performance to ensure it meets manufacturer specifications. Ensure effective and cohesive application of the newly installed solutions.
• Deliver and, in some cases develop, comprehensive on-site training to laboratory personnel on the proper use and maintenance of Roche systems, including theory of operation, workflow, quality control, and data interpretation.
• Act as the primary on-site resource for resolving complex technical issues related to instrumentation, software, and assay performance. Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to minimize instrument downtime. Partner with other Roche team members to implement and support total solutions, such as automation, digital tools, etc.
• Provide scientific and applications expertise to laboratory stakeholders (this could include supervisors, managers, directors, technologists) and medical professionals (this could include pathologists, doctors), helping them ensure cohesive lab operations by optimizing workflows, implementing new assays, and interpreting results for Roche's portfolio.
• Serve as the customer liaison and collect feedback from customers on product performance, features, and usability, and then relay this information back to support and commercial teams, maintaining a competitive advantage.
• Partner with the sales team and leverage in-depth technical knowledge during pre-sales activities, including product demonstrations, technical consultations, menu optimization, and other post-sales, revenue-generating opportunities.
• Ensure consistent customer experiences by following Roche protocols and procedures.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Dies ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich dem Roche Support Network anzuschließen. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich über Problemlösung sind, dann ist dies die Position für Sie! Als forschungsorientiertes Healthcare-Unternehmen entdeckt, entwickelt und bietet Roche innovative Diagnostik und therapeutische Produkte und Dienstleistungen, die für Patienten und medizinische Fachkräfte von der Früherkennung und Prävention von Krankheiten bis hin zur Diagnostik, Behandlung und Therapieüberwachung profitieren. Roche ist ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen, das spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten bieten kann. Wir fördern und unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung in Bereichen Ihres Interesses, die Sie auf die nächste Stufe in Ihrem Karriereweg vorbereiten. Wir wissen, dass Menschen für unseren Erfolg verantwortlich sind und wir unsere Mitarbeiter schätzen. Unser Engagement ist es, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem das Gefühl geschätzt, respektiert und gestärkt wird, ein tägliches Erlebnis ist. Als Field Applications Specialist sind Sie als primärer wissenschaftlicher und technischer Vertreter in Austin, TX für Roche-Systeme in Kundenlaboren im Core Lab-Bereich, unser Customer Support-Team. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Kundenbetreuung vor Ort, einschließlich Aktivitäten wie, Anwendung Implementierung, Bedienertraining und Fehlerbehebung für diagnostische Instrumentierung und Assays während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Die Gelegenheit:
• Erstellen und pflegen Sie starke, kollaborative Beziehungen zu Kundenvertretern, um ein hohes Maß an Kundenzufriedenheit und Wertschöpfung im Laborbetrieb des Kunden sicherzustellen. Besprechen Sie den Kunden auf den Laborbedarf und handeln Sie als Partner, indem Sie den Kunden während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus unterstützen, der Produkt-Upgrades und andere Änderungen unterstützen könnte.
• Durchführung und/oder Unterstützung bei der Installation komplexer diagnosischer Instrumente, Software und Reagenzienanwendungen in Kundenlabors. Gültige Systemleistung, um sicherzustellen, dass es den Herstellerspezifikationen entspricht. Gewährleistung einer effektiven und kohäsiven Anwendung der neu installierten Lösungen.
• Bereitstellung und in einigen Fällen eine umfassende Vor-Ort-Training an Laborpersonal bei der ordnungsgemäßen Nutzung und Wartung von Roche-Systemen, einschließlich der Theorie der Operation, Workflow, Qualitätskontrolle und Dateninterpretation.
• Aktivieren Sie als primäre Vor-Ort-Ressource zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Instrumentierung, Software und Testleistung. Führen Sie Root Ursache Analyse und implementieren Korrekturmaßnahmen, um Instrument Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren. Mit anderen Roche-Team-Mitgliedern werden Gesamtlösungen wie Automatisierung, digitale Werkzeuge etc. implementiert und unterstützt.
• Bereitstellung von wissenschaftlichen und Anwendungen Expertise für Labor-Stakeholder (dies könnte unter anderem Aufsichtspersonen, Manager, Direktoren, Technologen) und medizinische Fachkräfte (dies könnte Pathologen, Ärzte umfassen), die ihnen helfen, kohäsive Laboroperationen zu gewährleisten, indem sie Workflows optimieren, neue Assays implementieren und Ergebnisse für Roches Portfolio interpretieren.
• Servieren Sie als Kundenverbindung und sammeln Sie Feedback von Kunden über Produktleistung, Funktionen und Usability, und übermitteln Sie diese Informationen dann an Support- und Handelsteams, wobei ein Wettbewerbsvorteil erhalten wird.
• Partner des Vertriebsteams und nutzen fundiertes technisches Wissen während der Vorverkaufsaktivitäten, darunter Produktdemonstrationen, technische Beratungen, Menüoptimierung und andere Post-Sales, Umsatzerzeugende Möglichkeiten.
• Gewährleistung konsistenter Kundenerfahrungen nach den Roche-Protokollen und Verfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position C'est une période passionnante pour rejoindre le réseau de soutien Roche. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes alors c'est la position pour vous! En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre succès et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne. En tant que spécialiste des applications sur le terrain, vous serez un membre clé de notre équipe de support client en tant que principal représentant scientifique et technique à Austin, TX pour Roche systèmes dans les laboratoires clients dans l'espace Core Lab. Vous serez responsable de fournir le meilleur service client en classe sur place, y compris des activités telles que la mise en œuvre d'applications, la formation des opérateurs et le dépannage des instruments de diagnostic et des essais tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. La possibilité :
• Établir et maintenir des relations solides et collaboratives avec les parties prenantes du client, en assurant un niveau élevé de satisfaction du client et en créant de la valeur dans les opérations du laboratoire du client. Consulter les clients sur les besoins des laboratoires et agir en tant que partenaire en appuyant le client tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, ce qui pourrait inclure des améliorations du produit et d'autres changements.
• Effectuer et/ou aider à l'installation d'instruments de diagnostic complexes, de logiciels et d'applications de réactif dans les laboratoires clients. Valider la performance du système pour s'assurer qu'il répond aux spécifications du fabricant. Assurer l'application efficace et cohérente des solutions nouvellement installées.
• Offrir et, dans certains cas, développer une formation complète sur place au personnel de laboratoire sur l'utilisation et la maintenance correctes des systèmes Roche, y compris la théorie du fonctionnement, le flux de travail, le contrôle de la qualité et l'interprétation des données.
• Être la principale ressource sur place pour résoudre les problèmes techniques complexes liés à l'instrumentation, aux logiciels et aux performances d'essai. Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt des instruments. Partenaire avec d'autres membres de l'équipe Roche pour mettre en œuvre et soutenir des solutions complètes, telles que l'automatisation, les outils numériques, etc.
• Fournir une expertise scientifique et des applications aux parties prenantes du laboratoire (y compris les superviseurs, les gestionnaires, les directeurs, les technologues) et aux professionnels de la santé (y compris les pathologistes, les médecins), les aider à assurer la cohérence des opérations de laboratoire en optimisant les flux de travail, en mettant en oeuvre de nouveaux tests et en interprétant les résultats pour le portefeuille de Roche.
• Servir de liaison avec le client et recueillir les commentaires des clients sur les performances, les caractéristiques et la facilité d'utilisation du produit, puis transmettre ces informations aux équipes de soutien et commerciales, en maintenant un avantage concurrentiel.
• S'associer à l'équipe de vente et tirer parti de connaissances techniques approfondies lors des activités préventes, y compris les démonstrations de produits, les consultations techniques, l'optimisation des menus et d'autres occasions de générer des revenus après les ventes.
• Assurer une expérience client cohérente en suivant les protocoles et procédures Roche.

titleByLocale.it: Senior Security Ingegnere (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Security Engineer Impact Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud — supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment. Do you want to make a meaningful impact as a Security Engineer focused on secure access and network security? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, self-directed environment? If so, we’d love to hear from you! What You Will Do As a Security Engineer on the Secure Access team, you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor who brings both deep technical expertise and the energy to drive improvements independently. Purpose The Secure Access team engineers, delivers, and supports the solutions used to provide secure network access across the corporate environment — spanning on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. The team provides hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable in a regulated industry context. Key Activities and Deliverables
• Design, implement, and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions.
• Administer and support GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including policy management, troubleshooting, and lifecycle operations.
• Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and improve consistency across security configurations.
• Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations in GitHub.
• Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and change management compliance.
• Ensure security solutions meet regulatory requirements and support audit and compliance activities.
• Proactively identify gaps in access controls and propose improvements with a self-driven, solution-oriented mindset.
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners including network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated secure access capabilities.
• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices Job Skills Required
• High energy, self-motivated, and capable of owning work end-to-end with minimal direction.
• Accountability/Problem Solving : Independently leads the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems, clearly defining the security problem scope and driving root cause analysis for security breaches or vulnerabilities
• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor
• Strong customer focus with a highly responsive service delivery and support ethic.
• Collaborative and communicative — comfortable working across distributed, cross-functional teams.
• Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality, documentation, and operational excellence.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Qualifications and Experience Required
• 5-7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, with a focus on network security and secure access technologies.
• Demonstrated hands-on experie

As a Senior Data Center Network Engineer, you will join a culture of technical excellence, architecting resilient, high-performance infrastructures that empower our global mission. You will act as a technical expert, leveraging advanced automation to solve critical business challenges and drive our digital evolution. The Opportunity:
• Architect Scalable Networks: Lead the end-to-end design and deployment of "first-time-right" network solutions, specifically focusing on Spine-Leaf topologies and L2/L3 fabrics.
• Drive Technical Leadership: Act as a Solution Architect for large initiatives, managing resource estimation, dependencies, and risk mitigation across technical teams.
• Implement Network as Code: Modernize operations by developing and maintaining Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure scalable, repeatable deployments.
• Master Complex Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to diagnose complex network incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
• Maximize System Reliability: Define and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) through advanced telemetry and streaming analytics to ensure "five-nines" availability.
• Influence Strategic Roadmaps: Translate technical roadmaps into business value for stakeholders and steer vendor product evaluations to align with long-term strategy.
• Lead Seamless Migrations: Oversee high-stakes brownfield-to-greenfield migrations with a focus on hitless cutovers and zero-downtime execution.
• Foster Innovation and Growth: Proactively refine fabric performance and mentor junior engineers, contributing to a workplace culture of continuous learning. Who you are:
• Experienced Architect: You bring deep mastery of Arista EOS and EVPN-VXLAN architectures, with a proven track record of designing large-scale fabrics.
• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and bring years of relevant industry experience; CCIE-level expertise is highly desirable.
• Automation Expert: You are proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), specifically using Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines for network automation.
• Strategic Thinker: You possess the ability to translate complex system concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Resilient Problem Solver: You demonstrate expert-level troubleshooting skills and remain decisive in high-pressure, complex technical scenarios.
• Project Leader: You have significant experience leading technical teams through complex project dependencies and risk management.
• Visionary Engineer: You are a proactive learner who stays ahead of industry trends to maintain architectural excellence in modern fabric environments. A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Marketing Technologies (MarTech) incorporato all’interno della funzione GPS Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), riunirà le funzionalità chiave di business e IT con l’ambizione di aggiungere significato e valore a tutte le interazioni dei clienti di Roche attraverso un unico, comune, ecosistema integrato di tecnologia customer-centric. Il Marketing Technologies (MarTech) Business Operations Manager è un ruolo fondamentale dedicato a garantire che i nostri investimenti tecnologici traducono in performance aziendali tangibili. Invece di focalizzarsi sulla manutenzione tecnica, si supervisionerà un quadro di prontezza aziendale, progettando le strutture di governance e operative che permettono ai nostri team di capitalizzare su nuovi strumenti senza interrompere le prestazioni di base. Sei tu il custode dello "stato gestito", responsabile per garantire che i risultati aziendali e la crescita siano migliorati attraverso l'uso efficace della tecnologia. Un driver primario di successo per questo ruolo è la continua evoluzione dei nostri processi aziendali. Il vostro obiettivo è quello di garantire che il nostro modello operativo non è solo stabile, ma un vantaggio competitivo, offrendo miglioramenti misurabili in velocità-vendita, costo-per-serve e produttività organizzativa complessiva. L'opportunità In qualità di Business Operations Manager, sei responsabile dell'implementazione delle modifiche e della gestione del modello di servizio per garantire il successo operativo a lungo termine e la sostenibilità delle nostre piattaforme aziendali. Sosterrai le operazioni aziendali Piombo nella gestione dell'intera transizione dall'implementazione guidata dal progetto ad uno stato stabile, continuo e ad alto rendimento "business come al solito" (BAU).
• Verificare i flussi di lavoro aziendali esistenti per identificare le inefficienze; guidare la progettazione e l'implementazione di processi "to-be" che massimizzano il valore del nostro stack tecnologico semplificando l'esperienza dell'utente
• Attuazione della governance "run-state" necessaria per gestire i cambiamenti dei processi aziendali in corso. Ti assicurerai che le future iterazioni tecniche siano prioritarie in base alla loro capacità di fornire valore aziendale e stabilità organizzativa
• Partner con gli utenti finali per valutare in che modo i cambiamenti tecnici incidono sugli utenti e sugli strati operativi del business, assicurando che l'allocazione delle risorse sia ottimizzata per nuovi modi di lavoro e servizi pertinenti siano risorse e formati adeguatamente
• Identificare le lacune del modello operativo che si traducono nella realizzazione del valore mancato/perso e proporre tattiche per capitalizzare sulle opportunità mancate
• Operativealise il quadro di governance 'run-state' per la gestione del processo aziendale, della soluzione, dei dati e delle modifiche degli utenti dopo il go-live
• Stabilire e monitorare gli indicatori di performance chiave (KPI) relativi alla velocità di processo, al costo di servizio e all'attrito operativo, guidando una cultura del miglioramento continuo
• Gestire l'allineamento delle parti interessate (con fornitori, RDT/IT e business) per garantire che tutti i piani di transizione e il futuro modello "run" siano co-creati e pienamente supportati Chi sei Il successo di questo ruolo richiede un leader altamente strutturato e orientato al processo con una profonda comprensione delle operazioni aziendali e della gestione dei servizi. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Marketing Technologies (MarTech) embedded within the GPS Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI) function, will bring together key business and IT capabilities with the ambition to add meaning and value to all Roche’s customer interactions through a single, common, integrated customer-centric technology ecosystem. The Marketing Technologies (MarTech) Business Operations Manager is a critical role dedicated to ensuring that our technology investments translate into tangible business performance. Rather than focusing on technical maintenance, you will oversee a business readiness framework, designing the governance and operational structures that allow our teams to capitalize on new tools without disrupting core performance. You are the custodian of the "run state," responsible for ensuring that the business outcomes and growth are enhanced through the effective use of technology. A primary driver of success for this role is the continuous evolution of our business processes. Your objective is to ensure that our operational model is not just stable, but a competitive advantage, delivering measurable improvements in speed-to-market, cost-to-serve, and overall organisational productivity. The Opportunity As the Business Operations Manager, you are responsible for implementing changes and managing the service model to ensure the long-term operational success and sustainability of our business platforms. You will support the Business Operations Lead in managing the entire transition from project-led implementation to a stable, continuous, and high-performing "business as usual" (BAU) state.
• Audit existing business workflows to identify inefficiencies; lead the design and implementation of "to-be" processes that maximize the value of our technology stack while simplifying user experience
• Implementation of the "run-state" governance required to manage ongoing business process changes. You will ensure that any future technical iterations are prioritized based on their ability to deliver business value and organizational stability
• Partner with end users to assess how technical shifts impact the user and operational layers of the business, ensuring that resource allocation is optimized for new ways of working and relevant services are resourced and trained appropriately
• Identifies gaps in the operational model that translate into missed/lost value realisation and propose tactics to capitalise on missed opportunities
• Operationalise the 'run-state' governance framework for managing ongoing business process, solution, data and user changes after go-live
• Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to process speed, cost-to-serve, and operational friction, driving a culture of continuous improvement
• Manage stakeholder alignment (with vendors, RDT/IT, and business) to ensure all transition plans and the future "run" model are co-created and fully supported Who you are Success in this role requires a highly structured, process-oriented leader with a deep understanding of business operations and service management. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Der Marketing Technologies (MarTech) Business Operations Manager ist eine wichtige Rolle, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Technologie-Investitionen in greifbare Geschäftsentwicklung übersetzen. • Erkennt Lücken im operationellen Modell, die sich in eine verfehlte/verlorene Wertermittlung übersetzen und Taktiken vorschlagen, um über verpasste Möglichkeiten zu profitieren

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Les technologies marketing (MarTech) intégrées à la fonction GPS Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI) rassembleront des capacités clés en matière d'affaires et d'informatique avec l'ambition d'ajouter du sens et de la valeur à toutes les interactions clientes de Roche à travers un écosystème technologique unique, commun et intégré. Le responsable des opérations commerciales de Marketing Technologies (MarTech) est un rôle essentiel qui vise à garantir que nos investissements technologiques se traduisent par des performances commerciales tangibles. Plutôt que de vous concentrer sur la maintenance technique, vous superviserez un cadre de préparation opérationnelle, en concevant les structures de gouvernance et d'exploitation qui permettent à nos équipes de capitaliser sur de nouveaux outils sans perturber les performances de base. Vous êtes le gardien de l'état de gestion, responsable de veiller à ce que les résultats et la croissance de l'entreprise soient améliorés grâce à l'utilisation efficace de la technologie. L'évolution continue de nos processus opérationnels est l'un des principaux moteurs de la réussite de ce rôle. Votre objectif est de veiller à ce que notre modèle opérationnel ne soit pas seulement stable, mais aussi un avantage concurrentiel, offrant des améliorations mesurables de la rapidité de mise sur le marché, du coût au service et de la productivité organisationnelle globale. L'opportunité En tant que gestionnaire des opérations, vous êtes responsable de la mise en oeuvre des changements et de la gestion du modèle de service afin d'assurer la réussite opérationnelle à long terme et la durabilité de nos plateformes d'affaires. Vous soutiendrez le responsable des opérations commerciales dans la gestion de toute la transition de la mise en œuvre dirigée par le projet à un état stable, continu et performant « comme d'habitude » (BAU).
• Vérifier les flux de travail opérationnels existants pour identifier les inefficacités; diriger la conception et la mise en œuvre de processus « futurs » qui maximisent la valeur de notre pile technologique tout en simplifiant l'expérience utilisateur
• Mise en oeuvre de la gouvernance « d'État » nécessaire pour gérer les changements continus des processus opérationnels. Vous veillerez à ce que les futures itérations techniques soient hiérarchisées en fonction de leur capacité à fournir la valeur opérationnelle et la stabilité organisationnelle
• Établir des partenariats avec les utilisateurs finals afin d'évaluer l'impact des changements techniques sur les niveaux d'utilisation et d'exploitation de l'entreprise, en veillant à ce que l'allocation des ressources soit optimisée pour de nouvelles méthodes de travail et que les services pertinents soient dotés de ressources et formés de manière appropriée;
• Indique les lacunes du modèle opérationnel qui se traduisent par une réalisation de valeur manquée/perdue et propose des tactiques pour tirer parti des occasions manquées
• Mettre en œuvre le cadre de gouvernance de l'état de fonctionnement pour gérer les processus, les solutions, les données et les changements d'utilisateur en cours après la mise en service
• Établir et surveiller des indicateurs clés de performance (ICP) liés à la vitesse du processus, au coût de service et au frottement opérationnel, ce qui entraîne une culture d'amélioration continue
• Gérer l'alignement des parties prenantes (avec les fournisseurs, le RDT/IT et les entreprises) afin de s'assurer que tous les plans de transition et le modèle futur de gestion sont co-créés et pleinement pris en charge Qui vous êtes La réussite de ce rôle exige un chef de file hautement structuré et axé sur les processus, qui comprend parfaitement les opérations et la gestion des services. Vous êtes la main ferme qui assure que la vision stratégique du programme devient une réalité opérationnelle stable, fiable et en constante amélioration. Les principales caractéristiques sont les suivantes:
• > 3 ans d'expérience en opérations commerciales, prestation de services dans un environnement mondial à grande échelle avec une bonne compréhension de la façon de gérer et de soutenir les plates-formes d'entreprise dans une « entreprise comme d'habitude »

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Field Service Engineer – South Region - East London The Opportunity Are you ready to take on a role where the work you do truly makes a difference to patients’ lives? As a Field Service Engineer with Roche Diagnostics, you’ll be at the forefront of maintaining and supporting our world-class medical equipment across the South region of the UK. You’ll play a vital role in ensuring healthcare providers can deliver the best care possible by keeping our diagnostic systems running smoothly. From installations and preventative maintenance to troubleshooting and customer training, your expertise will help healthcare teams deliver results that patients rely on every day. With exciting product launches and ongoing investment in R&D, this is your chance to be part of a progressive, high-tech business that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Who You Are You’re an experienced and motivated engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and working hands-on with high-value capital equipment. You thrive on building strong customer relationships and take pride in representing a trusted global brand in the field. What You’ll Do
• Diagnose, repair, and maintain electro-mechanical, fluidic, and electronic systems across the South England region.
• Carry out preventative, corrective, modification, installation, and out-of-hours support for a range of Roche products.
• Deliver both on-site and office-based customer training to ensure effective equipment use.
• Support new product launches and help grow key business accounts across your territory.
• Collaborate with the Regional Technical Manager and wider Technical Services team to deliver exceptional service.
• Represent Roche with professionalism and integrity at customer sites across the region (with occasional UK travel). What You Bring
• An engineering or electrical qualification, ideally with experience in biomedical, industrial, automation, aerospace, or related fields.
• Previous field service experience with high-value capital equipment.
• Strong diagnostic skills — from component-level troubleshooting through to system-level expertise.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trusted, long-term customer relationships.
• Flexibility and willingness to travel within the South region (and occasionally across the UK). Join us and be part of a purpose-driven organisation where your expertise helps healthcare professionals do now what patients need next. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of Roche Products Ltd. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At the heart of our digital security is the trust we build through encrypted communication. As a PKI Engineer, you will join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team to help manage the core certificate infrastructure. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring that our digital certificates are issued, tracked, and renewed without a hitch. This is a growth-oriented role where you will learn to navigate complex security infrastructures while contributing to the automation of high-volume security tasks. Job Responsibilities Scope
• Support the day-to-day administration of Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), including basic template management and standard troubleshooting.
• Use Keyfactor Command to monitor certificate health, identify expiring assets, and assist in bringing untracked certificates into compliance.
• Support the deployment of ACME clients (like Certbot) for automated certificate issuance across web server environments.
• Participate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using Version Control systems and scripting as required (PowerShell or Python).
• Collaborate with senior engineers to orchestrate certificate distribution to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers. Impact/Strategy
• Collaborate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using basic scripting (PowerShell or Python) and maintain scripts using version control systems.
• Assist in maintaining team internal wikis, standard operating procedures, and runbooks for certificate lifecycle management.
• Collaborate with senior engineers to route, distribute, and install certificates to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers . ​ Complexity
• Focuses primarily on executing defined procedures, troubleshooting routine issues, and escalating complex anomalies to senior team members.
• Contributes to team agility by identifying operational inefficiencies and proposing minor process improvements within immediate daily tasks.
• Demonstrates growing autonomy within the specific domain by translating daily requirements into structured tasks under direct supervision. ​ Business/Technical ability
• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies
• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically ​ Qualifications Education / Experience
• Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an IT Helpdesk, Systems Administration, or junior Security Operations (SOC) role. An internship focused on infrastructure or security is highly valued.
• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or equivalent practical experience.
• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies
• Demonstrated ability to independently handle defined tasks and contribute to various stages of the security and business analysis lifecycle ​ Technical Skills
• Understanding of Zero Trust principles, authentication factors and cryptography.
• A solid understanding of cryptography basics (Symmetric vs. Asymmetric, Hashing, Digital Signatures).
• Experience with Windows Server and Active Directory. Exposure to web servers like IIS, Apache, or Nginx. Comfortable using Git for basic file management and collaboration.
• Knowledge of the ACME protocol or experience using tools like Certbot.
• Familiarity with PowerShell o

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture. You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape. As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Network Security, you will lead the Design, Build, and Improvement of critical security infrastructures, specifically focusing on Cisco ISE, Wired Access Control (WAC), and Palo Alto Networks. This is a dual-impact role: you are the technical authority for the secure access layer, while simultaneously leading the engineering of a custom observability framework. You will develop the front-end, back-end, and integration logic required to provide deep visibility into the security product health and asset inventory. Job Responsibilities 1. SME: Secure Access (ISE, WAC, Palo Alto)
• Design & Architecture: Lead the high-level and low-level design (HLD/LLD) for global Cisco ISE deployments and Wired Access Control (WAC) strategies to ensure seamless, identity-based security.
• Palo Alto SME: Serve as the primary engineer for Palo Alto NGFW architectures, including advanced threat prevention, decryption, and secure egress/ingress traffic management.
• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify gaps in the current security posture and implement technical enhancements to NAC policies, SGT (TrustSec) propagation, and firewall rule-sets.
• Build & Implementation: Act as the lead "implementer" for complex global migrations and new feature rollouts across the network security stack. ​ 2. Observability Framework Engineering
• Full-Stack Development: Architect and develop a custom framework (front-end and back-end) to provide a "single pane of glass" for infrastructure health.
• Inventory & Integration: Build automated integrations with external data sources (CMDB, IPAM, etc.) to maintain a real-time, dynamic inventory of all network assets and security nodes.
• Telemetry Logic: Design custom logic to ingest and visualize telemetry from ISE, WAC, and Palo Alto using APIs, SNMP, and Syslog. ​ 3. Operational Excellence & Visibility
• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, providing root-cause analysis and implementing long-term, automated architectural fixes.
• Security Observability: Develop dashboards and reporting to provide real-time visibility into the "connected landscape," identifying insecure nodes or unauthorized devices before they can affect the network.
• Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchest

Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture. • Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchest

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture. You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape. As a Cybersecurity Engineer within the AI Innovation workstream, you will be a key technical contributor responsible for the hands-on execution of our AI/ML security strategy. Working as part of a specialized team, you will assist in developing and implementing AI capabilities to optimize service delivery across the Design, Build, and Operations phases of our network security solutions. Your role is to help bridge the gap between network security engineering and data science, contributing to the development of intelligent automation that reduces manual intervention and shifts our infrastructure toward a proactive, self-healing model. You will apply your technical expertise to ensure these technologies integrate seamlessly with our core stack, including Cisco ISE, 802.1x, and Palo Alto Networks. Job Responsibilities 1. AI Strategy & Roadmap Execution
• Strategy Definition: Partner with product owners to define the vision for AI adoption within Network Security (e.g., predictive threat detection, automated policy optimization).
• Hands-on Implementation: Lead the technical execution of AI workstreams, moving from Proof of Concept (POC) to production-ready security enhancements.
• SME for AI Security: Act as the Subject Matter Expert for how AI can be leveraged to improve the efficacy and performance of Cisco ISE, Palo Alto, and 802.1x infrastructures. ​ 2. AI-Driven Observability & Inventory
• Intelligent Monitoring: Develop AI/ML models to identify anomalies in network traffic and security appliance telemetry that traditional threshold-based monitoring misses.
• Automated Classification: Enhance asset inventory and device profiling (NAC) by applying machine learning to identify complex IoT and medical device patterns.
• Framework Integration: Integrate AI insights into the existing observability front-end and backend frameworks to provide actionable intelligence to operations teams. ​ 3. Proactive Defense & Automation
• Predictive Analytics: Implement tools to predict potential security bottlenecks or infrastructure failures before they impact the global network.
• Policy Optimization: Use AI to analyze firewall and NAC policy usage, recommending automated cleanup or hardening of security rules.
• Continuous Improvement: Lead the "Design, Build, and Improve" cycle for AI-driven security controls, ensuring they evolve alongside the threat landscape. ​ Qualifications Education / Experience
• Educational Bac

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As the Workforce Strategy & Planning Lead, you will be the strategic intelligence behind how Roche's Digital & Technology (RDT) organization anticipates, plans, and shapes its future workforce. This is a senior global individual contributor role responsible for translating RDT's business strategy into actionable workforce implications – providing scenario insight and planning coherence to make informed decisions about talent supply and demand across the organization. You will lead by influence and connecting long-term business ambition to workforce reality – maintaining the workforce dashboard logic that enables RDT-level visibility. By anchoring every workforce decision in data-driven foresight, you will be shaping how a global digital organization plans, adapts, and builds for the future. Job Responsibilities
• RDT Workforce Dashboard & Intelligence: Define, build, and maintain the logic behind the workforce dashboard, ensuring it delivers accurate, timely, and strategically relevant insight to RDT leadership. Ensures dashboard outputs are integrated with capability data and reflect a holistic view of RDT's talent landscape.
• Strategic workforce planning coherence: Act as the steward of planning coherence across the RDT organization, ensuring that workforce planning assumptions, methodologies, and outputs are consistent across functions, sites, and geographies. Translate complex planning outputs into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholder consumption.
• Federated planning enablement: Equip HR partners, site leads, and functions with the frameworks, tools, and guidance needed to execute workforce planning consistently across the federated RDT model, enabling local teams to contribute meaningfully to the global workforce picture. Leverage the RDT site network to ensure planning insights reflect both global strategy and local talent realities.
• Workforce Intelligence: Responsible for designing and deploying a Skills Intelligence Platform (SIP) that serves as a centralized 'Digital Twin' of the RDT workforce. Integrates data from multiple HR, learning, finance, and workforce systems to build a holistic and dynamic picture of RDT's talent landscape. Develop scenario models and predictive analytics that generate forward-looking insight to support strategic workforce and capability decisions.
• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders, including management, across organizational boundaries. Shapes strategy as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and empowers teams in stakeholder management. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.
• Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices.
• Proven track record of recommending optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation and working on unusually complex problems with highly innovative solutions.
• Ability to apply systems thinking to provide holistic and enterprise-wide consulting advice.
• Exceptional stakeholder management skills, acting as a role model in teamwork, and driving good collaboration across Informatics and business structures.
• Strong dedication to actively contributing to organizational development. #RDT2026 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 emplo

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job description The ServiceNow IRM Technical Analyst is a dedicated IT Technologist responsible for overseeing and driving the delivery of a specific Integrated Risk Management (IRM) product, such as GRC, TPRM, Privacy, or BCM. Operating within an Agile framework, you will act as the technical owner for your assigned product area, balancing hands-on ServiceNow system configuration with product management. You will translate business requirements into technical solutions while leveraging AI tools like Claude as a productivity multiplier to accelerate delivery. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage a product backlog and roadmap without losing the ability to execute deep technical implementation. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Product Management & Delivery: Leads the end-to-end management of an assigned IRM product area. Responsible for executing the product roadmap, managing the backlog within an Agile framework, and ensuring technical alignment with business objectives.
• Hands-on Technical Execution: Maintains a high level of technical proficiency by performing hands-on ServiceNow system configurations and GRC module setups. Balances the business side of the product with direct technical implementation tasks as required.
• AI-Augmented Productivity: Effectively integrates AI tools (e.g., Claude) into the development lifecycle. Uses these tools as a productivity multiplier to accelerate technical tasks and documentation, while maintaining ownership of final system stability and quality.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Acts as the primary technical point of contact for the product area. Engages with stakeholders to refine requirements, manage expectations, and provide expert consultation on ServiceNow GRC capabilities.
• Technical Standards & Quality: Ensures all configurations meet architectural standards. Leverages strong knowledge of general GRC principles and ServiceNow best practices to deliver robust, scalable risk management solutions. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Demonstrated experience acting as an active and independent contributor within project or product teams.
• Experience analyzing business requirements independently and translating them into technical system specifications.
• Proven track record of executing an independent development plan and participating in knowledge-sharing initiatives. Technical Skills
• Strong capability to design automated systems and accurately determine hardware and software compatibility.
• Experience configuring system settings and options to meet specific user needs.
• Ability to plan and execute unit, integration, and acceptance testing.
• Proficiency in creating detailed system specifications and comprehensive technical documentation. Additional Qualifications
• Strong problem-solving mindset, capable of thinking of alternative ways to solve problems and resolving complex business systems issues.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support. The Device Engineering section combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities. The opportunity: In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams. Additionally, you will take on strategic responsibilities and contribute to efforts led by the Device Engineering leadership team. This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.
• Act as project leader / team leader / technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market
• Evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies. Application of theoretical engineering knowledge, to establish robust technical product requirements, and develop engineering design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the life of the product
• Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans and DHF creation/maintenance DHF), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.
• Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality and cost constraints, resulting in state-of–the-art drug delivery devices
• Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 and 21 CFR 820.30) Who you are:
• You have university level education (engineering degree or related discipline).
• You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development with experience in pharma or other closely-regulated environments, under current Good Practice (cGxP), Quality System Regulation (QSR), or similar working practices.
• You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.
• You have sound knowledge of legislation, regulation, industry standards, and guidance within the area of combination products and medical devices.
• You have experience with Health Authority interactions.
• You have demonstrable knowledge of drug delivery devices, parenteral drug delivery, risk assessment, tolerance analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, manufacturing processes, and reliability engineering.

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Abteilung für Geräteentwicklung in Roche Technical Development ist für die Entwicklung und Unterstützung von Medikamentenliefergeräten für das Produktportfolio verantwortlich. Unsere Aktivitäten umfassen eine Reihe von Engineering-Disziplinen von der Definitionsphase der Anforderungen bis hin zur Vermarktung und Vermarktung von Produkten. Der Bereich Device Engineering kombiniert Design, Engineering, Testing und Fertigung, um zuverlässige und sichere Medikamentenliefergeräte zu entwickeln, die den Bedürfnissen von Patienten, Gesundheitsdienstleistern und Gesundheitsbehörden entsprechen. Die Gelegenheit: In dieser Funktion engagieren Sie sich mit einer umfassenden funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit, insbesondere mit Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical und Commercial Teams. Darüber hinaus übernehmen Sie strategische Verantwortung und tragen zu Anstrengungen des Teams für Gerätetechnik bei. Diese Rolle berichtet an den Abschnittsleiter für Gerätetechnik und ist in die Roche-Geräteentwicklungsfunktion integriert.
• Aktivieren Sie als Projektleiter / Teamleiter / technischer Experte, um Kombinationsprodukte und medizinische Geräte erfolgreich auf den Markt zu bringen
• Evaluierung neuer und bahnbrechender Technologien. Anwendung von theoretischem Engineering-Wissen, um robuste technische Produktanforderungen zu etablieren und Engineering-Design-Lösungen zu entwickeln, um sicherzustellen, dass Geräte das erforderliche Maß an Leistung während der gesamten Lebensdauer des Produktes halten
• Dokumentation zur Designsteuerung (Design Development Plans, Benutzeranforderungen Spezifikationen, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans und DHF Erstellung/Wartung DHF), Konformitätsbewertungen und Risikomanagementdokumentation.
• Prognose- und Planressourcenanforderungen für Geräteentwicklungsprojekte. Projekte innerhalb der vereinbarten Zeit, Qualität und Kostenzwänge durchführen, was zu hochmodernen Medikamentenliefergeräten führt
• Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Landschaft anwenden, um normkonforme Designs zu gewährleisten (z.B. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 und 21 CFR 820.30) Wer du bist:
• Sie haben Hochschulbildung (Ausbildungsabschluss oder damit verbundene Disziplin).
• Sie haben einen mindestens 10-jährigen Erfahrungsnachweis in der Entwicklung von Maschinen- und Medikamentenliefergeräten mit Erfahrung in Pharma oder anderen eng regulierten Umgebungen, unter der aktuellen Good Practice (cGxP), der Qualitätssystemverordnung (QSR) oder ähnlichen Arbeitspraktiken.
• Sie haben Hand-on Pen Injektor / Auto Injektor Entwicklung Know-how.
• Sie haben fundierte Kenntnisse über Gesetzgebung, Regulierung, Industriestandards und Beratung im Bereich der Kombinationsprodukte und Medizinprodukte.
• Sie haben Erfahrung mit Interaktionen der Gesundheitsbehörde.
• Sie haben nachweisbare Kenntnisse über Arzneimittelliefergeräte, parenterale Medikamentenlieferung, Risikobewertung, Toleranzanalyse, statistische Techniken, Prozessfähigkeit, Fertigungsprozesse und Zuverlässigkeitstechnik.
• Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Dokumentation, Präsentation, zwischenmenschliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und strategisches Denken.
• Sie haben einen ausgezeichneten Befehl der englischen Sprache; Englischkenntnisse sind bevorzugt. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und zu halten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Le service de développement des dispositifs au sein de Roche Technical Development est responsable de la mise au point et du soutien des dispositifs de livraison des médicaments pour le portefeuille de produits. Nos activités couvrent une gamme de disciplines d'ingénierie, de la phase de définition des exigences jusqu'à la commercialisation et le soutien des produits commercialisés. La section Ingénierie des appareils combine la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la fabrication pour mettre au point des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments fiables et sécuritaires qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des fournisseurs de soins de santé et des autorités sanitaires. L'occasion : Dans ce rôle, vous vous engagerez dans une collaboration interfonctionnelle étendue, en particulier avec des équipes d'assurance de la qualité (AQ), d'affaires réglementaires, cliniques et commerciales. De plus, vous assumerez des responsabilités stratégiques et contribuerez aux efforts menés par l'équipe de direction du génie des appareils. Ce rôle relève du chef de section de l'ingénierie des appareils et est intégré à la fonction de développement des appareils Roche.
• Agir en tant que chef de projet / chef d'équipe / expert technique pour réussir à mettre sur le marché des produits combinés et des dispositifs médicaux
• Évaluation des technologies nouvelles et révolutionnaires. Application des connaissances théoriques en ingénierie, pour établir des exigences techniques robustes du produit, et développer des solutions de conception technique pour assurer que les appareils maintiennent le niveau de performance requis tout au long de la durée de vie du produit
• Documentation de contrôle de conception de l'auteur (plans de conception, spécifications des exigences d'utilisation, entrées de conception, sorties de conception, plans de vérification de conception et DHF création/entretien DHF), évaluations de conformité et documentation de gestion des risques.
• Prévision et planification des demandes de ressources pour les projets de développement d'appareils. Exécuter les projets dans les délais, la qualité et les contraintes de coûts convenus, ce qui se traduira par des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments à la fine pointe de la technologie
• Appliquer les connaissances du paysage réglementaire pour assurer des conceptions conformes aux normes (par exemple ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 et 21 CFR 820.30) Qui vous êtes:
• Vous avez une formation de niveau universitaire (diplôme d'ingénierie ou discipline connexe).
• Vous disposez d'une expérience de 10 ans au moins en génie mécanique et en développement d'appareils de livraison de médicaments ayant une expérience dans des environnements pharmaceutiques ou d'autres environnements étroitement réglementés, dans le cadre des bonnes pratiques actuelles (cGxP), de la réglementation du système de qualité (RSQ) ou de pratiques de travail semblables.
• Vous avez une expertise pratique en développement d'injecteurs Pen / Auto.
• Vous avez une bonne connaissance de la législation, de la réglementation, des normes de l'industrie et des conseils dans le domaine des produits combinés et des instruments médicaux.
• Vous avez une expérience des interactions avec les autorités sanitaires.
• Vous avez une connaissance démontrable des dispositifs d'administration de médicaments, de la prestation parentérale de médicaments, de l'évaluation des risques, de l'analyse de tolérance, des techniques statistiques, de la capacité des procédés, des procédés de fabrication et de l'ingénierie de la fiabilité.
• Vous possédez une excellente documentation, présentation, compétences en communication interpersonnelle et pensée stratégique.
• Vous avez une excellente maîtrise de la langue anglaise; la maîtrise de l'allemand est préférable. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. • Prognose- und Planressourcenanforderungen für Geräteentwicklungsprojekte. Projekte innerhalb der vereinbarten Zeit, Qualität und Kostenzwänge durchführen, was zu hochmodernen Medikamentenliefergeräten führt
• Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Landschaft anwenden, um normkonforme Designs zu gewährleisten (z.B. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 und 21 CFR 820.30) Wer du bist:
• Sie haben Hochschulbildung (Ausbildungsabschluss oder damit verbundene Disziplin).
