• Sie haben Hand-on Pen Injektor / Auto Injektor Entwicklung Know-how.
• Sie haben fundierte Kenntnisse über Gesetzgebung, Regulierung, Industriestandards und Beratung im Bereich der Kombinationsprodukte und Medizinprodukte.
• Sie haben Erfahrung mit Interaktionen der Gesundheitsbehörde.
• Sie haben nachweisbare Kenntnisse über Arzneimittelliefergeräte, parenterale Medikamentenlieferung, Risikobewertung, Toleranzanalyse, statistische Techniken, Prozessfähigkeit, Fertigungsprozesse, Zuverlässigkeitstechnik und Problemlösung.
• Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Dokumentation, Präsentation und zwischenmenschliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Sie haben einen ausgezeichneten Befehl der englischen Sprache; Englischkenntnisse sind bevorzugt. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist ein E
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le service de développement des dispositifs au sein de Roche Technical Development est responsable du développement et du soutien des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments pour le portefeuille de produits. Nos activités couvrent une gamme de disciplines d'ingénierie, de la phase de définition des exigences jusqu'à la commercialisation et le soutien des produits commercialisés. La section Ingénierie des appareils combine la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la fabrication pour mettre au point des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments fiables et sécuritaires qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des fournisseurs de soins de santé et des autorités sanitaires. L'occasion : Dans ce rôle, vous aurez une interaction interfonctionnelle considérable, notamment l'AQ, les affaires réglementaires, les fonctions cliniques et commerciales. Ce rôle relève du chef de section de l'ingénierie des appareils et est intégré à la fonction de développement des appareils Roche.
• Agir en tant que chef de projet / chef d'équipe / expert technique pour réussir à mettre sur le marché des produits combinés et des dispositifs médicaux
• Évaluation des technologies nouvelles et innovantes. Application des connaissances théoriques en ingénierie, pour établir des exigences techniques robustes du produit, et développer des solutions de conception technique pour assurer que les appareils maintiennent le niveau de performance requis tout au long de la durée de vie du produit
• Documentation sur le contrôle de la conception des auteurs (plans de conception, spécifications des exigences de l'utilisateur, entrées de conception, sorties de conception, plans de vérification de conception et DHF création/entretien DHF), évaluations de la conformité et documentation sur la gestion des risques.
• Prévision et planification des demandes de ressources pour les projets de développement d'appareils. Exécuter les projets dans les délais, la qualité et les contraintes de coûts convenus, ce qui se traduira par des dispositifs de distribution de médicaments de pointe
• Appliquer les connaissances du paysage réglementaire pour garantir des conceptions conformes aux normes (par exemple ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 et 21 CFR 820.30) Qui vous êtes :
• Vous avez une formation universitaire (diplôme d'ingénierie ou discipline connexe).
• Vous disposez d'une expérience de cinq ans au moins en génie mécanique et en développement d'appareils de livraison de médicaments ayant une expérience dans des environnements pharmaceutiques ou d'autres environnements étroitement réglementés, dans le cadre de bonnes pratiques actuelles (cGxP), de la réglementation du système de qualité (QSR) ou de pratiques de travail similaires.
• Vous avez une expertise pratique en développement d'injecteurs Pen / Auto.
• Vous avez une bonne connaissance de la législation, de la réglementation, des normes de l'industrie et des directives dans le domaine des produits combinés et des dispositifs médicaux.
• Vous avez une expérience des interactions avec les autorités sanitaires.
• Vous avez une connaissance démontrable des dispositifs de distribution de médicaments, de la distribution parentérale de médicaments, de l'évaluation des risques, de l'analyse de tolérance, des techniques statistiques, de la capacité des procédés, des procédés de fabrication, de l'ingénierie de la fiabilité et de la résolution de problèmes.
• Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en documentation, présentation et communication interpersonnelle.
• Vous avez une excellente maîtrise de l'anglais; la maîtrise de l'allemand est préférable. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un E

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, over 95,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. We believe every employee makes a difference. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action; we believe that good business means a better world. And as Roche Services & Solutions Network (RSS) we are fully committed to enabling our Roche Network to transform the way they operate to ultimately focus on patients and deliver what patients need next. The Opportunity As an External Engagement Coordinator – Grants, Sponsorships and Donations Specialist , you bring expertise in operational management and compliance to ensure the effective handling of Grants, Sponsorships, and Donations (GS&D) requests initiated by Roche R&D Networks and Roche Global Congress Teams. You act as a gatekeeper and facilitator, ensuring that all financial and non-financial contributions to Healthcare Organizations (HCOs) and Patient Groups (PGs) align with Roche’s compliance principles, adhere to local laws, and meet internal financial reporting standards. This includes upholding international regulations, such as EFPIA standards for sponsorships, and ensuring full transparency in the management and documentation of grants and donations. While the business retains overall accountability, your role ensures that every transaction is ethically vetted, medically justified, and audit-ready. You oversee the full GS&D process end-to-end, managing the operational workflow in partnership with relevant Roche Networks. This includes intake, documentation gathering, milestone tracking, final closure, and evidence collection to maintain the highest compliance standards.
• Compliance Expertise and Advisory: Provide independent, expert healthcare compliance advice to senior leaders and ensure adherence to global and local regulations throughout the external engagement process.
• End-to-End Compliance Management: Manage the end-to-end compliance process for HCP/HCO, patient engagements, and GSD management, including accurate FMV calculation, compliant ToV transfers, and reconciliation of POs, invoices, and payments to ensure timely and accurate execution.
• Global Coordination & Reporting: Collaborate with global pharma compliance offices and affiliates to determine FMV, hospitality restrictions, and gain approvals, while ensuring timely and compliant submission of Actual Spend Reports in coordination with PCO.
• Travel & Logistics Execution: Execute travel and logistics activities as needed to support engagement processes.
• Customer Service & Engagement: Deliver high-quality customer service by responding to complex compliance-related queries, guiding stakeholders, tracking engagement processes, and ensuring timely, high-quality execution.
• Process Development & Continuous Improvement: Partner with Compliance and Procurement Leads to develop new processes, tools, or resources, scale up team capabilities, and address deviations and CAPAs with the Global Compliance Senior Leader.
• Inspection & Audit Readiness: Support the preparation of documentation for inspections and audits, ensuring compliance and readiness. Who You Are
• Educational and Professional Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is mandatory, with 5+ years of experience in Customer Relations Management, Finance, Procurement, Event Ma

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Purpose
• As the leader for the squad team, set the vision and strategic ambition for the squad and be accountable for the delivery of Disease Area MTO/STO
• As an enterprise leader, prioritize squad outcomes and ensure resource requirements are met to align with affiliate MTO/STO and portfolio priorities.
• As country connector to work closely with DCL (Disease Commercialization Lead) and affiliate key stakeholders (ET/CL/TL) to mobilize affiliate and network resources Role Scope 1. Set Ambition and Strategic Vision:
• Establish the squad's vision, high ambitions, and key outcomes for the squad by leveraging insights from customer facing roles and other key stakeholders across the enterprise.
• Hold overall accountability for the squad’s performance, including delivering outcomes and managing the P&L within a framework of shared responsibility.
• Lead the prioritization of disease area strategies, co-create the squad's OBP, and support financial planning to drive long-term impact. 2. Lead and Inspire Teams:
• Collaborate with people leaders to foster squad member capability growth to deliver team shared goals and actively participate in the employee contribution cycle.
• Empower the squad team to make decisions, enable prioritization, and manage conflicts effectively to achieve ambitious outcomes, fostering a collaborative and continuous learning environment. 3. Ensure Strategic Prioritization and Resource Allocation:
• Adopt an enterprise mindset, taking into account affiliate strategies and portfolio priorities to prioritize squad outcomes.
• Ensure resource requirements are met to deliver on MTOs and STOs.
• Partner with WPO to enable effective WP execution and prioritization aligned with affiliate priorities.
• Facilitate squad resource prioritization and fluidity, ensuring alignment under the OBP cycle on a 120 days cycle. 4. Foster Partnerships and Network Engagement:
• Foster both external and internal partnerships, ensuring that clinical and non-clinical stakeholders view Roche as their preferred partner.
• Mobilize the network swiftly to address the urgent needs of key stakeholders.
• Inspire the squad team to engage and dialogue with key stakeholders to ensure organizational alignment and timely support.
• Enable cross-affiliate networking to achieve and scale team and organizational outcomes, connecting and mobilizing DA network resources to fit local needs. 5. Catalyze Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:
• Partner with internal stakeholders to catalyze collaboration towards achieving the triple-win goal.
• Accelerate learning and sharing across squads, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. Qualifications:
• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation has been identified in the past 5 years.
• Minimum 8+ years working experience in the pharma industry. Education:
• A bachelor degree in scientific, economic, or business related fields. An advanced degree in Life Science and/or MBA is a plus. Working Experience:
• Experience in managing senior key stakeholders
• Experience in leading cross-functional teams
• Experience in planning and managing resources prioritization
• Experience in leadership role (formal or informal) is preferred Competencies
• A VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst and Coach) leader with a creative mind. Unites people around a shared vision and a common purpose, inspiring them to achieve squad-aligned outcomes. Ensure individuals and teams are

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Purpose
• As the leader for the squad team, set the vision and strategic ambition for the squad and be accountable for the delivery of Disease Area MTO/STO
• As an enterprise leader, prioritize squad outcomes and ensure resource requirements are met to align with affiliate MTO/STO and portfolio priorities.
• As country connector to work closely with DCL (Disease Commercialization Lead) and affiliate key stakeholders (ET/CL/TL) to mobilize affiliate and network resources Role Scope 1. Set Ambition and Strategic Vision:
• Establish the squad's vision, high ambitions, and key outcomes for the squad by leveraging insights from customer facing roles and other key stakeholders across the enterprise.
• Hold overall accountability for the squad’s performance, including delivering outcomes and managing the P&L within a framework of shared responsibility.
• Lead the prioritization of disease area strategies, co-create the squad's OBP, and support financial planning to drive long-term impact. 2. Lead and Inspire Teams:
• Collaborate with people leaders to foster squad member capability growth to deliver team shared goals and actively participate in the employee contribution cycle.
• Empower the squad team to make decisions, enable prioritization, and manage conflicts effectively to achieve ambitious outcomes, fostering a collaborative and continuous learning environment. 3. Ensure Strategic Prioritization and Resource Allocation:
• Adopt an enterprise mindset, taking into account affiliate strategies and portfolio priorities to prioritize squad outcomes.
• Ensure resource requirements are met to deliver on MTOs and STOs.
• Partner with WPO to enable effective WP execution and prioritization aligned with affiliate priorities.
• Facilitate squad resource prioritization and fluidity, ensuring alignment under the OBP cycle on a 120 days cycle. 4. Foster Partnerships and Network Engagement:
• Foster both external and internal partnerships, ensuring that clinical and non-clinical stakeholders view Roche as their preferred partner.
• Mobilize the network swiftly to address the urgent needs of key stakeholders.
• Inspire the squad team to engage and dialogue with key stakeholders to ensure organizational alignment and timely support.
• Enable cross-affiliate networking to achieve and scale team and organizational outcomes, connecting and mobilizing DA network resources to fit local needs. 5. Catalyze Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:
• Partner with internal stakeholders to catalyze collaboration towards achieving the triple-win goal.
• Accelerate learning and sharing across squads, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. Qualifications:
• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation has been identified in the past 5 years.
• Minimum 8+ years working experience in the pharma industry. Education:
• A bachelor degree in scientific, economic, or business related fields. An advanced degree in Life Science and/or MBA is a plus. Working Experience:
• Experience in managing senior key stakeholders
• Experience in leading cross-functional teams
• Experience in planning and managing resources prioritization
• Experience in leadership role (formal or informal) is preferred Competencies
• A VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst and Coach) leader with a creative mind. Unites people around a shared vision and a common purpose, inspiring them to achieve squad-aligned outcomes. Ensure individuals and teams are

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Praktikum (m/w/d) im Bereich Events & Congresses Wer wir sind: Die Roche Pharma AG an ihrem Standort in Grenzach-Wyhlen steuert unter anderem die medizinischen Aktivitäten, das Marketing und die Vertriebsaktivitäten für den deutschen Markt. Der Bereich Events & Congresses verantwortet die konzeptionelle und organisatorische Planung sowie Durchführung von Roche-eigenen Veranstaltungen, von Roche Kongress-Auftritten und von Kogressteilnahmen. Was dich erwartet: Während Deines Praktikums übernimmst Du folgende vielfältige Tätigkeiten: ● Unterstützung der Events & Congresses Specialists bei der Planung und Durchführung von Präsenz-, virtuellen und hybriden Veranstaltungen sowie bei der Teilnahme an deutschen und internationalen Kongressen. ● Unterstützung und Übernahme von Teil-Aufgaben in den Bereichen:
• Projektmanagement von Veranstaltungen und Kongressen
• Recherche und Buchung von Hotels, Restaurants und anderen Locations
• Einbindung digitaler Kanäle wie z.B. des Roche Fachportals
• Teilnehmer-Management inklusive Vertragsmanagement
• Technische Betreuung virtueller Veranstaltungen
• Vor-Ort Betreuung großer Veranstaltungen
• Administrative Abwicklung der Veranstaltungen in den Roche-Systemen Wer Du bist: Du hast Interesse am Event & Kongress-Management im Pharmabereich und bringst idealerweise bereits erste Erfahrungen im Event & Kongress-Management sowie Projektmanagement mit. Darüber hinaus bist Du kundenorientiert und kommunikativ, arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert und hast ebenso Spaß daran, Aufgaben im Team zu lösen. Für das Praktikum im Bereich Events & Congresses bringst Du zudem folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:
• Generelle Voraussetzung zur Beschäftigung als Praktikant/in ist die ordentliche Immatrikulation während des gesamten Praktikums oder aber das Praktikum wird innerhalb eines Gap Years absolviert, also nach dem Bachelorabschluss in Vorbereitung auf ein Masterstudium oder auf die Promotion.
• Du bist Student (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkten im Bereich Event Management, der Hotellerie, Wirtschafts- oder Kommunikationswissenschaften o.ä.
• Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint)
• Gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Zeitraum : ab 01.09.2026 oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten Was wir Dir bieten:
• Möglichkeit, interne Weiterentwicklungsangebote wahrzunehmen
• Aufenthalt über die Dauer des Praktikums in unserem Boardinghouse (abhängig vom Wohnort)
• Mobiles Arbeiten möglich
• 2268€ monatl. Vergütung
• 2,5 Freizeittage pro Monat CV only - einfach Lebenslauf hochladen, fertig! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche. Oportunidad Esta posición forma parte de la División Diagnóstica , donde trabajamos con un enfoque integral para asegurar que nuestros clientes cuenten con el mejor soporte técnico y soluciones innovadoras para los pacientes. Te unirás a un equipo dinámico bajo la guía del Líder de Servicio de Cuentas Clave, ofreciendo una oportunidad única de aprendizaje en el sector de tecnología médica.
• Apoyas la ejecución de actividades técnicas para mejorar los tiempos de respuesta ante requerimientos de los clientes.
• Colaboras en el proyecto de predictividad y proactividad para transformar el modelo de servicio mediante sistemas de gestión proactivos.
• Participas en la implementación de herramientas de eficiencia como Inteligencia Artificial y Service Copilot.
• Brindas soporte en la planificación y ejecución de visitas de pre-instalación, evaluando requisitos de infraestructura y conectividad.
• Asesoras a los clientes sobre ajustes necesarios para garantizar el funcionamiento óptimo de los equipos médicos.
• Acompañas a los ingenieros de campo en mantenimientos preventivos, realizando pruebas diagnósticas y corrección de fallos.
• Contribuyes al posicionamiento de la marca y al cumplimiento de los estándares del sistema de Gestión de Calidad.
• Apoyas al equipo en cualquier actividad orientada al cumplimiento de los objetivos locales de servicio técnico. Quien eres
• Eres estudiante o profesional recién graduado en Ingeniería Electrónica, Ingeniería Biomédica e Ingeniería Mecatrónica.
• Ingles Intermedio, tanto verbal como escrito.
• Muestras una alta capacidad de trabajo en equipo, colaboración y orientación a la consecución de resultados.
• Te destacas por tu habilidad técnica, curiosidad por la innovación y apertura para recibir feedback y coaching. Posees excelentes habilidades de comunicación y una mentalidad orientada a la resolución de problemas y la toma de decisiones
• Actúas con integridad, coraje y pasión, alineándote con los valores fundamentales de Roche. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, oltre 100.000 persone in tutto il mondo sono pionieri della sanità. Insieme, ci siamo sviluppati in un gruppo sanitario leader mondiale e orientato alla ricerca. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità. La sede principale di Basilea & Kaiseraugst è una delle più grandi sedi Roche in tutto il mondo. Basato sulla posizione geografica nel cuore dell'Europa, Basilea è una delle regioni economiche più dinamiche della Svizzera con interessanti attività culturali e ricreative. C'è molto da scoprire e si dovrebbe essere lì! Nell'ambito dell'area Sicurezza, Salute, Ambiente (SHE), la sicurezza sul lavoro è responsabile del supporto e della consultazione di tutte le funzioni del sito. Si impegna a posti di lavoro sicuri e sani e definisce gli standard SGU in base alle esigenze legali e ai requisiti interni Roche. La continua revisione e il miglioramento delle preoccupazioni di sicurezza presso il sito BS / KAU è controllata dal dipartimento di sicurezza di lavoro. In qualità di specialista: in ASGS, si svolgono i seguenti compiti principali presso il nostro sito Basel / Kaiseraugst (Areal Kaiseraugst): La tua opzione Condurre valutazioni dei rischi per prevenire incidenti in un ambiente molto vario (ricerca, sviluppo, produzione, officina, ufficio, cantiere).
• Consigliare, chiarire e rispondere alle domande di agenti di sicurezza e dipendenti di tutte le aree di Roche Basel/Kaiseraugst in materia di sicurezza sul lavoro
• Sviluppare, organizzare e svolgere la formazione sulla “cultura della sicurezza e della sicurezza”
• Creazione, adattamento e aggiornamento di istruzioni e processi interni a causa di innovazioni e leggi
• Lavorare insieme a una strategia di localizzazione comune per la cultura della sicurezza e della sicurezza sul lavoro e lo scambio con il gruppo SHE o la cooperazione nei progetti globali corrispondenti.
• Cooperazione con altri dipartimenti interni, quali l'igiene del lavoro, la biosicurezza, la protezione antincendio ecc.
• Supporto/consulenza delle funzioni di linea nella chiarificazione degli infortuni sul lavoro e nello sviluppo delle misure.
• Gestione dei dati e delle misure di infortunio sul lavoro derivanti da STARI (Sistema di monitoraggio e segnalazione degli infortuni)
• ulteriore sviluppo di Incident Management presso il sito Basel/ Kaiseraugst Chi sei Sono aperti a nuove idee e mettere in discussione modelli convenzionali. Apprezzano il lavoro in un ambiente agile e mirato che è sostenuto da rispetto reciproco, discussione e cooperazione. Per voi, Roche è il punto di partenza per un ambiente di lavoro emozionante e internazionale con una varietà di opportunità di sviluppo. Come candidato di successo: nella nostra posizione di specialista: nella sicurezza del lavoro si mostra un'alta affinità per gli argomenti legati alla sicurezza. Con il tuo carattere orientato al servizio, puoi organizzarti come persona di contatto: per i tuoi gruppi di clienti nella zona di Basilea/Kaiseraugst. Hai anche le seguenti abilità:
• qualificazione professionale (nel campo della chimica, della produzione, della ricerca e dello sviluppo, del laboratorio, del cantiere) o laurea o tecnica in uno studio scientifico (chimica, ingegneria dei processi, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria elettrica), esperienza nel campo della chimica e ingegneria dei processi
• formazione supplementare come specialista: in sicurezza e salute sul lavoro o superiore.
• Esperienza professionale in Bere

The position At Roche, over 100,000 people worldwide are pioneering healthcare. Together, we have developed into a world-leading, research-oriented healthcare group. Our success is based on innovation, curiosity and diversity. The head office in Basel & Kaiseraugst is one of the largest Roche locations worldwide. Based on the geographical location in the heart of Europe, Basel is one of the most dynamic economic regions in Switzerland with interesting cultural and leisure activities. There is a lot to discover and you should be there! Within the Safety, Health, Environment (SHE) area, occupational safety is responsible for supporting and consulting all functions at the site. It is committed to safe and health-friendly jobs and sets SGU standards according to legal requirements and the Roche internal requirements. Continuous review and improvement of safety concerns at the BS / KAU site is controlled by the Working Safety department. As a specialist:in ASGS, you take the following main tasks at our Basel / Kaiseraugst site (Areal Kaiseraugst): Your option Conduct risk assessments to prevent accidents in a very varied environment (research, development, production, workshop, office, construction site).
• Advise, clarify and answer the questions of safety officers and employees from all areas of Roche Basel/Kaiseraugst concerning occupational safety
• Develop, organize and carry out training on “safety and security culture”
• Creating, adapting and updating internal instructions and processes due to innovations and laws
• Working together on a common location strategy for occupational safety and safety culture and exchange with Group SHE or Cooperation in corresponding global projects.
• Cooperation with other internal departments, such as working hygiene, biosecurity, fire protection etc.
• Support / advise line functions in the clarification of occupational accidents and the development of measures.
• Management of occupational accident data and measures derived therefrom in STARI (System for Tracking And Reporting Incidents)
• further development of Incident Management at the Basel/ Kaiseraugst site Who you are They are open to new ideas and question conventional patterns. They appreciate working in an agile, targeted environment that is supported by mutual respect, discussion and cooperation. For you, Roche is the starting point for an exciting and international working environment with a variety of development opportunities. As a successful candidate:in our position as a specialist:in occupational safety you show a high affinity for safety-related topics. With your service-oriented character, you can organize yourself as a contact person: for your customer groups in the Basel/Kaiseraugst area. You also have the following skills:
• Professional qualification (in the field of chemistry, production, research & development, workshop, construction site) or university or technical college degree in a scientific study (chemistry, process engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering), experience in the fields of chemistry and process engineering
• additional training as a specialist: in occupational safety and health or higher.
• Professional experience in Bere

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is part of the Legal and Compliance department in Diagnostics Division with matrix reporting lines. Your direct report is to Head of Legal and Compliance with dotted line managers Head of Marketing and Head of Professional Services also with direct access to executive directors (as legally required). The Cybersecurity and Digital Solutions Lead is responsible for developing and implementing cybersecurity policies and protocols to protect Roche's products, information systems and technologies and managing the roadmap, governance, and value realization of key digital initiatives across the Czech Affiliate and its Diagnostics and Pharma businesses. Using your expertise in Roche's products and environment, you will ensure systems comply with all security and regulatory standards. You will also apply your technical skills to manage and mitigate cyber threats. The Opportunity
• Develop and oversee cybersecurity framework, strategy, policies and procedures (eg. ISO 27001 implementation, NIS2 local implementation) to safeguard digital systems and sensitive information.
• Manage the cybersecurity responsibilities across different teams in Roche Diagnostics and Pharma divisions and ensure cooperation throughout the organization and overall alignment with Roche's security objectives.
• Ensure Regulatory Compliance with cybersecurity and data protection requirements.
• Manage the Risk Framework and monitor risk management activities.
• Perform risk assessments to identify potential cyber threats and establish and coordinate a risk management plan in the context of the organisation as well as individual installation cases.
• Assess system vulnerabilities and implement security measures.
• Monitor network and information security systems for potential breaches and intrusions.
• Coordinate potential cyber security incidents.
• Cooperate and coordinate the process of cybersecurity asset management.
• Conduct regular security audits and compliance checks across all systems and applications and elaborate regular reports on cybersecurity risks and mitigation steps.
• Liaise and communicate directly with the regulatory Authorities and relevant Bodies on topics of cybersecurity.
• Communicate directly and regularly with the management on the topics of cybersecurity, support Executive Management in cybersecurity-related decisions
• Prepare Security Assessments and Reports for Leadership.
• Maintain updated knowledge of cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, and technologies.
• Collaborate with external IT and external business units (e.g. hospitals and laboratories, etc.) to ensure effective cybersecurity strategies are integrated into business processes.
• Provide training and awareness programs on cybersecurity best practices for all staff.
• Manage cybersecurity training and awareness programs across business functions.
• Oversee third-party risk management and vendor cybersecurity compliance.
• Define and maintain the digital portfolio roadmap for diagnostics, including connected devices, remote monitoring tools, and AI-driven decision support systems.
• Work cross-functionally with Product Management, IT, and Legal, Compliance and Regulatory teams to ensure timely and compliant delivery.
• Collaborate with all stakeholders (internal/ external) on development and implementation of Digital Products and Solutions strategy. Who You Are
• Master’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• Certifications su

The Cybersecurity and Digital Solutions Lead is responsible for developing and implementing cybersecurity policies and protocols to protect Roche's products, information systems and technologies and managing the roadmap, governance, and value realization of key digital initiatives across the Czech Affiliate and its Diagnostics and Pharma businesses. Using your expertise in Roche's products and environment, you will ensure systems comply with all security and regulatory standards. You will also apply your technical skills to manage and mitigate cyber threats. The Opportunity
• Develop and oversee cybersecurity framework, strategy, policies and procedures (eg. ISO 27001 implementation, NIS2 local implementation) to safeguard digital systems and sensitive information.
• Manage the cybersecurity responsibilities across different teams in Roche Diagnostics and Pharma divisions and ensure cooperation throughout the organization and overall alignment with Roche's security objectives.
• Ensure Regulatory Compliance with cybersecurity and data protection requirements.
• Manage the Risk Framework and monitor risk management activities.
• Perform risk assessments to identify potential cyber threats and establish and coordinate a risk management plan in the context of the organisation as well as individual installation cases.
• Assess system vulnerabilities and implement security measures.
• Monitor network and information security systems for potential breaches and intrusions.
• Coordinate potential cyber security incidents.
• Cooperate and coordinate the process of cybersecurity asset management.
• Conduct regular security audits and compliance checks across all systems and applications and elaborate regular reports on cybersecurity risks and mitigation steps.
• Liaise and communicate directly with the regulatory Authorities and relevant Bodies on topics of cybersecurity.
• Communicate directly and regularly with the management on the topics of cybersecurity, support Executive Management in cybersecurity-related decisions
• Prepare Security Assessments and Reports for Leadership.
• Maintain updated knowledge of cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, and technologies.
• Collaborate with external IT and external business units (e.g. hospitals and laboratories, etc.) to ensure effective cybersecurity strategies are integrated into business processes.
• Provide training and awareness programs on cybersecurity best practices for all staff.
• Manage cybersecurity training and awareness programs across business functions.
• Oversee third-party risk management and vendor cybersecurity compliance.
• Define and maintain the digital portfolio roadmap for diagnostics, including connected devices, remote monitoring tools, and AI-driven decision support systems.
• Work cross-functionally with Product Management, IT, and Legal, Compliance and Regulatory teams to ensure timely and compliant delivery.
• Collaborate with all stakeholders (internal/ external) on development and implementation of Digital Products and Solutions strategy. Who You Are

Oportunidad
• Realizas la inspección física, registro fotográfico y verificación de rotulados e insertos de los productos médicos que ingresan al almacén.
• Elaboras y mantienes actualizados los expedientes de lote ( batch records ) y las órdenes de inspección para los procesos de reacondicionado.
• Verificas los certificados de análisis (CoAs) y reportas oportunamente cualquier discrepancia detectada en los productos.
• Gestionas la segregación y el control del inventario de contramuestras según los requerimientos establecidos.
• Descargas, analizas y notificas el estado de los monitores de temperatura de las importaciones, asegurando la cadena de frío.
• Consolidas la información de los registros de temperatura del almacén y generas los informes mensuales de conformidad.
• Apoyas en la preparación de autoinspecciones y auditorías internas para los procesos de almacenamiento y distribución.
• Colaboras en la actualización de los procedimientos de calidad y en las capacitaciones del personal en buenas prácticas. Quien eres
• Eres egresado/a de las carreras de Química Farmacéutica, Toxicología o Tecnología Médica.

• Demuestras un manejo intermedio de MS Office, especialmente en el uso de Excel.

Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part to achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspiration to build industry-leading digital and lean operations across functions and our entire manufacturing footprint. PTE is the organization that catalyzes global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further develop the Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients. We aim to activate data citizenship and digital mindset, revolutionize our FAIR data ecosystem and systems landscape, re-design excellent processes, and generate transformative insights. The Opportunity You will be responsible for driving the digital technology strategy through the delivery of key digital initiatives and use cases in the Quality domain and you take the role of an Agile Product Owner (PO) to partner with customers across PT functions to architect the planning (e.g. diagnose), execution (e.g. design & build), and sustainment of digital solutions to achieve the PT Digital Aspirations.
• Strategic Digital Transformation: Architecting key initiatives and acting as a digital translator between business needs and technical roles by navigating across both domains seamlessly.
• Impact: Defining impact aspirations (e.g. product vision, roadmap, value assessments, business cases) as well as leading deployment of a global solution in a function or site. Enable significant improvements in quality management processes through innovative digital solutions, confirmed through the measurement of key business metrics.
• Requirements Analysis: Utilize your broad Quality end to end Business understanding to perform detailed requirement analyses with the team, with a strong focus on balancing process requirements, stakeholder requirements with digital product simplicity, network scalability and sustainability.
• Prioritization and Team Setup: Conducting use case prioritization and assuming the product owner role to catalyze the implementation of key digital use cases. Coach teams that are developing and deploying digital use cases, e.g. share best practices, agile ways of working, backlog management, sprint planning and ensure full impact capture & coordination between different initiatives. Lead cross-functional project teams with digital experts and SMEs across multiple sites and time zones.
• Compliance and Solution Shaping: Facilitating compliant solutions for data and digital products in the GxP environment.
• Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Identify potential risks associated with digital quality initiatives and develop strategies to mitigate these risks.
• Innovation and Improvement: Continuously explore and assess emerging digital technologies and industry trends. Drive innovation and process improvements within the Quality domain to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Who you are You bring several years of experience in architecting and implementing digital

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche is seeking a strategic and collaborative ERP Product Lifecycle Management Business Partner to join the Informatics ERP Team at Roche. In this role, you will partner closely with business stakeholders across Roche Diagnostics and Roche Diabetes Care to drive digital transformation initiatives spanning Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) capabilities. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor between business functions and Informatics teams, ensuring that enterprise solutions align with operational, regulatory, product development, and manufacturing objectives across the Diagnostics discipline and Diabetes Care portfolio. The Opportunity: This role requires strong cross-functional engagement, business process expertise, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technology solutions. Business Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement
• Serve as the primary Informatics business partner for ERP and PLM initiatives within Roche Diagnostics and Roche Diabetes Care.
• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Commercial, and Operations teams.
• Facilitate alignment between business strategy and enterprise technology roadmaps.
• Drive effective communication between business users, solution architects, vendors, and delivery teams. ERP & PLM Strategy and Delivery
• Lead and support ERP and PLM transformation initiatives across Diagnostics and Diabetes Care.
• Identify opportunities for process optimization, harmonization, and digital innovation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position En Roche, nos apasiona transformar la vida de los pacientes . Como Access & Value Lead , reportarás directamente al Gerente General y liderarás el diseño e implementación de estrategias integrales para asegurar el acceso sostenible y oportuno a nuestras soluciones innovadoras en el sistema de salud ecuatoriano . Dirigirás un equipo multidisciplinario enfocado en generar propuestas de valor diferenciadas con un alto impacto clínico, económico y social . ● Estrategia de acceso: Diseñar y liderar la estrategia integral de acceso (precios, reembolso, HTA,acuerdos innovadores), alineada con los objetivos del negocio y las prioridades de salud pública. ● Liderazgo de equipo: Guiar, desarrollar y empoderar al equipo de acceso, asegurando una cultura de altodesempeño, colaboración transversal e innovación constante. ● Gestión del entorno institucional: Construir relaciones estratégicas con entidades regulatorias, aseguradoras públicas y privadas, organismos multilaterales, asociaciones de pacientes y otros actores clave. ● Valor y evidencia: Trabajar en conjunto con Medical y otras áreas para generar evidencia local relevante (real world evidence, PROs, análisis farmacoeconómicos) que sustente las decisiones de acceso.
• ● Participación en políticas públicas: Representar a Roche en espacios de diálogo regulatorio, técnico ypolítico, e influir en la construcción de políticas sanitarias basadas en valor.
• ● Desarrollo de soluciones sostenibles: Impulsar modelos de acceso innovadores como esquemas de riesgo compartido, acuerdos de valor, compra por resultados, entre otros.
• ● Colaboración regional y global: Conectar la realidad local con las estrategias regionales y globales, aportando insights y adaptando mejores prácticas.
• ● Cumplimiento regulatorio y ético: Garantizar que todas las actividades de acceso se realicen en conformidad con las políticas de Roche, el marco legal local y los más altos estándares éticos. ● Desarrollo de personas: responsabilidad de actuar como líder visionario, arquitecto, catalizador y coach en el desarrollo de su equipo, fomentando el crecimiento profesional, y a su vez, el desarrollo de posibles sucesores para el rol. Tu Perfil Formación Académica: Ciencias de salud, economía, salud pública o políticas, con un enfoque en la implementación de políticas y dinámicas del mercado. Maestría finalizada en Salud Pública, Economía de la Salud, Políticas Públicas o un MBA . Experiencia Profesional: Cuentas con un mínimo de 8 años de experiencia liderando roles de acceso al mercado ( Market Access ), asuntos gubernamentales o política sanitaria en la industria farmacéutica o sector salud . Experiencia en fijación de precios, reembolso, HTA (Evaluación de Tecnologías Sanitarias) incluyendo la demostración de valor y el desarrollo de dosieres para pagadores. Conocimiento del Entorno: Demuestras un entendimiento profundo del sistema de salud ecuatoriano u otros parecidos, así como conocimientos específicos en HTA, economía de la salud, regulaciones y pricing . Comprensión profunda de los sistemas de salud y los entornos políticos, así como su impacto en el acceso al mercado. Pensamiento Estratégico: Tienes una sólida capacidad para analizar el impacto sistémico, simplificar procesos complejos y ejecutar con un fuerte enfoque en resultados e innovación . descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Histology Associate (2nd shift) supports the functions of RTD histology laboratories in the performance of routine histotechniques. This is an essential position supporting the organizational goals requiring attendance on weekends, holidays and during emergency or exceptional conditions. The Opportunity:
• Histotechniques (Tissue Sectioning and Staining)
• Demonstrates foundational histotechniques of embedding, microtomy, coverslipping, processing and primary staining.
• Operates laboratory or manufacturing equipment.
• Receives detailed directions on all work. Follows standard operating procedures.
• Monitors and prepares bulk reagents.
• May assist in preparation work for moderately complex techniques under the direction of more senior histology technicians.
• Proactively collaborates with peers and with other functions to ensure targets are achieved.
• Provides suggestions to improve work processes and laboratory equipment. Quality and Safety
• Maintains Right to Operate and ensure that all processes are performed in a safe and healthy manner; Addresses and escalates any potentially unsafe hazards; Timely reports safety hazards, incidents and near misses using safety reporting tools.
• Navigates and understands the quality system and escalate issues.
• Accurately performs tasks in a regulated environment (OSHA, NMPA, FDA, etc.).
• Performs and documents all transactions and production instructions with accuracy related to the proper receipt, quarantine, storage, and disbursement of materials as it relates to FDA, OSHA, QSR, ISO, Good Manufacturing Practices and other Roche policies and procedures.
• Recognizes minor issues with raw materials, equipment and lab safety, escalates as needed.
• Adheres to 95% or above internal training compliance. Who you are?
• You have a High School Diploma or GED
• You have 1+ years in direct related histology experience. Experience with foundational histotechniques of embedding, microtomy, coverslipping, processing and primary staining. And experience with laboratory or manufacturing equipment. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
• Ability to read, analyze and follow Operating Procedures.
• Knowledge of basic manufacturing and laboratory techniques.
• Skilled use of word processing and email.
• Demonstrated experience with Lean / Continuous Improvement.
• Experience with Google products (gMail, gSheets, gDoc, etc), preferred.
• Experience with SAP required.
• Ability to read, write and comprehend English.
• Ability to work with cross-functional teams.
• Ability to be agile and accurate in a high-volume environment.
• Strong organizational skills, planning skills and attention to detail. Physical conditions and PPE requirements:
• Required to stand, walk, sit, kneel, bend, crouch for a combined 4 or more hours per day.
• Required to push, pull, and lift a minimum of 25 pounds. Repetitive, consistent movements of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
• Required to have good near visual acuity to perform activities throughout the processes in the assigned area. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. The Position La Oportunidad
• Desarrolla la estrategia médica con propuestas de valor enfocadas en que el paciente correcto reciba el tratamiento correcto en el momento correcto.
• Genera un entendimiento profundo del ecosistema de la oncología con foco en Cáncer de Mama y medicina de precisión y ayuda a diseñar el camino para lograr que la medicina personalizada sea parte de la práctica clínica.
• Analiza e interpreta los datos relevantes médicos y científicos, así como la recolección de insights de diferentes fuentes incorporándolo a la estrategia médica con foco en nuestros clientes, ofreciendo a través de la educación médica, conocimiento profundo sobre el área de Cáncer de Mama.
• Lidera, desarrolla, co-crea e implementa estrategias de acceso temprano, mostrando el valor que tiene el portafolio para la identificación y tratamiento oportuno de las pacientes con Cáncer de Mama.
• En su rol de líder habilitador construye y fortalece una interacción sólida con sus stakeholders.
• Trabaja en estrecha colaboración con los Patient Journey Partners (PJPs) y Healthcare System Partners (HSPs) del área de oncología para identificar y anticipar las necesidades de los clientes (Health Care Professionals, pacientes y pagadores) para co-crear y desarrollar soluciones integradas junto con diferentes partes interesadas que brinden el máximo beneficio a los pacientes y estén alineadas con la visión estratégica y de resultados para la atención médica oportuna y personalizada.
• Aprovecha y maximiza el uso de los canales y herramientas digitales para brindar experiencias significativas al cliente que agreguen valor a los pacientes.
• Lidera el diseño e implementación de programas de soporte a pacientes alineado al plan médico a través de Programas de Diagnóstico y Monitoreo de la Enfermedad, apoyo a la administración de medicamentos y educación para el diagnóstico temprano y referencia de pacientes
• Trabajo en conjunto con el equipo de acceso y de política pública para navegar el proceso de reembolso de forma efectiva y ayuda a formar un ambiente favorable para la oncología.
• Responsable de la aprobación apropiada de materiales promocionales y no promocionales asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos locales y globales aplicables a oncología. Generación de Evidencia Local
• Trabajo en conjunto con el área de RWE en la identificación de Gaps de evidencia local para co-crear con los actores de los ecosistemas soluciones que puedan cubrir los gaps para mejorar el acceso y la atención personalizada de los pacientes.
• Trabaja de forma colaborativa con operaciones clínicas en la identificación de potenciales estudios clínicos que puedan generar experiencia en nuestro país con nuestras moléculas. Medical Information
• Asegura de que la información médica y del producto se proporcione de acuerdo con los procedimientos operativos estándar, los requisitos locales y que todos los datos utilizados en la provisión de MI sean precisos y satisfagan las necesidades de los clientes internos y externos.
• Proporciona la información y los conocimientos necesarios en las respuestas relacionadas con el área de Cáncer de Mama cuando se requiera. Seguridad del Paciente y Calidad
• Convertirse en un embajador que promueva la seguridad de los pacientes, reportando de forma oportuna los EAs y fomentando a que el resto de los colegas internos y externos también lo realicen.
• Trabaja en conjunto con el área de calidad para asegurar altos estándares de nuestros productos (participación en r

The Position Como Estagiário(a) de Finanças e Propostas Comerciais você terá a oportunidade de criar impacto sendo essencial para o time, auxiliando na criação, revisão e envio das propostas comerciais da afiliada. Se você tem vontade de aprender e possui os requisitos necessários, junte-se a nós para aprimorar-se continuamente em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. A Oportunidade:
• Você elabora e acompanha as propostas comerciais para a equipe de Diagnóstica, oferecendo uma visão financeira estratégica para as demandas dos clientes.
• Você auxilia na revisão, no acompanhamento e no controle das propostas com os clientes, contribuindo ativamente para o cumprimento das cláusulas financeiras estabelecidas.
• Você gerencia stakeholders de diferentes áreas e realiza conexões com marketing, vendas e finanças para garantir a execução das estratégias comerciais da companhia.
• Você apoia o uso de ferramentas para o gerenciamento e acompanhamento contínuo dos indicadores gerenciais (KPIs).
• Você identifica oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários e atua diretamente nas suas implementações.
• Você colabora com a equipe de pricing na execução, análise e definição das estratégias de precificação para produtos e serviços.
• Você suporta o time de finanças na preparação das análises de rentabilidade e de preços.
• Você prepara apresentações e mantém uma interface clara e contínua com a equipe de liderança. Quem você é:
• Você possui habilidade colaborativa, gosta de lidar com pessoas, tem comunicação clara e assertiva e se adapta facilmente a contextos de mudanças.
• Você demonstra agilidade no aprendizado, foco e organização nas atividades processuais, e proatividade para buscar melhorias.
• Você está cursando o Ensino Superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas (a partir do 2º ano de formação).
• Você possui forte habilidade analítica, facilidade com números e dados, e extrema atenção aos detalhes.
• Você tem conhecimento intermediário em Excel (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, etc.) e valoriza o trabalho em equipe em seu dia a dia. Diferenciais:
• Você tem conhecimento prático em ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, SQL, Python, R).
• Você possui nível de inglês intermediário ou avançado para interações corporativas. Benefícios de recolocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Con i suoi 1400 dipendenti, il centro di produzione Kaiseraugst (PTM) garantisce una cura continua dei pazienti con farmaci di alta qualità. PTM è il più alto standard di produzione farmaceutica, il più grande e innovativo centro di confezionamento di Roche e la fornitura di oltre 120 paesi. La possibilità L'esperto di processo GMP nel campo del riempimento sterile (Asset AFL) è responsabile del coordinamento delle attività per rispettare i requisiti GMP nella sua area intorno agli impianti, processi e prodotti fabbricati. Oltre a rispettare e attuare i requisiti GMP, la produzione senza problemi e stabile è un'altra priorità che si ottiene attraverso miglioramenti indipendenti e continui. Ciò richiede una buona conoscenza delle operazioni e dei sistemi, nonché ottime capacità organizzative per l'elaborazione dei progetti.
• Responsabilità di produzione e di processo: analisi basate sui dati degli indicatori di performance per aumentare l'efficienza, la garanzia della qualità e il monitoraggio dei processi nella produzione; supporto per lanci, trasferimenti e problemi di processo.
• Documentazione & Batch Management: Recensione di Batch Records, SAP Accounting Control e Gestione dei documenti GMP.
• Manufacturing Execution System (MES) : Creazione, sperimentazione e cura di ricette, regolamenti di produzione e record master batch.
• Gestione della qualità e della deviazione: deviazioni, reclami, cambiamenti e CAPA; Gestione delle cause di radice e analisi delle tendenze.
• Gestione dell'ispezione e gestione dei rischi di qualità (QRM) : Preparazione e monitoraggio delle verifiche/ispezione; Responsabilità per le analisi dei rischi e la loro moderazione.
• Formazione e sicurezza: organizzazione e implementazione della formazione; garantire la sicurezza e la protezione ambientale nel settore.
• Progetti & KPI: Supporto per progetti tecnici nell'ambiente GMP con relativa documentazione; revisione KPI, standardizzazione e utilizzo degli strumenti LPS, miglioramento dei processi.
• Esperienze professionali pluriennali nella produzione farmaceutica, nello sviluppo, nella garanzia della qualità e nel controllo o in un'industria vicina sono di grande vantaggio
• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione nella parola e nella scrittura in tedesco e in inglese
• Alto impegno per il lavoro e il datore di lavoro, apertura a nuove, resilienza e flessibilità nonché prestazioni costanti con mutevoli esigenze Ora applicare e diventare parte del nostro team per modellare il futuro insieme! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter offrire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

• Establish Roche Digital Pathology & Sequencing leadership and business in India, through business development, Partnerships and building relationship with Key Opinion Leaders in field of Digital Pathology & Sequencing.

• Develop customer-specific strategies for Roche Digital pathology & Sequencing adoption; working closely with Histopathology laboratory/administrative leadership and pathology staff to develop and scope their Digital Pathology & Sequencing transformation.
• Provide subject matter expertise in pre and post sales capacity. Project Management & Implementation
• Establish new & effective operation approaches & interfaces within Roche functional groups (Sales/marketing, Service, Workflow) & external service provider for achieving desired Implementation.
• Work closely with sales team on presales engagements, drive turnkey solution package proposals, including workflow design (Histopathology & Sequencing set ups), and associated external requirement on network, IP, storage etc. Who You Are: You will have a successful and considerable proven track record in leading people, preferably acquired in the healthcare industry. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche in 50 Worten Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Beschreibung Abteilung/Team Der/Die Labormanager/in gewährleistet die Sicherheit, Einhaltung der Compliance und den reibungslosen Betrieb der zugeordneten Forschungs- und Entwicklungslabore. Diese Rolle dient als primäre Schnittstelle zwischen wissenschaftlichem Personal, Standortdiensten und externen Anbietern. Zu den Kernaufgaben gehört die Steuerung und Instandhaltung der Laborinfrastruktur, um sicherzustellen, dass dem wissenschaftlichen Personal alle erforderlichen Dienste zur Verfügung stehen. Zudem werden die Arbeitsprozesse und der Betrieb der zugewiesenen Laborbereiche überwacht und koordiniert, um die Einhaltung der Qualitätssysteme und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie ein ordnungsgemäßes Gerätemanagement zu garantieren. Die Rolle repräsentiert das Labormanagement-Team als Fachexpert:in für Labor- und Gerätefragen, baut professionelle Beziehungen zu funktionsübergreifenden Teams auf und fungiert als Kommunikationsschnittstelle für Labornutzer:innen, Management-Stakeholder und Auditor:innen. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten/Position
• Labororganisation & reibungslose Abläufe: Du übernimmst die Verwaltung und Überwachung der zugewiesenen R&D-Labore im Hinblick auf allgemeine Laborabläufe (z.B. Zugangskontrolle, Geräte, Reinigung und Wartung) und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Alltag.
• Sicherheit & Compliance: Du stellst die Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen, behördlichen und SHE-relevanten Vorschriften sicher. Dabei setzt du unsere Laborstandards konsequent durch – inklusive bei Verstößen externen Nutzer:innen oder Besucher:innen den Zutritt zu verweigern oder verpflichtende Nachschulungen anzuordnen.
• Sicherheit & Gefahrstoffmanagement: Du stellst sicher, dass alle Gefahrstoffe in den Laboren nach den bestehenden Vorgaben ordnungsgemäß gekennzeichnet und gelagert werden.
• Equipment Management & Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Du fungierst als primäre Ansprechperson zwischen dem wissenschaftlichen Personal, dem internen Gerätemanagement und den Site Services. Du steuerst die Prozesse rund um Installation, Kalibrierung, Qualifizierung, Wartungen, Reparaturen, Umzügen und Außerbetriebnahmen von Neu- und Bestandsgeräten, um Ausfallzeiten in der Forschung auf ein absolutes Minimum zu reduzieren. Zudem stellst du sicher, dass die wissenschaftlichen Teams stets rechtzeitig über geplante Infrastrukturmaßnahmen (wie Stromausfälle oder Umbauarbeiten) informiert sind. Dazu leitest oder nimmst Du an regelmäßigen Labor-User Runden teil.
• Audit-Readiness & Repräsentation: Du stellst GxP-konforme Labordokumentation sicher und vertrittst die Labore souverän bei internen wie externen Audits und führst professionelle Laborrundgänge sowie Sicherheitseinweisungen für Besucher:innen durch.
• Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst und implementierst proaktiv Optimierungen von Prozessen im R&D-Labormanagement (z. B. bei Wartungsplänen oder der Freezer-Nutzung) und gießt diese Best Practices in nachhaltige Prozesse, Leitfäden und SOPs.
• Coaching & Wissensvermittlung: Du bist nicht nur operativ tätig, sondern gibst dein Wissen auch weiter, indem du andere LabManager:innen fachlich betreust, coachst und zielgruppengerechte Schulungen anbietest. Wer bist Du
• Background: Abgesch

• Sicherheit & Gefahrstoffmanagement: Du stellst sicher, dass alle Gefahrstoffe in den Laboren nach den bestehenden Vorgaben ordnungsgemäß gekennzeichnet und gelagert werden.
• Equipment Management & Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Du fungierst als primäre Ansprechperson zwischen dem wissenschaftlichen Personal, dem internen Gerätemanagement und den Site Services. Du steuerst die Prozesse rund um Installation, Kalibrierung, Qualifizierung, Wartungen, Reparaturen, Umzügen und Außerbetriebnahmen von Neu- und Bestandsgeräten, um Ausfallzeiten in der Forschung auf ein absolutes Minimum zu reduzieren. Zudem stellst du sicher, dass die wissenschaftlichen Teams stets rechtzeitig über geplante Infrastrukturmaßnahmen (wie Stromausfälle oder Umbauarbeiten) informiert sind. Dazu leitest oder nimmst Du an regelmäßigen Labor-User Runden teil.
• Audit-Readiness & Repräsentation: Du stellst GxP-konforme Labordokumentation sicher und vertrittst die Labore souverän bei internen wie externen Audits und führst professionelle Laborrundgänge sowie Sicherheitseinweisungen für Besucher:innen durch.
• Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst und implementierst proaktiv Optimierungen von Prozessen im R&D-Labormanagement (z. B. bei Wartungsplänen oder der Freezer-Nutzung) und gießt diese Best Practices in nachhaltige Prozesse, Leitfäden und SOPs.
• Coaching & Wissensvermittlung: Du bist nicht nur operativ tätig, sondern gibst dein Wissen auch weiter, indem du andere LabManager:innen fachlich betreust, coachst und zielgruppengerechte Schulungen anbietest. Wer bist Du

title: Security Engineer - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management

titleByLocale.it: Security Ingegnere - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management
titleByLocale.en: Security Engineer - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management
titleByLocale.de: Security Ingenieur - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a Security Engineer on the Vulnerability and Exposure Management Team, you will help protect sensitive data and defend computer systems and web applications from existing and emerging threats. You will not just be managing scanner output. You will help manage and reduce existing risks, assess and evaluate the weaponization of emerging risks, and act as a core builder of our future capabilities. The Opportunity As an integrated part of the Vulnerability and Exposure Management team, your main responsibilities include :
• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities affecting Roche.
• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities found through our tools, including our bug-bounty program.
• Research emerging vulnerabilities and develop methods to confirm exploitability against our attack surface.
• Communicate risk and work with system owners and other stakeholders to mitigate security vulnerabilities.
• Assess company systems and web applications using both automated and manual tools.
• Maintain, improve, and engineer our scanning, detection, and automation solutions.
• Participating in security monitoring for a global environment. Who you are
• You hold an Associate Degree in a relevant field or 5+ years of experience in the information security field .
• You possess a demonstrated ability to triage, analyze, and escalate security vulnerabilities.
• You have experience with attack surface management in a large and global environment.
• You bring programming experience (e.g., Python, Node.js, JavaScript) combined with a familiarity with modern, AI-assisted code development and engineering workflows.
• You display a strong emphasis on web application, network, and computer security, along with experience validating vulnerabilities and basic exploit development.
• You have a track record of contributing to open-source security projects and writing custom detection logic/templates/scripts.
• You have hands-on cloud security experience and a genuine passion for the field of computer and network security.
• You exhibit strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex risks to non-technical audiences, balancing operational tasks with research projects.
• You are fluent in English. Preferred
• Industry certifications in the field of offensive security (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE). Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Bereit, die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mitzugestalten? Bei Roche verändern wir das Leben von Patient:innen jeden Tag aufs Neue. Für den Bereich Operations Near Patient Care – eine tragende Säule innerhalb der Global Diagnostic Operations – suchen wir ein kluges Köpfchen, das die Analyse, Stabilisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie den zugehörigen Geschäfts- und Logistiksystemen unterstützt. Als funktionale Brücke zwischen Business und IT trägst Du maßgeblich dazu bei, produktionskritische Abläufe zu sichern. Werde Teil unserer Reise innerhalb der Digital Operations und sorge mit Deinem praktischen Wissen für ein starkes Fundament, auf dem nachhaltiges Wachstum entstehen kann. Dein neues Team: Unser Team innerhalb der Digital Operations im Bereich Operations Near Patient Care lebt von Vielfalt, gegenseitigem Vertrauen und einer engen, cross-funktionalen Zusammenarbeit. Wir sind ein dynamisches Team, das gemeinsam an zukunftsweisenden Lösungen feilt, Best Practices teilt und sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Hier erwartet Dich ein lebendiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Deine Stimme zählt und neue Ideen ausdrücklich erwünscht sind. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
• Du unterstützt die Bereitstellung und Koordination des lösungsspezifischen Supports für zugewiesene Geschäfts- und Logistiksysteme.
• Du analysierst und behebst funktionale Störungen sowie Prozessunterbrechungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und der IT.
• Du bearbeitest funktionale System- und Prozessthemen im SAP ECC 6.0 Umfeld, insbesondere in den Bereichen Materialwirtschaft, Produktionsplanung, PP-PI und Fertigungssteuerung.
• Du unterstützt die Identifikation von wiederkehrenden Problemen oder Systemstörungen, um zu nachhaltigen Lösungen für produktionskritische Abläufe wie MES-Schnittstellen, Scan- oder Drucklösungen beizutragen.
• Du begleitest die Definition und Pflege von Standards für die unterstützten Systeme und Prozesse im Rahmen von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen.
• Du wirkst bei der Bewertung von Geschäftsanforderungen mit, unterstützt die Durchführung von funktionalen Tests sowie Regressionstests und stellst eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation sicher.
• Du erstellst und pflegst Schulungsunterlagen sowie Systemdokumentationen und führst Wissenstransfers für Key-User und Endanwendende durch. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, Supply Chain / Operations, der Informatik, des Ingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
• Relevante Berufserfahrung (3–5 Jahre mit Bachelor bzw. 2–4 Jahre mit Master), idealerweise mit ersten Erfahrungen in der Projektarbeit.
• Fundierte konzeptionelle und praktische Kenntnisse im Geschäftsprozessmanagement sowie im Bereich von Geschäfts- und Logistiksystemen, idealerweise in einem ERP-Umfeld.
• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) im SAP ECC 6.0 Support, insbesondere in den Modulen SAP MM, PP und PP-PI (wie Bestandsführung, Fertigungs- und Prozessaufträge oder Chargenmanagement).
• Praktisches Verständnis von Fertigungsumgebungen sowie der Unterstützung von Schnittstellen, MES-Prozessen, IDoc-Verarbeitung oder dem Output-Management.
• Strukturierte Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung, ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Kompetenz zur klaren Kommunikation zwischen technischen Teams und den Fachbereichen.
