• Du unterstützt die Identifikation von wiederkehrenden Problemen oder Systemstörungen, um zu nachhaltigen Lösungen für produktionskritische Abläufe wie MES-Schnittstellen, Scan- oder Drucklösungen beizutragen.
• Du begleitest die Definition und Pflege von Standards für die unterstützten Systeme und Prozesse im Rahmen von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen.
• Du wirkst bei der Bewertung von Geschäftsanforderungen mit, unterstützt die Durchführung von funktionalen Tests sowie Regressionstests und stellst eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation sicher.
• Du erstellst und pflegst Schulungsunterlagen sowie Systemdokumentationen und führst Wissenstransfers für Key-User und Endanwendende durch. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, Supply Chain / Operations, der Informatik, des Ingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
• Relevante Berufserfahrung (3–5 Jahre mit Bachelor bzw. 2–4 Jahre mit Master), idealerweise mit ersten Erfahrungen in der Projektarbeit.
• Fundierte konzeptionelle und praktische Kenntnisse im Geschäftsprozessmanagement sowie im Bereich von Geschäfts- und Logistiksystemen, idealerweise in einem ERP-Umfeld.
• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) im SAP ECC 6.0 Support, insbesondere in den Modulen SAP MM, PP und PP-PI (wie Bestandsführung, Fertigungs- und Prozessaufträge oder Chargenmanagement).
• Praktisches Verständnis von Fertigungsumgebungen sowie der Unterstützung von Schnittstellen, MES-Prozessen, IDoc-Verarbeitung oder dem Output-Management.
• Strukturierte Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung, ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Kompetenz zur klaren Kommunikation zwischen technischen Teams und den Fachbereichen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Head of Operations, APAC Hub A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Head of Operations APAC HUB to lead and oversee our outsourced Global Distribution HUB based in Singapore, serving the Asia Pacific region. This pivotal role is responsible for ensuring operational excellence, driving continuous performance improvement, and strengthening relationships with third-party logistics and distribution partners. The ideal candidate brings deep operational expertise, strong leadership capabilities, and a collaborative mindset to manage complex supply chain dynamics in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. The Opportunity
• Strategic & Operational Leadership: Oversee and align end-to-end operations of the APAC Distribution HUB with corporate and regional strategies, contributing to the development and execution of long-term distribution plans.
• Performance & Compliance Management: Define, track, and optimize key performance indicators (KPIs) and service levels, while ensuring full compliance with global trade regulations, regional customs requirements, and contractual agreements with 3PL partners.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with a wide range of internal teams and external partners to streamline processes, enhance customer satisfaction, and manage governance frameworks.
• Financial & Inventory Oversight: Manage a significant annual operating budget (SGD 25M) and an extensive inventory stock (~SGD 200M), balancing cost-effectiveness with service excellence and ensuring accuracy and availability across the region.
• Team Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team of more than 3 direct reports, fostering a culture of accountability and building future leadership pipelines.
• Continuous Improvement & Digital Transformation: Champion the adoption of digital tools, automation, and analytics to drive operational visibility, predictive planning, and continuous process improvements.
• Risk Management & Business Continuity: Identify and mitigate operational risks through robust business continuity planning and crisis response strategies.
• Values & Sustainability Champion: Promote a safe, efficient, and inclusive work environment, championing sustainable practices aligned with Roche’s values and ESG goals. Who you are
• You should possess a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in operations or supply chain management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within a regional or global distribution environment. A Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is required, while a Master’s degree (e.g., MBA or relevant technical specialization) is preferred.
• Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams while leveraging advanced analytical skills to drive data-driven decisions and contribute to long-term distribution strategies.
• Operational & Financial Oversight: Demonstrated success in managing complex outsourced operations and third-party logistics (3PL) providers, with a strong focus on optimizing financial performance, service levels, and inventor

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Als Biostatistiker (m/w/d) in unserem Team bist du der analytische Motor hinter der nächsten Generation medizinischer Diagnostik. In einem multidisziplinären Umfeld schaffst du die statistische Evidenz, die für weltweite Zulassungen lebensrettender Tests entscheidend ist. Unser Team an den Standorten Penzberg, Mannheim und Indianapolis lebt eine moderne, hybride Arbeitskultur und arbeitet regionen- und indikationenübergreifend in den Kundensegmenten Core Lab und Near Patient Care. Das erwartet Dich in der Rolle
• Verantwortung für die Planung und Durchführung statistischer Analysen für komplexe klinische Studien, damit unsere innovativen Diagnostiklösungen weltweit die Zulassungshürden nehmen und zeitnah beim Patienten ankommen.
• Du beherrscht ein breites Repertoir statistischer Standardmethoden und bist in der Lage, dich schnell in komplexe Verfahren einzuarbeiten.
• Professionelle Programmierung statistischer Analysen (primär in R) sowie Ursachenanalyse bei komplexen Fragestellungen während der Studiendurchführung.
• Du agierst als „Statistical Translator“ durch die adressatengerechte Präsentation von Ergebnissen für unsere Partner aus Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations sowie bei Behörden.
• Fachliche Anleitung und Mentoring von Teammitgliedern sowie Studierenden zur Förderung des internen Wissensaustauschs.
• Du wirkst aktiv an internen „Communities of Practice“ mit, um beispielsweise methodische und programmiertechnische Standards kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Wer du bist
• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium oder Promotion in Statistik, Biostatistik, Mathematik, Physik oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Fach.
• Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung (Master 5–7 Jahre / Promotion 3–5 Jahre), idealerweise im Bereich klinischer Zulassungsstudien.
• Du hast fundierte Programmierkenntnisse, idealerweise in R, sowie Erfahrung im Management großer Datensätze.
• Sicherer Umgang mit modernen statistischen Modellierungstechniken und deren Anwendung in einem regulierten Umfeld.
• Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, um komplexe statistische Theorien und Ergebnisse gegenüber fachfremden Stakeholdern souverän zu vertreten.
• Selbstständige und pro-aktive Arbeitsweise, analytisches Denkvermögen und ein ausgeprägtes Team-Mindset. Diese Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet. Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf
• Idealerweise auch Zeugnisse und ein Motivationsschreiben Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens 12.06.2026. (Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist) Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global imp

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Lo sviluppo tecnico di Pharma porta terapie che cambiano il gioco dalla fase clinica I al mercato per servire ogni paziente, ogni giorno. Il nostro core business è quello di sviluppare farmaci sicuri, innovativi ed efficaci utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia per il processo di produzione (Drug Substance and Drug Product), fornitura clinica, formulazione, dispositivo, imballaggio e sviluppo analitico. Il nostro lavoro quotidiano comprende anche la compilazione di documenti normativi e il trasferimento di progetti di sviluppo alla produzione commerciale. Mansioni - Analisi di routine dei campioni di rilascio e stabilità in diversi progetti e caratterizzazione funzionale estesa. - A seguito di un flusso di lavoro conforme a GMP nel nostro paesaggio analitico all'interno dello sviluppo tecnico (CMC). - Sviluppo, miglioramento e convalida dei metodi analitici per la valutazione della qualità delle sostanze attive - Supportare le interfacce per la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce e per l'organizzazione QC commercializzata.
• Requisiti - Tecnico di laboratorio con Apprenticeship (si prega di notare: questo ruolo è su misura per le qualifiche professionali; Master o PhD gradi sono al di fuori della portata di questa posizione) con almeno 5 anni di esperienza in un ambiente industriale che lavora su bioassay, idealmente in un'organizzazione QC e lavorare secondo GMP. - Esperienza pratica nelle metodologie immunologiche rilevanti come ELISA, saggi di gene reporter, saggi di proliferazione, saggi di uccisione cellulare e cultura cellulare. - Auto-organizzante modo di lavorare e la capacità di interagire e cooperare tra organizzazioni di matrice e dipartimenti/funzioni. - Buone competenze in lingua inglese e tedesca. Durata e nota Questa posizione è fissa per 2 anni. Cosa? Eccitato a plasmare il futuro con noi? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Contatto Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

The Position Pharma Technical Development brings game-changing therapies from clinical phase I into the market to serve every patient, every day. Our core business is to develop safe, innovative and effective drugs using cutting edge technologies for manufacturing process (Drug Substance and Drug Product), clinical supply, formulation, device, packaging, and analytical development. Our daily work also includes compiling of regulatory documents and the transfer of development projects to commercial manufacturing. The Opportunity:
• Routine analysis of release and stability samples across several projects as well as extended functional characterization.
• Following a GMP compliant workflow in our analytical landscape within technical development (CMC).
• Development, improvement and validation of analytical methods for the quality assessment of active substances
• Supporting the interfaces to early research and development as well as to marketed QC organization. Who You Are:
• Lab technician with Apprenticeship (please note: this role is tailored for vocational qualifications; Master’s or PhD degrees are outside the scope of this position) with at least 5 years of experience in an industrial setting working on bioassays, ideally in a QC organization and working according to GMP.
• Hands-on experience in relevant immunological methodologies like ELISA, reporter gene assays, proliferation assays, cell killing assays and cell culture.
• Self-organizing way of working and the ability to interact and cooperate across matrix organizations and departments/functions.
• Good written and spoken English and German language skills. This position is fixed term for 2 years. Excited to shape the future with us? We look forward to receiving your application! Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. La Posizione Pharma Technical Development bringt spielerische Therapien aus der klinischen Phase I in den Markt, um jeden Patienten jeden Tag zu bedienen. Unser Kerngeschäft ist die Entwicklung sicherer, innovativer und effektiver Medikamente mit modernsten Technologien zur Herstellung von Prozessen (Drug Substance and Drug Product), klinischer Versorgung, Formulierung, Gerät, Verpackung und analytischer Entwicklung. Unsere tägliche Arbeit umfasst auch die Erstellung von regulatorischen Dokumenten und die Übertragung von Entwicklungsprojekten auf die gewerbliche Fertigung. Mansion - Routineanalyse von Release- und Stabilitätsproben über mehrere Projekte sowie erweiterte Funktionscharakterisierung. - Nach einem GMP-konformen Workflow in unserer analytischen Landschaft in der technischen Entwicklung (CMC). - Entwicklung, Verbesserung und Validierung analytischer Methoden zur Qualitätsbewertung von Wirkstoffen - Unterstützung der Schnittstellen zur frühen Forschung und Entwicklung sowie zur vermarkteten QC-Organisation. Voraussetzungen - Labtechniker mit Lehramt (bitte beachten: diese Rolle ist auf berufliche Qualifikationen zugeschnitten; Master- oder PhD-Abschlüsse sind außerhalb des Rahmens dieser Position) mit mindestens 5 Jahren Erfahrung in einem industriellen Umfeld, das an Bioassays arbeitet, ideal in einer QC-Organisation und arbeiten nach GMP. - Hands-on Erfahrung in relevanten immunologischen Methoden wie ELISA, Reporter-Gen-Assays, Proliferations-Assays, Zell-Tötungs-Assays und Zellkultur. - Selbstorganisierende Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, über Matrixorganisationen und Abteilungen/Funktionen zu interagieren und zu kooperieren. - Gut geschrieben und gesprochen Englisch und Deutsch Sprachkenntnisse. Durata e Note Diese Position ist für 2 Jahre befristet.

Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Contattoo Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics, we are redefining how we connect with customers globally. We are seeking a Solution Architect - Content Supply Chain & Web Experience to lead the technical evolution of our next-generation ecosystem. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in shaping modular, cloud-native, and AI-enabled customer engagement capabilities across global and local markets. You will work within a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment alongside product leads, engineers, and strategic partners to translate business capabilities into future-state architecture. Your Responsibilities
• Shape Architecture Strategy: Define and maintain the target architecture, integration patterns, and technical guardrails for our Content Supply Chain and Web Experience capabilities.
• Design Scalable Solutions: Create reusable, secure, and compliant end-to-end architectures spanning content planning, creation, storage, activation, and real-time personalization.
• Lead Ecosystem Integration: Direct technical architecture across premiere platforms, including Adobe Experience Cloud (Sites, Assets, Workfront, GenStudio), Veeva Vault PromoMats, and advanced Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).
• Govern Technical Quality: Drive robust non-functional requirements including scalability, performance, security, and global compliance standards (such as GDPR).
• Collaborate and Guide: Partner closely with Technical Product Owners and engineering teams to validate technical designs, manage architectural dependencies, and ensure sustainable deliveries.
• Foster Innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies, championing proof-of-concepts in AI-enabled content operations, dynamic content assembly, and enterprise content intelligence. Who You Are
• You are a forward-thinking technical leader who thrives on turning complex digital ecosystem challenges into simplified, high-performing platform realities.
• You excel at bridging the gap between business vision and deep technical engineering, utilizing your exceptional stakeholder management skills to influence distributed global teams.
• Extensive Architecture Experience: 8+ years of proven success in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or complex digital platform engineering.
• Ecosystem Mastery: Demonstrated experience designing, integrating, and scaling enterprise web content management, digital asset management (DAM), and dynamic personalization technologies.
• Modern Engineering Mindset: Strong, practical understanding of cloud-native architectures, API-first delivery, integration patterns, and composable platform ecosystems.
• Technical Governance & Compliance: Robust knowledge of navigating non-functional requirements like web security, accessibility, performance optimization, and international data privacy regulations.
• Academic Foundation: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
• Nice-to-have highlights: Experience in regulated environments (such as life sciences or healthcare) or direct technical familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud and Veeva Vault platforms is highly valued. At Roche, we embrace emerging innovations, like AI, to enhance the patient journey. If you’re passionate about new technology and thinking ahead, we want you to join us! Oversees the management of significant scope changes, ensuring strategic alignment and minimal disruption, while proactively identifying and driving improvements to scope-related processes for enhanced delivery efficiency.
• Stakeholder Management: Identifies key stakeholders, including senior management, across organizational boundaries and analyzes complex stakeholder networks. Develops and executes comprehensive stakeholder engagement and communication plans. Influences stakeholder decisions related to delivery, navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and builds strong collaborative relationships across the organization.
• Impact/Strategy: Provides consistent leadership and significant impact across major products within a product line or domain. Drives significant impact on projects and programs by embedding Agile best practices and leading organizational change initiatives. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, fosters a culture of innovation, and proactively proposes improvements to help implement strategic objectives.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Manages complex projects or services, potentially across domains, and leads delivery within a program or large initiative. Manages highly complex delivery involving multiple dependencies, opportunities, and risks. Handles ambiguous delivery requirements and leads the implementation of delivery frameworks while navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.

The Position Data Engineer Experience - 4 to 8 years Location- Pune Job description The Senior IT Data Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and robust data pipelines and infrastructure. This role involves independently building ETL/ELT processes, optimizing data storage solutions (such as data warehouses and data lakes), ensuring data quality and reliability, and monitoring data systems. You will collaborate closely with data scientists and analysts to meet their specific data requirements, utilizing strong programming skills in Tableau, Snowflake, Talend, Python or Scala, expert SQL knowledge, and proficiency in big data technologies like Spark. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with experience working within Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, or Pharmacovigilance / Safety team with a solid understanding on the E2E process flow across R&D. Additionally, a proven track record of navigating the stringent requirements of GxP environments (GCP, GMP, GVP) and managing complex, cross-functional data workflows is highly desirable. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• End-to-End Pipeline Delivery: Independently leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines, managing specific data engineering projects autonomously from inception to deployment.
• Performance Optimization & Problem Solving: Solves complex data ingestion and processing challenges, actively optimizing data flows to enhance overall system performance and reliability.
• Stakeholder Alignment & Integration: Partners directly with business units and data scientists to understand data requirements, effectively bridging technical execution with non-technical business needs.
• Strategic Infrastructure Impact: Owns large-scale data engineering initiatives, implementing robust strategies that significantly modernize and strengthen the organization’s data infrastructure.
• Complex Data Integration: Manages large, intricate data ecosystems by seamlessly integrating multiple diverse data sources to ensure efficient, secure cross-platform data flows. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Large-Scale Data Systems Management: Demonstrated experience owning major data engineering initiatives and managing complex, high-volume enterprise data systems.
• Autonomous ETL/ELT Pipeline Development: Proven track record of independently architecting, building, and maintaining automated ETL/ELT data ingestion and transformation processes.
• Storage Solution Optimization: Hands-on experience designing and optimizing modern data storage environments, including data warehouses and data lakes, for peak performance and cost efficiency.
• Data Quality & Reliability Assurance: Expert capability in implementing rigorous data quality checks, data cleansing rules, and reconciliation frameworks across all pipelines.
• System Monitoring & Observability: Strong experience building robust monitoring, alerting, and logging systems to ensure continuous high availability and minimal downtime of data workflows.
• Technical Skills
• Programming & ETL/ELT Mastery: Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and Scala combined with expert use of tools like Talend to build, ingest, and process complex structured and unstructured data streams.
• Cloud & Big Data Architecture: Deep expertise leveraging distributed computing frameworks (Spark, Hadoop) and cloud-native data platforms ( Snowflake) to manage

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As an Expert within the Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA) team, you move beyond "checking boxes" to become a strategic partner for global Engineering hubs. You will lead high-impact security and privacy risk assessments, ensuring Roche’s most ambitious digital projects—from GenAI to cloud-native platforms—are resilient, "Secure by Design," and compliant with global regulations. The Team The Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA) team serves as the strategic bridge between IT, business, and legal functions at Roche. Our mission is to ensure that Roche’s digital landscape—from cutting-edge GenAI platforms to global enterprise solutions—is secure by design and compliant with international standards. We act as a global center of excellence that translates complex regulatory requirements into actionable security architecture, providing the expert guidance necessary to navigate a rapidly evolving global risk landscape. Key Responsibilities
• High-Risk Advisory: Lead Security Expert Reviews (SER) for complex architectures, performing deep-dive technical and privacy evaluations to identify and mitigate residual risks.
• Privacy: Bridge the gap between IT, Legal, and Data Protection Officers. Translate complex legal mandates (GDPR, CCPA etc.) into actionable technical and organizational controls.
• Information Security: Contribute to Security Design Patterns and Technical Baselines for emerging technologies like Generative AI and Cloud-native ecosystems.
• Risk Governance: Utilize ServiceNow IRM to ensure the integrity and traceability of security advisory, delivering data-driven, consistent, and audit-ready results.
• Peer Excellence: Foster a "Four-Eye" quality culture through peer reviews and collective knowledge exchange within a global team of experts. Who You Are Our Ideal Mindset: A proactive Expert & Influencer who brings deep industry experience to an established team. You have the confidence to lead initiatives independently while thriving in an environment of collective knowledge exchange. Qualifications:
• Experience: 5–10 years in Information Security/GRC, with a proven track record in Information Risk Assessments and DPIAs in complex, global environments.
• Technical Savvy: Deep understanding of Security Architecture and the ability to translate "Legal-speak" into "Engineering-speak."
• Regulatory Mastery: Expert knowledge of international privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, etc.) and security standards (ISO 27001, NIST).
• System Proficiency: Experienced in using ServiceNow IRM to execute and document risk assessments, utilizing the platform to ensure consistent, high-quality, and transparent security guidance.
• Education: Degree in Computer Science or Legal. Certifications like CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CIPP/E, CIPM or ISO27001 Lead Auditor are highly valued.
• C ommunication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive consensus across a global organization. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Summary: Lead the development and implementation of business plans and marketing activities focused on disease areas. Drive diagnostic solutions through deep cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Pharma partners, to achieve business targets. The Opportunity: 1. Establish and implement strategic marketing plans to achieve corporate objectives.
• Formulate and implement comprehensive market promotion plans aligned with the overall disease management diagnostic solutions strategy.
• Collaborate closely with Medical Science Affairs (MSA), Corporate Affairs, Communications and Sales teams to plan and execute integrated market events and promotional activities.
• Research, analyze, and monitor financial, technological, and demographic factors to capitalize on market opportunities and minimize effects of competitive activities
• Oversee and evaluate market research and adjust marketing strategy to meet changing market and competitive conditions
• Ensure effective control of marketing results, and take corrective action to guarantee that achievement of marketing objectives falls within designated budgets
• Establish and maintain relationships with industry influences, key communities and strategic partners
• Develop and manage Key Opinion Leader for products for effective promotion of product lines
• Regular key customers visit to understand their requirements and initiate project to maintain customer relationship and use as a marketing promotion material
• Guide preparation of marketing activity reports and presents to executive management
• Achieve satisfactory market share in relation to preset standards and industry and economic trends
• Recommend optimal pricing 2. Build KOL network in terms of product advisory board and speakers. 3. Build, coach, and lead a high-performing assay team. Develop the team's strategic capabilities to provide cross-disease/department strategic solutions. 4. Assist in yearly budgeting and control department expense within budget. 5. Develop career and development plan for the subordinates. Who you are: 1. Bachelor of Biology related discipline, Masters preferred. 2. Proficiency in both spoken and written English 3. Good command of MS office software application 4. Product & marketing expertise 5. 10 years working experience in a similar capacity and in a similar industry Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary) This role serves as a hybrid strategic leader, combining the leadership of a composite team (comprising Medical Information & Medical Review and AI Product) with the development of a data- and AI-driven medical communication strategy. The mandate is anchored in establishing a "data-driven medical communication flywheel": leveraging AI to proactively capture customer perception insights, building personalized content generation platforms, and developing localized digital education platforms to empower strategic business decisions. Furthermore, the role drives the transformation of traditional MI and MR business models through the introduction of Agent technologies, forging a new paradigm of human-machine collaboration in medical inquiries and automated pre-approvals to accelerate internal process efficiencies and support high-quality business growth under strict compliance standards. Principal Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 1. AI-Driven Strategy & Flywheel Construction Development and execution of a long-term, data-centric medical communication strategy, ensuring strict alignment with overarching business goals.
• Proactive Insight Generation: Leadership in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Social Listening) to proactively capture and analyze customer behaviors and perceptions, identifying market trends and opportunities to provide data-backed support for business decisions.
• Content Generation Platform & Impact: Establishment of a robust content generation platform to significantly accelerate the production speed of high-quality medical education materials. Leadership in the rapid construction of core scientific messaging and educational content derived from AI-driven insights to effectively influence and transform customer perceptions and clinical behaviors.
• Personalized Platform Development: Oversight of the construction of personalized content generation platforms and localized digital education platforms to ensure the medical value proposition is delivered precisely and efficiently based on targeted user personas. 2. Digital Product & Solution Leadership Lead the development, evolution, and ecosystem cooperation for strategic digital assets, ensuring they deliver measurable value to patients and the healthcare system.
• Portfolio Lifecycle Management: Oversee the roadmap and execution of key AI solutions, specifically, Social Listening, Content Generation, Digital Communication, MI Agent, and MR Agent.
• Agile Iteration: Driving the continuous iteration of cutting-edge technologies, such as Large Language Models (LLMs), within medical communication scenarios to optimize product performance in an evolving market landscape. 3. AI Agent Innovation & Human-Machine Collaboration
• Traditional Business Transformation: Leading the introduction and deployment of MI Agents and MR Agents to fundamentally revolutionize traditional medical information inquiries and compliance review workflows.
• Model Innovation: Establishment of a human-machine collaboration model for medical Q&A (MI Agent) and automated pre-approvals (MR Agent) to achieve a quantum leap in business responsiveness while ensuring 100% adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements. 4. Team Leadership & Capability Development Management and mentorship of a hybrid team of MI/MR and AI Product.
• Team Synergy: Elimination of functional barrier between traditional medical communication operations and technical product management

The mandate is anchored in establishing a "data-driven medical communication flywheel": leveraging AI to proactively capture customer perception insights, building personalized content generation platforms, and developing localized digital education platforms to empower strategic business decisions. Furthermore, the role drives the transformation of traditional MI and MR business models through the introduction of Agent technologies, forging a new paradigm of human-machine collaboration in medical inquiries and automated pre-approvals to accelerate internal process efficiencies and support high-quality business growth under strict compliance standards. Principal Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 1. AI-Driven Strategy & Flywheel Construction Development and execution of a long-term, data-centric medical communication strategy, ensuring strict alignment with overarching business goals.
• Proactive Insight Generation: Leadership in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Social Listening) to proactively capture and analyze customer behaviors and perceptions, identifying market trends and opportunities to provide data-backed support for business decisions.
• Content Generation Platform & Impact: Establishment of a robust content generation platform to significantly accelerate the production speed of high-quality medical education materials. Leadership in the rapid construction of core scientific messaging and educational content derived from AI-driven insights to effectively influence and transform customer perceptions and clinical behaviors.
• Personalized Platform Development: Oversight of the construction of personalized content generation platforms and localized digital education platforms to ensure the medical value proposition is delivered precisely and efficiently based on targeted user personas. 2. Digital Product & Solution Leadership Lead the development, evolution, and ecosystem cooperation for strategic digital assets, ensuring they deliver measurable value to patients and the healthcare system.
• Portfolio Lifecycle Management: Oversee the roadmap and execution of key AI solutions, specifically, Social Listening, Content Generation, Digital Communication, MI Agent, and MR Agent.
• Agile Iteration: Driving the continuous iteration of cutting-edge technologies, such as Large Language Models (LLMs), within medical communication scenarios to optimize product performance in an evolving market landscape. 3. AI Agent Innovation & Human-Machine Collaboration
• Traditional Business Transformation: Leading the introduction and deployment of MI Agents and MR Agents to fundamentally revolutionize traditional medical information inquiries and compliance review workflows.
• Model Innovation: Establishment of a human-machine collaboration model for medical Q&A (MI Agent) and automated pre-approvals (MR Agent) to achieve a quantum leap in business responsiveness while ensuring 100% adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements. 4. Team Leadership & Capability Development Management and mentorship of a hybrid team of MI/MR and AI Product.
• Team Synergy: Elimination of functional barrier between traditional medical communication operations and technical product management

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. ASPIRE is a Roche-wide, enterprise business transformation program that aims at harmonizing, simplifying and automating business processes to enable us to focus our efforts even more on doing now what patients need next. Scaled Agile Framework® (SAFe®) was adopted for ASPIRE to design and execute incremental builds with fast, integrated learning cycles, by applying the same cadence with cross-functional planning and decentralizing decision making, enabling us to further accelerate agility. The Opportunity
• Manage the product roadmap, prioritize the team backlog in alignment with the ART Backlog, and determine Agile team capacity allocation.
• Prioritize issue resolution, coordinate User Stories, and ensure approval against Definition of Done, also responsible for user story definition and acceptance criteria.
• Participate in exploration activities to further learn customer needs, ensure features meet Definition of Ready, and deliver input to program execution and incremental planning.
• Engage and collaborate with Product Management, Business SMEs, Data owners, and operational teams to align on E2E data governance processes and collaboratively reduce master data defects.
• Work to ensure training, consistency, and accuracy of master data across systems.
• Demonstrate expertise in SAP-MDG systems, Business partners data, workflow processes, and business improvements experience driven by in-depth business partners business process knowledge.
• Support vision and strategy for Master Data Governance , deployments, testing, creation of master data for other teams, and foster relationships to achieve project goals and objectives. Who you are We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development.
• Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, with over 5 years of master data management experience in the Business Partners Data domain.
• Over 3 years of experience with Enterprise Applications, such as SAP-MDG, and a deep understanding of governance impacts on both business process management and IT.
• Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, and other business partners -specific data privacy regulations, alongside robust interpersonal, communication, and networking skills.
• Proven track record of delivering in a matrixed organization across geographies and divisions, with a strong focus on quality, attention to detail, and the ability to make decisions in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
• Agile mindset and experience working with Agile Organizations, outstanding customer service, and excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a background in consulting or business management services as a strong plus. In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, intern

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position Intern - Direct Procurement Contract type: Contract of mandate (umowa zlecenie) for 12 months Availability: 5 days per week, 25 - 40 hours per week Place of work: Warsaw Office or Remote Join our procurement team as an operational and administrative support specialist! This is an ideal opportunity for someone starting their career to learn procurement processes from the inside, gain experience working in SAP , and participate in the department's digital transformation. You will support us in ensuring supply continuity and building professional relationships with our suppliers. The Opportunity: Operational and Systems Support:
• SAP Order Management: Support in creating and processing orders, as well as monitoring delivery deadlines to clients.
• Vendor Database Management: Setting up new vendors and unblocking existing accounts in the system.
• Material Data Administration: Creating new material indexes in the system and performing regular price list updates. P rocess and Quality Support:
• Contractor Verification: Conducting supplier Due Diligence to secure current business operations and updating the Preferred Supplier List (LPD) .
• Documentation Oversight: Managing specialized documentation related to medical devices ( IVD/MD ).
• Fulfilment Monitoring: Supervising the status of order fulfillment and informing partners about delivery schedules. Administrative Tasks and Innovation:
• Contract Workflow and Archiving: Managing the signing process and circulation of documents with suppliers, and archiving documents within systems ( MyBuy ).
• Communication and AI: Maintaining the Procurement Intranet site and providing substantive oversight of materials for the AI assistant . Who you are:
• You own a University Degree or you are still studying
• You are meticulous and accurate when working with data and IT systems.
• You have strong time management skills and the ability to prioritize tasks.
• You have great communication skills and a desire to work in a dynamic, modern environment.
• You are proficient in Polish & English What you get:
• Flexibility: A contract of mandate ( umowa zlecenie ) that can easily be adjusted to your university schedule.
• Modern Toolkit: Opportunity to learn SAP and MyBuy tools within international structures.
• Exposure to Innovation: The chance to co-create solutions based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in procurement.
• Expert Development: Working within a team of "team players" who focus on knowledge sharing and substantive support. If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it. The data is processed for the purpose of recruitment. You have the right to access data, rectify it, delete it, limit processing, transfer it and - if processing is based on your consent - withdraw this consent at any time. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position ASPIRE is a Roche-wide, enterprise business transformation program that aims at harmonizing, simplifying and automating business processes to enable us to focus our efforts even more on doing now what patients need next. Scaled Agile Framework® (SAFe®) was adopted for ASPIRE to design and execute incremental builds with fast, integrated learning cycles, by applying the same cadence with cross-functional planning and decentralizing decision making, enabling us to further accelerate agility. Disclosure Note: The role is open on a fixed-term basis until 31/12/2029. The Opportunity
• Manage the product roadmap, prioritize the team backlog in alignment with the ART Backlog, and determine Agile team capacity allocation.
• Prioritize issue resolution, coordinate User Stories, and ensure approval against Definition of Done, also responsible for user story definition and acceptance criteria.
• Participate in exploration activities to further learn customer needs, ensure features meet Definition of Ready, and deliver input to program execution and incremental planning.
• Engage and collaborate with Product Management, Business SMEs, Data owners, and operational teams to align on E2E data governance processes and collaboratively reduce master data defects.
• Work to ensure training, consistency, and accuracy of master data across systems.
• Demonstrate expertise in SAP-MDG systems, Business partners data, workflow processes, and business improvements experience driven by in-depth business partners business process knowledge.
• Support vision and strategy for Master Data Governance, deployments, testing, creation of master data for other teams, and foster relationships to achieve project goals and objectives. Who you are We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development.
• Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, with over 5 years of master data management experience in the Business Partners Data domain.
• Over 3 years of experience with Enterprise Applications, such as SAP-MDG, and a deep understanding of governance impacts on both business process management and IT.
• Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, and other business partners -specific data privacy regulations, alongside robust interpersonal, communication, and networking skills.
• Proven track record of delivering in a matrixed organization across geographies and divisions, with a strong focus on quality, attention to detail, and the ability to make decisions in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
• Agile mindset and experience working with Agile Organizations, outstanding customer service, and excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a background in consulting or business management services as a strong plus. In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Ca

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Wir sind Roche Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Hinter jeder Diagnose steht ein Mensch und seine Geschichte. Deshalb ist es unser Ziel bei Roche, Patienten und deren Angehörige auf ihrem Weg ideal zu begleiten. Werde Teil eines unserer Lifecycle Teams in Near Patient Care ! Die herausragende Vielfalt der angewandten Technologien bietet dir großartige Lernmöglichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir wollen wir jetzt schon tun, was Patienten als nächstes benötigen! In deiner Funktion als Produktionsmitarbeiter/Operator im Bereich NPC Internal Manufacturing Mannheim bist du primär für das Bedienen komplexer Produktionseinrichtungen zuständig. Deine Aufgaben:
• Du bedienst Bereichsübergreifend Abfüll-, Etikettier,- Fertigungs- und Verpackungsanlagen zur Produktion von diagnostischen Produkten
• Das prüfst die zur Produktion eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Reinigung der Produktionsanlagen und Betriebsmittel unter Berücksichtigung geltender Arbeitsanweisungen
• Gemäß geltender Regularien führst du Inprozesskontrollen durch und dokumentierst diese GMP-konform
• Durch Deine aktive Mitarbeit erkennst Du auftretende Qualitätsmängel, führst vorgeschriebene Stichprobenprüfungen, Musterziehungen und optische Kontrollen durch und arbeitest aktiv am kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess mit.
• Du behebst einfache technische Störungen und übernimmst einfache Umrüstungen
• Alle Aufgaben führst Du unter Beachtung der Arbeitsanweisungen, Hygienevorschriften, Arbeitsschutz-, GMP- und Umweltschutzregeln durch
• Das Arbeiten mit einer FFP3- Maske und einem Gebläse-Atemschutz stellt für Dich kein Problem dar.
• Ver- und Entsorgung der Produktionsbetriebe durch Materialanforderung/-transport, die sachgerechte Kennzeichnung sowie die Entsorgung des Materials liegen in deiner Verantwortung. Dabei nutzt Du manuelle und/oder angetriebene Transportmittel.
• Die Tätigkeit erfordert ständiges Stehen und das tägliche, regelmäßige Heben und Bewegen von schweren Lasten bis 15 kg (unter Umständen bis 28kg). Das bringst Du mit:
• Eine Berufsausbildung hast Du erfolgreich abgeschlossen und besitzt mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem Produktions- oder Verpackungsbetrieb
• Mit Deinem technischen Geschick überzeugst Du ebenso wie mit Deinen detaillierten Kenntnissen über die zu bedienenden Produktionsanlagen.
• Du verfügst über gute GMP-Kenntnisse sowie über praktische Erfahrung im Arbeiten in Bereichen mit besonderen Hygieneanforderungen (z. B. Produktion in einem Reinraum ISO 8 oder höher).
• Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse über manuelle Arbeit mit Kleinteilen in der Musterfertigung mit und hast bereits Erfahrung mit Arbeit an Messmikroskop
• In den gängigen Google Suite und MS Office Programmen bist Du sicher. Auch der sichere Umgang mit SAP und MES ist für Dich kein Problem. Du hast ein Grundverständnis für elektronische Abbildungen in prozessgesteuerten Anlagen.
• Deine Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in verschiedenen Produktionsteams sowie Dein Engagement zeichnet Dich aus.
• Du verfügst über Transportkenntnisse mit Flurförderfahrzeugen oder Gabelstapler.
• Du arbeitest gerne in wechselnden Arbeitszeiten (3-Schicht), um auf Produktionsänderungen entsprechend flexibel reagieren zu können. Auch die Bereitschaft zur Wochenendarbeit ist

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 岗位： (高级)战略合作经理 工作地点：武汉，湖北 您将有机会： 执行所属地区关键医院的准入计划
• 根据总部与BU讨论的每年医院开发计划，准备地区的医院开发计划和时间表，确保在有临床提单情况下的开发成功率
• 推动需开发医院的药事会、临采流程，提供关键医院药学部解决方案
• 确保所属区域关键医院的已准入状态的维护；将医院总控影响降到最低；维护好与关键医院医保办合作
• 协助多渠道准入团队处理区域关键医院或自费药房的价格谈判
• 协助招标和多渠道准入团队处理区域关键医院确标和专家工作 负责所属地区关键医院业务计划（Account planning）制定
• 熟知所负责医院信息和动态变化，完成和完善地区关键医院的 Account Planning
• 根据每家医院的Account Planning，合理分配学术项目所负责的医院
• 根据确认的Account Planning ，向项目团队建议每家医院创新方案，
• 搭建跨部门的沟通平台，分享和落实部分关键医院的Account Planning 负责建立与所属地区关键医院的合作关系
• 根基公司CRM拜访要求，每月制定客户拜访计划，每周上报拜访报告，及时向上级反馈市场信息
• 了解和挖掘所负责地区关键医院业务和学术发展需求，与策略和项目团队讨论提供相应的学术支持
• 协助实施区域品牌项目，培养区域的讲者，打造公司在区域的影响力
• 支持策略和项目团队的全国和区域项目在所负责地区关键医院的实施
• 整合内外部资源，搭建平台，为核心关键医院提供解决方案 日常工作管理
• 按时准确完成日常工作和相关报告
• 完成年度KPI目标
• 严格遵守和执行公司的合规政策 我们期待您： Education/Qualifications 教育程度/ 所获资格证书 大学本科及以上学历 医药相关专业优选 Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力
• 具备3年及以上医药销售经理相关工作经验；或具备5年高级医药销售顾问工作经验
• 掌握专业知识和办公技能，具备主动学习能力，能提供建议和解决方案；
• 具备客户管理能力，能够反映客户经营情况、业务能力的数据信息指标；能根据情况变化、突发情况等给出建议，及时调整工作计划；能得到利益相关客户的建议和大力支持，同医院客户建立持久长期的良好合作关系，为客户提供价值
• 具备项目管理能力掌握项目管理基本知识和技能及工具，能针对性的设计修改项目方案，体现罗氏制药的独特价值；能在项目推进的过程中，灵活调整且做好风险预案，主动管理风险
• 具有谈判和影响能力，能够根据分析出客户的需求和底线，随机应变的给出对应策略；能进行双赢谈判方案设计，与上级、合作部门共同分析讨论，改进谈判方案；建立影响，传递价值，能够不断总结谈判的成功经验，确保谈判成果
• 具备团队合作能力，善于与团队内部或跨部门同事合作分工，合理安排彼此工作重点；具有重大事件解决能力，能对风险有所预判并准备相关预案；能独立策划与举办跨部门沟通合作平台会议
• 具有区域管理能力，落地执行区域发展策略，能在多项事物之间保持好资源投入的平衡；具有高质量地执行流程能力，能够妥善的处理异常情况；能够勇于坚持观点和承担后果，在团队中成为表率，影响带动他人
• 能适应环境和条件的变化，具有较强的抗压能力，主动学习和参与创新，追求卓越绩效
• 战略思维、沟通能力，学习能力，团队合作能力 Travel Frequency出差频率：25% - 50% Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Hinter jeder Diagnose steht ein Mensch und seine Geschichte. Deshalb ist es unser Ziel bei Roche, Patienten und deren Angehörige auf ihrem Weg ideal zu begleiten. Werde Teil eines unserer Lifecycle Teams in Near Patient Care! Die herausragende Vielfalt der angewandten Technologien bietet dir großartige Lernmöglichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir wollen wir jetzt schon tun, was Patienten als nächstes benötigen! In deiner Funktion als Schichtleiter im Bereich NPC Internal Manufacturing Mannheim bist du primär für das Bedienen komplexer Produktionseinrichtungen zuständig. Was Dich erwartet:
• Verantworte den reibungslosen Produktionsablauf unter Einhaltung von SOPs, GMP-Richtlinien und Reinraumregeln.
• Maximiere die Schichtleistung durch effiziente Personal- und Materialplanung sowie gezielte Kennzahlensteuerung.
• Führe und entwickle Dein Schichtteam gemäß der Roche-Führungsgrundsätze und fördere aktiv den „One-Team“-Gedanken.
• Manage das operative Personalgeschäft von Mitarbeitergesprächen und Zielvereinbarungen bis zur Zeitwirtschaft.
• Sichere die Qualität durch regelmäßige Teamschulungen, Shopfloor-Meetings und lückenlose Dokumentation.
• Treibe die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen und Anlagen in enger Abstimmung mit den Schnittstellen voran.
• Gewährleiste höchste Arbeitssicherheit durch proaktive Kontrollen, Sicherheits-Rundgänge und die Wartung der Anlagen. Wer Du bist:
• Qualifikation & Erfahrung: Du hast eine technische Ausbildung abgeschlossen und bringst langjährige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder diagnostischen Produktion mit.
• Führungspersönlichkeit: Du besitzt nachweisbare (fachliche) Führungskompetenz, arbeitest strukturiert und förderst eine offene Kommunikation im Team.
• Fach-Know-how: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes GMP-Verständnis sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Produktions-IT (z. B. MES, SAP) und MS Office.
• Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest Dich durch hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Organisationsgeschick und Belastbarkeit im dynamischen Produktionsumfeld aus.
• Rahmenbedingungen: Du beherrschst Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift und bist bereit zur Arbeit im Vollkonti-Schichtmodell (18/21 Schichten). Deine Bewerbung: Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf
• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt und können bei Bedarf angefordert werden. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Territory Manager based in Bangalore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals. The Opportunity
• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.
• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Bangalore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

The Position Business Systems Analyst- Pharma R&D Job description The Business Systems Analyst is an active and self-sufficient contributor within their project or product team. In this role, you will analyze business requirements independently and translate them into detailed system specifications. You will be responsible for configuring systems, planning and executing various levels of testing, and designing automated systems, including hardware and software compatibility. By providing direct consultation to users, creating detailed documentation, and offering technical assistance, you will ensure seamless operations while considering both the short-term and long-term implications of your decisions. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with experience working within Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, or Pharmacovigilance / Safety team with a solid understanding on the E2E process flow across R&D. Additionally, a proven track record of navigating the stringent requirements of GxP environments (GCP, GMP, GVP) and managing complex, cross-functional data workflows is highly desirable. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Plays an active part within the project and/or product team. Provides constructive feedback, seeks feedback for self, reflects on own challenges and successes, and actively supports others.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Analyzes business requirements and translates them into system specifications. Configures system settings and options to meet user needs. Plans and executes unit, integration, and acceptance testing. Able to assess and communicate risks effectively.
• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and communicates with stakeholders in a straightforward manner. Considers both short-term and long-term implications in decision-making and adjusts rapidly in response to shifting priorities.
• Business / Technical ability: Acts as the strategic bridge between business stakeholders and technical implementation teams. This role provides expert consultation to users, translates complex business needs into detailed, actionable system specifications, and ensures technical solutions deliver measurable business value.
• Business-to-Technical Translation: Act as the primary bridge between cross-functional business stakeholders and technical or operational implementation teams to deliver seamless digital capabilities.
• Lifecycle & Workflow Management: Oversee and optimize complex domain workflows, including clinical data management, Health Authority Q&A tracking, dossier preparation, or global safety case processing.
• GxP Compliance & Governance: Ensure all processes, data exchanges, and platform configurations adhere strictly to global regulatory guidelines, data integrity principles, and company standard operating procedures (SOPs).
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global IT, validation leads, and system vendors to manage platform upgrades, integrations, and releases without disrupting business continuity. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Agile & Product Team Delivery: Demonstrated experience acting as an active, self-sufficient contributor within cross-functional project or product teams, driving deliverables independently under minimal supervision.
• Requirements Lifecycle Management: Proven capability to independently elicit and analyze complex business requirements, translating them into detailed functional requiremen

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Country Study Start-up Team Leader (cSTL) Roche Nederland B.V., Woerden The Opportunity At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In our Global Clinical Operations (PDG) team, we are looking for a Country Study Start-up Team Leader (cSTL) to take on a dual-impact role that is vital to our mission. You will be the driving force behind clinical trial submissions while simultaneously serving as a People Leader (for +- 30% of your time), guiding a dedicated team to success in our country delivery operations. In this pivotal role, you will balance strategic oversight of study start-up with hands-on leadership in regulatory submissions and people management. Your work ensures that we deliver innovative medicines to patients faster and more efficiently by streamlining the bridge between clinical design and site activation. In this role, you will:
• Lead the country strategy for study start-up, driving efficiency and innovation to ensure timely site activation.
• Drive clinical trial submissions and regulatory coordination, managing complex submission packages and responding to Health Authority queries.
• Serve as a People Leader for approximately 30% of your time, providing coaching, support, and professional development to your direct reports.
• Architect and oversee the management of Informed Consent Forms (ICF) and clinical site documentation to ensure global compliance.
• Champion process innovation by identifying opportunities for automation to improve trial initiation timelines.
• Collaborate with global stakeholders, including CROs and Health Authorities, to harmonise systems and influence the local start-up environment.
• Manage clinical site budgets and contracts, ensuring financial and legal alignment through expert negotiation. Who you are You are a proactive, visionary leader who combines deep technical expertise in clinical submissions with a genuine passion for developing others. You thrive in complex, matrixed environments and possess the analytical prowess to turn data into strategic improvements. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• Extensive industry expertise: Proven experience in clinical trial start-up and regulatory submissions, with deep knowledge of ICH-GCP and EU CTR.
• Transformation leadership: A track record in coaching, mentoring, and leading high-performing teams to deliver significant business impact.
• Advanced scientific background: A University degree (MD, PhD, MS, or BS) in life sciences; a postgraduate degree is highly desirable.
• Technical proficiency: Experience navigating complex clinical systems such as Veeva Vault, CTIS, and RIM.
• Exceptional communication: The ability to influence and partner with stakeholders, from local operational teams to global executive leadership.
• Language skills: Mandatory fluency in English and fluency in Dutch is strongly preferred Why Roche? For over 125 years, Roche has been working towards a healthier future with one clear goal: "Doing now what patients need next". We believe that the greatest medical challenges can only be solved through intensive collaboration with healthcare professionals and patients. Our impact goes beyond healthcare; we also take full responsibility for our planet. For instance, since 2025, all our locations have run on 100% sustainable electricity—a major milestone in our ambition to be fully climate neutral (net zero) by 2045. At Roche, you are not just working on the healthcare of tomorrow,

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Experience Required- 6+ years The Accounts Payables ERP Solution Architect designs business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions within the Accounts Payables context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle. By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust ERP implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization. Description of the area Our landscape in the Accounts Payables area integrates SAP ECC and S/4HANA with diverse procurement platforms to support the Invoice-to-Pay lifecycle. We ensure seamless processing from invoice receipt and compliant financial approval workflows through to the successful delivery of payment instructions to the Treasury solution. You will play a key role in navigating the transition from legacy environments to modern ERP standards, ensuring integration resilience and scalability as we re-engineer our global ERP landscape through the ASPIRE program. You will serve as the critical interface for translating business requirements into technical/ IT language. Your primary mission is to deeply explore and define the functional "why" behind business requests, ensuring that every technological solution is built upon a foundation of clearly mapped processes and validated organizational needs. Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs ERP solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific solution context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle, and aligns with the architecture community for proper governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned ERP solution. Assesses and consults on impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, and ontologies for the solution and the related interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, needed NFRs, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility for the solution, including vendor assessments.
• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive technical information and works collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers.
• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap within the solution context. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific ERP technologies for product teams. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies.
