descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Position At the heart of this internship, you will collaborate with our Simulation Teams to architect the future of System & Solution Design. As a key contributor, you will help build and validate ‘Digital Twins’ for our next-generation core lab solutions. Your work won’t just be theoretical, it will directly shape the physical architecture and the logical “brain” of cutting-edge, end-to-end laboratory systems. Your Key Responsibilities
• Model & Maintain: Create and maintain complex scenarios for software and hardware simulations.
• Execute & Analyze: Run simulations and perform deep-dive analyses of the results to identify system behaviors.
• Evolutionary Support: Provide status updates and issue notifications to support the continuous evolution of our simulators.
• Collaborate: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams to improve departmental operations and project delivery. What You Will Learn & Develop
• Advanced Simulation: Gain hands-on experience with Discrete Event Simulation (DES) using tools like Simio or AnyLogic.
• Systems Engineering: Understand the "big picture" of how hardware, software, and logistics integrate into massive diagnostic solutions.
• Algorithmic Thinking: Design and implement efficient heuristics for real-time decision-making in robotics.
• Data Science: Use Python to transform raw simulation outputs into powerful, data-driven visual stories.
• Software Development: Level up your OOP (C# or Java ) skills by extending simulation logic.
• Global Collaboration: Experience working across borders with engineers and product owners in an international environment. Who You Are You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.
• Education: Mechanical Engineering, SW Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Industrial Engineering.
• Programming: Solid foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (C# or Java).
• Data Tools: Knowledge of SQL, Python, and Pandas for data management.
• Simulation: Familiarity with Discrete Event Simulations and statistical modeling.
• Communication: Fluent in English; able to present complex data with clarity.
• Mindset: You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.A strong willingness to learn and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position Department Summary We are seeking a highly motivated professional with experience in Security and Privacy to join our dynamic team. As a Junior Penetration Tester, your main responsibilities will include supporting and assisting in penetration testing activities to ensure the security of Roche products and solutions. This role involves collaborating with Product Teams, executing predefined test strategies, and documenting the results. You will play a crucial role in identifying vulnerabilities and aiding in the reporting process. The Opportunity
• Work closely with Product Teams to understand and determine testing requirements and assist in the development, planning, scoping and execution of testing activities (both in physical and cloud products).
• Conduct cybersecurity penetration testing activities across various technology layers, assessing the criticality of vulnerabilities for adequate prioritization, and providing suitable remediation recommendations to product teams.
• Maintain and utilize the repository of penetration testing methods and tools to ensure consistency and standardization in testing practices.
• Create detailed reports and present findings, associated risks, and recommendations to product teams and management.
• Participate in planning and managing red team exercises to assess the cyber resilience of products and solutions.
• Support the Incident Response team during incidents.
• Contribute to initiatives aimed at integrating defense capabilities into products in collaboration with other PSPO colleagues.
• Develop, maintain, and continuously optimize processes, playbooks, and tools to enhance penetration testing efficiency and effectiveness. Program Highlights
• Intensive 1 year intern graduate program (Contrato en prácticas).
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Location in Sant Cugat del Valles, On Site.
• Access to training and development opportunities.
• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry. Who You Are (Required)
• Must have graduated from a University degree program.
• Must have attained a Bachelor's degree.
• Experience or familiarity with cloud computing technologies, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing.
• Knowledge of automating security controls through scripting languages such as shell scripting and Python.
• Understanding of information security and privacy risks.
• Problem solving abilities, communication, teamwork, flexibility and adaptability.
• Team player, proactive, self-driven, solution-oriented, and hands-on. Required Majors: Information Systems, Computer Science or a related relevant area of study. Your mission will be to help the department explore and implement AI use cases, directly contributing to projects that impact patient lives while developing your skills in a professional, high-tech environment. Main responsibilities
• AI Integration: Participate in initiatives to explore, prototype, and implement AI-driven features within our software ecosystem.

Under the guidance of an assigned mentor , you will transition from your initial onboarding to making real contributions to our codebase. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Overview Are you interested in how software R&D organizations evolve to integrate AI and stay ahead in a changing technological landscape? We are looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented R&D AI Transformation Intern to join our strategy team. You won't just be fetching coffee; you’ll be behind the scenes of major structural, cultural, and digital shifts as we embed AI into our engineering DNA, helping us bridge the gap between "traditional development" and "AI-augmented innovation." Key Responsibilities
• Data Analysis & Insights: Gather and analyze R&D performance metrics and AI tool adoption rates to identify bottlenecks and track the progress of ongoing AI transformation initiatives.
• Stakeholder Communication: Assist in drafting internal memos, newsletters, and presentation decks that translate complex AI strategies and LLM implementations into "human" language for our developers and engineers.
• Project Management Support: Maintain project timelines (Gantt charts) and follow up on action items from cross-functional workshops focused on AI integration and automated workflows.
• Research: Conduct competitive benchmarking and research best practices in AI-assisted coding, machine learning operations (MLOps), and organizational design for AI-first R&D teams.
• Workshop Facilitation: Help organize and document brainstorming sessions aimed at improving software delivery pipelines through AI and boosting developer engagement with new intelligent tools. What We’re Looking For
• Curiosity: A genuine interest in the intersection of software business strategy, AI ethics, and engineering culture.
• Communication: The ability to explain a complex technical AI concept or strategic shift simply and clearly.
• Agility: Comfort with ambiguity—navigating the rapid evolution of AI in R&D is rarely a straight line!
• Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data visualization) and PowerPoint (storytelling), with an interest in exploring AI productivity tools.
• Academic Background: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Why Join Us? This isn't your typical administrative internship. You will gain a "bird's-eye view" of how a software R&D organization operates at scale and learn the methodologies used to drive meaningful change in the age of AI. If you're a problem-solver who loves to see the big picture in a high-tech environment, we’d love to have you on board. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About the role Are you a natural communicator with an analytical mind? Do you want to understand how a complex medical product is defined before a single line of code is written? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Product Owner / Requirement Engineer Intern . In this role, you will support our Product Owners in the vital task of defining "what" we build. You will act as a bridge between high-level business needs and the technical implementation teams, ensuring that every feature is clearly documented and understood. This is a unique opportunity to gain a holistic view of the healthcare business and the lifecycle of medical software. Main responsibilities
• Requirement Definition: Support the creation and maintenance of Feature Files and Product Requirements that guide our software implementation partners.
• Product Risk Management: Identify product risks in defined features and define appropriate risk control measures to mitigate risks that could cause patient harm.
• Operational Agility: Assist Product Owners in the day-to-day operational tasks, ensuring that requirements are ready for development "sprints" and resolving functional doubts.
• Tool Management: Work directly with our official requirement management tool, Retina (Codebeamer) , to keep documentation organized and updated.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Help gather needs and feedback from different areas, including Business Leaders (IPM), Global Service (GCS), and other cross-functional departments.
• Quality Assurance: Ensure that the defined requirements meet the necessary quality attributes for a regulated medical environment.
• Process optimization: Actively participate in and contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements processes within a SAFe environment. How would your day-to-day look like? Your day will involve a lot of interaction within the internal team and stakeholders from other areas and projects. You will participate in meetings with senior Product Owners to understand the strategic roadmap, and then translate those ideas into detailed documentation. You will spend time in Retina , refining feature descriptions, product risks, product requirements and ensuring the "definition of ready" is met for the developers. Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to balance the needs of different stakeholders while building a strong network across various business areas. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position ABOUT THE ROLE Are you fascinated by how software is deployed, scaled, and maintained in high-stakes environments? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Engineer Trainee to join our DevOps and Infrastructure operations. In this role, you will be the backbone of our development process. You won't just be writing code; you will be ensuring that our software reaches its destination (testing and production environments) smoothly and reliably. This is a unique opportunity to enter the DevOps world, a discipline built on experience and collaboration rather than traditional textbooks. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
• Environment Maintenance: Support the daily operations of our testing environments, ensuring they are ready for the testing team’s deployments.
• Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with our implementation partners to maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, ensuring faster and safer software delivery.
• Infrastructure as Code: Assist in managing containerized environments using Docker, kubernetes and cloud resources within Azure and AWS .
• Daily Support: Provide support to the development squads in their day-to-day DevOps needs, troubleshooting deployment issues and monitoring system health.
• Continuous Improvement: Participate in initiatives to automate manual tasks and modernize our current infrastructure. HOW WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE? Your day will start with a sync meeting to identify any bottlenecks in our deployment pipelines or environments. Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to manage the infrastructure and how to orchestrate services with Kubernetes . You will work closely with both the testing team (to provide them with stable environments) and our external implementation partners (to learn and improve how we build software). It is a hands-on journey where you will see the immediate impact of your work on the speed and quality of the entire department. WHO ARE YOU?
• Education: Recent graduate in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical field.
• DevOps Passion: You are naturally curious about cloud technologies, automation, and the "behind the scenes" of software development.
• Tech Interest: While you don't need to be an expert, you have a basic understanding or a strong desire to master Cloud services and Kubernetes .
• Mindset: You are a problem-solver who enjoys technical challenges and thrives in collaborative environments.
• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B1/B2 or higher). WHAT DO WE OFFER?
• A Real DevOps School: DevOps is learned by doing. We offer you the environment, the tools, and the team to transform your curiosity into a professional career.
• Mentorship: You will have a dedicated mentor to guide your learning path from day one.
• High-Tech Stack: Gain hands-on experience with industry-standard tools (Azure, Docker, CI/CD).
• Flexibility: A flexible working model in our Sant Cugat office with remote work options.
• Program: This position is part of our START TECH program for young digital talent. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il gruppo Roche External Manufacturing (Commercial Drug Substance) è parte dell'unità di produzione Roche Drug Substance, siamo partner con le Organizzazioni Contrattuali (CMO) e garantiamo che gli obiettivi di produzione/produzione pertinenti vengano consegnati a Roche on-time, alla massima qualità e all'interno-budget e che i CMO operano in conformità con i requisiti attuali Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) e gli standard aziendali Roche. L'Externative Manufacturing and Business Operations Manager ha due responsabilità principali: Lei/he è il responsabile delle relazioni principali per le organizzazioni di produzione dei contratti partner specificate (CMO) o i siti. E agisce anche come Capo di Stato Maggiore per l'unità, assicura che l'implementazione di strategia sia ben eseguita, e porta la proprietà del processo di gestione delle prestazioni per il gruppo. L'opportunità: L'utente agisce come direttore principale e relazionale per gli OGM in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla selezione iniziale e dall'implementazione alla decommissione. Significa:
• Lead team di governance internazionale in diverse funzioni come Qualità, MSAT, Supply Chain, Legale e Procurement per garantire l'allineamento organizzativo durante la produzione di CMO, due diligence o Tech Transfers
• Fornire una stretta aderenza agli standard GMP, Qualità e SHE durante la conduzione di revisioni di rischio regolari per affrontare proattivamente i potenziali problemi di fornitura a CMO
• Serve come Capo di Stato Maggiore e consulente del team di leadership DS External Manufacturing Head e del sito, collaborando strettamente con gli sforzi per far avanzare il portafoglio verso la visione della rete di sostanza della droga
• Guidare il sistema di reportistica Performance Management, compresi gli obiettivi/KPI, l'allineamento PTN e l'esecuzione efficace delle recensioni settimanali, mensili e trimestrali
• Funziona a stretto contatto con la finanza e altri stakeholder per guidare la pianificazione aziendale e monitorare le prestazioni finanziarie
• Sviluppa la strategia globale per una comunicazione efficace tra i team, e conduce e assicura la gestione dei rischi attraverso DS External Manufacturing, identificando e incorporando i piani di mitigazione nel portafoglio prioritario del sito Chi sei? Abbiamo alte aspettative intorno al pensiero end-to-end e la collaborazione funzionale trasversale in una rete globale, prendendo la proprietà e delegare le decisioni a livello appropriato. Apprezziamo una mentalità imprenditoriale con la capacità di cambiare costantemente o adattarsi in un ambiente dinamico. Ci aspettiamo che ti concentri sul lavoro più efficace e di valore aggiungendo priorità ai tuoi sforzi con una chiara attenzione alla creazione di valore per il paziente. Sarete disposti a esplorare nuove opportunità, essere a proprio agio con ambiguità e prendere rischi intelligenti, nel rispetto delle ultime normative. Inoltre:
• Istruzione e esperienza di base: laurea in Ingegneria o Scienze della vita (preferito di laurea avanzato) con 10 anni di esperienza di produzione / operazioni all'interno di Pharma/Biotech o industrie similarmente regolamentate
• Leadership & Project Management: 3+ anni che portano rapporti diretti o squadre matrici, insieme a 5+ anni dirigendo progetti interfunzionali su larga scala e complessi (la certificazione di Project Management è un plus)
• Competenza Tecnica e Qualità: Profonda competenza in un ambiente GMP-regolato (specificamente sostanza biologica farmacologica), con un forte impegno per la conformità aziendale, l'integrità e le pratiche di miglioramento continuo Lean Six Sigma
• Procurement & Advanced Systems: Sfondo dimostrato nella strategia di approvvigionamento, nella gestione delle categorie e nell'ERP
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Roche External Manufacturing group (Commercial Drug Substance) is Part of the Roche Drug Substance manufacturing unit, we Partner with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and ensure that relevant production/manufacturing targets are delivered to Roche on-time, to the highest quality and within-budget and that the CMOs operate in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements and Roche corporate standards. The External Manufacturing and Business Operations Manager has two main responsibilities: She/he is the primary relationship manager for specified partner Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) or sites. And She/he also acts as Chief of Staff for the unit, ensures strategy deployment is well executed, and carries ownership of the Performance management process for the group. The Opportunity: You act as the primary lead and relationship manager for CMOs throughout the entire product Lifecycle, from initial selection and implementation to decommissioning. That means:
• Lead international governance teams across diverse functions such as Quality, MSAT, Supply chain, Legal, and Procurement to ensure organizational alignment during CMO manufacturing, due diligences or Tech Transfers
• Enforce strict adherence to GMP, Quality, and SHE standards while conducting regular risk reviews to proactively address potential supply issues at CMOs
• Serves as the Chief of Staff and advisor to the DS External Manufacturing Head and site leadership team, closely collaborating on efforts to advance the portfolio toward the Drug substance Network vision
• Lead the Performance Management reporting system, including goals/KPIs, PTN Alignment, and the effective execution of weekly, monthly, and Quarterly Business Reviews
• Works closely with Finance and other stakeholders to lead the business planning and track financial performance
• Develops overall strategy for effective communication across teams, and leads and ensures Risk management across DS External Manufacturing, identifying and incorporating mitigation plans into the site's prioritized portfolio Who You Are: We have high expectations around end-to-end thinking and cross functional collaboration in a global network by taking ownership and delegating decisions to the appropriate level. We value an entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to constantly change or adapt in a dynamic environment. We expect you to focus on the most impactful and value adding work by prioritizing your efforts with a clear focus on creating value for the patient. You will be willing to explore new opportunities, be comfortable with ambiguity and taking smart risks, while complying with the latest regulations. Furthermore:

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le groupe de fabrication externe de Roche (substances pharmaceutiques commerciales) fait partie de l'unité de fabrication de la substance médicamenteuse de Roche, nous collaborons avec des organismes de fabrication sous contrat (OCM) et nous veillons à ce que les objectifs pertinents de production et de fabrication soient livrés à Roche à temps, à la plus haute qualité et dans les limites du budget, et que les OCM fonctionnent conformément aux exigences actuelles des bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) et aux normes de Roche. Le gestionnaire externe de la fabrication et des opérations commerciales a deux responsabilités principales : il est le principal gestionnaire de relations pour les organismes ou les sites de fabrication à contrat de partenaires déterminés. Elle est également chef d'état-major de l'unité, elle veille à ce que le déploiement de la stratégie soit bien exécuté et elle est propriétaire du processus de gestion du rendement pour le groupe. La possibilité : Vous êtes le principal responsable et gestionnaire de relations pour les OCM tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, de la sélection et de la mise en œuvre initiales au déclassement. Cela signifie :
• Diriger les équipes de gouvernance internationale dans diverses fonctions telles que la qualité, le MSAT, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les services juridiques et les achats afin d'assurer l'alignement organisationnel pendant la fabrication des OCM, les diligences dues ou les transferts de technologie
• Appliquer le strict respect des BPF, de la qualité et des normes de la SHE tout en procédant régulièrement à des examens des risques afin de s'attaquer de façon proactive aux problèmes d'approvisionnement potentiels des OCM
• Chef de cabinet et conseiller auprès de l'équipe de direction de DS External Manufacturing Chef et chef de site, collaborant étroitement aux efforts visant à faire progresser le portefeuille vers la vision du Réseau des substances médicamenteuses
• Diriger le système d'établissement de rapports sur la gestion du rendement, y compris les objectifs/ICP, l'alignement des NPT et l'exécution efficace des examens hebdomadaires, mensuels et trimestriels des activités;
• Collabore étroitement avec les Finances et d'autres parties prenantes pour diriger la planification des activités et suivre la performance financière
• Élaborer une stratégie globale pour une communication efficace entre les équipes, diriger et assurer la gestion des risques dans l'ensemble de la fabrication externe DS, identifier et intégrer des plans d'atténuation dans le portefeuille prioritaire du site Qui vous êtes : Nous avons des attentes élevées concernant la pensée de bout en bout et la collaboration interfonctionnelle dans un réseau mondial en prenant en main et en déléguant les décisions au niveau approprié. Nous apprécions un état d'esprit d'entreprise avec la capacité de changer constamment ou de s'adapter dans un environnement dynamique. Nous espérons que vous vous concentrerez sur le travail le plus efficace et le plus intéressant en priorisant vos efforts en mettant clairement l'accent sur la création de valeur pour le patient. Vous serez prêt à explorer de nouvelles opportunités, être à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté et prendre des risques intelligents, tout en respectant les dernières réglementations. En outre:
• Éducation et expérience de base: Baccalauréat en génie ou en sciences de la vie (diplôme avancé préféré) avec plus de 10 ans d'expérience de fabrication/opérations au sein de Pharma/Biotech ou des industries réglementées de la même manière
• Leadership et gestion de projets : 3 ans et plus de rapports directs ou d'équipes matricielles, associés à 5 ans et plus de projets interfonctionnels complexes à grande échelle (la certification de gestion de projets est un plus)
• Expertise technique et de qualité : Compétence approfondie dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF (spécialement une substance médicamenteuse biologique), avec un engagement ferme en matière de conformité, d'intégrité et de Lean Six Sigma/pratiques d'amélioration continue
• Achats et systèmes avancés : expérience démontrée en matière de stratégie d'approvisionnement, de gestion de catégorie et de PGI

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management. The Diagnostics Insights Solution Management Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising solutions with multiple components (digital, physical, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs. As Business Solution Management Associate , you will support us in addressing the challenges in commercializing these integrated solutions. One of our key initiatives in commercializing integrated solutions with country organizations is the multi-year Stronger Solution Selling (S3) program . You will support the S3 core team in delivering strategic workshops with country organizations and optimizing essential solution-selling assets to help cross-functional affiliate teams better navigate Roche Diagnostic’s physical, digital, and service portfolios. This role offers a blend of project management and process refinement, providing a unique platform to shape how the organization delivers tailored value to its customers worldwide. Main responsibilities As a Business Solution Management Associate, you will help us in bridging the gap between strategic methodology and operational execution. Over the course of your one-year assignment, your core responsibilities will include:
• Project Management & Delivery : Take ownership of assigned tasks with a focus on structuring complexity and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality assets.
• Affiliate Support & Collaboration : Directly assist the S3 Core Team in driving activities with country organizations and country clusters.
• Asset & Tool Optimization : Refine existing and develop new solution-selling tools to help teams better navigate Roche’s physical and digital offerings.
• Change Management : Support ongoing activities aimed at sustaining the organizational shift toward effective solution selling.
• Process Improvement : Potentially step up into a process improvement project to refine workflows, systems, or insights that improve the effectiveness of solution selling. How would your day to day look like? As Business Solution Management Associate , you'll work closely with team members in the S3 core team, as well as subregional and country teams. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders for driving improvements in solution commercialization. Your day-to-day will be dynamic and diverse, and could begin by coordinating with the S3 Core Team to support global affiliates and manage project deliverables. You might spend the morning organizing workshops or refining assets that help teams navigate Roche's complex solution portfolio. This involves a high degree of ownership, as you structure complex information into clear, high-quality tools for country organizations. In the afternoon, you shift focus toward process optimization and change management. You might analyze workflows to improve solution-selling insights or collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the S3 methodology is effectively embedded across the region. Each day concludes by ensuring all project milestones are on track, balancing technical learning with a proactive, delivery-f

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Unsere Mission Als Produktionsteam an unserem Standort Penzberg verfolgen wir ein gemeinsames Ziel: Menschen weltweit zuverlässig mit lebenswichtigen Medikamenten zu versorgen – sicher, effizient und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, treiben neue Ideen voran und entwickeln uns stetig weiter – für unsere Patient:innen weltweit. Deine Rolle als People Lead Wir suchen People Leader (m/w/d) mit Macher-Qualitäten, die die Prozesse hinterfragen, Dinge proaktiv anpacken und als Servant Leader Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen in unserer Organisation aktiv fördern. Vor allem kommt es uns darauf an, dass diese Position von jemandem mit einer positiv denkenden, lösungsorientierten, integren und selbstreflektierten Persönlichkeit ausgefüllt wird. Was Dich erwartet In dieser Position geht es nicht einfach nur darum, eine Führungskraft zu sein. Es geht vielmehr darum, als positives Beispiel voranzugehen und die neue Führungskultur erlebbar zu machen. Mitarbeitende werden von Dir disziplinarisch geführt und gefördert, um Fachexpertisen aufrechtzuerhalten und vor allem um der Organisation dabei zu helfen, heute zu leisten, was unsere Patienten morgen brauchen!
• Die konzeptionelle Ausrichtung sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung der Leistung des Teams, die Begleitung des Teams bei Veränderungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in Deine Hände.
• Du wendest LPS-Methoden (z.B. Gemba-Walks o.ä.) an, überträgst Verantwortungen im Sinne eines proaktiven “empowern” und richtest die Teamziele strategisch aus, um somit das Servant-Leadership-Konzept erlebbar zu machen.
• Coaching, Check-Ins, Weiterentwicklung, Fördern und Fordern sowie Motivieren sind Bestandteil Deiner täglichen Arbeit.
• Du sorgst für ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld und gehst im Bereich SHE als gutes Beispiel voran.
• Als Change Agent gestaltest Du aktiv unsere Zukunft mit und begleitest Mitarbeitende bei Veränderungen.
• Die Motivation des Teams und eines jeden Mitarbeitenden ist uns ein besonderes Anliegen, daher ist es ebenso wichtig, dass das Team-Zusammenspiel von Dir empathisch begleitet und permanent entwickelt wird. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Tech Supervisors wird auch die Fachexpertise des Teams ausgerichtet und weiterentwickelt.
• Du bist verantwortlich für die Ressourcen- und die Kapazitätsplanung Deines Bereichs. Wer Du bist Du hast starkes Interesse diese Position kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, Ideen einzubringen, neue Wege miteinander zu gehen und diese gemeinsam zu diskutieren und umzusetzen. Für die Stelle bringst Du außerdem ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, einen Meistertitel oder eine abgeschlossene Technikerausbildung mit und hast erste Berufserfahrung in einer Führungsrolle mit Personalverantwortung, vorteilhaft in einem pharmazeutischen Umfeld sammeln können.
• Du hast ein intrinsisches Interesse daran Prozesse zu verstehen, setzt diese in einen Kontext und richtest Dein Handeln an dem Verständnis aus - Erfahrungen in der Durchführung von pharmazeutischen Produktionsprozessen und den begleitenden Qualitätsprozessen sind dabei von Vorteil.
• Deine Stärken liegen in der Beziehungsgestaltung (Mensch) und einer guten Komplexitätsverarbeitung (Überblick / Verstehen).
• Du verstehst Dich selbst als "Inspirierenden Leader", bist fähig situativ zu führen, nimmst Menschen mit, begeisterst und es gelingt Dir, sicherzustellen, dass alle die gleiche Strategie und Ziele verfolgen und als Team zusammenarbeiten.
• Du hast ein ehrliches Interesse an der kontinu

In questo ruolo, si agirà come agente di cambiamento chiave, identificare le sfide operative e implementare miglioramenti sostenibili e ad alto impatto sulla supply chain globale. • Identificare e privilegiare le opportunità di miglioramento, le principali iniziative di performance aziendali utilizzando il framework DMAIC, e incorporando tali miglioramenti in modo pulito nei processi e sistemi della supply chain.
• Sviluppare e implementare i KPI della supply chain per misurare e controllare le prestazioni in vari livelli di report, definendo una chiara responsabilitÃ in collaborazione con i proprietari di Business Capability.

• Valutare e interpretare continuamente le variabili interne ed esterne che influiscono sulle prestazioni della supply chain, identificare e implementare sistemi e tecnologie appropriati per raggiungere gli obiettivi.
• Sviluppare e implementare regole, procedure e politiche aziendali per garantire prestazioni operative costanti e gestire in modo proattivo i rischi.
• Definire e sostenere misure di resilienza per mantenere alti livelli di servizio e anticipare, mitigare e monitorare i rischi della supply chain. • Erkennen und Priorisieren von Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten, führenden Unternehmensleistungsinitiativen unter Verwendung des DMAIC-Rahmens und Einbetten dieser Verbesserungen sauber in Lieferkettenprozesse und -systeme.
• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Lieferkettenkennzahlen zur Messung und Steuerung der Leistungsfähigkeit auf verschiedenen Berichtebenen, die klare Rechenschaftspflicht in Zusammenarbeit mit den Eigentümern von Business Capability definieren.
• Nutzung von End-to-End-System denken, um Daten zur Prozess- und Leistungsoptimierung zu erfassen, zu integrieren und zu analysieren.
• Kontinuierliche Bewertung und Interpretation interner und externer Variablen, die die Leistungsfähigkeit der Lieferkette beeinflussen, Identifizierung und Bereitstellung geeigneter Systeme und Technologien, um Ziele zu erreichen.

Nous organisons les flux de valeur entre les sites et les filiales en conciliant la demande et l'offre, et nous assurons la bonne première fois que la commande et la livraison de médicaments dans le réseau mondial. De plus, nous sommes également responsables des stratégies de produits, menant la conception de produits et de chaînes d'approvisionnement conformément aux stratégies de mise en marché et assurant la santé de nos produits. Nous sommes une organisation agile dotée de responsabilités claires et d'une culture axée sur l'objectif qui repose sur la confiance et la collaboration, où les gens sont inspirés à co-créer des solutions et à développer les capacités nécessaires à l'exécution de notre mission. L'organisation Supply Chain Insights and Performance au sein de PTS est établie pour stimuler l'orchestration à l'échelle de l'entreprise, les meilleures pratiques de référence et accélérer l'optimisation des performances dans nos flux de valeurs de bout en bout. L'opportunité En tant que chef d'excellence de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous relèverez directement du chef d'excellence de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant qu'agent clé du changement, en identifiant les défis opérationnels et en déployant des améliorations durables et à impact élevé dans toute la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione All'interno di People & Culture (P&C), People Insights & Technology (PI&T) scatena le persone esponenziali e l'impatto commerciale attraverso il processo decisionale, le intuizioni attuabili e l'abbracciamento della tecnologia orientata alle persone. Siamo alla ricerca di uno stage motivato e curioso per unire il nostro People Insights Area of Practice per uno stage di 6 mesi con sede a Basilea, in Svizzera, a partire da agosto. In questo ruolo, collaborerete a stretto contatto con gli scienziati organizzativi sulle iniziative di ricerca applicata e di analisi delle persone. In questo ruolo, supporterai il team conducendo recensioni di letteratura, raccogliendo e analizzando i dati dei dipendenti, scoprendo intuizioni attuabili e sostenendo decisioni basate su prove che migliorano l'esperienza dei dipendenti e l'efficacia organizzativa. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Within People & Culture (P&C), People Insights & Technology (PI&T) unleashes exponential people and business impact through data-driven decision-making, actionable insights, and embracing people-centric technology. We are looking for a motivated and curious intern to join our People Insights Area of Practice for a 6 months internship based in Basel, Switzerland, starting August. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Organisational Scientists on applied research and people analytics initiatives. In this role, you will support the team by conducting literature reviews, collecting and analyzing employee data, uncovering actionable insights, and supporting evidence-based decisions that improve employee experience and organizational effectiveness. The Opportunity Literature Review & Knowledge Synthesis
• Conduct targeted literature searches and synthesize evidence on key topics (e.g., impact of AI on workforce and leadership, employee experience)
• Maintain and update shared literature repositories for ongoing team use Research Design & Execution
• Support design and execution of research approaches (e.g., surveys, experiments), including identifying validated measurement scales
• Contribute to hypothesis generation and assess feasibility of research approaches Data Analysis & Insights Communication
• Support the analysis of people data to uncover meaningful insights
• Summarize and visualize findings for clear stakeholder presentations Who You Are
• An ambitious Master’s student currently pursuing or having recently completed a degree in Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Organizational Behavior, HR, or related disciplines (within 12 months of the start date). Alternatively, PhD students currently enrolled in a doctoral program are also encouraged to apply.
• You have a solid foundation in research methods (e.g., surveys, experiments, psychometrics) and statistics,developed through academic training, thesis work, or hands-on application; experience with statistical programming (e.g., R, Python) is a plus.
• You are comfortable working with scientific literature and can critically evaluate and translate research findings into clear, practical insights for a business audience
• You are passionate about People & Culture topics (e.g., impact of AI on workforce/leadership; employee experience)
• You bring strong analytical and critical thinking skills, paired with excellent communication and writing abilities in English
• You are able to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and thrive in a dynamic environment
• You have a genuine eagerness to apply scientific thinking in a real-world business context Additional Information What We offer:
• Hands-on experience working with experienced Organisational Scientists and People Analytics professionals
• Exposure to real business challenges with opportunities to contribute meaningful impact
• A collaborative, international, and purpose-driven work environment
• Dedicated learning opportunities and professional development
• The chance to apply research and analytical skills in a global healthcare company committed to innovation and people development Application process

As the FEP Lead, you will act as a trusted thought partner across the entire value chain, leveraging your financial expertise and deep business understanding to drive strategies that deliver value for our customers, the affiliate, and the wider enterprise. In this pivotal role, where you will be reporting to Head of Finance and Operation, Roche Diagnostics Denmark - will have a team of specialists and experts, specifically overseeing a team of FEPs and Finance Excellence Partners (FxPs), while also holding dotted-line management responsibility for the Tender Manager. Your Impact Leadership & Team Management
• Leads a team of specialists/experts, adapting plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges.
• Role models the role of a leader as visionary, architect, catalyst and coach (VACC) and lives the Roche operating principles.
• Creates a psychologically safe environment and culture necessary for the team to be successful.
• Supports network building across the organization (including the Finance Excellence Partner) to share best practices and co-create solutions.
• Empowers decision-making at the lowest level, enabling team members to come up with innovative designs and solutions. Tender Management & Commercial Strategy
• Architects robust process and financial rigor into tenders, acting as a dotted-line manager to the Tender Manager to ensure highly competitive and profitable bids.
• Playsan active part in ensuring sustainable commercial deals by considering risk evaluation, competitor assumptions and implementing sustainable pricing strategies.
• Serves as a key partner for developing a coherent affiliate commercial strategy and commercial business related processes such as business planning and opportunity prioritization.
• Supports the business and customers in co-creating new business models, quantifying value, and providing pricing transparency. Financial & Operational Rigor
• Acts as a key guide for P&L and financial target achievement. This involves close monitoring of the numbers, from top-line to bottom-line, and providing direction on accounting implications.
• Proposes and drive ideas for P&L improvement, especially upsell opportunities, efficiency/waste improvement, and risk reduction.
• Solves problems autonomously with minimal guidance.
• Balances resource allocation across competing priorities and provide advice on financial implications of proposed business activities.
• Ensures financials are on track to achieve targeted business results and metrics, or advise on deviations and corrective actions.
• Monitors and manages customer performance over the whole contract life cycle with a profitability and outcomes based perspective. What You Bring
• Experience in leading, developing and coaching individuals in a team.
• An entrepreneurial, commercial, and customer-centric mindset with an ability to put all available financial and operational information into a holistic picture.
• An understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) to be able to guide the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow implications of decisions for the sales affiliate
• Strong business and financial acumen, coupled with experience partnering with stakeholders.
• Strong analytical skills and a data-d

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At the heart of Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) lies a mission to redefine what’s possible in healthcare through data. To achieve this, we need a backbone of strategic discipline and operational agility. As a key member of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, you will do more than manage processes, you will champion an innovation mindset, driving the evolution of our operating model and facilitating the strategies (such as in silico and 3D) that represent the future of medicine. Join us to help harmonize our strategic efforts and turn complex challenges into coordinated progress. By connecting enterprise priorities with operational realities, BSO drives consistency, clarity, and coordinated progress across PDD and the broader development organization. The Opportunity:
• You partner with sub-functional leaders to drive connectivity and coordinate planned and ad-hoc PDD-wide and functional strategic efforts in alignment with PDD priorities
• You drive key initiatives impacting the organization’s strategic and operating model, using an enterprise and innovation mindset
• You facilitate structured planning and reporting activities across sub-functions, proactively identifying and resolving issues in a dynamic and fast-paced setting to support the execution of strategies such as in silico and 3D
• You navigate high ambiguity and complexity, proactively driving clarity, alignment, and prioritization across multiple stakeholders and initiatives
• You operate with a continuous improvement mindset to proactively identify process gaps and opportunities for improved alignment, communications, and resource across key planned and ad-hoc efforts with a bias for action
• You independently organize and manage recurring leadership meetings (including Quant Team), develop agendas, and document and support the drive and follow-through of outcomes and next steps
• You maintain tools for initiative tracking, performance monitoring, and cross-functional alignment
• You lead or co-lead preparation of communications and presentations for functional updates, governance forums, senior leadership reviews, and evolving sub-functional or PDD-wide requirements in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders and leadership Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, life sciences, public health, or data sciences
• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic operations, business planning, or project management in pharma or healthcare settings; or an advanced degree with 5 years of equivalent work experience
• You demonstrate ability to independently lead initiatives, manage planning cycles, and facilitate leadership forums
• You are familiar with data- and R&D-oriented operating models and cross-functional execution
• You have capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles
• You have excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond technical domain
• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace
• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language Preferred:
• Prior experience managing operational workstreams or planning cycles within life sciences or data-focused environments
• Working knowledg

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities Technical responsibilities
• Oversee and guide the technical strategy and direction of validation activities for PT Shanghai in the preparation and execution of validation protocols, including facility, utilities, equipment, cleaning, and computer system validation.
• Review and approve site Validation Master Plan (VMP)/project plans and ensure the strategy meets business and regulatory requirements. As needed, review/approve validation protocols, engineering change orders, Standard Operation Procedures (SOP), engineering commissioning and turnover packages.
• Provide input and review for site-specific and corporate validation procedures and shared practices as applicable and in accordance with the requirements set forth in the governing quality standards in partnership with Global Quality.
• Oversee and guide execution of the validation of tech transfer oversight, new facility expansions and construction projects.
• Review and approve all relevant Quality Validation and other Site documentation and ensure documentation supports a compliant state.
• Provide expert interpretation and application of regulatory guidelines to ensure operations, facilities and documentation meet Roche standards and regulatory requirements.
• ensuring that the department ensures quality oversight of the qualification and validation processes. This applies across the entire lifecycle of the processes and equipment. This includes:
• Plant qualification of production equipment and the entire infrastructure (pharmaceutical water, HVAC, process gases).
• Validation of production, cleaning and transport processes
• Validation of computer systems and software (CSV), including ensuring current data integrity requirements.
• Oversight of product and process transfers from or to other locations and partners

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Istituto di Biologia Umana (IHB), incorporato all'interno della Divisione Ricerca e Sviluppo Anticipato di Roche, è un istituto di ricerca leader incentrato sull'accelerazione dello sviluppo di farmaci trasformativi. Si specializza nello sviluppo di nuovi e robusti sistemi di modello umano che assomigliano funzionale alla fisiologia e alla malattia umana. Separando il divario tra la scoperta accademica e l'applicazione industriale, IHB facilita la rapida traduzione della scienza innovativa in soluzioni orientate ai pazienti. L'opportunità Stiamo costruendo modelli renali umani di nuova generazione affrontando un problema centrale non risolto nel campo: come generare organotipi, organoidi renali vascolarizzati che mostrano una maggiore maturazione. Come parte di una borsa IHB appena finanziata, guiderai un ambizioso programma di ricerca all'interfaccia di biologia delle cellule staminali, biologia vascolare e genomica monocellulare, con l'obiettivo di creare sistemi traduttivamente rilevanti per la scoperta e la sicurezza della droga. In questo ruolo, definirete approcci innovativi per scoprire i principi biologici dell'interazione vascolare-parenchimale, contribuendo infine a stabilire una nuova classe di sistemi di modello umano attraverso le seguenti responsabilità:
• Guidare lo sviluppo di organoidi renali derivati da iPSC vascolarizzati, con un focus sulle specifiche del tessuto e la maturazione
• Utilizzare genomica a singola cella per dissezionare le specifiche endoteliali, la maturazione del nefro e la comunicazione cellulare
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i bioingegneria per integrare la biologia in sistemi di cultura profusi e di prossima generazione
• Tradurre intuizioni biologiche in modelli funzionali e predittivi rilevanti per la sicurezza dei reni umani Chi sei
• Uno scienziato con un dottorato di ricerca e un forte record di traccia nei modelli 3D derivati da iPSC o organoidi. Per qualificarsi per questa posizione di primo soccorso, devi aver completato gli studi di dottorato negli ultimi quattro anni.
• Sperimentato nella generazione e nell'analisi di dati transcriptomici monocellulari e nella comoda traduzione di set di dati complessi in una visione biologica
• Scientificamente ambizioso, con la capacità di guidare nuovi concetti piuttosto che seguire i protocolli stabiliti
• Idealmente con un forte background in biologia dello sviluppo, con esperienza in sistemi di organi renali, vascolari o correlati Informazioni aggiuntive Sarete incorporati in un ecosistema altamente interdisciplinare in IHB, lavorando con i principali esperti in bioingegneria, biologia delle cellule staminali e analisi computazionali, e strettamente collegati ai team di scoperta e sicurezza della droga di Roche. Questa è un'opportunità unica per definire come i modelli renali umani sono costruiti e utilizzati in futuro, dalla biologia fondamentale all'impatto diretto sullo sviluppo della droga. Processo di applicazione Per applicare, si prega di inviare i seguenti materiali:
• CV attuale: Si prega di fornire un CV completo, tra cui un elenco completo delle pubblicazioni peer-reviewed.
• Riferimenti professionali: Includere i dettagli di contatto per due riferimenti che possono parlare con la vostra competenza scientifica e carattere professionale.
• Ph.D. Documentazione: Fornire un diploma ufficiale o un certificato che confermi il diploma (se già ottenuto).
• Timeline & Disponibilità: La data di inizio di questa posizione è 1 settembre 2026. La durata iniziale è di 2 anni, con il potenziale di estensione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Institute of Human Biology (IHB), embedded within Roche’s Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) Division, is a leading research institute focused on accelerating the development of transformative medicines. It specializes in developing novel and robust human model systems that functionally resemble human physiology and disease. By bridging the gap between academic discovery and industrial application, IHB facilitates the rapid translation of groundbreaking science into patient-focused solutions. The Opportunity We are building next-generation human kidney models by tackling a central unsolved problem in the field: how to generate organotypic, vascularized kidney organoids that show enhanced maturation. As part of a newly funded IHB fellowship, you will drive an ambitious research program at the interface of stem cell biology, vascular biology, and single-cell genomics, with the goal of creating translationally relevant systems for drug discovery and safety. In this role, you will define innovative approaches to uncover the biological principles of vascular–parenchymal interaction, ultimately helping to establish a new class of human model systems through the following responsibilities:
• Drive the development of vascularized iPSC-derived kidney organoids, with a focus on tissue specification and maturation
• Use single-cell genomics to dissect endothelial specification, nephron maturation, and cell–cell communication
• Work closely with bioengineers to integrate biology into perfusable, next-generation culture systems
• Translate biological insights into functional, predictive models relevant for human kidney safety Who You Are
• A scientist with a PhD and a strong track record in iPSC-derived 3D tissue models or organoids. To qualify for this early-career position, you must have completed your doctoral studies within the last four years.
• Experienced in generating and analysing single-cell transcriptomic data and comfortable translating complex datasets into biological insight
• Scientifically ambitious, with the ability to drive new concepts rather than follow established protocols
• Ideally with a strong background in developmental biology, with expertise in kidney, vascular, or related organ systems Additional Information You will be embedded in a highly interdisciplinary ecosystem at IHB, working with leading experts in bioengineering, stem cell biology, and computational analysis, and closely connected to Roche’s drug discovery and safety teams. This is a unique opportunity to define how human kidney models are built and used in the future—from fundamental biology to direct impact on drug development. • Current CV: Please provide a comprehensive CV, including a full list of your peer-reviewed publications.

• Ph.D. Documentation: Provide an official diploma or certificate confirming your degree (if already obtained).
• Timeline & Availability: The start date of this position is 1st September 2026. The initial duration is for 2 years, with the potential for extension. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Das Institut für Humanbiologie (IHB), eingebettet in die Division Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) von Roche, ist ein führendes Forschungsinstitut, das sich auf die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von transformativen Arzneimitteln konzentriert. Es ist spezialisiert auf die Entwicklung neuartiger und robuster menschlicher Modellsysteme, die funktionell der menschlichen Physiologie und Krankheit ähneln. Durch die Überbrückung der Lücke zwischen akademischer Entdeckung und industrieller Anwendung erleichtert IHB die rasche Übersetzung bahnbrechender Wissenschaft in patientenorientierte Lösungen. Die Chance Wir bauen menschliche Nierenmodelle der nächsten Generation, indem wir ein zentrales ungelöstes Problem auf dem Gebiet anpacken: wie man organotypische, vaskuläre Nierenorganoide erzeugt, die eine verbesserte Reifung zeigen. Im Rahmen eines neu finanzierten IHB-Stipendiums werden Sie ein ambitioniertes Forschungsprogramm an der Schnittstelle von Stammzellbiologie, vaskulärer Biologie und einzelliger Genomik antreiben, mit dem Ziel, translatorisch relevante Systeme für die Entdeckung und Sicherheit von Drogen zu schaffen. In dieser Rolle werden Sie innovative Ansätze definieren, um die biologischen Prinzipien der vaskulären –parenchymalen Interaktion aufzudecken und letztendlich dazu beizutragen, eine neue Klasse menschlicher Modellsysteme durch folgende Aufgaben zu etablieren:
• Fahren Sie die Entwicklung vaskulärer iPSC-erregter Nierenorganoide, mit einem Fokus auf Gewebespezifikation und Reifung
• Verwenden Sie einzellige Genomik, um die Endothel-Spezifikation, Nephron-Maturierung und Zell-Zell-Kommunikation zu deaktivieren
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Bioingenieuren zusammen, um Biologie in perfusable Kultursysteme der nächsten Generation zu integrieren
• Übersetzen Sie biologische Einblicke in funktionelle, prädiktive Modelle, die für die menschliche Nierensicherheit relevant sind Wer bist du?
• Wissenschaftler mit einem PhD und einem starken Track-Record in iPSC-geförderten 3D-Gewebemodellen oder Organoiden. Um sich für diese vorzeitige Betreuung zu qualifizieren, müssen Sie Ihre Promotion innerhalb der letzten vier Jahre abgeschlossen haben.
• Erlebt bei der Generierung und Analyse von einzelligen transkriptomischen Daten und komfortabler Übersetzung komplexer Datensätze in biologische Erkenntnisse
• Wissenschaftlich ambitioniert, mit der Fähigkeit, neue Konzepte anzutreiben, anstatt etablierte Protokolle zu folgen
• Ideal mit einem starken Hintergrund in der Entwicklungsbiologie, mit Expertise in Nieren-, Gefäß- oder verwandten Organsystemen Weitere Informationen Sie werden in ein hochinterdisziplinäres Ökosystem der IHB eingebettet, das mit führenden Experten in der Biotechnik, Stammzellbiologie und rechnergestützten Analyse und eng mit den Pharma-Entdeckungs- und Sicherheitsteams von Roche verbunden ist. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, zu definieren, wie menschliche Nierenmodelle in der Zukunft gebaut und genutzt werden – von grundlegender Biologie bis hin zu direkten Auswirkungen auf die Drogenentwicklung. Anwendungsprozess Bitte geben Sie folgende Materialien ein:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf: Bitte geben Sie einen umfassenden Lebenslauf, inklusive einer vollständigen Liste Ihrer peer-reviewed Publikationen.
• Professionelle Referenzen: Fügen Sie Kontaktdaten für zwei Referenzen ein, die mit Ihrer wissenschaftlichen Expertise und Ihrem beruflichen Charakter sprechen können.
• Ph.D. Dokumentation: Geben Sie ein offizielles Diplom oder Zertifikat, das Ihren Abschluss bestätigt (wenn bereits erhalten).
• Timeline & Verfügbarkeit: Das Startdatum dieser Position ist der 1. September 2026. Die Anfangsdauer beträgt für 2 Jahre, mit dem Potenzial für Erweiterung. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'Institut de biologie humaine (IHB), qui fait partie intégrante de la Division de la recherche et du développement précoce (PRED) de Roches Pharma, est un institut de recherche de premier plan axé sur l'accélération du développement des médicaments transformateurs. Il se spécialise dans le développement de systèmes de modèles humains nouveaux et robustes qui ressemblent fonctionnellement à la physiologie et à la maladie humaines. En comblant l'écart entre la découverte académique et l'application industrielle, l'IHB facilite la traduction rapide de la science révolutionnaire en solutions axées sur le patient. L'opportunité Nous construisons des modèles rénaux humains de nouvelle génération en s'attaquant à un problème central non résolu dans le domaine : comment générer des organoides rénaux organotypiques et vasculaires qui montrent une maturation accrue. Dans le cadre d'une bourse nouvellement financée de la DGSI, vous dirigerez un ambitieux programme de recherche à l'interface de la biologie des cellules souches, de la biologie vasculaire et de la génomique monocellulaire, dans le but de créer des systèmes translationnels pertinents pour la découverte et l'innocuité des médicaments. Dans ce rôle, vous définirez des approches novatrices pour découvrir les principes biologiques de l'interaction vasculaire-parenchymique, en fin de compte aider à établir une nouvelle classe de systèmes modèles humains par les responsabilités suivantes:
• Favoriser le développement d'organoïdes rénaux dérivés de l'iPSC vasculaires, en mettant l'accent sur la spécification des tissus et la maturation
• Utilisez la génomique monocellulaire pour disséquer les spécifications endothéliales, la maturation du néphron et la communication cellulaire
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les bioingénieurs pour intégrer la biologie dans les systèmes culturels perfusables de la prochaine génération
• Traduire les connaissances biologiques en modèles fonctionnels et prédictifs pertinents pour la sécurité rénale humaine Qui vous êtes
• Un scientifique avec un doctorat et une solide expérience dans les modèles de tissus 3D ou organoïdes dérivés de l'iPSC. Pour être admissible à ce poste de début de carrière, vous devez avoir terminé vos études de doctorat au cours des quatre dernières années.
• Expérience dans la production et l'analyse de données transcriptomiques monocellulaires et la traduction confortable de ensembles de données complexes en données biologiques
• Scientifiquement ambitieux, avec la capacité de conduire de nouveaux concepts plutôt que de suivre des protocoles établis
• Idéalement avec une solide expérience en biologie du développement, avec une expertise dans les systèmes rénaux, vasculaires ou apparentés Informations complémentaires Vous serez intégré dans un écosystème hautement interdisciplinaire à l'IHB, en collaboration avec des experts de premier plan en bioingénierie, biologie des cellules souches et analyse computationnelle, et étroitement lié aux équipes Roches de découverte de médicaments et de sécurité. Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de définir comment les modèles rénaux humains sont construits et utilisés à l'avenir, de la biologie fondamentale à l'impact direct sur le développement des médicaments. Processus de demande Pour postuler, veuillez soumettre les documents suivants :
• CV actuel: Veuillez fournir un CV complet, y compris une liste complète de vos publications évaluées par les pairs.
• Références professionnelles : Inclure les coordonnées de deux références qui peuvent parler de votre expertise scientifique et de votre caractère professionnel.
• Doctorat : fournir un diplôme ou un certificat officiel confirmant votre diplôme (si déjà obtenu).
• Chronologie et disponibilité: La date de début de cette position est le 1er septembre 2026. La durée initiale est de deux ans, avec un potentiel de prolongation. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for a highly organized and proactive intern to join our Site Services team. This role will support various IT-related tasks (including hardware and software installation, device handovers for newcomers and leavers, handling ordered devices, and administrative tasks), Facility, and SHE tasks. • Update IT asset inventory and assist with inventory tasks.

• Provide support for new IT service projects and assist in event preparations.
• Supporting AV equipment in meeting rooms
• Supporting workstation equipment (monitor, docking station) Operational & Facilities Support:.
• Handling the tickets submitted to the SAM ticketing system
• Supporting the annual inventory of Facility team
• Weekly building inspection with Handyman team
• Administration of home office equipment handover and return Procurement & Administrative Tasks:
• Administrative support related to car fleet management and vendor management Safety, Health and Environment-related tasks:
• Administrative support related to occupational health examination
• Supporting business continuity documentation update process
• Helping in inventory Who you are
• Currently enrolled to a Hungarian University in a relevant field (e.g., Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering etc.).
• Ability to work at least 20-30 hours/week independently and as part of a team.
• Strong organizational and time management skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Proficient in troubleshooting Windows/macOS operating systems and common software applications.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
• Flexibility to take on various tasks and contribute to different teams. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position The Opportunity Are you a visionary leader passionate about shaping the future of Patient Safety? In this pivotal role, you will lead and manage the PV Regional Center, ensuring the delivery of high-quality pharmacovigilance (PV) and Device Vigilance activities across the Europe, Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA) region. You will be at the forefront of driving operational excellence, upholding regulatory compliance, and integrating regional clinical safety activities in a complex, global environment. Working in partnership with Affiliate Patient Safety and Global Leadership, you will contribute to the broader Patient Safety Operations (PSO) strategy. Your leadership will ensure that our safety processes are not only compliant but also innovative, leveraging data-driven insights and digital transformation to protect patients worldwide.
• Lead and inspire a multi-site regional team , acting as a catalyst for a quality- and customer-centric culture.
• Oversee the operationalization of safety processes to ensure full compliance with global Roche standards and local regulations.
• Drive continuous improvement and innovation by embedding technological advances like AI and digital analytics into safety operations.
• Ensure inspection and audit readiness for all regional activities, maintaining a robust business continuity plan.
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate regionalized clinical safety activities and achieve shared global objectives.
• Foster a culture of growth and empowerment , adopting the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leadership style to develop future talent.
• Represent the PV function with external parties, including regulators, ensuring Roche’s reputation for excellence remains unmatched. Who You Are You are a strategic thinker and a servant leader who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical landscape and are motivated by the opportunity to lead large-scale operational changes that have a real impact on patient lives.
• You hold a Health Care Professional Degree (Medical, Pharmacy, or equivalent professional experience).
• You bring 10+ years of pharmaceutical experience , with at least 5 years in significant PV leadership roles.
• You have a proven track record in managing multi-country or regional operations within a large, complex organization.
• You are a VACC leader , committed to inclusive behaviors and developing high-performing, diverse teams.
• You possess deep technical expertise in GVP, ICH-GCP, and global regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA).

The position With its 1400 employees, the Kaiseraugst production centre ensures continuous patient care with high-quality drugs. Become part of our team and contribute as a production expert to meeting the highest standards in pharmaceutical production and supply of over 120 countries with high-quality, sterile biologic products! The possibility As a Production Expert, you and your colleagues bear the technical responsibility for Filling Services (Compounding, Raw Materials, Equipment) production within the sterile filling and bear the responsibility for the following tasks:
• Responsible for the timely production of product solutions used for the production of commercial, sterile biologic products, such as liquid vials and syringes
• Operating production plants, weighing and controlling raw materials to ensure that the batches produced contain the correct ingredients and quantities
• Conduct process-accompanying testing of the product solution (IPC) produced to ensure that the batches meet the specifications
• Support in the validation of processes directly linked to production including cleaning and sterilization
• Documenting activities according to GMP requirements
• concerns for a clean room environment that meets regulatory requirements, good manufacturing practice (GMP) and standard operating procedures
• execution of process improvements and adaptation of default documents using LPS tools. Who you are To do this, you will have the following qualifications:
• Complete vocational training as a pharmaceutical or chemical engineer or comparable training (Pharma/Technik/Mechanik/Automation)
• At least 3 years of experience in the production of sterile medicines and experience in the GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) environment (work / documentation)
• Good technical understanding and skills in handling highly automated production facilities or safe and routine handling of IT systems (MES, Google applications, warehouse management systems, SAP, plant control systems)
• Ready to work in a layer model
• Flowing German-knowledge in word and writing is a prerequisite. Join your current CV and relevant testimonials and become part of our team to shape the future together! Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an equal opportunity employer.

• Bereitschaft in einem Schicht-Modell zu arbeiten
• Fließende Deutsch-Kenntnisse in Wort und Schrift gelten als Voraussetzung.
