La possibilité En tant qu'expert en production, vous et vos collègues assumez la responsabilité technique de la production des services de remplissage (composante, matières premières, équipement) dans le remplissage stérile et la responsabilité des tâches suivantes :
• Responsable de la production en temps opportun de solutions de produits utilisées pour la production de produits biologiques commerciaux et stériles, tels que les flacons liquides et les seringues
• Exploitation d'installations de production, pesage et contrôle des matières premières pour s'assurer que les lots produits contiennent les ingrédients et quantités appropriés
• Procéder à des essais d'accompagnement de la solution de produit (PCI) produite pour s'assurer que les lots répondent aux spécifications
• Appui à la validation des procédés directement liés à la production, y compris le nettoyage et la stérilisation
• Documenter les activités selon les exigences des BPF
• les préoccupations relatives à un environnement propre répondant aux exigences réglementaires, aux bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) et aux procédures d'exploitation normalisées;
• réalisation d'améliorations du processus et adaptation des documents par défaut à l'aide d'outils LPS. Qui vous êtes Pour ce faire, vous aurez les qualifications suivantes:
• Formation professionnelle complète en tant qu'ingénieur pharmaceutique ou chimique ou formation comparable (Pharma/Technik/Mechanik/Automation)
• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans la production de médicaments stériles et dans l'environnement des bonnes pratiques de fabrication (travail / documentation)
• Bonne compréhension technique et compétences en matière de gestion des installations de production hautement automatisées ou de gestion sûre et courante des systèmes informatiques (MES, applications Google, systèmes de gestion des entrepôts, SAP, systèmes de contrôle des installations)
• Prêt à travailler dans un modèle de couche
• Le flux de la connaissance allemande dans la parole et l'écriture est une condition préalable. Rejoignez votre CV actuel et les témoignages pertinents et devenez membre de notre équipe pour façonner l'avenir ensemble! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions au plus haut niveau, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics, we believe that project management is about being the operational backbone of innovation. As a Global Project Manager (GPM), you will be a catalyst for redefining how we deliver impactful diagnostic solutions. We are evolving this role into a strategic orchestration function, where the focus is on enabling value, ensuring end-to-end traceability, and driving operational excellence at a systemic level. We are looking for operational architects who can challenge the status quo. By taking ownership of the links between strategy and execution, connecting cross-functional teams, and building a "single source of truth," you will help elevate the GPM role into a servant-leader position that ensures teams have the space and focus required to innovate. Your Challenges Your mission is to move beyond traditional task-tracking and actively shape the operational health of our global portfolios. Key challenges include:
• Operational Orchestration: Act as a strategic partner ensuring vertical traceability—ensuring that high-level goals are clearly connected to execution units to enable autonomous, high-quality decisions.
• Systemic Flow & Friction Reduction: Proactively identify and resolve structural bottlenecks. You will act as a servant-leader, absorbing operational overhead and administrative friction to protect the core delivery teams.
• Single Source of Truth: Guarantee reliable, consolidated data for tracking investments, capacity, and risks. You will move the organization toward predictive steering rather than reactive reporting.
• Integrated Operating Excellence: Drive the organic adoption of standardized frameworks (Quality, Regulatory, and Methodology) into daily workflows, ensuring compliance is "built-in" rather than an after-the-fact exercise.
• Cross-Domain Connectivity: Facilitate high-level Risk and Opportunity management (ROMA) and coordinate critical integration points between different lifecycles to ensure organizational coherence. ​ Who You Are We need systems-thinkers who are obsessed with efficiency and data integrity.
• Experience: 3+ years leading complex operational frameworks or portfolios in Biotech/Tech. You are comfortable navigating highly regulated environments.
• Expertise: Mastery of the "Ops Stack" (JIRA, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Aha!) and modern frameworks (SAFe, Lean, or Systems Thinking).
• Strategic Impact: Proven ability to translate complex strategy into clear operational execution plans.
• Mindset: A fierce advocate for team autonomy who views "operations" as a product that needs to be optimized for the user. Are you a Project Manager who is tired of chasing status updates? Do you believe that the best leaders don't just "check boxes"—they build the systems that make work flow? At Roche Diagnostics, we are transforming the Global Project Manager role. We are moving away from administrative reporting and toward Operational Intelligence. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Are you ready to shape the future of quality management in healthcare? As an Associate Quality Lead within our Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) function, you will play a vital role in supporting the delivery of quality-focused strategies that reinforce trust in our Quality Management System (QMS). Working with a high degree of independence, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure our clinical and safety data meets rigorous global regulatory standards. In this dynamic position, you will have the unique opportunity to champion a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. By leveraging data analytics and digital tools, you will help optimize data collection and provide key insights that directly support our mission of delivering life-changing medicines to patients faster and more securely. The Opportunity:
• Implement Quality Strategies: Support the design, execution, and tracking of risk-based quality management strategies across the PDQ portfolio.
• Deliver Quality Assurance: Execute targeted activities to assess quality assurance status and generate confidence in our end-to-end systems.
• Manage Quality Data: Enhance data collection procedures, perform ad-hoc analyses, and deliver high-quality data insights to fulfil external regulatory needs.
• Present to Health Authorities: Demonstrate the effective implementation of quality strategies.
• Drive Compliance Projects: Participate in departmental or cross-functional compliance initiatives aimed at optimizing daily operations.
• Champion Innovation: Drive the adoption of innovative digital tools and technologies into daily workflows to foster a proactive quality culture.
• Foster Collaboration: Build and maintain an inclusive, supportive work environment while executing departmental goals and initiatives under limited supervision.
• Audit Execution : Utilize AI and automated tools to execute audits and synthesize audit evidence.
• Inspection Support : Provide logistical and compliance support for GCP inspections, including scribe duties and back-room document QC. Who You Are You are a proactive, organized professional looking to elevate your career in quality management within a global, life-changing industry. You thrive in environments that value continuous learning, offer room for professional growth, and empower you to work independently to make a genuine impact on patient outcomes. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• A Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or quality-related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and 1-3 years' of experience.
• Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry, with a foundational understanding of product development and GxP regulations (e.g., GCP, GVP, MDR).
• Strong digital and data literacy, with the ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable quality insights.
• Exceptional organizational and execution skills, alongside a demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects proactively.
• Developing expertise in Critical to Quality (CtQ) factors and functional group operations.
• Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong presentation skills. Relocation Benefits are not available for this job posting. #MQRS The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 89,256.00 and 117,148.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company

The Position Responsibilities: Quality and Safety: ● Maintain the Right to Operate and ensure that all processes are performed safely and healthily; Address and escalate any potentially unsafe hazards. ● Ensure accuracy and completeness of all procedures and instructions related to the proper receipt, quarantine, storage, and disbursement of materials as it relates to FDA, OSHA, FAA, QSR, ISO, Good Manufacturing Practices, manufacturing exception events (MEEs), and other Roche policies and procedures.
• ● Audit readiness (OSHA, FAA, FDA, etc.); Performs department initiatives to prepare for internal/external audits and inspections.
• ● Timely reporting of safety hazards, incidents, and near misses.
• ● Completes all assigned training. Responsible for maintaining 95% or above training compliance. Production:
• ● Performs daily assigned standard work according to the department’s governing processes (i.e., GSP’s, OPs, QPs, or SOPs)
• ● Ensures materials are distributed on time and accurately per the production schedule.
• ● Inventory counting and adherence to inventory control processes.
• ● Provides support to non-operations stakeholders with their good receipts, allocation, movements, and shipments.
• ● Learns and operates automated systems/equipment, and sequences of operation, including Equipment setup, operation, and cleaning; Monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting of equipment.
• ● Responsible for daily attendance in Tier meetings.
• ● Responsible for the operation of powered industrial vehicles in a safe and compliant manner.
• ● Required to handle or manage hazardous materials. Continuous Improvement: ● Organize and maintain logistics areas according to 6S principles. ● Identifies gaps and may participate in process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean principles and tools. Teamwork and Collaboration:
• ● Proactively collaborate with peers in other shifts/functions to achieve daily targets.
• ● Support the leaders to maintain and cultivate the organization's culture. Collaborate with the team and leaders to achieve departmental goals.
• ● Communicates outside the department with manufacturing and associated organizations. Performs other duties as assigned. Who you are: Education/Experience:
• ● High School Diploma/GED required
• ● 1 year of relevant work experience, preferably in a GMP environment
• ● 1 year of experience operating power industrial vehicles Knowledge Skills and Abilities:
• ● Demonstrated experience with Lean / Continuous Improvement
• ● Ability to read, write and comprehend English
• ● Strong communication skills - written and verbal
• ● Ability to be flexible and agile in a fast-paced, constantly changing, and high-volume environment.
• ● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• ● Ability to use PC-based applications and general data entry skills
• ● Previous experience with ERP systems; SAP preferred
• ● Ability to work with cross-functional teams
• ● Self-motivated
• ● Ability to have prompt, regular and reliable worksite attendance. Physical conditions and PPE requirements: The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by an individual to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. ● Required to stand, walk, sit, kneel, bend, and crouch for a combined 4 or more hours per day. ● Required to push, pull, and lift a minimum of 50 pounds. Repetitive, consistent movements of the wrists, hands

• Establish and maintain a strategic and technical roadmap for the responsible area to support the site's strategic development and product lifecycle.

• Enhance Electrical system maintenance and operation through implementation of an effective maintenance and operation program, work prioritization, complying with operational and personnel standards, regulatory and statutory requirement to ensure efficient, reliable, and uninterrupted plant operation.

• Respond to critical alarms and provide timely technical support for complex issues.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance sustainability, safety, and asset reliability.

• Evaluate the alarm trends and establish corrective actions to avoid repeat events.

• Responsible for the implementation of the site Reliability Engineering process within owned areas.

Compliance & Safety ● Adhere to all GMP and SOPs to ensure the quality and integrity of all materials and products. ● Follow all SHE rules and regulations, including wearing appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintaining a clean and orderly work area. ● Report any deviations, quality issues, or safety hazards immediately to the supervisor/manager. ● Participate in team meetings, safety training, and continuous improvement initiatives. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist based in Ireland (ideally Dublin area).

Job Summary

As a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist at Roche Diagnostics Ltd. in Ireland, you are at the forefront of the healthcare revolution, moving diagnostics closer to the patient to enable faster, more clinical decision-making. You will manage a high-value portfolio—including Point-of-Care (POC) and associated digital solutions—across hospitals, HSE clinics, and community care settings.

• Location: Field-based (Ireland).

• Role Type: Permanent

• Company: Roche Diagnostics Ltd.

• Primary Goal: To drive the adoption of "Near Patient Care" technologies, ensuring healthcare providers have the tools to deliver real-time results that improve patient outcomes and hospital efficiencies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Sales & Territory Management

• Drive Revenue: Meet and exceed sales targets for the Near Patient Care portfolio (e.g., blood gas, glucose monitoring, and rapid diagnostic platforms).

• Market Growth: Identify new business opportunities within the HSE, private hospitals, and community health districts.

• Tender Management: Lead and contribute to complex tender submissions for business acquisition and retention within the Irish healthcare landscape.

2. Customer Partnership & Consultation

• Relationship Building: Nurture deep relationships with key stakeholders, including Hospital Managers, Laboratory Directors, Point of Care Coordinators, and HSE procurement.

• Solution Selling: Consult with clinical teams to understand their workflow challenges and develop tailored diagnostic solutions that enhance service delivery.

• Clinical Education: Provide high-quality product demonstrations and in-service training for healthcare professionals to ensure the effective use of Roche technology.

3. Market Intelligence & Analysis

• Competitive Awareness: Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to inform strategic sales planning.

• CRM Management: Maintain accurate records and sales pipelines within Salesforce to support forecasting and territory reporting.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

• Education: Degree level in Life Sciences, Biomedical Science, or a related field.

• Experience: Proven track record in medical device or diagnostic sales with experience in the Irish HSE ecosystem.

• License: Full, clean driving license.

• Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and "respectfully challenge the status quo".

Desirable:

• Point-of-Care Expertise: Specific knowledge of "Near Patient" or Point of Care (POC) diagnostic workflows.

• Agile Mindset: Ability to work in an agile environment and adapt to a rapidly evolving pathology pipeline.

Why Join Roche?

• Impact: Be part of a global leader that aims to "prevent, stop, and cure diseases" by ensuring access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

• Culture: A collaborative environment that encourages "personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections".

• Growth: Extensive opportunities for professional development and career progression within the broader Roche network.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, stiamo espandendo il nostro team di affari medici globali in oftalmologia con due aperture per un Global Medical Science Leader (GMSL). Questo team è dedicato alla comprensione, all'anticipazione e alla trasformazione della pratica medica nell'area della malattia. Ti unirai a un ambiente altamente collaborativo e matrice in cui le competenze scientifiche soddisfano la pianificazione strategica per migliorare i risultati dei pazienti negli ecosistemi sanitari in tutto il mondo. In qualità di Global Medical Science Leader, servirai come esperto medico e clinico di base, portando i contributi di strategia medica alla strategia integrata per i nostri prodotti. Potrai colmare il divario tra la ricerca clinica e la pratica medica, assicurando che le nostre strategie di ciclo di vita siano informate da approfondimenti di fornitori di assistenza sanitaria, pazienti e paganti. L'opportunità Per eccellere in questo ruolo, guiderai l'evoluzione della pratica medica attraverso le seguenti responsabilità chiave:
• Guidare e coordinare i contributi di strategia medica per la strategia integrata e la strategia del ciclo di vita per i prodotti assegnati o le aree di malattia.
• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di generazione di prove che incorporano "dati di pratica clinica essenziali" e affrontare le esigenze di "accesso".
• Coordinare la strategia globale di prova integrata, comprendente piani di sviluppo clinico (CDP) e le esigenze di dati per l'accesso al mercato.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con partner interfunzionali in Comunicazione Scientifica, Partenariato Paziente, Marketing e Sviluppo della Droga.
• Mantenere una visione attuale delle tendenze esterne, tra cui la salute digitale, la medicina personalizzata e l'ecosistema-centricità sanitaria.
• Rappresentare le competenze mediche nella ricerca clinica e nella pratica medica per catalizzare la trasformazione della rispettiva area malattia.
• Integrare le prospettive di diversi stakeholder, tra cui HCP, pazienti, infermieri e paganti, nel processo decisionale strategico. Chi sei Sei un pensatore strategico con un profondo background scientifico e una passione per la formazione del futuro dell'oftalmologia. Dovresti portare:
• Un MD con un'esperienza di ricerca clinica o di pratica medica rilevante (decisione di cura paziente), o un grado avanzato di vita-scienza (ad esempio, PhD / PharmD) con uno sfondo compatibile.
• Corso di specializzazione ed esperienza specificatamente in Oftalmologia (altamente desiderato).
• Prove capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente matrice con diversi colleghi interfunzionali.
• Forte comprensione del processo di pianificazione integrata dello sviluppo e della commercializzazione.
• Competenza nella generazione delle prove e capacità di tradurre dati medici complessi in strategia attuabile. Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per scoprire questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are expanding our global medical affairs team in Ophthalmology with two openings for a Global Medical Science Leader (GMSL). This team is dedicated to understanding, anticipating, and contributing to the transformation of medical practice within the disease area. You will join a highly collaborative, matrixed environment where scientific expertise meets strategic planning to improve patient outcomes in healthcare ecosystems worldwide. As a Global Medical Science Leader, you will serve as a core medical and clinical expert, leading the medical strategy contributions to the integrated strategy for our products. You will bridge the gap between clinical research and medical practice, ensuring our life cycle strategies are informed by deep insights from healthcare providers, patients, and payers. The Opportunity To excel in this role, you will lead the evolution of medical practice through the following key responsibilities:
• Lead and coordinate medical strategy contributions to the integrated strategy and life cycle strategy for assigned products or disease areas.
• Develop and execute evidence generation strategies that incorporate "essential clinical practice data" and address "access" needs.
• Coordinate the overall integrated evidence strategy, encompassing Clinical Development Plans (CDP) and data needs for market access.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in Scientific Communication, Patient Partnership, Marketing, and Drug Development.
• Maintain a current view of external trends, including Digital Health, personalized medicine, and healthcare ecosystem-centricity.
• Represent medical expertise in clinical research and medical practice to catalyze the transformation of the respective disease area.
• Integrate perspectives from multiple stakeholders, including HCPs, patients, nurses, and payers, into strategic decision-making. Who You Are You are a strategic thinker with a deep scientific background and a passion for shaping the future of ophthalmology. You should bring:
• An MD with relevant clinical research or medical practice experience (patient care decision-making), or an advanced life-science degree (e.g., PhD / PharmD) with a compatible background.
• Specialization degree and experience specifically in Ophthalmology (highly desired).
• Proven ability to work effectively in a matrix environment with diverse cross-functional colleagues.
• Strong understanding of the Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning process.
• Expertise in evidence generation and the ability to translate complex medical data into actionable strategy. Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À Roche, nous développons notre équipe mondiale des affaires médicales en ophtalmologie avec deux ouvertures pour un leader mondial des sciences médicales (GMSL). Cette équipe se consacre à la compréhension, à l'anticipation et à la transformation de la pratique médicale dans la région de la maladie. Vous rejoindrez un environnement fortement collaboratif et matricié où l'expertise scientifique rencontre la planification stratégique pour améliorer les résultats des patients dans les écosystèmes de santé du monde entier. En tant que leader mondial des sciences médicales, vous serez un expert médical et clinique de base, dirigeant les contributions de la stratégie médicale à la stratégie intégrée pour nos produits. Vous comblerez l'écart entre la recherche clinique et la pratique médicale, en veillant à ce que nos stratégies de cycle de vie soient éclairées par des connaissances approfondies des fournisseurs de soins de santé, des patients et des payeurs. L'opportunité Pour exceller dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'évolution de la pratique médicale à travers les responsabilités clés suivantes:
• Diriger et coordonner les contributions de la stratégie médicale à la stratégie intégrée et à la stratégie du cycle de vie pour les produits ou les domaines de maladies assignés.
• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies de production de données probantes qui intègrent des « données essentielles sur les pratiques cliniques » et répondent aux besoins en matière d'« accès ».
• Coordonner la stratégie globale intégrée en matière de données probantes, qui englobe les plans de développement clinique et les besoins en données pour l'accès aux marchés.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les partenaires interfonctionnels de la communication scientifique, du partenariat patient, du marketing et du développement des médicaments.
• Maintenir une vision actuelle des tendances externes, y compris la santé numérique, la médecine personnalisée et la centricité des écosystèmes de soins de santé.
• Représenter l'expertise médicale dans la recherche clinique et la pratique médicale pour catalyser la transformation du domaine de la maladie.
• Intégrer les points de vue de multiples parties prenantes, y compris les HCP, les patients, les infirmières et les payeurs, à la prise de décisions stratégiques. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur stratégique avec un fond scientifique profond et une passion pour façonner l'avenir de l'ophtalmologie. Vous devriez apporter:
• un MD ayant une expérience pertinente en recherche clinique ou en pratique médicale (prise de décision en matière de soins aux patients) ou un diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie (p. ex. doctorat/pharmD) avec une expérience compatible.
• Diplôme de spécialisation et expérience spécifique en ophtalmologie (hautement désiré).
• Capacité éprouvée de travailler efficacement dans un environnement matriciel avec divers collègues interfonctionnels.
• Une bonne compréhension du processus de planification du développement intégré et de la commercialisation.
• Expertise en matière de production de données probantes et capacité à traduire des données médicales complexes en stratégie concrète. Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant pour découvrir cette opportunité passionnante! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role: We are looking for a creative, innovative and open-minded intern to join the Global Regulatory Affairs team. As an Intern in Regulatory Affairs, you have the opportunity to support regulatory and product care activities, and get insights into the IVD/MD industry and the applicable regulations and standards for IVD/MD products. In Global Regulatory Affairs we work on specific challenges as a team within all areas of the diagnostic business around the globe, to grow together to bring the best products to patients while choosing a work environment that fits our life. As AI plays an increasing role in our daily lives we are also looking for colleagues who are keen in taking part in high-impact projects that leverage machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs) to optimize how we navigate the complex landscape of global health regulations. In this intern role, you can clearly demonstrate your creativity and leave a footprint in our products’ lifecycle. You will directly contribute to Roche Diagnostics' vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare & changing lives. Your key responsibilities: After your onboarding program, you will be assigned to tasks or projects. You’ll be mostly spending your time in:
• Assisting in the worldwide registrations and activities for various IVD/MD products, at various stages of their development and lifecycle
• Supporting the preparation and maintenance of global documentation for our IVD/MD products
• Collaborating with other regulatory affairs teams, including local affiliates, for registrational activities
• Coordinating with global interdisciplinary project teams to provide regulatory input to development, submission planning, and documentation needed
• Supporting the global regulatory affairs team members in their non-registrational activities
• Assisting in the design, development, and testing of AI-powered tools and dashboards for regulatory tracking, document analysis, and automated reporting.
• Participating in the training and fine-tuning of ML and NLP models tailored for regulatory use cases, ensuring high accuracy and compliance with internal standards.
• Keep abreast of emerging AI technologies and changing regulatory guidelines regarding AI in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industries. Who you are:
• You have recently graduated (within the last 3 years) in the field of Biology, Life Sciences, Engineering, or Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics
• You possess facilitation and communications skills and the ability to deal with adversity in a multicultural and international environment
• You are a fast learner, have a proactive attitude to drive solutions, and have a high level of team orientation
• You are curious and attentive to detail with a strong problem-solving capability
• You are fluent in English (written and spoken)
• You have a strong proficiency in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).
• You have Experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face, spaCy).
• You have Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering.
• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, or Matplotlib/Seaborn). What do we offer?
• Become a Regulatory Affairs professional for IVDs/MDs.
• Develop a Regulatory Mindset and understand the most important regulations and industry standards. •

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Durante il processo di progettazione, garantiamo la governance del processo di business e tutti i requisiti di conformità sono soddisfatti. L'opportunità In qualità di Global Compliance Global Business Process Specialist ( SAP Authorization Specialist) farai parte dell'Area del Prodotto di Compliance Finanziaria RSS e riferirai direttamente al Lead del Capitolo. Al fine di fornire soluzioni sanitarie innovative ai nostri pazienti, abbiamo bisogno del miglior talento nella nostra organizzazione. Come membro del team ideale siete open-minded, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, avresti:
• Competenza nelle autorizzazioni SAP: comprovata esperienza nella progettazione, costruzione e mantenimento dei ruoli di sicurezza SAP
• Corso di laurea in Finanza, Business Administration, Informatica, Ingegneria o una formazione comparabile e 5-7 anni di esperienza professionale, preferibilmente in Business Process Management, Gestione delle informazioni / IT, Finanza / approvvigionamento, Risk/Internal Control Management, Contabilità, Audit
• Forte conoscenza nell'ambito dell'autorizzazione e della gestione degli accessi e degli strumenti GRC, basati sulla gestione dei processi aziendali o sull'esperienza e sull'esperienza IT
• SAP ABAC Specialist: Prove esperienze di progettazione e attuazione delle politiche di controllo dell'accesso basato sugli attributi (ABAC) utilizzando il framework standard SAP per integrare il tradizionale RBAC (Role-Based Access Control).
• Avanzate competenze tecniche nei privilegi analitici SAP S/4 HANA, nonché interfacce con analisi e reportistica e come la sicurezza focalizzata sui dati si traduce dallo strato di applicazione allo strato del database.
• Esperienza preferenziale che lavora con BI moderno multipiattaforma specificatamente AppSheet, LookerStudio, TABLEAU e Alteryx.
• Fluency aziendale in inglese In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Foodlicious è la nostra attività quotidiana Da oltre 30 anni l'osteria Roche è diventata un'azienda di catering di successo nel settore della ristorazione collettiva. Tavero AG è una filiale al 100% di F. Hoffmann-La Roche. Nelle nostre sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst diamo lavoro a circa 350 persone provenienti da oltre 37 nazioni. La nostra offerta comprende sia ristoranti per il personale che abbracciano la diversità, sia ristoranti raffinati con una cucina raffinata e un servizio eccellente. Offriamo anche ristoranti con prelibatezze da tutto il mondo, caffè in tutte le varietà, preparato dai nostri baristi, nonché le lounge più alte della Svizzera: fantastici luoghi dopo il lavoro sopra i tetti della città. Le offerte Grab'n'Go dal sushi agli hamburger e il primo e unico club nella storia di Roche completano la nostra offerta. Offriamo inoltre ai nostri ospiti una sala riunioni e un catering per eventi che possono ospitare fino a 1.500 persone. I ristoranti pubblici, lo Schöpfli nel parco e lo Chez Jeannot nel Museo Tinguely, completano la nostra offerta. Cerchiamo subito un aiuto cuoco per la Tavero AG a Kaiseraugst. Principali mansioni:
• Lavorare nella cucina fredda o calda, nel free flow o nel ristorante per il personale
• Preparazione puntuale dei pasti secondo le ricette Tavero
• Lavoro preparatorio e continuo rifornimento della mise en place
• Fornitura di consegne per le nostre filiali
• Informazioni amichevoli e competenti agli ospiti presso il vostro punto vendita o di servizio
• Gestione attenta e responsabile di attrezzature, macchine e alimenti
• Implementazione di nuove istruzioni di lavoro in conformità con la formazione interna
• Supporto in occasioni ed eventi speciali
• Lavorare economicamente per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali Profilo dei requisiti:
• Formazione completata come uno chef (EFZ) (desiderabile) o esperienza professionale in cucina
• Ti piace cucinare e maneggiare il cibo
• Lavori in modo indipendente e ti assumi responsabilità
• Lavoro di squadra e affidabilità sono per te un dato di fatto
• Conosci la legislazione alimentare svizzera
• Sei flessibile e pronto per il lavoro occasionale serale e nei fine settimana

Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si impegnano a far progredire la scienza, garantendo a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi hanno portato a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e a oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Ci diamo la forza reciproca di esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alte le nostre ambizioni, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita e hanno un impatto globale. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Position Based in our Sant Cugat hub, you will join the Global Customer Support Knowledge & Learning Excellence (KLE) organization. As Content Creation and Management Sub-chapter, we create content that enables customers and Roche service personnel to use, install, and maintain diagnostic instruments and software. As a Technical Writer Intern, you will join a team evolving from traditional document-based publishing toward a content-first approach, focusing on modular reusable content and moving away from static outputs. You will work with a new content management system (CMS) to migrate and deliver high-quality information through a global content delivery platform. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a regulated, high-tech healthcare environment. What You Will Do
• Play a key role in transitioning our knowledge base to a new CMS, helping us move from "documents" to "intelligent, reusable content".
• Learn to author in XML, treating content as data. You will explore how this modular approach allows for reuse across different deliverables and platforms.
• Explore the use of AI applied to the content creation process.
• Learn to plan, develop, and organize technical documentation according to global corporate style guides and standards.
• Collaborate with content managers, project teams, and subject matter experts (SMEs) to gather complex information.
• Learn how to meet quality targets and timelines, while ensuring regulatory requirements are respected.
• Assist in creating and modifying multimedia content (photographs, screenshots, diagrams) using modern software tools.
• When ready, draft and update customer-facing and service content (User Guides, Installation Guides, Data Specifications, etc.) in English for Roche software and instruments.
• Contribute your fresh perspective to discussions aimed at the continuous improvement of our tools and processes. What You Bring
• A strong interest in technical writing, instructional design, or knowledge management.
• Excellent spoken and written command of English (C1/C2 level or native equivalent) as this is our primary working language.
• Familiarity with or curiosity about documentation tools and standards (e.g., XML/DITA, IXIASoft, Oxygen, or Figma) and multimedia tools.
• Enthusiasm for working collaboratively in an international, multicultural environment.
• Ability to join for a full-time internship (12 months) Who We Are At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. Are you ready to apply? We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the task at hand—a learner who sees this as a unique opportunity to shape the future of Diagnostics. If that is you, apply now! Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich Als Site Automation Manager (m/w/d) stellst Du sicher, dass a lle Systeme der Roche Pharma AG sicher, konform und effektiv betrieben werden. Du gewährleistest die Einhaltung aller Gesetze, Vorschriften und Roche - Standards, unterstützt Prozesse durch Bereitstellung automatisierter Systeme und bietest Fach wissen in Engineering, Design, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Automatisierungssystemen. Außerdem supportest Du den Betrieb bei der Problemlösung in Bezug auf Automatisierungssysteme sowie der V alidierung von Prozess - und Gebäudeautomation und entwickelst Systemarchitekturen. Darüber hinaus übernimmst Du folgende Aufgaben:
• Maintenance Strategy: Entwicklung und Optimierung der Instandhaltungsstrategien für die Systeme des Verantwortungsbereichs.
• Smart Building Automation & Technology: Strategische Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb der Gebäudeleittechnik (GLT) und Gebäudeautomation (MSR).
• Operational Technology (OT) & Cyber Security: Betrieb und Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit der technischen Netzwerke (OT), sowie Sicherstellung der IT - Sicherheit in den technischen Netzen (OT - Security).
• Systembetreuung FM - spezifischer Systeme (z.B. IWMS - Hub, Raumbuchungssysteme, Locker, Digital Signage, Multimedia).
• IoT & AI: Implementierung von IoT - Sensoren (Internet of Things) zur Datenerfassung (z.B. Raumklima, Belegung) und Nutzung von KI/Analytics zur Betriebsoptimierung (Predictive Maintenance).
• Measures & Controls: Überwachung der Regelungstechnik zur Sicherstellung eines energieeffizienten Betriebs durch intelligente Steuerung der Gebäudetechnik.
• Technical Standards: Definition und Pflege der technischen Standards und Normen.
• Life Cycle Asset Management (LCAM): Erstellung von Budget - /Investitionsplänen (OPEX/CAPEX) für den Betrieb.
• Records Management: Sicherstellung einer lückenlosen und konformen Dokumentation aller systembezogenen Daten und Pläne.
• Planung und Leitung von Projekten . Fachverantwortung und Mitarbeit bei Investitionsprojekten als Betreiber - /Bauherrenvertreter.
• Service & Fremdfirmen Management: Steuerung und Überwachung der Dienstleister als Subject Matter Expert (SME). Abnahme von Leistungen und Qualitätskontrolle. Sicherstellung der Durchführung gesetzlich vorgeschriebener Prüfungen. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Ausbildung: Studium Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik, MSR - Technik oder vergleichbar.
• Fundierte Erfahrung in der Gebäudeautomation (GLT, DDC, Feldgeräte) und Netzwerktechnik.
• Kenntnisse gängiger Bus - Systeme (BACnet, KNX, Modbus).
• Verständnis von OT - Cyber Security Anforderungen (IEC 62443).
• Affinität zu neuen Technologien (IoT, Cloud - Lösungen, Smart Building).
• Sprachen: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, gutes Englisch.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Questo ruolo si basa nel Centro Assistenza Clienti Regionale che si dedica a fornire eccellenza aiutando il personale di laboratorio a utilizzare i nostri prodotti. Operiamo con un approccio olistico, il che significa che ci occupiamo del nostro portafoglio prodotti dall'idea attraverso lo sviluppo e il lancio di mercato a phase-out. L'eccezionale varietà di tecnologie applicate in questo settore offre grandi opportunità di apprendimento. Specialista di supporto tecnico (lingua slovacca e ceca) Località: Varsavia, Praga o Bratislava (La tua scelta!) Sei pronto a passare dall'esperienza tecnica all'impatto che cambia la vita? Il nostro Centro Assistenza Clienti Regionale (RCSC) è il motore intellettuale dietro l'eccellenza di laboratorio in Europa Centrale. Stiamo cercando un talento ceco e/o slovacco che ha fame di conoscenza, gode di problem solving, ed è pronto a padroneggiare le tecnologie diagnostiche più avanzate del mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità: Più di un semplice supporto Questo non è un tipico ruolo di helpdesk. Si tratta di una posizione di consulenza ingegneristica e applicativa in cui si diventa il "guardiano" dell'accuratezza diagnostica.
• Master the Complexity: lavorerai con sistemi IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) di fascia alta che combinano robotica, biochimica complessa e IT avanzato.
• Crescita continua: forniamo un programma intensivo di formazione di livello mondiale. Non ci aspettiamo che tu sappia tutto il primo giorno, ma ci aspettiamo che tu sia quello che non smette mai di chiedere "perché?".
• Agile Impact: Unisciti a un team in cui la tua proattività non è solo accolta – è necessario. Impedirai i problemi prima che accadano, utilizzando gemelli digitali e strumenti diagnostici a distanza. Chi sei?
• Istruzione: Hai una laurea in Ingegneria, IT, Biochimica, Diagnostica di laboratorio o equivalente. Più importante, si dispone di una "tendenza" per la risoluzione dei problemi.
• Potere linguistico: Lei è un madrelingua o C1/C2 ceco e/o slovacco. Il tuo inglese è abbastanza forte da guidarti attraverso allenamenti internazionali e forum tecnici globali.
• Il ponte "Lab-to-Office": se hai lavorato in un laboratorio clinico e senti di aver superato le pareti attuali, vogliamo la tua logica diagnostica. Vi insegneremo l'ingegneria; portate la passione per la scienza.
• Resilience & Ambition: Lei è qualcuno che vede un complesso errore tecnico non come un problema, ma come una sfida da conquistare. Cosa Roche ti offre:
• Autonomia: Un modello di lavoro ibrido a Varsavia, Praga o Bratislava.
• Portfolio senza eguali: Accesso alle tecnologie che fissano lo standard per il prossimo decennio di assistenza sanitaria. Il ruolo è un contratto di 18 - mese tramite un'agenzia esterna. Per la posizione Bratislava lo stipendio parte da 1 600 EUR lordo / mese. Per la posizione di Praga, lo stipendio parte da 48 300 CZK / mese. Lo stipendio finale dipende dal livello di esperienza, competenze e qualifiche del candidato di successo. Interessato? APPLY! Se sentite questo di
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities. Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language) Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!) Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies. At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events. The Opportunity: More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.
• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.
• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".
• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools. Who You Are:
• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.
• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.
• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.
• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered. What Roche Offers You:

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Technischer Support Spezialist (Slowakisch und Tschechisch) Standorte: Warschau, Prag oder Bratislava (Ihre Wahl!) Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. • Agile Impact: Begleiten Sie ein Team, in dem Ihre Proaktivität nicht nur begrüßt wird – es ist erforderlich. Sie verhindern Probleme, bevor sie passieren, mit digitalen Zwillingen und Remote-Diagnose-Tools. Wer sind Sie?

• Die "Lab-to-Office"-Brücke: Wenn Sie in einem klinischen Labor gearbeitet haben und fühlen, dass Sie Ihre aktuellen Wände ausgewachsen sind, wollen wir Ihre Diagnoselogik. Wir werden Ihnen das Engineering lehren; Sie bringen die Leidenschaft für die Wissenschaft.
• Widerstand & Ambition: Sie sind jemand, der einen komplexen technischen Fehler nicht als Problem sieht, sondern als Herausforderung erobert werden. Was Roche Ihnen bietet:
• Autonomie: Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell in Warschau, Prag oder Bratislava.
• Unübertroffenes Portfolio: Zugang zu Technologien, die den Standard für das nächste Jahrzehnt der Gesundheitsversorgung setzen. Die Rolle ist ein 18-monatiger Vertrag über eine externe Agentur. Für den Standort Bratislava beginnt das Gehalt von 1 600 EUR brutto / Monat. Für den Standort Prag beginnt das Gehalt von 48 300 CZK / Monat. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Ce rôle est basé dans le Centre Régional d'Assistance à la Clientèle qui se consacre à fournir l'excellence tout en aidant le personnel de laboratoire à utiliser nos produits. Nous travaillons avec une approche holistique, ce qui signifie que nous prenons soin de notre portefeuille de produits, de l'idée jusqu'au développement et au lancement du marché jusqu'à l'élimination progressive. La grande variété de technologies appliquées dans ce domaine vous offre d'excellentes possibilités d'apprentissage. Spécialiste du soutien technique (Slovaque et tchèque) Emplacements: Varsovie, Prague ou Bratislava (Votre choix!) Êtes-vous prêt à passer de l'expertise technique à l'impact qui change la vie? Notre Centre régional d'assistance à la clientèle (RCSC) est le moteur intellectuel derrière l'excellence du laboratoire en Europe centrale. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un talent tchèque et/ou slovaque qui a faim de savoir, aime la résolution de problèmes et est prêt à maîtriser les technologies de diagnostic les plus avancées du monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. La possibilité : Plus que juste soutenir Ce n'est pas un rôle typique d'assistance. Il s'agit d'une position de conseil en ingénierie et en application où vous devenez le "gardien" de la précision diagnostique.
• Maîtriser la complexité: Vous travaillerez avec des systèmes de diagnostic IVD haut de gamme (In-Vitro Diagnostics) qui combinent la robotique, la biochimie complexe et l'informatique avancée.
• Croissance continue : Nous proposons un programme de formation intensif de calibre mondial. Nous ne nous attendons pas à ce que vous sachiez tout au premier jour, mais nous nous attendons à ce que vous soyez celui qui ne cesse de demander "pourquoi?".
• Impact Agile: Rejoignez une équipe où votre proactivité n'est pas seulement bienvenue – c'est nécessaire. Vous éviterez les problèmes avant qu'ils ne se produisent, en utilisant des jumelles numériques et des outils de diagnostic à distance. Qui vous êtes :
• Éducation: Vous avez un diplôme en ingénierie, IT, biochimie, diagnostic de laboratoire ou équivalent. Plus important encore, vous avez un "esprit détecteur" pour le dépannage.
• Pouvoir linguistique: Vous êtes un natif ou C1/C2 locuteur de tchèque et/ou slovaque. Votre anglais est assez fort pour vous guider à travers des formations internationales et des forums techniques mondiaux.
• Le pont "Lab-to-Office" : Si vous avez travaillé dans un laboratoire clinique et que vous vous sentez dépassé vos murs actuels, nous voulons votre logique diagnostique. Nous allons vous enseigner l'ingénierie; vous apportez la passion pour la science.
• Résilience & Ambition: Vous êtes quelqu'un qui voit une erreur technique complexe non pas comme un problème, mais comme un défi à conquérir. Ce que Roche vous offre :
• Autonomie : un modèle de travail hybride à Varsovie, Prague ou Bratislava.
• Portfolio inégalé : accès aux technologies qui établissent la norme pour la prochaine décennie de soins de santé. Il s'agit d'un contrat de 18 mois passé par une agence externe. Le salaire final dépend du niveau d'expérience, des compétences et des qualifications du candidat reçu. Internés ? S'il vous plaît ! Si vous ressentez

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Senior Security Engineer plays a vital role in protecting Roche Manufacturing systems and networks against cybersecurity threats. This role is responsible for local architecture and engineering support, helping system owners and administrators in keeping their manufacturing environment up to date with the latest Roche Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards, baselines and industry best practices. Some of this role’s responsibilities are:
• Taking part in technical design reviews, integration, testing, and documentation activities concerning new OT systems and/or changes to existing manufacturing system or infrastructure
• Supporting development of Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards and baselines OT Cybersecurity Advisor during OT System planning phase and OT System Risk Assessment process
• Advising System Owners in selecting appropriate security measures to mitigate risk
• Coordinating of OT services and activities delivered by Vendors
• Reviewing local technical designs as part of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Requests (in ServiceNow)
• Designing and sustaining OT Security Monitoring (IIDS) at the Manufacturing Site
• Providing technical support during Incident Response process including steps to minimize the impact, conducting a technical and forensic investigation into how the breach happened and the extent of the damage
• Working closely with System Owners, Cybersecurity Site Representative and is a catalyst for cross-site collaboration on topics related to Manufacturing Cybersecurity The Senior Security Engineer is a member of the Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering team led by the Head of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering and part of the Security Platforms subfunction in the Information Security function at Roche. Job Responsibilities
• Independently manages end-to-end security analysis tasks across various capabilities and contributes to more complex problems
• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices
• Stakeholder Management
• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor
• Acts as a strategic influencer, defining and driving stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops, resolving conflicts, and proactively shaping stakeholder perspectives to align with project goals
• Impact/Strategy
• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster
• Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives, and takes a proactive role in shaping team processes Complexity
• Manages business analysis activities on more complex projects or across multiple products within a domain
• Capable of handling ambiguous requirements, navigating intricate stakeholder environments, and evaluating solution impacts considering both immediate and longer-term implications within the domain
• Business/Technical ability
• Demonstrates a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies
• Can independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis, effectively managing interconnections to improve overall efficiency and effectiveness Qu

The Position Unsere Pharma-Vision Medikamente schnell zu den Patienten zu bringen und das beste Ergebnis für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Das ist es, was uns in Sterile Drug Product Manufacturing (SDPM) in Mannheim antreibt. So tragen wir auch dazu bei, bis 2029 unser Ziel zu erreichen: 20 bahnbrechende Medikamente zur Behandlung der Krankheiten mit der größten gesellschaftlichen Belastung bereitzustellen. Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM! ​ Was Dich erwartet: Als Pharmazeutischer Assistent (m/w/d) unterstützt Du die Leitung der Herstellung im Produktionsbetrieb im Rahmen der folgenden Aufgaben:
• Du stellst sicher, dass die GMP-konforme Herstellpraxis und die GMP-gerechte Dokumentation im Produktionsbetrieb eingehalten werden. Für den Chargenreview sowie konzeptionelle Erstellung der GMP-Dokumente in deutscher und englischer Sprache bist Du verantwortlich
• Du bearbeitest die Chargendokumentation (Batch Record Review) vor der Freigabe durch den Leiter der Herstellung.
• Du erstellst und bearbeitest Abweichungen, Reklamationen und Changes.
• Du erstellst und aktualisierst Arbeitsanweisungen und Vorschriften eigenständig.
• Du wirkst bei behördlichen Inspektionen mit und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von Maßnahmen. Wer Du bist:
• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Master), idealerweise mit Approbation als Apotheker.
• Du bringst erste Erfahrungen in der Pharmaindustrie mit, zum Beispiel in den Bereichen Verpackung, aseptische Produktion, Qualitätskontrolle oder Qualitätssicherung.
• Du überzeugst mit deinen Sprachkenntnissen und deinem Ausdrucksvermögen in Deutsch und Englisch (in Wort und Schrift)
• Du besitzt ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit und Verantwortungsbereitschaft
• Die Fähigkeit zu interdisziplinärem Denken, Konfliktbewältigung sowie Integrations- und Überzeugungsfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab Diese Stelle ist befristet auf 24 Monate. Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil
• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, fos

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L’organizzazione “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, parte della funzione “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, fornisce l’infrastruttura e i servizi per l’intero sito e li sviluppa continuamente e in modo innovativo. Lavoriamo con tutti gli stakeholder lungo tutta la catena del valore, dalla ricerca precoce alla cura dei pazienti. Con noi si può aspettare un modello organizzativo moderno, in cui è possibile contribuire i vostri talenti nel lavoro sensuale. Garantiamo la libertà di progettazione e di decisione nella nostra organizzazione. Stai cercando dei superiori classici. All’interno dell’organizzazione “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst” creiamo soluzioni su misura nel cluster “Business Solutions” insieme ai nostri stakeholder. All'interno del Dipartimento di Ingegneria Farmacia – Qualificazione Drug Substance (DS) presso il sito Kaiseraugst, sosteniamo la qualificazione iniziale di impianti e sistemi di produzione. In un ambiente dinamico, vi offriamo l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente alla trasformazione digitale del nostro dipartimento come stagista: in o come parte di una tesi di laurea. L'obiettivo è aumentare l'efficienza e la qualità attraverso l'uso dell'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e standardizzare i nostri processi di documentazione. La possibilità Ottimizzazione e standardizzazione dei processi basati su AI
• Integrazione dell'intelligenza artificiale: si sta lavorando attivamente per ottimizzare i processi di formazione, valutando e implementando applicazioni AI per aumentare l'efficienza operativa.
• Standardizzazione: Lei ci sostiene nello sviluppo di concetti per la standardizzazione della formazione mediante strumenti tecnologici.
• Gestione dell'innovazione: è possibile identificare i potenziali per trasferire i processi manuali ai flussi di lavoro basati su AI digitali. Documentazione e ottimizzazione dei modelli
• Smart Documentation: Supporti la concezione e l'implementazione di soluzioni per creare automaticamente documenti di qualificazione utilizzando AI.
• Gestione del ciclo di vita: analizza e ottimizza i modelli esistenti, nonché i documenti standard relativi alla facilità d'uso e all'automazione. Standard di conformità e GxP
• Conformità delle policy: l'utente aiuta a garantire la conformità e la documentazione delle politiche GxP e degli standard interni durante l'introduzione di nuovi strumenti AI. Ci supporta nella creazione di una documentazione completa del ciclo di vita per sistemi qualificati. Requisiti / conoscenza
• Comprensione di base per la qualificazione / validazione e l'interesse per le linee guida GxP.
• Affinità per tecnologie AI e strumenti software moderni e la loro applicazione
• Un modo di lavoro strutturato e indipendente
• Buone capacità di comunicazione per lo scambio in un team interdisciplinare. Chi sei
• Sei attualmente uno studente immatricato: in (Bachelor/Master) o hai completato con successo i tuoi studi nei campi delle scienze della vita, della farmacia, delle scienze ingegneristiche o di un soggetto paragonabile negli ultimi 12 mesi.
• Le competenze linguistiche tedesche nella parola e nella scrittura sono assolutamente necessarie; le buone abilità inglesi sono di vantaggio. Ulteriori informazioni
• Data di inizio: Con accordo (ideale Q3 2026)
• Durata: 6 mesi
• Sotto la P

The position The organization “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, part of the global Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, provides the infrastructure and services for the entire site and develops them continuously and in an innovative way. We work with all stakeholders along the entire value chain, from early research to patient care. With us you can look forward to a modern organizational model, in which you can contribute your talents in sensual work. We guarantee freedom of design and decision-making in our organization. You're looking for classic superiors. Within the organization “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst” we create tailor-made solutions in the “Business Solutions” cluster together with our stakeholders. Within the Department of Pharma Engineering – Qualification Drug Substance (DS) at the Kaiseraugst site, we support the initial qualification of production facilities and systems. In a dynamic environment, we offer you the opportunity to actively participate in the digital transformation of our department as an intern:in or as part of a Bachelor's thesis. The focus is on increasing efficiency and quality through the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and standardizing our documentation processes. The possibility AI-based process optimization and standardization
• AI integration: You are actively working to optimize training processes by evaluing and implementing AI applications to increase operational efficiency.
• Standardization: You support us in the development of concepts for standardizing training by means of technological tools.
• Innovation Management: You can identify potentials to transfer manual processes to digital AI-based workflows. Documentation and Template Optimization
• Smart Documentation: You support the conception and implementation of solutions to automatically create qualification documents using AI.
• Lifecycle Management: You analyze and optimize existing templates as well as standard documents regarding user-friendliness and automatability. Compliance and GxP standards
• Policy compliance: You help to ensure compliance and documentation of GxP policies as well as internal standards when introducing new AI tools. You support us in creating a complete lifecycle documentation for qualified systems. Requirements / knowledge
• Basic understanding for qualification / validation as well as interest in GxP guidelines.
• Affinity for AI technologies and modern software tools and their application
• A structured, independent way of working
• Good communication skills for exchange in an interdisciplinary team. Who you are
• You are currently an immatricated student:in (Bachelor/Master) or have successfully completed your studies in the fields of life sciences, pharmacy, engineering sciences or a comparable subject within the last 12 months.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Description / Description of the Area We are seeking a skilled and motivated Technical Business Analyst with experience in Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) to support the delivery and continuous improvement of customer identity services. The successful candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear requirements and ensuring scalable, secure, and user-centric CIAM solutions. This role combines business analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder engagement, and delivery support in a complex enterprise environment. Key Responsibilities Business Analysis and Requirements Management
• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to customer identity, registration, authentication, consent, profile management, and access journeys.
• Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
• Challenge and refine requirements to ensure clarity, feasibility, and business value.
• Support prioritization of demand, backlog items, and roadmap initiatives. Solution Design and Delivery Support
• Work closely with architects, engineers, and product teams to shape fit-for-purpose CIAM solutions.
• Support design discussions by bringing process, customer journey, and business context.
• Ensure requirements are traceable through delivery, testing, and implementation.
• Participate in release planning, change activities, and deployment readiness. Stakeholder Management and Collaboration
• Engage with business, security, legal, compliance, digital, and IT stakeholders across multiple functions.
• Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and decision meetings.
• Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and options clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. Governance, Risk, and Compliance
• Support alignment with privacy and regulatory requirements such as GDPR and related frameworks.
• Ensure customer identity processes reflect governance, auditability, and security expectations.
• Contribute to control documentation and evidence gathering where required. Continuous Improvement
• Identify pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities to simplify CIAM processes and customer journeys.
• Support KPI tracking, service improvement initiatives, and process optimization.
• Stay informed on CIAM trends, identity standards, and digital customer expectations. Qualifications Education
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued. Experience
• Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role.
• Experience in Identity & Access Management, Customer Identity, digital platforms, or customer-facing systems.
• Experience working in enterprise delivery environments with multiple stakeholders. Technical Skills
• Strong understanding of CIAM concepts such as registration, authentication, SSO, MFA, consent, profile lifecycle, and access control.
• Familiarity with identity standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
• Ability to interpret APIs, system integrations, data flows, and technical dependencies.
• Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Visio, Miro, or equivalent collaboration platforms.
• Familiarity with SAP Customer Data Cloud (SAP CDC) or similar CIAM p
