At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Patient Safety Intern will embark on a growth journey upon joining Roche. The intern will develop fundamental knowledge in Pharmacovigilance and Safety Risk Management throughout the lifecycle of a product and enabling safe access to innovative treatments for the patients, ensuring optimal beneﬁt-risk balance for a therapeutic product. At the end of the internship, the intern should achieve the following;
• To understand and apply pre-marketing pharmacovigilance requirements in Asia Paciﬁc
• To understand and apply post-marketing pharmacovigilance requirements in Asia Paciﬁc
• To understand EU Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) and its implementation in global processes
• To be able to accurately assess and independently complete some basic Pharmacovigilance requirements
• Demonstrate soft skills, project management and presentation skills Qualiﬁcations:
• Currently pursuing a degree in Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or Pharmaceutical Science.
• Preferably a student who can commit from July 2026 to December 2026 .
• Willing to work at our Singapore oﬃce located in Paya Lebar Quarter . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Chi siamo L’organizzazione Global Data, Digital & AI (GDDA) svolge un ruolo centrale nell’ecosistema digitale e AI di Roche Pharma Commercial. GDDA definisce la strategia digitale aziendale, traduce obiettivi commerciali in un portafoglio coordinato di investimenti, e definisce gli standard e il modello operativo che consentono l'esecuzione scalabile attraverso programmi e prodotti. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. Who We Are The Global Data, Digital & AI (GDDA) organization plays a central role in Roche Pharma Commercial’s digital and AI ecosystem. GDDA sets the enterprise digital strategy, translates commercial objectives into a coordinated portfolio of investments, and defines the standards and operating model that enable scalable execution across programs and products. By connecting strategy, portfolio, standards, programs, and products, GDDA ensures that data, digital, and AI capabilities are delivered as scalable, enterprise solutions that drive adoption and improve outcomes for patients, healthcare providers, and the broader healthcare ecosystem. The Opportunity The Head of Digital Strategy, Excellence & Standards is responsible for shaping and driving the strategic agenda of the Global Data, Digital & AI organization within Pharma Commercial. This role leads development of the GDDA strategic plan, ensuring strategic coherence with GDDA’s core mandates while translating enterprise and Pharma Commercial priorities into clear GDDA objectives, outcomes, and prioritization principles that guide investment decisions. This role also drives the design of GDDA’s operating model and organizational approach including the definition of global vs. local standards and operating discipline for digital products, data, and technology— establishing the bar for quality and consistency across markets and local execution. This role also owns change enablement across the digital ecosystem — ensuring that new standards, processes, and capabilities are adopted effectively through structured communication, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness. Partnering closely with leaders across Roche Pharma, the Head of Strategy defines interfaces, aligns initiatives, and avoids duplication across the broader digital ecosystem. La position Responsable Stratégie numérique, excellence et normes, Global Digital & Data Analytics Pourquoi Roche Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Qui nous sommes L'organisation Global Data, Digital & AI (GDDA) joue un rôle central dans l'écosystème numérique et d'IA de Roche Pharma Commercial. GDDA définit la stratégie numérique d'entreprise, traduit les objectifs commerciaux en un portefeuille coordonné d'investissements, et définit les normes et le modèle d'exploitation qui permettent l'exécution évolutive des programmes et des produits. En connectant la stratégie, le portefeuille, les normes, les programmes et les produits, GDDA veille à ce que les capacités de données, numériques et d'IA soient fournies en tant que solutions d'entreprise évolutives qui favorisent l'adoption et améliorent les résultats pour les patients, les fournisseurs de soins de santé et l'écosystème de santé en général. L'opportunité Le responsable de la stratégie numérique, excellence et normes est responsable de l'élaboration et du pilotage du programme stratégique de l'organisation Global Data, Digital & AI au sein de Pharma Commercial. Ce rôle dirige l'élaboration du plan stratégique de l'ADDG, assurant la cohérence stratégique avec les mandats de base de l'ADDG, tout en transformant les priorités d'entreprise et de Pharma Commercial en objectifs, résultats et principes de priorité clairs de l'ADDG qui guident les décisions d'investissement. Ce rôle est également à l'origine de la conception du modèle d'exploitation et de l'approche organisationnelle de la GDDA, y compris la définition de normes globales par rapport aux normes locales et la discipline d'exploitation des produits numériques, des données et de la technologie, en établissant la barre de la qualité et de la cohérence entre les marchés et l'exécution locale. Ce rôle est également le moteur du changement dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème numérique, en veillant à ce que les nouvelles normes, les nouveaux processus et les nouvelles capacités soient adoptés efficacement grâce à une communication structurée, à l'engagement des intervenants et à la préparation organisationnelle. En étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants de Roche Pharma, le responsable de la stratégie définit les interfaces, aligne les initiatives et évite les doubles emplois dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème numérique. En tant que chef de cabinet du chef de l'ADGD, ce rôle représente les points de vue de l'ADGD dans les forums de leadership, élabore des récits de la haute direction et assure une forte harmonisation interfonctionnelle et un cheminement cohérent de la stratégie à l'impact. Au fil du temps, le rôle consistera à constituer et à diriger une équipe chargée d'exécuter et d'étendre ces mandats. Sur quoi vous travaillerez Stratégie et normes Diriger le développement et l'évolution de la stratégie d'entreprise GDDA, y compris la définition de mandat, l'établissement d'ambitions, et une vision de capacité pluriannuelle et une orientation stratégique assurant l'alignement avec les priorités de l'entreprise et l'évolution continue fondée sur la réalisation de valeurs et les signaux externes.
• Définir et développer des normes mondiales testables, répétables et évolutives pour les produits numériques, les données, les technologies et les méthodes de travail, permettant une adoption cohérente sur tous les marchés.
• Engager des conversations stratégiques d'entreprise pour s'assurer que les priorités pharmaceutiques numériques commerciales sont représentées au fur et à mesure que les stratégies d'entreprise sont élaborées.
• Assurer l'alignement stratégique continu des initiatives de la GDDA sur les priorités plus larges de Roche Pharma et de l'entreprise.
• Actualiser, connecter en permanence,

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Als Pharmafacharbeiter Ansatz / Abfüllung (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine, der Gefriertrocknungsanlage und den optischen Kontrollmaschinen verantwortlich. Verantwortlichkeiten In dieser Rolle bist Du für die sichere Durchführung von Standardaufgaben und komplexen Prozessen in der Wirkstoffverarbeitung verantwortlich:
• Du gewährleistest den reibungslosen Ablauf der Abfüllung von sterilen Lösungen in Vials unter Berücksichtigung aseptischer Arbeitsweise nach Herstellanweisung und Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften
• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen an der Abfüll- und Gefriertrocknungsanlage
• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.
• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du Geräte und Kleinteile
• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)
• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe
• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln. Das bringst du mit
• Du hast idealerweise eine dreijährige abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Pharmakant oder Pharmazeutisch-technischer Assistent (PTA) (m/w/d).
• Deine mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, ggf. Berufserfahrung in der Parenteralia-Herstellung zeichnet Dich aus.
• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Hygienebereich und in der Einhaltung der GMP-Richtlinien sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit Dokumentationsarbeiten und gängigen IT-Anwendungen (insbesondere MS Office, MES, Unilab).
• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für die Bedienung und Kenntnis von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.
• Du arbeitest gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
• Fähigkeit und Offenheit, die Chancen und die Vorteile von Veränderungen zu erkennen und das Warum zu vermitteln.
• Du begegnest allen Mitarbeitenden offen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung.
• Es besteht die Bereitschaft, in flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen eingesetzt zu werden. Darüber hinaus bist Du bereit, in Schichtsystemen mit Früh/Spät/Nacht zu arbeiten. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Finance Business Partner for Roche Diagnostics (internally known as Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP)), you'll play a pivotal role in driving the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) journey. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the financial health of our business while delivering market-leading customer experiences. You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to identify profitable commercial opportunities, improve contract performance, and ensure sustainable business outcomes. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the financial strategy, contract management, and performance insights within the network. You will collaborate across teams to ensure the success of our commercial pipeline and contribute to the development and execution of the annual business plan. By leveraging your expertise, you’ll ensure that our contracts are financially sustainable, competitive, and aligned with Roche Diagnostics' long-term goals. The Opportunity:
• Lead the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) processes for a portfolio of contracts, ensuring financial sustainability. This includes modelling new tenders, extensions and amendments.
• Monitor and improve contract financial health in collaboration with customers
• Lead negotiations regarding complex contracts and dispute resolution.
• Contribute to the business planning process and actively participate in the regional network governance, aligning targets with the annual cycle.
• Support the commercial pipeline by balancing growth with profitability and timely cash generation, while driving sustainable commercial deals that consider risks, competitor assumptions, and pricing.
• Develop and partner key stakeholders, providing coaching and support, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and building trusted cross-functional partnerships to achieve shared objectives and co-lead critical affiliate business plan initiatives. Who you are:
• You hold a university degree (Upper Second Class or equivalent), a Master’s or MBA is preferred but not required.
• Strong, proven commercial finance experience, professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, ACA, or international equivalent) is preferred
• Excellent excel skills and experience with financial modelling
• You're a customer-centric professional, adept at delivering solutions that meet both client and business objectives.
• Experience in navigating complex Customer Relationships and Negotiations
• You excel at navigating complex, matrix organizations, fostering strong collaborative networks, and translating complex financial ideas into easily understandable insights.
• You embrace change as an opportunity, thrive in both independent and team environments, and are driven by results and continuous improvement.
• Fluent in English, you're passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences that drive business success. This role is based onsite at our Burgess Hill office in West Sussex, United Kingdom. Please upload only your current compelling CV and / or Cover Letter. We look forward to receiving your application! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, en

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Dein neues Team Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg. In dieser Funktion bist du Teil der Roche Diagnostics GmbH Risk Management & SHE Compliance, explizit des Teams Environmental Safety. Wir handeln stets mit dem Bewusstsein für unsere große Verantwortung gegenüber der Umwelt und der Gesellschaft und verwalten daher nicht nur, sondern gestalten aktiv eine zukunftsorientierte umweltrechtliche Compliance. Werde jetzt Teil eines Teams werden, dass sich wie folgt auszeichnet:
• Zwei Standorte, ein Team: Trotz der räumlichen Distanz verbindet uns ein engmaschiger, standortübergreifender Austausch und ein starker Teamgeist.
• Gesetzliche Fachexpertise: Wir übernehmen die zentralen Rollen der gesetzlichen Betriebsbeauftragten für Umweltschutz und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Innovationen & Assets stets auf einem rechtssicheren Fundament stehen.
• Vom Berater zum Gestalter: Wir verstehen uns nicht als „Bedenkenträger“, sondern als lösungsorientierte Gestalter. Wir handeln business-orientiert und unterstützen die operativen Einheiten dabei, Nachhaltigkeit und Effizienz in Einklang zu bringen. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich In dieser Rolle unterstützt Du die Geschäftsführung und die operativen Einheiten bei der Sicherstellung der technischen Anlagen- und Verfahrenssicherheit. Mit Deiner Expertise im Boden- und Gewässerschutz agierst Du am Standort Mannheim als zentrale Instanz für die Überwachung und fachliche Beratung zur Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen. Du stellst sicher, dass die Betreiberverantwortung durch fundierte Expertise und proaktive Begutachtung gestärkt wird, und übernimmst darüber hinaus folgende spannende Aufgaben:
• Du überprüfst sicherheitstechnische Konzepte und stellst sicher, dass diese den gesetzlichen sowie internen Anforderungen im Bereich Gewässerschutz entsprechen.
• Du übernimmst die fachliche Überprüfung und auditierst die Umsetzung von Umwelt- und Sicherheitsvorgaben für Gewässer- und Bodenschutz, um die Einhaltung der Standards nachhaltig zu sichern.
• Durch die Bestellung zum Gewässerschutzbeauftragten und die fachliche Beratung der Verantwortlichen minimierst du proaktiv Risiken und sicherst die Compliance ab.
• Bei umweltrelevanten Vorfällen führst du fundierte Ursachenanalysen durch und verantwortest das Reporting gemäß gesetzlichen und Roche-internen Standards in Deinem Fachgebiet. Bei Bedarf unterstützt du intern im Rahmen der Gefahrenabwehr und im Notfallmanagement.
• Du agierst als kompetente:r Berater:in für die Fachbereiche, indem du Du komplexe Vorschriften wie das WHG oder die AwSV analysierst und in klare, praxisnahe Handlungsanweisungen für unsere Business Units übersetzt.
• Du agierst als Schnittstelle zu Genehmigungs- und Aufsichtsbehörden in Deinem Fachgebiet und begleitest die Fachbereiche proaktiv bei externen Audits und Inspektionen.
• Du beteiligst dich aktiv in internen (z.B. Communities of Practice) und externen (z.B. VCI) Gremien und und trägst mit Deinem Fachwissen zu pragmatischen und wirtschaftlichen Lösungsfindungen bei. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Du hast ein Studium (Bachelo

The Position The Opportunity: As a Senior Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.
• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments
• Manage vendor accounts
• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution
• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries
• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams
• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer Who you are:
• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience
• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage
• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues
• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions
• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations
• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment
• Proficiency in English and Spanish In exchange we provide you with:

titleByLocale.de: Domain Architect - International Pharma Commercial Marketing & Customer Engagement

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Principal Domain Architect designs business-driven, future-ready solutions for our International Pharma Commercial Marketing & Customer Engagement portfolio. In this strategic role, you will define the architectural vision for how we engage with patients and HCPs across international markets. You will align technology deployments with commercial priorities, ensuring our "Global-to-Local" scaling strategy is seamless, compliant, and data-driven Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a Multiple Solution, Platform, or Product Line Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and strictly aligns with the architecture community for governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Guides others in resolving highly complex issues and problems with implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes. Defines and manages architecture, governance, and technology aligned with stakeholder needs. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for a complete platform or product line. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are systematically recorded and published across the platform. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including comprehensive vendor assessments.
• Stakeholder Management: Communicates complex ideas and influences senior-level stakeholders to adopt new approaches. Deeply connects with and understands the business needs, closely partnering with Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs and Marketing stakeholders. Drives seamless information sharing across the complete customer engagement products .
• Impact: Provides high-level technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies strategic opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Platform or Product.
• Domain Strategy: Maintain the technology roadmap for the International Commercial landscape, focusing on CRM, Omnichannel Marketing, and other capabilities
• Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge across multiple technology areas. Serves as a recognized leader in Architecture Practices development and mentoring. Qualifications Education / Experience
• 5+ years of experience in designing and architecting business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a multiple solution, platform, or product line context.
• Experience resolving highly complex issues with implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes.
• Proven track record acting as a recognized leader in architecture practices, including significant experience mentoring and developing architectural talent.
• Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry Technical Skills
• Demonstrates deep technical authority across diverse technology stacks to solve complex, enterprise-scale challenges.
• Expert at designing Conceptual and Logical Data Models, Taxono

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology. In Roche Digital Technology we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives. You will be responsible for the Design and Implementation of Directory Services (mainly Microsoft Active Directory) solutions and tier 2-3 operational support, performance, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies. You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives. As a Manufacturing Specialist Directory Services you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks. Job Responsibilities
• Collaborate in small to medium sized technical teams and contribute to the end to end design of infrastructure solutions producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.
• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and support and implement the Directory Services Infrastructure on premises for manufacturing environments and its associated compliments and applications.
• Proactively monitor systems and platforms for performance, availability and capacity management and ensure that the solution and component escalations are minimized.
• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implement changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction
• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management
• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve
• Provide 24x7 on-call support. Flexibility regarding working hours
• Occasional international travel is required Qualifications Education / Experience
• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.
• 4+ years experience administering and advance troubleshooting in Active Directory
• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry Technical Skills
• Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and desirable in Entra ID.
• Powershell Scripting skills will be required
• Ability to apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis in practical scenarios
• Skill in evaluating change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, and breaking down complex technical concepts with minimal guidance Additional Qualifications
• Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures
• Willingness to continually evolve, acquire and maintain the technical and soft skills appropriate to the requirements of this position
• Committing to operational excellence, with a willin

descriptionByLocale.it: # Mansioni - **Product Manager - Delivery Organization Primary Operational Anchor and Practitioner-Leader** # Descrizione dell'Area - Guida una squadra di consegna diversificata, composta da Senior Project/Program Managers, Deployment Leads, RTEs e STEs. - Opera come un leader praticante, bilanciando la mentorship approfondita con l'esecuzione della rete. - Stabilisce una fiducia assoluta con i leader aziendali e IT attraverso una comunicazione costante e una partnership attiva. # Opportunità: - **Guida la Strategia del Prodotto:** Responsabile della direzione del prodotto, garantendo che tutte le funzionalità e le roadmap si allineino con gli obiettivi finanziari e gli obiettivi organizzativi definiti. - **Dirige l'Eccellenza Cross-Funzionale:** Orchestra il flusso continuo del flusso di valore Agile mentre guida distinti programmi e progetti verso il completamento riuscito. - **Favorisce Partnerships Fiduciarie:** Costruisce alleanze profonde con i dirigenti aziendali e IT attraverso una comunicazione trasparente per colmare il divario tra strategia ed esecuzione. - **Promuove la Centralità del Cliente:** Funziona come il proprietario principale del problema del cliente, priorizzando i bisogni interni degli utenti per consegnare soluzioni che forniscono un valore tangibile. - **Esegue la Gestione del Ciclo di Vita End-to-End:** Guida l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla pianificazione strategica iniziale all'ideazione, al lancio, all'espansione e alla fine al pensionamento. - **Innova con l'IA:** Integra proattivamente le capacità rilevanti dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) nella roadmap del prodotto per mantenere un portafoglio competitivo e pronto per il futuro. - **Ottimizza le Prestazioni:** Definisce e traccia gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) e le metriche di soddisfazione dell'utente per informare le iterazioni e le ottimizzazioni del prodotto basate sui dati. - **Nurture Team Development:** Funziona come un coach praticante, mentor della squadra per padroneggiare la facilitazione SAFe e navigare paesaggi ibridi complessi (Agile/Waterfall). # Chi sei: - **Leader Esperto del Prodotto:** Porti 5+ anni di esperienza in gestione del prodotto o analisi aziendale con un track record comprovato di lancio di prodotti tecnologici. - **Specialista del Settore:** Possiedi 2+ anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o nella tecnologia regolamentata del settore sanitario. - **Leader Esperto:** Possiedi 1+ anni di esperienza in una posizione di leadership nella gestione di squadre tecniche multidisciplinary e nell'esercizio dell'autorità sulle persone. - **Tecnicamente Proficuo:** Hai una forte comprensione dell'architettura del software (API, cloud) e del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del prodotto, compresi GxP e GDPR. - **Comunicatore Strategico:** Eccelli nella traduzione degli obiettivi scientifici di alto livello in roadmap concrete e nell'influenzare gruppi diversi verso una visione comune. - **Esperto di Agile:** Sei esperto nella facilitazione SAFe e sei in grado di rimuovere gli ostacoli sistemici per mantenere l'eccellenza operativa e il flusso. - **Fondamento Accademico:** Sei altamente istruito in un campo scientifico, tecnico o aziendale rilevante, che sostiene la tua capacità. # Contatto - Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il sito web di Roche o contatta il tuo recruiter dedicato.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are fearless in both decision-making and taking action. You will be the primary operational anchor and practitioner-leader for our delivery organization, bridging the gap between strategic intent and technical execution. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead engineering teams in building sustainable products that accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines. Description of the Area We are seeking a hands-on leader, ideally with experience as an STE, RTE, Program Manager or Initiative Owner, to guide a diverse delivery team, including Senior Project/Program Managers, Deployment Leads, RTEs, and STEs. You will operate as a practitioner-leader, balancing deep mentorship with Network Execution. Success in this role relies on establishing absolute trust with Business and IT leaders through constant communication and active partnership. The Opportunity:
• Drive Product Strategy: Accountable for setting the product direction, ensuring all features and roadmaps align with defined financial objectives and organizational goals.
• Lead Cross-Functional Excellence: Orchestrate the continuous flow of the Agile Value Stream while simultaneously driving distinct programs and projects to successful completion.
• Foster Trusted Partnerships: Build deep alliances with Business and IT executives through transparent communication to bridge the gap between strategy and execution.
• Champion Customer-Centricity: Act as the primary owner of the customer's problem, prioritizing internal user needs to deliver solutions that provide tangible value.
• Execute End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Lead the entire product lifecycle from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement.
• Innovate with AI: Proactively integrate relevant Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities into the product roadmap to maintain a competitive and future-ready portfolio.
• Optimize Performance: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and user satisfaction metrics to inform data-driven product iterations and optimizations.
• Nurture Team Development: Act as a practitioner-coach, mentoring your team to master SAFe facilitation and navigate complex hybrid (Agile/Waterfall) landscapes. Who you are:
• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 5+ years of experience in product management or business analysis with a proven track record of launching technology products.
• Industry Specialist: You possess 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry.
• Proven People Lead: You have 1+ years of experience in a leadership role managing multidisciplinary technical teams and holding people authority.
• Technically Proficient: You have a strong understanding of software architecture (APIs, cloud) and the product development lifecycle, including GxP and GDPR.
• Strategic Communicator: You excel at translating high-level scientific goals into concrete roadmaps and influencing diverse groups toward a common vision.
• Agile Expert: You are skilled in SAFe facilitation and capable of removing systemic impediments to maintain operational excellence and flow.
• Academic Foundation: You are highly educated in a relevant scientific, technical, or business field, supporting your ability

Il établit une confiance absolue avec les chefs d'entreprise et de TI par une communication constante et un partenariat actif. Possibilité : - Guider la stratégie du produit : Responsable de la gestion du produit, s'assurer que toutes les caractéristiques et les feuilles de route correspondent aux objectifs financiers et aux objectifs organisationnels définis. - Dirige l'excellence trans-fonction : orchestre le flux continu de la valeur Agile tout en conduisant des programmes et des projets distincts vers la réussite. - Promotion des partenariats fiduciaires : Elle crée des alliances profondes avec les dirigeants des entreprises et des TI grâce à une communication transparente pour combler le fossé entre la stratégie et l'exécution. - Promotion de la centralité client: Il fonctionne comme le principal propriétaire du problème du client, en priorisant les besoins internes de l'utilisateur pour fournir des solutions qui fournissent une valeur tangible. - Exécute la gestion du cycle de vie de bout en bout : Dirigez tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la planification stratégique initiale à l'idée, le lancement, l'expansion et éventuellement la retraite. - Innovation avec l'IA: intègre de manière proactive les capacités pertinentes de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) dans la feuille de route des produits afin de maintenir un portefeuille compétitif et prêt à porter. - Excellente performance : Définit et suit les indicateurs de performance clés (ICP) et les mesures de la satisfaction des utilisateurs pour éclairer les itérations et les optimisations de produits basées sur les données. - Développement de l'équipe Nurture : Il travaille comme entraîneur, mentor de l'équipe pour maîtriser la facilitation SAFe et naviguer dans des paysages hybrides complexes (Agile/Waterfall). Qui êtes-vous : - Expert Product Leader : 5+ ans d'expérience dans la gestion de produits ou l'analyse d'affaires avec une expérience éprouvée de lancement de produits technologiques. - Spécialiste du Secteur : Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience dans les technologies pharmaceutiques, biotechnologiques ou réglementaires de la santé. - Chef d'équipe : Vous avez 1+ ans d'expérience en leadership dans la gestion d'équipes techniques multidisciplinaires et l'exercice de l'autorité sur les gens. - Techniquement rentable: Vous avez une bonne compréhension de l'architecture logicielle (API, cloud) et du cycle de vie du développement de produits, y compris GxP et GDPR. - Communication stratégique: Eccelli traduit les objectifs scientifiques de haut niveau en feuilles de route concrètes et influence les différents groupes vers une vision commune. - Expert d'Agile: Vous êtes expert en facilitation Safe et êtes en mesure d'éliminer les obstacles systémiques pour maintenir l'excellence opérationnelle et le flux. - Fondement académique: Vous êtes très instruit dans un domaine scientifique, technique ou pertinent, qui soutient votre capacité. Contact - Pour plus d'informations ou pour postuler, visitez le site Web de Roche ou contactez votre recruteur dédié.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job description As a Cloud DevOps Infrastructure Engineer at the SE6 level, you will be responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative DevOps solutions across the entire infrastructure landscape. Possessing deep knowledge of the impact of DevOps practices on business infrastructure, you will make critical technical decisions across multiple product lines with considerable independence. In this role, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor teams, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Establishes technical direction to the whole lifecycle of platforms and services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and retirement. Applies software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products and services, abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure to provide self-service tools and APIs for developers. Designs complex CI/CD pipelines, designs and develops self-healing features, and leads Disaster Recovery design and execution plans.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Strategically applies advanced problem-solving and decision-making skills to address highly complex issues spanning multiple product lines within a domain. Leads the maintenance of live services by designing metrics to measure availability, latency, and system health, and is responsible for identifying critical metrics used to establish SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Proactively plans for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance, and scalability, and leads large initiatives aimed at optimizing inter-related platforms. Accountable for availability, tuning, efficiency, change and configuration management, and emergency response.
• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates exceptional customer and delivery focus by proactively leading partnership and collaboration with developers, Managed Services suppliers, and vendors to continuously improve application development velocity and optimize services reliability. Works closely with development teams to ensure new features are rolled out with a strategic understanding of reliability. Provides direction, guidance, and priority setting, acting as a senior analyst to transform customer and developer needs into specific requirements.
• Impact/Strategy: Ensures implemented solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and is responsible for implementing and updating cost, compliance, and security best practices. Leads complex audit exercises, providing required evidence to audit teams, and leads audit remediation plans. Manages ITSM processes, challenges requirements to scale systems sustainably, and applies innovation to foster business strategy.
• Complexity/ (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse virtual teams globally, driving success across multiple product lines within a domain. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.
• Business/Technical ability: Utilizes wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing, and CI/CD tools to define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no human intervention. Implements and maintains Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and CI/CD pipelines. Applies design thinking, lean, prioritization, and agile methodologies to evo

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Für unseren Bereich Instrumental Analytics - Spectrometry and Separation Science suchen wir Dich als engagierte Persönlichkeit für eine Schlüsselrolle in unserer Forschung und Entwicklung. Der Fokus dieser Position liegt auf der Bearbeitung komplexer analytischer Fragestellungen jenseits der Routine. Als R&D Spezialist (m/w/d) HPLC bist Du maßgeblich an der Entwicklung und Optimierung robuster Methoden zur Charakterisierung chemischer und biochemischer Einsatzstoffe beteiligt. Bringe Deine exzellente Fachexpertise ein, um die hohen Qualitätsstandards unserer Diagnostik nachhaltig zu sichern und zu prägen. Das erwartet Dich in der Rolle
• Du verantwortest die Entwicklung und Optimierung neuer und bestehender Analysemethoden (HPLC, UPLC, ESI-MS).
• Planung und selbstständige Durchführung anspruchsvoller chromatographischer und spektrometrischer Analysen.
• Du bist verantwortlich für die Validierung und den Transfer der Analysenmethoden in andere Abteilungen (z.B. QC).
• Auswertung von Rohdaten, Interpretation der Ergebnisse und Erstellung aller notwendigen technischen Dokumente (Berichte, SOPs) in Deutsch und Englisch.
• Die Pflege, Wartung und das Troubleshooting der komplexen Analysegeräte fallen in deinen Aufgabenbereich.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Auftraggebern und aktive Beteiligung an der Arbeitsorganisation und den Sicherheitsfunktionen. Wer du bist
• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor, Master oder Diplom) in Chemie, Lebensmittelchemie oder Pharmazie.
• Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in der instrumentellen Analytik (mindestens 2–4 Jahre, je nach Abschluss).
• Du verfügst über fundierte theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in HPLC/UPLC/LCMS und Massenspektrometrie, insbesondere in der Methodenentwicklung.
• Vertrautheit mit Anforderungen im regulierten Umfeld (GxP) und relevanten Qualitätsrichtlinien der Pharmaindustrie sowie Prozessaffinität.
• Deine Persönlichkeit zeichnet sich durch hohe Motivation, Flexibilität, eigenständiges Arbeiten und Freude an der Teamarbeit aus.
• Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab. Diese Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet. Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Die Abteilung Pharma Technical Characterization Cell and Genetherapy (PTCG ) ist verantwortlich für die technische Entwicklung von in vivo Gentherapeutika in der präklinischen und klinischen Entwicklungsphase. Das Team Die Funktion Gentherapie-Analytik konzentriert sich auf die analytische Charakterisierung, Qualitätskontrolle sowie die Entwicklung und Implementierung neuartiger analytischer Technologien von präklinischen Studien bis zur Marktzulassung (BLA, Biologics License Application) und Markteinführung für gentherapeutische Modalitäten. Deine Aufgaben Wir suchen Dich mit speziellem Fokus auf Liquid Handling und Automation analytischer Methoden für die Testung und Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren und Plasmiden . Zudem übernimmst du Projektverantwortung für Gentherapie Portfolioprojekte in der Entwicklung.
• Automation & Innovation: Scouting, Evaluierung, Entwicklung sowie die Implementierung und routinemäßige Anwendung innovativer vollautomatisierter E2E Lösungen von Methoden für die Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren (vorwiegend rAAV) und Plasmiden.
• Portfolio Projektverantwortung: Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner in präklinischen sowie klinischen Phasen für Gentherapie Portfolioprojekte, agierst als Vertreter der Analytischen Entwicklung und Qualitätskontrolle in den Technical Development Teams (TDT) und koordinierst anstehende Aufgaben innerhalb der Teams unter Berücksichtigung der Timelines.
• Funktionelle Analyse : Vorantreiben der Technologien zur Quantifizierung und funktionellen Charakterisierung in einem hochmotivierten, agilen und interdisziplinären Team.
• Praktische Durchführung: Eigenverantwortliche, selbstorganisierte Durchführung von Experimenten, Methodenentwicklung sowie Gerätequalifizierung und Test-Validierung unter GMP-Anforderungen inklusive der Durchführung der Analysen.
• Strategische Mitwirkung: Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung und Definition von Kontroll- und Prüfstrategien für gentherapeutische Vektorenprodukte.
• Datenmanagement: Selbstständige Interpretation, Bewertung und Dokumentation von Daten sowie Erstellung von Analyseberichten gemäß den geltenden regulatorischen Vorschriften. Unser Wunschprofil
• PhD-Abschluss in Biologie, molekularbiologischen oder einer anderen einschlägigen biowissenschaftlichen Disziplin mit > 3 Jahren praktische Erfahrung mit Liquid Handling Systemen für analytische Anwendungen.
• Darüber hinaus bringst du ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Datenbanken und Datenflüsse mit sowie Grundlagen in SQL, VBA, Python oder ähnlichen Programmiersprachen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz und Fachkenntnisse (sowohl theoretisch als auch praktisch) in der Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren (AAV, Lentiviren etc.) mittels analytischer Methoden.
• Expertenwissen auf dem Gebiet der Plasmide und gentherapeutischen Modalitäten (AAV, Lentiviren, etc.)
• Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit den Grundsätzen der GMP (z.B. Datenintegrität, Gerätequalifizierung, Testvalidierung).
• Ein hohes Maß an Eigenmotivation, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Ergebnisorientierung und Teamfähigkeit.
• Fließende englische und deutsche Sprachkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift). Diese Position ist auf 2 Jahre befristet. • PhD-Abschluss in Biologie, molekularbiologischen oder einer anderen einschlägigen biowissenschaftlichen Disziplin mit > 3 Jahren praktische Erfahrung mit Liquid Handling Systemen für analytische Anwendungen.
• Darüber hinaus bringst du ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Datenbanken und Datenflüsse mit sowie Grundlagen in SQL, VBA, Python oder ähnlichen Programmiersprachen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz und Fachkenntnisse (sowohl theoretisch als auch praktisch) in der Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren (AAV, Lentiviren etc.) mittels analytischer Methoden.
• Expertenwissen auf dem Gebiet der Plasmide und gentherapeutischen Modalitäten (AAV, Lentiviren, etc.)
• Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit den Grundsätzen der GMP (z.B. Datenintegrität, Gerätequalifizierung, Testvalidierung).

• Fließende englische und deutsche Sprachkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift). Diese Position ist auf 2 Jahre befristet. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Ready to put the voice of the customer at the heart of healthcare innovation? As our new field-based Regional Customer Account Manager - South you won’t just manage a team—you will inspire a regional squad of Account Managers and Senior Account Managers to redefine the Roche customer experience. If you are a strategic commercial leader who thrives on the road, builds deep, meaningful relationships, and knows how to turn a superior customer experience into long-term business growth, we want you on our frontline. Reports to: Head of Customer Account Management Key Responsibilities
• Creates and influences account management strategies that cross organisational boundaries to achieve broad business goals
• Establishes and maintains consistent and productive relationships with customer Senior lab management and especially with the “C” suite level leadership teams
• Manages/leads critical regional support escalations, often including multiple internal and external support teams and often with visibility to internal and external leadership teams
• Leads sharing of best practices with sales & account management team community
• Leads clients to drive service performance improvements through effective long term partnerships Key Activities Customer experience management
• Manages service delivery of a team of peers and account managers, leads through influence
• Manages the delivery of recommended/agreed-upon services to achieve high customer satisfaction and trust at a regional level
• Manages a diverse and complex scope of support issues at a regional level. Solves complex support issues effectively through the internal network of Roche professionals
• Assesses customers’ risks & needs and recommends appropriate service offerings to proactively address customer issues at a regional level as well as providing input to the Access and Innovation function
• Establishes and maintains relationships with regional sales and cross functional teams to execute on a regional account plan Contract Development
• Ensures Roche and third party stakeholders understand each customer’s requirements and the pressures/opportunities they are experiencing
• Works closely with colleagues, third party partners and the customer to ensure changes in and novation to MS contracts are timely and appropriate
• Ensures all proposals meet with customer requirements and stage of the contract life cycle Key Contributions (impact of the role)
• Retains and grows customer business and profitability within the region via C suite engagement
• Increases NPS for customer satisfaction within region
• Drives ideation with innovation and business development function
• Drives service performance initiatives with internal and external stakeholders to improve processes focussed on improving customer experience Team Development

• Active performance management Decision Making Authority

• Educated to degree level or equivalent
• Full valid UK Driving License

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar, a avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y a asegurar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y para las generaciones venideras . Crear un mundo donde todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos: eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche . Como Procurement Coordinator para Roche Diagnóstica Colombia, liderarás la visión estratégica de abastecimiento para garantizar una gestión óptima del gasto . Actuarás como un socio de negocio clave, integrándote tempranamente en los procesos de planeación para entregar soluciones de compra de alta calidad que satisfagan a los interesados internos y generen valor al negocio . La Oportunidad
• Desarrollas y ejecutas planes estratégicos de abastecimiento para las principales categorías de compra en alineación con los objetivos del negocio .
• Lideras negociaciones con proveedores estratégicos, realizando análisis de mercado profundos para identificar los mejores productos y servicios .
• Gestionas el proceso integral de "Requisición a Pago" (R2P), asegurando estándares de productividad, alta calidad y tiempos de respuesta oportunos .
• Identificas y mitigas riesgos de suministro mediante el desarrollo de planes robustos de continuidad y contingencia para servicios clave .
• Garantizas el cumplimiento total de los requisitos de Compliance y Códigos de Conducta durante la precalificación y auditoría de proveedores .
• Implementas los principios de Gestión de Categorías ( CATMAN ) para apalancar la demanda y optimizar los planes anuales de licitación .
• Brindas capacitación y soporte en plataformas de compras como SAP y Smartsheet para asegurar una adopción eficiente por parte de los usuarios.
• Monitoreas los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) y reportes de ahorros para dar visibilidad a la alta gerencia en la toma de decisiones . Quién eres
• Tú cuentas con un título profesional en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas o Negocios Internacionales .
• Tú aportas más de 4 años de experiencia en roles de liderazgo o coordinación dentro de las áreas de compras, logística o mejora de procesos .
• Tú posees habilidades avanzadas de negociación y una capacidad demostrada para gestionar estrategias de categorías complejas.
• Tú demuestras fluidez en el idioma inglés (nivel avanzado) y tienes experiencia en el manejo de herramientas de MS Office y G-Suite .
• Tú te caracterizas por un pensamiento sistémico y la capacidad de alcanzar resultados a través de la colaboración transversal . Preferible
• Experiencia previa en las industrias de Diagnóstica, Tecnología o Aeronáutica .
• Conocimiento en metodologías ágiles como Scrum o Lean Management .
• Familiaridad con herramientas de Gestión de Relaciones con Proveedores (SRM) y Gestión de Riesgos . Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo. Compensation & Benefits This position also offers an attractive benefits package . Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can

The Position Technical Manager - Regional Customer Support Centre Are you looking for an exciting challenge? Are you ready to lead a specialist team in delivering world-class diagnostic support across the UK, Ireland and Northern Europe? Roche Diagnostics is looking for a Technical Manager to lead our SWA/Core Lab Hardware remote support team. Based within our Regional Customer Support Centre (RCSC) in Burgess Hill, you will be the strategic lead for a team of 16 specialists providing critical technical and systems support for the Roche Core Laboratory portfolio. The Role As Technical Manager, you will lead a team of 16 specialists who provide remote technical and systems support for the Roche Core Laboratory portfolio, alongside customer and staff training. You will be the driving force behind the team’s operational and strategic success, ensuring we deliver a "best-in-class" customer experience. You will be accountable for the successful delivery of service requirements across the UK, Ireland, Nordics and the wider EMEA-LATAM region. Key Responsibilities:
• Leadership & Coaching: Use your skills to empower your team, remove obstacles and foster high performance.
• Line Management: Drive recruitment of ideal skill sets, manage performance and take ownership of the team's professional development.
• Strategic Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Regional Service Managers to ensure the technical service offering aligns with broader business goals.
• Operational Excellence: Oversee the delivery of high-value remote support and the implementation of Roche Global standards. Location & Flexibility This is an office based role with an expectation of a minimum of 2 days a week in our office in Burgess Hill, Sussex. Who you are You are a resilient leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You don’t just manage tasks; you inspire innovation and possess a "questioning" approach that challenges the status quo to exceed customer expectations. Essential Requirements:
• Education: A degree in a relevant field OR a proven track record of technical mastery and leadership in an engineering environment.
• Experience: A minimum of 3 years experience of leading technical teams
• Technical Background: A proven track record of supporting complex healthcare instrumentation and/or deep experience within a Blood Sciences laboratory.
• Leadership: Proven experience in line management or a clear ability to demonstrate the leadership competencies required to coach and develop a high-performing team.
• Technical Proficiency: Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).
• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a matrix environment.
• IT Literacy: Strong digital skills, including Microsoft/Google Suite and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce). Investing in you Roche is a company that invests as much in its people as it does in R&D (over £6.5 billion worldwide). In addition to a competitive salary and benefits package, you will receive recognised product training and continuous support to build your knowledge and potential. • 主数据治理： 配合 ITOT 流程负责人（SME）进行系统上线前的数据清理、分类与核对，确保主数据的准确性。

• 技术支持与调查： 参与系统上线后的初期支持，协助 SME 收集 ITOT 相关的系统偏差、故障数据，并参与初步调查。 2. GMP 质量管理与技术支持 (GMP生产运营中质量合规领域)
• 偏差与变更管理： 在 SME 指导下，协助收集 GMP 偏差（Deviation）和变更（Change Control）相关的背景数据和证明文件。
• 质量文档整理： 负责 GMP 流程相关文件的更新、归档及版本控制，确保符合合规性审计要求。
• 现场调查支持： 参与生产设备或工艺偏差的现场调研，协助收集故障相关的运行参数和物料数据，并整理成报告草案。 任职资格要求： 教育背景：
• 本科或研究生在读， 制药、生物工程、自动化、信息技术、工业工程 或相关专业背景优先。 技能要求：
• 熟练使用 Office 办公软件（尤其是 Excel 的数据处理能力）。
• 具备良好的文档撰写能力，逻辑清晰。
• 对数字化系统（如 ERP, MES 等）有浓厚兴趣或初步了解。 素质要求：
• 细致严谨： 由于涉及 GMP 合规和系统主数据，需具备高度的细心和责任感。
• 沟通协作： 具备跨部门沟通的主动性，能与不同职能的 SME 高效配合。
• 快速学习： 能够快速理解复杂的业务流程和合规要求。 时间要求：
• 每周至少出勤 3-4 天，实习期 6 个月以上者优先。 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead (CVRM)

titleByLocale.it: Ricerca e valutazione China Strategy Lead (CVRM)
titleByLocale.en: Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead (CVRM)
titleByLocale.de: Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead (CVRM)
titleByLocale.fr: Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead (CVRM)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche aims to be an innovation accelerator in China, collaborating with partners to jointly develop and deliver novel therapies for patients across the world. This effort is designed to expand and deepen their collective impact on patient health. The global I2CVRM Search & Evaluation (S&E) team, a component of Corporate Business Development (CBD), is focused on identifying and securing external innovation opportunities that strategically align with the Immunology & Infectious Diseases (I2) and Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism (CVRM) Therapeutic Areas (TAs). This involves active engagement with the external innovation community, including academic institutions, venture capital firms, Roche Accelerator, KoL, PI and the startup biotech ecosystem. The S&E team works collaboratively with internal teams (e.g. Asian partnering team) to advance opportunities from initial identification and incubation through to pre-due diligence. A key function is translating the I2CVRM TA's end-to-end strategy (DAS) into regional sourcing and activation plans designed to bring high-impact science into our pipeline. We are looking to partner with pharma and biotech in China. Currently, the global I2CVRM S&E team has one Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead CVRM opportunity available in Shanghai . The Opportunity The CVRM S&E China Strategy Lead will be responsible for proactively shaping and nurturing key relationships and stakeholders (prioritized academic research centers, Roche accelerator, venture capital investors, life science and health technology incubators and start-ups) to ensure Roche is perceived as a “Partner of Choice” in their respective regions. This leader will also work closely with the global S&E I2CVRM team & local Asian partnering team, to scout, triage and conduct early evaluations activities to understand the true value of further pursuit through provision of scientific expertise. This role reports to the Global Head I2CVRM S&E who is based in Basel (CH). Responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to the following:
• External Search: to cover the China CVRM landscape, to partner closely with the Global S&E Head to set the sourcing strategy and engagement plan aligned with the TA end to end strategy & CBD priorities
• To lead the triage process and work closely with TA partners and CBD colleagues to conduct initial evaluations and ensure alignment with our strategic focus. To provide scientific thought leadership and analysis in initial scientific review.
• The S&E China CVRM Strategy Lead will maintain overall oversight of S&E CVRM activities in China, with the autonomy to delegate specific landscaping, scouting or evaluation tasks to CBD team members (e.g. BDPLs from Asia partnering team) as appropriate.
• Building close relationships with relevant Roche & Genentech businesses. This is to both understand/contribute to strategy/requirements and to develop sufficient influence in order to champion new opportunities, including those that are potentially “off strategy” but where a compelling business case can be made.
• Supports the transition of identified opportunities to the Due Diligence phase via collaboration and transfer of background and scientific context to a BDPL
• Serves as an ambassador for CBD internally and externally at industry events
• The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list, and you may be required to undertake any other reasonable duties compatible with your experience and competencies.

The Opportunity The CVRM S&E China Strategy Lead will be responsible for proactively shaping and nurturing key relationships and stakeholders (prioritized academic research centers, Roche accelerator, venture capital investors, life science and health technology incubators and start-ups) to ensure Roche is perceived as a “Partner of Choice” in their respective regions. This leader will also work closely with the global S&E I2CVRM team & local Asian partnering team, to scout, triage and conduct early evaluations activities to understand the true value of further pursuit through provision of scientific expertise. This role reports to the Global Head I2CVRM S&E who is based in Basel (CH). Responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to the following:
• External Search: to cover the China CVRM landscape, to partner closely with the Global S&E Head to set the sourcing strategy and engagement plan aligned with the TA end to end strategy & CBD priorities
• To lead the triage process and work closely with TA partners and CBD colleagues to conduct initial evaluations and ensure alignment with our strategic focus. To provide scientific thought leadership and analysis in initial scientific review.
• The S&E China CVRM Strategy Lead will maintain overall oversight of S&E CVRM activities in China, with the autonomy to delegate specific landscaping, scouting or evaluation tasks to CBD team members (e.g. BDPLs from Asia partnering team) as appropriate.
• Building close relationships with relevant Roche & Genentech businesses. This is to both understand/contribute to strategy/requirements and to develop sufficient influence in order to champion new opportunities, including those that are potentially “off strategy” but where a compelling business case can be made.
• Supports the transition of identified opportunities to the Due Diligence phase via collaboration and transfer of background and scientific context to a BDPL
• Serves as an ambassador for CBD internally and externally at industry events
• The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list, and you may be required to undertake any other reasonable duties compatible with your experience and competencies.

The Position Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任 Routine Operation:
• Perform the microbiological testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.
• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements
• Assist Head of Microbiology lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.
• Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely data to internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.
• Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.
• Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative. ● By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.
• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of microbiology supplies
• Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
• CCS Support: Support the establishment of the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) for the aseptic production line.
• Environmental Monitoring (EM): Support EMPQ execution according to the project timeline.
• Microbiology Method Validation: Support the microbiology methods transfer, including supporting the confirmation of cleaning and disinfection processes, and the efficacy of disinfectants.
• Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred ● Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and microbiological testing. ● Experienced in QC new facility startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred. ● Fluent communications skills in English ● Project management skills are preferred. The Position Key Responsibilities
• Metabolite Profiling & Identification: Conduct in vitro (e.g. microsomes, hepatocytes, S9, lysosome) and in vivo (e.g. plasma, urine, feces, bile, tumor tissue) metabolite identification studies across various species.
• Mass Spectrometry Lead: Operate, troubleshoot, and maintain advanced LC-HRMS instrumentation (e.g., Orbitrap or Q-TOF).
• Structural Elucidation: Interpret complex MS/MS fragmentation patterns to propose accurate chemical structures for metabolites.
• Pathway Mapping: Propose biotransformation pathways and identify potential "soft spots" in chemical leads to guide medicinal chemistry efforts.
• Reactive Metabolite Screening: Design and execute glutathione (GSH) trapping assays to assess potential idiosyncratic toxicity risks.
• Regulatory & Reporting: Oversee and manage CRO partnerships to ensure the delivery of high-quality technical reports; provide expert MetID authorship and scientific review for IND/NDA regulatory filings.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Medicinal Chemistry, DMPK/PD Lead, and Clinical Pharmacology lead to communicate the impact of metabolic data on project strategy. Qualifications & Skills
• Educational Background: Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, or related, with 4+ years of experience; or an MS with 8+ years of dedicated industry experience in small molecules and/or ADC DMPK.
• Technical Expertise: Proven mastery of liquid chromatography and high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS) for structure elucidation.
• Biotransformation Expertise: Demonstrates a mastery of Phase I/II biotransformation pathways with the ability to translate in vitro metabolic data into predictive in vivo outcomes; experience navigating the unique MetID challenges of Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs) is a significant plus.
• Soft Skills: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to "distill the essence" of complex data for stakeholders at all levels. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position The application specialist is responsible for responding to customers’ needs and expectations with high quality scientific answers, to contribute to customer long term loyalty, ensuring immediate and proper scientific support to customers (incl. providing instrument training and troubleshooting, settlement of scientific problems and timely update on new methods, techniques and Product Bulletins), and documenting all calls, activities on the CRM System. This is a field-based role. Key Responsibilities:
• Provide high-level scientific support and operator training to customers.
• Handle all calls received from customers that relate to CPS and troubleshoot them to provide instant solutions to reagent and software problems due to customer complaints.
• Escalate unsolved cases to 2nd level support CIR, and/or GCS with complete case explanation.
• Ensure follow-up until the issue has been resolved and the customer is satisfied.
• Provide scientific documentation to customers.
• Document all his activities in Rexis/Lightning/ NFSS.
• Deliver best in class support utilizing appropriate systems and processes and providing a consistent and high level of support to customers.
• Continuing development of application skills to ensure resilience in the support of all CPS products.
• Proactively propose and implement activities aligned with customer satisfaction surveys and on-going customer and business area feedback.
• Ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner and guarantee the activity reporting at the CRM (Rexis) software and appropriate escalation of product issues to management center and ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner. Who you are:
• B.S. Medical Laboratory Sciences, Chemistry, Histopathology, Biology or Biochemistry or work-related experience.
• Good knowledge and experience in pathology solutions - an advantage.
• Fluent in English (oral and written).
• Technical vocabulary & terminology.
• Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).
• Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).
• Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.
• Verbal and written communication skills.
• Planning, administration and decision making.
• Work well in a team environment.
• Service/Customer oriented.
• Creativity & well critical thinking with a proactive mindset. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate.
