descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione A Roche/Genentech, abbiamo un audace Pharma Ambition per fornire 20 farmaci trasformativi che affrontano le malattie con il più alto peso sociale entro il 2030. All'interno di Portfolio Strategy & Management (PSM), portiamo questa Ambition alla vita guidando decisioni di alta qualità per modellare il nostro portafoglio. Vogliamo che ti unisca alla nostra visione e faccia parte del nostro team PSM appassionato, collaborativo e globale! Siamo un team forte, molto attento e fiducioso che opera da una mentalità creativa. Proviamo le cose, discutere apertamente e imparare da errori e fallimento, sperimentare e iterare per raggiungere le nostre aspirazioni. Siamo il luogo in cui il talento cresce e contribuisce; il nostro talento si sente prezioso, connesso, e un senso di appartenenza a qualcosa di impatto. Abbiamo un alto impatto; le parti interessate si affidano alla nostra competenza per aiutare a gestire attivamente il nostro portafoglio al fine di soddisfare il nostro ambiente Pharma. L'opportunità: Come Leader Portfolio, Oncology ti concentrerai sulla creazione della Strategia Portfolio e sulla gestione del portafoglio dell'Area Terapeutica Oncologia. Si prevede di collaborare a stretto contatto con i colleghi in gruppi oltre PSM (ad esempio, Global Product Strategy, PD Functions, altri gruppi Portfolio in Roche, Program Management, Finance, gRED, pRED, Chugai) nel vostro lavoro quotidiano. Le capacità di contabilità includono, ma non sono limitate, una combinazione delle seguenti aree:
• Sviluppo della strategia di Portfolio Area terapeutica - Partner delle testate di area PD & GPS e di altri leader farmaceutici (membri di LLSPC, Teste di Franchise PD & GPS, Leader di area terapeutica di PRED & GRED, Leader di LifeCycle) per co-creare e fornire robuste strategie di portafoglio Oncology che forniscono il ponteggio per le decisioni di molecole
• Therapeutic Area Portfolio Management - Gestire attivamente il portafoglio Oncology con una mentalità aziendale, fornendo informazioni di portafoglio attuabili basate sui dati che contestualizzare le singole molecole e le decisioni di progetto all'interno dell'Area Terapeutica, Late Stage, così come le priorità del portafoglio Pharma. Collaborare a stretto contatto con il Team di Governance del Piano Ultimo nell'attuazione del processo di governance nell'impostazione Area terapeutica, oltre a consentire lo sviluppo e le recensioni aziendali in anticipo delle decisioni di investimento del portafoglio.
• Decision Support and Valuation - Serve come partner di pensiero attivo ai decisori e mentore a Portfolio Leads per aree tra cui, ma non solo per definire/scoping di tattiche per fornire su strategie di portafoglio definite; competenze di contenuto per sviluppare opzioni e valutazioni strategiche; analisi di trade-off e/o inquadramento decisionale compreso il contesto di portafoglio. Servire come critico obiettivo e esperto a Boards quando invitato, concentrandosi su opzioni strategiche, analisi di trade-off e valutazione
• Valutazioni e presentazioni del portafoglio - Comprendere e comunicare dinamiche del portafoglio (rischio, valore, mix, posizionamento competitivo ecc) presso l'Area Terapeutica, Late Stage, così come i livelli di Pharma per influenzare le decisioni del portafoglio.
• Supporterete attivamente e modellate il flusso di talento per lavorare con il massimo impatto su PSM e la più ampia comunità di portafoglio tra le unità R&D per offrire un maggior beneficio ai pazienti. Chi sei? Sei un individuo di talento e appassionato, guidato dal nostro comune scopo di co-creare e fornire il portafoglio a beneficio dei pazienti. Porti il seguente background ed esperienza:
• Laurea in scienze, business, ingegneria, o un campo relativo. Grado avanzato e/o certificazione (ad esempio MBA, PhD, PharmD, MS, MPH) preferito.
• Esperienza nella leadership multifunzionale matrice
• Eccellente capacità interpersonali, tra cui comunicazione chiara, succinta e tempestiva, comprovata capacità di costruire relazioni di fiducia con e influenzare gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli.
• Forte comprensione dello sviluppo della droga, insieme con la pianificazione e le competenze organizzative.
• Partenariato di pensiero dimostrata e/o capacità di influenzare i Leader senior su argomenti complessi, tra cui il inquadramento, il supporto decisionale e l'analisi delle opzioni.
• Esperienza
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Position At Roche/Genentech, we have a bold Pharma Ambition to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2030. Within Portfolio Strategy & Management (PSM), we bring this Ambition to life by driving high quality decisions to shape our portfolio. We want you to join our vision and be part of our passionate, collaborative, global PSM team! We are a strong, closely-knit, trusting team that operates from a creative mindset. We try things, openly discuss and learn from mistakes and failure, experiment and iterate to achieve our aspirations. We are THE place for talent to grow and contribute; our talent feels valued, connected, and a sense of belonging to something impactful. We have high impact; stakeholders rely on our expertise to help actively manage our portfolio in order to meet our Pharma Ambition. The Opportunity: As Portfolio Leader, Oncology you will focus on co-creating the Portfolio Strategy and managing the portfolio of the Oncology Therapeutic Area. You will be expected to closely collaborate with colleagues in groups beyond PSM (e.g., Global Product Strategy, PD Functions, other Portfolio groups in Roche, Program Management, Finance, gRED, pRED, Chugai) in your day to day work. Accountabilities include, but are not limited to, a combination of the following areas:
• Therapeutic Area Portfolio Strategy development - Partner with PD & GPS Therapeutic Area Heads and other Pharma Leaders (LSPC members, PD & GPS Franchise Heads, pRED & gRED Therapeutic Area Leaders, LifeCycle Leaders) to co-create and deliver robust Oncology portfolio strategies that provide the scaffolding for molecule decisions
• Therapeutic Area Portfolio Management - Actively manage the Oncology portfolio with an enterprise mindset, providing data-driven actionable portfolio insights that contextualize individual molecule and project decisions within the Therapeutic Area, Late Stage, as well as Pharma portfolio priorities. Collaborate closely with the Late Stage Governance Team in implementing the governance process at the Therapeutic Area setting, as well as enabling development and business reviews in advance of portfolio investment decisions.
• Decision Support and Valuation - Serve as an active thought partner to decision-makers and mentor to Portfolio Leads for areas including, but not limited to defining/scoping of tactics to deliver on defined portfolio strategies; content expertise to develop strategic options and valuations; trade-off analysis, and/or decision framing including portfolio context. Serve as an objective and expert reviewer at Boards when invited, focusing on strategic options, trade-off analyses, and valuation
• Portfolio assessments and presentations - Understand and communicate portfolio dynamics (risk, value, mix, competitive positioning etc) at the Therapeutic Area, Late Stage, as well as Pharma levels to influence portfolio decisions.
• You will actively support and model talent flow to work with the highest impact across PSM as well as the broader portfolio community across R&D units to deliver more patient benefit. Who You Are: You are a talented and passionate individual, driven by our shared purpose of co-creating and delivering the portfolio for the benefit of patients. You bring the following background and experience:
• Bachelor's degree in science, business, engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree and/or certification (e.g. MBA, PhD, PharmD, MS, MPH) preferred.
• Experience in matrix cross-functional leadership
• Excellent interpersonal skills, including clear, succinct and timely communication, proven ability to build trusting relationships with and influence stakeholders at all levels.
• Strong drug development understanding, along with planning and organizational skills.
• Demonstrated thought partnership and/or ability to influence Senior Leaders on complex topics, including framing, decision support, and options analysis.
• Experience
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Position Bei Roche/Genentech haben wir eine mutige Pharma Ambition, 20 transformative Medikamente zu liefern, die Krankheiten mit der höchsten gesellschaftlichen Belastung bis 2030 behandeln. Innerhalb von Portfolio Strategy & Management (PSM) bringen wir diese Ambition zum Leben, indem wir qualitativ hochwertige Entscheidungen treffen, um unser Portfolio zu gestalten. Wir wollen, dass Sie sich unserer Vision anschließen und Teil unseres leidenschaftlichen, kollaborativen, globalen PSM-Teams sein! Wir sind ein starkes, enges und vertrauensvolles Team, das von einem kreativen Geist arbeitet. Wir versuchen Dinge, diskutieren offen und lernen von Fehlern und Fehlern, Experimenten und Iterate, um unsere Ziele zu erreichen. Wir sind der Ort für Talente zu wachsen und zu beitragen; unser Talent fühlt sich geschätzt, verbunden, und ein Gefühl von Zugehörigkeit zu etwas wirkungsvoll. Wir haben hohe Auswirkungen; Interessenvertreter verlassen sich auf unser Know-how, um unser Portfolio aktiv zu verwalten, um unsere Pharma Ambition zu erfüllen. Die Gelegenheit: Als Portfolio Leader, Onkologie, konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Ko-Erstellung der Portfolio-Strategie und das Management des Portfolios der Onkologie Therapeutic Area. Sie werden erwartet, dass Sie mit Kollegen in Gruppen außerhalb von PSM (z.B. Global Product Strategy, PD Functions, andere Portfolio-Gruppen in Roche, Program Management, Finance, gRED, pRED, Chugai) in Ihrer täglichen Arbeit eng zusammenarbeiten. Die Rechenschaftspflichten umfassen eine Kombination aus folgenden Bereichen:
• Therapeutic Area Portfolio Strategy Development - Partner mit PD & GPS Therapeutic Area Heads und anderen Pharma Leaders (LSPC-Mitglieder, PD & GPS Franchise Heads, pRED & gRED Therapeutic Area Leaders, LifeCycle Leaders) zur Ko-Kreation und Bereitstellung robuster Oncology Portfolio-Strategien, die das Gerüst für Molekülentscheidungen bieten
• Therapeutic Area Portfolio Management - Das Onkologie-Portfolio aktiv mit einem Enterprise Mindset verwalten und datengesteuerte actionfähige Portfolio-Einsichten bereitstellen, die individuelle Molekül- und Projektentscheidungen im Therapeutic Area, Late Stage sowie Pharma-Portfolio-Prioritäten kontextualisieren. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Late Stage Governance Team bei der Umsetzung des Governance-Prozesses in der Therapeutic Area-Einstellung sowie der Ermöglichung von Entwicklungs- und Business-Reviews im Vorfeld von Portfolio-Investitionsentscheidungen.
• Entscheidungsunterstützung und -validierung - Als aktiver Denkpartner für Entscheidungsträger und Mentor zu Portfolio Leads für Bereiche, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf die Festlegung von Taktiken, um bestimmte Portfoliostrategien zu liefern; Content-Expertise zur Entwicklung strategischer Optionen und Bewertungen; Trade-off-Analyse und/oder Entscheidungsfindung einschließlich Portfolio-Kontext. Besuchen Sie als objektiver und kompetenter Reviewer bei Boards, der sich auf strategische Optionen, Trade-off-Analysen und Bewertung konzentriert
• Portfolio-Bewertungen und Präsentationen - Verstehen und kommunizieren Portfolio-Dynamik (Risiko, Wert, Mix, Wettbewerbspositionierung usw.) auf Therapeutic Area, Late Stage sowie Pharma-Ebenen, um Portfolioentscheidungen zu beeinflussen.
• Sie werden den Talentfluss aktiv unterstützen und modellieren, um mit den höchsten Auswirkungen auf PSM sowie der breiteren Portfolio-Community über R&D-Einheiten zu arbeiten, um mehr Patientennutzen zu bieten. Wer sind Sie? Sie sind ein talentiertes und leidenschaftliches Individuum, das von unserem gemeinsamen Zweck angetrieben wird, das Portfolio zu Gunsten der Patienten zu erstellen und zu liefern. Sie bringen den folgenden Hintergrund und die Erfahrung:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich. Advanced Grad und/oder Zertifizierung (z.B. MBA, PhD, PharmD, MS, MPH) bevorzugt.
• Erfahrung in der Matrix-übergreifenden Führung
• Ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, einschließlich klarer, schlanker und zeitnaher Kommunikation, bewährte Fähigkeit, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen mit und Einfluss auf alle Ebenen aufzubauen.
• Starkes Verständnis der Drogenentwicklung, zusammen mit Planung und organisatorischen Fähigkeiten.
• Demonstrierte Gedankenpartnerschaft und/oder Fähigkeit, Senior Leaders auf komplexe Themen zu beeinflussen, einschließlich Friaming, Entscheidungsunterstützung und Optionen Analyse.
• Erfahrung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
La position Chez Roche/Genentech, nous avons une ambition Pharma audacieuse pour fournir 20 médicaments transformatifs qui s'attaquent aux maladies qui ont le fardeau sociétal le plus élevé d'ici 2030. Au sein de Portfolio Strategy & Management (PSM), nous donnons vie à cette ambition en prenant des décisions de haute qualité pour façonner notre portefeuille. Nous voulons que vous rejoigniez notre vision et participiez à notre équipe de PSM passionnée, collaborative et mondiale ! Nous sommes une équipe forte, étroite, confiante qui fonctionne à partir d'un état d'esprit créatif. Nous essayons des choses, discutons ouvertement et apprenons d'erreurs et d'échecs, expérimentons et itérer pour réaliser nos aspirations. Nous sommes LE lieu où les talents grandissent et contribuent; notre talent se sent valorisé, connecté, et un sentiment d'appartenance à quelque chose d'influant. Nous avons un impact important; les intervenants comptent sur notre expertise pour aider à gérer activement notre portefeuille afin de rencontrer notre Ambition Pharma. L'occasion : En tant que chef de portefeuille, Oncologie, vous vous concentrerez sur la co-création de la stratégie du portefeuille et la gestion du portefeuille du domaine thérapeutique Oncologie. On s'attend à ce que vous collaboriez étroitement avec des collègues de groupes autres que PSM (p. ex., Global Product Strategy, PD Functions, autres groupes de portefeuille à Roche, Program Management, Finance, gRED, pRED, Chugai) dans votre travail quotidien. Les responsabilités comprennent, sans s'y limiter, une combinaison des domaines suivants :
• Élaboration de la stratégie du portefeuille des secteurs thérapeutiques - Partenaire avec les chefs des secteurs thérapeutiques PD et GPS et d'autres leaders pharmaceutiques (membres du CPS, chefs des secteurs pharmaceutiques PD et GPS, chefs des secteurs thérapeutiques pRED et gRED, chefs des cycles de vie) pour créer et fournir des stratégies robustes du portefeuille des Oncologies qui fournissent l'échafaudage pour les décisions relatives aux molécules
• Gestion du portefeuille des secteurs thérapeutiques - Gérer activement le portefeuille des Oncologies avec un état d'esprit d'entreprise, en fournissant des renseignements concrets sur le portefeuille des données qui contextualisent les décisions individuelles relatives aux molécules et aux projets dans le domaine thérapeutique, à la fin de l'étape, ainsi que les priorités du portefeuille des pharmaciens. Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe de gouvernance en retard à la mise en oeuvre du processus de gouvernance dans le domaine thérapeutique, et permettre le développement et l'examen des activités avant les décisions d'investissement de portefeuille.
• Appui à la décision et évaluation - Servir de partenaire de réflexion actif pour les décideurs et de mentor pour les chefs de portefeuille dans des domaines tels que, mais sans s'y limiter, la définition et l'établissement de la portée des tactiques visant à mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de portefeuille définies; l'expertise en matière de contenu pour élaborer des options et des évaluations stratégiques; l'analyse comparative et/ou l'élaboration de décisions, y compris le contexte du portefeuille. Servir d'évaluateur objectif et expert aux conseils d'administration lorsqu'ils sont invités, en mettant l'accent sur les options stratégiques, les analyses de compromis et l'évaluation.
• Évaluations et présentations de portefeuille - Comprendre et communiquer la dynamique de portefeuille (risque, valeur, mélange, positionnement concurrentiel, etc.) dans le domaine thérapeutique, au stade avancé, ainsi que les niveaux de pharmacie pour influencer les décisions de portefeuille.
• Vous soutiendrez activement et modéliserez le flux de talents pour travailler avec le plus grand impact dans l'ensemble des PSM ainsi que dans l'ensemble du portefeuille des unités de R-D afin d'offrir davantage d'avantages aux patients. Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un individu talentueux et passionné, animé par notre objectif commun de co-créer et de fournir le portefeuille au bénéfice des patients. Vous apportez la formation et l'expérience suivantes:
• Baccalauréat en sciences, affaires, ingénierie, ou un domaine connexe. Diplôme avancé et/ou certification (p. ex. MBA, PhD, PharmD, MS, MPH) préféré.
• Expérience du leadership matriciel interfonctionnel
• Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles, y compris une communication claire, succincte et opportune, une capacité prouvée de construire des relations de confiance avec les parties prenantes et d'influencer celles-ci à tous les niveaux.
• Une bonne compréhension du développement de la drogue, ainsi que des compétences en matière de planification et d'organisation.
• Partenariat de réflexion démontré et/ou capacité d'influencer les cadres supérieurs sur des sujets complexes, y compris l'élaboration, l'aide à la décision et l'analyse des options.
• Expérience

titleByLocale.en: Head of Direct Materials - Global Procurement

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'assistenza sanitaria si sta evolvendo e Global Procurement risponde continuando ad impegnarsi per le più alte prestazioni possibili, adottando approcci innovativi e strategici per le partnership tra imprese e fornitori. Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. La capacità di Delivery (Category) copre le attività principali di approvvigionamento da gestione di categoria, approvvigionamento strategico e operativo, gestione dei fornitori, contrazione, definizione di strategia di contenuto ed esecuzione. La capacità di consegna (categoria) comprende molte comunità che raggruppano le categorie della stessa catena di valore o che hanno la comunitÃ . descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte del mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in medicina. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Il gruppo Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione di potere traduzione, migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerare lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. PS supporta la scoperta e lo sviluppo di tutta la catena del valore dalla valutazione dell'obiettivo al mercato e oltre. L'opportunità Come parte del capitolo Traduzionale DMPK-PD e Farmacologia Clinica, vi concentrerete sulla fornitura del farmaco giusto alla dose giusta per i pazienti in modo sicuro con un vantaggio efficace. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con le aree terapeutiche per convertire le ipotesi in farmaci innovativi, guidando strategie noncliniche per portare avanti i migliori candidati clinici per specifiche indicazioni. I vostri impatti e responsabilità:
• Strategia & Design: strategie di progettazione e ottimizzazione dei farmaci di piombo e profilazione dei composti per tutti gli aspetti del metabolismo e della farmacocinetica (DMPK), con un forte focus sui concetti di convalida della biologia di destinazione e di convalida traduttiva PK/Pharmacodinamica (PD).
• Valutazione traduttiva: fornire supporto ai team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione di destinazione attraverso l'applicazione di considerazioni biochimiche e farmacologiche.
• Modeling & Simulation (M&S): Eseguire attività M&S fondamentali, tra cui PKPD, Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), e predizione dose/regimen umano, per fornire un supporto essenziale per progetti che spaziano dall'ottimizzazione del piombo (LO) all'ingresso nell'uomo (EIH).
• Supporto normativo: Preparare e fornire valutazioni scientifiche di alta qualità di informazioni DMPK non cliniche per le recensioni dei programmi interni e le sottomissioni normative esterne (ad esempio, Investigational New Drug (IND), Brochure dell'investigatore (IB), Applicazione clinica di prova (CTA), Nuova applicazione della droga (NDA), Applicazione della licenza di Biologics (BLA)).
• Attuazione: implementazione di biomarcatori e strategie bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con partner chiave per garantire la sicurezza dei pazienti e il raggiungimento di un significativo beneficio terapeutico.
• Collaborazione: Facilitare processi decisionali trasparenti e basati sui dati all'interno di team e team di progetto, coltivando e mantenendo relazioni professionali affidabili con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. Si prega di notare che questa posizione è un contratto temporaneo di 2 anni. Chi sei
• Hai un PharmD o un PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia o Bioingegneria, abbinato a oltre 5 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico.
• Possiedi profonda esperienza nella scoperta, caratterizzazione precoce PK, distribuzione e PKPD attraverso varie modalità, sostenuta da una solida base in farmacologia e fisiologia.
• Lei dimostra esperienza pratica con la modellazione e la simulazione, la competenza nell'applicazione dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) Machine Learning (ML) alla strategia DMPK, e un forte impulso a strumenti master come Phoenix, Ber
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. pRED's Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) group enables discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. PS supports discovery and development across the whole value chain from target assessment to on-market and beyond. The Opportunity As part of the Translational DMPK-PD and Clinical Pharmacology chapter, you will focus on providing the right drug at the right dose to patients safely with an efficacious benefit. You will collaborate closely with therapeutic areas to convert hypotheses into innovative medicines, driving nonclinical strategies to bring forward the best clinical candidates for specific indications. Your Impact & Responsibilities:
• Strategy & Design: Lead drug design and optimization strategies and compound profiling for all Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) aspects, with a strong focus on target biology validation and translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) concepts.
• Translational Evaluation: Provide support to early discovery teams in the development of translational strategies for the clinical evaluation of target modulation through the application of biochemical and pharmacological considerations.
• Modeling & Simulation (M&S): Execute fundamental M&S activities, including PKPD, Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), and human dose/regimen prediction, to provide essential support for projects spanning from Lead Optimization (LO) through Entry into Human (EIH).
• Regulatory Support: Prepare and deliver high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK information for internal program reviews and external regulatory submissions (e.g., Investigational New Drug (IND), Investigator's Brochure (IB), Clinical Trial Application (CTA), New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA)).
• Implementation: Implement biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close collaboration with key partners to ensure both patient safety and the achievement of meaningful therapeutic benefit.
• Collaboration: Facilitate transparent, data-driven decision-making processes within project teams and squads while cultivating and maintaining trustful professional relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. Please note that this position is a 2-year temporary contract. Who you are
• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, or Bioengineering, paired with over 5 years of industry experience in a pharmacokinetic-related field.
• You possess deep expertise in discovery, early PK characterization, distribution, and PKPD across various modalities, backed by a solid foundation in pharmacology and physiology.
• You demonstrate hands-on experience with modeling and simulation, proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) Machine Learning (ML) to DMPK strategy, and a strong drive to master tools like Phoenix, Ber

Ihre Auswirkungen und Aufgaben:

• Translational Evaluation: Unterstützung von Früherkennungsteams bei der Entwicklung von Translationsstrategien zur klinischen Bewertung der Zielmodulation durch Anwendung biochemischer und pharmakologischer Überlegungen.
• Modellierung und Simulation (M&S): Durchführung grundlegender M&S-Aktivitäten, einschließlich PKPD, Physiologisch-basierter Pharmakokinetik (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI) und menschlicher Dosis/Regimen-Vorhersage, um wesentliche Unterstützung für Projekte von Lead Optimization (LO) durch Entry into Human (EIH) bereitzustellen.
• Regulatorische Unterstützung: Bereiten und liefern qualitativ hochwertige wissenschaftliche Bewertungen von nicht-klinischen DMPK-Informationen für interne Programmbewertungen und externe regulatorische Einreichungen (z.B. Investigational New Drug (IND), Investigator's Brochure (IB), Clinical Trial Application (CTA), New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA)).
• Umsetzung: Biomarker- und bioanalytische Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Schlüsselpartnern implementieren, um sowohl die Patientensicherheit als auch die Erzielung sinnvoller therapeutischer Vorteile zu gewährleisten.
• Zusammenarbeit: Erleichterung transparenter, datengesteuerter Entscheidungsprozesse innerhalb von Projektteams und Teams bei gleichzeitiger Kultivierung und Aufrechterhaltung vertrauensvoller Berufsbeziehungen mit internen und externen Akteuren. Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Position ein 2-jähriger befristeter Vertrag ist. Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Doktortitel oder Doktortitel in Pharmazie, Pharmakologie oder Bioengineering, gepaart mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie in einem pharmakokinetischen Bereich.
• Sie verfügen über fundiertes Know-how in der Entdeckung, frühe PK-Zeichen, Verteilung und PKPD über verschiedene Modalitäten, unterstützt durch eine solide Grundlage in der Pharmakologie und Physiologie.
• Sie zeigen praktische Erfahrungen mit Modellierung und Simulation, Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) Machine Learning (ML) auf DMPK-Strategie und einen starken Antrieb für Master-Tools wie Phoenix, Ber

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (PRED) , nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Chez PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médecine. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le groupe des Sciences Pharmaceutiques (PS) de pRED permet de découvrir et de développer des traitements sûrs et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées, avec une vision pour la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. SP appuie la découverte et le développement dans l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au marché et au-delà. L'opportunité Dans le cadre du chapitre sur la DMPK-PD et la pharmacologie clinique, vous vous concentrerez sur la fourniture du bon médicament à la bonne dose aux patients en toute sécurité avec un bénéfice efficace. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les domaines thérapeutiques pour convertir les hypothèses en médicaments innovants, en conduisant des stratégies non cliniques pour présenter les meilleurs candidats cliniques pour des indications spécifiques. Votre impact et vos responsabilités :
• Stratégie et conception : Les stratégies de conception et d'optimisation des médicaments et le profilage des composés pour tous les aspects du métabolisme et de la pharmacocinétique des médicaments (DMPK), l'accent étant mis sur la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts de PK/Pharmacodynamique translationnelle (PD).
• Évaluation translationnelle: fournir un soutien aux équipes de découverte précoce dans l'élaboration de stratégies translationnelles pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible par l'application de considérations biochimiques et pharmacologiques.
• Modélisation et simulation (M&S): Exécuter des activités fondamentales de M&S, y compris la PKPD, la Pharmacocinétique physiologique (PBPK), l'interaction médicament-drogue (DDI) et la prédiction de la dose humaine/régime, afin de fournir un soutien essentiel aux projets allant de l'optimisation du plomb (OL) à l'entrée dans l'humain (EIH).
• Soutien réglementaire : Préparer et fournir des évaluations scientifiques de haute qualité de l'information DMPK non clinique pour les examens internes des programmes et les présentations de règlements externes (p. ex., les nouveaux médicaments expérimentaux (IND), la brochure de l'enquêteur (IB), la demande d'essai clinique (CTA), la demande de drogue nouvelle (NDA), la demande de licence de produits biologiques (BLA).
• Mise en oeuvre : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de biomarqueur et de bioanalyse en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires clés afin d'assurer à la fois la sécurité des patients et l'obtention d'avantages thérapeutiques significatifs.
• Collaboration : Faciliter des processus décisionnels transparents et axés sur les données au sein des équipes et des équipes de projet tout en cultivant et en maintenant des relations professionnelles de confiance avec les parties prenantes internes et externes. Veuillez noter que ce poste est un contrat temporaire de 2 ans. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie ou bioingénierie, jumelé à plus de 5 ans d'expérience industrielle dans un domaine lié à la pharmacocinétique.
• Vous disposez d'une expertise approfondie en découverte, caractérisation précoce de la PK, distribution et PKPD sur différentes modalités, soutenue par une base solide en pharmacologie et en physiologie.
• Vous démontrez l'expérience pratique de la modélisation et de la simulation, la compétence dans l'application de l'intelligence artificielle (AI) Machine Learning (ML) à la stratégie DMPK, et une forte volonté de maîtriser des outils comme Phoenix, Ber

titleByLocale.it: Piombo di Oncologia e Neurologia Medica & Access

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Planear y liderar la implementación de estrategias de educación médica y de acceso al sistema sanitario para el área de Oncología y Neurología, impulsando el reembolso y la adopción médica de la tecnología diagnóstica. Generar proyectos, establecer y mantener una relación de estrecho contacto académico, profesionales de la salud y tomadores de decisión, en todo el país, con el objeto de facilitar el acceso de los pacientes y la diseminación de evidencia relacionada con las áreas diagnósticas de Oncología y Neurología. Ser punto de contacto para resolver dudas de la comunidad médica y científica que requieran de información sustentada en evidencia, mediante el desarrollo e implementación de programas educativos específicos y medibles. Ser parte de un equipo estratégico para el desarrollo de planes que mejoren la penetración al sistema de salud de los productos de Alto Valor Médico. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Diseñar y ejecutar, junto a las Unidades de Negocio, estrategias de acceso y educación médica en Oncología y Neurología, liderando su implementación en centros estratégicos a nivel nacional.
• Liderar la generación y diseminación de evidencia médico-científica en entornos remotos y presenciales hacia profesionales de la salud, investigadores y tomadores de decisión, asegurando un enfoque no promocional y cumplimiento regulatorio.
• Construir relaciones estratégicas de largo plazo con la comunidad médica y stakeholders clave, identificando oportunidades de colaboración, investigación y co-creación de soluciones innovadoras que mejoren resultados en pacientes y optimicen costos del sistema de salud.
• Impulsar la generación de evidencia clínica y económica local, liderando actividades educativas, presentaciones científicas y proyectos multidisciplinarios, asegurando alineación con estándares de compliance, políticas internas y normativas vigentes. Tu Perfil:
• Título universitario en el área de la salud.
• Deseable posgrado, maestría o PhD en Administración y Gestión en Salud, Economía de la Salud o Salud Pública.
• Experiencia en el sector salud público o privado, ya sea en prestadores de salud o proveedores de tecnologías sanitarias.
• Nivel de inglés intermedio y deseable experiencia en metodologías ágiles. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position F ield Application Specialist (Molecular Biology & Pathology) – Castilla y León ¿Te apasiona la intersección entre la ciencia de vanguardia y la tecnología de diagnóstico? En Roche, no solo trabajamos; somos pioneros en biotecnología para mejorar la salud y el bienestar en todo el mundo. Buscamos un Field Application Specialist con base en Valladolid (valorando otras zonas de Castilla y León) para liderar nuestras líneas de Biología Molecular y Anatomía Patológica . Tu Misión: Transformar el Diagnóstico Tu rol será el motor que garantice que nuestras soluciones operen con la máxima excelencia. Serás el referente científico y técnico para nuestros clientes, asegurando que cada sistema instalado se convierta en una ventaja competitiva que mejore la vida de los pacientes. ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?
• Excelencia Operativa: Ejecutarás instalaciones, configuraciones y mantenimientos (preventivos y correctivos) de nuestros analizadores y software.
• Empoderamiento del Cliente: Capacitarás y entrenarás a los usuarios en el manejo de soluciones de alta tecnología.
• Consultoría Científica: Proporcionarás información técnica profunda y apoyo en la implementación de nuevos protocolos y controles de calidad.
• Socio Estratégico: Colaborarás estrechamente con el equipo de Ventas y Marketing para identificar necesidades y respaldar nuevas oportunidades comerciales.
• Gestión Digital: Reportarás tu actividad en CRM, asegurando que toda la documentación técnica esté siempre al día y bajo los más altos estándares. ¿Quién eres?
• Formación: Grado en Ciencias de la Salud (Biología, Biomedicina, Biotecnología o similar) o Ingeniería.
• Experiencia: Se valorará muy positivamente contar con experiencia previa en el sector del diagnóstico in vitro o laboratorios clínicos , así como conocimiento en flujos de trabajo automatizados.
• Especialización: Conocimiento o especialización en Biología Molecular y/o Anatomía Patológica .
• Idiomas: Nivel fluido de español e inglés (capacidad para interactuar con referentes globales).
• Habilidades: Eres una persona curiosa, con gran capacidad de comunicación, liderazgo y una clara vocación de servicio al cliente.
• Movilidad: Tienes carnet de conducir B1 y disponibilidad para viajar por el territorio nacional e internacional cuando sea necesario.
• Residencia: Preferiblemente en Valladolid u otras zonas de Castilla y León. ¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Impacto Real: Participar en un proyecto donde tu trabajo mejora directamente la calidad de las decisiones clínicas.
• Entorno de Innovación: Trabajar con la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector.
• Crecimiento Profesional: Desarrollo continuo en una empresa líder, con un entorno de trabajo inclusivo, colaborativo y dinámico .

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como Especialista de Dados em Supply Chain, você terá a oportunidade de transformar dados em inteligência estratégica para otimizar a Cadeia Logística da Roche Diagnóstica Brasil. Seu foco está em elevar a experiência do cliente e maximizar a rentabilidade através de decisões fundamentadas. Você será responsável por promover a cultura de dados utilizando desde soluções analíticas clássicas até Advanced Analytics , atuando como um facilitador para parceiros de negócios na identificação de casos de uso de alto impacto. Você é um agente ativo na transformação digital da companhia, convergindo tecnologia e logística para atender às demandas do cliente. Sobre a oportunidade:
• Supervisão de KPIs, metas e governança de dados para o chapter de Supply Chain, garantindo a integridade dos cálculos.
• Atuação como parceiro estratégico de stakeholders, direcionando soluções de dados alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio.
• Gestão de Produtos de Dados através da manutenção e otimização contínua das ferramentas e produtos de dados da área.
• Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards de visualização para suporte à tomada de decisão.
• Automação através da criação de bots e scripts para extração automatizada de dados em diversas plataformas e sistemas.
• Engenharia de Dados (ETL): Desenho e gerenciamento de rotinas de estruturação, movimentação e organização de dados.
• Mapeamento de fluxos de informação para erradicar tarefas manuais e maximizar o uso de recursos nativos.
• Liderança de projetos do subchapter de Supply Chain Excellence, apoiando a governança e a excelência operacional. Quem você é:
• Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Física, Matemática ou similares.
• Experiência relevante em Análise de Dados, administração e manutenção de bancos de dados, aliadas ao desenho de fluxo de informações e processos.
• Proficiente no desenvolvimento de scripts e uso de linguagem de programação.
• Experiência com uso de linguagem de programação para banco de dados e automações, como Python, SQL ou similares.
• Experiência em uso de ferramentas de visualização como Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio ou similares.
• Desejável experiência com fluxos e conteúdos ligados a operações logísticas, manufaturas e/ou supply chain.
• Inglês avançado
• Disponibilidade para atuar com base na zona sul de São Paulo no modelo híbrido (3x escritório) Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. Purpose: As the FEP Lead, you will bridge the gap between commercial strategy and financial expertise. Your mission is to partner with the business to drive strategic commercial decisions incorporating an end-to-end view while simplifying how we operate daily and ensuring that every decision supports the sustainable growth of the company. In this role, you will lead a team of 5 professionals and report directly to the Finance Manager as their strategic sparring partner while collaborating closely with the Sales and Marketing teams. The Opportunity:
• Coach and mentor a team of 5 Finance Enterprise Partners to accelerate their development and drive high performance.
• Drive operational change by challenging old habits, simplifying and continuously improving team processes, and maintaining lean, fit‑for‑purpose governance and risk-compliant financial practices.
• Support commercial growth by partnering with the commercial organization on product launches, customer pricing, and evaluation of commercial opportunities to ensure sustainable business outcomes.
• Drive P&L and performance improvements by proposing and scaling initiatives (upselling, efficiency and waste reduction, risk mitigation) and leading sales planning and reporting in close collaboration with the Performance Finance Enterprise Partner Lead, including monitoring results and advising on corrective actions to meet financial objectives. Who you are:
• University degree in Finance, Business, Engineering or a related discipline, with 5+ years of relevant professional experience.
• Experience in finance business partnering and proven ability to collaborate beyond the finance function; prior mentoring or guiding of small teams is highly valued (formal leadership not required).
• Fluency in Spanish and English.
• Coaching & empowering leadership style: develops people, elevates performance, and drives a unified, consistent way of working; challenges the status quo with a continuous improvement and process optimization mindset (simplifying, standardizing, automating with an enterprise view).
• Strategic business partner who connects financial insights with business realities to confidently challenge decisions and advise stakeholders as a trusted partner; shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video assessment. The Position Im Bereich Near Patient Care (NPC) Development bist Du bei uns Teil einer internationalen, kollaborativen Community, die gemeinsam die Zukunft der Diagnostik neu denkt. Als Subchapter Lead Mechanical Development (w/m/d) Near Patient Care (NPC) übernimmst Du eine zentrale, führende Rolle innerhalb des Bereichs Near Patient Care Development. In dieser Position führst Du ein hochqualifiziertes Team aus technischen Expert:innen und entwickelst effektiv und effizient die Kompetenzen rund um die Mechanikentwicklung weiter. Du gibst in dieser verantwortungsvollen Rolle fachliche, innovative Impulse, bist Coach und “Architekt:in des Wandels” für unsere moderne, agile Arbeitsweise. Mit Deiner außerordentlichen Expertise gestaltest Du aktiv die Zukunft der Diagnostik bei Roche. Deine Aufgaben
• Führung von mehreren Teams von Führungskräften und Spezialisten im Bereich Mechanik.
• Verantwortung für die Teamleistung und Ergebnisse im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich.
• Setzen und Umsetzen kurzfristiger Abteilungsziele und Prioritäten unter Berücksichtigung des Budgets.
• Etablierung und Verwaltung von externen Partnerschaften in Übereinstimmung mit den Anforderungen und der Strategie des Projekts
• Formuliert die Vision für das Subchapter und unterstützt bei Schlüsselprojekten zur Entwicklung von Geschäftseinheitsstrategien und Unternehmensprozessen.
• Eigenständige Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Entscheidungen zur Problemlösung im Verantwortungsbereich.
• Förderung der Kompetenzentwicklung im Team durch gezieltes Skill-Management. Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Mechatronik oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung. Ein Masterabschluss oder eine Promotion ist von Vorteil.
• Mindestens 8 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung, bevorzugt im Bereich der Medizintechnik.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Führungserfahrung, einschließlich Personalverantwortung.
• Vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Maschinenentwicklung und -betreuung, bevorzugt im Bereich Sondermaschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt auf vollautomatisierten Produktionsmaschinen.
• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch.
• Ausgeprägte Führungsfähigkeiten und Erfahrung in der Anleitung und Mentoring von Mitarbeitenden.
• Teamorientierte Arbeitsweise und Fähigkeit zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit.
• Analytisches Denkvermögen und Fähigkeit zur Entwicklung von Strategien für die Einheit. Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch oder bewirb Dich mit Deinem Workday-Profil. Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir kein Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse oder Ähnliches. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Im Bereich Near Patient Care (NPC) Development bist Du bei uns Teil einer internationalen, kollaborativen Community, die gemeinsam die Zukunft der Diagnostik neu denkt. Als Subchapter Lead Mechanical Development (w/m/d) Near Patient Care (NPC) übernimmst Du eine zentrale, führende Rolle innerhalb des Bereichs Near Patient Care Development. In dieser Position führst Du ein hochqualifiziertes Team aus technischen Expert:innen und entwickelst effektiv und effizient die Kompetenzen rund um die Mechanikentwicklung weiter. Du gibst in dieser verantwortungsvollen Rolle fachliche, innovative Impulse, bist Coach und “Architekt:in des Wandels” für unsere moderne, agile Arbeitsweise. Mit Deiner außerordentlichen Expertise gestaltest Du aktiv die Zukunft der Diagnostik bei Roche. Deine Aufgaben
• Führung von mehreren Teams von Führungskräften und Spezialisten im Bereich Mechanik.
• Verantwortung für die Teamleistung und Ergebnisse im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich.
• Setzen und Umsetzen kurzfristiger Abteilungsziele und Prioritäten unter Berücksichtigung des Budgets.
• Etablierung und Verwaltung von externen Partnerschaften in Übereinstimmung mit den Anforderungen und der Strategie des Projekts
• Formuliert die Vision für das Subchapter und unterstützt bei Schlüsselprojekten zur Entwicklung von Geschäftseinheitsstrategien und Unternehmensprozessen.
• Eigenständige Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Entscheidungen zur Problemlösung im Verantwortungsbereich.
• Förderung der Kompetenzentwicklung im Team durch gezieltes Skill-Management. Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Mechatronik oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung. Ein Masterabschluss oder eine Promotion ist von Vorteil.
• Mindestens 8 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung, bevorzugt im Bereich der Medizintechnik.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Führungserfahrung, einschließlich Personalverantwortung.
• Vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Maschinenentwicklung und -betreuung, bevorzugt im Bereich Sondermaschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt auf vollautomatisierten Produktionsmaschinen.
• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch.
• Ausgeprägte Führungsfähigkeiten und Erfahrung in der Anleitung und Mentoring von Mitarbeitenden.
• Teamorientierte Arbeitsweise und Fähigkeit zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit.
• Analytisches Denkvermögen und Fähigkeit zur Entwicklung von Strategien für die Einheit. Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch oder bewirb Dich mit Deinem Workday-Profil. Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir kein Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse oder Ähnliches. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Overview We are seeking a skilled and proactive QA / Test Automation Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be a champion for product excellence, ensuring our software meets strict quality standards and exceeds customer expectations. You will be responsible for the end-to-end testing lifecycle—from analyzing requirements and designing robust test strategies to coding automated test suites and fostering a "built-in quality" mindset across the organization. Your Main Tasks & Duties
• Test Strategy & Execution: Compose, execute, and assess functional and non-functional tests aligned with the defined test strategy to ensure product quality and customer satisfaction. + Requirements & Design Review: Review the product backlog, requirements, and specifications for clarity, testability, and traceability. Analyze system designs and architecture with a sharp eye for code quality, risks, and testability.
• Test Case Management: Create, maintain, and review test cases for software across all lifecycle phases within our designated tooling and documentation standards + Test Automation: Build software that tests software by writing automated test code or integrating robust third-party tools into our existing test suites.
• Environment & Infrastructure Management: Configure, manage, and maintain stable and scalable Test Environments + Defect Tracking & Metrics: Execute test cases, analyze results, report/track issues, and verify incoming fixes. Define and monitor relevant quality metrics to track overall product health.
• Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation under your responsibility (including test cases, test results, tooling guides, and best practices).
• Risk & Compliance: Collaborate on product risk assessments by identifying potential failures and ensuring adequate test coverage. Guarantee strict adherence to quality standards, relevant Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs), SOPs, and Working Instructions. Continuous Improvement & Leadership
• Process Optimization: Provide continuous input to improve testing processes and overall efficiency, heavily leveraging test automation where appropriate.
• QA Initiatives: Actively participate in internal testing improvement initiatives to elevate our engineering standards.
• Mentorship & Culture: Share, coach, and actively train team members both within and outside the department to promote a strong built-in quality mindset . Who you are
• Experience: Proven experience as a QA Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, or in a similar software testing role.
• Automation Skills: Experience building test frameworks via code (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript) or integrating modern third-party automation tools.
• Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to review architectural designs, pinpoint technical risks, and ensure full test traceability.
• Compliance Awareness: Familiarity working within structured environments governed by SOPs, QAPs, and strict quality guidelines is a plus.
• Soft Skills: Excellent collaboration, communication, and coaching skills to advocate for quality across cross-functional teams. There is a preferred candidate. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conduct

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position AI Platform Engineer Role Overview Own the full lifecycle of a production AI/ML platform spanning on-prem GPU clusters, multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Alibaba Cloud), and service delivery. This role bridges datacenter hardware, platform engineering, and AI service operations in a GxP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. You will work closely with global engineering teams, solution architects, and business stakeholders across time zones. Key Responsibilities Infrastructure Engineering (On-Prem & Cloud)
• Own OS baseline: REDHAT Satellite management, custom Base ISO lifecycle
• Integration with enterprise storage systems, which are managed by the Roche Storage team
• GPU server BOM selection,and hardware qualification
• Architect cloud resource strategy: Reserved Instance planning, cost optimization across AWS and Alibaba Cloud
• Cloud Accounts (AWS and Alibaba) Post Previsioning, configuration, and management, for Platform and Platform managed use case accounts Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
• Develop and maintain Ansible scripts for automated server management (Provision, Decommission, Configuration)
• Build and operate AMI Bakery pipelines for immutable image delivery
• Orchestrate multi-cloud server deployments (AWS, Alibaba Cloud) via IaC
• Automate Kubernetes cluster provisioning and management
• Develop and harden custom IAC Scripts MLOps Platform Engineering
• Manage full cluster lifecycle: provisioning, upgrades, scaling, disaster recovery

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità In qualità di proprietario del processo Payroll, sarai un driver chiave nella semplificazione e nell'ottimizzazione della fornitura di servizi payroll, time e benefit (PTB) in tutta la regione EMEA. Segnalando al Global PTB Lead, agirai come un ponte strategico tra i team operativi regionali e la gestione globale dei prodotti per garantire che le nostre soluzioni siano efficienti e scalabili.
• Agire come partner strategico e rappresentante regionale per i team operativi PTB, assicurando l'allineamento con le best practice globali.

• Gestire le relazioni dei fornitori insieme alla leadership globale, interfacciandosi con partner chiave come Workday, ADP e Deloitte.
• Sostenere la governance dei servizi supervisionando KPI regionali, cataloghi di servizi e audit di conformità (ad esempio, controlli ICFR e SOD). Chi sei Sei un pensatore strategico con profonda competenza tecnica nel libro paga e nella gestione del tempo. Tu prosperi in ambienti matrici e possiedi l'influenza necessaria per gestire diversi stakeholder, mantenendo un forte focus sulla responsabilità end-to-end e l'eccellenza di processo.
• Professionista esperto: Porti 3+ anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione Payroll, Time/Absence e Benefits, preferibilmente in un complesso ambiente di servizi condivisi.
• Technical Savvy: Hai una solida conoscenza di lavoro di Workday e esperienza di gestire le relazioni con i fornitori di payroll esterni.
• Esperto Stakeholder: Possiedi la capacità di coinvolgere e influenzare partner diversi oltre la funzione HR, tra cui Finanza e IT.
• Process Oriented: Hai uno sfondo ideale nella gestione dei processi aziendali e una comprovata traccia delle principali iniziative di miglioramento continuo.
• Leader del progetto: si portano forti competenze di gestione del progetto e la capacità di priorità requisiti concorrenti in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.
• Contabile & analitico: Lei dimostra la responsabilità end-to-end, utilizzando il pensiero critico e problem-solving per garantire la consegna di servizio di alta qualità.
• Communicatore fluente: Possiedi eccellenti competenze in inglese (scritto e parlato) e abbracci il lavoro all'interno di un'organizzazione multiculturale e globale. In Exchange vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, opportunità di coaching / mentoring, programma amico, edifici di squadra, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a team member of RSS, you execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level requirements, in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process. It is also key to follow the instructions of the Team Lead regarding the daily work coordination. You are responsible for managing incoming and outgoing phone calls based on the predefined SLAs and processes and incoming Service Now tickets. With your dedicated work, you contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of Roche. You will be :
• Service Delivery : Your key responsibilities will be providing support on 1st level questions, system related questions, role management, consultancy services on existing procurement functionalities of the system/platform for end users. Providing support primarily by phone and ticketing tool for above mentioned system related queries coming from Indirect Procurement End Users. Creating/maintaining and following up cases/tickets in the adequate quality and in timely manner – within 24 hours if possible- in order to achieve the best response and end-to-end resolution time. Proceed with role ownership tickets in timely manner according to the guidelines
• Responsible for first level issue resolution and being able to make decision on further actions for completing and resolving the upcoming requests and issues. Being a bridge between other resolver groups and the business, by reviewing feedback related incidents and sharing the knowledge and instructions with the Requestor on the adequate level. Work on scheduled and ad-hoc reporting activities, pro-actively practice the available and required tool sets. Work on the regular and ad-hoc monitoring activity and apply fixes as needed. Being responsible and contribute to a proper availability planning within the Team by discussing planned holiday/training schedule in advance
• Cross-Functional Collaboration : Contribute continuously to the implementation of new tasks and responsibilities coming to the RSS
• Outputs & Deliverables : Maintaining SOPs, Annexes and training materials for 1st level support. Prepare and share knowledge base documents in timely manner or for the requested deadline.
• Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly. Your skills:
• You bring the following skills and competencies: Experience in supplier relationship management. Basic understanding of procurement support. Familiar with ticketing tools
• Good numerical and analytical skills. React to problems in an appropriate manner. Able to work in a fast paced environment. Good at time management. Open to working in afternoon schedule until 6:00 pm. Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills. Outstanding customer service and interpersonal skills
• Highly accountable, agile, and results oriented. Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and written. Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks. Strong communication skills in English and Mandarin are essential. Additional languages will be an advantage.
• We are seeking an individual with 1-3 years of experience in Procurement operational or support. Experience and knowledge of SAP/ SAP SRM. Proficiency in Mandarin and English (read, write, understand) is

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• Présentation de l’équipe:
• Au cœur de l’équipe Medical & Evidence Data science, tu auras pour mission de travailler sur la stratégie de génération de données médicales. Stage de 6 mois à pourvoir à partir de janvier 2026 Basé à Paris, Boulogne-Billancourt (92)
• Quel sera ton impact ?
• ● tu travailleras essentiellement sur des données de vie réelle, issue de registres, cohortes ou de bases de données médico-administratives comme le SNDS (Système National des données de santé
• ● Tu coordonneras des groupes de travail pour identifier les besoins clefs en
• données médicales robustes sur une indication et identifier des solutions adaptées ● Tu co-construiras les plans de génération de preuves avec le médical et l’accès au marché, intégrant essais cliniques, données épidémiologiques, accès précoces et support à l’efficience du système de santé. ● Tu réaliseras des revues de littérature ● Tu valideras les protocoles d’étude, notamment des études en vie réelle, les plans d' analyse statistique et les rapports d'études produits par les partenaires ou en interne, en collaboration avec les expertises scientifiques internes requises.
• ● Tu participeras à la rédaction de d’abstract , poster ou d’articles ou coordonner sa rédaction
• ● Tu établiras un plan de publication adapté aux enjeux clefs de l’aire thérapeutique.
• ● Tu seras amené à faire de la coordination de projet transverse ou de projet clinique Ton ADN
• ● Tu as envie d’apprendre
• ● Tu es autonome dans la gestion de ton planning avec des réunions hebdomadaires
• programmées entre toi et ton tuteur.
• ● Tu es rigoureux(se) et pragmatique
• ● Tu as des connaissances en épidémiologie, sur les données de vie réelle ou le développement clinique
• ● Tu as un esprit d’équipe
• ● Tu as un bon niveau d ’anglais car tu auras beaucoup de contacts avec des
• anglophones;
• ● Tu es curieux, motivé(e) et proactif(ve) et tu souhaites t’immerger dans le monde de l’entreprise ! Pourquoi nous rejoindre? ● Cette stage va te permettre d'apprendre et maîtriser des découvrir tous les aspects du Medical Evidence & Data science dans le milieu de la santé. ● Notre entreprise dispose d'un environnement collaboratif et stimulant, où tu pourras travailler aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés et passionnés, ce qui facilitera ton apprentissage et ton développement professionnel. ● Tu auras la possibilité de contribuer à des activités qui ont un impact direct sur la compréhension et le traitement des maladies, ce qui ajoutera une dimension enrichissante à ton travail ● Nous considérons les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes. ● Conformément à la réglementation, tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de travailleurs handicapés. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler lors de l’entretien. ● Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact et l’avancée pour la santé de tous. Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generati

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Please note that this role offers a fixed-term contract (up until Feb 29, 2029). The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity. The Opportunity As a Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process . In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:
• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities
• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts
• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions
• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices
• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling
• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP
• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions
• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits Who you are We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
• University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline
• 1-3 years of experience in a relevant position
• Excellent communication and analytical skills
• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus
• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude
• Proficiency in English In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office day/week on average) . We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruit

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roles & Responsibilities Routine Operation : Implement GMP compliance against global GMP standards and China GMP requirement
• By assisting the Head of Analytical Testing lab to conduct GMP Self-Inspection, and follow-up the implementation action to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.
• By maintaining the quality system and documentation system to ensure quality system operations in QC meets the regulatory requirements. Complete the assigned routine inspection of sample, issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time. Implement the maintenance and calibration of assigned instruments
• By accomplishing the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.
• By keeping the relevant document to trace the calibration, maintenance history and any change of the instruments.
• By keeping contact with instrument company to obtain the sufficient application technical support and repair service in time. Maintain the analysis methods to be current and effective.
• Implement the defined analysis method validation via planning, executing and reporting process.
• Perform method periodical review timely. Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.
• By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert the supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in the correct way and in time.
• By leading the investigation precession to identify the actual data and information, and try to find the cause to help to prevent the same issue from happening repeatedly. Stick lab safety regulations to prevent occurrence of accidents.
• By obeying the safety instruction of the storage, usage and disposal of reagent, narcotics, medicines, lab waste.
• By following the usage instructions of facilities of water, electricity and steam etc. in lab. Tutor colleagues to fulfill analysis tasks
• By providing technical support to colleagues if necessary and sharing knowledge and experience within working section.
• By checking and reviewing the testing process and analysis data to feedback improve opportunity. As the experienced SME, proactive drive the continuous improvement in Analytical Testing lab by leading the taskforce to identify and implement new technologies to improve the compliance and efficiency in routine QC operations. Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness : Analytical Transfer Support: Support the establishment of the product control strategy and implement Analytical Transfer activities. Analytical method validation and qualification: Support and establish analytical method validation activities and perform method monitoring. Equipment Support: Drive the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation. Qualification and Experience Education/Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above
• Special Equipment management certification Leadership Competencies
• Models Integrity
• Focus on value and customer
• Align for success
• Deliver results
• Learn for the future Job Required Competencies
• 3 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on protein analysis in pharmaceutical industry. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred
• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance an
