descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position El Medical Ecosystem Partner (MEP) está en el centro de la nueva organización en Roche, desafiando el papel que jugamos en la sociedad para pasar de ofrecer medicamentos de clase mundial a construir alianzas, co-crear, innovar y liderar la atención médica. Es directamente responsable de entregar los mejores resultados para los pacientes, su comunidad, el ecosistema y la organización de una manera más rápida. El objetivo de esta función es también colaborar con la comunidad científica y médica externa para proporcionar información clara, científicamente sólida, coherente y oportuna sobre nuestros productos, servicios y áreas de enfermedad, y recopilar información externa relevante para la estrategia general. La Oportunidad
• El MEP es un rol clave dentro de la afiliada, que tiene las habilidades para identificar y superar barreras de acceso con el fin de tener un mayor impacto en el viaje del paciente.
• El MEP se enfoca en la importancia de traer y compartir insights trabajando de cerca con nuestros clientes para descubrir las oportunidades potenciales para transformar los resultados en salud para los pacientes, de forma más rápida. Comparte la experiencia, la ciencia y el conocimiento de Roche a los diferentes ecosistemas de salud.
• Participa y promueve el trabajo en red (Network) para agilizar, colaborar e innovar, así como atraer experiencia y recursos a nivel local.
• Procesa , analiza y proporciona información médica valiosa, tanto interna como externamente, de forma proactiva o basada en solicitudes.
• Trabajar de cerca con todos los actores que intervienen directamente en el manejo de la enfermedad (en un área terapéutica determinada), compartiendo con los Expertos de Áreas Terapéuticas (TAEs) un profundo y actualizado conocimiento sobre el manejo de la patología, información relacionada con los productos con FOCO EN PIPELINE acorde a los estándares de Roche y de las regulaciones locales, así como asociaciones de pacientes y otras partes interesadas.
• Comunica propuestas de valor a los diferentes grupos de interés para acelerar soluciones de acceso “One Roche”
• Brinda apoyo como experto en los ecosistemas locales, fomentando el trabajo multidisciplinario y el desarrollo de iniciativas OneRoche que apoyen el desarrollo de la estrategia de una Medicina Integral y Personalizada.
• Asegura de que las consultas de información médica cumplan con los estándares de calidad, las políticas y los SOP de Roche, y satisfagan las necesidades del cliente.
• Asegura de que los departamentos de Farmacovigilancia y Calidad tengan información oportuna sobre los informes de eventos adversos y quejas de calidad, y realizar las conciliaciones requeridas por estos departamentos.
• Participa de forma significativa con las comunidades globales y regionales pertinentes, participando activamente (compartiendo experiencias y participando en grupos de trabajo) y defendiendo el valor de las redes y la colaboración.
• Trabaja en conjunto con el Squad y el área de RWE en la identificación de Gaps de evidencia local para co-crear con los actores de los ecosistemas soluciones que puedan cubrir los gaps para mejorar el acceso y la atención personalizada de los pacientes y lograr que se generen publicaciones
• Cuenta con entendimiento profundo del ecosistema médico (médico tratante, tomadores de decisión en instituciones públicas y privadas, asociaciones médicas y de pacientes) para encontrar oportunidades y moldearlo, facilitando que más pacientes reciban mejores solucion

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Backlog Elaboration Team Lead The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As an accomplished Systems Engineer with a strong background in end-to-end new product development programs and successful launches, you will play the role of Backlog Elaboration Team Lead being at the forefront of leading Roche Tissue Diagnostics’ design & development programs. Using the Agile method of development, you will primarily focus on the prioritization, definition, estimation, tracking and continuous maintenance of solution level backlog by heavily collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders. The Opportunity
• You will facilitate and improve Backlog Elaboration by leading backlog elaboration meetings, ensuring they are productive and owning the project’s backlog elaboration WiKi site.
• You will collaborate and seek guidance from the program’s Solution Train Engineer to continuously iterate and refine processes with a goal to have backlogs sequenced, defined & estimated for confident predictability and project schedule tracking.
• You will manage interdependencies by developing a deep understanding of System, Software, Assay, Consumables and Hardware teams & the Agile Release Trains (ARTs) to ensure that all Epics, Capabilities & Features are clearly defined & documented in the backlog.
• You will continually look for ways of enhancing tools (such as Azure DevOps and Lucid) and communication by streamlining our workflow, be the central point of contact for backlog-related communications & engaging with a wide range of stakeholders (including Product Managers, ART leads, and senior leadership) to align everyone towards a unified goal.
• You will strategize and plan for the future by developing and communicating yearly backlog goals that provide clear direction for the teams. This includes implementing Agile SAFe's rolling-wave planning approach involving detailed planning for upcoming Program Increments while keeping a high-level view of future PIs. Over time, this role can grow into co-facilitating PI Planning with the Solution Train Engineer. Who you are
• An Agile & SAFe expert with strong understanding of Agile principles including backlog elaboration, just-in-time planning, and rolling-wave planning. You must know how to apply these concepts to maintain a healthy and predictive backlog.
• An expert at organizational & planning skills to effectively manage complex backlogs, track dependencies across multiple teams (SW, Assay, System, etc.), and maintain the Project Backlog Elaboration wiki. The ability to sequence work and ensure a high-level project schedule will be a direct outcome of this skill.
• While not a developer, you must have a solid grasp of the development lifecycle and key milestone deliverables. This technical acumen & understanding is crucial for effective communication and for ensuring that backlog items are well-defined and feasible.
• Expert in using Azure DevOps and Lucid tools is essential. You'll be responsible for driving tool improvements and using these platforms to manage and visualize the backlog, dependencies, and project flow.
• An excellent facilitator & communicator. This role requires strong skills in facilitating meetings and communicating with diverse stakeholders, from team members

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position For over 60 years, Roche has been guided by a profound vision: a future where cancer can be cured. 22.8 million people have been treated with Roche cancer therapy as of 2025. We have had nearly 30 New Molecular Entities (NMEs) approved in our oncology and haematology portfolio. We are committed to developing innovative medicines and diagnostic solutions that help prevent, stop and cure cancer. Leading with bold moves, while grounded in science and experience, our focus is on turning scientific breakthroughs into better outcomes for people with cancer, healthcare systems and society. We are aiming to deliver seven new transformative cancer medicines by the end of the decade, for those that need them most. To help us achieve this vision we are looking for a dedicated Breast Cancer Specialist Representative to join our dynamic team. If you have a proven track record working in the pharmaceutical industry and a passion for the area of Breast Cancer then we want you to be a part of our success story. As a Breast Cancer Patient Journey Partner (PJP) , you will play a pivotal role in promoting our exciting portfolio of Breast Cancer treatments to healthcare professionals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key Breast Cancer stakeholders, including oncologist and other respective healthcare professionals/practice staff, to create meaningful solutions that improve patient outcomes. The territory will focus on key Breast Cancer accounts across NSW and the ACT. What you will be working on: You will independently manage territory metrics and targets, showing resilience and confidence when challenging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). You will work with your team to advance customers through the adoption ladder, drive market growth to meet our patient-focused goals, and contribute to the development of pioneering therapies. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Drive adoption of our Breast Cancer products with healthcare providers across NSW and the ACT.
• Develop and execute territory plans to maximise opportunities to create value for our stakeholders and for Roche to and meet our goals
• Build strong, long-term relationships with oncologist and other healthcare professionals
• Review customer engagement metrics to optimise communication channels ensuring regular engagement with target customers through face to face meetings, virtual calls, dinner presentation meetings, clinic/practice luncheons and participation in industry events
• Provide expert knowledge on the clinical data and benefits of our treatment
• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams (marketing, medical etc) to drive business growth and great customer experience
• Monitor and analyse territory performance, market trends and competitor activity to adjust strategies/tactics to improve outcomes
• Gather valuable insights from customers and effectively communicate them to the internal team to help validate and define our strategic initiatives.
• Adhere to company policies and industry regulations, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and ethics. Who you are: You are someone who demonstrates a passion for patient outcomes, enterprise-level thinking, and an entrepreneurial mindset with an excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical industry. You have:
• 5+ years or equivalent level of experience as a specialist pharmaceutical representative or in similar capacity
• In-depth knowledge of the healthcare system

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a dynamic and global role? As a Global Product Planner, you will be at the forefront of supply chain management, driving operational excellence and ensuring product availability across our hubs and nodes.. You will develop and manage supply plans utilizing both affiliate and statistical forecasts to create accurate and efficient supply chains. By proactively addressing supply and demand planning issues, you will maintain seamless operations and ensure the accuracy and continuous optimization of MRP master data. Leading bottleneck management, allocation, reserve management, and scrap mitigation across the network will be vital components of your role. In this position, you will be the primary point of contact for product supply-related communications with suppliers, regions, business areas, and affiliates. You will guarantee the timely supply of finished goods to regional and local warehouses, aligning with service level agreements (SLAs), and strive to meet customer service objectives at the lowest possible total costs, including distribution, inventory, and write-offs. We are looking for someone with specialized and comprehensive knowledge in supply chain management or a related business area. Your analytical and problem-solving skills will be engaged in varied and complex duties involving research, analysis, and solution development. You will provide expert guidance to department leadership in setting strategic direction and utilize originality and ingenuity in your daily responsibilities and decision-making processes. Applying a wide range of principles, practices, and procedures to navigate more complex and challenging assignments will be crucial. Additionally, your commitment to maintaining and continuously improving the planning objectives and goals through daily actions will be key. This is your opportunity to make a significant impact in a highly professional and strategic role. Join us and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service and operational efficiency. Apply now to be part of a global team committed to excellence! The Opportunity
• End-to-End Inventory Management: Accountable to ensure global product availability across all regional and central warehouse locations for a defined portfolio, including the strategic setting and continuous monitoring of global safety levels.
• Supply Planning & Optimization: Responsible for the creation and accuracy of global supply plans by aligning demand inputs with manufacturing and supplier capabilities; provides robust recommendations regarding Master Production Schedules (MPS) and Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP).
• Lifecycle & Launch Coordination: Accountable to liaise with functional leads and lifecycle teams to manage complex product transitions, ensuring seamless availability during critical launch and phase-out periods.
• Operational Execution & Data Integrity: Responsible for the ongoing optimization and accuracy of MRP master data and executes logistics interventions, including batch reservations, to guarantee uninterrupted product flow during emergencies.
• Crisis Management & S&OP Leadership : Serves as the primary lead for initiating escalation

Leading bottleneck management, allocation, reserve management, and scrap mitigation across the network will be vital components of your role. In this position, you will be the primary point of contact for product supply-related communications with suppliers, regions, business areas, and affiliates. You will guarantee the timely supply of finished goods to regional and local warehouses, aligning with service level agreements (SLAs), and strive to meet customer service objectives at the lowest possible total costs, including distribution, inventory, and write-offs. We are looking for someone with specialized and comprehensive knowledge in supply chain management or a related business area. Your analytical and problem-solving skills will be engaged in varied and complex duties involving research, analysis, and solution development. You will provide expert guidance to department leadership in setting strategic direction and utilize originality and ingenuity in your daily responsibilities and decision-making processes. Applying a wide range of principles, practices, and procedures to navigate more complex and challenging assignments will be crucial. Additionally, your commitment to maintaining and continuously improving the planning objectives and goals through daily actions will be key. This is your opportunity to make a significant impact in a highly professional and strategic role. Join us and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service and operational efficiency. Apply now to be part of a global team committed to excellence! The Opportunity
• End-to-End Inventory Management: Accountable to ensure global product availability across all regional and central warehouse locations for a defined portfolio, including the strategic setting and continuous monitoring of global safety levels.
• Supply Planning & Optimization: Responsible for the creation and accuracy of global supply plans by aligning demand inputs with manufacturing and supplier capabilities; provides robust recommendations regarding Master Production Schedules (MPS) and Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP).
• Lifecycle & Launch Coordination: Accountable to liaise with functional leads and lifecycle teams to manage complex product transitions, ensuring seamless availability during critical launch and phase-out periods.
• Operational Execution & Data Integrity: Responsible for the ongoing optimization and accuracy of MRP master data and executes logistics interventions, including batch reservations, to guarantee uninterrupted product flow during emergencies.
• Crisis Management & S&OP Leadership : Serves as the primary lead for initiating escalation

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Anatomic Pathology Solutions Manager L'opportunità Il responsabile delle soluzioni di patologia anatomica nella diagnostica dei tessuti è responsabile della protezione e della crescita delle porzioni IHC, H&E e Special Stains del business insieme a piattaforme aggiuntive, guidando il business stesso e attraverso altri. Si tratta di un ruolo specifico per le vendite dei singoli collaboratori con responsabilità di leadership informali. Conosce e comprende il panorama competitivo Advanced Stain, inclusi prodotti, strumenti di vendita e prezzi per RTD e tutti i concorrenti. Leva le relazioni commerciali attuali per mantenere e crescere la base clienti attuale. Lavora in coordinamento con Account Manager e Strategic Account Managers per chiedere ai clienti attuali e prospettici. Ha una conoscenza completa dei prodotti e dei servizi aziendali, e visto come un esperto della società e dei clienti. Può essere incaricato di vendite di prodotti nuovi o strategici. Funziona su problemi di varia portata in cui l'analisi dei dati richiede la valutazione di fattori identificabili. Dimostra buon giudizio nella scelta di metodi e tecniche per ottenere soluzioni. • Responsabile del mantenimento e del miglioramento continuo del sistema di qualità e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi di qualità attraverso azioni quotidiane.

• Fornisce una leadership professionale nella pianificazione, nell'organizzazione e nel controllo della crescita delle vendite equilibrata, della penetrazione continua del conto e della soddisfazione del cliente.
• Utilizza una forte conoscenza del prodotto/mercato e un'esperienza di vendita per gestire le vendite complesse e risolvere le domande e le preoccupazioni del cliente.
• Costruire costantemente la conoscenza delle attuali tendenze del settore, delle informazioni concorrenziali e delle conoscenze e delle azioni industriali/tecniche con altri colleghi Roche.
• Responsabile della gestione efficace dell'imbuto di vendita mediante l'identificazione delle opportunità e la creazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni.
• Stabilisce e lavora con Account Manager e Strategic Account Manager per costruire forti relazioni con i clienti che consentono crescita, redditività e prevedibilità. Comunica con altre funzioni Roche rilevanti per garantire il supporto di vendita necessario e la consegna di programmi / prodotti.

The Position We are looking for an experienced and passionate Legal Counsel to join our Legal team at Roche Diagnostics Turkiye. In this role, you will play a key part in protecting our reputation and supporting strategic decision-making with expert legal guidance. What will you do? As a Legal Counsel, you will be a strategic partner for Roche, providing proactive and commercially focused legal services and solutions. You will oversee legal compliance, mitigate risks, support corporate governance, and advise on business operations. Your role includes managing contracts, handling litigation, monitoring regulatory developments, and ensuring company policies align with legal requirements. Key responsibilities include:
• Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating bilingual legal documents such as contracts and agreements.
• Leading key contract negotiations and maintaining Roche’s contract template pool.
• Keeping company departments updated on changes in laws and recent cases, assessing potential risks, and offering legal solutions.
• Handling litigation to safeguard Roche’s legal rights and interests.
• Managing corporate maintenance topics, including company registration and corporate filings.
• Overseeing external legal counsel on various legal matters.
• Providing legal support for commercial and operational projects.
• Delivering legal training to employees and third parties, such as distributors and suppliers.
• Managing legal department reporting responsibilities and documentation. Who are you? As a Legal Counsel, you are a proactive and business-minded legal professional with a strong ability to navigate complex regulatory environments. You thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic setting, and you bring the following qualifications and skills:
• A Bachelor’s Degree in Law (Master’s preferred).
• At least 6-7 years of experience in contract law, commercial law, and tender law.
• Strong expertise in developing business models and customer solutions that drive superior business results.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (additional languages are a plus).
• High adaptability and eagerness for continuous learning and self-development.
• Exceptional analytical, investigative, and organizational skills.

• An agile and people-focused work environment, where autonomy and decision-making are valued.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for a SHE & Site Security Officer at Roche Diagnostics to lead and execute SHE (Safety, Health and Environment) and Site/Office Security agenda in the business. In this role, you will:
• Lead SHE and Site Security agenda in the business, provide SHE and Site Security guidance to GM and LT
• Responsibility for establishing, leading and delivering SHE management systems (incl. organization, documentation, goals and performance management, audits, CAPA, training awareness, communication, incident and emergency management, fire protection, security management, operational safety, environment, SHE business partner's management, product stewardship, etc.)
• Promote SHE and Site Security in the company based on local / Group Roche SHE objectives and goals. Ensure a safe environment for employees
• Communicate local and corporate SHE and Site Security requirements within the site and help to ensure compliance
• Ensure compliance with local legal SHE legislation and regulations, with Roche SHE directives and provisions, Roche Security requirements (K19), processes and policies so company, employees and customers are kept safe and secure
• Ensure that a Risk management and risk assessment process is implemented and documented, organize periodic SHE and Site Security inspections. Report critical SHE situations and critical security incidents to CSO
• Monitor, document and report SHE KPIs, trends towards SHE goals, implementation of SHE programs and action plans
• Being responsible for delivery of regular SHE/SS Onboarding training of new employees and regular trainings of the whole affiliate as per legal and Group SHE requirements
• Having responsibility for managing of Occupational Health agenda, including Medical checks; ensure close cooperation with People&Culture Department.
• Ensure regular communication of SHE related information, manage regular communication with Group SHE team
• Support BCM (Business Continuity Management) process, be an active member of the emergency management team
• Ensure Pandemic planning and plan activation in case of a need
• Manage critical issues / cases related to security of the company / site (including participation in investigations)
• Manage financial provisions for legacy health and environmental liabilities, together with the finance department
• Establish and maintain contacts with the local SHE authorities, professional organizations and associations, scientific bodies and the public, with law enforcement authorities / police.
• Manage and guide security/safety aspects of car fleet/company car usage. Close communication/collaboration with purchasing department in terms of car selection process from safety/emission/environment perspective
• Supporting procurement team in office landlord relations and future office strategy in context of Roche ways of working Qualification and Experience:
• University degree (preferably from engineering faculty)
• More than 5 years in a similar role and technical leadership experience
• Occasional travel is required for this role
• Spoken and written English & Turkish
• Project and change management skills
• Substantial experience working with diverse senior leaders
• Experience working in a matrix and multi-cultural environment
• Location: Istanbul/Turkey Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for gen

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Nell'area del supporto manifatturiero nell'assemblaggio delle unità di produzione e imballaggio presso la nostra sede a Kaiseraugst, offriamo un sito di stage dal settembre 2026 (o per accordo). All'interno di Manufacturing Support Packaging, il GMP Support Group si occupa della definizione, adattamento e miglioramento dei processi di confezionamento completi. Nella vita di tutti i giorni, lo implementiamo in modo specifico attraverso compiti quali il trattamento di misure correttive e preventive (CAPA), la creazione e la revisione di istruzioni di lavoro standard (SOP), l'attuazione di emendamenti (Changes) e la creazione di analisi di rischio di qualità. La gamma dei compiti è completata da attività di supporto. Questi includono il supporto per argomenti quali l'igiene, la sicurezza, la salute e la protezione ambientale (SGU) e altri compiti versatili e il supporto ad hoc, a seconda delle esigenze operative. Come tirocinante nel campo del gruppo di supporto GMP in Manufacturing Support Packaging, supporti il team in una varietà di problemi. In questo stage, lavorerai sui seguenti argomenti:
• Creare, modificare e personalizzare i cambiamenti e le SOP
• Cura e ulteriore sviluppo dei nostri assistenti AI
• Controllare e aggiornare le schede di dati di sicurezza
• Supporto per il supporto manifatturiero Guida alle prestazioni e alla manutenzione del consiglio di prestazione
• Supporti attivamente la progettazione e l'attuazione di misure di formazione per il concetto di bordo dell'unità di produzione
• Supporta il campo di auto-ispezione/ispezione da parte delle autorità sanitarie Chi sei tu sei immattricolato o avere i tuoi studi in un'università o università di scienze applicate, preferibilmente nel campo farmaceutico o in un campo STEM (matematica, informatica, scienze naturali, tecnologia) hanno completato negli ultimi 12 mesi e sono interessati a utilizzare le tue conoscenze in un ambiente di lavoro moderno e per conoscere l'industria farmaceutica. Inoltre, completate il vostro profilo con le seguenti competenze:
• Passione per la cooperazione
• Motivato, flessibile e aperto a nuove
• Competenze organizzative molto buone
• Hai una forte comprensione analitica e usa i dati come base solida per le tue decisioni
• Sei caratterizzato da un modo di lavoro indipendente, auto-responsabile e strutturato sopra la media, e stai guidando i compiti proattivamente.
• Competenze di comunicazione molto buone
• Gestione degli stakeholder goffrata Pronto per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di incontrarti. Iscriviti ora per scoprire questa entusiasmante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions au plus haut niveau, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questa è un'ottima opportunità per uno scienziato biomedico o equivalente per unire Roche Diagnostics, il fornitore di salute leader mondiale nella diagnostica In-Vitro. Questa eccitante posizione fa parte dell'Area di Lavoro del Siero (SWA) all'interno del Centro di Assistenza Clienti Regionale (RCSC) UK Hub che supporta la chimica clinica e i sistemi di Immunoassay. Il Centro di assistenza clienti regionale con sede a Burgess Hill, Regno Unito, fornisce supporto tecnico e scientifico alla nostra base clienti in tutto il Regno Unito, Irlanda, Danimarca, Finlandia, Norvegia e Svezia. Questa posizione è stata offerta come un ruolo di supporto remoto basato in Finlandia, idealmente vicino alla Roche Diagnostics Ufficio Oy Espoo, o in alternativa un ruolo di ufficio nel Regno Unito, Burgess Hill (dove l'aspettativa è di essere entro un 1 ora di viaggio e di essere in ufficio la maggior parte del tempo). Il ruolo consisterà principalmente nel fornire supporto alle prestazioni di test remoto per il nostro portafoglio di strumenti e soluzioni SWA e Near Patient Care (NPC), nonché per la formazione dei clienti e dei dipendenti. L'ambito di sostegno comprende clienti e colleghi Roche all'interno del Regno Unito, Irlanda, Danimarca, Finlandia, Norvegia e Svezia. Potrai eccellere nell'arte di risolvere i problemi e orgogliosi di fornire un servizio clienti eccellente. L'opportunità
• Risoluzione dei problemi analitici complessi e problemi di sistema in remoto, fornendo risoluzioni rapide ed efficaci per salvaguardare le operazioni di laboratorio.
• Condurre prodotti di alta qualità e formazione tecnica per clienti e colleghi interni, sia in remoto che in siti di formazione designati.
• Gestire e documentare le richieste dei clienti e i reclami diligentemente, garantendo un allineamento assoluto con le normative del nostro sistema di qualità aziendale.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di campo e i responsabili delle vendite interfunzionali per elevare la soddisfazione del cliente e ottimizzare la ritenzione.
• Partecipare attivamente alle revisioni dei reclami, alle analisi di tendenza e al tracciamento metrico delle prestazioni per migliorare il servizio continuo.
• Assistere i team commerciali durante i processi di gara fornendo dimostrazioni di strumenti e risposte tecniche di impatto. Ci sarà una formazione iniziale intensiva di introduzione per i primi sei mesi della posizione alcuni dei quali saranno nei nostri centri di formazione europei. Successivamente, vi sarà anche richiesto di partecipare alla formazione periodica sulle operazioni di assistenza clienti e offerte di prodotti in varie sedi. Chi sei
• Sfondo educativo: Lei ha una laurea in Scienze Biomediche o un campo scientifico equivalente.
• Esperienza nell'industria: Lei porta esperienza pratica all'interno di un'industria diagnostica o di un ambiente di laboratorio ospedaliero clinico, con una forte attenzione alla chimica clinica o all'immunologia.
• Risolvere dei problemi analitici: possiedi una mentalità di risoluzione dei problemi, con la capacità di avvicinarsi a problemi di laboratorio complessi metodicamente e lavorare sotto pressione.
• Campione del Cliente & Communicator: Lei è motivato dal superamento delle aspettative, dalla condivisione delle conoscenze e dal lavoro in modo efficace in un ambiente ricco e multiculturale.
• Proficienza linguistica: Lei è pienamente fluente sia in finlandese scritto che in inglese. Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è la Finlandia. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedi

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This is an excellent opportunity for a Biomedical Scientist or equivalent to join Roche Diagnostics, the world’s leading health supplier in In-Vitro Diagnostics. This exciting position is part of the Serum Work Area (SWA) within the Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) UK Hub supporting Clinical chemistry and Immunoassay systems. The Regional Customer Support Centre based in Burgess Hill, UK, provides technical and scientific support to our customer base across the UK, Ireland, Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden. This position is being offered as a remote support role based in Finland, ideally close to the Roche Diagnostics Oy Espoo office, or alternatively an office based role in the UK, Burgess Hill (where the expectation is to be within a 1 hour commute and be in the office the majority of the time). The role will primarily consist of providing remote assay performance support for our SWA and Near Patient Care (NPC) portfolio of instruments and solutions as well as customer and employee training. The scope of support includes customers and Roche colleagues within the UK, Ireland, Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden. You will excel in the art of troubleshooting and pride yourself in providing excellent customer service. The Opportunity
• Troubleshoot complex analytical and system issues remotely, delivering swift and effective resolutions to safeguard lab operations.
• Conduct high-quality product and technical training for customers and internal colleagues, both remotely and at designated training sites.
• Manage and document customer inquiries and complaints diligently, ensuring absolute alignment with our corporate Quality System regulations.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional Field Teams and Sales Managers to elevate customer satisfaction and optimize retention.
• Participate actively in data-driven complaint reviews, trend analyses and performance metric tracking to drive continuous service improvement.
• Assist commercial teams during tender processes by delivering impactful instrument demonstrations and technical responses. There will be an intensive initial introduction training for the first six months of the position some of which will be in our European training centers. Thereafter, you will also be required to attend periodic training on customer support operations and product offerings at various locations. Who You Are
• Educational Background: You hold a degree in Biomedical Science or an equivalent scientific field.
• Industry Experience: You bring practical experience within a diagnostic industry or clinical hospital laboratory environment, with a strong focus on Clinical Chemistry or Immunology.
• Analytical Problem Solver: You possess a troubleshooting mindset, with the ability to approach complex laboratory problems methodically and work under pressure.
• Customer Champion & Communicator: You are motivated by exceeding expectations, sharing knowledge and working effectively in a rich, multi-cultural environment.
• Language Proficiency: You are fully fluent in both written and spoken Finnish and English. Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Finland. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process. Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Dies ist eine ausgezeichnete Gelegenheit für einen Biomedizinischen Wissenschaftler oder gleichwertig mit Roche Diagnostics, dem weltweit führenden Gesundheitsanbieter in der In-Vitro-Diagnostik. Diese spannende Position ist Teil des Serum Work Area (SWA) im Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) UK Hub, der klinische Chemie und Immunoassay-Systeme unterstützt. Diese Position wird in Finnland als Remote-Support-Rolle angeboten, ideal in der Nähe der Roche Diagnostics Oy Espoo-Büro, oder alternativ eine bürobasierte Rolle in Großbritannien, Burgess Hill (wo die Erwartung innerhalb einer 1 Stunde Straße sein soll und im Büro die Mehrheit der Zeit sein). Die Rolle besteht in erster Linie darin, unser SWA- und Near Patient Care (NPC)-Portfolio aus Instrumenten und Lösungen sowie Kunden- und Mitarbeiterschulung zu unterstützen. Der Umfang der Unterstützung umfasst Kunden und Roche-Kollegen in Großbritannien, Irland, Dänemark, Finnland, Norwegen und Schweden. Sie werden in der Kunst der Fehlerbehebung und Stolz selbst in der Bereitstellung ausgezeichneten Kundenservice. Die Chance
• Fehlerbehebung komplexer analytischer und systemischer Probleme in der Ferne und liefert schnelle und effektive Auflösungen, um Laboroperationen zu schützen.

• Kundenanfragen und -beschwerden verwalten und dokumentieren sorgfältig und gewährleisten eine absolute Abstimmung mit unseren Corporate Quality System Vorschriften.
• Mit funktionsübergreifenden Field Teams und Sales Managern eng zusammenarbeiten, um die Kundenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen und die Retention zu optimieren.
• Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an datengesteuerten Reklamationsrezensionen, Trendanalysen und leistungsmetrischem Tracking, um eine kontinuierliche Serviceverbesserung zu erreichen.
• Assist kommerzielle Teams bei Ausschreibungsprozessen durch die Bereitstellung von schlagzähen Instrumentenvorführungen und technischen Antworten. • Bildungshintergrund: Sie halten einen Abschluss in der Biomedizinischen Wissenschaft oder einem gleichwertigen wissenschaftlichen Bereich.
• Branchenerfahrung: Sie bringen praktische Erfahrungen in einer diagnostischen Industrie oder klinischen Krankenhauslaborumgebung mit einem starken Fokus auf Klinische Chemie oder Immunologie.
• Analytisches Problem Solver: Sie besitzen eine Störungsbehebung Denkweise, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Laborprobleme methodisch anzugehen und unter Druck zu arbeiten.
• Customer Champion & Communicator: Sie sind motiviert, die Erwartungen zu übertreffen, Wissen zu teilen und effektiv in einem reichen, multikulturellen Umfeld zu arbeiten.
• Sprachkenntnisse: Sie sind sowohl schriftlich als auch gesprochen Finnisch und Englisch voll fließend. Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Finnland. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position C'est une excellente occasion pour un scientifique biomédical ou l'équivalent de rejoindre Roche Diagnostics, le leader mondial de la santé chez In-Vitro Diagnostics. Cette position passionnante fait partie du Serum Work Area (SWA) au sein du Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) UK Hub soutenant les systèmes de chimie clinique et d'essai immunologique. Le Centre régional d'assistance à la clientèle basé à Burgess Hill, au Royaume-Uni, fournit un soutien technique et scientifique à notre clientèle à travers le Royaume-Uni, l'Irlande, le Danemark, la Finlande, la Norvège et la Suède. Ce poste est offert comme un rôle de soutien à distance basé en Finlande, idéalement proche de la Roche Diagnostics Bureau d'Oy Espoo, ou encore un bureau basé au Royaume-Uni, Burgess Hill (où l'attente est d'être dans un délai d'une heure de trajet et être dans le bureau la majorité du temps). Le rôle consistera principalement à fournir un support de performance à distance pour notre portefeuille d'instruments et de solutions SWA et Near Patient Care (NPC), ainsi que pour la formation des clients et des employés. Le champ de l'aide comprend les clients et les collègues de Roche au Royaume-Uni, en Irlande, au Danemark, en Finlande, en Norvège et en Suède. Vous excellerez dans l'art de dépanner et vous-même de fournir un excellent service à la clientèle. L'opportunité
• Dépanner les problèmes complexes d'analyse et de système à distance, en fournissant des résolutions rapides et efficaces pour protéger les opérations de laboratoire.
• Mener une formation technique et des produits de haute qualité à l'intention des clients et des collègues internes, à distance et sur des sites de formation désignés.
• Gérer et documenter avec diligence les demandes de renseignements et les plaintes des clients, en assurant l'alignement absolu sur notre système de qualité.
• Collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de terrain et les directeurs commerciaux pour améliorer la satisfaction de la clientèle et optimiser la rétention.
• Participer activement à l'examen des plaintes, à l'analyse des tendances et au suivi des résultats afin d'améliorer continuellement le service.
• Aider les équipes commerciales lors des appels d'offres en leur fournissant des démonstrations d'instruments et des réponses techniques. Il y aura une formation initiale intensive pour les six premiers mois du poste, dont certains seront dans nos centres de formation européens. Par la suite, vous devrez également suivre une formation périodique sur les opérations de soutien à la clientèle et les offres de produits à divers endroits. Qui vous êtes
• Contexte éducatif : vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en sciences biomédicales ou d'un domaine scientifique équivalent.
• Expérience de l'industrie: vous apportez une expérience pratique dans un environnement de laboratoire de diagnostic ou d'hôpital clinique, en mettant l'accent sur la chimie clinique ou l'immunologie.
• Résolveur de problèmes d'analyse: Vous possédez un état d'esprit de dépannage, avec la capacité d'aborder des problèmes de laboratoire complexes méthodiquement et travailler sous pression.
• Client Champion & Communicator: Vous êtes motivé par le dépassement des attentes, le partage des connaissances et le travail efficace dans un environnement riche et multiculturel.
• Connaissance de la langue: Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le finnois et l'anglais. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est la Finlande. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Who we are The internal value chain (IVC) for digital solutions team is acting as a linking pin across the organization to support global lifecycle teams and affiliates in the commercialization of digital solutions. The team is working on building the backoffice foundations for a successful digital business, along the customer journey “Subscribe-to-retire” digital products. The team provides the organization with fit-for-digital operational processes, innovative technology, analytics and global services. Responsabilities
• The position is part of the Internal Value Chain for Digital Solutions and integrated into the IVC Services Chapter
• Perform daily operational business services for digital products
• Collaborate with and provide services to lifecycle teams and affiliates
• Improve and standardize service processes for digital products
• Perform quality checks and measure service maturity
• Safeguard best-in-class operational support for our internal customers
• Provide project support focusing on the Services Responsibility of Operational Services for Lifecycle Teams
• Support product lifecycle teams with day-to-day operational back office processes:
• Material master data management: global master data creation and maintenance in DMS for digital products and services; maintenance of material master extension workflows for operations sites; support in the regional affiliates SAP systems
• Digital products access management: maintain unique form and process for affiliates to request access to cloud-based products; create and maintain admin/user accounts for end-customers; reconcile and extend/terminate accounts based on license agreements
• 3rd party management: execute ordering of integration services from 3rd party supplier per product; coordination and tracking of all steps / stakeholders involved in the process
• UDI & labeling: manage the E2E process for UDI and labeling, work with LCTs to gather all relevant information, create templates and submit data packages Responsibility of Operational Services for Affiliates
• Support affiliates with day-to-day operational back office processes
• Customer-related activities: regular monitoring of the process designed for digital products & services; training of the affiliates; execution of centralized services such as equipment creation
• First level support: support process execution in SAP/REXIS and other linked systems; monitoring of generic support mailbox; train selected key users
• Global commercial backoffice: generation of commercial documents in related systems, such as contracts, equipments, scheduling agreements
• Service quality measurement: calculate KPIs and perform quality checks to ensure effective and efficient service according to the agreed SLAs Responsibility of IVC Project Support
• Support the transformation of current operations to a global, centralized service organization
• Adapt new ways of working in an agile project environment
• Document processes and procedures for business services
• Support training and testing phases
• Identify improvement potential for effective & efficient service operations Who you are:

• Master’s degree preferred

• Commercial and/or finance functions

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Impacto sostenible Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones. La Oportunidad En Roche Diagnóstica buscamos un/a New Account Manager en Lima, Perú, con la misión de conquistar nuevas cuentas y expandir el acceso de más pacientes a soluciones médicas de alta calidad. A través de propuestas de valor disruptivas y modelos comerciales innovadores, serás el motor que impulse soluciones integradas en beneficio de los pacientes, el sistema de salud y la sostenibilidad de nuestra compañía. Responsabilidades:
• Estrategia y análisis de mercado: Evaluar el potencial del mercado, prospectar y segmentar clientes para diseñar estrategias de conquista personalizadas junto a los squads de trabajo.
• Liderazgo de propuestas de valor: Liderar la creación y ejecución de ofertas comerciales integradas que sumen consultoría, soluciones digitales, marketing y disease management .
• Crecimiento de negocio y Market Share: Identificar, desarrollar y cerrar oportunidades de negocio incremental, enfocándose en ganar cuentas de la competencia y expandir la participación de mercado.
• Modelos de negocio innovadores: Colaborar en la implementación de nuevas soluciones de valor y modelos comerciales adaptados a las necesidades específicas del cliente.
• Gestión de visitas clave: Planificar y ejecutar visitas de venta estratégicas bajo el enfoque One Roche Solutions , coordinando con otros roles para unificar mensajes clave y ofertas diferenciadoras.
• Gestión integral de ofertas: Supervisar la preparación de propuestas y ofertas comerciales en conjunto con el equipo de contratos para asegurar cierres exitosos.
• Coordinación interna y campo: Liderar la interacción de los squads de trabajo y coordinar con todas las áreas de la compañía para asegurar la firma del contrato, manteniendo cobertura nacional mediante visitas de campo. Quién eres:
• Título de 3er nivel en ciencias de la salud, negocios, marketing o similar es requerido, Título de 4to nivel de preferencia y nivel medio-alto de idioma inglés.
• Experiencia de 3 años en la industria de la salud, específicamente en diagnóstico. Experiencia de 3 años en funciones comerciales y apertura de nuevos clientes.
• Conocimiento de la dinámica y los participantes del mercado de IVD y de la industria: la problemática y soluciones para el laboratorio. Amplio conocimiento de la tecnología y marcas de los competidores.
• Conocimiento e interés de las áreas analíticas de laboratorio y sus tendencias y actualizaciones. Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Role Purpose The Contract Record Processor is responsible for the upload of contract documents into the global contract database tool (GRACE/Contract Now or MyBuy). This ensures a compliant documentation of all contractual obligations of suppliers and Roche and makes contract related information available throughout the Global Procurement organization. By transmitting relevant contract data into transactional procurement systems this role is also responsible for enabling Shopping Cart and PO processing as well as automated contract call-offs. Thus, the role contributes to overall increase of transparency, data consistency and efficiency, in line with Procurement Strategy and Category objectives. During daily work the Contract Record Processor interacts with other roles to make sure that processes are running smoothly, especially with: Contract Requestor, Transactional Buyer, Contract Manager as well as Contract Record Teamlead and Contract Record SME. Primary responsibilities
• Continuous service delivery: Execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level and in compliance with the SOPs of the respective contract management process and sub-processes. These activities comprise esp. the following:
• Assess contract upload/ update requests.
• Archive contract document by uploading it into contract database.
• Activate contract info.
• Transmit contract data into the operational procurement system, if relevant.
• Maintain contract records.
• Following working instructions: Follow the instructions of the Team Lead regarding the daily work coordination.
• Performance improvement: Contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of the team, by constantly gathering experience and improving the quality of task execution.
• Ticketing tool handling: Utilizing ticketing system for incoming requests and issues during daily service delivery.
• Support end-users and requestors: Support end users and requesters on system related questions, proper system usage, searching contract documents in the system, ensure relevant system usage and solve simple issues, etc.
• Channel process/ system change requests: Route request to relevant colleagues.
• Initiate supplier onboarding: trigger supplier registration in the vendor master data management system. Education, Experience and Skills Required
• Technical High School Diploma or Student of a Professional Career (+1 Year) - (Administration, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Engineer, Supply Chain or similar).
• 2+ years of experience on transactional Demand-to-Pay Process (Procurement buyer, Accounts Payable, Master Data, Contract Management) or Compliance/Legal positions.
• MS Office knowledge.
• Demonstrated problem solving skills.
• Excellent communication skills to varied stakeholder audiences.
• Team player with demonstrated strong interpersonal skills.
• Strong collaborator in a multi-cultural environment.
• Experience implementing legal records governance, classifying documents, archiving, and providing end user training across a broad region
• Requires expertise in working with electronic and hard copy information, and classifying information regardless of medium
• Strong computer skills; familiarity with Microsoft Office and Google suite and database functionality/concepts.
• Strong focus on collaboration and customer service
• Written and spoken fluency in English required Desired
• Experience with Procurement systems e.g. SRM.
• +2 years’ experie

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As an Regulatory Program Manager, you will play a crucial role in bringing innovative treatments to patients by shaping and executing global regulatory strategies. You will join a dynamic, collaborative global team, leading impactful interactions with Health Authorities and industry experts to ensure timely approvals across our product lifecycles. This unique opportunity allows you to influence the broader healthcare environment while fostering a supportive culture of continuous improvement and regulatory excellence. The Opportunity:
• Drive the submission of high-quality CMC regulatory documents to global health authorities, ensuring strict compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and international standards.
• Lead strategic informational and pre-submission meetings with global Health Authorities and partners to facilitate optimal regulatory pathways and accelerate patient access.
• Partner with diverse, cross-functional stakeholders to guide synthetic and biologic products across their lifecycle, ensuring the accuracy of data in regulatory information management systems.
• Ensure that cross-functional team deliverables are completed thoroughly, compliantly, and in a high-quality, timely manner to support the successful approval of Roche products.
• Contribute to regulatory excellence by identifying growth opportunities, mitigating risks, and proactively optimizing departmental business processes.
• Manage and deliver timely, strategic responses to questions received from major global regulators to maintain our right to operate. Who You Are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in a life science discipline (a postgraduate degree is a plus) and bring a minimum of 3 years of industry experience in technical regulatory, manufacturing, or quality fields within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology sectors (biologics experience is highly desired).
• You have a deep technical understanding of drug development, biologics manufacturing, critical quality attributes, control systems, and commercial lifecycle management.
• You are experienced in developing global regulatory strategies, conducting robust risk assessments, and successfully navigating interactions with international Health Authorities.
• You possess outstanding communication and organizational skills, allowing you to synthesize complex issues, make confident decisions, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
• You are an agile, collaborative leader with a proven ability to build trusted, sustainable relationships across multidisciplinary internal departments and with external partners. Additional Information:
• Location: Mississauga site, ON.
• Full time (35 hours per week)
• Hybrid, majority of days in the office. This position is not eligible for relocation support. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 89 256,00 and 117 148,50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il gruppo Pharmaceutical Development DP SM Parenterals è responsabile per lo sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici parenterali molecole sintetiche dalla fase 1 al lancio. Le attività comprendono la formulazione e lo sviluppo del processo di produzione per tutte le fasi cliniche e del mercato, il trasferimento di prodotto e processo a siti di produzione commerciale, così come lo sviluppo di estensione della linea. Stiamo cercando un esperto esperto esperto di svolgere un ruolo di ancoraggio nello sviluppo e nel lancio di formulazioni di peptide parenterali, in particolare all'interno del gruppo Pharmaceutical Development DP SM Parenterals in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) a Basilea. L'opportunità: La posizione richiede una profonda esperienza scientifica e una visione strategica per supportare il portafoglio di sviluppo della droga (perizia CMC) e guidare l'innovazione all'interno di team multifunzionali.
• Sviluppare la roadmap tecnica che definisce le attività per la prontezza dell'industrializzazione del portafoglio peptidi attraverso la collaborazione strategica con gli stakeholder globali
• Consigliare e coordinare i team CMC per lo sviluppo di formulazioni robuste e processi produttivi che gestiscono rischi e mitigazioni per il portafoglio di molecole sintetiche DP parenterali, garantendo una tempestiva consegna delle attività tecniche
• Rimani aggiornato sui progressi nella ricerca del peptide, nella scienza della formulazione e nello sviluppo della droga parenterale per consigliare sulle pratiche all'avanguardia.
• Guidare strategie scientifiche e processi decisionali per fornire piani di sviluppo e di ricerca ottimizzati.
• Personale di mentore e allenatore in preparazione e autore di CTA e nuove applicazioni di droga (NDA).
• Collaborare con gli stakeholder interfunzionali per affrontare le sfide e garantire il successo nei programmi di ricerca e sviluppo. Chi sei?
• Ha un dottorato o master in chimica, chimica / ingegneria del processo, o campi correlati, con un minimo di 6 anni di esperienza nel settore nella formulazione e sviluppo di processo per le forme di dosaggio genitoriale peptide.
• Regime di traccia comprovata dell'autorizzazione delle sezioni di un NDA per i prodotti peptide e dello sviluppo e del lancio di prodotti di combinazione peptide per uso parenterale.
• Profonda competenza in chimica, caratterizzazione a stato solido e campi scientifici correlati.
• Esperienza nelle tecniche analitiche peptide, nei processi produttivi asettici, in scala, nei trasferimenti tecnologici e nella comprensione dei requisiti normativi e di qualità.
• Esperienza diretta nella scrittura e nella revisione dei documenti di origine e presentazione CMC normativi, con una capacità dimostrata di valutare i rischi di programma e di presentazione da una formulazione del prodotto farmaceutico e prospettiva di produzione.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione, con una forte gestione degli stakeholder e la capacità di pensare end-to-end e globalmente.
• Un collaudato team player con una mentalità di problem solving e una passione per l'innovazione nel campo farmaceutico. Siamo alla ricerca di candidati con sede o disposti a trasferirsi a Basilea , con l'attesa di lavorare dall'ufficio un minimo di tre giorni alla settimana. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività, e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter offrire la vita che cambia guarire

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Pharmaceutical Development DP SM Parenterals group is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products Synthetic molecules from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for all clinical stages and the market , the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites,as well as line extension development. We are seeking a seasoned expert to play an anchor role in the development and launch of parenteral peptide formulations, particularly within the Pharmaceutical Development DP SM Parenterals group in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel. The opportunity: The position requires deep scientific expertise and strategic vision to support the drug development portfolio (CMC expertise) and drive innovation within cross-functional teams.
• Develop the technical roadmap defining activities for industrialization readiness for the peptides portfolio through strategic collaboration with global stakeholders
• Advise and coach the CMC teams for the development of robust formulations and manufacturing processes managing risks and mitigations for parenteral DP synthetic molecules portfolio ensuring timely delivery of technical activities
• Stay updated on advancements in peptide research, formulation science, and parenteral drug development to advise on cutting-edge practices.
• Lead scientific strategies and decision-making processes to deliver optimized development and research plans.
• Mentor and coach staff in preparation and authoring of CTA and New Drug Applications (NDAs).
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to address challenges and ensure success in research and development programs. Who You Are:
• You hold a Ph.D. or master’s degree in chemistry, chemical/process engineering, or related fields, with a minimum of 6 years of industry experience in formulation and process development for peptide parenteral dosage forms.
• Proven track record of authoring Drug Product (DP) sections of an NDA for peptide products and developing and launching peptide combination products for parenteral use.
• Deep expertise in chemistry, solid-state characterization, and related scientific fields.
• Experience in peptide analytical techniques, aseptic manufacturing processes, scale-up, technology transfers, and understanding regulatory and quality requirements.
• Direct experience in writing and reviewing regulatory CMC source and submission documents, with a demonstrated ability to assess program and submission risks from a drug product formulation and manufacturing perspective.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to think end-to-end and globally.
• A proven team player with a problem-solving mindset and a passion for innovation in the pharmaceutical field. We are looking for candidates based in or willing to relocate to Basel , with the expectation of working from the office a minimum of three days per week . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healt

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. Die Aktivitäten umfassen die Entwicklung von Formulierungen und Herstellungsprozessen für alle klinischen Phasen und den Markt, die Übertragung von Produkt und Prozess auf kommerzielle Produktionsstätten sowie die Entwicklung von Linienerweiterungen. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Experten, um eine Ankerrolle bei der Entwicklung und dem Start von parenteralen Peptidformulierungen zu spielen, insbesondere innerhalb der Gruppe Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel. Die Gelegenheit: Die Position erfordert fundiertes wissenschaftliches Know-how und strategische Vision, um das Pharma-Entwicklungs-Portfolio (CMC-Expertise) zu unterstützen und Innovationen in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu fördern.
• Entwicklung der technischen Roadmap zur Definition von Aktivitäten für die Industrialisierungsbereitschaft für das Peptidportfolio durch strategische Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Akteuren
• Beratung und Coaching der CMC-Teams für die Entwicklung von robusten Formulierungen und Fertigungsprozessen, die Risiken und Minderungen für das elterliche DP-Synthetische Moleküle-Portfolio verwalten, um eine rechtzeitige Lieferung technischer Aktivitäten sicherzustellen
• Bleiben Sie auf den Fortschritten in der Peptidforschung, der Formulierungswissenschaft und der parenteralen Arzneimittelentwicklung auf dem Laufenden.
• Führen Sie wissenschaftliche Strategien und Entscheidungsprozesse, um optimierte Entwicklungs- und Forschungspläne zu liefern.
• Mentor- und Coachpersonal bei der Vorbereitung und Autorisierung von CTA- und New Drug Applications (NDAs).

• Sie halten einen Doktor oder Master-Abschluss in Chemie, Chemie/Prozess-Engineering oder verwandten Bereichen, mit mindestens 6 Jahren Branchenerfahrung in der Formulierung und Prozessentwicklung für Peptid parenterale Darreichungsformen.
• Nachweis von Nachweisen über die Zulassung von Drug Product (DP)-Abschnitten einer NDA für Peptidprodukte und die Entwicklung und Einführung von Peptidkombinationsprodukten für die parenterale Verwendung.
• Deep Expertise in der Chemie, der Festkörpercharakterisierung und verwandten wissenschaftlichen Bereichen.
• Erfahrung in peptidanalytischen Techniken, aseptischen Fertigungsprozessen, Scale-up, Technologietransfers und Verständnis regulatorischer und Qualitätsanforderungen.
• Direkte Erfahrung in der schriftlichen und Überprüfung von regulatorischen CMC-Quellen- und Einreichungsdokumenten, mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, Programm- und Einreichungsrisiken aus einer Arzneimittelformulierung und Produktionsperspektive zu bewerten.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le groupe Development Pharmaceutical DP SM Parenterals est responsable de la mise au point de produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux. Les activités comprennent la formulation et le développement de procédés de fabrication pour toutes les étapes cliniques et le marché, le transfert de produits et de procédés vers des sites de fabrication commerciaux, ainsi que le développement de prolongements de gamme. Nous recherchons un expert chevronné pour jouer un rôle d'ancrage dans le développement et le lancement de formulations de peptides parentéraux, en particulier au sein du groupe de développement pharmaceutique DP SM Parenterals dans Pharma Technical Development (PTD) à Bâle. L'occasion : Le poste exige une expertise scientifique approfondie et une vision stratégique pour appuyer le portefeuille de développement des médicaments (expertise du CMC) et stimuler l'innovation au sein des équipes interfonctionnelles.
• Élaborer une feuille de route technique définissant les activités de préparation à l'industrialisation du portefeuille de peptides grâce à une collaboration stratégique avec les parties prenantes mondiales
• Conseiller et coacher les équipes du CMC pour le développement de formulations et de procédés de fabrication robustes pour la gestion des risques et des atténuations du portefeuille de molécules synthétiques de PDD parentérales, assurant la prestation rapide des activités techniques
• Restez au courant des progrès de la recherche sur les peptides, de la science de la formulation et de la mise au point de médicaments parentaux afin de vous conseiller sur les pratiques de pointe.
• Diriger les stratégies scientifiques et les processus décisionnels afin d'optimiser les plans de développement et de recherche.
• Mentor et entraîneurs en préparation et en rédaction du CTA et des demandes de drogues nouvelles.
• Collaborer avec les intervenants interfonctionnels pour relever les défis et assurer la réussite des programmes de recherche et de développement. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat ou d'un master en chimie, en génie chimique/procédé ou dans des domaines connexes, avec un minimum de 6 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie dans la formulation et le développement de procédés pour les formes de dosage parentérale peptide.
• Antécédents prouvés de la création de sections de produit pharmaceutique (PD) d'une ADN pour les produits peptides et la mise au point et le lancement de produits combinés peptides pour usage parentéral.
• Expertise approfondie en chimie, caractérisation à l'état solide et domaines scientifiques connexes.
• Expérience des techniques d'analyse des peptides, des procédés de fabrication aseptiques, de l'échelle, des transferts de technologie et de la compréhension des exigences réglementaires et de qualité.
• Expérience directe de la rédaction et de l'examen des documents d'origine et de présentation du CMC, avec une capacité démontrée d'évaluer les risques liés aux programmes et aux présentations du point de vue de la formulation et de la fabrication des produits pharmaceutiques.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration, avec une gestion forte des parties prenantes et la capacité de penser de bout en bout et à l'échelle mondiale.
• Un joueur d'équipe éprouvé avec un état d'esprit de résolution de problèmes et une passion pour l'innovation dans le domaine pharmaceutique. Nous sommes à la recherche de candidats basés dans ou désireux de déménager à Bâle , avec l' attente de travailler du bureau au moins trois jours par semaine . Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des soins qui changent la vie

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring.
