descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Sobre Roche: Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche. Oportunidad:
• Título del Puesto: Becario / Practicante de Farmacoeconomía
• Departamento: Acceso al Mercado / Farmacoeconomía
• Reporta a: Gerente de Farmacoeconomía
• Propósito del Puesto: Brindar soporte técnico y analítico al equipo de Farmacoeconomía en la generación de evidencia local, optimizando los tiempos de entrega de los dosieres de valor y materiales económicos necesarios para el posicionamiento de las terapias de Productos Roche. Responsabilidades:
• Investigación y análisis de datos: Realizar búsquedas sistemáticas de literatura científica, guías clínicas y datos epidemiológicos o de costos locales en fuentes oficiales.
• Soporte en Modelaje: Apoyar en la adaptación, control de calidad y actualización de modelos de impacto presupuestal y costo-efectividad.
• Desarrollo de Entregables: Colaborar en la redacción y armado de secciones técnicas de los dossiers de valor para sometimientos institucionales.
• Gestión de Información: Mantener actualizadas las bases de datos internas del área (precios, competidores, resoluciones institucionales). Quién eres:
• Educación: Estudiante activo de los últimos semestres (con al menos 6 meses a 1 año restante de carrera) en Licenciaturas de Economía, Actuaría, Matemáticas o carreras afines con un fuerte enfoque analítico.
• Habilidades Técnicas: * Manejo de Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado (fórmulas, tablas dinámicas).
• Comprensión de lectura técnica en inglés (indispensable para la revisión de artículos científicos).
• Deseable (no exclusivo): Conocimiento básico o interés en estadística o economía de la salud.
• Competencias: * Atención al detalle y rigurosidad analítica.
• Proactividad y alta capacidad de organización.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Job Purpose : The Customer Care Country Expert is reporting to the Customer Care Team Manager or other Customer Care Leader and is responsible for the technical, analytical, and operational support of the area and coordinating country-related topics. She/He could assist the leader in daily people management tasks and take over deputy functions in case of leader absence. Additionally, it is providing excellent customer front-line assistance through a variety of channels and technology to patients with diabetes, caregivers, and healthcare professionals, understanding their needs and following all the systems and procedures established.

The Opportunity:

• Act as a role model and first point of reference for advisors: provide constructive technical/behavioral feedback, coaching (with the leader), training on country-specific topics, and support in quality management (call audits, documentation checks, complaint handling).

• Ensure smooth daily operations and team administration: oversee day-to-day running, communicate and follow up on operational topics, manage holidays/absences, and replace the leader in their absence.

• Support leadership on country-related topics: participate in country meetings, define and implement operational processes, distribute country tasks, monitor correct application of country procedures, identify training needs, and keep the knowledge base up to date.

• Contribute to people and performance processes: support recruitment (interviews, first selection with P&C); monitor and analyze KPIs; handle escalated customer interactions with exemplary solutions; and maintain outstanding communication with interfaces.

• Deliver high-quality customer service and continuous improvement: process complex technical and marketing-oriented customer requests (incl. diabetes-related inquiries) and complaints per quality and regulatory guidelines; manage CRM workflow objects and data in real time; gather information on new processes; and propose optimizations and special projects.

Who you are:

• Fluent in German and English (other languages a plus), with 3–5+ years’ experience in customer care or similar, ideally within Roche Diabetes Care Customer Care as Expert Advisor (CGM, DMS) and with consolidated knowledge of Roche DC products and solutions.

• Strong analytical and IT skills: role model in IT navigation and fast learning of new technologies, experienced in KPI monitoring and report building, able to develop deep product/service knowledge and work autonomously with sound, quick decision-making.

• Outstanding customer orientation and service mindset, able to handle complex requests, multitask in a dynamic environment, remain agile and flexible to changes, and engage actively in continuous improvement and learning.

• Inspirational people and communication skills: role model in listening and clear communication; understands what motivates people; conveys objectives and expectations; gives constructive feedback and recognition; and contributes positively to team spirit and a pleasant working environment.

• Demonstrated leadership potential and business mindset: proactive in suggesting improvements, actively participating in meetings, supporting team decisions, showing genuine interest in leading people, working with a teamwork attitude, having a humble growth mindset, and having schedule flexibility (including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Be part of our inclusive team at Roche Informatics, where we're driven by a shared passion for technological novelties and optimal IT solutions. As an IT Workplace Services Professional you continuously evaluate and improve the employee experience through subject matter expertise in the digital workplace, focusing on efficiency, employee satisfaction, and ensuring business continuity. This is a varied role and can give you a springboard into other careers in Informatics and beyond.

The Opportunity

• You will act as a digital enabler for our business colleagues & functions

• You act as the owner of the digital employee experience for the respective site

• You drive employee productivity through consultancy, provide intimacy and site proximity at the sites, and ensure a personalized Roche employee experience.

• You leverage available data (e.g.: Nexthink, SNOW) for proactive support

• You support and manage the Incident/ Request management processes to ensure SLAs are met and drive continuous improvement through trend analysis.

• You manage IT hardware lifecycle management & deskside support processes/managed services for the site

• You provide support & guidance for onsite services (e.g. events and meetings) by leveraging from internal and external providers. Drive the user experience and promote best practices.

• You drive and enable standard workplace infrastructure, global/local projects, and deployments in collaboration with product teams.

• You proactively address and follow through on process-improvement ideas

• You support & drive budgeting process related to the respective site

• You support local audit, inspection and certification requirements

• You support local Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery planning activities

Who you are:

• Exhibits a Lean-Agile Mindset

• Manages risks progressively and in a way that leads to opportunity

• Enterprise mindset that can break down silos. Focus on delivery through collaboration, and bringing people together to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries.

• Exhibits intellectual curiosity and integrity and has a strong passion for innovation

• Understanding of Roche-supported operating systems, devices and applications, including the Google Suite of Applications, MS Office, etc.

• Experience with ticketing systems and troubleshooting hardware, software and mobile devices.

• Excellent working knowledge of the ITIL v3 processes in an IT service delivery

• Solid written and oral communication skills in German and English.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a Unix Access Management Engineer (Red Hat IDM) to serve as a trusted technical leader and independent expert within our Enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) team. In this role, you will drive the design, implementation, and optimization of Unix access management infrastructure while leading the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents. You will bridge deep technical expertise with business acumen to champion security excellence across Roche's global identity and access management infrastructure, protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access and cyber threats.

The Opportunity
This position offers a unique blend of strategic influence and hands-on technical leadership within a multicultural, global team. You will work across multiple Identity and Access Management (IAM) products, managing end-to-end security analysis tasks, leading security incidents, and fostering continuous improvement in security operations and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Unix Access Management & Infrastructure Leadership

• Lead the design, integration, and automation of Unix Access Management systems using Red Hat IDM, with Centrify product knowledge a significant advantage

• Provide strategic consultations with stakeholders to identify security requirements, design system integrations, and develop implementation roadmaps for enterprise initiatives

• Lead large-scale migrations of virtual machines to Red Hat IDM infrastructure

• Enable and strengthen Red Hat IDM infrastructure and monitoring capabilities to support high-volume VM environments across cloud and on-premises data centers globally

Security Analysis & Incident Management

• Independently lead analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems, defining security scope and driving root cause analysis

• Participate in and lead troubleshooting efforts as part of 2nd or 3rd level support with 24x7 on-call availability for major and critical issues

• Deliver comprehensive security requirements, designs, and validation of effective controls

• Apply advanced analytical reasoning to identify security patterns and threats

Stakeholder Collaboration & Advisory

• Collaborate with key business partners to understand and address their security needs and concerns

• Act as a trusted advisor, managing relationships with diverse security stakeholders across functional areas

• Define and drive stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops and resolving conflicts

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

• Manage day-to-day Tier 3 operational support, performance optimization, and lifecycle management of Unix access management infrastructure

• Stay current with latest security tools, techniques, and best practices; recommend improvements and strategic enhancements

• Coach and mentor peers and junior colleagues in this technology area

• Proactively shape team processes and contribute to Communities of Practice

Technical & Process Development

• Apply CI/CD methodologies to maintain and develop infrastructure

• Implement ITIL, GxP, Product Management, and Agile Methodologies (Request, Incident, Change, and Problem Management)

• Translate business requirements into strategic implementation plans aligned with organizational objectives

• Apply tools and principles related to requirements analysis, data management, and process optimization

Additional Duties

• Occasional international travel as require

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• At Roche/Genentech Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG), we are
• determined to transform drug development and realize our Pharma Ambition to deliver 20
• transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2029.
• As a key member of our Country Study Start-Up team, you will drive and facilitate the efficient
• initiation of clinical trials, ultimately helping to deliver innovative treatments to patients. You will
• work in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment, where you have the opportunity
• to influence and shape our clinical trial delivery strategy. This is a unique opportunity to use your
• expertise to make a meaningful impact by ensuring seamless trial execution for patients,
• investigators, and clinical site staff.

The Role
• ● Lead Country Strategy: You will lead the country strategy for study start-up, driving
• efficiency, innovation, and collaboration with external stakeholders.
• ● Oversee Operations: You will oversee start-up operations to ensure timely and efficient
• site activation and regulatory compliance.
• ● Drive Process Improvements: You will identify and lead opportunities for process
• automation, standardization, and innovation at both the country and site levels.
• ● Collaborate and Harmonize: You will collaborate with regional and global counterparts
• to harmonize systems and improve timelines.
• ● Manage Clinical Trial Submissions: You will oversee the development and
• management of clinical trial submissions and amendments, ensuring regulatory
• coordination.
• ● Strategize on Budget ; Contracts: You will provide strategic oversight for all aspects
• of budgeting and contract management, including developing budget strategies and
• negotiating with internal and external stakeholders.
• ● Influence the Environment: You will participate in external industry collaborations to
• influence the countrys start-up environment.

Who You Are
• ● You have a degree (MD, PhD, MA/MS, BA/BS) in life sciences or a related field. A postgraduate degree in clinical trials or clinical research is highly desirable.
• ● You have demonstrated experience in clinical trial start-up in Spain, regulatory
• submissions, and cross-functional collaboration.
• ● Proven track record in managing site relationships with a customer centric mindset and
• managing complex clinical trials start-up (e.g. at least 2-year previous experience as a
• Clinical Trial Monitor).
• ● You possess a strong understanding of ICH-GCP, EU CTR, and local regulatory
• environments.
• ● You have excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a
• collaborative mindset.
• ● You are fluent in both written and spoken English, and in Spanish.
• ● Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• ● Ability to travel if needed.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The team provides timely, accurate and decision-relevant information to support the Head of Group Controlling and Accounting, Head of Strategic Finance, Pharma CFO and ultimately the CEO, the Corporate Executive Committee and the Board of Directors in value creation and financial performance management. In addition, it provides timely, accurate and decision-relevant information and analysis of actual and planned financial performance of the Pharmaceutical Division management units.

The Opportunity

The Enterprise Center of Excellence (eCoE) focuses on three areas: delivering a high-level of financial expertise, innovative insights, and an entrepreneurial mindset that enables agility and flexibility for stakeholders.
This role involves preparing presentations for the Pharma Leadership Team and Pharma Finance Leadership Team, alongside supporting the compilation of critical management reports for the Corporate Executive Committee, Board of Directors, and other key decision-makers. You will also assist in analyzing the performance of the Roche Pharma Division, generating valuable insights, and contributing to various ad-hoc financial projects, ensuring all reports are updated and continuously enhanced. Furthermore, you will assist in the preparation of evidence and supporting documents to back-up the reported financial results.

Who You are:

• You are currently enrolled at University studying Finance / Economics or a similar degree, or you completed your degree within the past 12 months prior to the start date.

• You are someone who wants to influence your own development and you are an enthusiastic team player who enjoys working in a global and dynamic environment.

• You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions.

• Exceptional Analytical and Technical Proficiency: Possess strong analytical skills, quick perception, and a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. This includes advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VBA is a plus) and PowerPoint, as well as Google Sheets and Google Slides.

• Adaptability and Resilience: Demonstrate an accurate working style and the ability to perform effectively under pressure and within tight timelines, coupled with an open-minded and flexible attitude.

• Strong Communication and Language Skills: Exhibit excellent command of English, enabling clear and effective communication within a global environment.

• High Motivation and Continuous Learning Mindset: Show outstanding motivation and a strong willingness to continuously learn and develop, reflecting a genuine interest in Finance.

• Proactive and Improvement-Oriented Approach: A growth mindset with a passion for improving the status quo is highly valued, as are IT skills for introducing automation.

Application process:

• Please upload your current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship.

Additional Information:

• Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship.

• Part-time employment is not possible.

• Earliest start date: 1 August 2026 or upon availability

• Duration: 12 months, full- time (40 hours/ week)

• Location: Basel

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses.

The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires up to 25% travel. This person will support Hoover, AL.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Hoover, AL is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses.

The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires up to 25% travel. This person will support Hoover, AL.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

title: Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery

titleByLocale.en: Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery
titleByLocale.it: Capo Team PT Insights & Data Delivery
titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe PT Insights & Data Delivery

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery (Product Manager) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.
Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Description of the area
PT Insights and Data Delivery focuses on the reliable delivery of high quality data combined with the use of data in analytics solutions for both existing and anticipatory business needs with a cross-functional scope and mandate.
The role will lead a team of over 20 people to bring the following key benefits to PT

• Reusable and scalable systems that are efficiently operated

• Faster and more robust solutions to meet business challenges

• Reliable delivery of key metrics and performance indicators

• Identifying areas for cost savings and where to invest

• Data/evidence driven decisions

• Process enabling efficient maintenance of reliable enterprise data

The role will need knowledge and experience in the following areas
Analytics excellence for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality

• Supports business process from Make, Assess to Release

• GMP and Non-GMP Reporting

• Different Levels of Views (Helicopter vs Front Line)

• Enhanced Business Planning

• Self service reporting

• Reducing workload for knowledge workers

• Drive towards actionable insights

• Reliable key performance indicators and metrics

• Comparison across manufacturing sites

Data Delivery for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality

• Reliable and high quality delivery of core manufacturing, supply chain and quality dataDevelopment and support of FAIR data pipelines and data products across PT

• Efficient and reliable DataOps

• Brings together information from multiple systems, so that interdependencies between data can be managed and resolved

Job Responsibilities

• Strategy & Vision
Accountable for setting the direction for a product and ensuring that it achieves defined outcomes and financial objectives. Defines product strategy, roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user needs and organisational policies. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.

• Customer-Centricity
Actively collect, understand, and prioritize the needs of internal users. Act as the primary owner of the “customer's” problem and be responsible for defining and delivering a solution that provides tangible value. Define and track key metrics related to user satisfaction, engagement, and value delivery, and use this data to inform product iterations.

• Product Lifecycle Mgmt.
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, guide its development, and manage its gro

title: Strategic Alliance Manager - Custom Biotech - LA / San Diego Region

titleByLocale.it: Strategic Alliance Manager - Custom Biotech - LA / Regione di San Diego
titleByLocale.en: Strategic Alliance Manager - Custom Biotech - LA / San Diego Region
titleByLocale.de: Manager der strategischen Allianz – Custom Biotech – LA / San Diego Region
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire d'alliance stratégique - Biotech personnalisée - LA / San Diego Region

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità: Basato su oltre 30 anni di esperienza nel settore, Roche Custom Biotech utilizza le potenti competenze multidisciplinari che si trovano nelle strutture Roche di tutto il mondo. Il team offre prodotti e soluzioni per i produttori nel settore della diagnostica e della biotecnologia, che vanno dalle materie prime alle soluzioni di sistema per il bioprocessing. Sfruttando il know-how unico di Roche Diagnostics e Roche Pharmaceuticals, i nostri Strategic Alliance Managers lavorano per collaborare con i leader nei mercati di diagnostica biofarmaceutica, cellulare o in vitro per consentire offerte di approvvigionamento strategico. Lo Strategic Alliance Manager è responsabile per la costruzione, la gestione e l'ottimizzazione dei rapporti con i principali partner strategici, assicurando che le partnership si allineano con gli obiettivi aziendali globali dell'azienda. Questo ruolo coinvolge la collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per guidare iniziative congiunte, massimizzare il valore dei partenariati e promuovere la crescita strategica dell'azienda nei mercati diagnostici biofarmaceutici e molecolari.
• Identificare, valutare e stabilire alleanze strategiche con le aziende farmaceutiche, le imprese di biotecnologia, le organizzazioni di ricerca e altri partner rilevanti sulle opportunità nuove e esistenti.
• Promuovere relazioni forti con i partner esistenti, lavorando a stretto contatto con il vostro leader, Key Account Executives, garantendo una comunicazione coerente, fiducia e allineamento degli obiettivi. Pianificazione e esecuzione strategica
• Collaborare con team interni (ad esempio, leadership di vendita, sviluppo aziendale, regolamentazione, R&D, marketing) per definire obiettivi di partnership e metriche di successo.
• Sviluppare piani di business e strategie per massimizzare il valore delle partnership in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Monitorare e valutare i risultati dell'alleanza, formulando raccomandazioni basate sui dati per migliorare le prestazioni e affrontare le sfide. Collaborazione interfunzionale
• Agire come collegamento tra l'organizzazione e le aziende partner, garantendo una comunicazione e un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità.
• Collaborare con il team di vendita attraverso la rete, l'identificazione del piombo, ecc.
• Coordinare i team interni a fornire impegni di partenariato e pietre miliari, quali progetti di cooperazione, opportunità di licenze congiunte o strategie di immissione sul mercato.
• Sostenere gli sforzi normativi, operativi e logistici legati agli accordi di partenariato. Analisi del mercato & Identificazione delle opportunità
• Condurre l'intelligenza competitiva e il benchmarking del settore per identificare le opportunità di partenariato nei nuovi e emergenti mercati farmaceutici.
• Resta aggiornato sulle tendenze, i progressi tecnologici e i cambiamenti normativi del settore per identificare potenziali nuove partnership o opportunità di espansione. Risoluzione dei problemi e gestione dei rischi
• Affrontare conflitti o sfide in partnership con un approccio orientato alle soluzioni, garantendo un buon progresso verso obiettivi reciproci.
• Monitorare e mitigare i rischi associati alle alleanze, inclusi i rischi di mercato, legale e finanziario. Reporting & Performance Monitoring
• Preparare e presentare recensioni trimestrali e aggiornamenti alla gestione senior o agli stakeholder chiave, evidenziando le prestazioni del partenariato e le raccomandazioni future. Questa è una posizione basata sul campo. Il territorio è all'interno

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity: Building on over 30 years of industry experience, Roche Custom Biotech uses the powerful multidisciplinary skills found in Roche facilities across the world. The team offers products and solutions for manufacturers in the diagnostics and pharma biotech industry, ranging from raw materials to system solutions for bioprocessing. Leveraging the unique know-how of Roche Diagnostics and Roche Pharmaceuticals, our Strategic Alliance Managers work to partner with leaders in the biopharmaceutical, cell therapy, or in vitro diagnostics markets to enable strategic sourcing deals. The Strategic Alliance Manager is responsible for building, managing, and optimizing relationships with key strategic partners, ensuring that partnerships align with the company's overall business objectives. This role involves collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to drive joint initiatives, maximize value from partnerships, and promote the company's strategic growth in the biopharmaceutical and molecular diagnostic markets. Mit dem einzigartigen Know-how von Roche Diagnostics und Roche Pharmaceuticals arbeiten unsere Strategic Alliance Manager zusammen, um mit Führungskräften in den Bereichen Biopharmazeutika, Zelltherapie oder in vitro Diagnostik zusammenzuarbeiten, um strategische Beschaffungsangebote zu ermöglichen. Der Strategic Alliance Manager ist für den Aufbau, das Management und die Optimierung von Beziehungen zu strategischen Partnern verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass Partnerschaften mit den allgemeinen Geschäftszielen des Unternehmens übereinstimmen. • strategische Allianzen mit Pharmaunternehmen, Biotechnologieunternehmen, Forschungsorganisationen und anderen relevanten Partnern über neue und bestehende Möglichkeiten identifizieren, bewerten und etablieren.

• Aktivieren Sie die Verbindung zwischen Organisation und Partnerunternehmen, um eine nahtlose Kommunikation und Koordination zu gewährleisten.

• Bleiben Sie auf Trends, technologischen Fortschritten und regulatorischen Veränderungen in der Branche, um potenzielle neue Partnerschaften oder Erweiterungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren. Problemlösung & Risikomanagement
• Konflikte oder Herausforderungen in Partnerschaften mit einem lösungsorientierten Ansatz ansprechen, um reibungslose Fortschritte in Richtung gegenseitiger Ziele zu gewährleisten.
• Überwachung und Minderung von Risiken im Zusammenhang mit Allianzen, einschließlich Markt-, Rechts- und Finanzrisiken. Reporting & Performance Monitoring
• Vorbereiten und präsentieren vierteljährliche Bewertungen und Aktualisierungen des Senior Managements oder der wichtigsten Stakeholder, was die Leistungsfähigkeit der Partnerschaft und zukünftige Empfehlungen hervorhebt. Dies ist eine feldbasierte Position. Das Gebiet befindet sich in

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. La possibilité : Fort de plus de 30 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie, Roche Custom Biotech utilise les puissantes compétences multidisciplinaires que l'on retrouve dans les installations Roche à travers le monde. L'équipe propose des produits et des solutions aux fabricants de l'industrie du diagnostic et de la biotechnologie pharmaceutique, allant des matières premières aux solutions système pour le biotraitement. Forts du savoir-faire unique de Roche Diagnostics et de Roche Pharmaceuticals, nos gestionnaires d'alliances stratégiques collaborent avec des leaders des marchés biopharmaceutiques, de la thérapie cellulaire ou du diagnostic in vitro pour permettre des contrats d'approvisionnement stratégique. Le gestionnaire de l'Alliance stratégique est chargé d'établir, de gérer et d'optimiser les relations avec les principaux partenaires stratégiques, en veillant à ce que les partenariats cadrent avec les objectifs généraux de l'entreprise. Ce rôle implique la collaboration avec les intervenants internes et externes pour mener des initiatives conjointes, maximiser la valeur des partenariats et promouvoir la croissance stratégique de l'entreprise sur les marchés du diagnostic biopharmaceutique et moléculaire.
• Identifier, évaluer et établir des alliances stratégiques avec des sociétés pharmaceutiques, des entreprises de biotechnologie, des organismes de recherche et d'autres partenaires pertinents sur les possibilités nouvelles et existantes.
• Favoriser des relations solides avec les partenaires existants, travailler en étroite collaboration avec votre chef, les dirigeants de comptes clés, assurer une communication cohérente, la confiance et l'alignement des objectifs. Planification stratégique et exécution
• Collaborer avec des équipes internes (p. ex., direction des ventes, développement des entreprises, réglementation, R-D, marketing) pour définir les objectifs du partenariat et les indicateurs de succès.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Description / Description of the Area Experience- 7+ years Work Location- Baner, Pune We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Developer with strong experience in MuleSoft to support the design, development, and continuous improvement of enterprise integration services. The successful candidate will be responsible for building scalable, secure, and reliable integrations across business-critical systems and platforms. This role combines hands-on development, solution design, API-led connectivity, troubleshooting, stakeholder collaboration, and delivery support within a complex enterprise environment. Key Responsibilities Design and Development
• Design, develop, and maintain integration solutions using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
• Build reusable System, Process, and Experience APIs following API-led connectivity principles.
• Develop integrations between enterprise platforms, cloud services, SaaS applications, and on-premise systems.
• Create reusable assets, shared templates, and accelerators to improve delivery efficiency.
• Contribute to solution architecture decisions focused on scalability, security, maintainability, and performance. API and Platform Engineering
• Design and implement REST, SOAP, asynchronous, file-based, and event-driven integration patterns.
• Develop complex transformations using DataWeave for JSON, XML, CSV, flat-file, and canonical data models.
• Configure API policies for authentication, rate limiting, client enforcement, logging, and threat protection.
• Manage deployments through CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, or hybrid runtimes.
• Use Anypoint Exchange, API Manager, Runtime Manager, Monitoring, Secrets Manager, and related platform services.
• Optimize performance, resilience, error handling, retry logic, and observability of integrations. Support and Operations
• Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for production incidents and platform issues.
• Support release, deployment, change, and environment management activities.
• Monitor integration platform health and proactively address risks or service degradation.
• Ensure documentation of technical solutions, runbooks, and support procedures. Collaboration and Delivery Support
• Work closely with architects, analysts, product teams, infrastructure teams, security, and business stakeholders.
• Translate business requirements into robust technical integration solutions.
• Support agile delivery ceremonies, planning sessions, estimations, and technical reviews.
• Mentor junior developers and contribute to team capability growth. Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities for simplification, modernization, automation, and reuse.
• Stay informed on integration trends, cloud-native architectures, and emerging technologies.
• Promote engineering excellence, coding standards, and secure development practices. Experience
• Proven experience as a Senior Developer, Integration Developer, or similar role.
• Strong hands-on experience delivering solutions on MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
• Proven experience designing and building APIs in enterprise environments.
• Experience integrating ERP, CRM, identity, data, or other core enterprise platforms.
• Experience working in complex enterprise delivery environments with multiple stakeholders.
• Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, finance, or similar sectors is highly valued. Technical Skills
• Strong experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Studio, API M

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Job Purpose : The Customer Care Country Expert is reporting to the Customer Care Team Manager or other Customer Care Leader and is responsible for the technical, analytical, and operational support of the area and coordinating country-related topics. She/He could assist the leader in daily people management tasks and take over deputy functions in case of leader absence. Additionally, it is providing excellent customer front-line assistance through a variety of channels and technology to patients with diabetes, caregivers, and healthcare professionals, understanding their needs and following all the systems and procedures established.

The Opportunity:

• Act as a role model and first point of reference for advisors: provide constructive technical/behavioral feedback, coaching (with the leader), training on country-specific topics, and support in quality management (call audits, documentation checks, complaint handling).

• Ensure smooth daily operations and team administration: oversee day-to-day running, communicate and follow up on operational topics, manage holidays/absences, and replace the leader in their absence.

• Support leadership on country-related topics: participate in country meetings, define and implement operational processes, distribute country tasks, monitor correct application of country procedures, identify training needs, and keep the knowledge base up to date.

• Contribute to people and performance processes: support recruitment (interviews, first selection with P&C); monitor and analyze KPIs; handle escalated customer interactions with exemplary solutions; and maintain outstanding communication with interfaces.

• Deliver high-quality customer service and continuous improvement: process complex technical and marketing-oriented customer requests (incl. diabetes-related inquiries) and complaints per quality and regulatory guidelines; manage CRM workflow objects and data in real time; gather information on new processes; and propose optimizations and special projects.

Who you are:

• Fluent in German and English (other languages a plus), with 3–5+ years’ experience in customer care or similar, ideally within Roche Diabetes Care Customer Care as Expert Advisor (CGM, DMS) and with consolidated knowledge of Roche DC products and solutions.

• Strong analytical and IT skills: role model in IT navigation and fast learning of new technologies, experienced in KPI monitoring and report building, able to develop deep product/service knowledge and work autonomously with sound, quick decision-making.

• Outstanding customer orientation and service mindset, able to handle complex requests, multitask in a dynamic environment, remain agile and flexible to changes, and engage actively in continuous improvement and learning.

• Inspirational people and communication skills: role model in listening and clear communication; understands what motivates people; conveys objectives and expectations; gives constructive feedback and recognition; and contributes positively to team spirit and a pleasant working environment.

• Demonstrated leadership potential and business mindset: proactive in suggesting improvements, actively participating in meetings, supporting team decisions, showing genuine interest in leading people, working with a teamwork attitude, having a humble growth mindset, and having schedule flexibility (including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Job Purpose : The Customer Care Country Expert is reporting to the Customer Care Team Manager or other Customer Care Leader and is responsible for the technical, analytical, and operational support of the area and coordinating country-related topics. She/He could assist the leader in daily people management tasks and take over deputy functions in case of leader absence. Additionally, it is providing excellent customer front-line assistance through a variety of channels and technology to patients with diabetes, caregivers, and healthcare professionals, understanding their needs and following all the systems and procedures established.

The Opportunity:

• Act as a role model and first point of reference for advisors: provide constructive technical/behavioral feedback, coaching (with the leader), training on country-specific topics, and support in quality management (call audits, documentation checks, complaint handling).

• Ensure smooth daily operations and team administration: oversee day-to-day running, communicate and follow up on operational topics, manage holidays/absences, and replace the leader in their absence.

• Support leadership on country-related topics: participate in country meetings, define and implement operational processes, distribute country tasks, monitor correct application of country procedures, identify training needs, and keep the knowledge base up to date.

• Contribute to people and performance processes: support recruitment (interviews, first selection with P&C); monitor and analyze KPIs; handle escalated customer interactions with exemplary solutions; and maintain outstanding communication with interfaces.

• Deliver high-quality customer service and continuous improvement: process complex technical and marketing-oriented customer requests (incl. diabetes-related inquiries) and complaints per quality and regulatory guidelines; manage CRM workflow objects and data in real time; gather information on new processes; and propose optimizations and special projects.

Who you are:

• Fluent in German and English (other languages a plus), with 3–5+ years’ experience in customer care or similar, ideally within Roche Diabetes Care Customer Care as Expert Advisor (CGM, DMS) and with consolidated knowledge of Roche DC products and solutions.

• Strong analytical and IT skills: role model in IT navigation and fast learning of new technologies, experienced in KPI monitoring and report building, able to develop deep product/service knowledge and work autonomously with sound, quick decision-making.

• Outstanding customer orientation and service mindset, able to handle complex requests, multitask in a dynamic environment, remain agile and flexible to changes, and engage actively in continuous improvement and learning.

• Inspirational people and communication skills: role model in listening and clear communication; understands what motivates people; conveys objectives and expectations; gives constructive feedback and recognition; and contributes positively to team spirit and a pleasant working environment.

• Demonstrated leadership potential and business mindset: proactive in suggesting improvements, actively participating in meetings, supporting team decisions, showing genuine interest in leading people, working with a teamwork attitude, having a humble growth mindset, and having schedule flexibility (including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.

descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir sind Roche

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Hinter jeder Diagnose steht ein Mensch und seine Geschichte. Deshalb ist es unser Ziel bei Roche, Patienten und deren Angehörige auf ihrem Weg ideal zu begleiten.

Werde Teil eines unserer Lifecycle Teams in Near Patient Care ! Die herausragende Vielfalt der angewandten Technologien bietet dir großartige Lernmöglichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir wollen wir jetzt schon tun, was Patienten als nächstes benötigen!

In deiner Funktion als Produktionsmitarbeiter/Operator im Bereich NPC Internal Manufacturing Mannheim bist du primär für das Bedienen komplexer Produktionseinrichtungen zuständig.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du bedienst Bereichsübergreifend Abfüll-, Etikettier,- Fertigungs- und Verpackungsanlagen zur Produktion von diagnostischen Produkten

• Das prüfst die zur Produktion eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Reinigung der Produktionsanlagen und Betriebsmittel unter Berücksichtigung geltender Arbeitsanweisungen

• Gemäß geltender Regularien führst du Inprozesskontrollen durch und dokumentierst diese GMP-konform

• Durch Deine aktive Mitarbeit erkennst Du auftretende Qualitätsmängel, führst vorgeschriebene Stichprobenprüfungen, Musterziehungen und optische Kontrollen durch und arbeitest aktiv am kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess mit.

• Du behebst einfache technische Störungen und übernimmst einfache Umrüstungen

• Alle Aufgaben führst Du unter Beachtung der Arbeitsanweisungen, Hygienevorschriften, Arbeitsschutz-, GMP- und Umweltschutzregeln durch

• Das Arbeiten mit einer FFP3- Maske und einem Gebläse-Atemschutz stellt für Dich kein Problem dar.

• Ver- und Entsorgung der Produktionsbetriebe durch Materialanforderung/-transport, die sachgerechte Kennzeichnung sowie die Entsorgung des Materials liegen in deiner Verantwortung. Dabei nutzt Du manuelle und/oder angetriebene Transportmittel.

• Die Tätigkeit erfordert ständiges Stehen und das tägliche, regelmäßige Heben und Bewegen von schweren Lasten bis 15 kg (unter Umständen bis 28kg).

Das bringst Du mit:

• Eine Berufsausbildung hast Du erfolgreich abgeschlossen und besitzt mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem Produktions- oder Verpackungsbetrieb

• Mit Deinem technischen Geschick überzeugst Du ebenso wie mit Deinen detaillierten Kenntnissen über die zu bedienenden Produktionsanlagen.

• Du verfügst über gute GMP-Kenntnisse sowie über praktische Erfahrung im Arbeiten in Bereichen mit besonderen Hygieneanforderungen (z. B. Produktion in einem Reinraum ISO 8 oder höher).

• Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse über manuelle Arbeit mit Kleinteilen in der Musterfertigung mit und hast bereits Erfahrung mit Arbeit an Messmikroskop

• In den gängigen Google Suite und MS Office Programmen bist Du sicher. Auch der sichere Umgang mit SAP und MES ist für Dich kein Problem. Du hast ein Grundverständnis für elektronische Abbildungen in prozessgesteuerten Anlagen.

• Deine Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in verschiedenen Produktionsteams sowie Dein Engagement zeichnet Dich aus.

• Du verfügst über Transportkenntnisse mit Flurförderfahrzeugen oder Gabelstapler.

• Du arbeitest gerne in wechselnden Arbeitszeiten (3-Schicht), um auf Produktionsänderungen entsprechend flexibel reagieren zu können. Auch die Bereitschaft zur Wochenendarbeit ist

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position En Roche , estamos comprometidos con la excelencia en el área de Neurociencias. Buscamos un profesional con visión estratégica y capacidad analítica para integrarse como Marketing Specialists para el portafolio de Neurociencias. Este rol es una pieza clave en la coordinación transfuncional para el diseño, ejecución y éxito de las estrategias de mercadotecnia en todo el ciclo de vida del producto. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
• Strategic Execution: Brindar soporte en la implementación de estrategias de portafolio, segmentación y targeting, colaborando estrechamente con Patient Journey Partners (PJP) para asegurar el posicionamiento de marca.
• Business Intelligence & Forecasting: Desarrollo de pronósticos mensuales de ventas y pacientes por canal, realizando un seguimiento riguroso de indicadores clave (KPIs) frente a los objetivos establecidos.
• Product Launch & Pipeline: Asegurar la ejecución impecable de lanzamientos y extensiones de línea, gestionando la logística y la administración presupuestaria (P&L).
• Compliance & Content Creation: Desarrollar materiales promocionales y de entrenamiento bajo estrictos estándares de Compliance , gestionando el proceso de aprobación e implementación en sistemas como Veeva .
• Stakeholder Management: Coordinar esfuerzos con áreas cross-funcionales (Médico, Comercial, Legal y Finanzas) y gestionar relaciones con proveedores estratégicos para Market Research.
• Operational Excellence: Liderar la planificación y ejecución logística de eventos de educación médica continua y programas de pacientes, asegurando el cumplimiento de tiempos y presupuestos.
• Digital Marketing: Generar materiales y colaborar en la estrategia omnichannel en conjunto con el Marketing Manager, para lograr el mejor impacto de la estrategia. Tu perfil: Buscamos candidatos con un alto sentido de responsabilidad, atención al detalle y mentalidad de crecimiento:
• Licenciaturas económicas administrativas, ingenieras industriales o afines
• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (capacidad de interactuar en entornos globales).
• Experiencia previa en la industria farmacéutica. Dominio de google environment, paqueteria microsoft, capacidad de análisis de datos y comprensión de auditorías de mercado.
• Manejo de Veeva, SAP, Simple buy es un diferencial
• Comunicación asertiva e influencia. Pensamiento analítico y orientación a resultados. Resiliencia y gestión del cambio.
• Capacidad de colaboración en equipos multidisciplinarios. Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a member of the Safety Development & Processes (SDP) team within Product Development Safety, you will lead the evolution of global processes that enable world-class safety and vigilance activities across Roche’s drug and device development portfolio.. In this influential role, you will operate as a Global Process Owner or senior subject-matter expert, shaping the frameworks that underpin our safety activities for medicines, devices, and digital health solutions. You will drive strategic innovation and process excellence to ensure Roche remains at the forefront of patient safety and regulatory compliance. The Opportunity As the Safety Process Director / Senior Director, you will design and govern the global operating models that translate complex safety requirements into scalable, high-impact clinical and post-marketing practices. This role is internally known as Safety Process Director/Senior Director.
• Lead the design and continuous improvement of global safety processes, ensuring they remain robust, agile, and aligned with industry-leading standards.
• Act as a Global Process Owner or senior expert for complex safety and vigilance activities, providing strategic direction across the organization.
• Partner with key stakeholders , including Safety Science Leaders, the QPPV/PRRC offices, and cross-functional global teams to harmonize safety initiatives.
• Drive process innovation by identifying opportunities to strengthen Roche’s safety capabilities and participating in external industry collaborations.
• Translate scientific and regulatory foundations of Signal Management and Risk Management into effective global safety practices.
• Influence internal governance discussions to ensure safety and vigilance practices support the safe development of innovative medicines and digital health solutions. Who you are You are a strategic leader who thrives in a global matrix environment, combining deep technical expertise in Safety Science with the ability to coach and catalyze change across organizational boundaries.
• You hold a degree in Medicine, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• You bring extensive experience in Pharmacovigilance and Safety Science, with deep expertise in Signal Management and Risk Management.
• You possess a strong command of global pharmacovigilance and safety regulations (such as FDA, EMA, and MHRA).
• You have a proven track record of leading complex initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders to drive strategic improvement. We look forward to your application. This role is based onsite at our Welwyn, United Kingdom office. Our team follows a hybrid work structure, requiring a fixed number of onsite days per week. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A equipe de FEP atua como o braço analítico e financeiro junto às áreas de Vendas e Marketing. O escopo do time de FEP é estritamente focado em governança comercial, precificação corporativa ( Pricing ), gestão de capital de giro ( Working Capital ) e maximização da rentabilidade. A Oportunidade: Como Estagiário(a) de FEP no time de NPC, você atuará como um co-piloto estratégico de Vendas e Marketing, focando na linha de frente dos negócios. O dia a dia envolve o suporte à modelagem de business cases, análises de precificação e gestão da saúde financeira (AR/AP) de clientes Retail e Non-Retail.
• Modelagem Financeira: Suportar a estruturação e análise de business cases para avaliar a viabilidade financeira e a margem de contribuição de novos contratos comerciais e participação em pregões públicos.
• Gestão de Receita: Auxiliar no acompanhamento de KPIs dos portfólios de NPC, monitorando os impactos de descontos e verbas comerciais na rentabilidade das linhas de produto.
• Capital de Giro e Risco: Apoiar no controle e a visibilidade dos indicadores de Contas a Receber (análise de aging e DSO) e Contas a Pagar comerciais, garantindo a correta alocação e conciliação de provisões ( accruals ).
• Reporte Gerencial: Auxiliar na consolidação de bases de dados financeiras, atualizar dashboards de performance de vendas e auxiliar na automação de rotinas analíticas para os fóruns de revisão de resultados com as áreas de negócios. Quem é você:
• Você está cursando graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas (com previsão de formatura a partir de Dezembro/2027).
• Você possui domínio de Excel, incluindo o uso de funções lógicas, manipulação de grandes bases de dados e noções de modelagem financeira.
• Você tem nível de inglês intermediário ou avançado. Desejável:
• Você possui conhecimento em Power BI, LookerStudio, macros (VBA) ou outras ferramentas de visualização/manipulação de dados (considerado um diferencial competitivo). Informações Adicionais:
• Local de Trabalho: Zona Sul de São Paulo;
• Modelo de Trabalho: Atuação em modelo híbrido, presencial 3x por semana *Benefícios de relocalização não estão disponíveis para esta vaga. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. • Modelagem Financeira: Suportar a estruturação e análise de business cases para avaliar a viabilidade financeira e a margem de contribuição de novos contratos comerciais e participação em pregões públicos.
• Gestão de Receita: Auxiliar no acompanhamento de KPIs dos portfólios de NPC, monitorando os impactos de descontos e verbas comerciais na rentabilidade das linhas de produto.

• Reporte Gerencial: Auxiliar na consolidação de bases de dados financeiras, atualizar dashboards de performance de vendas e auxiliar na automação de rotinas analíticas para os fóruns de revisão de resultados com as áreas de negócios. Quem é você:

• Você possui domínio de Excel, incluindo o uso de funções lógicas, manipulação de grandes bases de dados e noções de modelagem financeira.
• Você tem nível de inglês intermediário ou avançado. Desejável:
• Você possui conhecimento em Power BI, LookerStudio, macros (VBA) ou outras ferramentas de visualização/manipulação de dados (considerado um diferencial competitivo). Informações Adicionais:

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. That’s what motivates us to innovate. Continuously promote science and ensure that everyone has access to the health care they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Talent Acquisition Partner , you will work across borders within an empowered, self-organized environment. You will support team development and deliver exceptional candidate and stakeholder experiences by leveraging diverse talent and specialized expertise. About the opportunity:
• Drive end-to-end standardized recruiting processes across multiple Latin American countries, delivering customized talent acquisition solutions, proactive sourcing, pipelining, and seamless candidate experiences.
• Manage the complete offer and negotiation process with all necessary stakeholders according to local specifications, ensuring compliance, creating proposals, and aligning with our total rewards strategy while securing internal approvals.
• Elevate customer value across the People & Culture suite by incorporating core behaviors and key metrics into every interaction with Hiring Managers, candidates, and stakeholders.
• Influence high-quality hiring decisions by focusing on the moments that matter most in the candidate journey and driving strategic talent conversations to enhance organizational efficiency.
• Leverage a scaled, AI-ready, and knowledge-sharing culture, utilizing and mastering advanced applicant tracking and sourcing tools such as Workday, Phenom People, and LinkedIn.
• Contribute directly to global recruiting priorities by participating in upskilling, talent exchange, or knowledge-sharing activities. Who you are:
• 4+ years of recruiting experience in a corporate, biotech, or pharmaceutical setting, with a required University Degree.
• Trilingual fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English (mandatory).
• Expertise in progressive sourcing options (direct sourcing, web recruitment tools, networking, diversity recruiting) and a proven track record in proactive talent acquisition.
• Demonstrated experience in end-to-end Talent Acquisition across Latin America within corporate or agency settings.
• Technical proficiency in ATS systems, with a preference for Workday and Phenom, alongside offer process and systems management.
• Strong business acumen combined with stakeholder management, consultative problem-solving, communication and influencing skills.
• Agile mindset with the flexibility to adapt, move, and support different functions/capabilities as needed within a matrix environment. Location: São Paulo – Hybrid model. Relocation benefits are not available for this position. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position Présentation de l'équipe : Rattaché(e) au directeur de l’Unité Accès Regional au sein de la Direction Accès, Affaires Publiques et Communication, ta mission sera de garantir l'accès à notre portefeuille produits Roche auprès des établissements de soins et des officines, dans les meilleures conditions et dans le respect du bon usage, au bénéfice des patients. Quel sera ton impact ? En étroite collaboration avec les autres équipes de la direction Accès, Affaires Publiques et Communication (accès national, médicoéconomie…), les autres unités de l’entreprise (médical, marketing produit, omnicanalité…) et les squad parcours, tu contribueras : ● Lancement de produits innovants : Coordonner les référencements hospitaliers ou mise en place grossiste-répartiteur, en partenariat avec les équipes produits et les équipes terrain ● Lien ville-hôpital : Développer des solutions d'accompagnement pour les produits prescrits à l’hôpital et dispensés en ville, afin d’assurer une bonne coordination entre la ville et l'hôpital (pharmaciens, URPS, DAC, OMEDIT…). ● Nouvelles initiatives : Contribuer à faire évoluer notre offre et nos services par des propositions différenciantes (événements, site internet, dispositifs d’accompagnement), et à leur communication interne et externe en capitalisant sur les différents canaux de communication (omnicanalité). ● Gestion de projets marketing : Soutenir la création de Newsletters, d'événements et d'outils pour l'équipe terrain (slidedecks, brochures). ● Veille active : Surveiller l'environnement de l'accès aux soins en ville et à l'hôpital et anticiper les changements impactant notre écosystème. ● Analyse d'impact : Mesurer les résultats des actions menées à l'aide d'indicateurs pertinents. Ton ADN
• Tu es de formation supérieure scientifique et tu recherches une alternance pour ton master en marketing ou école de commerce

descriptionByLocale.it: Rock - Descrizione del lavoro Mansioni - Impacto sostenible: Contribuire a soluzioni che sostengono ai desafíos più urgenti della salute riducendo l'impatto sul pianeta. - Liderare la strategia di accesso e poliche pubbliche per il portafolio di Roche Diagnóstica nella regione di Ecuador e Perú-PEC. - Responsabilità: - Strategia di Accesso e Valor: Disegnare ed eseguire il Piano di Accesso per prodotti di alto valore medico, anticipationando le tendenze del mercato per definire proposte di valore innovativo che accelerino la loro inclusione. - Relazione di Livello Alto e Influenza: Costruire relazioni strategiche con Leader di Opinione (KOLs), società scientifique e authority à governance per guidare la partecipazione dell'azienda nella modifica delle poliche pubbliche e dei quadri normativi. - Mappatura degli Stakeholder e Percorso del Paziente: Piattaformare la mappatura degli attori chiave e delle istituzioni obiettivi, analizzando il percorso del paziente peridentice le priorità cliniche e le nuove opportunità di crescita. - Economia della Salute (HECON): Implementationare gli strumenti di economia della salute e i modelli di costo-beneficio per posizionare strategyemente il portafolio nelle competenze di salute della regione Perú e Ecuador. - Liderazgo Científico y de Opinión: Acte come il principale esperto scientifico del portafolio, diffondendo l'evidenza clinica attraverso le pubblicazioni, i façelli di esperti e diffusondo le esigenze dei pazienti e dei professionali in strategy di business. - Collaborazione Transversale: Lavorare in assenza con i team commerciali, di strategia e finanza per agevolare i processi di accesso e massimizzare le opportunità commerciali del portafolio. Obbligo - Professionista in Scienze della Salute, Amministrazione delle Imprese o corsi affini, con dominio Avvio del linguaggio inglese (parlato e scritto). - Più di 3 anni nell'industria farmaceutica o dell'assistenza sanitaria, guidando i ruoli di Accesso al Mercato e Politica Pubblica. - Profonda comprensione del sistema di saluto peruviano-escuadoriano, nonché la sua normativa e gli storeholder necessari per l'ecosistema della salutee. - Visione strategica e sistemica, con capacità dimostrate di incorrere e ispirare attraverso la leadership collaborazioniativo. - Desiderabile: - Studi aggiuntivi o specializzazione in Economy della Salute e Politiche Pubbliche. - Trayectoria comprovada in metodologías ágiles y colaboración en equipos multidisciplinarios. Contatto I dettagli sulla trasparenza della percezione sono forniti sulla base della posizione di pubblicazione principale. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Quito. Se sei interessato ad altre posizioni in cui il ruolo potrebbe essere disponibile, perniamo i dettagli sulla concessione pendente il processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge è stato innovativo. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a lontano avanzare la scienza, guarantorendo che tutti hanno accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future.
