At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Impacto sostenible Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones. La Oportunidad Liderar la estrategia de acceso y políticas públicas para el portafolio de Roche Diagnóstica en la región de Ecuador y Perú-PEC. En este rol, serás el principal experto ante el Ministerio de Salud y aseguradoras así como otros stakeholders relevantes para el sistema de salud, generando evidencia clínica de alto impacto para reducir barreras y crear oportunidades en el sistema de salud y garantizar que nuestras innovaciones lleguen a quienes más las necesitan. Responsabilidades
• Estrategia de Acceso y Valor: Diseñar y ejecutar el Plan de Acceso para productos de alto valor médico, anticipando tendencias del mercado para definir propuestas de valor innovadoras que aceleren su adopción.
• Relacionamiento de Alto Nivel e Influencia: Construir relaciones estratégicas con Líderes de Opinión (KOLs), sociedades científicas y autoridades gubernamentales para liderar la participación de la compañía en la modificación de políticas públicas y marcos regulatorios.
• Mapeo de Stakeholders y Ruta del Paciente: Desarrollar el mapeo de actores clave e instituciones objetivo, analizando el journey del paciente para identificar prioridades clínicas y nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento.
• Economía de la Salud (HECON): Implementar herramientas de economía de la salud y modelos de costo-beneficio para posicionar estratégicamente el portafolio en las entidades de salud de la región Perú y Ecuador.
• Liderazgo Científico y de Opinión: Actuar como el principal experto científico del portafolio, difundiendo evidencia clínica a través de publicaciones, paneles de expertos y traduciendo las necesidades de los pacientes y profesionales en estrategias de negocio.
• Colaboración Transversal: Trabajar en sinergia con los equipos comerciales, de estrategia y finanzas para agilizar los procesos de acceso y maximizar las oportunidades comerciales del portafolio. Quién Eres

• Más de 3 años en la industria farmacéutica o del cuidado de la salud, liderando roles de Acceso al Mercado y Política Pública.
• Profundo entendimiento del sistema de salud peruano- ecuatoriano, así como su normativa y los stakeholders relevantes para el ecosistema de salud
• Visión estratégica y sistémica, con capacidad demostrada para influir e inspirar a través del liderazgo colaborativo. Deseable
• Estudios adicionales o especialización en Economía de la Salud y Políticas Públicas.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department is responsible for workflow optimization and successfully integrating hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.

As a Development Engineer, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team, working on Nucleic Acid Purification, PCR and Sequencing, on developing complex diagnostics systems. You will perform hands-on experiments, Hardware (HW) and Software (SW) testing, including evaluation of system performance, error handling, and reliability improvements.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today, and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Plan and execute the work packages within the area of responsibility, including reporting and escalating issues to management.

• Subject matter expert for an assigned area of responsibility. Provide guidance and support to team members.

• Generate required documentation/procedures/technical reports.

• Prepare and deliver presentations of project results to team and management.

• Experimental design and execution of the experiments in the biosafety levels S1 and S2 laboratory.

• Creation of Test Cases based on Product Requirements. Execution of Test Cases, analysis of the results, and creation of the respective regulatory documents. Issue tracking and verification of bug fixes/Anomalies.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems. Document and maintain software functionality.

• Coordinate efforts with other functional areas to accomplish tasks: Hardware, Software-, Consumables-and Assay-Development.

Who you are

You are someone who wants to influence your development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. A job title is not considered the final definition of who you are but the starting point.

The ideal candidate for our dynamic, international team will have the following skills and experience:

• Degree in a relevant life science discipline (e.g. (e.g. biology, biotechnology, biomedical informatics, engineering related to life sciences) or corresponding job experience

• Interest in resolving technical problems and interdisciplinary teamwork

• Experience and willingness to work in a highly regulated industry and labs with biosafety levels S1 and S2.

• Familiarity with or strong interest in software and engineering applications and tools .

• Enthusiastic team player with good communication and collaboration skills. Solution-oriented, autonomous, and proactive working style.

• Proven experience in laboratory diagnostics and/or service & support, as well as supporting HW and SW, are additional assets.

• Working knowledge of English (written and spoken), and German a strong asset

titleByLocale.it: Business Architetto – Platform Strategy and Transformation
titleByLocale.de: Business Architect – Platform Strategy and Transformation
titleByLocale.fr: Business Architecte – Platform Strategy and Transformation

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams.
Your tasks and Responsibilities

• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.

• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.

• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.

• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness.

Who you are

• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.

• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.

• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del servizio di consegna - RDT Pharma Technical Operations

titleByLocale.de: Delivery Service Manager - RDT Pharma Technical Operations

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Delivery Services Manager leads the delivery and operational continuity of digital solutions supporting Pharma Technical Development (PTD) systems transitioning to RDT TechOps. In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery management of a portfolio of GMP and non-GMP applications – ensuring service stability, compliance readiness, and stakeholder alignment throughout the knowledge transfer and steady-state operations. You will also act as IT Product Owner for your assigned systems, bridging the gap between business needs and technical execution. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as: Service Manager, Delivery Service Manager, and Technical Product Owner. The Opportunity In this role, you will be responsible for:
• Delivery & Service Ownership: Lead the end-to-end delivery and operational management of assigned PTD systems – including GMP-critical applications clinical manufacturing solutions at the intersection of process development and manufacturing – ensuring continuity, compliance, and performance throughout and after the transition from PTD to RDT TechOps.
• IT Product Ownership: Act as IT Product Owner for assigned systems, defining and prioritizing the product backlog, managing vendor relationships, and ensuring delivery is aligned with business value and regulatory requirements.
• GMP Compliance Awareness: Operate with a strong understanding of GMP-regulated environments, ensuring that all delivery activities, system changes, and documentation practices meet applicable quality and compliance standards.
• Knowledge Transfer Leadership: Drive structured knowledge transition from outgoing PTD resources, ensuring documentation, runbooks, and operating procedures are captured and validated before go-live.
• Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong working relationships with PTD business stakeholders, TechOps leadership, MSP vendors, and RDT product teams – acting as the primary point of contact for your assigned systems.
• Vendor & MSP Coordination: Manage third-party service providers and system integrator partners supporting your portfolio, ensuring SLA adherence and value delivery.
• Continuous Improvement: Identify and drive process improvements across delivery operations, contributing to the maturity of the broader RDT TechOps model.
• Agile Execution: Apply Agile methodologies to manage delivery cadence, facilitate ceremonies, and maintain transparency across workstreams. Who you are You are a delivery-oriented professional with a hands-on approach and a passion for operational excellence in regulated digital environments. You bring:
• Proven experience in a Delivery Management or Service Management role, ideally within a pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated industry context.
• A University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Information Technology, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience managing GMP or GxP-regulated systems, with an understanding of validation requirements and change control processes.
• Strong IT Product Owner capabilities, including backlog management, stakeholder prioritization, and vendor governance.
• Experience managing third-party technology providers and system integrator partners.
• Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive decisions in complex environments.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As an Operational Specialist in Treasury & AR , you will play a vital role within our Finance Shared Service Center. You will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial transactions while supporting the broader Treasury and Accounts Receivable functions. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is committed to continuous process improvement. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Operational Execution: Coordinate and support stringent financial tasks, including daily bank postings, interface controls, manual corrections, and the reconciliation of bank and bank suspense balance sheet accounts.
• AR & Treasury Management: Execute customer direct debit payments, cash allocation, and the clearing of AR and bank suspense accounts. You will be responsible for posting and reconciling treasury and AR transactions.
• Accounting & Compliance: Perform day-to-day activities according to agreed service levels and SOPs. This includes AR manual invoicing, GL journal posting, account reconciliations, and FX revaluation.
• Reporting & Communication: Manage intercompany reconciliation and reporting. You will handle incoming calls and emails from stakeholders in a timely, professional manner.
• Team Collaboration: Proactively seek opportunities for effective cooperation across teams and geographies. Provide support to team members to balance workloads and foster a positive team environment.
• Continuous Improvement: Propose process and system improvements and contribute to the overall performance of the Shared Service Center (SSC) through active participation in workshops and meetings. Who you are: You are a finance professional with a solid understanding of accounting processes, a customer-service mindset, and the ability to work effectively with limited direction. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: University or College degree, with a concentration in Finance or Accounting .
• Experience: 3-5 years of experience in Finance and Accounting .
• Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with Finance Shared Services and operational accounting processes. Knowledge of technology systems such as SAP and BlackLine is highly desired.
• Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish is required. Proficiency in Portuguese and/or French is a plus.
• Skills: * Strong ability to prioritize and organize work to meet tight deadlines.
• Excellent analytical, presentation, and communication skills.
• Ability to multitask and manage up effectively.
• High level of integrity and commitment to complying with corporate guidelines. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity The Head of US Government Affairs & Policy leads Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and public policy strategy, shaping the legislative and regulatory environment to advance innovation, protect market access, influence healthcare policy, and mitigate risk. Based in Washington, D.C., this executive serves as Roche Diagnostics’ principal representative to policymakers, regulatory agencies, trade associations and external stakeholders, while acting as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on political and policy developments affecting the business. This role reports to the Global Head of Quality, Regulatory & External Affairs, with a dotted-line relationship to the President and CEO, Roche Diagnostics North America. KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Policy Strategy & Advocacy
• Develop and lead Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and policy strategy aligned with business priorities.
• Influence federal and state policy impacting diagnostics, reimbursement, healthcare innovation, trade and regulatory matters.
• Anticipate risks and opportunities and shape advocacy strategies to support growth and patient access.
• Serve as a strategic partner ensuring the US Government Affairs agenda is co-created with commercial leaders; translate complex political and regulatory shifts into strategic implications that inform business planning and investment decisions. Strategic Trade Association Leadership:
• Evaluate and recommend Roche Diagnostics’ participation in industry trade associations;
• Direct executive engagement within these forums to lead cross-industry efforts on critical medical technology and policy issues. Government & Stakeholder Engagement
• Serve as Roche’s senior liaison with Congress, Administration officials, federal agencies and state policymakers.
• Lead engagement with key trade associations, coalitions, patient groups and external stakeholders to advance Roche’s policy agenda. Partners with external stakeholders, as appropriate, to build alignment with Roche Diagnostics’ policy positions and encourage external advocacy efforts consistent with those positions. (e.g., non-profit associations, industry organizations, think tanks, coalitions).
• Lead Roche’s presence in government forums and strategically deploy internal subject matter experts (from manufacturing to R&D) to testify, brief officials, and provide technical guidance that advances the company's policy objectives. Strategic Counsel & Business Partnership
• Advise senior leaders on political, legislative and policy developments affecting Roche Diagnostics.
• Bring external insights into business strategy and translate policy developments into actionable implications.
• Support executive engagement with policymakers and key public affairs opportunities. Policy Leadership in Partnership with Commercial Organization
• Lead customer communications on policy in partnership with the US commercial team.
• Engage with policy counterparts from key customers as well as laboratory industry trade associations.
• Participate in US Commercial leadership forums including USLT (US Leadership Team) and ELT (Enterprise Leadership Team). Team Leadership & Capability Building
• Lead and develop a high-performing US Government Affairs and Policy team, including talent development, succession planning, coaching and organizational capability building.
• Assess resource needs and manage use of external advisors, consultants and advocacy partnerships.

• Fundament: Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft, Technik oder Naturwissenschaften abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung.
• Erfahrung: Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Gesundheitsmarkt und Vertriebsumfeld sind von Vorteil; alternativ bringst Du mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einem vergleichbaren Aufgabenfeld mit.
• IT-Skills: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office/Google Workspace und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen (wie Salesforce) oder SAP.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo è un momento emozionante per aderire alla rete di supporto Roche. Se siete appassionati di problem solving allora questa è la posizione per voi! In qualità di società di assistenza sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche scopre, sviluppa e fornisce prodotti e servizi diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi che forniscono benefici significativi ai pazienti e ai professionisti sanitari - dalla rilevazione precoce e prevenzione delle malattie alla diagnostica, al monitoraggio del trattamento e del trattamento. Roche è una società di successo che può offrire interessanti opportunità di carriera. Incoraggiamo e sosteniamo il vostro sviluppo in aree di vostro interesse che vi preparerà per il prossimo livello nel vostro percorso di carriera. Sappiamo che le persone sono responsabili del nostro successo e apprezziamo i nostri dipendenti. Il nostro impegno è quello di creare un ambiente di lavoro in cui sentirsi valorizzati, rispettati e potenziati è un'esperienza quotidiana. In qualità di Field Applications Specialist , sarete un membro chiave del nostro team di assistenza clienti come principale rappresentante scientifico e tecnico nella regione di Allentown , PA per i sistemi Roche nei laboratori del cliente all'interno dello spazio Core Lab. Sarete responsabili di fornire il miglior supporto clienti in loco, tra cui attività come, l'implementazione delle applicazioni, la formazione dell'operatore e la risoluzione dei problemi per la strumentazione diagnostica e le analisi durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. L'opportunità:
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e collaborative con le parti interessate del cliente, garantendo un elevato livello di soddisfazione del cliente e creando valore nelle operazioni di laboratorio del cliente. Consultare i clienti sulle esigenze del laboratorio e agire come partner supportando il cliente durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto che potrebbe includere aggiornamenti di prodotto e altre modifiche.
• Eseguire e/o assistere con l'installazione di strumenti diagnostici complessi, software e applicazioni reagente nei laboratori del cliente. Convalida le prestazioni del sistema per garantire che soddisfi le specifiche del produttore. Assicurare un'applicazione efficace e coesa delle soluzioni appena installate.
• Fornire e, in alcuni casi, sviluppare una formazione completa in loco al personale di laboratorio sul corretto uso e manutenzione dei sistemi Roche, tra cui teoria del funzionamento, flusso di lavoro, controllo della qualità e interpretazione dei dati.
• Agire come risorsa principale in loco per risolvere problemi tecnici complessi relativi alla strumentazione, software e prestazioni di analisi. Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice e implementare azioni correttive per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo dello strumento. Partner con altri membri del team Roche per implementare e supportare soluzioni totali, come l'automazione, gli strumenti digitali, ecc.
• Fornire competenze scientifiche e applicative agli stakeholder di laboratorio (questo potrebbe includere supervisori, manager, direttori, tecnici) e professionisti medici (questo potrebbe includere patologi, medici), aiutandoli a garantire operazioni di laboratorio coesi ottimizzando i flussi di lavoro, implementando nuovi saggi e interpretando i risultati per il portafoglio di Roche.
• Servire come collegamento al cliente e raccogliere feedback da parte dei clienti sulle prestazioni, le caratteristiche e l'usabilità del prodotto, e poi relay queste informazioni di supporto e team commerciali, mantenendo un vantaggio competitivo.
• Partner con il team di vendita e sfruttare le conoscenze tecniche approfondite durante le attività pre-vendita, tra cui dimostrazioni di prodotto, consultazioni tecniche, ottimizzazione dei menu e altre opportunità post-vendita, generazione di ricavi.
• Assicurare esperienze di cliente coerenti seguendo i protocolli Roche
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience. As a Field Applications Specialist , you will be a key member of our Customer Support team as the primary scientific and technical representative in the Allentown , PA region for Roche systems in customer laboratories within the Core Lab space. You will be responsible for providing best-in-class on-site customer support, including activities such as, application implementation, operator training, and troubleshooting for diagnostic instrumentation and assays throughout the entire product life cycle. The Opportunity:
• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with customer stakeholders, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and creating value within the customer’s lab operations. Consult with customers on lab needs and act as a partner by supporting the customer throughout the product lifecycle which could include supporting product upgrades and other changes.
• Perform and/or assist with the installation of complex diagnostic instruments, software, and reagent applications in customer laboratories. Validate system performance to ensure it meets manufacturer specifications. Ensure effective and cohesive application of the newly installed solutions.
• Deliver and, in some cases develop, comprehensive on-site training to laboratory personnel on the proper use and maintenance of Roche systems, including theory of operation, workflow, quality control, and data interpretation.
• Act as the primary on-site resource for resolving complex technical issues related to instrumentation, software, and assay performance. Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to minimize instrument downtime. Partner with other Roche team members to implement and support total solutions, such as automation, digital tools, etc.
• Provide scientific and applications expertise to laboratory stakeholders (this could include supervisors, managers, directors, technologists) and medical professionals (this could include pathologists, doctors), helping them ensure cohesive lab operations by optimizing workflows, implementing new assays, and interpreting results for Roche's portfolio.
• Serve as the customer liaison and collect feedback from customers on product performance, features, and usability, and then relay this information back to support and commercial teams, maintaining a competitive advantage.
• Partner with the sales team and leverage in-depth technical knowledge during pre-sales activities, including product demonstrations, technical consultations, menu optimization, and other post-sales, revenue-generating opportunities.
• Ensure consistent customer experiences by following Roche protocols
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Dies ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich dem Roche Support Network anzuschließen. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich über Problemlösung sind, dann ist dies die Position für Sie! Als forschungsorientiertes Healthcare-Unternehmen entdeckt, entwickelt und bietet Roche innovative Diagnostik und therapeutische Produkte und Dienstleistungen, die für Patienten und medizinische Fachkräfte von der Früherkennung und Prävention von Krankheiten bis hin zur Diagnostik, Behandlung und Therapieüberwachung profitieren. Roche ist ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen, das spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten bieten kann. Wir fördern und unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung in Bereichen Ihres Interesses, die Sie auf die nächste Stufe in Ihrem Karriereweg vorbereiten. Wir wissen, dass Menschen für unseren Erfolg verantwortlich sind und wir unsere Mitarbeiter schätzen. Unser Engagement ist es, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem das Gefühl geschätzt, respektiert und gestärkt wird, ein tägliches Erlebnis ist. Als Field Applications Specialist werden Sie als primärer wissenschaftlicher und technischer Vertreter in der Allentown , PA-Region für Roche-Systeme in Kundenlaboren im Core Lab-Raum ein wichtiges Mitglied unseres Customer Support-Teams sein. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Kundenbetreuung vor Ort, einschließlich Aktivitäten wie, Anwendung Implementierung, Bedienertraining und Fehlerbehebung für diagnostische Instrumentierung und Assays während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Die Gelegenheit:
• Erstellen und pflegen Sie starke, kollaborative Beziehungen zu Kundenvertretern, um ein hohes Maß an Kundenzufriedenheit und Wertschöpfung im Laborbetrieb des Kunden sicherzustellen. Besprechen Sie den Kunden auf den Laborbedarf und handeln Sie als Partner, indem Sie den Kunden während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus unterstützen, der Produkt-Upgrades und andere Änderungen unterstützen könnte.
• Durchführung und/oder Unterstützung bei der Installation komplexer diagnosischer Instrumente, Software und Reagenzienanwendungen in Kundenlabors. Gültige Systemleistung, um sicherzustellen, dass es den Herstellerspezifikationen entspricht. Gewährleistung einer effektiven und kohäsiven Anwendung der neu installierten Lösungen.
• Bereitstellung und in einigen Fällen eine umfassende Vor-Ort-Training an Laborpersonal bei der ordnungsgemäßen Nutzung und Wartung von Roche-Systemen, einschließlich der Theorie der Operation, Workflow, Qualitätskontrolle und Dateninterpretation.
• Aktivieren Sie als primäre Vor-Ort-Ressource zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Instrumentierung, Software und Testleistung. Führen Sie Root Ursache Analyse und implementieren Korrekturmaßnahmen, um Instrument Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren. Mit anderen Roche-Team-Mitgliedern werden Gesamtlösungen wie Automatisierung, digitale Werkzeuge etc. implementiert und unterstützt.
• Bereitstellung von wissenschaftlichen und Anwendungen Expertise für Labor-Stakeholder (dies könnte unter anderem Aufsichtspersonen, Manager, Direktoren, Technologen) und medizinische Fachkräfte (dies könnte Pathologen, Ärzte umfassen), die ihnen helfen, kohäsive Laboroperationen zu gewährleisten, indem sie Workflows optimieren, neue Assays implementieren und Ergebnisse für Roches Portfolio interpretieren.
• Servieren Sie als Kundenverbindung und sammeln Sie Feedback von Kunden über Produktleistung, Funktionen und Usability, und übermitteln Sie diese Informationen dann an Support- und Handelsteams, wobei ein Wettbewerbsvorteil erhalten wird.
• Partner des Vertriebsteams und nutzen fundiertes technisches Wissen während der Vorverkaufsaktivitäten, darunter Produktdemonstrationen, technische Beratungen, Menüoptimierung und andere Post-Sales, Umsatzerzeugende Möglichkeiten.
• Gewährleistung einheitlicher Kundenerfahrungen durch die folgenden Roche-Protokolle

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position C'est une période passionnante pour rejoindre le réseau de soutien Roche. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes alors c'est la position pour vous! En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre succès et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne. En tant que spécialiste des applications sur le terrain, vous serez un membre clé de notre équipe de support client en tant que principal représentant scientifique et technique dans la région d'Allentown, PA pour les systèmes Roche dans les laboratoires clients de l'espace Core Lab. Vous serez responsable de fournir le meilleur service client en classe sur place, y compris des activités telles que la mise en œuvre d'applications, la formation des opérateurs et le dépannage des instruments de diagnostic et des essais tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. La possibilité :
• Établir et maintenir des relations solides et collaboratives avec les parties prenantes du client, en assurant un niveau élevé de satisfaction du client et en créant de la valeur dans les opérations du laboratoire du client. Consulter les clients sur les besoins des laboratoires et agir en tant que partenaire en appuyant le client tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, ce qui pourrait inclure des améliorations du produit et d'autres changements.

Valider la performance du système pour s'assurer qu'il répond aux spécifications du fabricant. Assurer l'application efficace et cohérente des solutions nouvellement installées.
• Offrir et, dans certains cas, développer une formation complète sur place au personnel de laboratoire sur l'utilisation et la maintenance correctes des systèmes Roche, y compris la théorie du fonctionnement, le flux de travail, le contrôle de la qualité et l'interprétation des données.
• Être la principale ressource sur place pour résoudre les problèmes techniques complexes liés à l'instrumentation, aux logiciels et aux performances d'essai. Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt des instruments. Partenaire avec d'autres membres de l'équipe Roche pour mettre en œuvre et soutenir des solutions complètes, telles que l'automatisation, les outils numériques, etc.
• Fournir une expertise scientifique et des applications aux parties prenantes du laboratoire (y compris les superviseurs, les gestionnaires, les directeurs, les technologues) et aux professionnels de la santé (y compris les pathologistes, les médecins), les aider à assurer la cohérence des opérations de laboratoire en optimisant les flux de travail, en mettant en oeuvre de nouveaux tests et en interprétant les résultats pour le portefeuille de Roche.
• Servir de liaison avec le client et recueillir les commentaires des clients sur les performances, les caractéristiques et la facilité d'utilisation du produit, puis transmettre ces informations aux équipes de soutien et commerciales, en maintenant un avantage concurrentiel.
• S'associer à l'équipe de vente et tirer parti de connaissances techniques approfondies lors des activités préventes, y compris les démonstrations de produits, les consultations techniques, l'optimisation des menus et d'autres occasions de générer des revenus après les ventes.
• Assurer une expérience client cohérente en suivant les protocoles Roche

titleByLocale.it: Biostatistica senior per gli Algoritmi Clinici

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Your Department We are a global team of 100+ biostatisticians and data scientists united by the ambition to advance diagnostic assays and elevate their use in clinical practice. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to provide robust quantitative methods for all stages of the product lifecycle—from early research to market registration. By combining our statistical expertise with a profound understanding of the clinical questions at hand, we extract actionable information from data and deliver customer-tailored insights. Your Team Our team thrives on creating innovative solutions for both novel and traditional challenges in data analysis. We are heavily involved in early biomarker discovery projects, aiming to identify new biomarkers and develop clinical algorithms that solve unmet medical needs. To achieve our goals, we leverage data from clinical trials as well as real-world data. Collaboration is at our core; we work in close partnership with colleagues across clinical science, clinical operations, business, and assay development. Your Main Objectives and Tasks
• Conduct exploratory data analysis of clinical data and develop clinical algorithms by applying state-of-the-art statistical and machine learning methods.
• Perform statistical analysis for clinical studies and real world data, generate analysis reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
• Analyze data from biomarker discovery experiments using multivariate and machine learning techniques.
• Support peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate the clinical utility of your results.
• Proactively contribute to and support cross-functional project teams. Who You Are
• You hold a university degree (Master’s) in (Bio-)Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, (Bio-)Informatics, or a comparable field; a Ph.D. is a plus.
• You possess proven expertise in applying biostatistical and machine learning methods to clinical data, ideally in the context of biomarker evaluation or similar research tasks.
• You have excellent knowledge of R or a comparable programming language.
• You bring exceptional communication and analytical skills, with a strong desire to continuously expand your knowledge and apply new quantitative methodologies.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Your Department We are a global team of 100+ biostatisticians and data scientists united by the ambition to advance diagnostic assays and elevate their use in clinical practice. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to provide robust quantitative methods for all stages of the product lifecycle—from early research to market registration. By combining our statistical expertise with a profound understanding of the clinical questions at hand, we extract actionable information from data and deliver customer-tailored insights. Your Team Our team thrives on creating innovative solutions for both novel and traditional challenges in data analysis. We are heavily involved in early biomarker discovery projects, aiming to identify new biomarkers and develop clinical algorithms that solve unmet medical needs. To achieve our goals, we leverage data from clinical trials as well as real-world data. Collaboration is at our core; we work in close partnership with colleagues across clinical science, clinical operations, business, and assay development. Your Main Objectives and Tasks
• Conduct exploratory data analysis of clinical data and develop clinical algorithms by applying state-of-the-art statistical and machine learning methods.
• Perform statistical analysis for clinical studies and real world data, generate analysis reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
• Analyze data from biomarker discovery experiments using multivariate and machine learning techniques.
• Support peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate the clinical utility of your results.
• Proactively contribute to and support cross-functional project teams. Who You Are
• You hold a university degree (Master’s) in (Bio-)Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, (Bio-)Informatics, or a comparable field; a Ph.D. is a plus.
• You possess proven expertise in applying biostatistical and machine learning methods to clinical data, ideally in the context of biomarker evaluation or similar research tasks.
• You have excellent knowledge of R or a comparable programming language.
• You bring exceptional communication and analytical skills, with a strong desire to continuously expand your knowledge and apply new quantitative methodologies.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt. Dein neues Team: Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:
• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.
• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.
• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.
• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.
• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.
• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:
• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.
• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.
• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.
• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.
• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich. Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position YOUR TEAM You will report to the HGR Officer and partner closely with the global biosample operations teams across the enterprise. You will be recognized as a leader and work autonomously in both local as well as global cross functional study teams. ROLE PURPOSE As a China Biosample Operations Asset Lead, you will provide biosample operational expertise to one or more cross-functional local or global study teams through all phases and stages in accordance with the appropriate quality standards and applicable local regulations. WHAT YOU WILL DO
• PROVIDE BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS GUIDANCE TO CLINICAL CHINA STUDY TEAMS AND GLOBAL STUDY TEAMS FOR CHINA RELATED ACTIVITIES by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of study samples (collection, processing, analysis, data delivery and final disposition).
• LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CHINA SPECIFIC BIOMARKER MANAGEMENT PLAN WITHIN CLINICAL STUDIES based on input from scientific and operational stakeholders to execute biosample operational strategies in China
• PROVIDE INPUT TO HGRAC APPLICATION to support Country Study Managers - when applicable - and within Biosample Operations’ remit.
• PARTNER CLOSELY WITH BIOMARKER SCIENTISTS AND BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS PROGRAM LEADS LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY to align study specific activities with program sample collection strategies. Evaluate the operational feasibility of specific testing in China and provide input to global program teams.
• PROVIDE OPERATIONAL INPUT AND RECOMMENDATIONS INTO STUDY RELATED DOCUMENTATION AND PROCESSES (e.g. protocol, ICF, HGRAC applications)
• PRESENT CHINA STUDY SAMPLE COLLECTION STRATEGY AT OPERATIONS TEAM MEETINGS AND CHINA INVESTIGATOR MEETINGS
• CONTRIBUTE TO LOCAL LAB/ REGIONAL VENDOR SELECTION FOR SPECIFIC TESTING in collaboration with Biosample Ops Lead, biomarker scientist, Procurement and based on technology expertise, performance and compliance.
• ESTABLISH BIOSAMPLE ANALYSIS AND DATA DELIVERY MILESTONES AND ENSURE ACCURATE TRACKING AND REPORTING OF BIOSAMPLE METRICS (sample collection, assay status, analyses updates). Provide study level updates to the study and global biomarker teams. Support study teams in addressing local vendor/site sample queries. Actively partner with Data Management to oversee and coordinate data format, and delivery timelines.
• PROVIDE DAY TO DAY OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF CHINA BIOSAMPLE VENDORS. Partner with internal/external stakeholders in the central lab set up, providing sample collection and processing instructions. titleByLocale.en: Strategischer Leiter Bau-Governance & Projekt Manager Capex

titleByLocale.fr: Strategischer Leiter Bau-Governance & Projekt Manager Capex

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Mit der Zukunft im Blick gestalten wir den Standort von Roche in Rotkreuz aktiv weiter. Einen wichtigen Beitrag hierzu leistet die Abteilung Engineering & Project: Hier liegt die Verantwortung für die strategische Weiterentwicklung des Standortes und sämtliche Investitionen in Gebäude und Anlagen. Dazu gehören Bauprojekte im Bereich Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur. Dabei legen wir besonderen Wert auf Nachhaltigkeit, Sicherheit, Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit und Wirtschaftlichkeit. In dieser anspruchsvollen Schlüsselfunktion bist du die zentrale Instanz für die operative Exzellenz und die baurechtliche Strategie auf dem Areal Rotkreuz. Du vereinst tiefgreifendes technisches Verständnis mit strategischem Prozessmanagement und repräsentierst das Unternehmen gegenüber Behörden und Partnern. Die Möglichkeit Strategisches Construction Management
• Standardisierung: Definition und Überwachung globaler Standards für die Auswahl, das Onboarding und die Steuerung von CM-Partnern, Generalplanern und Unternehmern.
• Schnittstellenmanagement: Agieren als entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Vendor Management und Projektleitung zur Sicherstellung prozesskonformer Projektabläufe.
• Beratung: Fachspezifischer Input bei komplexen Ausschreibungen und strategische Beratung der Projektleiter in allen Belangen des Construction Managements. Bebauungsplanung & Bewilligungsmanagement
• Arealstrategie: Verantwortung für die Einhaltung und strategische Weiterentwicklung bestehender Bebauungspläne in enger Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.
• Process Ownership: Zentrale Steuerung sämtlicher Baubewilligungsprozesse sowie Definition standortweiter Bewilligungsstrategien für alle Investitionsprojekte.
• Behördenmanagement: Repräsentation der Unternehmensinteressen in städtebaulichen Gremien und erste Ansprechperson für Ämter und Behörden im Bereich Baurecht. Areal-Koordination & Safety (SHE)
• Sicherheitsstrategie: Implementierung von SHE-Standards (Safety, Health, Environment) und Befähigung der Projektteams zur sicheren Durchführung komplexer Bauvorhaben.
• Logistiksteuerung: Strategische Koordination der zeitlichen und logistischen Abfolgen aller Baustellen, um einen unterbrechungsfreien Betrieb der Kernprozesse am Standort zu garantieren. Capex-Projekt Manager
• Projektsteuerung (End-to-End): Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Erreichung der Projektziele (Termine, Kosten, Qualität, Sicherheit) von der Initiierung bis zum Projektabschluss.
• Anforderungs- & Scope-Management: Gemeinsame Definition der Projektanforderungen mit den internen Nutzern, Aufzeigen von Lösungsalternativen sowie konsequentes Risiko- und Change-Management.
• Teamführung & Stakeholder Management: Fachliche Anleitung des (agilen) Projektteams sowie zielgerichtete Kommunikation und Interessenvertretung gegenüber internen Schnittstellen und externen Partnern.
• Governance & Reporting: Strukturierte Fortschrittsverfolgung, regelmässiges Berichten an das Steering Committee und proaktives Herbeiführen von notwendigen Entscheidungen. Wer Du bist
• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Architektur, des Bauingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Expertise (z. B. MAS Baumanagement, eidg. Diplom als Bauleiter/Techniker HF) mit langjähriger Praxis.
• Fundierte Erfolgsbilanz in der Bau- oder Projektleitung von Hochbauprojekten innerhalb der Schweizer Baubranche.
• Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Teams innerhalb komplexer Matrixorganisationen.
• Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken, Verhandlungsgeschi

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Payroll, Time and Benefits Senior Team Lead What we do: The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We work closely together as a team to ensure strong employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Your day to day responsibilities: As a Payroll Time & Benefits Team Lead, you are responsible for leading a Payroll Time & Benefits Operations (PTB) team across multiple countries (a country cluster) and performing all people leadership activities in line with Roche People Practices. You will ensure local PTB performance targets are met at both the team and individual levels, and that regular operations reviews are held internally, as well as externally with relevant stakeholders. As a Qualified Lead you are:
• Leading and managing the Payroll Time and Benefits Operations (PTB) team by delivering best services and solutions towards the clients.
• Ensuring delivery of services in accordance with agreed performance levels (KPI) and in line with legal/regulations (compliance), continuously driving improvement activities/projects (simplification, standardization, automation) for service excellence and consistent customer experience.
• Working in line with overall People Support Solutions strategy, seeking better/creative solutions to support business needs as well as leveraging advanced technology to continually drive teamwork efficiency and enhance customer experience.
• Leading and facilitating people processes in line with Roche Leadership commitments, People Practices and policies, Roche values.
• Role Modeling our people practices, ensuring that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions.
• Developing team member’s knowledge, skills, capabilities in line with the Roche People Practices to retain and develop talented staff.
• Driving employee retention, engagement and talent management.
• Creating a safe and positive team culture and environment, ensuring the team is demonstrating the right mindset and attitude (trust, growth mindset, customer centricity, E2E accountability, problem solving).
• Ensuring consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced, maintaining strong customer satisfaction within the area of responsibility, pro-actively providing feedback/inputs to stakeholders from a service perspective.
• Setting and monitoring team working plan, resource allocations, workload.
• Seeking, identifying and driving continuous service and process improvement (in terms of standardization, automation, and simplification), and service enhancement based on monthly performance, customer feedback.
• Sustaining a win-win relationship with external vendors, as well as monitor the vendor performance through routine and/or project work.
• Collaborating with peers within the region and globally PTB community and achieving our People Support Solutions vision by driving global consistency through collaboration.
• Partnering with other Service teams (e.g. Advisory, People Support, Employee Lifecycle teams) for cross functional end to end service delivery and process improvement.
• Actively contributing to the global PTB program and People & Culture transformation to ensure the defined strategy is successfully implemented within the assigned countries. What you bring to our team: ​ We are looking for someone who is self-motivated,

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità Come Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, vi assicurerete che le pratiche delle persone di Roche funzionano senza soluzione di continuità per il business gestendo l'esecuzione end-to-end di payroll, tassa e assicurazione sociale. Si svolgerà un ruolo vitale nel fornire supporto consultivo e mantenere l'integrità dei dati, mantenendo i principi focalizzati sul cliente al centro di ogni interazione.
• Eseguire attività di payroll end-to-end , compresa la manutenzione dei dati per l'imposta, l'assicurazione sociale e l'amministrazione locale / globale delle prestazioni con alta precisione.
• Fornire un servizio clienti esperto risolvendo complesse indagini, richieste di gestione e problemi di risoluzione dei problemi relativi a pagamento, tempo e benefici.
• Superare la gestione del tempo e dell'assenza, collaborare con i manager per garantire il rispetto delle politiche locali e l'accuratezza nei registri dei dipendenti.
• Gestione dei flussi di dati tecnici, monitoraggio Integrazioni Workday e elaborazione di file di caricamento di massa per garantire l'accuratezza del fornitore e l'elaborazione tempestiva.
• Assicurare la conformità alle normative in vari paesi e giurisdizioni, mantenendo aggiornato i requisiti legali in evoluzione e la documentazione interna.
• Promuovere relazioni chiave con gli stakeholder, collaborando attivamente con i Capitoli P&C e fornendo indicazioni ai team di supporto di primo livello per migliorare la consegna dei servizi.
• Migliorare continuamente partecipando a progetti globali e implementando iniziative per ottimizzare le prestazioni e la qualità dei servizi. Chi sei Sei un professionista orientato al dettaglio con una forte mentalità analitica e una passione per la centricità del cliente. Si prospera in ambienti multiculturali veloci e si prende tutta la responsabilità per fornire risultati coerenti e di alta qualità attraverso i confini.
• Esperienza professionale: Lei porta 1-3 anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione dei servizi e dei benefici payroll, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente del Service Center condiviso.
• competenze linguistiche: sei fluente in tedesco e inglese
• Proficienza Tecnica: Hai competenze Excel avanzate (v-lookup, tabelle pivot) e una solida comprensione del ciclo di payroll e dei processi HR.
• Capacità analitica: Hai un occhio eccellente per i dettagli e può navigare strutture di dati complesse per risolvere gli errori e garantire l'accuratezza.
• Matrix Collaboration: Hai una comprovata traccia di fornire risultati in un'organizzazione di matrice e sei comodo lavorare indipendentemente dalle priorità concorrenti.
• Soluzione Orientamento: Lei dimostra forti capacità di problem solving, utilizzando l'ascolto attivo e il pensiero critico per migliorare il processo.
• Mindset di crescita: sei adattabile al cambiamento, goditi l'apprendimento di nuovi strumenti (come Workday o ServiceNow), e prosperi in situazioni ambigue. In Exchange vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, opportunità di coaching / mentoring, programma amico, edifici di squadra, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity As a Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, you will ensure that Roche’s people practices work seamlessly for the business by managing the end-to-end execution of payroll, tax, and social insurance. You will play a vital role in providing advisory support and maintaining data integrity while keeping customer-focused principles at the heart of every interaction.
• Execute end-to-end payroll activities , including data maintenance for tax, social insurance, and local/global benefits administration with high accuracy.
• Provide expert customer service by resolving complex inquiries, managing requests, and troubleshooting issues related to pay, time, and benefits.
• Oversee time and absence management , collaborating with managers to ensure compliance with local policies and accuracy in employee records.
• Manage technical data flows , monitoring Workday integrations and processing mass upload files to ensure vendor accuracy and timely processing.
• Ensure regulatory compliance across various countries and jurisdictions, keeping up-to-date with evolving legal requirements and internal documentation.
• Foster key stakeholder relationships , partnering proactively with P&C Chapters and providing guidance to first-level support teams to enhance service delivery.
• Drive continuous improvement by participating in global projects and implementing initiatives to optimize performance and service quality. Who You Are You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for customer centricity. You thrive in fast-paced, multicultural environments and take full accountability for delivering consistent, high-quality results across borders.
• Professional Experience: You bring 1–3 years of experience in payroll services and benefits administration , ideally within a Shared Service Center environment.
• Language Skills: You are fluent in German and English
• Technical Proficiency: You have advanced Excel skills (v-lookup, pivot tables) and a solid understanding of the payroll cycle and HR processes.
• Analytical Ability: You have an excellent eye for detail and can navigate complex data structures to resolve errors and ensure accuracy.
• Matrix Collaboration: You have a proven track record of delivering results in a matrix organization and are comfortable working independently with competing priorities.
• Solution Orientation: You demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, utilizing active listening and critical thinking to drive process improvements.
• Growth Mindset: You are adaptable to change, enjoy learning new tools (such as Workday or ServiceNow), and thrive in ambiguous situations. In Exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Chance Als Payroll-, Time & Benefits-Spezialist sorgen Sie dafür, dass die Mitarbeiter von Roche nahtlos für das Unternehmen arbeiten, indem Sie die End-to-End-Ausführung der Lohn-, Steuer- und Sozialversicherung verwalten. Sie werden eine wichtige Rolle bei der Beratung und Aufrechterhaltung der Datenintegrität spielen und kundenorientierte Prinzipien im Mittelpunkt jeder Interaktion halten.

• Berufserfahrung: Sie bringen 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Lohn- und Leistungsverwaltung, ideal in einer gemeinsamen Service-Center-Umgebung.
• Sprachkenntnisse: Sie sind fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch
• Technische Effizienz: Sie haben erweiterte Excel-Fähigkeiten (v-lookup, Pivot-Tabellen) und ein solides Verständnis des Lohn- und HR-Prozesses.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité En tant que spécialiste de la paie, du temps et des avantages sociaux, vous vous assurerez que les gens de Roche travaillent de façon transparente pour l'entreprise en gérant l'exécution de bout en bout de la paie, de l'impôt et de l'assurance sociale. Vous jouerez un rôle vital en fournissant un soutien consultatif et en maintenant l'intégrité des données tout en maintenant les principes axés sur le client au cœur de chaque interaction.
• Exécuter de bout en bout des activités de paie, y compris la maintenance des données pour l'impôt, l'assurance sociale, et l'administration des prestations locales/mondiales avec une grande précision.
• Fournir un service à la clientèle expert en résolvant les demandes complexes, en gérant les demandes et en dépannant les problèmes liés à la rémunération, au temps et aux avantages.
• Superviser la gestion du temps et de l'absence, collaborer avec les gestionnaires pour assurer le respect des politiques locales et l'exactitude des dossiers des employés.
• Gérer les flux de données techniques , surveiller les intégrations Workday et traiter les fichiers de téléchargement de masse pour assurer l'exactitude du fournisseur et le traitement en temps opportun.
• Assurer le respect de la réglementation dans divers pays et juridictions, en tenant compte de l'évolution des exigences juridiques et de la documentation interne.
• Favoriser les relations avec les principaux intervenants, établir des partenariats proactifs avec les chapitres sur les P et C et fournir des conseils aux équipes de soutien de premier niveau pour améliorer la prestation des services.
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue en participant à des projets mondiaux et en mettant en œuvre des initiatives visant à optimiser les performances et la qualité des services. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel axé sur les détails avec une forte mentalité analytique et une passion pour la centricité des clients. Vous prospèrez dans des environnements multiculturels et rapides et vous êtes pleinement responsable de la prestation de résultats cohérents et de haute qualité au-delà des frontières.
• Expérience professionnelle: Vous apportez de 1 à 3 ans d'expérience dans les services de paie et l'administration des prestations, idéalement dans un environnement de centre de services partagés.
• Compétences linguistiques: Vous maîtrisez couramment l'allemand et l'anglais
• Compétence technique : vous avez des compétences Excel avancées (v-lookup, tables pivotantes) et une bonne compréhension du cycle de paie et des processus RH.
• Capacité d'analyse : Vous avez un excellent œil pour les détails et pouvez naviguer dans des structures de données complexes pour résoudre les erreurs et assurer l'exactitude.
• Collaboration matricielle : Vous avez fait la preuve de vos résultats dans une organisation matricielle et vous êtes à l'aise de travailler indépendamment avec des priorités concurrentes.
• Orientation à la solution: Vous démontrez de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, en utilisant l'écoute active et la pensée critique pour conduire à des améliorations de processus.
• Growth Mindset: Vous êtes adaptable au changement, profitez de l'apprentissage de nouveaux outils (comme Workday ou ServiceNow), et prospèrez dans des situations ambiguës. En échange, nous vous fournissons:
• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery (Product Manager) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape. Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards. Description of the area PT Insights and Data Delivery focuses on the reliable delivery of high quality data combined with the use of data in analytics solutions for both existing and anticipatory business needs with a cross-functional scope and mandate. The role will lead a team of over 20 people to bring the following key benefits to PT
• Reusable and scalable systems that are efficiently operated
• Faster and more robust solutions to meet business challenges
• Reliable delivery of key metrics and performance indicators
• Identifying areas for cost savings and where to invest
• Data/evidence driven decisions

• Self service reporting
• Reducing workload for knowledge workers
• Drive towards actionable insights
• Reliable key performance indicators and metrics
