Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Liaison médicale scientifique (région du Centre-Ouest, États-Unis) Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. La possibilité : La Liaison Scientifique Médicale (LSM) est un chef de file scientifique sur le terrain qui représente Roche Affaires Médicales et Scientifiques auprès des intervenants en laboratoire et cliniques de votre région. Dans ce rôle, vous serez un partenaire de confiance pour les directeurs de laboratoire, les cliniciens et les décideurs clés. Vous allez traduire des données diagnostiques et cliniques complexes en un dialogue significatif qui fait progresser les soins aux patients et informe la stratégie médicale régionale et nationale. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec Sr. Scientific Managers et Sr. Medical Managers pour aider à façonner et à exécuter un plan médical intégré basé sur des idées du monde réel provenant du terrain. Vous apporterez la voix du client à notre plan et stratégie médicale. Votre point de vue influencera directement la façon dont nous priorisons les initiatives éducatives, soutenons les laboratoires et accélérons l'accès aux diagnostics innovants pour les patients. Ce rôle fait partie de l'équipe Cardiométabolism/Neurologie (Core Lab et NPC) des Affaires Médicales et Scientifiques et nécessite une profondeur scientifique, une curiosité intellectuelle et la capacité d'engager des pairs dans des discussions cliniques et techniques de haut niveau. Bien que vous puissiez apporter une expertise profonde dans un domaine spécifique de la maladie, vous devez être à l'aise d'étendre à une variété de sujets de la maladie et de renforcer continuellement votre base scientifique et de connaissances. Il s'agit d'un rôle pour quelqu'un qui prospère dans l'engagement indépendant sur le terrain tout en contribuant de façon significative à une équipe médicale collaborative et axée sur la stratégie. Rôles et responsabilités clés :
• Engagement stratégique : servir de partenaire scientifique principal pour les KOL, les laboratoires et les intervenants cliniques régionaux.
• Gestion des relations : établir et maintenir des partenariats fiables à long terme pour comprendre l'évolution des besoins et des lacunes des clients.
• Insight Generation: Diriger des échanges scientifiques de grande valeur afin de recueillir des informations concrètes qui éclairent la stratégie médicale et la planification du portefeuille.
• KOL Mapping & CRM Excellence: Identifier les leaders émergents et maintenir une documentation précise et opportune des interactions et des idées dans la SFDC.
• Échanges scientifiques et éducation : offrir une éducation pertinente et non promotionnelle aux cliniciens et aux travailleurs (en personne et virtuellement).
• Soutien éducatif adapté : évaluer les besoins et fournir des ressources personnalisées (p. ex. présentations, mises à jour des pipelines, programmes de conférenciers, PACE).
• Expertise médicale et conformité : maintenir des connaissances thérapeutiques approfondies et répondre aux demandes non sollicitées et non étiquetées conformément aux normes de conformité.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle: partenariat avec des équipes médicales et interfonctionnelles pour exécuter des plans régionaux, soutenir les lancements et contribuer aux activités des conseils consultatifs et des congrès.
• L'excellence médicale et la contribution de l'équipe : assurer l'exactitude scientifique, partager les meilleures pratiques, le soutien à bord et favoriser l'amélioration continue de la MSA. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes un expert scientifiquement crédible, prêt sur le terrain qui est à l'aise d'engager les directeurs de laboratoire, les directeurs médicaux, les spécialistes cliniques et les principaux intervenants cliniques en tant que pairs. Vous travaillez de façon indépendante, pensez stratégiquement et traduisez des données diagnostiques et cliniques complexes en dialogue significatif

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care. This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses. The Opportunity: Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:
• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.
• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.
• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.
• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.
• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.
• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction. This field-based role requires up to 25% travel. This person will support Hoover, AL. Who You Are:
• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience
• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking
• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy
• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required Preferred Qualifications:
• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.
• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.
• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Hoover, AL is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Security Engineer Job description The Mission: You will be a key member of the SIEM team, contributing to the engineering and strategic evolution of our global Security Log Management and Vulnerability Scanning services. This is an end-to-end ownership role: from defining the roadmap and architectural strategy to hands-on engineering and operational excellence. You will ensure our security infrastructure is not only reliable and scalable but also optimized for the modern era of federated data and AI-driven automation. Description of the area Key Responsibilities:
• Service Ownership & Strategy: Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our Security Log Management (Splunk & Cribl) and Security Scanning (Tenable) platforms.
• Service Reliability: Ensure the high availability and performance of our security services globally, acting as an escalation point for complex technical challenges.
• System Interconnectivity: Develop and manage sophisticated API integrations to ensure seamless data flow between the security scanning (Tenable) and logging (Splunk/Cribl) tiers.
• Next-Gen Security Log Architecture: Drive the transition from a traditional "index-all" logging approach to a "data-tiering" mindset. You will focus on cost optimization and performance across all data lifecycle phases: routing, filtering, storing and searching, ensuring security data is accessible and cost-effective.
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Orchestrate the evolution of our security infrastructure by managing all configurations via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub, Ansible, and Python), to ensure a fully automated and version-controlled environment.
• AI-Augmented Engineering: Actively integrate AI Agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into daily operations. You will build agentic AI workflows to automate configuration, troubleshooting, and complex interconnectivity, while simultaneously improving service offerings and user experience.
• Mentorship: Act as a technical catalyst for the team, mentoring colleagues in the art of prompt engineering, agentic AI development, and advanced AI ecosystems.
• Technical Leadership: Serve as a technical lead, defining implementation plans and driving continuous process improvements.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Effectively manage relationships across functional teams, acting as a clear communicator and advisor to ensure alignment on security goals and project delivery. Technical Requirements & Expertise:
• Security Service Depth: Deep conceptual understanding of the SIEM/Log Management lifecycle (Collection, Indexing, Storage, Retention and Searching) and Vulnerability Management.
• Networking Fundamentals: Expert understanding of networking (TCP/IP, Load Balancing, Firewalls) as it relates to high-volume security data transport.
• Coding & API Mastery: Strong experience with Python and interacting with complex REST APIs. Proven ability to interconnect disparate technologies via APIs and custom integrations.
• Modern DevOps: Strong experience with Ansible and GitHub for managing infrastructure.
• Advanced AI/Automation: Proven experience or deep project work building Agentic AI workflows. Practical expertise in MCP (Model Context Protocol) or building custom LLM-based tools to automate technical tasks.
• Tooling (Preferred): Experience with Cribl, Splunk, or Tenable is a plus, but the ability to rapidly upscale and automate these via AI is essential. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 10

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Summary As a Customer Logistics Partner, you will be responsible for in-country distribution and Order-to-Cash to ensure timely delivery to customers. You will oversee in-country supply chain activities to ensure we meet our service goals. You will be responsible to ensure world class service levels and right-to-operate for local distribution and to implement supply chain strategies that successfully deliver our innovative medicines to customers and patients. This is a key role within the end-to-end supply chain operating model that interacts with local and global stakeholders. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Main
• Responsibilities ● Ensure in-market supply on time in full at the right quality and cost ● Ensure “right to operate” for distribution ● Oversee successful in-market supply and distribution management (Commercial, Promotional, Clinical/IMP affiliate level) ● Partner with CSM for upstream replenishment coordination including artwork, shipment qty and RSL from central packaging site incl. exception management. ● Monitor and inform CLM and CVSP around the exceptions related to our inbound process before triggering importation ● Depending on the local finance model: ownership to oversight of the order to cash process ● Manage contracts and optimize performance with supply chain service providers (e.g. O2C, logistics and distrib) incl. establishing and monitoring KPI metric ● Monitor and control Warehouse & Distribution and/or Logistic Service Provider operational cost as part of the Supply Chain budget ● Leverage data for decision making by using e.g. analytics, simulation tools and customer insights ● Drive efficiency through identifying value-adding and productivity-enhancing in-market opportunities through technology and data (e.g. CWP, IMIP, Robotics ASPIRE etc) in-line with the digital roadmap ● Collaborate with different functions in the affiliate to understand the changes which may impact supply to and within the country and aligns with CSM to adjust the repl. Plan ● Contribute to the supply chain design together with the CVSP and support implementation of supply solutions to meet customer requirements ● Ensure appropriate supply chain set-up (incl. e.g. master data) in-line with the life cycle status of the product/portfolio ● Implement in-market supply projects/initiatives to gain efficiency and meet customer needs (e.g. cold chain, home delivery etc). ● Monitor local supply chain risk management plan (e.g. financial and operations) ● For Inbound process oversee operations of our agent in which regards to custom clearance and logistic to ensure our importation orders arrives on time respecting complying with Roche standard and local regulation Skills & Competencies ● Undergraduate degree in Business/Commerce, Engineering, Finance or related fields ● Deep understanding of the distribution environment (transportation, customs and health authority regulations, GXP, country(s) infrastructure) ● Able to build and maintain strong internal and external partnerships ● Solid understanding of supply chain planning and execution systems with at least 3 years of work experience in logistics operations ● Possess strong business, logistics, and Supply Chain acumen ● Strong sense of urgency and problem-solving skills ● Knowledgeable of master data impact ● Strong communicator and connector between the Business, Finance, Quality, Regulatory and Supply Chain teams ● Systems thinker, deep listener, able to uncover novel insights ● Capability to trans

The Position As the Head of Project Management for Roche Information Solutions (RIS), you will be at the heart of our digital transformation. You will lead a high-performing chapter of project management experts dedicated to delivering life-changing digital healthcare products. In this role, you will: - Shape Strategy : Partner with the Portfolio & Project Management Leadership Team to design and execute mid-to-long-term strategies that drive excellence across Roche Diagnostics. - Lead with Vision : Act as the primary expert for digital product development project management, ensuring our capabilities evolve with industry trends. - Empower People : Serve as a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leader, mentoring Sub-Chapter and Network Leads to reach their full professional potential. - Optimize Resources : Collaborate across functions to break down silos, ensuring the right expertise is allocated to the most impactful organizational priorities. - Drive Innovation : Champion the evolution of our Digital Foundation, leveraging data, systems, and AI to enhance project execution. - Build Partnerships : Cultivate trusting relationships with executive stakeholders, influencing global alignment to achieve our Diagnostics Vision. Who You Are You are a proactive, strategic leader who thrives on building diverse teams and navigating complex, global environments. You bring a coaching mindset and a passion for developing talent in a networked organization. To be successful in this role, you bring: - Extensive Leadership Experience : Significant track record in line management and leading diverse, international teams within a technology-driven industry. - Digital Expertise : Over 15 years of experience in project management specifically for software and digital products, ideally within Life Sciences or Diagnostics. - Methodological Mastery : Deep knowledge of project management frameworks, including proficiency in Scaled Agile (SAFe) and regulated product development. - Strategic Mindset : Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and challenge the status quo with innovative ideas. - Global Collaboration: Excellent communication skills in English and the flexibility to partner with teams across Europe and US time zones, including 10-20% travel. Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Standardize end-to-end lifecycle management for master data to ensure cross-system consistency and regulatory compliance.
• Conduct upstream and downstream lineage analysis for master data across systems, monitor data quality, and drive continuous improvement. Mater Data Community Leadership and Organization
• Lead and facilitate the Master Data Community to foster a cross-functional, data-driven culture.
• Act as the core liaison across strategic, tactical, and operational layers to ensure the implementation of the Master Data Management Policy.
• Continuously upskill BDOs through practical capability-building initiatives.
• Project Management: Lead data governance/analytical governance and other relevant projects by applying professional methodologies (e.g., BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, or PMP).

• Stakeholder Influence: Influence stakeholders to adopt new approaches and data-centric mindsets. Qualifications and Education Requirements

• Pharma industry experience preferred

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Fin dalla sua approvazione dieci anni fa, ocrelizumab si è affermata come uno standard di cura per la relapsing e forme progressive di sclerosi multipla (MS). Il nostro lavoro, tuttavia, è in corso. Il team di scienza clinica ocrelizumab continua a concentrarsi sul miglioramento dell'esperienza del paziente e sull'espansione dell'accesso. Stiamo attualmente cercando uno scienziato clinico per unirsi al nostro team globale con sede a Basilea, Welwyn e negli Stati Uniti. Questo ruolo sosterrà principalmente le nostre ultime priorità di sviluppo. Siamo un team dedicato e collaborativo focalizzato sulle innovazioni significative del ciclo di vita che influiscono direttamente sulla comunità MS. Questa posizione offre l'opportunità di contribuire alla scienza consolidata, affrontando le esigenze insoddisfatte nella comunità MS e servendo le popolazioni più giovani dei pazienti. L'opportunità
• Fornire supporto nello sviluppo e/o nella preparazione di informazioni scientifiche cliniche per l'inclusione nel Piano di Sviluppo Clinico.
• Guidato dallo scienziato clinico Lead/Senior, contribuire al protocollo/ICF (scrittura o modifica), costruire CRF appropriati e coordinare cross-funzionalmente.
• Guidato dallo Scienziato Clinico Lead/Senior, contribuire a presentazioni e comunicazioni cliniche interne/esterne (ad esempio incontri di ricerca, interazioni dei siti di studio, informazioni dei pazienti, newsletter di studio). Presente a riunioni interne appropriate, ad esempio il Team di Leadership di Studio. Contribuisce a astratti, manifesti, contenuti per incontri scientifici.
• Lavorare con Lead/Senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors e gruppi interfunzionali per eseguire il Medical Data Review Plan, l'interpretazione dei dati e contribuire allo studio di reportistica.
• Con l'orientamento, contribuire all'applicazione clinica di prova (CTA)/Comitato di etica (CE) interazioni scritte, pacchetti di briefing, risposte scritte alle domande dell'Autorità sanitaria (HA), dati/preparazioni di scienze cliniche per le interazioni HA e l'inserimento dei dati clinici alle presentazioni regolamentari. Chi sei
• Corso di laurea richiesto (la scienza della vita preferito). Advanced Clinical/Science Degree è altamente preferito (ad esempio PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH, ecc.).
• da 0 a 3 anni di esperienza di sviluppo clinico. Mentre l'esperienza precedente è un plus, stiamo principalmente cercando qualcuno con alto potenziale, forte motivazione, e una volontà di imparare

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Since its approval ten years ago, ocrelizumab has established itself as a standard of care for relapsing and progressive forms of Multiple Sclerosis (MS). Our work, however, is ongoing. The ocrelizumab clinical science team continues to focus on improving patient experience and expanding access. We are currently seeking a Clinical Scientist to join our global team based in Basel, Welwyn, and the US. This role will primarily support our latest development priorities. We are a dedicated, collaborative team focused on meaningful lifecycle innovations that directly impact the MS community. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to established science while addressing unmet needs in the MS community and serving younger patient populations. The Opportunity
• Provide support in developing and/or preparing clinical science information for inclusion into the Clinical Development Plan.
• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to protocol/ICF (writing or amendment), construct appropriate CRFs and coordinate cross-functionally.
• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to internal/external clinical presentations and communications (e.g. investigator meetings, study site interactions, patient information, study newsletters). Present at appropriate internal meetings, e.g. Study Leadership Team. Contributes to abstracts, posters, content for scientific meetings.
• Work with Lead/senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors and cross-functional groups to execute the Medical Data Review Plan, data interpretation and contribute to study reporting.
• With guidance, contribute to Clinical Trial Application (CTA)/Ethics Committee (EC) written interactions, briefing packs, written responses to Health Authority (HA) questions, clinical science data/preparations for HA interactions and clinical data input to regulatory submissions. Who you are
• Bachelor’s Degree required (life sciences preferred). Advanced Clinical/Science Degree is highly preferred (e.g. PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH, etc.).
• 0 to 3 years of clinical development experience. While prior experience is a plus, we are primarily looking for someone with high potential, strong motivation, and a willingness to learn
• Familiarity with governing laws, regulations, guidelines on global clinical trial execution is required and some knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonization of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA and other relevant guidelines and regulation.
• Good understanding of the multidisciplinary functions involved in drug development. Some therapeutic area relevant clinical trial experience or clear potential to assimilate with some support.
• Strong collaborative skills with the ability to work effectively within a geographically distributed global team. Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Diese Rolle wird vor allem unsere neuesten Entwicklungsprioritäten unterstützen. • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und/oder Vorbereitung von klinischen wissenschaftlichen Informationen für die Aufnahme in den klinischen Entwicklungsplan.

Untersuchungssitzungen, Studieninteraktionen, Patienteninformationen, Studien-Newsletter). Präsentiert bei geeigneten internen Treffen, z.B. Study Leadership Team. Beiträge zu Abstracts, Postern, Inhalten für wissenschaftliche Treffen.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Depuis son approbation il y a dix ans, l'ocrelizumab s'est imposé comme une norme de soins pour les formes récurrentes et progressives de la sclérose en plaques (SM). Toutefois, notre travail se poursuit. L'équipe scientifique clinique d'ocrelizumab continue de se concentrer sur l'amélioration de l'expérience des patients et l'élargissement de l'accès. Nous cherchons actuellement un Clinical Scientist pour rejoindre notre équipe mondiale basée à Bâle, Welwyn et les États-Unis. Ce rôle appuiera principalement nos dernières priorités de développement. Nous sommes une équipe de collaboration dévouée axée sur des innovations significatives du cycle de vie qui ont une incidence directe sur la communauté de la SP. Ce poste offre l'occasion de contribuer à la science établie tout en répondant aux besoins non satisfaits dans la communauté de la SP et au service des jeunes patients. L'opportunité
• Fournir un appui pour l'élaboration et/ou la préparation d'information scientifique clinique à inclure dans le Plan de développement clinique.
• Guidé par le chef/chercheur clinique principal, contribuer au protocole/ICF (écriture ou modification), construire des CRF appropriés et coordonner de manière transversale.
• Guidé par le responsable/chercheur clinique principal, contribuer aux présentations et communications cliniques internes/externes (p. ex. réunions des chercheurs, interactions avec les sites d'étude, information des patients, bulletins d'étude). Présenter aux réunions internes appropriées, p. ex. Équipe de leadership d'étude. Contribue aux résumés, aux affiches, au contenu des réunions scientifiques.
• Collaborer avec les scientifiques cliniciens principaux/directeurs médicaux/directeurs cliniques et les groupes interfonctionnels pour exécuter le plan d'examen des données médicales, interpréter les données et contribuer à la production de rapports d'études.
• Avec des conseils, contribuer à la demande d'essai clinique (DEC)/Comité d'éthique (CE) des interactions écrites, des dossiers d'information, des réponses écrites aux questions de l'Autorité sanitaire (HA), des données/préparations scientifiques cliniques pour les interactions avec les AP et des données cliniques entrées dans les présentations réglementaires. Qui vous êtes
• Baccalauréat requis (les sciences de la vie préférées). Le diplôme de clinicien/science avancé est très préféré (p. ex. doctorat, doctorat en médecine, MSN, MPH, etc.).
• 0 à 3 ans d'expérience clinique. Bien que l'expérience antérieure soit un atout, nous cherchons surtout une personne qui a un potentiel élevé, une forte motivation et une volonté d'apprendre.
• Il est nécessaire de se familiariser avec les lois, les règlements et les directives régissant l'exécution des essais cliniques à l'échelle mondiale et de connaître certains aspects médicaux du GCP (bonnes pratiques cliniques), de l'ICH (Conférence internationale sur l'harmonisation des prescriptions techniques relatives à l'enregistrement des produits pharmaceutiques à usage humain), de la FDA, de l'EMA et d'autres directives et règlements pertinents.
• Bonne compréhension des fonctions multidisciplinaires liées au développement de la drogue. L'expérience d'essais cliniques pertinents dans certains domaines thérapeutiques ou un potentiel évident d'assimilation avec un certain soutien.
• De solides compétences en collaboration avec la capacité de travailler efficacement au sein d'une équipe mondiale géographiquement répartie. Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dédiés à la promotion de la science, garantissant à tous l'accès aux soins de santé

The Position On en Roche Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one? Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale. What is it?
• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.
• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.
• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.
• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning. Why join?

• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale
• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations
• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams
• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback

• Demand & Supply Planning
• Transport & 3PL Network Management
• Order management & customer collaboration The Position
• Monitor and analyze key supply chain KPIs
• Support demand and supply planning activities

• Contribute to inventory optimization and stock management
• Collaborate with logistics partners to ensure reliable delivery
• Support projects for network optimization and process improvement initiatives

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Purpose Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications . Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public. Role scope: Key responsibilities
• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies
• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas
• Plan and handle medical budgets
• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions
• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness
• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues
• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come Commercial Business Leader (CBL) per Foundation Medicine Institute, lavorerai all'interno di un ecosistema innovativo guidato da Foundation Medicine, un pioniere con oltre 15 anni di leadership nel combinare il progresso scientifico e tecnologico con le strategie di trattamento trasformativo. A Roche, ci impegniamo a trasformare la salute e ad avere un impatto positivo sulla vita dei pazienti. Unire il nostro team significa contribuire a promuovere la trasformazione della salute su scala globale in un ambiente dinamico che favorisce la collaborazione e l'eccellenza. In questo ruolo di alto impatto, avrete l'opportunità unica di plasmare il futuro della Medicina di Precisione su scala globale e garantire che le nostre soluzioni innovative traducono in benefici che cambiano la vita per i pazienti di tutto il mondo. Come membro centrale del International Business Team (IBT), rappresenterai l'International Commercial Business Unit, che fungerà da ponte strategico tra le funzioni globali e l'esecuzione regionale/locale. In questa capacità, si agirà come principale Collegamento Commerciale all'Area Business FMI, portando la "Voce del Cliente" all'avanguardia dell'organizzazione per informare i requisiti del prodotto e modellare le priorità del portafoglio. L'opportunità
• Strategia commerciale e esecuzione: guidare la progettazione, l'esecuzione e la priorità delle strategie commerciali, dei modelli operativi e dei progetti strategici chiave (ad esempio, le squadre, le comunità di pratica) per i mercati internazionali in collaborazione con le regioni.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: agire come collegamento commerciale alla corrispondente Business Area, Pharma e Rete Area Malattia, che rappresenta la voce del cliente dei mercati internazionali per dare priorità alla roadmap del portafoglio prodotti.
• Supporto affiliato & Market Expansion: Steer the business, supporto affiliati con diverse esigenze aziendali, guidare la riuscita implementazione dei prodotti FMI, identificare nuove opportunità di mercato / corsi, e gestire i rischi di mercato come definito nel Business Plan e P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support affiliati in riunioni di clienti di alto livello / C (ad esempio, ospedali di alto livello, laboratori, paganti), fornire risorse centrali per trattative di contratto / clienti, e accelerare sinergie trasversali attraverso FMI IBT, iKAMs e Pharma.
• Integrazione della gestione delle malattie: assicurare l'integrazione della vostra area di attenzione in un approccio globale di gestione delle malattie, ove applicabile, collaborando strettamente con gli Affari medici e governativi / MAx e il capitolo della strategia regionale e innovazione.
• Change & Risk Management: Guidare cambiamenti organizzativi, sviluppare concetti di rete regionale, anticipare scenari di rischio, e stabilire adeguate strategie di gestione del rischio e mitigazione.
• Pianificazione finanziaria: collaborare con altri leader commerciali e finanza per preparare, tracciare e regolare il budget e la pianificazione aziendale internazionale in risposta alle influenze interne ed esterne. Chi sei
• Leader commerciale esperto: possiede un minimo di un diploma di laurea (o equivalente) con almeno 7 anni di esperienza in settori IVD o correlati, un forte record di decisioni commerciali strategiche, e l'esperienza preferita in un ruolo orientato al cliente o sul campo.
• Acume Strategico & Business: Dimostra l'agilità strategica comprovata per tradurre ampi piani concettuali in azioni semplificate, forte acume aziendale, e una solida comprensione del mercato clinico/prescrittivo (ad esempio, cura Oncologia) e sistemi sanitari.
• Progetto e cambiamento C

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As the Commercial Business Leader (CBL) for Foundation Medicine, you will work within an innovative ecosystem led by Foundation Medicine, a pioneer with over 15 years of leadership in combining scientific and technology advancement with transformative treatment strategies. At Roche, we are committed to transforming healthcare and making a positive impact on patients' lives. Joining our team means contributing to driving healthcare transformation on a global scale within a dynamic environment that fosters collaboration and excellence. In this high-impact role, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of Precision Medicine on a global scale and ensure that our innovative solutions translate into life-changing benefits for patients across the globe. As a core member of the International Business Team (IBT), you will represent the International Commercial Business Unit, serving as the strategic bridge between global functions and regional/local execution. In this capacity, you will act as the primary Commercial Liaison to the FMI Business Area, bringing the "Voice of the Customer" to the forefront of the organization to inform product requirements and shape portfolio priorities. The Opportunity
• Commercial Strategy & Execution: Drive the design, execution, and prioritization of commercial strategies, operating models, and key strategic projects (e.g., squads, communities of practice) for International Markets in collaboration with the regions.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Act as the Commercial Liaison to the corresponding Business Area, Pharma, and Disease Area Network, representing the customer voice of International Markets to prioritize the product portfolio roadmap.
• Affiliate Support & Market Expansion: Steer the business, support affiliates with diverse business needs, drive the successful implementation of FMI products, identify new market opportunities/trends, and manage market risks as defined in the Business Plan and P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support affiliates in high-stakes/C-level customer meetings (e.g., top hospitals, labs, payers), provide central resources for contract negotiations/tenders, and accelerate cross-functional synergies across FMI IBTs, iKAMs, and Pharma.
• Disease Management Integration: Ensure the integration of your focus area into an overall disease management approach where applicable, collaborating closely with Medical & Government Affairs / MAx and the regional strategy and innovation chapter.
• Change & Risk Management: Drive organizational changes, develop regional networking concepts, anticipate risk scenarios, and establish suitable risk management and mitigation strategies.
• Financial Planning: Collaborate with other commercial business leaders and finance to prepare, track, and adjust the International Business budget and business planning in response to internal and external influences. Who You Are
• Experienced Commercial Leader: Holds a minimum of a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) with at least 7 years of experience in IVD or related sectors, a strong track record of strategic commercial decision-making, and preferred experience in a customer-facing or field-based role.
• Strategic & Business Acumen: Demonstrates proven strategic agility to translate broad conceptual plans into simplified actions, strong business acumen, and a robust understanding of the clinical/prescriber market (e.g., Oncology care) and healthcare systems.
• Project & Change Champion: P

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que chef commercial (CBL) de la Fondation Medicine Institute, vous travaillerez au sein d'un écosystème novateur dirigé par Foundation Medicine, un pionnier de plus de 15 ans de leadership dans la combinaison des progrès scientifiques et technologiques avec des stratégies de traitement transformatrices. Chez Roche, nous nous engageons à transformer les soins de santé et à avoir un impact positif sur la vie des patients. Rejoindre notre équipe signifie contribuer à la transformation des soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale dans un environnement dynamique qui favorise la collaboration et l'excellence. Dans ce rôle à impact élevé, vous aurez l'occasion unique de façonner l'avenir de la médecine de précision à l'échelle mondiale et de veiller à ce que nos solutions innovantes se traduisent par des avantages qui changent la vie des patients à travers le monde. À ce titre, vous agirez en tant que principale liaison commerciale avec le secteur d'activité de l'IMF, en mettant la « voix du client » au premier plan de l'organisation pour informer les exigences du produit et façonner les priorités du portefeuille. L'opportunité
• Stratégie commerciale et exécution: Diriger la conception, l'exécution et la hiérarchisation des stratégies commerciales, des modèles opérationnels et des projets stratégiques clés (par exemple, les équipes, les communautés de pratique) pour les marchés internationaux en collaboration avec les régions.

• Soutien aux filiales et expansion du marché : dirigez l'entreprise, soutenez les filiales ayant des besoins d'affaires variés, dirigez la mise en oeuvre réussie des produits de l'IMF, identifiez de nouvelles opportunités/tendances du marché et gérez les risques du marché tels que définis dans le plan d'affaires et P&L.
• Hautes étapes et gestion des parties prenantes: soutenir les filiales dans les réunions de clients de haut niveau/C (p. ex., les hôpitaux de haut niveau, les laboratoires, les payeurs), fournir des ressources centrales pour les négociations contractuelles/appels d'offres, et accélérer les synergies interfonctionnelles entre les IBT de l'IMF, les iKAM et les Pharma.
• Intégration de la gestion des maladies : assurez l'intégration de votre domaine d'intervention dans une approche globale de gestion des maladies, le cas échéant, en collaborant étroitement avec les Affaires médicales et gouvernementales/MAx et le chapitre sur la stratégie régionale et l'innovation.

• Planification financière: Collaborer avec d'autres chefs d'entreprise et de finance pour préparer, suivre et ajuster le budget des affaires internationales et la planification des affaires en réponse aux influences internes et externes. Qui vous êtes
• Leader commercial expérimenté : est titulaire d'un baccalauréat (ou d'un équivalent) d'au moins 7 ans d'expérience en DIV ou dans des secteurs connexes, d'une solide expérience en matière de prise de décisions commerciales stratégiques et d'une expérience privilégiée dans un rôle axé sur le client ou sur le terrain.

• Responsibilities / Accountabilities 1. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About Roche UK A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. The Opportunity Imagine working for an organization that puts people at the heart of everything they do, where your contributions directly impact patient outcomes. At Roche, our number one priority is our patients, and we believe that every person plays a key role in achieving this mission. As a Regulatory Partner at Roche UK, you will be a vital part of our UK Regulatory Chapter. You will leverage your regulatory and scientific expertise to shape and drive strategic initiatives. This is your opportunity to make a difference and be part of a company dedicated to improving lives. UK Regulatory Group Responsibilities The Regulatory group collaborates with the wider business to translate the constantly evolving requirements of the UK regulatory environment into Roche policies, procedures, solutions, and strategies that ensure compliance and maximize the value for patients. Our activities encompass:
• Clinical Trial Applications
• National Licensing Applications
• Early Access to Medicines Applications
• National components of medicines authorization via the European Centralized procedure The team serves as Roche's primary contact with the MHRA, requiring effective cross-functional collaboration at both local and global levels, as well as the capability to negotiate and influence externally. Regulatory Partners need to be adaptable and entrepreneurial to identify opportunities, while maintaining a focused approach on ensuring compliance and playing a key role in retaining Roche UK's License to Operate. Who You Are You are a passionate regulatory expert with a clear vision for improving patient outcomes. With broad and comprehensive expertise within the UK regulatory environment, you will lead foundational work and partner with the business to solve complex regulatory issues impacting the chapter and/or wider business. You will contribute to the development of squad/chapter-based strategic plans and goals, and actively participate in the learning and development of other chapter members. You will have the ability to understand scientific and technical information relating to an assigned portfolio of Roche products. You also bring :
• A Scientific University degree
• Extensive experience in UK Regulatory Affairs
• Proven experience managing UK submissions post-Brexit
• Experience providing strategic and technical advice
• In-depth knowledge and experience of UK and EU regulatory requirements and procedures
• A proven track record of developing, implementing, and communicating regulatory strategies
• Excellent documentation skills to ensure high-quality and timely submissions
• Experience as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in defined subject areas or therapeutic areas
• Experience in mentoring peers, as well as managing stakeholder relationships Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambi

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Cybersecurity Analyst (Incident Response Operations) The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a CyberSecurity Analyst, you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems. As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents. Responsibilities:
• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment
• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information
• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts
• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents
• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations
• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team
• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group
• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management
• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes
• Mentor newer team members Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment
• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices
• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience
• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents
• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts
• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)
• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)
• Excellent organization and communication skills.
• Fluent spoken and written English Preferred Qualifications:
• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment
• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring
• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)
• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)
• A passion for the field of computer and network security
• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets
• Public speaking or mentoring experience Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build

All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems. As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents. Responsibilities:
• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment
• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information
• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts
• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents
• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations
• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team
• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group
• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management
• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes
• Mentor newer team members Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment
• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices
• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience
• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents
• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts
• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)
• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)
• Excellent organization and communication skills.
• Fluent spoken and written English Preferred Qualifications:
• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment
• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring
• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)
• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)
• A passion for the field of computer and network security
• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets
• Public speaking or mentoring experience Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Descrizione A Roche potete mostrare chi siete, addestrati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuine, dove siete valorizzati, attrezzature e rispettati per chi siete, permettendo a voi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui intendiamo portare, fermare e curare le malattie e assicurare a tutti l'accesso alle cure oggi e per le generazioni future. Unitevi a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La Divisione Roche Diagnostics è in un percorso eccitante per diventare più orientaleta ai dati, riconoscendo i dati come un bene critico per crescere il nostro business e imparare e aumentare costantemente. Questa trasformazione è guidata dall'implementazione di una strategia dati relativi e di un nuovo modello di gestione e governo dei dati, sovrainteso dall'Ufficio dei Dati Diagnostics (DDO).
• Stiamo cercando un esperito Lead per l'Adozione dei Dati con un forte background nell'industria delle scienze della vita. In questa posizione, fornire strategie e approcci per fornire ai key business e stakeholder tecnici per raggiungere la visione della Strategia dei Dati Diagnostics Roche, dove i dati sono condivisi e utilizzati di nuovo, e di nuovo, e di nuovo. L'Opportunità - Guidare e sovraintendere progetti di impatto alto che servono da catalizzatori per la Strategia Globale dei Dati Dia, diffusondo obiettivi di alto livello in piani organizzativi azionabili e scalabili, assicurando flussi di dati lisci e sicuri dai prodotti diagnostic cobas e navify. - Agire come partner strategico e individua, valutare e perfezionare le metodologie più efficaci per raggiungere gli obiettivi strategici in contesti di business diversifica. - Navigare una matrice globale complessa per allineare gli stakeholder in diverse regioni e aree colpite, compresi i Senior Management, gli Affiliati, il Legale e gli esperti tecnici e di dati. - Agire come moderatore principale per risolvere frizioni interfunzionali, colmando il pericolo tra le esigenze tecniche, le ragioni legali e le esigenze di business. - Identificare proattivamente gli ostacoli organizzativi e i sistemi blocchici che frenano l'adozione della strategia dei dati; progettare e implementare soluzioni creative per rimuoverli. - Dare potere e coachare i contributori e le squadre, raccolte loro strumenti e la mentalità necessaria per guidare il cambiamento all'interno dei propri domini. - Contribuire alla governance dei dati in ambito transdisciplinare, in modo che l'interoperabilità e la combinazione dei prodotti di dati siano facili lungo l'intero ciclo di vita, ad esempio dipendenti da politiche codificate e automatizzate. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Roche Diagnostics Division is on an exciting journey to become more data-driven, recognizing data as a critical asset to grow our business and continuously learn and optimise. This transformation is driven by the implementation of a comprehensive data strategy and a new data operating and governance model, overseen by the Diagnostics Data Office (DDO). We are seeking an experienced Data Adoption Lead with a strong background in the life sciences industry. In this position, you will liaise with key business and technical stakeholders to provide strategies and approaches in order to achieve the vision of the Roche Diagnostics Data Strategy, where data is shared and used again, and again, and again. The Opportunity
• Lead and oversee high-impact projects that serve as catalysts for the global Dia Data Strategy, translating high-level objectives into actionable, scalable organizational roadmaps, ensuring seamless and secure data flows from diagnostic cobas and navify products.
• Act as a strategic partner and identify, evaluate, and refine the most effective methodologies to achieve strategic goals within diverse business contexts.
• Navigate a complex global matrix to align stakeholders across diverse regions and impacted areas, including Senior Management, Affiliates, Legal and technical and data experts.
• Act as a lead moderator to resolve cross-functional frictions, bridging the gap between technical requirements, legal constraints, and business needs.
• Proactively identify organizational burdens and systemic bottlenecks that hinder data strategy adoption; design and deploy creative solutions to dismantle these obstacles.
• Empower and coach contributors and teams, providing them with the tools and mindset necessary to lead change within their own domains.
• Contribute to cross-domain data governance such that interoperability and combination of data products is straightforward along the whole lifecycle, e.g. reliant on codified and automated policies. ​ Who you are
• A Master's degree in Informatics, Engineering or equivalent and 10+ years of experience in life science, healthcare or medtech industries
• 8+ years of experience in business analysis, architecture, project and change management
• Preferably 4+ years experience in Business Coaching and Organizational Development
• Result-oriented with a demonstrated history of delivering in complex environments
• Strong affinity for data and information
• Proven track record of communicating and working with a broad spectrum of stakeholders, from data engineers and scientists to senior business leaders
• Sound knowledge of modern data architecture methods and approaches (Domain-Driven Design, Data Mesh, FAIR principles, etc.)
• Fluent in English (German is a plus) Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Who We Are At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. Step into the Future of IT with Roche! As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Incident Manager at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. You’ll be at the helm of incident management, orchestrating swift and effective responses to ensure our digital infrastructure remains available, performant, and secure. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward. Your Mission Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction. Your Impact Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues. Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant. By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation. Your Core Responsibilities
• Lead the lifecycle of incidents from initial detection to successful resolution and post-incident review.
• Coordinate and guide response teams to resolve incidents quickly and efficiently.
• Develop, implement, and refine incident management processes and procedures.
• Conduct regular reviews to identify root causes and drive the implementation of corrective actions.
• Work on-call outside of normal working hours and weekends as scheduled to ensure continuous support.
• Oversee the onboarding of new products into our support ecosystem.
• Provide consistent and clear updates to technical teams, business users, and management.
• Partner with engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, product managers, test engineers, support teams, and administrators to enhance system reliability.
• Identify and implement opportunities to enhance incident management processes and tools.
• Align SRE activities with product release planning to streamline product adoption.
• Actively contribute to the growth and development of the SRE team's capabilities, nurturing a stronger, more inclusive, and resilient team. Who You Are:
• Minimum Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering

You’ll be at the helm of incident management, orchestrating swift and effective responses to ensure our digital infrastructure remains available, performant, and secure. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward. Your Mission Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction. Your Impact Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues. Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant. By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation. Your Core Responsibilities
• Lead the lifecycle of incidents from initial detection to successful resolution and post-incident review.
• Coordinate and guide response teams to resolve incidents quickly and efficiently.
• Develop, implement, and refine incident management processes and procedures.
• Conduct regular reviews to identify root causes and drive the implementation of corrective actions.
• Work on-call outside of normal working hours and weekends as scheduled to ensure continuous support.
• Oversee the onboarding of new products into our support ecosystem.
• Provide consistent and clear updates to technical teams, business users, and management.
• Partner with engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, product managers, test engineers, support teams, and administrators to enhance system reliability.
• Identify and implement opportunities to enhance incident management processes and tools.
• Align SRE activities with product release planning to streamline product adoption.
• Actively contribute to the growth and development of the SRE team's capabilities, nurturing a stronger, more inclusive, and resilient team. Who You Are:
• Minimum Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering

En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As a R2R Period-End Close Senior Analyst based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be an integral part of our Global Shared Services organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert, delivering advanced accounting support and complex financial analysis while driving process improvements and automation initiatives. You will act as a key point of contact for accounting and reporting matters, serving as a trusted advisor for our supported affiliates. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Accounting Expertise & Audit Leadership: Lead complex accounting analyses and audit activities for assigned areas. You will serve as a subject matter expert for affiliates and internal stakeholders, ensuring technical accounting excellence.
• Financial Reporting & Close Activities: Prepare and review complex financial statements and reports. You will manage month-end close activities, including journal entries, cost allocations, and reconciliations, while maintaining a proper audit trail and compliance with standards.
• Analysis, Commentary & Advisory: Analyze financial results to investigate variances and provide clear, actionable insights to management. You will interpret and communicate financial data effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.
• Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Team Development: Support the growth of the team through coaching, reviewing work, and contributing to cross-functional initiatives and global projects.
• Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements and support automation initiatives to increase the efficiency of the Record-to-Report flow. Who you are: You are a highly analytical finance professional with a strong attention to detail, capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment to meet tight deadlines. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance , or a related field. A professional certification ( CPA, ACCA , or equivalent) is preferred.
• Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of experience in accounting or finance. Prior experience in a Finance Shared Services environment is preferred. Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is a plus.
• Technical Skills: * Strong knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS .
• Experience with ERP systems, specifically SAP (FI, CO/PA, MM, FA, FCC) and BlackLine is highly desirable.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace.
• Languages: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English and Spanish . Portuguese and or French is preferred.
• Core Competencies: * Strong stakeholder management and collaboration abilities.
• Problem-solving mindset with a focus on process automation and continuous improvement.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position On en Roche Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one? Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale. What is it?
• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.
• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.
• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.
• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning. Why join?
• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges
• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale
• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations
• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams
• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback
• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche The Opportunity Drive business performance through financial insight, strategic sourcing, and data-driven decision-making. Rotations may include:
• Customer Finance
• Controlling & Reporting
• Procurement & Strategic Sourcing The Position
• Analyze financial and operational performance to identify risks and opportunities
• Support pricing, cost, and margin optimization initiatives
• Contribute to procurement and sourcing strategies
• Participate in forecasting, business planning, and performance management
• Monitor customer profitability and performance
• Support cross-functional transformation initiative Who you are We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Data Science , or related fields
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)
• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments
• Full availability for a 24-month program Timelines & further information
• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)
• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)
• Start date: September 2026
• Assessment Center: July 7th
