descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione Chi siamo Global Product Strategy (GPS) guida la strategia di Roche e il portafoglio di prodotti - dalla ricerca e sviluppo fino ai pazienti. Come membro del GPS, sarete parte di un gruppo veramente internazionale che collabora con funzioni e affiliati in tutto il mondo, attraverso l'impresa Roche, per plasmare il futuro della medicina. In qualità di Responsabile Area Terapeutica Globale (TAH), Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive, guiderai team multidisciplinari su larga scala, composti da rapporti diretti e indiretti, con notevole influenza sulle prestazioni strategiche, finanziarie e operative dell’azienda. Potrai dirigere direttamente un team di leader senior che sono responsabili per il coordinamento e la gestione della pipeline precoce e del ciclo di vita dei prodotti in fase avanzata e sul mercato; fornire leadership globale, interfunzionale per tutte le attività di sviluppo, tecnico e commerciale per tutte le molecole / prodotti in Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive. Sarete un membro in piedi del GPS Leadership Team e dare contributi significativi alla visione a lungo raggio, strategia e piani per GPS e Roche Pharma generale. Sarete una co-presidente per i comitati di governance dell'Area Terapeutica (TA) pertinenti (commissioni di business e sviluppo / riunioni TAH) e un membro in piedi di vari comitati decisionali globali, come il Comitato Portfolio di Late-Stage (LSPC). Chi sei
• Stiamo cercando un leader con attributi VACC (Visionaire, Architetto, Coach, Catalyst) che si impegna per i nostri nuovi modi di lavorare. Sei autentico e consapevole di te stesso, appassionato del grande quadro, della scienza all'avanguardia e del raggiungimento dei risultati, creando un ambiente diversificato e inclusivo che esalta il meglio della gente. Principali responsabilità In questa posizione, sarai principalmente responsabile per in modo efficace: - Definire, impostare, allineare e supervisionare l'implementazione/adozione della visione a lungo raggio e della strategia globale per le diverse aree terapeutiche della neurologia e dell'immunologia. - Sviluppo e realizzazione di una visione robusta, integrata e coesa e Piano Strategico Area terapeutica, che comprende singole strategie globali di pipeline, area malattia e ciclo di vita (comprese le soluzioni integrate, se del caso), per tutte le aree di attività/indicazioni/disease in Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive. - Ottimizzazione dell'allocazione delle risorse per garantire il portafoglio strategico e i risultati finanziari sono raggiunti, sia all'interno di Neurologia e Immunologia che attraverso GPS. - Garantire rigorose valutazioni commerciali dei risultati della Fase I – III e fornire approfondimenti di esperti, opzioni strategiche e raccomandazioni ai comitati executive e Portfolio Strategici relativi alle attività terapeutiche e al loro potenziale di mercato. - Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCT), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DAT), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLT), e Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, per coordinare le attività attraverso Roche per assicurare l'allineamento globale e affiliato. - Assicurare che i team di Neurologia e Immunologia forniscano una guida di asset leadership, approfondimenti commerciali rilevanti e un rigoroso supporto analitico per le licenze e altre attività di sviluppo aziendale. - Contabile per collaborare con i leader del team Portfolio di Immunology Pharma (IPPT) e del team di neurologia Pharma (NPPT) per garantire la realizzazione delle nostre strategie TA e DA, tra cui sostenere considerazioni strategiche di portafoglio, valutazioni di opportunità e trade-off, promuovendo la collaborazione e la comunità TA end-to-end. - Co-chair Business and Development Boards e TAH meeting per garantire un asset e un processo decisionale a livello di programma robusto e rigoroso. In qualità di co-presidente attraverso i Bordi di Sviluppo e Business, il TAH svolge un ruolo vitale nel sterzare le attività attraverso il loro ciclo di vita end-to-end attraverso il collegamento di esecuzione tecnica con la strategia commerciale. Nella scheda di sviluppo, si assicura che i programmi soddisfino i criteri "Bar". A
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Position Who We Are Global Product Strategy (GPS) drives Roche’s strategy and portfolio of products - from research and development through to patients. As a member of GPS, you will be part of a truly international group that collaborates with functions and affiliates worldwide, across the Roche enterprise, to shape the future of medicine. As the Global Therapeutic Area Head (TAH), Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases, you will lead large-scale, multidisciplinary teams, composed of direct and indirect reports, with considerable influence on the company’s overall strategic, financial and operational performance. You will directly lead a team of senior leaders who are accountable for coordinating and managing the early pipeline and the lifecycle of late-stage and on-market products; providing global, cross-functional leadership for all development, technical, and commercial activities for all molecules/products across Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases. You will be a standing member of the GPS Leadership Team and make significant contributions to the long-range vision, strategy and plans for GPS and Roche Pharma overall. You will be a co-chair for relevant Therapeutic Area (TA) governance boards (business and development boards / TAH meetings) and a standing member of various global decision-making committees, such as the Late-Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC). Who You Are We're looking for a leader with VACC attributes (Visionaire, Architect, Coach, Catalyst) who is committed to our new ways of working. You're authentic and self-aware, passionate about the big picture, cutting-edge science and achieving results while creating a diverse and inclusive environment that brings out the best in the people. Key Responsibilities In this position, you will be primarily accountable for effectively:
• Defining, setting, aligning and overseeing implementation/adoption of the long-range vision and global strategy for the diverse therapeutic areas of Neurology and Immunology.
• Leading development and execution of a robust, integrated and cohesive vision and Therapeutic Area Strategic Plan, which includes individual global pipeline, disease area and lifecycle strategies and plans (including integrated solutions, if appropriate), for all assets/indications/disease areas across Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases.
• Optimizing resource allocation to ensure strategic portfolio and financial outcomes are achieved, both within Neurology and Immunology and across GPS.
• Ensuring rigorous commercial assessments of Phase I – III results and provision of expert insights, strategic options and recommendations to executives and Strategic Portfolio Committees regarding therapeutic area assets and their market potential.
• Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCTs), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DATs), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLTs), and Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, to coordinate activities across Roche to assure global and affiliate alignment.
• Ensuring Neurology and Immunology teams provide asset leadership guidance, relevant commercial insights and rigorous analytical support for licensing and other business development activities.
• Accountable for partnering with the Immunology Pharma Portfolio Team (IPPT) and Neurology Pharma Portfolio Team (NPPT) leaders to ensure the realisation of our TA and DA strategies including supporting strategic portfolio considerations, opportunity assessments, and trade-offs, while fostering end-to-end TA collaboration and community.
• Co-chair Business and Development Boards and TAH meetings to ensure robust and rigorous asset and program level decision making. As a co-chair across the Development and Business Boards, the TAH plays a vital role in steering assets through their end-to-end lifecycle by bridging technical execution with commercial strategy. At the development board, you ensure programs meet the "Bar" criteria. A
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Position Wer wir sind Die globale Produktstrategie (GPS) treibt die Strategie und das Produktportfolio von Roche – von Forschung und Entwicklung bis hin zu Patienten. Als Mitglied von GPS, Sie werden Teil einer wirklich internationalen Gruppe, die mit Funktionen und Tochtergesellschaften weltweit, über das Roche-Unternehmen zusammenarbeiten, um die Zukunft der Medizin zu gestalten. Als Global Therapeutic Area Head (TAH), Neurologie, Immunologie und Infektionskrankheiten führen Sie groß angelegte, multidisziplinäre Teams, die aus direkten und indirekten Berichten bestehen, mit erheblichem Einfluss auf die allgemeine strategische, finanzielle und operative Leistung des Unternehmens. Sie leiten direkt ein Team von führenden Führungskräften, die für die Koordination und Verwaltung der frühen Pipeline und den Lebenszyklus von latenten und auf dem Markt verantwortlich sind; bieten globale, funktionsübergreifende Führung für alle Entwicklung, technische und kommerzielle Aktivitäten für alle Moleküle/Produkte in der Neurologie, Immunologie und Infektionskrankheiten. Sie werden ein stehendes Mitglied des GPS Leadership Teams sein und maßgebliche Beiträge zur Weitsicht, Strategie und Pläne für GPS und Roche Pharma insgesamt leisten. Sie sind Co-Vorsitzender für relevante Therapeutic Area (TA) Governance Boards (Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsboards / TAH-Meetings) und ein ständiges Mitglied verschiedener globaler Entscheidungsgremien wie dem Late-Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC). Wer bist du? Wir suchen einen Führer mit VACC-Attributen (Visionaire, Architekt, Coach, Catalyst), die sich unserer neuen Arbeitsweise verpflichtet. Sie sind authentisch und selbstbewusst, leidenschaftlich über das große Bild, innovative Wissenschaft und Ergebnisse zu erzielen, während eine vielfältige und integrative Umgebung zu schaffen, die das Beste in den Menschen bringt. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten In dieser Position sind Sie in erster Linie für effektiv verantwortlich: - Definieren, Einstellen, Ausrichten und Übersehen der Umsetzung/Annahme der langfristigen Vision und der globalen Strategie für die vielfältigen therapeutischen Bereiche der Neurologie und Immunologie. - Führende Entwicklung und Durchführung einer robusten, integrierten und zusammenhängenden Vision und Therapeutic Area Strategic Plan, die individuelle globale Pipeline-, Krankheits- und Lebenszyklusstrategien und -pläne (einschließlich integrierter Lösungen, gegebenenfalls) für alle Assets/Indications/Disease-Bereiche in der Neurologie, Immunologie und Infektionskrankheiten umfasst. - Optimierung der Ressourcenzuweisung, um ein strategisches Portfolio und finanzielle Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten, sowohl innerhalb der Neurologie als auch im Bereich der Immunologie und des GPS. - Sicherstellung strenger kommerzieller Bewertungen der Phase I – III Ergebnisse und Bereitstellung von fachkundigen Erkenntnissen, strategischen Optionen und Empfehlungen an Führungskräfte und Strategische Portfolio-Komitees in Bezug auf therapeutische Flächenaktiva und ihr Marktpotenzial. - Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCTs), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DATs), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLTs) und Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, um Aktivitäten über Roche zu koordinieren, um eine globale und assoziierte Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten. - Die Teams für Neurologie und Immunologie sorgen für Asset-Führung, relevante kommerzielle Erkenntnisse und strenge analytische Unterstützung für Lizenzierung und andere Geschäftsentwicklungsaktivitäten. - Verantwortlich für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Immunology Pharma Portfolio Team (IPPT) und dem Neurology Pharma Portfolio Team (NPPT) Führungskräften, um die Umsetzung unserer TA- und DA-Strategien zu gewährleisten, einschließlich der Unterstützung strategischer Portfoliobetrachtungen, Gelegenheitsbeurteilungen und Trade-offs, und gleichzeitig die Förderung einer end-to-end TA-Kollaboration und -Community. - Co-Vorsitzende Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsräte und TAH-Meetings, um eine robuste und strenge Entscheidungsfindung im Bereich Asset und Programmebene zu gewährleisten. Als Co-Vorsitzender in den Entwicklungs- und Wirtschaftsräten spielt die TAH eine wichtige Rolle bei der Steuerung von Vermögenswerten durch ihren End-to-End-Lebenszyklus, indem sie technische Ausführung mit kommerzieller Strategie überbrücken. Im Entwicklungsboard stellen Sie sicher, dass Programme die Kriterien "Bar" erfüllen. A
descriptionByLocale.fr: La position Qui nous sommes La stratégie mondiale des produits (GPS) stimule la stratégie Roches et son portefeuille de produits - de la recherche et du développement jusqu'aux patients. En tant que membre du GPS, vous ferez partie d'un groupe véritablement international qui collabore avec des fonctions et des affiliés dans le monde entier, à travers l'entreprise Roche, pour façonner l'avenir de la médecine. En tant que Responsable du Secteur Thérapeutique Mondial (TAH), Neurologie, Immunologie et Maladies Infectieuses, vous dirigerez des équipes multidisciplinaires à grande échelle, composées de rapports directs et indirects, avec une influence considérable sur la performance globale stratégique, financière et opérationnelle de l'entreprise. Vous dirigerez directement une équipe de cadres supérieurs responsables de la coordination et de la gestion du pipeline précoce et du cycle de vie des produits en retard et sur le marché; fournirez un leadership mondial et interfonctionnel pour toutes les activités de développement, techniques et commerciales de toutes les molécules/produits de la neurologie, de l'immunologie et des maladies infectieuses. Vous serez un membre permanent de l'équipe de leadership du GPS et apporterez une contribution importante à la vision, à la stratégie et aux plans à long terme du GPS et de Roche Pharma. Vous serez coprésident des conseils de gouvernance des domaines thérapeutiques pertinents (conseils d'affaires et de développement/réunions des TAH) et membre permanent de divers comités décisionnels mondiaux, comme le Comité du portefeuille en fin d'étape. Qui vous êtes Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader avec des attributs VACC (Visionaire, Architecte, Coach, Catalyst) qui est engagé dans nos nouvelles façons de travailler. Vous êtes authentique et conscient de vous-même, passionné par la vision d'ensemble, la science de pointe et l'obtention de résultats tout en créant un environnement diversifié et inclusif qui fait ressortir le meilleur des gens. Principales responsabilités Dans ce poste, vous serez principalement responsable : - Définir, mettre en place, aligner et superviser la mise en œuvre/l'adoption de la vision à long terme et de la stratégie globale dans les divers domaines thérapeutiques de la neurologie et de l'immunologie. - Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre d'une vision solide, intégrée et cohérente et d'un plan stratégique sur les domaines thérapeutiques, qui comprend des stratégies et des plans globaux individuels sur les domaines de la maladie et du cycle de vie (y compris des solutions intégrées, s'il y a lieu) pour tous les biens, les indicateurs et les maladies de la neurologie, de l'immunologie et des maladies infectieuses. - Optimiser l'allocation des ressources pour s'assurer que le portefeuille stratégique et les résultats financiers sont atteints, tant au sein de la neurologie et de l'immunologie que dans l'ensemble du GPS. - Assurer des évaluations commerciales rigoureuses des résultats de la Phase I – III et fournir aux cadres supérieurs et aux comités du portefeuille stratégique des connaissances spécialisées, des options stratégiques et des recommandations concernant les actifs thérapeutiques et leur potentiel commercial. - Catalyser les équipes de cycle de vie (ELD), les équipes de stratégie des régions de maladies (EAD), les équipes de leadership en commercialisation (ELD) et les équipes de planification intégrée du développement et de la commercialisation (PDIC) afin de coordonner les activités dans l'ensemble de Roche afin d'assurer l'alignement des activités à l'échelle mondiale et des filiales. - Veiller à ce que les équipes de neurologie et d'immunologie fournissent des conseils sur le leadership des actifs, des renseignements commerciaux pertinents et un soutien analytique rigoureux pour les licences et autres activités de développement des entreprises. - Responsable du partenariat avec l'équipe de portefeuille d'Immunology Pharma (IPPT) et les chefs de file de l'équipe de portefeuille de Neurology Pharma (NPPT) pour assurer la réalisation de nos stratégies d'AT et d'AD, y compris l'appui à des considérations stratégiques de portefeuille, des évaluations des possibilités et des compromis, tout en favorisant la collaboration et la communauté d'AT de bout en bout. - Coprésider les conseils d'affaires et de développement et les réunions du TAH pour assurer une prise de décision solide et rigoureuse au niveau des biens et des programmes. En tant que coprésident des Conseils de développement et d'affaires, le TAH joue un rôle essentiel dans la direction des actifs tout au long de leur cycle de vie en reliant l'exécution technique à la stratégie commerciale. Au conseil de développement, vous assurez que les programmes répondent aux critères « Bar ». A

The Position Dein Team Als Nurse Liaison Manager:in (NLM) wirst Du Teil unserer Disease Area Neuroimmunologie. In Deiner Rolle als Expert:in im Außendienst gestaltest Du die Zusammenarbeit mit der Nurses-Community sowie unseren Teams in Vertrieb, Medical und Marketing aktiv mit. Wir verstehen uns als verlässliche Partner für Behandelnde, um gemeinsam die bestmögliche Versorgung von Patient:innen mit Multipler Sklerose zu fördern. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
• Beratung & Schulung: Du informierst und schulst Nurses und Ärzte zur Anwendung von B-Zell- und IL6-Therapien, inkl. Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Komplikationsmanagement.
• Organisationsberatung: Du berätst Praxen und Kliniken bei der Optimierung von Ablauforganisationen rund um unsere Neuroimmunologie-Produkte.
• Digitale Lösungen: Du begleitest die Implementierung unserer CE-zertifizierten Medizinprodukte (z.B. Brisa) zur Therapieunterstützung.
• Eventmanagement: Du planst und gestaltest aktiv lokale Anwendertreffen, Best-Practice-Sharing-Konzepte und moderierst Workshops.
• Netzwerkarbeit: Du identifizierst Kundenbedürfnisse vor Ort und bringst Deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in das Disease Area Squad ein.
• Crossfunktionale Kooperation: Du arbeitest eng mit allen Vertretern der Customer Pacing Functions, Medical, Marketing und Patient Partnership Bereichen zusammen und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Account Plänen. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger:in, Medizinische Fachangestellte oder vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 4 Jahre), idealerweise in der Neurologie.
• Erfahrung in der Therapie der Multiplen Sklerose (MS),insbesondere im Umgang mit MS-Patienten und Erfahrung im Management von Praxisabläufen und der Anleitung von Pflegekräften (Praxisanleiter:in)
• Medizinische Praxis: Sicherer Umgang mit Venenverweilkanülen, Durchführung von Infusionstherapien und Komplikationsmanagement.
• Zusatzqualifikation: Kenntnisse im Qualitätsmanagement (QSM) und Ausbildung zum Medizinprodukteberater sind von Vorteil.
• Hohe Sozialkompetenz, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist.
• Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace/MS Office sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis. Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente: Aktueller Lebenslauf. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As an EHS Technician, you support the Manufacturing and R&D functions of GenMark Diagnostics across all Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) matters. Under general supervision, you perform technical duties including hazardous waste disposal, office ergonomics, and the maintenance of site SHE documentation. You serve as a key resource, providing safety expertise and guidance to site leadership The Opportunity
• Assisting in maintaining corporate safety standards and policies, adapting to changes, and ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations by creating and maintaining safety records, data, and files.
• Supporting the safety supervisor in implementing policies, procedures, and training, including ergonomic assessments, industrial hygiene surveys, evacuation drills, facility inspections, and handling and disposal of hazardous chemicals and medical waste.
• Coordinating, conducting, and participating in regular safety meetings, such as Emergency Response Team meetings, while managing and maintaining required documentation.
• Utilizing and updating company-specific SHE Data Management Software, Work Order systems, and Preventive Maintenance software to support safety operations efficiently.
• Assisting with incident investigations, follow-up on corrective actions, and thorough documentation of safety/environmental/equipment-related incidents.
• Developing metrics, creating data summaries, and preparing communications for leadership reporting to facilitate informed decision-making.
• Performing additional tasks as assigned, contributing to a wide range of safety and environmental health responsibilities essential to the position. Who You Are
• You bring a minimum of 1 year of experience in an EHS-specific role.
• If you have two years of college courses completed in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or another technical degree, that's preferred
• CPR, AED and First Aid Instructor Certification are preferred Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.
• Knowledge of Emergency Action and Emergency Response Plans, including recurring training and drills
• Self-directed and demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple projects and prioritize. You are a trusted partner and can influence within a complex and collaborative organization.
• You bring technical skills with the ability to explain complex issues and requirements verbally and in writing in an easily understood manner. Proficient in computer skills.
• Interpersonal and cross-cultural skills; willingness to work flexible hours Relocation Benefits are not offered for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position, based on California is 40,200.00.- 74,600.00 USD annually. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. Benefits Who we are GenMark is now a proud member of the Roche Group, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. As a global leader in healthcare, Roche Diagnostics offers a broad portfolio of products, tools and services that help in the prevention, diagnosis and management of diseases like HPV, HIV, hepatitis and diabetes as well as other medical conditions, such as fertility and blood coagulation.

titleByLocale.it: Partner del Viaggio Paziente (Hematology & Hemophilia - Timisoara)

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Partner del Viaggio Paziente (PJP) in Ematologia & Hemophilia sarà al centro della nuova organizzazione Roche, ponendo in risalto il ruolo che giochiamo nella società - dall'offrire per lo più medicine straordinarie verso una maggiore collaborazione, innovazione e interruzione generativa. Come leader potenziato e il volto di Roche, collaborerai a stretto contatto con tutti i partner che toccano direttamente il percorso del paziente, acquisendo una profonda comprensione delle loro esigenze, al servizio della connessione delle capacità di Roche per creare soluzioni significative. Inoltre, sarete responsabili di:
• Agire come partner affidabile e punto di contatto primario tra le parti interessate e Roche, priorità e protezione delle risorse, e soluzioni di guida che forniscono risultati più velocemente.
• Collaborare con i partner di viaggio del paziente per rimuovere i blocchi stradali e sbloccare le possibilità di offrire valore ai pazienti e alla comunità.
• Guidare i prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e sostenere il loro uso appropriato, condividendo i loro meriti con HCP in modo veritiero ed equilibrato.
• Assicurare grandi esperienze quando i partner dell'ecosistema si impegnano con dipendenti, prodotti e servizi Roche. Chi sei Lei dimostra lo scopo personale nel migliorare il viaggio del paziente, nonché una forte passione per portare valore e impatto all'ecosistema sanitario. Sei un vero visionario, definendo e incorporando la strategia intorno alla creazione di migliori risultati di salute per più pazienti più velocemente, portando una forte mentalità imprenditoriale con eccellenti capacità di partner (coaching, consulenza, capacità di ascoltare profondamente, domanda e capire). Inoltre, si portano le seguenti competenze & esperienza:
• mentalità di crescita, in grado di imparare e scatenare rapidamente, correre rischi e sperimentare, e contribuire al ciclo di apprendimento condividendo la conoscenza con gli altri all'interno e all'esterno Roche
• Autogestito e autodiretto - altruista nel sostenere la rete globale
• Visualizzazione dell'integrità in tutto come leader che percepisce, riflette e risponde
• Agisce coraggiosamente su decisioni e opportunità chiave e ferma audacemente qualsiasi attività che non aggiunge valore.
• Eccellenti capacità di coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, tra cui la collaborazione con gli esperti di area terapeutica (TAEs) e le organizzazioni è necessaria.
• Esperienza sia nella formulazione di strategie interfunzionali che nell'orchestrazione di team interfunzionali
• Occhio sicuro per il business con esperienza desiderata nella commercializzazione, l'eccellenza dell'esperienza medica e del cliente
• In grado di comprendere e utilizzare mezzi e strumenti digitali
• Una profonda conoscenza del percorso dei pazienti e dei trattamenti correlati nell'area(i) definita della malattia, consentendo l'impegno a livello specialistico.
• Ampia comprensione del portafoglio attuale di Roche e della futura pipeline, in modo da poter lavorare su soluzioni future
• Robusta comprensione delle strategie di affari medici e tattiche, compresa la ricerca clinica
• Sei fluente in lingua rumena e inglese Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) in Hematology & Hemophilia will be at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering extraordinary medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. As an empowered leader and the face of Roche, you will collaborate closely with all partners directly touching the patient journey, gaining a deep understanding of their needs, in service of connecting Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. In addition, you will be responsible for:
• Acting as a trusted partner and the primary point of contact between stakeholders and Roche, prioritising and securing resources, and driving solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• Collaborating with patient journey partners to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.
• Guiding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
• Ensuring great experiences whenever partners in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Who You Are You demonstrate personal purpose in improving the patient journey, as well as a strong passion to bring value and impact to the healthcare ecosystem. You are a true visionary, defining and embedding the strategy around creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand). In addition, you bring the following skills & experience:
• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche
• Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network
• Display of integrity in everything as a leader who senses, reflects and responds
• Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value.
• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and organizations is required.
• Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams
• Keen eye for business with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence
• Able to understand and use digital means and tools
• Deep knowledge of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling engagement at the specialist level.
• Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions
• Robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research
• You are fluent in Romanian and English languages Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) in Hematologie & Hemophilia wird im Zentrum der neuen Roche-Organisation stehen und die Rolle, die wir in der Gesellschaft spielen, auf den Kopf stellen - von meist außergewöhnlichen Medikamenten bis hin zu viel mehr Partnering, innovative und führender Generativstörung. Als kraftvoller Leiter und Gesicht von Roche werden Sie eng mit allen Partnern zusammenarbeiten, die die Patientenreise direkt berühren und ein tiefes Verständnis für ihre Bedürfnisse gewinnen, um Roches Fähigkeiten zu verbinden, um sinnvolle Lösungen zu schaffen. Darüber hinaus sind Sie für:
• Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner und primärer Ansprechpartner zwischen Stakeholdern und Roche, Priorisierung und Sicherung von Ressourcen und Fahrlösungen, die Ergebnisse schneller liefern.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Patienten-Reisepartnern, um Straßensperren zu entfernen und Möglichkeiten zu entsperren, um Wert für Patienten und die Gemeinschaft zu liefern.
• Die Produkte von Roche über ihren Lebenszyklus zu informieren und ihre angemessene Nutzung zu unterstützen und ihre Verdienste mit HCPs in wahrhaftiger und ausgewogener Weise zu teilen.
• Sicherstellung großer Erfahrungen, wenn die Partner im Ökosystem mit Roche-Mitarbeitern, Produkten und Dienstleistungen zusammenarbeiten. Wer bist du? Sie zeigen persönliche Ziele bei der Verbesserung der Patientenreise sowie eine starke Leidenschaft, um Wert und Auswirkungen auf das Ökosystem der Gesundheitsversorgung zu bringen. Sie sind ein wahrer Visionär, definieren und einbetten die Strategie um bessere gesundheitliche Ergebnisse für mehr Patienten schneller zu schaffen, eine starke unternehmerische Mentalität mit hervorragenden Partnerfähigkeiten (Coaching, Beratung, Fähigkeit zu tief zu hören, Frage und Verständnis). Darüber hinaus bringen Sie die folgenden Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung:
• Wachstumsgeist, schnell lernen und unlernen können, Risiken und Experimente eingehen und zum Lernzyklus beitragen, indem sie Wissen mit anderen innerhalb und außerhalb von Roche teilen
• Selbst verwaltet und selbstgerichtet - altruistisch bei der Unterstützung des globalen Netzes
• Anzeige der Integrität in allem als Anführer, der Sinne, Spiegel und Antworten
• Boldly wirkt auf Schlüsselentscheidungen und Chancen und stoppt kühn jede Tätigkeit, die keinen Wert addiert.
• Ausgezeichnete Stakeholder-Verlobungskompetenzen, einschließlich der Zusammenarbeit mit Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) und Organisationen sind erforderlich.
• Erfahrungen bei der Formulierung von funktionsübergreifenden Strategien und der Orchestrierung von funktionsübergreifenden Teams
• Keen Auge für Unternehmen mit gewünschtem Know-how in der Kommerzialisierung, Medizin und Customer Experience Exzellenz
• Befähigt, digitale Mittel und Werkzeuge zu verstehen und zu verwenden
• Tiefe Kenntnis der Patientenreise(n) und damit zusammenhängenden Behandlungen in definierten Krankheitsbereichen, die das Engagement auf der Fachebene ermöglichen.
• Weitreichendes Verständnis von Roches gegenwärtigem Portfolio und zukünftiger Pipeline, so dass sie an zukunftsorientierten Lösungen arbeiten können
• Robustes Verständnis von medizinischen Strategien und Taktiken einschließlich klinischer Forschung
• Sie sind fließend in rumänische und englische Sprachen Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Lassen Sie uns eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le Patient Journey Partner (PJP) en Hématologie et en Hémophilie sera au centre de la nouvelle organisation Roche, tournant à l'envers le rôle que nous jouons dans la société - de l'offre surtout de médicaments extraordinaires à beaucoup plus de partenariat, d'innovation et de principale perturbation génératrice. En tant que leader et visage de Roche, vous collaborerez étroitement avec tous les partenaires touchant directement le parcours patient, en acquérant une compréhension profonde de leurs besoins, au service de la connexion des capacités Roches pour co-créer des solutions significatives. De plus, vous serez responsable :
• Agir en tant que partenaire de confiance et principal point de contact entre les parties prenantes et Roche, hiérarchiser et sécuriser les ressources, et conduire des solutions qui produisent des résultats plus rapidement.
• Collaborer avec des partenaires de voyage pour éliminer les barrages routiers et débloquer les possibilités de fournir de la valeur pour les patients et la communauté.
• Guider les produits Roches tout au long de leur cycle de vie et soutenir leur utilisation appropriée, en partageant leurs mérites avec les HCP de manière honnête et équilibrée.
• Assurer de bonnes expériences chaque fois que les partenaires de l'écosystème s'engagent avec les employés, les produits et les services de Roche. Qui vous êtes Vous faites preuve d'un but personnel en améliorant le parcours des patients, ainsi qu'une forte passion pour apporter valeur et impact à l'écosystème de santé. Vous êtes un véritable visionnaire, définir et intégrer la stratégie autour de la création de meilleurs résultats de santé pour plus de patients plus rapidement, apportant une forte mentalité entrepreneuriale avec des capacités de partenariat exceptionnelles (coaching, consultation, capacité à écouter profondément, questionner et comprendre). En outre, vous apportez les compétences et l'expérience suivantes:
• L'état d'esprit de croissance, capable d'apprendre et de désapprendre rapidement, de prendre des risques et d'expérimenter, et de contribuer au cycle d'apprentissage en partageant les connaissances avec d'autres à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de Roche
• Autogéré et autogéré - altruiste pour soutenir le réseau mondial
• Affichage de l'intégrité en tout en tant que leader qui sens, réfléchit et répond
• Agir avec audace sur les décisions et les opportunités clés et arrêter avec audace toute activité qui n'apporte pas de valeur ajoutée.
• D'excellentes compétences en matière d'engagement des parties prenantes, y compris des partenariats avec des spécialistes des domaines thérapeutiques (ETA) et des organisations, sont nécessaires.
• Expérience dans la formulation de stratégies interfonctionnelles et l'orchestration d'équipes interfonctionnelles
• Keen œil pour les affaires avec l'expertise souhaitée dans la commercialisation, l'expérience médicale et client excellence
• Capable de comprendre et d'utiliser des moyens et des outils numériques
• Une connaissance approfondie du ou des parcours(s) patient(s) et des traitements connexes dans un ou des domaines de maladie définis, permettant l'engagement au niveau des spécialistes.
• Une large compréhension du portefeuille actuel et du futur pipeline de Roches, afin qu'ils puissent travailler sur des solutions basées sur l'avenir
• Compréhension rigoureuse des stratégies et tactiques médicales, y compris la recherche clinique
• Vous parlez couramment le roumain et l'anglais Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Laissez-nous construire un avenir plus sain

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Data Steward Lead Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions Hyderabad A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement (GP) is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next. The Opportunity This role sits within the Enablement Chapter, in Global Procurement Analytics & Insights, where we drive operational and financial effectiveness by delivering trusted data, actionable insights, stronger performance management, and robust decision support for GP leadership and chapters. As Data Steward Lead , you will play a senior role in shaping how Global Procurement defines, governs, documents, validates, and uses its critical data products. You will act as the data stewardship lead for priority procurement data products, ensuring that business definitions, metadata, lineage, data quality expectations, ownership, access requirements, and usage guidance are clear, trusted, and consistently applied. You will work closely with procurement, finance, governance, informatics, data engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders to improve trust in critical metrics such as spend, savings, supplier, category, contract, and sustainability data. This is a senior stewardship and data product governance role. You will connect business meaning with technical implementation, helping ensure that data products are not only built, but also understandable, reusable, well-governed, and fit for decision-making. Responsibilities include
• Leading data stewardship for priority Global Procurement data products, including business definitions, metric logic, ownership, metadata, lineage, data quality expectations, and approved usage.
• Defining and maintaining data product standards and data product contracts, including product purpose, data grain, source dependencies, business rules, ownership, service expectations, and release-readiness criteria.
• Partnering with business owners and domain experts to resolve conflicting metric definitions and align on certified business logic for critical procurement data products.
• Working with data engineering teams to translate business rules into governed data products using modern data platforms and tools such as Snowflake, dbt, GitLab, and related data engineering practices.
• Ensuring that production-grade data products are properly documented and registered in enterprise cataloging tools such as Collibra, including technical metadata, business glossary terms, ownership, stewardship, and lineage.
• Supporting data access and policy alignment in partnership with governance, informatics, and security teams, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Immuta-enabled policy controls, masking requirements, and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) handling where applicable.
• Leading data quality issue triage for critical data products by identifying root causes, coordinating resolution, tracking open risks, and esca

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is based in Roche Services Americas, one of our worldwide Shared Services Centers providing Finance and Procurement services to various countries in the Americas region. As the Record to Report (R2R) CRM SME , you will be based in San José, Costa Rica, reporting to the Cluster Section Lead CRM NALA. The Opportunity: In this specialized role, you will be responsible for executing high-level AR operational activities and serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for our systems and processes. Your focus will be on maintaining technical excellence and driving regional process harmonization. Your responsibilities include:
• SME Leadership: Maintain deep knowledge of accounts receivable processes, flows, and systems. Serve as the technical expert for "AS IS" processes during global project implementations.
• Operational Execution: Coordinate and perform complete, stringent, and timely financial tasks including bank reconciliation, cash application, and clearing of AR/bank suspense accounts.
• Process Improvement: Propose and coordinate system enhancements, sharing best practices from global organizations and following through on implementations.
• Credit & Data Management: Execute Customer Credit Analysis, manage dispute resolutions, and maintain customer credit master data.
• Project Coordination: Support the resolution of gaps found during project rollouts, coordinating testing and documentation to ensure seamless transitions.
• Training & Mentorship: Maintain a training network to ensure knowledge flows across the organization, providing functional guidance to team members.
• Stakeholder Communication: Handle incoming inquiries via calls and emails with a focus on customer service, and facilitate cross-functional communication to resolve complex issues. Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Project Management or Engineering.
• You bring 5+ years of finance and accounting experience, with a deep understanding of R2R and AR process flows.
• You are characterized by a high level of social competence and are fluent in both English and Spanish ; Portuguese is a plus.
• You possess strong technical expertise in Finance Shared Services systems such as SAP, BlackLine, and SNOW . SAP FS-CM and Power BI a plus.
• You are an expert at organizing tasks with limited direction and managing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• You are well known for your independent, yet collaborative working style and your ability to act as a technical bridge between local teams and global projects. Preferred:
• Advanced knowledge of computerized environments (Excel, G-Suite, PowerPoint, Power BI) for data analysis.
• Demonstrated experience in project testing and documentation (UAT) within a Shared Service Center environment. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The Position Como Process Owner - Administrative Engagement Services , serás responsable de gestionar y optimizar los procesos administrativos de la célula de Engagement, la cual centraliza el soporte para las interacciones de Roche con actores clave del sector salud (profesionales, organizaciones, programas de pacientes y donaciones). En este rol, actuarás como guardián del cumplimiento normativo y líder de mejora continua, asegurando que cada contrato, pago o colaboración se ejecute con excelencia operativa y bajo los más altos estándares éticos. The Opportunity
• Liderar proyectos de optimización, simplificación y automatización de procesos para mejorar los tiempos de respuesta y la eficiencia operativa.
• Actuar como experto (SME) orientando a los stakeholders internos y externos en la ejecución correcta de interacciones con actores del sector salud.
• Negociar y monitorear los Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLAs) con los clientes internos para alinear expectativas y capacidad de respuesta.
• Gestionar el equipo de soporte transaccional y personal externo en el procesamiento de contratos, órdenes de compra y documentos de estudios clínicos o donaciones.
• Definir y mantener actualizadas las políticas y procedimientos del área buscando la estandarización de los servicios bajo estándares de cumplimiento.
• Implementar métricas y KPIs para evaluar la capacidad del equipo y realizar análisis de datos que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas.
• Aplicar principios de metodologías ágiles (Scrum y Lean Management) para gestionar el backlog de solicitudes y facilitar reuniones de seguimiento. Who you are
• Profesional en Ingeniería Industrial (preferiblemente), Ingeniería Química, Química Farmacéutica o Administración de Empresas.
• Experiencia mínima de 2 a 4 años en gestión de procesos administrativos, centros de servicios compartidos (SSC), optimización de procesos o gestión de proyectos.
• Experiencia previa en la industria farmacéutica o sector salud (preferible).
• Dominio del idioma inglés a nivel avanzado (B2-C1) para interactuar en un entorno multinacional.
• Conocimiento y aplicación demostrable de metodologías ágiles como Scrum, Six Sigma o Lean Management.
• Mentalidad analítica y metódica con capacidad demostrada para influir en diversos stakeholders. Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocalización. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to an inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing inclusion and belonging enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. The Strategic Quality Partner acts as a single point of contact within project teams (New product development / Product Change) for a portfolio of products assigned to them. The SQP leads and drives for decisions for strategic topics from a compliance and product quality perspective. The SQP partners with internal and external stakeholders across the value chain to accelerate the development process and incorporate learnings. Stakeholders include, but are not limited to Development Leads, Project Leaders, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Global Customer Support, and Post-Market Quality. The Opportunity
• Ensure consistent interpretation & implementation of global requirements across Customer Areas (CAs)
• Incorporate lessons learned from all areas of quality across Customer Areas (CA) into project support and ensure PostMarket Quality feedback is built into the requirements
• Ensure development project plans contain the right deliverables according to the Design & Development module to deliver safe and compliant solutions
• Support internal and external audits
• Lead and facilitate constructive discussions e.g. at project team meetings
• Drive awareness and adoption of the Risk Enabler inside and outside of Global Quality & Regulatory decision making; prepare and enable risk-based decisions
• Partner to ensure effective resolution of issues (e.g. CAPA, NC)
• Ensure effective feedback loops and information flow for milestone review. Who You Are
• Bachelor's degree in science, engineering, business administration or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is considered an advantage.
• 8+ years of experience in the diagnostics industry or a related field in business related f unctions
• Strong scientific and technical background with sound product knowledge, ideally with assay/reagents/system/hardware/software development experience for IVD Products.
• Strong business and financial acumen with an enterprise mindset
• Knowledge of Regulations pertaining to the environment (i.e. ISO 13485, ISO 14971, GDP, GMP, others)
• Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
• Strong agile knowledge and capabilities demonstrating new ways of working
• Pragmatic decision making and ability to move forward without a perfect solution
• Demonstrated thorough E2E understanding for lifecycle management
• Strong leadership capabilities, with experience in leading cross-functional teams (Squad Lead, Matrix Lead) and driving change. Locations You are located in Carlsbad, CA. This is a primarily onsite role. Relocation benefits are not available for this position. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Carlsbad is $103,800 and $221,780. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be a

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Let’s build a healthier future, together. By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche. The Opportunity The Security and Cybersecurity Expert provides expert-level leadership and strategic guidance across the organization's critical security programs and initiatives. This role manages a team of analysts, establishes team objectives and processes, and develops enterprise-wide security best practices that ensure consistency and alignment with organizational standards. The position combines hands-on oversight of high-impact projects with mentorship of less experienced team members, while maintaining quality assurance and strategic alignment across all security initiatives. Responsibilities Accountability/Problem Solving
• Leads comprehensive analysis of complex, strategic business problems across organizational boundaries, conducting root cause analysis and eliciting stakeholder needs to influence sound decision-making and drive consensus through persuasive communication
• Demonstrates mastery in requirements and domain knowledge, providing thought leadership on unusually complex problems with innovative solutions; mentors colleagues, leads large-scale process improvement initiatives, and guides strategic change adaptation while ensuring deliverables align with strategic objectives Stakeholder Management
• Identifies and analyzes complex stakeholder networks across organizational boundaries and global teams, developing comprehensive engagement and communication plans that drive consensus on strategic vision while building and maintaining strong relationships across the organization
• Acts as a master negotiator and trusted advisor to leadership, navigating complex conflicts to achieve alignment, empowering teams in stakeholder management, and serving as a role model in collaboration and organizational trust-building Impact/Strategy
• Drives significant, consistent impact across major products and domains by ensuring delivery of high-value solutions aligned with business strategy, embedding best practices, and leveraging industry trends to influence organizational strategy and foster continuous improvement
• Leads evaluation and implementation of optimal strategic solutions and transitions across large, complex projects spanning multiple domains; manages highly ambiguous requirements holistically while ensuring traceability and alignment with broader organizational goals Who you are
• Advanced technical proficiency in Java, JavaScript, AWS (Amazon Web Services), and SAP Customer Data Cloud (SAPCDC), with comprehensive knowledge of cybersecurity technologies and enterprise systems
• In-depth understanding of business domain, organizational strategy, and Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts; ability to apply systems thinking for holistic, enterprise-wide security consulting
• Demonstrated expertise in complex root cause analysis, requirements elicitation, strategic solution evaluation, and traceability principles across organizational boundaries
• Proven leadership and mentoring capabilities with ability to manage technical teams, build consensus among senior stakeholders, and establish trusted advisory relationships that influence strategic decisions
• Track record of driving significant impact through large-scale process improvements, change management initiatives, and thought leadership in emerging security trends and industry best pract

In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability. As a Safety Director, you will provide vital safety science and pharmacovigilance support across our diverse portfolio, ensuring the safety of our participants and the integrity of our clinical data from early development through to marketed products. • Develop and maintain an expert understanding of product safety profiles and drive the overarching safety strategy for assigned molecules.
• Drive signal detection and management activities, ensuring proactive identification and evaluation of safety issues.

• Lead safety science contributions for global regulatory filings, including INDs, NDAs, and MAAs.
• In partnership with the SSL, you will support the presentation of important safety issues to internal and external review and governance committees, as needed.
• Work cross-functionally in a global matrix environment, mentoring colleagues and coordinating with external vendors to ensure excellence in safety science.
• Act as a functional business process owner or subject matter expert to improve our safety science practices.
• You may be expected to support non-molecule projects, due diligence evaluations and other projects as needed.

At Roche, you will find a culture that values your expertise and offers you the space to grow as a leader in safety science.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design. The Opportunity: We are looking for an upbeat, dynamic, innovative and creative individual who is highly involved and very passionate about Digital Marketing and Project Management. As a Digital Campaign Intern you will be responsible for supporting our Delivery Managers to deliver on campaign objectives for various affiliates globally. You will be at the forefront of our project deliveries and the work you'll do will directly impact the way affiliates will interact with our teams. In this position you will be focusing on :
• Assisting in project managing various digital campaigns to enhance customer satisfaction during asset delivery operations through the DIA Content Lab
• Managing updates of marketing materials in a timely manner in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders depending on the updates incl. communication/coordination with requestors (from the affiliates)
• Managing tickets within our project manager system, coordinating the organization of source files and asset managements for seamless identification and reuse within our global network.
• Staying curious, open-minded, and always willing to do more. Who you are:
• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University /college in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
• You are available at least 20-25 hours per week
• You are passionate about project management
• You're organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, with the ability to easily transition between multiple tasks and problem solve thoughtfully
• You have highly developed interpersonal and communication skills
• You are a quick learner, proactive, flexible and curious with an an innovative mind
• You are a strong team player with ability to work in a virtual team environment
• English proficiency is a must. Any other language is a big plus. In exchange we provide you with: Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career. A global community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about. Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team! Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high,

Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management. The Diagnostics Insights Solution Management Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising solutions with multiple components (digital, physical, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs. As Business Solution Management Associate , you will support us in addressing the challenges in commercializing these integrated solutions. One of our key initiatives in commercializing integrated solutions with country organizations is the multi-year Stronger Solution Selling (S3) program . You will support the S3 core team in delivering strategic workshops with country organizations and optimizing essential solution-selling assets to help cross-functional affiliate teams better navigate Roche Diagnostic’s physical, digital, and service portfolios. This role offers a blend of project management and process refinement, providing a unique platform to shape how the organization delivers tailored value to its customers worldwide. Main responsibilities As a Business Solution Management Associate, you will help us in bridging the gap between strategic methodology and operational execution. Over the course of your one-year assignment, your core responsibilities will include:
• Project Management & Delivery : Take ownership of assigned tasks with a focus on structuring complexity and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality assets.
• Affiliate Support & Collaboration : Directly assist the S3 Core Team in driving activities with country organizations and country clusters.
• Asset & Tool Optimization : Refine existing and develop new solution-selling tools to help teams better navigate Roche’s physical and digital offerings.
• Change Management : Support ongoing activities aimed at sustaining the organizational shift toward effective solution selling.
• Process Improvement : Potentially step up into a process improvement project to refine workflows, systems, or insights that improve the effectiveness of solution selling. How would your day to day look like? As Business Solution Management Associate , you'll work closely with team members in the S3 core team, as well as subregional and country teams. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders for driving improvements in solution commercialization. Your day-to-day will be dynamic and diverse, and could begin by coordinating with the S3 Core Team to support global affiliates and manage project deliverables. You might spend the morning organizing workshops or refining assets that help teams navigate Roche's complex solution portfolio. This involves a high degree of ownership, as you structure complex information into clear, high-quality tools for country organizations. In the afternoon, you shift focus toward process optimization and change management. You might analyze workflows to improve solution-selling insights or collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the S3 methodology is effectively embedded across the region. The Position Présentation de l’équipe: sous la responsabilité de l’Ingénieur Réseau Terrain et du Responsable Régional Equipe Service, tu seras Rattaché(e) à l’équipe Service Excellence. En lien étroit avec les équipes supports et commerciales, tu seras amené(e) à travailler sur des missions liées à l’installation et aux maintiens des réseaux instruments Roche dans les laboratoires d’analyses médicales privés et hospitaliers. Quel sera ton impact? ● Assurer la conception des schémas réseau et déploiement . ● Installer et maintenir le réseau IT Roche toutes gammes en collaboration avec les équipes Ingénieur Service et Ingénieur ITWF. ● Garantir les plans d’actions en lien avec la cybersécurité. ● Effectuer les retrofits hardware / software IT réseau roche, la maintenance des réseaux instruments et les mises à jour des solutions en place chez nos clients. ● Installer et tester les solutions de télémaintenance Roche. ● Assurer la traçabilité et le reporting des interventions et upgrades réalisés. Ton ADN: ● Tu recherches une alternance pour ton Bac+4 ou 5 de 12/24 mois à compter de septembre 2026 ● De formation école d’ingénieurs spécialisé en informatique et réseau et cyber résilience, tu possède également une appétence dans le domaine de la santé. ● Tu as le sens de l’écoute et le sens des responsabilités . ● Autonomie et rigueur te caractérisent, tu aimes travailler en équipe. ● Tu possèdes un bon niveau d’anglais (B2). ● Tu aimes te déplacer et tu es titulaire du permis B depuis plus de 2 ans. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? - Cette alternance va te permettre de développer des compétences concrètes et solides en sécurités et architectures informatique et de découvrir le monde de la santé à travers les laboratoires d’analyses médicales. - Nous considérons les alternants et les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes. - Conformément à la réglementation, tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de travailleurs handicapés. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler. - Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact pour la santé de tous. Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
