descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo in EFG Nel sito Management Mannheim/Penzberg, siamo ben 1300 specialisti per una vasta gamma di infrastrutture e servizi professionali che li forniscono per i siti di Mannheim e Penzberg. In un ambiente dinamico, promuoviamo una cooperazione senza soluzione di continuità tra aree e funzioni aziendali, offriamo soluzioni innovative e migliorare l'ambiente di lavoro dei dipendenti nelle sedi di Mannheim e Penzberg - dove formiamo attivamente il futuro. La nuova struttura organizzativa In questa funzione fai parte delle Operazioni del Sito e appartieni alla Gestione del Fornitore di Servizi di Team. responsabilità Ti aspetti Nel ruolo Lei è responsabile della gestione strategica e del monitoraggio dei servizi integrati di gestione degli impianti (servizi morbidi) da parte di fornitori esterni. Questo consente di eseguire le seguenti attività interessanti
• Controllo del fornitore: Si controlla e controlla i fornitori di servizi IFM esterni per una posizione definita e garantire prestazioni efficienti.
• Gestione della qualità: monitora la conformità agli accordi di livello dei servizi (SLA) e agli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) e avvia misure correttive proattive per le deviazioni.
• Responsabilità finanziaria: Lei è responsabile del monitoraggio e della previsione dei bilanci per i servizi FM e identifica le potenzialità per ridurre i costi e aumentare l'efficienza.
• Responsabilità dell'operatore: in qualità di garanzia della conformità giuridica, l'utente garantisce che tutti gli obblighi legali e interni dell'operatore siano rispettati dai fornitori di servizi.
• Gestione dei progetti: conduce progetti indipendenti per l'ottimizzazione dei processi e l'implementazione di nuovi concetti di servizio con visione digitale.
• Gestione delle interfacce: moderando come driver di collaborazione centrale Tra le esigenze degli utenti interni e le possibilità operative dei partner esterni. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta
• Hai completato con successo un Master/Diplom in Facility Management, Industrial Engineering o Supply Technology o hai una qualifica simile con una formazione a lungo termine (ad esempio uno specialista:in/master:in).
• Hai più di 5 anni di esperienza professionale consolidata nella gestione delle strutture, nella gestione dei fornitori di servizi esterni (gestione dei fornitori) e nella gestione dei progetti.
• L'utente fornisce una conoscenza approfondita del diritto contrattuale e del diritto degli appalti, nonché una solida conoscenza della gestione delle infrastrutture e della responsabilità dell'operatore.
• Sei sicuro nel gestire i sistemi CAFM e SAP e ha una forte mentalità di crescita per aiutare i cambiamenti proattivi in un ambiente dinamico.
• Si parla inglese e generalmente hanno eccellenti competenze comunicative. Come giocatore di squadra, si è in grado di lavorare efficacemente con diversi stakeholder e di comprendere relazioni complesse.
• Le missioni locali, principalmente tra le nostre sedi a Mannheim e Penzberg, possono essere considerate come arricchimento. Cosi' bene? E' meglio. Vi offriamo una varietà di migliori raccordi nelle nostre sedi. Solo con voi possiamo migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Si rende Roche unico con il vostro contributo. Ecco perché offriamo benefici eccezionali che ti sostengono, la tua vita, le tue finanze e la tua salute
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position We in EFG In the Management Mannheim/Penzberg site, we are well 1'300 specialists for a wide range of infrastructure and professional services that provide them for the Mannheim and Penzberg sites. In a dynamic environment, we promote seamless cooperation across business areas and functions, offer innovative solutions and improve the working environment of employees at the Mannheim and Penzberg locations - where we actively shape the future. The new organisational structure In this function you are part of Site Operations and belong to the Team Service Vendor Management. Responsibilities You're expecting In the role You are responsible for the strategic management and monitoring of integrated facility management services (soft services) by external providers. This allows you to perform the following exciting tasks
• Provider control: You control and control external IFM service providers for a defined location and ensure efficient performance.
• Quality management: You monitor compliance with service-level agreements (SLAs) as well as key performance indicators (KPIs) and initiate proactive corrective measures for deviations.
• Financial Responsibility: You are responsible for monitoring and forecasting budgets for FM services and identify potentials for reducing costs and increasing efficiency.
• Operator Responsibility: As a guarantee of legal compliance, you ensure that all statutory and internal operator obligations are complied with by the service providers.
• Project management: You conduct independent projects for process optimization and the implementation of new service concepts with digital vision.
• Interface management: moderating as a central collaboration driver You between the needs of internal users and the operational possibilities of external partners. Qualifications | That brings you
• You have successfully completed a Master/Diplom degree in Facility Management, Industrial Engineering or Supply Technology or have a comparable qualification with long-term training (e.g. a specialist:in/master:in).
• You have more than 5 years of well-founded professional experience in facility management, management of external service providers (provider management) and project management.
• You bring in-depth knowledge of contract law and procurement law as well as sound knowledge in infrastructure building management and operator responsibility.
• You are safe in handling CAFM systems as well as SAP and has a strong growth mindset to help proactive changes in a dynamic environment.
• You speak English and generally have excellent communicative skills. As a team player, you are able to work effectively with different stakeholders and to understand complex relationships.
• Local missions, primarily between our locations in Mannheim and Penzberg, can be seen as enrichment. So good? It's better. We offer you a variety of top fittings at our locations. Only with you can we improve the life of patients. You make Roche unique with your contribution. This is why we offer exceptional benefits that support you, your life, your finances and your health

• Projektleitung: Du leitest eigenständig Projekte zur Prozessoptimierung und zur Implementierung neuer Servicekonzepte mit digitaler Weitsicht.
• Schnittstellenmanagement: Als zentraler Kollaborationstreiber moderierst Du zwischen den Bedürfnissen der internen Nutzer und den operativen Möglichkeiten der externen Partner. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Du hast ein Hochschulstudium (Master/Diplom) in Facility Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Versorgungstechnik erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit langjähriger Weiterbildung (z. B. Fachwirt:in/Meister:in).
• Du verfügst über mehr als 5 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im Facility Management, in der Steuerung externer Dienstleister (Provider Management) sowie im Projektmanagement.
• Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse im Vertrags- und Vergaberecht sowie fundiertes Wissen im infrastrukturellen Gebäudemanagement und der Betreiberverantwortung mit.
• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit CAFM-Systemen sowie SAP und besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Growth Mindset, um in einem dynamischen Umfeld proaktiv Veränderungen mitzugestalten.
• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Englisch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln.
• Gelegentliche Dienstreisen, vorrangig zwischen unseren Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg, siehst du als Bereicherung an. Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit s
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position que nous avons dans l'EFG Sur le site Management Mannheim/Penzberg, nous sommes bien 1'300 spécialistes pour une large gamme d'infrastructures et de services professionnels qui les fournissent pour les sites Mannheim et Penzberg. Dans un environnement dynamique, nous promouvons une coopération transparente entre les secteurs d'activité et les fonctions, proposons des solutions innovantes et améliorons l'environnement de travail des employés des lieux de Mannheim et de Penzberg, où nous façonnons activement l'avenir. La nouvelle structure organisationnelle Dans cette fonction, vous faites partie des Opérations du Site et vous appartenez à la Gestion des Vendeurs Team Service. Responsabilités Cela vous attend dans le rôle Vous êtes responsable du contrôle stratégique et du suivi des services intégrés de gestion des installations (services soft) par des fournisseurs externes.
• Contrôle du fournisseur : vous contrôlez et contrôlez les fournisseurs de services IFM externes pour une zone de localisation définie et assurez des performances efficaces.
• Gestion de la qualité : vous contrôlez la conformité aux accords de service (ALS) ainsi qu'aux indicateurs de performance clés (ICP) et vous lancez des mesures correctives proactives pour les écarts.
• Responsabilité financière: Vous êtes responsable du suivi et de la prévision des budgets des services de FM et identifiez les possibilités de réduction des coûts et d'amélioration de l'efficacité.
• Responsabilité de l'opérateur: comme garantie de conformité légale, vous veillez à ce que toutes les obligations légales et internes de l'opérateur soient respectées par les prestataires de services.
• Gestion de projet : Vous réalisez des projets indépendants pour l'optimisation des processus et la mise en œuvre de nouveaux concepts de service avec vision numérique.
• Gestion de l'interface: Modérer en tant que moteur central de collaboration Vous entre les besoins des utilisateurs internes et les possibilités opérationnelles des partenaires externes. Qualités
• Vous avez obtenu avec succès un diplôme universitaire (maîtrise/diplôme) en gestion d'installations, en génie industriel ou en technologie d'approvisionnement ou avez une qualification comparable avec une formation de longue durée (par exemple, un spécialiste:in/master:in).
• Vous avez plus de 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle bien fondée dans la gestion des installations, le contrôle des fournisseurs de services externes (gestion des fournisseurs) et la gestion de projets. Vous apportez une connaissance approfondie du droit des contrats et des marchés ainsi qu'une connaissance solide de la gestion des infrastructures et de la responsabilité de l'exploitant.
• Vous êtes en sécurité dans la gestion des systèmes CAFM ainsi que SAP et vous avez une forte croissance d'esprit pour aider à façonner des changements proactifs dans un environnement dynamique.
• Vous parlez anglais et avez généralement d'excellentes compétences en communication. En tant que joueur d'équipe, vous pouvez travailler efficacement avec différents intervenants et communiquer des relations complexes de manière compréhensible.
• Des voyages de service locaux, principalement entre nos sites de Mannheim et Penzberg, sont disponibles en tant qu'enrichissement. Si bien ? C'est mieux. Nous vous offrons une variété de meilleurs bœufs à nos emplacements. Seulement avec vous, nous pouvons améliorer la vie des patients. Vous faites Roche unique avec votre contribution. C'est pourquoi nous offrons des avantages exceptionnels qui vous soutiennent, votre vie, vos finances et votre santé

title: Data Transfer and Migration Lead - Mergers & Acquisitions

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del trasferimento e della migrazione dei dati - Fusioni e acquisizioni
titleByLocale.en: Data Transfer and Migration Lead - Mergers & Acquisitions
titleByLocale.de: Data Transfer and Migration Lead - Mergers & Acquisitions
titleByLocale.fr: Data Transfer and Migration Lead - Mergers & Acquisitions

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche we believe it’s critical to deliver medical solutions now — even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and creating a healthier future for all. The IT Data Transfer and Migration Lead plays a critical role in supporting Roche’s Mergers & Acquisitions initiatives by leading enterprise-scale data migration and transfer strategies across complex systems and environments. This role partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure scalable, compliant, and efficient data migration solutions that support business continuity and operational excellence. Your Opportunity As a Data Transfer & Migration Lead, you will lead the design and execution of migration strategies for acquired and partnering organizations, ensuring data transfer activities are delivered efficiently, securely, and in compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards. In this role, you will:
• Lead the design, execution, and lifecycle management of enterprise-scale data transfer and migration strategies for Mergers & Acquisitions initiatives
• Design and implement scalable data architectures, advanced ETL/ELT frameworks, and automation tools to improve migration efficiency and reliability
• Drive technical excellence by mentoring engineering teams, setting architectural standards, and guiding complex technical decision-making
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define migration rules aligned with Roche’s enterprise architecture and compliance requirements
• Ensure data infrastructure and migration platforms remain secure, resilient, scalable, and compliant with applicable standards including GxP where required
• Oversee system ownership and lifecycle management of data migration platforms, tools, and related operational processes
• Partner with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align migration strategies with organizational priorities and business objectives Who you are You are a strategic and technically strong data engineering leader who thrives in complex, enterprise environments. You bring strong stakeholder management capabilities, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to lead high-impact transformation initiatives across global teams. To be successful in this role, you have:
• 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data migration, or enterprise data architecture within complex global environments
• Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud data platforms, and advanced ETL/ELT patterns, with the ability to architect scalable data warehouses and data lakes
• Strong understanding of enterprise system interoperability, including platforms such as Veeva, SAP, ServiceNow, and related ecosystems
• Proven experience leading high-impact data migration or transformation projects with strong focus on governance, security, and operational resilience
• Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, mentor engineers, and influence architectural decisions across cross-functional stakeholders
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with senior leadership on data strategy and execution
• Experience with event-driven architectures, streaming technologies, or AI-enabled data capabilities is considered an advantage Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As our Communications & Corporate Affairs Partner , you will spearhead initiatives to engage stakeholders, influence policy, and articulate the organization's dedication to advancing health in line with Roche Philippines’ priorities. You will develop and implement strategic communication advocacy and campaigns that resonate with diverse audiences, driving our narrative with focused intent and clarity. This is a unique opportunity to lead critical initiatives, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and make a tangible difference in the healthcare landscape. What you will be working on: In this role, you will lead company advocacy and corporate reputation management by delivering purpose-driven communications. You will ensure a consistent narrative across internal and external stakeholders, markets, and cultures, collaborating cross-functionally to align communication strategies with healthcare and social sector priorities. Key responsibilities include but are not limited to.
• Strategic Communication & Brand Ambassadorship: Develops, enhances, and executes communication strategies for assigned therapeutic areas and corporate branding. Ensures Roche is flawlessly represented in all internal and external messaging, upholding a consistent commitment to excellence.
• Influence & Ecosystem Engagement: Manages interactions and builds strategic relationships with external media, patient groups, policymakers, and academics to advance advocacy goals and increase the company’s share of voice.
• Crisis Leadership & Reputation Management: Owns the communications strategy and execution during crisis situations, acting as the primary guardian of corporate reputation to mitigate risk and protect the brand.
• Championing Best Practices & Standards: Leads the development, implementation, and management of best-in-class communication policies, procedures, and templates to drive consistency, operational efficiency, and high-quality standards.
• Omnichannel Reach & Media Management: Manages and leverages Roche Philippines’ media channels to their fullest potential, expanding reach and impact through both traditional and digital platforms.
• Employee Engagement & Internal Culture: Leads internal communications and employee engagement initiatives, utilizing local and network resources to foster an inclusive, purpose-driven culture.
• Measuring Success & Continuous Improvement: Develops metrics and mechanisms to measure the results of communication plans and tactics, sharing best practices and identifying opportunities for ongoing optimization across the network.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Acts as a high-agility partner, collaborating with cross-functional teams (locally and globally) and external partners to ensure communication activities directly support the achievement of business objectives. Who you are: You are a Corporate Communications expert who demonstrates:
• Healthcare Passion: A strong understanding of health and pharmaceutical concepts, universal healthcare, access to medicines, and the building blocks of health, with proven experience in driving related advocacy initiatives
• Strategic Agility: Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment. You're a strategic thinker with a knack for systems-level organization
• Business Acumen: Strong understanding of market dynamics, organizational drivers, and financial indicators to make informed decisions that align with broader business goals. •

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management. The Diagnostics Insights Solutions Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising larger solutions with multiple components (digital products, physical products, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs. As a Technical Solution Management Associate you will act as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation of our solutions portfolio. You will work hand in hand with our team and different Solution Teams in the organization to support them with the automation of processes, contributing to the alignment with organizational objectives. Your main area of responsibility will be the application of Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence technologies to design and develop tailored tools to bring the end-to-end management of digital solutions to the next level. Main responsibilities As a Technical Solution Management Associate, your core responsibilities will include:
• Contribution to Ideation and Design: Actively participate in the ideation, analysis, and evaluation of solutions within the team's scope with the objective of optimizing processes and augmenting transparency and traceability with data.
• Process Optimization Tool Development: Identify opportunities for improvement and enhance solution management by leveraging data analytics and AI tools for diverse stakeholder groups (e.g., solution teams, affiliate members, or the broader organization). Additionally, identify inefficient processes and create tools to automate or streamline them.
• Team management (e.g. lean portfolio management, Aha! Automation, etc.)
• Technical solution management (e.g. requirements, version control,...)
• End-to-End solution management (e.g. coordination of solutions portfolio, traceability,...)
• Solution Lifecycle Management Support: Assisting with the administrative and documentation tasks related to the different stages of the lifecycle of complex software solutions.
• Reporting and Metrics Creation: Supporting the creation of data-driven tools to track the performance and adoption of key organizational solutions.
• Sustainable Development: Define the necessary maintenance and sustainability tasks to ensure the continued relevance and accuracy of the developed tools by e.g. enabling seamless retraining with new or updated training data. How would your day to day look like? As Technical Solution Management Associate in the Diagnostics Insights Solutions team, you'll work closely with our team members (Business Solution Managers and Technical Solution Managers) as well as cross-functional partners from across the organization. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including product managers, marketing leads, definition teams, engineering teams and subject matter experts. The successful candidate will play a dual role, handling management and administrative support tasks related to organizational solutions, while also developing and implementing tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our internal processes. title: Internship in Innovation & Sustainability - Mission Eco-Possible

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Our Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to gain hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry while making a positive impact on the world. Are you ready to join a global network spanning 20+ countries, where bright minds collaborate to tackle real-world challenges in Innovation & Sustainability? Do you want to work on impactful projects, shape the future, and drive change from within? As an intern, you will contribute to Mission Eco-Possible, an active initiative designed to align CAC DIA operations with Roche’s global sustainability strategy and support a 25% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions by 2030. The project focuses on turning the affiliate’s emissions baseline into a practical roadmap for action, with particular attention to Scope 1 and Scope 3 emissions in the Central America and Caribbean context. Within your first months, you are expected to help design and implement an internal environmental sustainability campaign, support the definition of a feasible action plan and investment needs for emissions reduction, and develop an emissions reporting tool aligned with Roche Group guidelines. Your work will help translate global sustainability commitments into local action, strengthen reporting transparency, and mobilize the organization around a shared environmental mission. This internship offers a valuable opportunity to combine sustainability strategy, analytics, and culture change in a high-impact regional setting. The Opportunity
• Design and implement an internal cultural campaign focused on environmental sustainability and the 2030 Eco-Mission
• Support the definition of a feasible action plan to reduce Scope 1 and Scope 3 emissions in the CAC regional context
• Assess investment needs and support feasibility analysis for proposed sustainability initiatives
• Develop an emissions reporting tool for the affiliate aligned with Roche Group guidelines
• Analyze current emissions drivers, including fleet operations, refrigerants, business travel, and e-waste
• Translate sustainability data into clear dashboards, reports, and visual materials for internal use
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to support implementation and engagement across the organization
• Help connect local actions to Roche’s broader net-zero and SBTi-aligned commitments Who You Are You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program at a university in your final years , preferably in the field of Environmental Engineering or related and are interested in applying your knowledge in a modern working environment as part of an internship of 6 months. Furthermore you are
• Proficient in advanced Excel, Power BI, or Tableau and able to create strong reporting and visualization tools
• Knowledgeable in ESG principles and greenhouse gas accounting frameworks such as the GHG Protocol
• Able to conduct technical and financial feasibility analyses for sustainability projects and investment decisions
• A strong communicator who can turn complex data into compelling stories and work effectively with different stakeholders
• Fluent in Spanish and English.
• Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable driving initiatives in a dynamic regional environment If you meet most but not all qualifications, we still encourage you to apply. Additional information
• The internship is expected to start between 1 and 16 July 2026 and will last 6 months.
• Work term: full

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position International Product Manager – Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. Who We Are: Advancing precision medicine through diagnostics for over 25 years. In collaboration with leading pharmaceutical companies, Roche Personalised Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) identify and develop innovative precision diagnostics to help radically improve the lives of patients. As the global diagnostic partner of choice, we deliver diagnostic confidence through a broad menu of high medical value assays across Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ hybridization (ISH), PCR and NGS. We are a global partner of choice in Oncology, including tissue diagnostics, as well as Neurology & Cardiology. Roche PHCS brings unmatched value as a collaborative partner to pharmaceutical organizations developing treatments across critical areas of highest unmet medical need. The Opportunity: As an International Product Manager (IPM) within the PHCS Lifecycle Team, you are the primary driver of our mission. You sit at the critical intersection of diagnostics and therapeutics, transforming complex technology into clinical reality. Your primary responsibility is to drive the global commercialization of our Companion Diagnostics (CDx) portfolio related to Tissue Diagnostics in direct partnership with pharmaceutical customers. Beyond the core product management of the Tissue Diagnostic portfolio, you will act as a strategic leader, driving initiatives that grow the PHCS organization and innovative pipeline, and support the broader Roche Diagnostics network. Key Roles & Responsibilities:
• External Pharmaceutical Partnering: Act as the dedicated commercial lead for pharmaceutical partners. Co-create and align CDx launch plans with drug therapy timelines to ensure seamless "day-one" testing readiness.
• Country & Regional Collaboration: Partner with Roche Diagnostics regional and country stakeholders to drive successful CDx pull-through. You will help markets overcome barriers to adoption, deliver pharmaceutical partner objectives and ultimately drive precision medicine innovation.
• Commercial Strategy Leader: Drive the commercial strategy for IHC-based companion diagnostics, ensuring our value proposition resonates with pathologists, laboratory managers, and pharma stakeholders.
• End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management: Provide technical and strategic guidance throughout early assay development and lead commercial product delivery from concept to commercialization. Responsible for on-market product strategy, supply topics, quality issues, incorporating global regulatory updates, label expansion and end-of-life product management.
• PHCS Strategy Leadership: Lead design and execution of our overarching strategy in collaboration with PHCS leadership and senior stakeholders. Analyze global market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes to define long-term strategies.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Drive high-impact growth projects that define how Roche Diagnostics delivers value beyond the individual test, collaborating closely with lifecycle teams and stakeholders across the organization. Who You Are: Candidates should exhibit a strong track record in product commercialization, strategic design and execution alongside exceptional co

Ejecutar actividades de soporte de segundo nivel local. Ser referente técnico a nivel local. Identificar y dar solución a problemas complejos asociados a las plataformas informáticas. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Liderar la ejecución de proyectos de IT relacionados con instalación, integración y mejoras de sistemas (hardware y software), asegurando cumplimiento en alcance, tiempos, calidad y coordinación con áreas internas y clientes.
• Brindar soporte técnico de segundo nivel en soluciones informáticas, resolviendo incidencias complejas, configuraciones avanzadas, integraciones con sistemas host y conexión de instrumentos, priorizando la resolución remota.
• Gestionar y ejecutar entrenamientos técnicos, manteniendo actualización continua en sistemas e infraestructura IT, y asegurando el cumplimiento de programas de formación corporativos.
• Asegurar una comunicación efectiva con stakeholders y participar en el diseño de soluciones IT, contribuyendo con información técnica para propuestas, licitaciones y evaluación de riesgos.
• Garantizar la operación y soporte continuo de sistemas IT mediante monitoreo, mantenimiento preventivo, gestión de casos y documentación, asegurando cumplimiento de SLAs, políticas de compliance y normativas corporativas. Tu Perfil:
• Título universitario o técnico en Informática, Sistemas, Tecnólogo Médico o carreras afines.
• Experiencia de al menos 2 años en el área de informática, idealmente con conocimiento en sistemas de salud.
• Nivel de inglés intermedio-avanzado.
• Conocimiento en manejo de sustancias peligrosas. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei parte di un team di alto livello e ad alto impatto che co-crea e implementa la strategia Roche Diagnostics per realizzare la nostra visione “innovare la diagnostica, plasmare la salute, cambiare la vita”. Si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella massimizzazione del valore complessivo di consegna della strategia Diagnostica per i nostri clienti e pazienti e nello sblocco della potenza dell'organizzazione per i nostri clienti e pazienti. Nell'ambito del team Diagnostics Strategy, guiderai iniziative strategiche chiave, come le integrazioni M&A o i cambiamenti del Modello Operativo che consentono la realizzazione della Strategia Divisionale. Hai l'opportunità di plasmare e guidare attività di strategia, metodologie e best practice al fine di raggiungere una comprensione e competenze strategiche critiche in tutta l'organizzazione. Quando un M&A è deciso, guiderà o parte del team di integrazione M&A che sta definendo l'approccio di integrazione e svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel rendere l'integrazione un successo raggiungendo gli obiettivi definiti dello stato finale. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con una varietà di stakeholder senior provenienti da diverse parti dell'organizzazione Diagnostics e riferire in un Team Lead Strategy. Le aree di responsabilità previste includono la guida e l'attuazione di iniziative strategiche tra le funzioni, ma non sono necessariamente limitate a quelle descritte di seguito: L'opportunità
• Ampia comprensione del business Diagnostics come prerequisito per progettare la vestibilità per il modello operativo, la progettazione organizzativa e gli approcci di integrazione
• Conoscenza di più aree e aspetti di integrazione M&A (come: fasi di integrazione M&A, Org.Design, Integrazione di sistema o considerazioni legali e fiscali)
• Utilizzare la conoscenza delle conoscenze di business e integrazione, metriche, competenze e principi decisionali per diagnosticare efficacemente gli argomenti di integrazione con una vasta gamma di complessità.
• Proattivamente costruisce la conoscenza dell'ambiente esterno per diagnosticare e implementare efficacemente le strategie per aiutare a guidare le decisioni di integrazione.
• Conduce e/o supervisiona e coordina il lavoro di progettazione o integrazione del Modello Operativo dalla pianificazione all'implementazione, tra cui l'individuazione di opportunità e rischi, sviluppando e supervisionando piani d'azione per affrontarli. Sviluppa e conduce/coordina il programma/progetto
• comprovata capacità di influenzare i leader aziendali e i decisori per raggiungere i risultati necessari.
• Sviluppare e perfezionare ulteriormente gli aspetti del nostro overarching design organizzativo e modello operativo (ad esempio, strutture, ruoli, interfacce, ecc.), eseguire controlli sanitari dell'organizzazione
• Guidare la comprensione delle scelte di progettazione organizzativa In un ambiente altamente interfunzionale, fornirete anche la leadership di progetto e matrice coerente con i valori Roche, le capacità di leadership e la mentalità. L'incumbent cercherà di ispirare e accendere la passione in altri per creare un cambiamento sostenibile e sfruttare gli sforzi di una vasta gamma di persone e team. Chi sei

• Esperienza in una società di consulenza o sviluppo strategico e attuazione in un ruolo di strategia aziendale o globale &
• Esperienza comprovata con integrazioni post-merger all'interno o supporto in/con società di diagnostica

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position You are part of a high-performing and high-impact team that co-creates and implements the Roche Diagnostics strategy in order to realize our vision “innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, changing lives”. You play a pivotal role in maximizing the overall value delivery of the Diagnostics strategy for our customers and patients and in unlocking the power of the organization for our customers and patients. As part of the Diagnostics Strategy team, you will lead key strategic initiatives, like M&A Integrations or Operating Model changes that enable the realization of the Divisional Strategy. You have the opportunity to shape and drive strategy activities, methodologies, and best practices with a view to reaching a critical strategy understanding and expertise throughout the organization. When an M&A is decided you will lead or be part of the M&A integration team that is defining the integration approach and will play a key role in making the integration a success by reaching the defined end state objectives. You will collaborate closely with a variety of senior stakeholders from different parts of the Diagnostics organization and report into a Strategy Team Lead. Expected areas of accountability would include driving and implementing strategic initiatives across functions, but are not necessarily limited to those outlined below: The Opportunity
• Broad understanding of the Diagnostics business as a prerequisite to design the fit for purpose operating model, Organisational Design and integration approaches
• Knowledge of multiple M&A Integration areas and aspects (like: M&A Integration phases, Org.Design, System Integration or legal and tax considerations)
• Use of knowledge of business and integration insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively diagnose integration topics with a wide range of complexity.
• Proactively builds knowledge of the external environment to effectively diagnose and implement strategies to help drive integration decisions.
• Leads and/or oversees and coordinates the Operating Model design or integration work from planning to implementation including identifying opportunities and risks while developing/overseeing action plans to address them. Develops and leads/coordinates program / project planning
• Proven ability to influence business leaders and decision makers to achieve required outcomes.
• Further develop and refine aspects of our overarching organisational design and operating model (e.g., structures, roles, interfaces, etc.), run health checks of the organization
• Drive the understanding of the organisational design choices In a highly cross-functional environment,you will also provide project and matrix leadership consistent with the Roche values, leadership capabilities and mindset. The incumbent will seek to inspire and ignite passion in others to create sustainable change and to leverage the efforts of a diverse range of people and teams. Who you are
• University degree level qualification in a relevant discipline, typically with 5-7+ years of experience, preferably in large matrix Diagnostics or Medical Device CompaniesIndustry
• Experience in a consultancy company or strategy development and implementation in a corporate or global strategy role &
• Proven experience with post-merger integrations inside or supporting in/with diagnostics companies
• Structured thinking, proven problem-solving skills & t rack record of successful project & program management-
• Highly developed

• Ein umfassendes Verständnis des Diagnostics-Geschäfts als Voraussetzung für die Gestaltung der Passform für zielorientiertes Betriebsmodell, Organisationsdesign und Integrationsansätze

Wer bist du?
• Hochschulabschluss-Qualifikation in einer relevanten Disziplin, typischerweise mit 5-7+ Jahren Erfahrung, vorzugsweise in der großen Matrix Diagnostics oder MedizinprodukteunternehmenIndustrie
• Erfahrung in einem Beratungsunternehmen oder Strategieentwicklung und Umsetzung in einer Corporate oder Global Strategie Rolle &
• Erprobte Erfahrung mit Post-Merger-Integrationen innerhalb oder Unterstützung in/mit Diagnostik-Unternehmen
• Strukturiertes Denken, bewährte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten & t Rack Rekord von erfolgreichem Projekt- & Programmmanagement-
• Hochentwickelt
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Vous faites partie d'une équipe à haut rendement et à fort impact qui co-crée et met en œuvre la stratégie de diagnostic Roche afin de réaliser notre vision, d'innover le diagnostic, de façonner les soins de santé, de changer les vies. Vous jouez un rôle central en maximisant la valeur globale de la stratégie Diagnostics pour nos clients et patients et en débloquant la puissance de l'organisation pour nos clients et patients. Dans le cadre de l'équipe de la Stratégie diagnostique, vous dirigerez des initiatives stratégiques clés, comme les intégrations de M et A ou les changements du modèle opérationnel qui permettent la réalisation de la Stratégie divisionnaire. Vous avez l'occasion de concevoir et de diriger des activités stratégiques, des méthodologies et des pratiques exemplaires en vue d'atteindre une compréhension et une expertise stratégiques essentielles dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Lorsqu'une M&A est décidée, vous dirigerez ou participerez à l'équipe d'intégration des M&A qui définit l'approche d'intégration et jouera un rôle clé pour faire de l'intégration un succès en atteignant les objectifs définis de l'état final. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec divers intervenants chevronnés de différentes parties de l'organisation Diagnostics et vous ferez rapport en chef d'équipe stratégique. Les domaines de responsabilisation prévus comprendraient la conduite et la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives stratégiques dans toutes les fonctions, mais ne se limitent pas nécessairement à ceux décrits ci-dessous : L'opportunité
• Une compréhension large de l'activité Diagnostic comme préalable à la conception de l'ajustement à des fins de modèle opérationnel, conception organisationnelle et approches d'intégration
• Connaissance de multiples domaines et aspects d'intégration des fusions et acquisitions (comme les phases d'intégration des fusions et acquisitions, la conception, l'intégration des systèmes ou des considérations juridiques et fiscales)
• Utilisation des connaissances sur les perspectives d'affaires et d'intégration, les paramètres, l'expertise et les principes de décision pour diagnostiquer efficacement les sujets d'intégration avec un large éventail de complexité.
• Développer activement les connaissances sur l'environnement extérieur afin de diagnostiquer et de mettre en œuvre efficacement des stratégies permettant d'orienter les décisions d'intégration.
• Dirige et/ou supervise et coordonne les travaux de conception ou d'intégration du modèle d'exploitation, de la planification à la mise en oeuvre, y compris la détermination des possibilités et des risques tout en élaborant ou supervisant des plans d'action pour y remédier. Élaborer et diriger/coordonner la planification des programmes et des projets
• Capacité éprouvée d'influencer les chefs d'entreprise et les décideurs pour obtenir les résultats requis.
• Développer et affiner les aspects de notre conception organisationnelle globale et de notre modèle opérationnel (par exemple, structures, rôles, interfaces, etc.), effectuer des contrôles de santé de l'organisation
• Favoriser la compréhension des choix de conception organisationnelle Dans un environnement hautement interfonctionnel, vous assurerez également un leadership de projet et de matrice conforme aux valeurs de Roche, aux capacités de leadership et à l'état d'esprit. Le titulaire cherchera à inspirer et à susciter la passion chez d'autres pour créer un changement durable et pour tirer parti des efforts d'un éventail varié de personnes et d'équipes. Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme universitaire dans une discipline pertinente, généralement avec 5-7 ans d'expérience, de préférence dans une grande matrice Diagnostics ou entreprises d'instruments médicaux
• Expérience d'une société de conseil ou d'une stratégie de développement et de mise en œuvre dans un rôle de stratégie d'entreprise ou globale &
• Expérience éprouvée des intégrations post-fusion à l'intérieur ou en support dans/avec des entreprises de diagnostic
• La pensée structurée, les compétences éprouvées de résolution de problèmes et l'enregistrement de la réussite de projet et de gestion de programme-
• Hautement développés

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Introduction The Digital Integration Engineer takes ownership of ambiguous tasks and skillfully navigates group dynamics, fostering strong collaboration and acting as a technical mentor. In this role, you will lead small to medium (S/M) initiatives, effectively prioritize with stakeholders, and maintain a "bigger picture" view of how various components align with the overall strategic goals. You will leverage extensive experience to design, develop, and implement complex, end-to-end integrations primarily leveraging ServiceNow platform capabilities (e.g., IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, REST/SOAP APIs) with various external enterprise systems. The Opportunity:
• Drive ownership of ambiguous tasks and "grey zone" topics, successfully leading small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the project, squad, or product level.
• Engineer end-to-end integrations by leveraging ServiceNow capabilities including IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP APIs with external systems.
• Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing by navigating group dynamics in diversified settings and acting as a technical mentor for the team.
• Lead feasibility studies and technical evaluations to ensure all integration solutions are scalable, reliable, and performant.
• Manage stakeholders effectively by prioritizing demands and maintaining a "bigger picture" view of how components fit the overall product strategy.
• Influence platform governance through enterprise-level technical decision-making and the formulation of global integration strategies.
• Champion technical excellence by sharing knowledge at internal events such as DevOps Days, Tech Talks, and Tech Live sessions.
• Ensure documentation integrity by developing comprehensive data maps, API specifications, and ServiceNow Update Set best practices. Who you are:
• Proven Integrator: You have extensive experience in designing, developing, and implementing ServiceNow integrations and complex platform solutions.
• Educated & Experienced: You are educated to a degree level in a relevant field and bring a strong track record of driving technical initiatives.
• ServiceNow Specialist: You possess deep expertise in ServiceNow technical architecture and multiple modules, including ITSM, HRSD, and CSM.
• Technical Leader: You are a recognized mentor capable of aligning development plans with global strategies and fostering a collaborative team environment.
• Strategic Thinker: You possess the ability to challenge the status quo and navigate complex group dynamics to achieve engineering quality.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position ***12 Month Opportunity*** Roche is a global healthcare leader at the forefront of innovation, dedicated to improving the lives of patients through the development of groundbreaking medicines and diagnostic tools. With a heritage spanning over 125 years, we are committed to sustainable healthcare and delivering medical solutions that address some of the world’s most complex health challenges. Our Global Clinical Supply Chain Organization is the backbone of our clinical research, ensuring that no patient goes without treatment and no clinical trial is delayed. By joining our newly expanded team in Mississauga, Canada, you will be part of a strategically significant hub that fosters agility, cross-functional collaboration, and the delivery of life-saving biopharmaceuticals to more than 100 molecules across 600+ clinical trials globally. The Opportunity
• You will take ownership of the clinical study supply chain for Investigational Medicinal Products (IMP), ensuring effective and cost-conscious delivery across diverse disease areas.
• You will execute end-to-end demand and supply planning within ERP systems, such as SAP, to maintain robust aggregate and long-range program oversight.
• You will lead the alignment of key activities and timelines across cross-functional teams to ensure every clinical trial is supplied in strict accordance with agreed scopes.
• You will strategically forecast, plan, and initiate the procurement of comparator drugs and other study materials required for complex clinical protocols.
• You will integrate all relevant regulatory and quality requirements into the supply plan to ensure compliance with international standards and GMP environments.
• You will drive business excellence by owning and optimizing Clinical Supply Chain processes, influencing change, and ensuring global system integration.
• You will collaborate with Technical Development Teams and Clinical Operations to bridge the gap between drug development and patient-centric delivery. Who you are
• You possess a minimum of five years of experience in Clinical Supply Chain, Planning, or Manufacturing, ideally within the Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical industry.
• You hold an academic degree in Life Sciences, Business, or Engineering, complemented by a solid understanding of clinical trial design and drug technical development.
• You are skilled at navigating ERP systems and IRT functionalities to manage complex inventory and supply chain optimization simulations.
• You demonstrate a high level of proficiency in GMP environments, with a keen eye for quality assurance, regulatory affairs, and budget planning.
• You are a confident stakeholder manager who excels at building customer focus and earning respect through impactful, needs-driven actions.
• You possess an agile mindset, showing a willingness to experiment with new ideas and lead process improvement activities in a self-directed team environment.
• You are an action-oriented professional with the ability to influence others, make decisive choices, and travel internationally to support global operations. *** Relocation not available for this position*** The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 115,328.00 and 151,368.00 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role. This

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Professional Technical Services team (Field Service Engineering) in Hungary is a dedicated group of experts committed to delivering high-quality engineering and technical solutions in the field of in vitro diagnostics (IVD) . As part of Roche Diagnostics, the team focuses on creating long-lasting partnerships with healthcare providers by ensuring our diagnostic systems are installed and maintained to the highest standards, ultimately supporting reliable patient results across the country. The Opportunity As a Technical Services Project Manager and Team Lead, you will play a dual role that balances high-level project execution with people leadership. You will be responsible for ensuring compliant, professional services for our customers while developing a high-performing team of Field Service Engineers. In this role, you will split your focus between driving complex technical implementations (60-70%) and mentoring your team (30-40%). You will be the bridge between technical excellence and strategic growth, ensuring our laboratory solutions are delivered seamlessly while fostering a culture of continuous improvement. As a Technical Project Manager (60-70%):
• You will manage the full project lifecycle for laboratory implementations, from initial tender to handover.
• You will conduct on-site technical assessments, develop and execute detailed project plans to meet stakeholder expectations, identify and mitigate risks.
• You will oversee the installation of systems, testing, and reagent applications, ensuring all deliverables are met on time and within scope. As a Team Lead (30-40%):
• You will lead, coach, and develop a customer-focused, future-ready and high-performing Field Service Engineering team, attract and retain top talent, and foster a continuous learning culture.
• You will manage resource planning and workload, oversee the business portfolio (SWA, NPC, M&TD), monitor team KPIs and service data to ensure high-quality technical support for Hungarian customers. Who you are
• Experienced Leader: You have a proven track record in leading and developing teams, with the ability to motivate others and facilitate professional growth.
• Technical Expert: You hold a BSc/MSc in Engineering (e.g. Electrical, Mechatronical, Mechanical, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, etc) and have 3-5 years of experience in laboratory technology or medical devices.
• Project Specialist: You are proficient in project management methodologies and tools, with a focus on delivering outcomes in complex, changing environments.
• Strategic Thinker: You possess a growth mindset and the ability to think at an enterprise level, identifying business development opportunities within the healthcare system.
• Strong Communicator: You are fluent in Hungarian and proficient in English, with the interpersonal intelligence needed to build sustainable relationships with diverse stakeholders.
• Mobile and Flexible: You are willing to work in a field-based environment across Hungary to support our customers where they need us most. Location: This position is based in Budapest. Relocation Assistance is not available. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. Questo è ciò che ci guida. In People & Culture la nostra visione è quella di portare a vita il nostro scopo Roche sbloccando la grandezza in tutta la nostra gente e organizzazione. Costruiamo la fiducia proteggendo e creando valore attraverso la nostra partnership con i clienti per fornire non solo servizi, ma esperienze di impatto. Siamo un catalizzatore per consentire prestazioni elevate, alimentando un senso di appartenenza e una cultura inclusiva dove possiamo prosperare quando scopriamo le migliori idee e sviluppiamo soluzioni veramente innovative per i pazienti e il futuro successo di Roche. In qualità di Lead & Organisation Development Community Lead, formerai la visione strategica di come trasformiamo la nostra organizzazione per realizzare le Ambizioni di 10 anni di Roche. Leader della Global Consulting Practice, tu e il tuo partner di squadra con i team di leadership senior per migliorare le prestazioni e la salute organizzative, utilizzando competenze profonde nella trasformazione, progettazione organizzativa, efficacia del team di leadership e formazione della cultura. Come membro del team di abilitazione del capitolo P&OG, creerai e garantirai una visione del capitolo, una strategia e priorità che forniscono valore e impatto aziendale. La tua opportunità In questo ruolo, guiderai la direzione strategica per la nostra pratica di consulenza:
• Guidare il Global Consulting Practice of Organizational Development (OD) professionisti per supportare i leader con il design organizzativo, l'efficacia del team, la formazione culturale e la trasformazione.
• Collaborare con i leader aziendali per co-creare strategie che supportano la trasformazione delle imprese su larga scala.
• Costruire le capacità di consulenza in tutta l'organizzazione, assicurando ai nostri partner gli strumenti e le competenze per guidare il cambiamento.
• Promuovere una forte rete di esperti, garantendo un costante trasferimento di conoscenze e lo scambio di migliori pratiche a livello globale.
• Guidare l'armonizzazione dei processi e definire standard di alta qualità e KPI per la pratica.
• Catalizzare l'azione formando squadre agili per fornire iniziative ad alta priorità.
• Allenare e sviluppare i membri del capitolo, garantendo una pipeline diversificata e pronta di talento. Chi sei Sei un pensatore strategico che prospera in ambienti complessi e multiculturali ed è appassionato di leadership inclusiva. Porti una mentalità di crescita e le seguenti qualifiche:
• 10+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo organizzativo, nello sviluppo di Leadership o in un campo relativo.
• 5+ anni di ruoli di leadership, in particolare leader di team globali o comunità di esperti.
• Competenza nella progettazione organizzativa e nella realizzazione di trasformazioni di grandi dimensioni.
• Prova capacità di consultare le prestazioni organizzative, lo sviluppo della leadership, la dinamica del team e l'apprendimento degli adulti.
• Mindset agile con la capacità di navigare in ambiguità e influenzare gli stakeholder in un ambiente a matrice. Questa posizione è aperta a seguito di una promozione esterna, riflettendo il nostro impegno a sviluppare leader che sono riconosciuti sia all'interno che al di là della nostra organizzazione. Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità! Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all’avanzamento della scienc

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. That’s what drives us. In People & Culture our vision is to bring our Roche purpose to life by unlocking the greatness in all our people and organisation. We build trust by protecting and creating value through our partnership with customers to deliver not just services, but impactful experiences. • Lead the Global Consulting Practice of Organizational Development (OD) professionals to support leaders with organizational design, team effectiveness, cultural shaping and transformation.
• Collaborate with business leaders to co-create strategies that support large-scale enterprise transformation.
• Build consulting capabilities across the organization, ensuring our partners have the tools and skills to drive change.
• Foster a strong network of experts , ensuring constant knowledge transfer and the exchange of best practices globally.
• Drive harmonization of processes and define high-quality standards and KPIs for the practice.

• 10+ years of experience in Organizational Development, Leadership Development, or a related field.
• 5+ years in leadership roles , specifically leading global teams or communities of experts.
• Expertise in organizational design and driving large-scale change transformations.
• Proven ability to consult on organizational performance, leadership development, team dynamics and adult learning.
• Agile mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence stakeholders across a matrixed environment. This position is open as a result of an external promotion, reflecting our commitment to developing leaders who are recognized both within and beyond our organization. Ready to take the next step? Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an. In People & Culture ist es unsere Vision, unseren Roche-Ansatz zum Leben zu bringen, indem wir die Größe in all unseren Menschen und Organisationen entschlüsseln. Wir bauen Vertrauen durch den Schutz und die Schaffung von Wert durch unsere Partnerschaft mit Kunden, um nicht nur Dienstleistungen, sondern effektvolle Erfahrungen zu liefern. Wir sind ein Katalysator, um eine hohe Leistung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit und einer integrativen Kultur zu pflegen, in der wir alle begeistert sein können, da wir die besten Ideen entdecken und wirklich innovative Lösungen für Patienten und Roches zukünftiger Erfolg entwickeln. Als Beratungspraxis Lead & Organisation Development Community Lead prägen Sie die strategische Vision, wie wir unsere Organisation umsetzen, um die 10-Jahre-Ambitionen von Roche zu realisieren. Führen Sie die Global Consulting Practice, Sie und Ihr Teampartner mit Senior Leadership-Teams, um die organisatorische Leistung und Gesundheit zu verbessern, indem Sie tiefe Expertise in Transformation, Organisationsdesign, Führungsteam Effektivität und Kulturgestaltung nutzen. Als Mitglied des P&OG Chapter Enabling Teams erstellen und gewährleisten Sie ein Kapitel Vision, Strategie und Prioritäten, die Wert- und Geschäftsauswirkungen bieten. Ihre Chance In dieser Rolle leiten Sie die strategische Richtung für unsere Beratungspraxis:
• Führen Sie die Global Consulting Practice of Organizational Development (OD) Fachleute, um Führungskräfte mit Organisationsdesign, Teameffektivität, kultureller Gestaltung und Transformation zu unterstützen.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Wirtschaftsführern, um Strategien zu entwickeln, die eine umfassende Unternehmenstransformation unterstützen.
• Aufbauen Sie Beratungskompetenzen in der gesamten Organisation und stellen Sie sicher, dass unsere Partner die Werkzeuge und Fähigkeiten haben, um Veränderungen voranzutreiben.
• Ein starkes Expertennetzwerk, das einen ständigen Wissenstransfer und den Austausch bewährter Praktiken weltweit gewährleistet.
• Die Harmonisierung der Prozesse vorantreiben und qualitativ hochwertige Standards und Kennzahlen für die Praxis definieren.
• Catalyze-Action, indem agile Teams gebildet werden, um hochprioritäre Initiativen zu liefern.
• Coach und entwickeln Kapitel-Mitglieder, um eine vielfältige und fertige Pipeline von Talent. Wer bist du? Sie sind ein strategischer Denker, der in komplexen, multikulturellen Umgebungen lebt und leidenschaftlich an der inklusiven Führung ist. Sie bringen einen Wachstumsgeist und die folgenden Qualifikationen:
• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in Organisationsentwicklung, Leadership Development oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 5+ Jahre Führungsrolle, insbesondere führende globale Teams oder Expertengemeinschaften.
• Know-how im organisatorischen Design und dem Fahren von großen Veränderungen.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, über organisatorische Leistung, Führungsentwicklung, Teamdynamik und Erwachsenenbildung zu beraten.
• Agile Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, Mehrdeutigkeit zu navigieren und Stakeholder in einer Matrix-Umgebung zu beeinflussen. Diese Position ist durch eine externe Förderung offen und spiegelt unser Engagement für die Entwicklung von Führungskräften wider, die innerhalb und außerhalb unserer Organisation anerkannt werden. Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir würden gerne von Ihnen hören. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt, um diese spannende Gelegenheit zu erkunden! Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Basel. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ça qui nous pousse. Dans People & Culture, notre vision est de donner vie à notre but Roche en débloquant la grandeur de notre peuple et de notre organisation. Nous renforçons la confiance en protégeant et en créant de la valeur grâce à notre partenariat avec nos clients pour offrir non seulement des services, mais aussi des expériences pertinentes. Nous sommes un catalyseur pour permettre des performances élevées tout en nourrissant un sentiment d'appartenance et une culture inclusive où nous pouvons tous prospérer alors que nous découvrons les meilleures idées et développons des solutions vraiment innovantes pour les patients et le succès futur de Roche. En tant que chef de file communautaire de la pratique de conseil et du développement de l'organisation, vous façonnerez la vision stratégique de la façon dont nous transformons notre organisation pour réaliser les ambitions de 10 ans de Roche. Diriger la Global Consulting Practice, vous et votre équipe vous associez à des équipes de direction pour améliorer la performance organisationnelle et la santé, en utilisant une expertise approfondie dans la transformation, la conception organisationnelle, l'efficacité de l'équipe de leadership et l'élaboration de la culture. En tant que membre de l'équipe habilitante du chapitre P&OG, vous créerez et assurerez une vision, une stratégie et des priorités chapitre qui offre de la valeur et un impact opérationnel. Votre opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'orientation stratégique de notre pratique de consultation :
• Diriger la Global Consulting Practice of Organizational Development (OD) pour aider les dirigeants à concevoir l'organisation, à améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe, à façonner et à transformer leur culture.
• Collaborer avec les chefs d'entreprise pour co-créer des stratégies qui soutiennent la transformation des grandes entreprises.
• Développer les capacités de consultation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, en veillant à ce que nos partenaires disposent des outils et des compétences nécessaires pour favoriser le changement.
• Favoriser un solide réseau d'experts, assurant un transfert constant des connaissances et l'échange des meilleures pratiques à l'échelle mondiale.
• Favoriser l'harmonisation des processus et définir des normes de qualité et des ICR pour la pratique.
• Catalyser l'action en formant des équipes agiles pour réaliser des initiatives hautement prioritaires.
• Coach et développer les membres du chapitre, en assurant une gamme variée et prête de talents. • Umsetzung von Herstellvorgaben in Checkpläne, Batch- und MES-Rezepte
• End-to-End Direct Support und Configuration Management für Automationssysteme der Produktion
• Herstellprozessbezogene Datenbereitstellung & Analyse
• Anwendertraining
• Anforderungsmanagement für alle Produktions-Automationssysteme und Datenreports
• PLS (PCS7) Umsetzung und Support
• Application Administration für prozessnahe Automation

In diesem agilen Umfeld ist es für uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit, kunden- und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten und dabei viele Schnittstellen zu bedienen. Deine Aufgaben
• Rezepterstellung für pharmazeutische Entwicklungs- und Marktprodukte: Planung und Umsetzung von beschriebenen Herstellprozessen in automatisierte Produktionsabläufe auf MES- und Batchebene
• Konfiguration von Prozess- und Stammdaten
• 1st Level Support und Fehleranalyse (24/7) für automatisierte Produktionssysteme
• Analyse und Bereitstellung von Prozessdaten
• Standardisierung von Prozessen, Rezepten, PLS-Phasen und Konfigurationen
• Anforderungensmanagement für Produktionssysteme
• GMP-gerechte Dokumentation sämtlicher Arbeitsaktivitäten Dein Profil passt gut zu uns, wenn
• Du Dein naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Bachelor oder Master) erfolgreich abgeschlossen hast oder alternativ tiefgreifende Erfahrung aus der pharmazeutischen Produktion vorweisen kannst,
• Du über fundierte verfahrenstechnische oder biotechnologische Kenntnisse verfügst und es Dir Spaß macht, diese in die Sprache der Prozessautomation zu übersetzen,
• Du GMP-Dokumentation als wichtig empfindest und bereit bist, Deine Expertise jederzeit in der sicheren Bedienung des Sematic Batch Client sowie in Routine-GMP-Prozessen (z.B. Abweichungen und Changes) sowie in Audits und Inspektionen einzubringen,
• Du praktische Erfahrung im GMP-Bereich von Labor oder Produktion mitbringst,
• Du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement gesammelt hast,
• You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken and you are able to influence at all levels,
• Du idealerweise eine Affinität zu Lean Methoden besitzt,
• Du gerne Dein Wissen erweiterst (z.B. durch externe Seminar- und Kongressbesuche) und dieses mit Deinen Kollegen und den Anwendern in den Produktionsbetrieben teilst,
• Du ein wahrer Teamplayer bist, über Durchsetzungsvermöge
