descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Are you a Finance or Business student looking to gain hands-on experience in a global corporate environment? We are looking for a motivated Intern to join our Global Procurement Finance team. This is a unique opportunity to see the "inner workings" of a global finance function. You will gain exposure to complex stakeholder management and international reporting standards-all while being part of a supportive, expert team. The opportunity In this role, you won’t just be crunching numbers; you’ll be a key part of a team operating across a global scale. You will work directly under the Finance Functional Partner to support global operations and strategic procurement. As our Intern you will:
• Drive Financial Insights: Assist in preparing monthly financial reports
• Master the Tools: Take ownership of our procurement savings tracking tool (SpendHQ) - validating business cases and savings entered by the procurement organization.
• Business Partnering: Collaborate directly with one function/team to provide financial support.
• Support & Innovate: Help Procurement Finance Business Partners with insight generation, SMC planning, and organizational training. Who you are You are enrolled in or have completed your studies within the last 12 months with a degree (Bachelor’s, Master’s) in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
• Skills: A solid foundation in financial controlling and reporting.
• Communication: Fluent in English; you’re comfortable working in a diverse, international environment.
• Mindset: Proactive, detail-oriented, and ready to take ownership of projects.
• You come with the ability/interest to automate reports and improve processes Additional information Start Date: August 2026 Workload: 100% Duration: 12 months Application process Please submit your complete application, including your CV and a motivation letter. A certificate of enrollment (if you are currently studying) OR recent graduates are also eligible to start an internship with us within 12 months of their graduation date. For non-EU/EFTA citizens: Certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory (required due to regulations) Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Cria r um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que a mamos. É isso que nos faz Roch e. Como um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Serviços , você será responsável por realizar visitas de Site Preparation para orientar os clientes na adequação do local onde serão instalados os equipamentos Roche. Você conduzirá manutenções preventivas e corretivas, garantindo o cumprimento do planejamento anual e assegurando o menor impacto possível na rotina laboratorial do cliente. Sua atuação será fundamental para manter a excelência técnica e a disponibilidade das soluções Roche no campo. Sobre a Oportunidade:
• Realizar visitas de Site Preparation para orientar clientes na adequação técnica de infraestrutura para instalação de equipamentos.
• Conduzir manutenções preventivas técnicas, desde o agendamento e conferência de kits até o registro detalhado em sistema CRM.
• Executar manutenções corretivas de forma eficaz e eficiente para minimizar o downtime e manter a rotina operacional do cliente.
• Efetuar upgrades de hardware e software nos equipamentos instalados conforme orientações dos Especialistas Técnicos.
• Identificar situações críticas em clientes e reportá-las ao Coordenador Regional de Serviços, propondo respostas rápidas e resolutivas.
• Apoiar as equipes de Assessoria Científica na resolução de problemas de operação e aplicações, sempre que necessário.
• Colaborar com o Repair Shop nas revisões de equipamentos seguindo rigorosamente os procedimentos técnicos existentes.
• Garantir o fluxo de informações estratégicas do campo para a equipe de Vendas e dar suporte ao desenvolvimento técnico do time. Quem você é:
• Graduação completa.
• Experiência comprovada em assistência técnica, manutenções e serviços relacionados a equipamentos de análises clínicas ou informática.
• Conhecimento intermediário de Inglês (leitura técnica e comunicação básica).
• Habilidade em organização e autogestão para cumprimento de cronogramas de manutenção e chamados técnicos.
• Facilidade em estabelecer bom relacionamento interpessoal e atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.
• Perfil proativo com foco na resolução de problemas e excelência no atendimento ao cliente.
• Capacidade de comunicação clara para orientar clientes e reportar situações críticas internamente.
• Habilidades de liderança e suporte técnico para auxiliar no desenvolvimento de colegas e parceiros.
• Disponibilidade para viagens em território nacional. Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità: Sei un professionista esperto di vendite con un talento per risolvere sfide complesse? In questo ruolo, userai la tua esperienza per navigare diversi problemi e prendere decisioni strategiche che spingono il successo. Potrai gestire conti di medie e grandi dimensioni, superando gli obiettivi di vendita durante la costruzione di relazioni durature con i decisori chiave. Il vostro obiettivo sarà quello di espandere la vostra rete, identificare nuove opportunità e presentare proposte di valore convincenti. Con una profonda comprensione della nostra linea di prodotti, servirai come consulente affidabile, migliorando continuamente il nostro sistema di qualità attraverso le tue azioni quotidiane. Come amministratore del conto - Diagnostica molecolare, Lei:
• essere responsabile della promozione di test diagnostici molecolari, tra cui malattia infettiva, respiratoria e trapianto.
• contattare i clienti nuovi e esistenti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati, sviluppando nuovi business, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e risolvendo i problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche, il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere le vendite.
• generare domanda e massimizzare la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti.
• implementa iniziative strategiche e piani per facilitare il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• lavorare con altri, se necessario o richiesto, per preparare proposte per conti assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte di contratto ai clienti per massimizzare il business complessivo e la redditività, che possono richiedere alcune trattative.
• condurre e organizzare la pianificazione e il routing del territorio necessario per l'efficienza. Conduce l'analisi aziendale e la pianificazione.
• comunica le informazioni sul mercato competitivo internamente.
• reti e interfacce con i colleghi interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente coinvolti in organizzazioni di settore/clienti che influiscono sul business. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo - il territorio è Massachusetts, Connecticut, Vermont e Eastern NY. Fino al 50% di viaggio notturno previsto. Chi sei?
• Corso di laurea o esperienza equivalente
• 3+ anni di vendite rilevanti o di esperienza equivalente
• La partecipazione a uno sviluppo accelerato approvato, la comunione o il programma rotazionale possono essere considerati al posto dell'esperienza. Preferiti Requisiti:
• L'esperienza nelle vendite diagnostiche è fortemente preferita
• Buone capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta, tra cui fare presentazioni d'impatto
• Prove capacità di leadership
• Negoziazione, contrattazione e problem solving competenze
• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente regolamentato
• Pianificazione strategica e competenze organizzative I benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questo lavoro L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione, in base alla posizione principale del Massachusetts, è $ 84,100.00-$156,300.00. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Questa posizione è ammissibile per ottenere un indennizzo incentivo calcolato

In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers. • be responsible for promoting molecular diagnostic testing, including infectious disease, respiratory and transplantation.
• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.
• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.
• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.
• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.
• conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• Develop and Implement commercial contracting framework to address needs of different account segments

• Identify bottlenecks and challenges in the Formulary Inclusion process and plan Interventions for Select Public ecosystems

• Create short & long term sustainable channels and pricing strategies for new products along with the launch squad and be audit ready at any time

• Postgraduierung: MBA oder gleichwertig

• Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen der Payers Ecosystem & Budget Zuteilungsprozess
• gründliches Verständnis der Beschaffungsprozesse verschiedener öffentlicher Konten & Prozesse, Preisgestaltung, Vorschriften und Wertrahmen

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Titre de l'emploi: Partenaire de tarification Lieu de travail: Delhi Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.
• Une opportunité unique pour les patients dans la fonction Accès au marché
• Soutenir les initiatives de la stratégie de tarification pan-Inde
• Équipe de soutien et environnement de travail En tant que partenaire de tarification (lead), vous co-créerez des interventions ARI durables et évolutives en Inde pour les écosystèmes payeurs avec des équipes de clusters d'État, fournirez des prix innovants, un financement alternatif, des contrats commerciaux et une stratégie d'inclusion des appels d'offres. Grâce à des interventions qui répondent aux défis de la capacité de payer des patients, vous offrirez des solutions compétitives au-delà des prix pour les comptes privés et les stratégies d'inclusion dans les formules nationales Principales responsabilités : Le partenaire de tarification :
• Fournir des solutions de tarification aux marques clés sur la base d'obstacles d'accès validés tout en maintenant le prix plancher ainsi que le respect intégral de la réglementation
• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre un cadre de passation de marchés commerciaux pour répondre aux besoins des différents segments de compte
• Évaluer et créer des solutions de financement alternatives spécifiques à la marque et au payeur
• Collaborer avec les parties prenantes concernées pour créer des solutions permettant le développement d'écosystèmes de soins de santé personnalisés et des stratégies de tarification durable pour l'IMF (Foundation Medicine Transition).
• Élaborer des stratégies de navigation des patients dans l'écosystème Select Public en identifiant les obstacles à l'innovation Roche grâce à la cartographie des parcours des patients
• Recenser les goulets d'étranglement et les défis dans le processus d'inclusion de formulation et planifier des interventions pour certains écosystèmes publics
• Défis en grappe pour la mise à niveau de l'ARI et planification des équipes d'État pour développer des solutions pour certains écosystèmes publics (par exemple, Défense et Chemins de fer)
• négocier avec les fournisseurs potentiels sur la création de solutions et avec les hôpitaux pour permettre des contrats commerciaux;
• Fournir des informations et des contributions pour lancer l'équipe d'excellence sur le processus d'inclusion des formulaires de divers organismes de remboursement, les délais d'inclusion, les documents nécessaires ainsi que la préparation du dossier Value à attribuer aux autorités compétentes pour certains écosystèmes publics
• Créer des mécanismes de surveillance et de contrôle continus pour la tarification des produits de base et des nouveaux produits
• Permettre aux réseaux ayant une fonction mondiale de promouvoir activement les approbations requises pour les produits de base et les nouveaux lancements
• Créer des canaux durables à court et à long terme et des stratégies de tarification pour les nouveaux produits avec l'équipe de lancement et être prêt à tout moment
• Veiller à ce que les prix opérationnels et les communications gouvernementales soient établis et contribuer à l'instauration d'un environnement de tarification favorable en Inde; Qui vous êtes Avec un état d'esprit en croissance, et l'expérience dans des façons agiles de travailler, vous êtes en mesure de démontrer la concentration des patients dans la prise de décision, une forte collaboration et des compétences de réseautage, inspirant et influençant. Vous avez
• Post graduation: MBA ou équivalent
• 10 ans et plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, y compris au moins 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en matière de prix et/ou de comptes publics
• Connaissance et expérience des payeurs Processus d'allocation des écosystèmes et du budget
• Compréhension approfondie des processus d'approvisionnement des différents comptes et processus publics, du processus de tarification, des règlements et du cadre de valeurs
• Bonne connaissance et compétences analytiques
• Démonstration de valeur aux payeurs et décideurs Vous êtes

This role is essential in shaping the future of our facilities and ensuring optimal safety, sustainability, and operational excellence. You will lead all aspects of facilities, Sustainability, Safety, Health & Environment (SHE). By fostering a culture of collaboration and customer-centric service, you will create an environment that anticipates future needs and enhances the employee and customer experience. The Opportunity
• Lead Your Team : Develop and lead a high-performing team by fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You will also provide coaching and mentorship, and support professional development.
• Lead Strategy & Innovation : Define and drive local workplace strategy in alignment with local and global ambitions. You will also participate in the International Real Estate/Facilities Management (RE/FM) portfolio and support corporate initiatives.

• Manage Operations & Maintenance : Plan and control repairs and maintenance to ensure high availability of site infrastructure. You will also implement Lifecycle Asset Management and define KPIs to measure success.
• ​ Engage Stakeholders : Drive close communication and collaboration with all site stakeholders, following a "customer first" principle. You'll advocate for Roche's position within external industry and government entities.
• Oversee Security & Safety: Develop, implement, and maintain security measures related to physical, personnel, and information security. Who are you We are looking for a leader who is passionate about sustainability, safety, and creating exceptional workplaces. Your profile should include:
• Leadership & Behavioral Qualities : You must be a strategic thinker with proven experience leading a diverse team and driving a culture of accountability. You should be an active listener who fosters collaborative problem-solving, trusting and empowering your team to take ownership. We need a leader who is objective-driven, adaptable, and has strong communication, conflict resolution, and decision-making skills. We are looking for a leader who is a true Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach (VACC).

• Qualifications & Experience : A degree or equivalent, relevant & established experience. Advanced IWFM qualification or comparable certification preferred. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Deine Abteilung Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, um Einblicke in die pharmazeutische Industrie zu bekommen? Bei uns erhältst Du die spannende Möglichkeit dazu. In Deinem Praktikum lernst Du den Bereich der Qualitätskontrolle umfassend kennen. Es erwartet Dich eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit im Bereich der Analytik von immunologischen Einsatzstoffen. Du erhältst ebenfalls die Möglichkeit, Einblicke in andere Bereiche wie z.B. Biotech Produktion oder Qualitätssicherung zu gewinnen. Während des gesamten Praktikums steht Dir ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite. Deine Aufgaben
• Du unterstützt die proteinchemische Analytik und Freigabeanalytik von immunologischen Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld
• Du bearbeitest eigenständig kleinere Projekte zur Optimierung der Qualitätskontrolle, beispielsweise durch Datenrecherche bei Abweichungen oder die Zentralisierung von Analysemethoden
• Du wirkst aktiv an Compliance-Themen mit, indem Du beispielsweise bei der Erstellung und Anpassung von Dokumenten nach internen Vorschriften und geltenden Standards unterstützt
• Du erhältst Einblicke in angrenzende Bereiche wie die Vorbereitung von Audits und Inspektionen sowie in den gesamten Lebenszyklus diagnostischer Tests (Neuentwicklung, Produktion und Verpackung) Dein Profil
• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (z.B. B.Sc . / M.Sc . Chemie, Biochemie, Biotechnologie, Biologie, etc.) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year
• Du bringst eine hohe Motivation und Neugierde für die Arbeit in der Qualitätskontrolle mit.
• Idealerweise verfügst Du über Vorkenntnisse in der proteinchemischen Analytik.
• Solide Deutsch-Kenntnisse sind erforderlich Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung
• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Gestionar y expandir la operación comercial de las cuentas asignadas, asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos de ventas y rentabilidad, alineados con el código de conducta Roche, normativas locales y lineamientos corporativos.
• Liderar negociaciones estratégicas e implementar soluciones integrales adaptadas a las necesidades de los clientes, desarrollando propuestas de valor basadas en un entendimiento profundo de sus operaciones y desafíos.
• Construir y fortalecer relaciones de largo plazo con clientes y stakeholders clave, brindando una experiencia superior de servicio, realizando visitas estratégicas y participando activamente en actividades externas como congresos, talleres y jornadas.
• Identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y contribuir al desarrollo de cuentas estratégicas, apoyando procesos de licitación, análisis de mercado, actualización de CRM y colaboración interdisciplinaria enfocada en el paciente y el cliente.
• Impulsar una cultura de trabajo colaborativa y de crecimiento continuo, participando en iniciativas internas, fortaleciendo habilidades comerciales y contribuyendo al desarrollo y capacitación de nuevos integrantes del equipo. Tu Perfil:
• Profesional del área de la salud, idealmente Tecnólogo Médico o Bioquímico, con residencia en Temuco y disponibilidad para viajar dentro de la zona asignada.
• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en el área comercial de soluciones diagnósticas para laboratorio clínico, idealmente en entornos de diagnóstico clínico, equipos médicos o industrias relacionadas.
• Deseable formación en ventas profesionales, manejo de herramientas CRM como Salesforce, y conocimientos comerciales orientados a negociación estratégica y desarrollo de cuentas.
• Nivel de inglés intermedio o avanzado, junto con capacidad de trabajo en equipo, mirada corporativa y pensamiento estratégico orientado a equipos de alto desempeño. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a skilled Identity & Access Management Engineer to join our growing IAM team. This role offers a unique opportunity for a Java Developer to expand their expertise into the Identity and Access Management space, with a focus on SailPoint technologies and application integration. You will work on solving complex business problems through practical application of your development skills, contributing to the design, implementation, and evolution of enterprise-scale identity solutions. In this position, you will take on meaningful responsibility for technical design decisions, build resilient IAM infrastructure, and play an active role in shaping how our organization manages identity and access across the enterprise. The Opportunity This role positions you at the intersection of software development and information security, where you'll apply your Java expertise to solve complex identity and access management challenges within a large global enterprise. Your Responsibilities
• Contribute to the end-to-end design of IAM infrastructure solutions and create and maintain related component standards
• Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation for designs, design patterns, and component standards
• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters related to organizational priorities
• Strengthen the Information Security community by building bridges and collaborating with peers and stakeholders
• Contribute to determining success criteria and evaluating promising solutions and technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies
• Design, build, test, and implement integrated, resilient, and reliable IAM solutions
• Advise, influence, and collaborate with various IT partners and line-of-business stakeholders, integrating their feedback
• Ensure designs and solutions align with organizational policies, standards, and strategic directions
• Contribute to estimating engineering resources and timelines for successful project delivery
• Write and contribute to position papers, white papers, technical recommendations, and best practices documentation for the IAM solution space
• Remain proactive in identifying operational challenges and opportunities, working with support teams to ensure solutions meet quality and regulatory standards
• Collaborate closely with Identity Management Support and Operations teams on incident management, problem management, and continuous service improvement
• Embrace our Infrastructure as Code tool chain and adhere to coding best practices Who You Are Technology Skills & Experience
• Deep expertise in Java development with proven ability to apply it within enterprise security contexts
• Hands-on experience with Identity Management technologies; SailPoint experience is highly desired
• Demonstrated experience following CI/CD and DevOps practices
• Knowledge of microservices architectures, API design, and REST APIs
• Understanding of distributed architectures and the challenges they present
• Experience working in an Agile environment
• Proficiency in Python and scripting languages (Perl, JavaScript, PowerShell, etc.) is desired
• Background in Identity and Access Management, Directory Services, or Cyber Security is a plus Core Competencies & Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
• 5+ years of overall experience in relevant technology areas

The Position We are seeking a skilled Identity & Access Management Engineer to join our growing IAM team. This role offers a unique opportunity for a Java Developer to expand their expertise into the Identity and Access Management space, with a focus on SailPoint technologies and application integration. You will work on solving complex business problems through practical application of your development skills, contributing to the design, implementation, and evolution of enterprise-scale identity solutions. In this position, you will take on meaningful responsibility for technical design decisions, build resilient IAM infrastructure, and play an active role in shaping how our organization manages identity and access across the enterprise. The Opportunity This role positions you at the intersection of software development and information security, where you'll apply your Java expertise to solve complex identity and access management challenges within a large global enterprise. Your Responsibilities
• Contribute to the end-to-end design of IAM infrastructure solutions and create and maintain related component standards
• Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation for designs, design patterns, and component standards
• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters related to organizational priorities
• Strengthen the Information Security community by building bridges and collaborating with peers and stakeholders
• Contribute to determining success criteria and evaluating promising solutions and technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies
• Design, build, test, and implement integrated, resilient, and reliable IAM solutions
• Advise, influence, and collaborate with various IT partners and line-of-business stakeholders, integrating their feedback
• Ensure designs and solutions align with organizational policies, standards, and strategic directions
• Contribute to estimating engineering resources and timelines for successful project delivery
• Write and contribute to position papers, white papers, technical recommendations, and best practices documentation for the IAM solution space
• Remain proactive in identifying operational challenges and opportunities, working with support teams to ensure solutions meet quality and regulatory standards
• Collaborate closely with Identity Management Support and Operations teams on incident management, problem management, and continuous service improvement
• Embrace our Infrastructure as Code tool chain and adhere to coding best practices Who You Are Technology Skills & Experience
• Deep expertise in Java development with proven ability to apply it within enterprise security contexts
• Hands-on experience with Identity Management technologies; SailPoint experience is highly desired
• Demonstrated experience following CI/CD and DevOps practices
• Knowledge of microservices architectures, API design, and REST APIs
• Understanding of distributed architectures and the challenges they present
• Experience working in an Agile environment
• Proficiency in Python and scripting languages (Perl, JavaScript, PowerShell, etc.) is desired
• Background in Identity and Access Management, Directory Services, or Cyber Security is a plus Core Competencies & Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
• 5+ years of overall experience in relevant technology areas
• 2+ years working in a multinational environment as an Engineer or Te

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a dynamic and global role? As a Global Product Planner, you will be at the forefront of supply chain management, driving operational excellence and ensuring product availability across our hubs and nodes.. You will develop and manage supply plans utilizing both affiliate and statistical forecasts to create accurate and efficient supply chains. By proactively addressing supply and demand planning issues, you will maintain seamless operations and ensure the accuracy and continuous optimization of MRP master data. Leading bottleneck management, allocation, reserve management, and scrap mitigation across the network will be vital components of your role. In this position, you will be the primary point of contact for product supply-related communications with suppliers, regions, business areas, and affiliates. You will guarantee the timely supply of finished goods to regional and local warehouses, aligning with service level agreements (SLAs), and strive to meet customer service objectives at the lowest possible total costs, including distribution, inventory, and write-offs. We are looking for someone with specialized and comprehensive knowledge in supply chain management or a related business area. Your analytical and problem-solving skills will be engaged in varied and complex duties involving research, analysis, and solution development. You will provide expert guidance to department leadership in setting strategic direction and utilize originality and ingenuity in your daily responsibilities and decision-making processes. Applying a wide range of principles, practices, and procedures to navigate more complex and challenging assignments will be crucial. Additionally, your commitment to maintaining and continuously improving the planning objectives and goals through daily actions will be key. This is your opportunity to make a significant impact in a highly professional and strategic role. Join us and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service and operational efficiency. Apply now to be part of a global team committed to excellence! The Opportunity
• End-to-End Inventory Management: Accountable to ensure global product availability across all regional and central warehouse locations for a defined portfolio, including the strategic setting and continuous monitoring of global safety levels.
• Supply Planning & Optimization: Responsible for the creation and accuracy of global supply plans by aligning demand inputs with manufacturing and supplier capabilities; provides robust recommendations regarding Master Production Schedules (MPS) and Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP).
• Lifecycle & Launch Coordination: Accountable to liaise with functional leads and lifecycle teams to manage complex product transitions, ensuring seamless availability during critical launch and phase-out periods.
• Operational Execution & Data Integrity: Responsible for the ongoing optimization and accuracy of MRP master data and executes logistics interventions, including batch reservations, to guarantee uninterrupted product flow during emergencies.
• Crisis Management & S&OP Leadership : Serves as the primary lead for initiating escalation

• End-to-End Inventory Management: Accountable to ensure global product availability across all regional and central warehouse locations for a defined portfolio, including the strategic setting and continuous monitoring of global safety levels.

• Crisis Management & S&OP Leadership : Serves as the primary lead for initiating escalation

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 您是谁： 您负责 制定 患者整体 解决方案 相关的 策略 和相关项目执行工作，包含但不限于 疾病教育 、创新 支付解决方案 、准入及安全运营以及上市前后产品的学术平台搭建，从而提升标准化诊疗水平 ， 提高患者知晓率和可及性，从而 实现患者获益。 您的机会:
• 构建全国性，跨省，市级等学术平台，与医生组织合作开展学术活动，传递前沿医学和科学进展；提供系统化解决方案方便医生获得前沿医学信息，提高医生的规范化治疗的观念和行为；
• 支持第三方疾病认知教育项目，针对相关疾病领域区域现状及整体策略，开展患者教育，加深患者疾病认知，提升患者获益；
• 整合罗氏相关支付方案，提升团队/客户/患者对支付方案的全景视角；
• 承接CMA整体策略，在生态群更广泛目标医院与院方管理层和关键行政科室领导开展医疗政策的倡导和共识，推进专科联盟建设，医共体/医联体建设，提高医院管理规范；
• 建立和管理生态圈内患者全程管理项目，推进各项目落地实施。 我们期待 这样的您加入： •5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先 •有跨职能、或者治疗领域经验优先

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Integration Governance Expert is responsible for defining, implementing, and continuously improving governance frameworks for enterprise integrations, including APIs, event-driven architectures, and AI-driven and A2A integrations. This role ensures that integrations are discoverable, reusable, compliant, high-quality, and AI-ready through effective management of metadata, schemas, and standards. You will drive governance practices across integration platforms, enabling consistent design, implementation, and lifecycle management of integration assets. The Opportunity:
• Lead the evolution of integration governance frameworks across APIs, events, and AI-driven systems to ensure enterprise-wide scalability.
• Drive schema governance by designing, versioning, and validating standards such as OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and JSON Schema to maintain high-quality assets.
• Shape the integration strategy aligned with global digital, data, and AI goals, promoting metadata-driven approaches for maximum reuse.
• Ensure AI-readiness by implementing semantically structured metadata and schemas that support advanced analytics and automation.
• Collaborate with architects and engineers to align on governance standards, providing the enablement needed for consistent global practices.
• Resolve complex integration challenges by performing root cause analysis and debugging issues to improve overall landscape compliance.
• Maximize discoverability of integration assets, ensuring they are well-documented and easily accessible across multiple platforms and domains.
• Operate as a Subject Matter Expert in metadata management, balancing strategic design with practical implementation across MCP interactions. Who you are:
• Experienced professional with a proven track record in integration engineering, architecture, or governance roles within complex enterprise environments.
• Educated specialist holding a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
• Technical expert with advanced knowledge of API design (REST, SOAP, microservices) and management practices.
• Systems architect with strong experience in event-driven architectures, messaging systems, and metadata management (APIs, events, MCP).
• Standardization advocate with expertise in schema governance, lifecycle management, and quality assessment through validation and observability.
• Tech-savvy collaborator familiar with DevOps, CI/CD, and hands-on experience in Mulesoft, Solace, IBM Sterling, or SAP IS.
• Strategic influencer possessing excellent communication skills to engage stakeholders and drive improvement without direct authority. Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare. #RDT2026 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Formação: Cursando graduação em áreas relacionadas à TI (Ciências da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software e correlatos).
• Idiomas: Inglês ou Espanhol em nível intermediário a avançado.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This position has the mindset of a business leader and entrepreneur. You will act as a strategic architect for the Mexico affiliate. You are responsible for translating long-term business strategy into "fit-for-purpose" P&C initiatives that drive organizational agility and accelerated growth. You will partner flexibly across leadership areas to foster VACC leadership, advance organizational design, and secure future talent capabilities. In this role, you also serve as the Country Connector for Mexico, managing external system shaping and internal cultural stewardship for the site. Legal entity representation for the organization. The Mexico Pharma affiliate is home to +280 collaborators and generated CHF 423 million in revenue in 2025. . The Opportunity: Business Acumen
• Aligns P&C strategy, goals, and objectives to overall business strategies and objectives; translates P&C strategies to drive key business results; provides guidance on talent management, workforce strategies, organization design and reward and recognition in partnership with Business Partners (Enterprise), other Chapters and subject-matter experts to develop high quality solution
• Maintains broad-based knowledge of multiple leadership areas across the organization and its operations; uses knowledge of business and P&C insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively diagnose topics with a wide range of complexity
• Recommends business practice/work process improvements to identify opportunities for leveraging human capital; ensures all P&C initiatives have ROI that adds to organizational value
• Maintains knowledge of external environment and other related information on peer and comparison groups to effectively diagnose and implement strategies to help drive business decisions Leadership
• Strategic Coaching: Act as a trusted partner and coach for senior leaders to foster a leadership culture aligned with the Roche Leadership Framework
• HPO Leadership: Drive High-Performing Organization (HPO) transformations to evolve organizational behaviors, mindsets, and ways of working
• Translates the business vision, mission, and strategy along with the 10 year ambition and P&C Aspirational Goals into projects and initiatives with milestones and delivery schedules; leads or participates i n WPTs/squads to effectively meet planned objectives; develops clear action plans with results-oriented goals for measuring success; drives alignment and buy-in within multiple leadership areas as part of a network
• Diagnoses P&C needs and identifies interventions that address issues of retention, change leadership, employee engagement, and leadership development, partnering with Enterprise Business Partners, WPTs/squads and other P&C Chapters as appropriate; uses appropriate tools for leadership competency and skills assessment.
• Engagement & Culture: Continuously improve the employee experience, driving measurable increases in satisfaction (eSAT) and fostering a diverse, inclusive culture.
• Drives and implements change with proven ability to influence business leaders and P&C professionals to required outcomes Strategic P&C Insights & Innovation
• Gathers and analyzes internal and external data, evidence-based research, benchmarks,
• P&C and business metrics to make critical decisions; shares insights with leaders and recommends innovative solutions based on the P&C decision principles that support the culture, strategic direction and resources
• Diagnoses root ca

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Doing now what patients need next. Near Patient Care is committed to helping people with diabetes everywhere in the world think less about their daily diabetes routine, so they can get true relief, day and night. We offer a broad portfolio of solutions for both people with diabetes and their professionals - from blood glucose monitoring to information management to continuous glucose monitoring. Our aim is to offer innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management. The Opportunity As a Data and Systems Analyst, you will be a vital driver of digital excellence within the Near Patient Care Indianapolis Product Performance team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-tech manufacturing and IT infrastructure, taking ownership of commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) applications and driving the automation of our production processes. This is an ideal opportunity for a proactive, analytical problem-solver who enjoys working independently to investigate cutting-edge technical solutions, while seamlessly collaborating with cross-functional and global networks to turn complex manufacturing data into actionable business intelligence. What You Do
• Individual will assist the Near Patient Care Indianapolis Manufacturing Product Performance team manage software applications relevant to our manufacturing processes.
• You develop reports and other visualization techniques and analyze and interpret data to provide recommendations for process improvements
• You work independently to learn and investigate solutions; while also capable of collaborating and learning from other team members
• You exchange technical information with employees from other sites and form a network.
• Administer COTS applications to ensure proper execution and performance
• May interact with IT teams regarding technologies such as: Active Directory, Windows Server, SQL, Oracle, VMWare, Cisco switches and firewalls
• Use ServiceNow for incident management and change management
• You will attend, support and/or plan team meetings and workshops to build and maintain an understanding of ongoing activities and projects
• You will investigate and drive further automation and simplification of current processes
• You will support teams to manage complex system structures and interfaces Competencies:
• Experience successfully managing medium to large scale improvement projects and in successfully interacting with all levels of the organization
• Ability to effectively negotiate and influence others
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to effectively communicate complex technical problems to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Ability to multitask, prioritize and be detail-oriented
• Ability to work well in a self-managed or team environment
• Strong analytical thinking and problem solving mindset Who You Are
• Bachelor’s degree in Math, Engineering, IT or related field
• Proficient with SAS or other data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. R, R shiny)
• 3+ years professional experience in a related field; OR 1 year with a Master’s degree Preferred
• Familiarity with ServiceNow
• Knowledge of laboratory data systems and quality analytics
• Strong understanding of networking concepts (VLAN’s, SNMP, subnets, switches, firewalls)
• Proven troubleshooting skills in a manufacturing context This is an onsite role in Indianapolis. Relocation benefits are not available. The expe

This is an ideal opportunity for a proactive, analytical problem-solver who enjoys working independently to investigate cutting-edge technical solutions, while seamlessly collaborating with cross-functional and global networks to turn complex manufacturing data into actionable business intelligence. • You work independently to learn and investigate solutions; while also capable of collaborating and learning from other team members

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Team Lead e Product Manager è responsabile per l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ideazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione strategica fino al lancio, scaling e all'eventuale pensionamento. Questo ruolo è fondamentale per trasformare le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni tecnologiche tangibili e ad alto valore. Sarete responsabili di definire la visione del prodotto, la strategia e la roadmap, assicurando che si allinea con gli obiettivi di overarching della nostra organizzazione e, infine, accelera la consegna di diagnostica e medicine che cambiano la vita ai pazienti. Questo ruolo richiede una combinazione distintiva di inquisitività scientifica, competenza tecnica e business insight per navigare con successo nel paesaggio. Il vostro obiettivo primario è quello di guidare team di ingegneria e servizi che costruiscono prodotti desiderabili, fattibili, fattibili e sostenibili che soddisfano le esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri utenti interni pur mantenendo una stretta conformità con gli standard del settore. Descrizione della zona All'interno di RDT Pharma Technical Operations e in particolare nel contesto di Manufacturing Technologies, il Team Lead Process Data supervisiona un portafoglio strategico di team e soluzioni focalizzate sul ciclo di vita dei dati farmaceutici. Questo settore fa parte della spina dorsale digitale del nostro ambiente di produzione, assicurando che i processi scientifici complessi siano tradotti in formati digitali affidabili, eseguibili e reportabili. Il nostro scopo include:
• Definizione e tracciamento dei parametri di processo: garantire la precisione e l'integrità dei dati che definiscono i nostri passi di produzione. . Enterprise Recipe Management: Orchestrare i "blueprint" per i nostri farmaci in diversi siti per garantire coerenza e scalabilità. Data Historian Solutions: Gestione dei flussi di dati ad alta frequenza e in tempo reale dal piano del negozio per consentire analisi approfondite, risoluzione dei problemi e miglioramento continuo del processo. Accessibilità dei dati di Shop-Floor: Semplificare l'estrazione e la disponibilità dei dati di produzione grezzi per garantire che sia facilmente accessibile per sistemi di livello superiore, analisi e processi decisionali operativi. Tu sarai:
• Strategia & Visione: Contabile per impostare la direzione di un prodotto e garantire che raggiunga i risultati definiti e gli obiettivi finanziari. Definisce strategia di prodotto, roadmap e caratteristiche allineate agli obiettivi aziendali, alle esigenze degli utenti e alle politiche organizzative. Integrare attivamente le capacità AI rilevanti nella roadmap del prodotto. Definire, tracciare e comunicare i KPI rilevanti per il prodotto per misurarne le prestazioni e il contributo agli obiettivi e alla strategia aziendali.
• Customer-Centricity: raccogliere, comprendere e dare priorità alle esigenze degli utenti interni. Agire come titolare principale del problema del “cliente” ed essere responsabile della definizione e della fornitura di una soluzione che fornisce valore tangibile. Definire e monitorare le metriche chiave relative alla soddisfazione dell'utente, all'impegno e alla consegna del valore, e utilizzare questi dati per informare le iterazioni del prodotto.
• ciclo di vita del prodotto Mgmt. Proprio il ciclo di vita del prodotto end-to-end, guidare il suo sviluppo, e gestire la sua crescita e l'eventuale declino basato su ricerca di mercato, feedback dei clienti e obiettivi aziendali. Gestire il prodotto nel rispetto delle normative emergenti.
• Collaborazione Stakeholder: Espandi la collaborazione ad un più ampio gruppo di team interfunzionali e sia responsabile dell'allineamento di queste squadre intorno alla roadmap del prodotto. Comunicare chiaramente la roadmap del prodotto, le linee temporali e i potenziali trade-off a vari stakeholder per gestire efficacemente le loro aspettative.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Team Lead and Product Manager is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape. Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards. Description of the area Within RDT Pharma Technical Operations and specifically in the context of Manufacturing Technologies , the Team Lead Process Data oversees a strategic portfolio of teams and solutions focused on the lifecycle of pharmaceutical manufacturing data. This area is part of the digital backbone of our production environment, ensuring that complex scientific processes are translated into reliable, executable, and reportable digital formats. Our scope includes:
• Process Parameter Definition & Tracking: Ensuring the precision and integrity of data that defines our manufacturing steps. . Enterprise Recipe Management: Orchestrating the "blueprints" for our medicines across different sites to ensure consistency and scalability. Data Historian Solutions: Managing the high-frequency, real-time data streams from the shop floor to enable deep analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous process improvement. Shop-Floor Data Accessibility : Streamlining the extraction and availability of raw manufacturing data to ensure it is readily accessible for higher-level systems, analytics, and operational decision-making. You will be:
• Strategy & Vision : Accountable for setting the direction for a product and ensuring that it achieves defined outcomes and financial objectives. Defines product strategy, roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user needs and organisational policies. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.
• Customer-Centricity : Actively collect, understand, and prioritize the needs of internal users. Act as the primary owner of the “customer's” problem and be responsible for defining and delivering a solution that provides tangible value. Define and track key metrics related to user satisfaction, engagement, and value delivery, and use this data to inform product iterations.
• Product Lifecycle Mgmt. Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, guide its development, and manage its growth and eventual decline based on market research, customer feedback, and business goals. Manage the product in compliance with emerging regulations.
• Stakeholder Collaboration : Expand collaboration to a broader set of cross-functional teams and be responsible for aligning these teams around the product roadmap. Clearly communicate the product roadmap, timelines, and potential trade-offs to various stakeholders to manage their expectations effectively.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Der Team Lead and Product Manager ist verantwortlich für den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, von der ersten Idee und strategischen Planung bis hin zum Start, Skalierung und eventuellen Ruhestand. Diese Rolle ist von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Transformation von wissenschaftlichen und geschäftlichen Anforderungen in konkrete, hochwertige Technologielösungen. Sie werden für die Definition der Produktvision, Strategie und Roadmap verantwortlich sein, um sicherzustellen, dass sie mit den übergeordneten Zielen unserer Organisation in Einklang steht und letztendlich die Lieferung von lebensverändernden Diagnostik und Arzneimitteln an Patienten beschleunigt. Diese Rolle erfordert eine unverwechselbare Kombination von wissenschaftlicher Inquisition, technischer Kompetenz und geschäftlicher Einsicht, um die Landschaft erfolgreich zu navigieren. Ihr primäres Ziel ist es, Ingenieur- und Serviceteams zu führen, die wünschenswerte, machbare, lebensfähige und nachhaltige Produkte aufbauen, die den sich entwickelnden Bedürfnissen unserer internen Nutzer gerecht werden und gleichzeitig die Einhaltung der einschlägigen Industriestandards strenger halten. Beschreibung der Fläche Im Rahmen von RDT Pharma Technical Operations und speziell im Rahmen von Fertigungstechnologien betreut das Team Lead Process Data ein strategisches Team- und Lösungsportfolio, das sich auf den Lebenszyklus von pharmazeutischen Fertigungsdaten konzentriert. Dieser Bereich ist Teil des digitalen Rückgrats unserer Produktionsumgebung, um sicherzustellen, dass komplexe wissenschaftliche Prozesse in zuverlässige, ausführbare und belegbare digitale Formate übersetzt werden. Unsere Reichweite umfasst:
• Prozessparameter Definition & Tracking: Sicherstellung der Präzision und Integrität von Daten, die unsere Fertigungsschritte definieren. . Enterprise Recipe Management: Orchestrieren der "Blauabdrücke" für unsere Medikamente auf verschiedenen Seiten, um Konsistenz und Skalierbarkeit zu gewährleisten. Data Historian Solutions: Verwalten der hochfrequenten Echtzeit-Datenströme aus dem Ladenboden, um eine tiefe Analyse, Fehlersuche und kontinuierliche Prozessverbesserung zu ermöglichen. Zugang zu den Daten über die Nutzung von Daten für die Verarbeitung von Rohmaterial: Optimierung der Gewinnung und Verfügbarkeit von Rohdaten, um sicherzustellen, dass sie für übergeordnete Systeme, Analysen und operative Entscheidungsfindungen leicht zugänglich ist. Sie werden sein:
• Strategie & Vision : Konzipierbar für die Einstellung der Richtung für ein Produkt und sicherzustellen, dass es definierte Ergebnisse und finanzielle Ziele erreicht. Definiert Produktstrategie, Roadmap und Funktionen, die mit Geschäftszielen, Benutzeranforderungen und Organisationsrichtlinien übereinstimmen. Integrieren Sie relevante KI-Fähigkeiten proaktiv in die Produkt-Roadmap. Definieren, verfolgen und kommunizieren relevante Kennzahlen für das Produkt, um seine Leistung und seinen Beitrag zu Geschäftszielen und Strategie zu messen.
• Customer-Centricity: Aktiv sammeln, verstehen und priorisieren die Bedürfnisse der internen Benutzer. Aktivieren Sie als Primäreigentümer des „Kunden“-Problems und sind verantwortlich für die Definition und Bereitstellung einer Lösung, die einen spürbaren Wert bietet. Definieren und verfolgen Sie wichtige Metriken im Zusammenhang mit der Benutzerzufriedenheit, dem Engagement und der Wertschöpfung und nutzen Sie diese Daten, um die Produkt iterationen zu informieren.
• Product Lifecycle Mgmt. Eigener End-to-End-Produktlebenszyklus, führen seine Entwicklung und verwalten ihr Wachstum und seinen eventuellen Rückgang basierend auf Marktforschung, Kundenfeedback und Geschäftszielen. Verwalten Sie das Produkt in Übereinstimmung mit den aufstrebenden Vorschriften.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Erweitern Sie die Zusammenarbeit zu einem breiteren Satz von funktionsübergreifenden Teams und sind für die Ausrichtung dieser Teams auf die Produkt-Roadmap verantwortlich. Deutlich kommunizieren Sie die Produkt-Roadmap, Timelines und potenzielle Trade-offs an verschiedene Stakeholder, um ihre Erwartungen effektiv zu verwalten.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef d'équipe et le gestionnaire des produits sont responsables de tout le cycle de vie du produit, depuis l'idée initiale et la planification stratégique jusqu'au lancement, à l'échelle et à la retraite. Ce rôle est essentiel pour transformer les besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en solutions technologiques tangibles et de grande valeur. Vous serez responsable de la définition de la vision, de la stratégie et de la feuille de route du produit, en s'assurant qu'elle s'harmonise avec les objectifs généraux de notre organisation et, en fin de compte, accélère la prestation de diagnostics et de médicaments qui changent la vie aux patients. Ce rôle exige une combinaison distinctive d'enquête scientifique, de compétence technique et de perspicacité commerciale pour naviguer avec succès dans le paysage. Votre objectif principal est de diriger les équipes d'ingénierie et de service en construisant des produits souhaitables, réalisables, viables et durables qui répondent aux besoins changeants de nos utilisateurs internes tout en maintenant le strict respect des normes pertinentes de l'industrie. Description de la zone Dans le cadre des opérations techniques de RDT Pharma et plus particulièrement dans le contexte des technologies de fabrication , les données de processus de l'équipe supervisent un portefeuille stratégique d'équipes et de solutions axées sur le cycle de vie des données de fabrication pharmaceutique. Cette zone fait partie de l'épine dorsale numérique de notre environnement de production, assurant que les processus scientifiques complexes sont traduits en formats numériques fiables, exécutables et à déclaration. Notre portée comprend :
• Définition et suivi du paramètre process : assurer la précision et l'intégrité des données qui définissent nos étapes de fabrication. . Gestion de la recette d'entreprise : orchestrer les "empreintes bleues" pour nos médicaments sur différents sites afin d'assurer la cohérence et l'évolutivité. Data Historian Solutions: Gestion des flux de données en temps réel à haute fréquence depuis l'atelier pour permettre une analyse approfondie, le dépannage et l'amélioration continue des processus. Accessibility Shop-Floor Data : Simplification de l'extraction et de la disponibilité des données brutes de fabrication pour s'assurer qu'elles sont facilement accessibles pour les systèmes de niveau supérieur, les analyses et la prise de décisions opérationnelles. Vous serez :
• Stratégie & Vision : Responsable de définir l'orientation d'un produit et de veiller à ce qu'il atteigne des résultats définis et des objectifs financiers. Définit la stratégie, la feuille de route et les caractéristiques des produits en fonction des objectifs opérationnels, des besoins des utilisateurs et des politiques organisationnelles. Intégrer de manière proactive les capacités d'IA pertinentes dans la feuille de route des produits. Définir, suivre et communiquer les ICR pertinents pour le produit afin de mesurer son rendement et sa contribution aux objectifs et à la stratégie de l'entreprise.
• Client-Centricité : Recueillir, comprendre et prioriser activement les besoins des utilisateurs internes. Agir en tant que propriétaire principal du problème du client et être responsable de définir et de fournir une solution qui fournit une valeur tangible. Définir et suivre les mesures clés liées à la satisfaction des utilisateurs, à l'engagement et à la livraison de valeur, et utiliser ces données pour éclairer les itérations de produits.
• Cycle de vie du produit Mgmt. Posséder le cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, orienter son développement et gérer sa croissance et éventuellement son déclin en fonction de l'étude de marché, de la rétroaction des clients et des objectifs commerciaux. Gérer le produit conformément aux nouveaux règlements.
• Collaboration avec les parties prenantes : étendre la collaboration à un ensemble plus large d'équipes interfonctionnelles et être responsable de l'alignement de ces équipes sur la feuille de route des produits. Communiquer clairement la feuille de route du produit, les échéanciers et les compromis possibles à divers intervenants pour gérer efficacement leurs attentes.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que membre de l'équipe du Réseau mondial des patients (GPN) au sein du département Développement de produits médicaux (PDMA) de Roche, le Patient Insights & Analytics Lead est un rôle central qui sert dans toute la chaîne de valeur Pharma de la R-D à la commercialisation. En tant que membre principal de l'équipe d'activation du réseau au GPN, vous servirez de moteur fondamental pour la gestion des connaissances des patients et la mesure de leur impact sur les principales décisions d'affaires en fournissant les systèmes, les cadres et les principes de gestion des connaissances essentiels nécessaires au GPN pour obtenir des résultats pertinents à l'échelle mondiale. En s'assurant que les connaissances des patients sont FAIR (fichables, accessibles, interopérables, réutilisables), quantifiées, comprises et intégrées aux processus d'affaires de Roche, vous faciliterez des partenariats significatifs et interfonctionnels qui auront un impact tangible pour les patients, tout en permettant le succès de notre entreprise. La position
• KPI Framework & Value Narrative: mettre en œuvre un cadre de mesure de KPI, recueillir des données et développer un récit solide démontrant la valeur tangible et l'impact de l'intégration des connaissances des patients dans les décisions clés de l'entreprise
• Affiliate Metric Alignement: Input et façonner les cadres d'affiliation KPI, connectant avec succès les paramètres mondiaux et locaux, dans la mesure du possible
• Insights & CRM Infrastructure: concevoir, déployer et gérer des outils internes qui permettent une gestion rationalisée des intervenants et des connaissances afin de permettre des gains d'efficacité dans la façon dont les entreprises clés fonctionnent l'accès et d'appliquer les connaissances des patients dans leur travail
• Intégration des outils : intégrer et gérer les outils de collecte et de gestion des connaissances utilisés par le GPN dans les solutions à l'échelle de l'entreprise, en alignant l'approche avec les approches/principes plus larges de l'AGPD
• Benchmarking externe: maintenir le contrôle des initiatives et des plateformes de benchmarking externe pour s'assurer que Roche est bien représentée, en générant des données d'impact qui peuvent être intégrées dans des cadres internes pour raconter une histoire complète de l'impact de Roches sur et de la réputation auprès des patients
• Gestion stratégique des parties prenantes : naviguer dans un environnement complexe et matriciel pour intégrer les outils de gestion des connaissances des patients dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, en réunissant les infrastructures mondiales et locales pour offrir une approche « One Roche » Qui vous êtes
• 5 ans et plus d'expérience éprouvée dans la fourniture de solutions complexes d'analyse/de connaissances dans une organisation matricielle avec une présence mondiale et régionale (expérience de travail avec des données sur les patients et des informations hautement valorisées)
• Haute compétence dans l'élaboration de mesures et de récits validés qui prouvent la valeur commerciale de l'inclusivité du patient de bout en bout.
• Expertise éprouvée dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et la gestion de plateformes et de solutions sur un réseau mondial.
• Forte capacité d'interagir avec les dirigeants internes et de collaborer efficacement avec les fonctions juridiques, de conformité, de communication, d'analyse de marché et autres fonctions commerciales.
• Capacité de diriger des projets ou des initiatives qui vont au-delà des idées et des analyses pour aider à orienter les priorités de l'équipe, au besoin.
• L'intelligence émotionnelle et l'influence efficace des compétences pour aligner les parties prenantes, renforcer la confiance et promouvoir des solutions mutuellement précieuses.
• Les candidats doivent avoir une maîtrise native ou quasi native en anglais professionnel des affaires (écrit et parlé)
• L'emploi nécessite un minimum de voyage (10-15 %) et une flexibilité d'horaire pour desservir les fuseaux horaires mondiaux Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par additio

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity As a Cluster Section Lead in the Global Finance Support organization, you will be responsible for establishing and leading day-to-day Finance Technical support, working with the respective Global Cluster Lead. The role has a strong focus on people management, compliance and operational excellence. In this position you will drive operational excellence to achieve the objectives of the Global Product Line, leading a team of Finance Business and System Analysts. As a people manager you will inspire and help to shape the future of our organization. You will actively coach and foster the development of the team members, help remove siloes and support your team to evolve with the organic development of the business. You will lead the collaboration across clusters, as well as, across Global Product Lines, and Global teams.
• Strategic Talent Management: Lead the full employee lifecycle by managing recruitment with P&C, overseeing onboarding/integration, and ensuring comprehensive training through various learning channels.
• Performance & Development: Motivate and develop team members by setting clear goals, documenting performance, and providing proactive coaching and feedback.
• Operational Excellence: Drive service quality in Finance Business Support by meeting KPI targets, ensuring high end-user satisfaction, and maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes.
• Collaboration & Communication: Foster a culture of teamwork and transparency by proactively sharing information, project roadmaps, and business knowledge across global and functional boundaries.
• Continuous Improvement: Partner with enabling functions to implement best practices and identify system/process enhancements that drive automation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
• Stakeholder & Risk Management: Manage key business relationships and collaborate with leadership to set performance targets, manage team workloads, and mitigate operational risks.
• Values-Driven Leadership: Serve as a role model by embodying Roche values and Leadership Commitments while promoting Agile, LEAN, and ITIL methodologies. Who you are
• Strategic Leadership & Change Management: Proven ability to lead projects in complex matrix organizations, drive organizational change, and mentor/coach team members to success.
• Operational Excellence & Metrics: Extensive experience in customer support (preferably Finance) with a focus on meeting department KPIs, managing escalations, and utilizing reporting tools for data-driven decisions.
• Stakeholder & Account Management: Expert in demand and relationship management, possessing exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills to navigate a dynamic international environment.
• Agile & Structured Methodologies: Proficient in implementing support processes through modern ways of working, such as Agile, ITIL, and LEAN, while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.
• Results-Oriented Professionalism: Highly accountable and resourceful problem-solver with a university degree and the ability to manage multiple priorities with composure and integrity. In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private
