descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
In Roche´s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. This position is located in Preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC), a department within the small molecule research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities, where we pave, in a diverse, ambitious and innovative environment, the path to bring drug candidates from early research into development.

The Opportunity:
As an Intern in our team your main tasks will include:

Option 1 - Oligo synthesis

• Discovery of new techniques for the synthesis of complex oligonucleotides

• Purification and analysis of reactions involving oligonucleotides with state of the art chromatographic techniques.

• Scale up your findings into processes for the preparation of multi-gram quantities of desired target materials.

Option 2 - Oligo Analytical Chemistry

• State-of-the-art analysis of complex synthetic oligonucleotides by LC-MS.

• Development and implementation of innovative analytical methods to support synthesis, development and production.

• Conducting critical in-solution stability and hold-time studies.

Who you are:

• An enthusiastic, motivated and scientifically interested person who enjoys teamwork and has a strong willingness to learn new techniques.

• A BSc or MSc student, or a recent graduate (within the last 12 months prior to the start date), in Chemistry or Biochemistry . Prior hands-on laboratory experience is required .

• Prior experience with oligonucleotide chemistry (solid phase synthesis, conjugation, purification and analysis; Option 1) or LC-MS analytics (Option 2) is desirable.

• Excellent organizational skills and proactive knowledge sharing.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Application process:
Please upload a current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship.

Additional Information:

• Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship.

• this internship is not suitable for a thesis, nor for PhD students or post-graduates.

If you are eager to contribute and feel you have the dedication to teamwork and innovation that we are seeking, then Roche is the organization for you. Every role at Roche plays a part in making a difference to patients’ lives. If you want to work in a passionate team, make your mark & improve lives, apply now!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high,
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.
In Roche ́s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organizzazione (pRED), facciamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Questa posizione si trova in Chimica Preclinica, Manifattura e Controlli (pCMC), un dipartimento all'interno della piccola organizzazione di ricerca molecola in PRED Therapeutic Modalities, dove pave, in un ambiente diverso, ambizioso e innovativo, il percorso per portare i candidati alla droga dalla ricerca precoce nello sviluppo.

L'opportunità:
Come Interno nel nostro team i vostri compiti principali includono:

Opzione 1 - Sintesi Oligo

• Scoperta di nuove tecniche per la sintesi di oligonucleotidi complessi

• Purificazione e analisi di reazioni che coinvolgono oligonucleotidi con tecniche cromatografiche all'avanguardia.

• Scalare i risultati in processi per la preparazione di quantità multi-gram di materiali target desiderati.

Opzione 2 - Chimica analitica Oligo

• Analisi all'avanguardia di oligonucleotidi sintetici complessi di LC-MS.

• Sviluppo e attuazione di metodi analitici innovativi per sostenere la sintesi, lo sviluppo e la produzione.

• Condurre studi critici di stabilità e tempo di attesa.

titleByLocale.fr: Data Steward – Centre de données médicales

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy team drives data excellence and analytics across Roche Product Development, helping unlock the value of clinical, operational and real-world data to accelerate better decisions and improved outcomes for patients.

Within this team, the Medical Data Hub (MDH) Squad enables trusted, reusable and accessible data across the product development lifecycle.

As a Data Steward , you will help ensure data is properly documented, governed and fit for secondary use, supporting transparency, consistency and scientific rigor across Roche’s development landscape. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data governance, clinical development and innovation, helping build the foundations for future-ready, AI-enabled healthcare solutions.
You will:

• Support trusted data ecosystems by helping develop tools and processes that enable real-world and secondary use of clinical trial data.

• Contribute to platform excellence by supporting the Medical Data Hub to remain scalable, accessible and fit for purpose.

• Enable data transparency and reuse through metadata standards, cataloguing, classification and stewardship activities.

• Strengthen data quality by assisting with routine assessments across structured and unstructured datasets.

• Build stewardship capability by contributing to knowledge sharing and helping embed good governance practices across teams.

• Enable FAIR data practices by supporting traceability, accessibility and consistency across development data assets.

• Collaborate across functions including Product Development, Research, Medical and Commercial teams with management of secondary use data.

• Support compliance and trust by applying relevant privacy, security and regulatory expectations, including GDPR and HIPAA where appropriate.

Who you are
You are curious, collaborative and passionate about improving how data is managed and used to advance science and healthcare.
You have:

• A degree, advanced qualification or equivalent practical background in Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Information Science, Information Management or a related discipline.

• Experience working in data documentation, metadata, quality, governance or stewardship-related environments.

• An understanding of clinical, operational or real-world data structures and foundational stewardship practices.

• Familiarity with documentation tools, spreadsheets, cataloguing approaches or version control systems.

• Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills with the ability to work independently and adapt in evolving environments.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to a broad range of stakeholders.

• A collaborative and inclusive mindset, with respect for different perspectives in a global organisation.

Preferred

• Exposure to healthcare data governance, data catalogues or classification systems.

• Familiarity with FAIR data principles or regulatory documentation expectations.

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality, consistent data practices.

Join Roche and help shape a connected, trusted and future-ready data ecosystem that accelerates innovation for patients worldwide.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Welwyn. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details

La posizione
Il team di Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy guida l'eccellenza e l'analisi dei dati attraverso lo sviluppo di Roche, aiutando a sbloccare il valore dei dati clinici, operativi e reali per accelerare le decisioni migliori e i risultati migliori per i pazienti.

Si tratta di un'opportunità per lavorare all'intersezione della governance dei dati, dello sviluppo clinico e dell'innovazione, contribuendo a costruire le basi per soluzioni sanitarie pronte per il futuro e per il futuro.
Lo farai:

• Sostenere la conformità e la fiducia applicando le aspettative relative alla privacy, alla sicurezza e alle normative, incluso GDPR e HIPAA, se del caso.

Chi sei
Siete curiosi, collaborativi e appassionati di migliorare il modo in cui i dati vengono gestiti e utilizzati per promuovere la scienza e la salute.
Hai...

• Una laurea, una qualifica avanzata o un background pratico equivalente in Scienza dei dati, Bioinformatica, Scienze della vita, Scienza dell'informazione, Gestione delle informazioni o una disciplina relativa.

• Esperienza di lavoro nella documentazione dei dati, metadati, qualità, governance o ambienti correlati alla gestione.

• Una comprensione delle strutture di dati cliniche, operative o reali e delle pratiche di stewardship fondazionali.

• Familiarità con strumenti di documentazione, fogli di calcolo, approcci di catalogazione o sistemi di controllo delle versioni.

• Forte capacità di problem solving e di pensiero critico con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e adattarsi in ambienti in evoluzione.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di spiegare chiaramente i concetti tecnici ad una vasta gamma di stakeholder.

• Una mentalità collaborativa e inclusiva, nel rispetto di diverse prospettive in un'organizzazione globale.

Preferito

• Esposizione alla governance dei dati sanitari, ai cataloghi di dati o ai sistemi di classificazione.

• Familiarità con i principi di dati FAIR o le aspettative di documentazione regolamentare.

• Forte attenzione ai dettagli e impegno nelle pratiche di dati di alta qualità e coerente.

Unisciti a Roche e aiuta a plasmare un ecosistema di dati collegato, affidabile e pronto per il futuro che accelera l'innovazione per i pazienti in tutto il mondo.

Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Welwyn. • Permettre les pratiques de données FAIR en soutenant la traçabilité, l'accessibilité et la cohérence entre les données de développement.

• Collaborer à l'ensemble des fonctions, y compris le développement de produits, la recherche, les équipes médicales et commerciales, avec la gestion des données sur l'utilisation secondaire.

• Soutenir la conformité et la confiance en appliquant les attentes pertinentes en matière de confidentialité, de sécurité et de réglementation, y compris le RGPD et le HIPAA, le cas échéant.

Qui vous êtes
Vous êtes curieux, collaboratif et passionné par l'amélioration de la façon dont les données sont gérées et utilisées pour faire progresser la science et les soins de santé.
Vous avez :

• Un diplôme, une qualification avancée ou une formation pratique équivalente en sciences des données, bioinformatique, sciences de la vie, sciences de l'information, gestion de l'information ou une discipline connexe.

• Expérience dans la documentation des données, les métadonnées, la qualité, la gouvernance ou les environnements liés à la gérance.

• Une compréhension des structures de données cliniques, opérationnelles ou réelles et des pratiques de gérance fondamentales.

• Familiarité avec les outils de documentation, les feuilles de calcul, les approches de catalogage ou les systèmes de contrôle de version.

• Des compétences fortes en résolution de problèmes et en pensée critique, capables de travailler de façon indépendante et de s'adapter dans des environnements en évolution.

• Excellentes compétences en communication, avec la capacité d'expliquer clairement les concepts techniques à un large éventail de parties prenantes.

• Une mentalité collaborative et inclusive, dans le respect des différentes perspectives d'une organisation mondiale.

Préféré

• Exposition à la gouvernance des données de santé, aux catalogues de données ou aux systèmes de classification.

• Connaissance des principes de données FAIR ou des attentes en matière de documentation réglementaire.

• Une grande attention aux détails et un engagement en faveur de pratiques de données cohérentes et de qualité.

Rejoignez Roche et aidez à façonner un écosystème de données connecté, fiable et prêt à l'avenir qui accélère l'innovation pour les patients dans le monde entier.

Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Welwyn. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle pourrait être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche.

ASPIRE is a multi-year program that will define, design, and deploy Future ERP solutions based on SAP S/4 HANA and other cloud/on-premise technology platforms. The program will enable simplified, standardized, and harmonized global business processes by capitalizing on SAP, Life Science Industry and Roche effective practices.

The opportunity:

• Preparation and leading of FIT-to-Template (assessment of the current business processes compared and aligned against the future Aspire Global Template) and scoping workshops for Financial Compliance

• Liaising with local affiliate Finance stakeholders for the implementation of Financial Compliance requirements

• Assessment of localization requirements for Authorization

• Execution of Testing Activities during the deployment (UT, SAT, UAT, REG)

• Go Live & Hyper care (incl. Month end closing ) support

• Ensure template governance within the project including change control management in line with the respective GBPMs/GBPOs and the overall Finance governance concept

Who you are

• You have a university degree in Business Administration, Accounting or a related field and proficiency in English.

• 5+ years related business experience or equivalent Project Management skills in the area of SAP Authorization

• Broad knowledge of business processes, policies and programs

• Strong Project Management , business partner management, communication and change management skills. Experience in Agile Project Methodologies is a plus

• Strong people skill s are required as the role is highly consultative, interacting with staff at all levels across an organization

Relocation benefits are not available for this job opportunity.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy powers better decision-making and evidence generation across Roche Product Development, helping teams use clinical, operational and real-world data to accelerate scientific progress for patients.

Within Data Governance and Operations, the Master and Operational Data Team builds the foundations that make data trusted, reusable and ready for future innovation.

As a Data Steward , you will help ensure key data assets are documented, governed and accessible across the product development lifecycle. You will connect data to business processes, support master and operational data standards, and strengthen the quality, usability and trustworthiness of data across Roche.
You will:

• Strengthen trusted data foundations by maintaining documentation across key data domains, including study operational, scientific and medical affairs data.

• Support data governance in practice through metadata standards, reference data, lineage tracking, conceptual data models and catalogue management.

• Improve data quality and reuse by contributing to lifecycle management, quality controls and metadata enrichment.

• Connect data to business context by supporting data mapping, classification and modelling linked to ways of working and processes.

• Enable FAIR data principles so data is findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable across teams.

• Collaborate across functions to improve visibility, accessibility and usability of critical data assets.

• Support compliance and trust by applying relevant privacy, security and regulatory expectations, including GDPR and HIPAA where appropriate.

Who you are
You bring a thoughtful, detail-focused approach to data stewardship and enjoy turning complex data environments into clear, usable and governed assets.
You have:

• A degree, advanced qualification or equivalent practical background in Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Information Science, Information Management or a related field.

• Experience working with data management, metadata curation, master data or data governance in a life sciences, healthcare, scientific or regulated environment.

• Familiarity with tools or approaches for data lineage, cataloguing, data quality, versioning or master data management.

• An understanding of FAIR data principles, semantic modelling and foundational data governance practices.

• The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different audiences.

• A collaborative mindset, with respect for different perspectives in a global working environment.

Preferred

• Exposure to clinical operations, Phase I–IV studies or scientific/operational data domains.

• Experience contributing to agile teams, platform implementation or data product initiatives.

Bring your curiosity, rigour and care for data quality — and help Roche build a future-ready data ecosystem that supports better science and better outcomes for patients.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Welwyn. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy potenzia il processo decisionale e la generazione di prove in Roche Product Development, aiutando i team ad utilizzare dati clinici, operativi e reali per accelerare il progresso scientifico per i pazienti.

All'interno del Data Governance and Operations, il Master and Operational Data Team costruisce le basi che rendono i dati affidabili, riutilizzabili e pronti per l'innovazione futura.

In qualità di Data Steward , vi aiuterà a garantire che le attività chiave dei dati siano documentate, disciplinate e accessibili attraverso il ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del prodotto. Si collegherà i dati ai processi aziendali, supportano gli standard di dati operativi e rafforzano la qualità, l'usabilità e la affidabilità dei dati attraverso Roche.
Lo farai:

• Rafforzare le basi di dati attendibili mantenendo la documentazione nei domini di dati chiave, inclusi i dati operativi, scientifici e medici.

• Supporta la governance dei dati in pratica attraverso gli standard di metadati, i dati di riferimento, il tracciamento della linea, i modelli di dati concettuali e la gestione del catalogo.

• Migliorare la qualità e il riutilizzo dei dati contribuendo alla gestione del ciclo di vita, ai controlli di qualità e all'arricchimento dei metadati.

• Collegare i dati al contesto aziendale supportando la mappatura dei dati, la classificazione e la modellazione collegati a modi di lavoro e processi.

• Abilitare i principi di dati FAIR in modo che i dati siano rilevabili, accessibili, interoperabili e riutilizzabili tra le squadre.

• Collaborare tra le funzioni per migliorare la visibilità, l'accessibilità e l'usabilità dei dati critici.

• Sostenere la conformità e la fiducia applicando le aspettative relative alla privacy, alla sicurezza e alle normative, incluso GDPR e HIPAA, se del caso.

Chi sei
Porti un approccio attento e dettagliato alla gestione dei dati e goditi di trasformare ambienti di dati complessi in beni chiari, utilizzabili e regolati.
Hai...

• Una laurea, una qualifica avanzata o un background pratico equivalente in Scienza dei dati, Bioinformatica, Scienze della vita, Scienza dell'informazione, Gestione delle informazioni o un campo relativo.

• Esperienza di lavoro con la gestione dei dati, la cura dei metadati, i dati master o la governance dei dati in una scienza della vita, la sanità, l'ambiente scientifico o regolamentato.

• Familiarità con strumenti o approcci per datalinege, catalogazione, qualità dei dati, versione o gestione dei dati master.

• Una comprensione dei principi di dati FAIR, della modellazione semantica e delle pratiche di governance dei dati fondamentali.

• La capacità di spiegare i concetti tecnici chiaramente a un pubblico diverso.

• Una mentalità collaborativa, nel rispetto di diverse prospettive in un ambiente di lavoro globale.

Preferito

• Esposizione a operazioni cliniche, studi di Fase I-IV o domini di dati scientifici/operativi.

• Esperienza contribuendo a team agili, implementazione della piattaforma o iniziative di prodotto dati.

Porta la tua curiosità, rigore e cura per la qualità dei dati - e aiuta Roche a costruire un ecosistema di dati pronto per il futuro che supporta una migliore scienza e migliori risultati per i pazienti.

Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Welwyn. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione.
Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy ermöglicht eine bessere Entscheidungs- und Beweiserzeugung über Roche Product Development und hilft Teams, klinische, operative und reale Daten zu verwenden, um den wissenschaftlichen Fortschritt für Patienten zu beschleunigen.

Innerhalb von Data Governance und Operations baut das Master- und Operationsdaten-Team die Grundlagen, die Daten vertrauensvoll, wiederverwendbar und für zukünftige Innovationen bereit machen.

Als Data Steward können Sie sicherstellen, dass über den gesamten Produktentwicklungs-Lebenszyklus wichtige Datenwerte dokumentiert, geregelt und zugänglich sind. Sie verbinden Daten mit Geschäftsprozessen, unterstützen Master- und Betriebsdatenstandards und stärken Qualität, Usability und Vertrauenswürdigkeit von Daten über Roche.
Sie werden:

• Stärkung vertrauenswürdiger Datenfundamente durch die Aufrechterhaltung der Dokumentation über Schlüsseldatendomänen, einschließlich der Daten über operationelle, wissenschaftliche und medizinische Angelegenheiten.

• Unterstützung der Datenverwaltung in der Praxis durch Metadatenstandards, Referenzdaten, Zeilenverfolgung, konzeptionelle Datenmodelle und Katalogmanagement.

• Verbesserung der Datenqualität und Wiederverwendung durch einen Beitrag zum Lifecycle Management, zur Qualitätskontrolle und zur Metadatenanreicherung.

• Vernetzen Sie Daten mit Geschäftskontexten, indem Sie die Datenkartierung, -klassifizierung und -modellierung unterstützen, die mit Arbeits- und Prozessmethoden verbunden sind.

• Aktivieren Sie die FAIR-Datenprinzipien, damit Daten über Teams erkennbar, zugänglich, interoperabel und wiederverwendbar sind.

• Zusammenarbeit über Funktionen zur Verbesserung der Sichtbarkeit, Zugänglichkeit und Usability von kritischen Datenvermögen.

• Unterstützung der Compliance und des Vertrauens durch die Anwendung relevanter Datenschutz-, Sicherheits- und regulatorischer Erwartungen, einschließlich der DSGVO und der HIPAA gegebenenfalls.

Wer bist du?
Sie bringen einen durchdachten, detailorientierten Ansatz für die Datenführung und genießen es, komplexe Datenumgebungen in klare, nutzbare und geregelte Vermögenswerte zu verwandeln.
Sie haben:

• Ein Abschluss, eine fortgeschrittene Qualifikation oder ein gleichwertiger praktischer Hintergrund in Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Information Science, Information Management oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Erleben Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit Datenmanagement, Metadatenkuration, Masterdaten oder Daten-Governance in Life Sciences, Healthcare, wissenschaftlichen oder regulierten Umgebungen.

• Vertrautheit mit Werkzeugen oder Ansätzen für Datenleitung, Katalogisierung, Datenqualität, Versionierung oder Master-Datenmanagement.

• Ein Verständnis der FAIR-Datenprinzipien, semantische Modellierung und grundlegende Praktiken der Datenverwaltung.

• Die Fähigkeit, technische Konzepte für verschiedene Publikum klar zu erklären.

• Eine kollaborative Denkweise in Bezug auf unterschiedliche Perspektiven in einem globalen Arbeitsumfeld.

Bevorzugt

• Exposition gegenüber klinischen Operationen, Phase-I-IV-Studien oder wissenschaftlichen/betrieblichen Datenbereichen.

• Erleben Sie einen Beitrag zu agilen Teams, Plattform-Implementierung oder Datenproduktinitiativen.

Bringen Sie Ihre Neugier, Rigour und Pflege für Datenqualität – und helfen Roche, ein zukunftsfähiges Daten-Ökosystem aufzubauen, das bessere Wissenschaft und bessere Ergebnisse für Patienten unterstützt.

Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Welwyn. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung.

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy permet une meilleure prise de décision et la production de preuves dans Roche Product Development, aidant les équipes à utiliser des données cliniques, opérationnelles et réelles pour accélérer le progrès scientifique des patients.

Au sein de la gouvernance et des opérations de données, l'équipe de gestion et de données opérationnelles construit les fondations qui rendent les données fiables, réutilisables et prêtes à l'innovation future.

En tant que délégué aux données, vous vous assurerez que les principaux éléments de données sont documentés, régis et accessibles tout au long du cycle de développement du produit. Vous connecterez les données aux processus opérationnels, supporterez les normes de gestion et d'exploitation des données, et renforcerez la qualité, la convivialité et la fiabilité des données à travers Roche.
Vous:

• Renforcer les bases de données fiables en maintenant la documentation dans les principaux domaines de données, y compris les données d'études opérationnelles, scientifiques et médicales.

• Soutenir la gouvernance des données dans la pratique au moyen de normes de métadonnées, de données de référence, de suivi des lignées, de modèles conceptuels de données et de gestion du catalogue.

• Améliorer la qualité et la réutilisation des données en contribuant à la gestion du cycle de vie, aux contrôles de qualité et à l'enrichissement des métadonnées.

• Relier les données au contexte commercial en appuyant la cartographie, la classification et la modélisation des données liées aux méthodes de travail et aux processus.

• Activer les principes de données FAIR pour que les données soient accessibles, interopérables et réutilisables entre les équipes.

• Collaborer entre les fonctions pour améliorer la visibilité, l'accessibilité et la facilité d'utilisation des données essentielles.

• Soutenir la conformité et la confiance en appliquant les attentes pertinentes en matière de confidentialité, de sécurité et de réglementation, y compris le RGPD et le HIPAA, le cas échéant.

Qui vous êtes
Vous apportez une approche réfléchie et détaillée de la gestion des données et aimez transformer des environnements de données complexes en actifs clairs, utilisables et gouvernés.
Vous avez :

• Un diplôme, une qualification avancée ou une expérience pratique équivalente en Data Science, Bioinformatique, Sciences de la vie, Information Science, Gestion de l'information ou un domaine connexe.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche / GenMark Diagnostics’ mission is to revolutionize patient care by providing high-value, simple-to-perform, and clinically relevant multiplex molecular diagnostics, specifically targeting infectious disease testing. We aim to improve patient outcomes, enhance laboratory efficiency, and reduce total cost-of-care through rapid, sample-to-answer solutions.

Roche/Genmark Diagnostics is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer (Sr. Engineer) to join our team. In this role, the Sr. Engineer will be responsible for defining the requirements for new tooling and part designs to deliver high quality plastic injection molded products in a timely and cost-efficient manner. In addition, the Senior Engineer will collaborate with procurement, quality assurance, quality control, operations, document control teams on validation and verification for injection molding tools. This is a highly visible role; allowing the Sr. Engineer to make an immediate impact within the team.

The Opportunity:

• You will create, review, and execute engineering change process for consumable components

• You will complete assembly and part drawings as well as other required documentation from design concept to manufacturing transfer; you will work with production teams to transfer verified designs into full production using principles of DFM/DFA

• You will technically manage projects by identifying, planning, & scheduling technical activities for successful completions.

• You will participate or lead in failure analyses, First Article Inspections, and test method development.

• You will transfer troubleshooting knowledge to Operations, Production, and Contract Manufacturers as new problems arise; you will interact with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure parts and assemblies can be reliably produced against material specifications.

• You will perform and document feasibility, design, verification, validation, and risk analysis activities under design controls within the new product development process potentially working alongside outsourced partners.

• You will develop test and development strategies and plans of substantial scope and duration that may include coordinating contributors across teams and outsourced partners..

• You will provide engineering and troubleshooting support to assay integration and development teams.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a B.S. in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering (or equivalent area of study) with 5+ years of industry experience; or a Master’s in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering (or equivalent area of study) with 3+ years of industry experience; or or Ph. D. level in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering, (or equivalent area of study) w/ 1+ years of industry experience.

• You have demonstrated experience with the engineering change control process, including technical report documentation, quality document management, and validation and verification activities.

• You have demonstrated experience with CAD (SolidWorks preferred), including drafting to ASME Y14.5 and GD&T standards.

• You have demonstrated experience in the design, DFM, and production of injection molded plastics, including rapid prototyping, prototype molding, and multi-cavity production molds.

• You are highly skilled at developing and sustaining medical or in-vitro diagnostics consumables and instrumentation working within an ISO 13485/GMP compliant environment.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, 94,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. We believe every employee makes a difference. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action, we believe that good business means a better world.

You will provide strategic leadership and management to the Cell & Gene Therapy Quality Systems organization within PTQC. Accountable for the establishment and Quality oversight of the global tools, processes and procedures specific to Cell & Gene Therapy. Ensure the Quality tools, processes and procedures used in PTC are fit for purpose, GxP compliant and support Clinical development timelines as well as future commercial launch.

The Opportunity:

• You will partner with senior leadership to set the strategic direction and ensure alignment with Roche Quality and business strategies, developing and maintaining strong collaborations with internal and external partners .

• You will provide quality expertise and oversight for IT tools, business processes, and GxP procedures used by the PTC unit, ensuring they are phase-appropriate and fit for purpose for Cell & Gene Therapy production .

• You will liaise with production activities, including Apheresis collection, AAV plasmid production, Drug Substance/Product manufacturing, analytics, and shipment to treatment centers .

• You will coordinate work across systems, functions, and sites to harmonize workflow and optimize cross-functional team member participation .

• You will lead the development, review, and revision of SOPs and procedural documents, and collaborate on updating curricula based on determined training needs .

• You will monitor the implementation and effectiveness of systems, create Quality Management Review metrics, and foster continuous quality improvement and procedural simplification .

• You will support internal and external audits, manage deviations and complaints, provide timely support and author responses for Health Authority interactions, and ensure pragmatic, patient-centered problem solving .

Who you are :

• You will have a Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in a Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or related science discipline.

• You will possess over 10 years of experience in the Pharma/Biopharmaceutical industry, specifically with ATMPs manufacturing, with experience in aseptic operations, Biologics, or analytics being an advantage.

• You will apply strong knowledge of GxP regulations to clinical and commercial products to ensure patient safety and the appropriate level of compliance.

• You will manage ambiguity through effective communication, skillfully removing barriers, and overcoming resistance.

• You will operate autonomously and manage complex situations by successfully coordinating multiple tasks and prioritizing them to deliver optimum results.

• You will demonstrate high integrity and accountability, ensuring your team's actions and decisions are aligned with business objectives.

**Relocation benefits not available for this position**
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 136,936.00 and 179,728.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.

As the Recruiting Lead, Operations & Quality (US), this is your moment to shape how Roche & Genentech brings the deep and exceptional talent into our US operations & quality functions, powering our next chapter of growth. We are at the threshold of exciting strategic expansions in the US, and we need a recruiting leader who thrives in delivering fit-for-purpose talent acquisition strategies that give our business a competitive edge. You will lead a high-impact team of Talent Acquisition Partners (TAPs) in a fluid, networked environment, balancing global consistency with the local agility needed to win in this competitive and critical market. This is a role for a transformational leader, relentlessly inspiring high performance in your team, and continuously raising the bar of excellence.

The Opportunity:

• Mentor and coach a dedicated community of TAPs, elevating the recruiting team to a high-performing advisory group that consistently delivers value through strategic partnership and talent advisory.

• Continuously strive to enable the team by removing barriers, building high-value capabilities, influencing change adoption, accelerating learning, and empowering high performance.

• Move beyond reactive hiring by partnering with functional and geographic senior leaders to ensure proactive recruitment strategies that align directly with our business priorities.

• Turn market insights and hiring data into a competitive advantage, utilizing analytics to drive smarter sourcing and innovative solutions for complex talent gaps across the US Operations & Quality network.

• Ensure our global recruiting standards are upheld while having the autonomy to localize strategies that resonate within the US market.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent on-the-job training / experience gained work experience (6+ years)

• You bring 6+ years of Human Resources/ Recruiting experience

• Previous senior stakeholder management, coaching experience, and demonstrated leadership capabilitie s

Preferred:

• Transformational leadership; Demonstrated experience leading teams through strategic change

• Proven ability to elevate team performance

• Prior experience partnering with senior leadership and successfully recruiting executive level roles (vice presidents, senior directors, etc.)

• Previous recruitment experience with strong business acumen and ideally at senior level

• Experience developing broad and deep recruitment strategies

This will be a campus-based role.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis is 135,800.00 - 252,200.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. We serve our patients through external partnerships because access to quality products is every patient’s right. We leverage external partners in order to offer flexibility to our internal capacity at the right cost and quality. We enable our external partners to reliably deliver compliant, quality products to our supply chain customers, so that we can deliver to patients worldwide. We do this through cross-functional collaborations ensuring quality process excellence and continuous improvement.

The Network Quality Assurance Manager will be a senior and integral part of the Network QA organization, reporting directly to the Network QA Lead. This role is crucial for maintaining stringent quality assurance standards and ensuring the safety, efficacy, and reliability of our products. As our portfolio and network become increasingly diverse and complex, the role of QA oversight is essential to protect patient safety, minimize risks, and maintain the company’s reputation and operational integrity.

The Opportunity:

• You will lead global cross- chapter initiatives for continuous improvement and standardizes QA decision-making processes globally.

• Foster alignment between Site Quality Assurance Heads in defining and implementing Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) based on audit findings and quality issues, ensuring timely and effective resolution across all sites.

• Drive the oversight, identification, and assessment of QA-related high-risk issues in all PT manufacturing sites and create risk mitigation strategies and execute corrective actions.

• Be able to support local functions with compliance , technical issues/ counterfeit investigation and ability to effectively communicate with Health Authorities

• Develop strategies to address and mitigate issues effectively, providing comprehensive data and insights, advising the senior decision-makers.

• Collaborate with senior leadership to implement global strategic and operational guidance on quality oversight, executing strategies in alignment with the PT strategy.

• Take an active role in conducting comprehensive risk assessments for manufacturing processes, proactively identify potential quality risks, and devise strategic mitigation plans in close collaboration with senior leadership.

• Act as liaison between global and local QA team to ensure teamwork in aligning on issues.

​
Who You Are:

• Strategic Foundation: Possess an advanced degree (BA/BS/MS or equivalent) in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Engineering, or Chemistry, serving as a critical base for complex decision-making.

• Extensive Industry Impact: Over 12-15 years of progressive, high-impact experience across the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry, specifically integrating manufacturing, quality, and supply chain functions to drive holistic business outcomes.

• Operational Excellence & Influence: Demonstrated mastery in quality assurance, quality control, and manufacturing operations, evidenced by a verifiable track record of architecting and implementing system-wide efficiency and compliance improvements.

• Global Matrix Leadership: Exceptional and proven matrix leadership capabilities, adept at navigating complex, multicultural, and virtual environments to effectively lead people and business units through significant change and transformation initiatives.

• Risk and Regulatory Authority: Deep and authoritative understanding of global qu

The PO is responsible for defining and implementing the overall Technology strategy for PT Quality, acting as the Global Product Owner for applicable PT technologies. A core function of the role is translating complex business use cases and requirements into standardized, compliant technology solutions, requiring a blend of technical expertise and business acumen. The PO collaborates with cross-functional teams, including Business, IT, and Validation, to ensure that high-quality, innovative solutions are defined, developed, and implemented. The role also involves managing the global master data entity and assisting the organization with expertise during regulatory inspections and the resolution of deviations.

This position requires a collaborative and open-minded individual who is capable of maintaining and transforming integral technologies while valuing continuous learning. The successful candidate must be someone who thoughtfully challenges ideas, prioritizes impactful work, and can be relied upon to operate in the best interest of the team, thriving in a dynamic work environment.

The Opportunity:

• You will standardize and optimize the systems and technology powering Quality operations and data insights.

• You will translate complex business use cases and project requirements into standardized technology solutions.

• You will serve as the Global Product Owner or sub-product owner for applicable technologies used in Pharma Technical Operations (PT).

• You will lead the lifecycle management for multiple products and systems, including upgrades, replacement, and retirement of computerized systems.

• You will manage system enhancement features, act as the Business Data Steward for data governance, and drive continuous improvement opportunities.

• You will drive the product vision, roadmap, and development lifecycle.

• You will provide in-depth global subject matter expertise and support the implementation of fit-for-purpose innovative solutions while ensuring GxP

​
Who you are :

• You will have Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Science, Computer Science, a related field, or an equivalent technical/vocational qualification.

• Demonstrated proficiency in the Software Development Lifecycle is essential.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

Tu Perfil:

• Título universitario o técnico en Electrónica, Mecánica o áreas afines.

• Experiencia de al menos 3 años en funciones similares o 2 años en manejo de plataformas Roche.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio.

• Manejo de herramientas Office a nivel intermedio.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Functional Consultant – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

We are seeking an SAP EWM/ TM Functional Consultant to join our team supporting a highly complex, customized SAP solution. This role is ideal for a consultant who thrives in technically challenging environments and is passionate about deep-dive problem-solving and continuous learning. We are looking for a consultant who is not intimidated by complexity but energized by it. This role requires someone who views a non-standard solution as an intellectual challenge rather than an obstacle, and who sees continuous learning as a core part of the job.

The Opportunity

• Provide functional consulting and support for our bespoke SAP solution with extensive custom developments

• Analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize complex business processes in the supply chain and logistics space

• Collaborate with development and technical teams to understand non-standard functionality and custom implementations

• Drive system enhancements, testing, and deployment activities in a GxP context

• Deal with uncertainty and make decisions at the product level with guidance from a more senior member. Provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems.

• Primarily interact within product teams, squads, and across the Product Line as applicable. Interacts directly with stakeholders on small to medium engagements. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions within product teams and clearly communicates the impact of their own work in the context of business needs.

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement

Who you are:

• Hands-on experience with SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• General understanding of SAP Transportation Management (TM) concepts and integration points

• Working knowledge of BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) and its application in custom developments

• Familiarity with BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call) functionality

• Experience supporting complex, non-standard SAP solutions with custom code

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively across technical and functional teams

• Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work effectively across technical and functional teams

• Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn new concepts and technologies quickly

Nice to have:

• German language skills (written and spoken)

• Experience with SAP ABAP or custom object development

• Experience in the Pharmaceutical environment following GxP guidelines

• Familiarity with change management and process improvement methodologies

• Familiarity with agile methodologies like SAFe

• Basic to intermediate level of business process domain knowledge in supply chain

What you get:

• Salary range 10,000 - 18,000 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 12%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private heal
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Consulente funzionale – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

Stiamo cercando un consulente funzionale SAP EWM/TM per unire il nostro team supportando una soluzione SAP altamente complessa e personalizzata. Questo ruolo è ideale per un consulente che prospera in ambienti tecnicamente impegnativi ed è appassionato di deep-dive problem-solving e apprendimento continuo. Siamo alla ricerca di un consulente che non è intimidito dalla complessità ma stimolato da esso. Questo ruolo richiede qualcuno che vede una soluzione non standard come una sfida intellettuale piuttosto che un ostacolo, e che vede l'apprendimento continuo come una parte fondamentale del lavoro.

L'opportunità

• Fornire consulenza e supporto funzionali per la nostra soluzione SAP su misura con ampi sviluppi personalizzati

• Analizzare, risolvere i problemi e ottimizzare i processi aziendali complessi nella supply chain e nello spazio logistico

• Collaborare con team di sviluppo e tecnici per comprendere funzionalità non standard e implementazioni personalizzate

• Miglioramento del sistema di trasmissione, test e attività di distribuzione in un contesto GxP

• Affrontare l'incertezza e prendere decisioni a livello del prodotto con la guida di un membro più anziano. Fornisce soluzioni a una vasta gamma di problemi difficili.

• Interagire principalmente all'interno di team di prodotti, squadre e attraverso la linea di prodotto come applicabile. Interagisce direttamente con le parti interessate su piccoli o medi impegni. Comunica informazioni, problemi e potenziali soluzioni all'interno dei team di prodotti e comunica chiaramente l'impatto del proprio lavoro nel contesto delle esigenze aziendali.

• Viaggiare in Svizzera come necessario per il supporto in loco, workshop e impegno dei clienti

Chi sei:

• Esperienza pratica con SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• Comprensione generale dei concetti e dei punti di integrazione SAP Transportation Management (TM)

• Conoscenze di lavoro di BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) e la sua applicazione negli sviluppi personalizzati

• Familiarità con funzionalità BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call)

• Esperienza di soluzioni SAP complesse e non standard con codice personalizzato

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di navigare ambiguità

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team tecnici e funzionali

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team tecnici e funzionali

• Volontà e capacità dimostrata di apprendere rapidamente nuovi concetti e tecnologie

Bello da avere:

• competenze linguistiche tedesche (scritte e parlate)

• Esperienza con SAP ABAP o sviluppo di oggetti personalizzati

• Esperienza nell'ambiente farmaceutico seguendo le linee guida GxP

• Familiarità con la gestione dei cambiamenti e metodologie di miglioramento dei processi

• Familiarità con metodologie agili come SAFe

• Livello base a livello intermedio di conoscenza del dominio del processo aziendale nella catena di fornitura

Che cosa si ottiene:

• Salario range 10.000 - 18.000 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.

• Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 12%).

• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).

• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).

• Prendere il programma di tempo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).

• Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile.

• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).

• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).

• Cura privata
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position

Functional Consultant – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

Wir suchen einen SAP EWM/ TM Functional Consultant, um mit unserem Team eine hochkomplexe, maßgeschneiderte SAP-Lösung zu unterstützen. Diese Rolle ist ideal für einen Berater, der in technisch anspruchsvollen Umgebungen lebt und leidenschaftlich über tiefgehende Problemlösung und kontinuierliches Lernen ist. Wir suchen einen Berater, der nicht durch Komplexität eingeschüchtert, sondern von ihm eingeschüchtert wird. Diese Rolle erfordert jemanden, der eine nicht standardisierte Lösung als intellektuelle Herausforderung betrachtet, anstatt als Hindernis, und der ständiges Lernen als Kernteil der Arbeit sieht.

Die Chance

• Bereitstellung von funktioneller Beratung und Unterstützung unserer maßgeschneiderten SAP-Lösung mit umfangreichen kundenspezifischen Entwicklungen

• Analyse, Fehlersuche und Optimierung komplexer Geschäftsprozesse in der Lieferkette und Logistik

• Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungs- und technischen Teams, um nicht-Standard-Funktionalität und kundenspezifische Implementierungen zu verstehen

• Antriebssystemerweiterungen, Tests und Bereitstellungsaktivitäten in einem GxP-Kontext

• Umgang mit Unsicherheit und Entscheidungen auf der Produktebene mit Anleitung von einem höheren Mitglied. Bietet Lösungen für eine breite Palette von schwierigen Problemen.

• Grundsätzlich interagieren innerhalb von Produktteams, Teams und über die Produktlinie. Interagiert direkt mit Interessenvertretern über kleine bis mittlere Engagements. Kommuniziert Informationen, Probleme und potenzielle Lösungen innerhalb von Produktteams und kommuniziert eindeutig die Auswirkungen ihrer eigenen Arbeit im Kontext der geschäftlichen Bedürfnisse.

• Reisen in die Schweiz nach Bedarf für Unterstützung vor Ort, Workshops und Kundenbindung

Wer du bist:

• Hand-on-Erfahrung mit SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• Allgemeines Verständnis von SAP Transportation Management (TM) Konzepten und Integrationspunkten

• Arbeitswissen von BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) und dessen Anwendung in kundenspezifischen Entwicklungen

• Vertrautheit mit BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call) Funktionalität

• Erleben Sie komplexe, nicht standardisierte SAP-Lösungen mit benutzerdefiniertem Code

• Starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Mehrdeutigkeit zu navigieren

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und effektives Arbeiten in technischen und funktionalen Teams

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch und die Fähigkeit, effektiv über technische und funktionale Teams zu arbeiten

• Bereitschaft und demonstrierte Fähigkeit, neue Konzepte und Technologien schnell zu lernen

Schön zu haben:

• Deutschkenntnisse (schriftlich und gesprochen)

• Erfahrung mit SAP ABAP oder benutzerdefinierter Objektentwicklung

• Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Umgebung nach GxP-Richtlinien

• Vertrautheit mit Change Management und Prozessverbesserung Methoden

• Vertrautheit mit agilen Methoden wie SAFe

• Grundlegende bis mittleres Niveau des Business-Process-Domain-Wissens in der Lieferkette

Was Sie bekommen:

• Salary Bereich 10.000 - 18.000 PLN brutto auf der Grundlage des Arbeitsvertrags.

• Jährliche Bonuszahlung auf Basis Ihrer Leistung (Ziel 12%).

• Dediziertes Ausbildungsbudget (Ausbildung, Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen, diversifizierte Karrierewege usw.).

• Freitagserneuerung (2 Freitage pro Quartal verfügbar).

• Nehmen Sie Zeit Programm (bis zu 3 Monate Urlaub zu jedem Zweck zu verwenden).

• Urlaubszuschüsse verfügbar.

• Flex Location (Möglichkeit, unsere Arbeit von verschiedenen Orten der Welt für einen bestimmten Zeitraum durchzuführen).

• Nehmen Sie Zeit für Charity (zusätzliche bezahlte Urlaub von maximal 2 Wochen, um sich in die Wohltätigkeitsaktion Ihrer Wahl zu engagieren).

• Private Heilung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Consultant fonctionnel – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

Nous recherchons un conseiller fonctionnel SAP EWM/TM pour rejoindre notre équipe en soutenant une solution SAP hautement complexe et personnalisée. Ce rôle est idéal pour un consultant qui prospère dans des environnements techniquement difficiles et qui est passionné par la résolution profonde de problèmes et l'apprentissage continu. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un consultant qui ne soit pas intimidé par la complexité mais stimulé par elle. Ce rôle exige une personne qui considère une solution non standard comme un défi intellectuel plutôt qu'un obstacle, et qui considère l'apprentissage continu comme une partie essentielle du travail.

L'opportunité

• Fournir des conseils fonctionnels et un soutien pour notre solution SAP sur mesure avec des développements personnalisés étendus

• Analyser, dépanner et optimiser les processus complexes de la chaîne logistique

• Collaborer avec les équipes de développement et techniques pour comprendre les fonctionnalités non standard et les implémentations personnalisées

• Conduire les améliorations du système, les essais et les activités de déploiement dans un contexte GxP

• Traiter l'incertitude et prendre des décisions au niveau du produit avec l'aide d'un membre plus âgé. Fournit des solutions à un large éventail de problèmes difficiles.

• Principalement interagir au sein des équipes de produits, des équipes et de toute la gamme de produits, selon le cas. Interagit directement avec les intervenants sur les engagements de petite à moyenne taille. Communique l'information, les enjeux et les solutions possibles au sein des équipes de produits et communique clairement l'impact de leur propre travail dans le contexte des besoins opérationnels.

• Voyage en Suisse selon les besoins pour l'appui sur place, les ateliers et l'engagement des clients

Qui vous êtes :

• Expérience pratique avec SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• Compréhension générale des concepts et des points d'intégration SAP Transportation Management (TM)

• Connaissance pratique du BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) et de son application dans les développements personnalisés

• Familiarité avec la fonctionnalité BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call)

• Expérience supportant des solutions SAP complexes et non standard avec code personnalisé

• Fortes compétences en analyse et résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de naviguer l'ambiguïté

• Excellentes compétences en communication et aptitude à travailler efficacement entre les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles

• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et capacité de travailler efficacement entre les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles

• Volonté et aptitude démontrée à apprendre rapidement de nouveaux concepts et technologies

Sympa d'avoir:

• Compétences linguistiques en allemand (écrit et parlé)

• Expérience avec SAP ABAP ou développement d'objets personnalisés

• Expérience dans l'environnement pharmaceutique suivant les directives GxP

• Connaissance des méthodes de gestion du changement et d'amélioration des processus

• Familiarité avec les méthodologies agiles comme SAFe

• Niveau de base à intermédiaire des connaissances du domaine des processus opérationnels dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement

Ce que vous obtenez:

• Salaires compris entre 10 000 et 18 000 PLN brut sur la base du contrat de travail.

• Paiement de bonus annuel en fonction de votre performance (objectif 12%).

• Budget dédié à la formation (formation, certifications, conférences, parcours professionnels diversifiés, etc.).

• Recharger les vendredis (2 vendredis par trimestre disponibles).

• Prendre du temps Programme (jusqu'à 3 mois de congé à utiliser à n'importe quelle fin).

• Allocations de vacances disponibles.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Digital Insights
Location: Seoul, South Korea

The role involves developing and executing digital sales strategies to achieve revenue targets, managing sales forecasting and reporting, and leading the virtual team in value-based selling. Key responsibilities also include building and maintaining customer relationships, understanding market needs, and conducting competitive analysis. The role requires strong cross-functional collaboration with customer areas and digital marketing.

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor's degree or higher in relevant fields, 5+ years of B2B software solution sales experience. A deep understanding of modern software sales methodologies (SaaS, cloud, subscription models) and the diagnostics industry or healthcare IT is plus. The role seeks a leader with a passion for digital transformation in healthcare, who can set challenging targets, and drive results through strong communication and collaboration.

Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Sales Strategy

• Develop and Execute Digital Sales Strategy: Formulate digital sales strategies aligned with our digital product goals, translating market analysis, customer segmentation, and competitive insights into concrete action plans.

• Achieve Revenue Targets: Take primary responsibility for achieving the divisional revenue quotas, leading and supporting pipeline management, opportunity generation, and contract closures.

• Sales Forecasting & Reporting: Conduct accurate sales forecasting and provide regular performance analysis and reports to maximize sales activity efficiency.

• Value-Based Selling: Understand customer business challenges and lead the virtual team in formulating strategies to convincingly communicate the business value (e.g., ROI, efficiency gains, improved patient outcomes) our software solutions offer.

2. Customer Relationship & Market Insight

• Build Key Customer Relationships: Establish and maintain strategic relationships with key customers and stakeholders, strengthening partnerships for long-term customer success.

• Understand Customer Needs: Keenly observe evolving customer needs and digital transformation trends in the diagnostics industry, incorporating these insights into product development and sales strategies.

• Competitive Analysis: Develop strategies that maximize the unique strengths of our products based on a deep understanding of competing software solutions in the market.

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with relevant Customer Areas: Work closely with related Customer Areas like Core Lab, Pathology Lab and so on to effectively convey digital value to customers and support complex solution sales.

• Partner with Digital Marketing: Collaborate with the marketing team to plan lead generation activities and brand awareness campaigns that support sales efforts.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biotechnology, Medical Informatics, or a related field.

• 5+ years of B2B software solution sales experience.

• Deep understanding and experience with modern software sales methodologies, including SaaS, cloud solutions, and subscription models.

• In-depth understanding of the diagnostics industry or healthcare IT, including relevant experience (e.g., LIS, EMR integration) is preferred.

• Proven experience successfully managing and leading complex, long sales cycles.

• Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

• Da
