descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about using the power of communications to drive meaninful policy change?
As part of the External Engagement Centre of Excellence within Group Communications, you will join a high-impact team dedicated to leveraging strategic communications tactics to drive meaningful policy change and reinforce Roche’s reputation as a leader in access. This isn't just a strategy role; we are looking for a hands-on builder who moves at the speed of the external world and can translate complex access and policy challenges into bold, persuasive campaigns.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Policy Communications, you will act as a trusted communications advisor and strategic thought partner to the Pharma Global Access Leadership team and Policy teams.

• Narrative & Content Development: Develop compelling public narratives and unified messaging to ensure Roche speaks with a consistent, powerful voice on critical policy topics.

• Communications Strategy Development & Execution: Design and deliver end-to-end communication strategies across digital channels, thought leadership, and media engagement in support of Roche’s policy and access priorities

• Global Presence: Drive Roche’s digital and physical presence at selected global policy and access events

• Reputation Protection: Proactively monitor emerging issues, maintain communication preparedness to mitigate risks and manage issues across sensitive access and policy topics.

• Measuring Success: Establish clear KPIs to track and report the tangible results of external communication tactics

Who you are
You are a strategic thinker who isn't afraid to get your hands dirty in execution. You thrive in multicultural, matrixed environments and possess the business acumen to navigate complex healthcare topics with ease.
Your Experience & Skills:

• Education: Master’s degree from a leading university in a relevant field (e.g. Politics, History, Business, Communications)

• Track Record: 10+ years of experience in policy, public affairs, or communications, with a proven ability to execute integrated campaigns across multiple channels.

• Industry Savvy: Deep experience in the healthcare industry and a strong understanding of the fast-paced external environment impacting our industry

• Communication Mastery: Exceptional writing and presentation skills in English; proficiency in German is an advantage.

• Collaborative Influence: Strong networking skills with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across a global matrix organization.

• Adaptability: The ability to prioritize a high workload in a changing environment, with a willingness to travel up to 20%

We look forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Sei appassionato di usare il potere delle comunicazioni per guidare cambiamenti politici meschini?
Nell’ambito del Centro di Engagement Esterni di Eccellenza all’interno delle Comunicazioni di Gruppo, vi unirete ad un team ad alto impatto dedicato a sfruttare le tattiche di comunicazione strategica per guidare cambiamenti politici significativi e rafforzare la reputazione di Roche come leader nell’accesso. Questo non è solo un ruolo di strategia; stiamo cercando un costruttore pratico che si muove alla velocità del mondo esterno e può tradurre complesse sfide di accesso e di politica in campagne audaci e persuasive.

L'opportunità

Segnalandosi al capo delle comunicazioni politiche, si agirà come consulente di comunicazione di fiducia e partner di pensiero strategico per il team di Pharma Global Access Leadership e Policy team.

• Narrative & Content Development: Sviluppare narrazioni pubbliche convincenti e messaggi unificati per garantire che Roche parli con una voce coerente e potente su argomenti politici critici.

• Communications Strategy Development & Execution: Progettare e fornire strategie di comunicazione end-to-end attraverso i canali digitali, la leadership del pensiero e l’impegno dei media a sostegno della politica di Roche e delle priorità di accesso

• Presenza globale: guidare la presenza digitale e fisica di Roche in una politica globale selezionata e eventi di accesso

• Protezione della reputazione: monitorare attivamente i problemi emergenti, mantenere la preparazione della comunicazione per mitigare i rischi e gestire i problemi attraverso temi sensibili di accesso e politica.

• Misura del successo: Stabilire i KPI chiari per monitorare e segnalare i risultati tangibili delle tattiche di comunicazione esterna

Chi sei
Sei un pensatore strategico che non ha paura di sporcarsi le mani in esecuzione. Tu prosperi in ambienti multiculturali, matrici e possiedi l'acum aziendale per navigare argomenti sanitari complessi con facilità.
La tua esperienza e competenze:

• Istruzione: laurea magistrale da un'università leader in un campo rilevante (ad esempio Politica, Storia, Affari, Comunicazioni)

• Track Record: 10+ anni di esperienza nella politica, negli affari pubblici o nelle comunicazioni, con una comprovata capacità di eseguire campagne integrate su più canali.

• Industria Savvy: Profonda esperienza nel settore sanitario e una forte comprensione dell'ambiente esterno veloce che colpisce il nostro settore

• Mastery di comunicazione: competenze di scrittura e presentazione eccezionali in inglese; la competenza in tedesco è un vantaggio.

• Influenza collaborativa: competenze di networking forti con la capacità di costruire relazioni e influenzare gli stakeholder in un'organizzazione di matrice globale.

• Adaptability: La capacità di priorizzare un alto carico di lavoro in un ambiente in evoluzione, con la volontà di viaggiare fino al 20%

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran, die Macht der Kommunikation zu nutzen, um einen mittleren politischen Wandel zu bewirken?
Im Rahmen des externen Engagement Centre of Excellence in Group Communications werden Sie sich einem hocheffizienten Team anschließen, das sich darauf spezialisiert hat, strategische Kommunikationstaktiken zu nutzen, um einen sinnvollen politischen Wandel voranzutreiben und den Ruf von Roche als Marktführer zu stärken. Dies ist nicht nur eine Strategierolle; wir suchen einen Hand-on-Builder, der sich mit der Geschwindigkeit der Außenwelt bewegt und komplexe Zugriffs- und politische Herausforderungen in mutige, überzeugende Kampagnen übersetzen kann.

Die Chance

Sie werden als vertrauenswürdiger Kommunikationsberater und strategischer Denkpartner des Pharma Global Access Leadership Teams und Policy Teams fungieren.

• Narrative & Content Entwicklung: Entwickeln Sie überzeugende öffentliche Erzählungen und einheitliche Messaging, um sicherzustellen, dass Roche mit einer konsequenten, leistungsfähigen Stimme zu kritischen politischen Themen spricht.

• Communications Strategy Development & Execution: Design und Bereitstellung von End-to-End-Kommunikationsstrategien über digitale Kanäle, Gedankenführung und das Medienengagement von Roche zur Unterstützung von Politik- und Zugangsprioritäten

• Global Presence: Die digitale und physische Präsenz von Roche bei ausgewählten globalen Politik- und Zugriffsereignissen

• Reputation Protection: Proaktiv die aufstrebenden Probleme zu überwachen, die Kommunikationsbereitschaft beizubehalten, Risiken zu mindern und Probleme in sensiblen Zugangs- und Politikthemen zu bewältigen.

• Erfolgsmessung: Stellen Sie klare Kennzahlen fest, um die greifbaren Ergebnisse externer Kommunikationstaktiken zu verfolgen und zu berichten

Wer bist du?
Sie sind ein strategischer Denker, der keine Angst hat, Ihre Hände schmutzig in der Ausführung zu bekommen. Sie blühen in multikulturellen, Matrix-Umgebungen und besitzen das Geschäft, um komplexe Gesundheitsthemen mit Leichtigkeit zu navigieren.
Ihre Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten:

• Ausbildung: Masterstudium an einer führenden Universität in einem relevanten Bereich (z.B. Politik, Geschichte, Wirtschaft, Kommunikation)

• Track Record: 10 Jahre Erfahrung in Politik, öffentlichen Angelegenheiten oder Kommunikation, mit einer bewährten Fähigkeit, integrierte Kampagnen über mehrere Kanäle auszuführen.

• Industry Savvy: Tiefe Erfahrung in der Gesundheitsbranche und ein starkes Verständnis der schnelllebigen externen Umwelt, die unsere Branche beeinflusst

• Communication Mastery: Außergewöhnliche Schreib- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Vorteil.

• Collaborative Influence: Starke Netzwerkfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Beziehungen aufzubauen und Stakeholder in einer globalen Matrix-Organisation zu beeinflussen.

• Anpassungsfähigkeit: Die Fähigkeit, eine hohe Arbeitsbelastung in einer sich verändernden Umgebung zu priorisieren, mit einer Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 20%

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben.

Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft.

Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Êtes-vous passionné par l'utilisation du pouvoir de communication pour provoquer un changement de politique significatif?
Dans le cadre du Centre d'excellence pour l'engagement externe au sein des communications de groupe, vous vous joindrez à une équipe à fort impact qui s'emploiera à mettre à profit les tactiques de communication stratégiques pour susciter un changement de politique significatif et renforcer la réputation de Roches en tant que chef de file en matière d'accès. Ce n'est pas seulement un rôle stratégique; nous cherchons un constructeur pratique qui se déplace à la vitesse du monde extérieur et peut traduire des défis complexes d'accès et de politique en campagnes audacieuses et convaincantes.

L'opportunité

Sous l'autorité du chef des Communications en matière de politiques, vous agirez à titre de conseiller en communication de confiance et de partenaire de réflexion stratégique auprès de l'équipe de leadership Pharma Global Access et des équipes de politiques.

• Narratif et développement du contenu : Développer des récits publics convaincants et des messages unifiés pour assurer que Roche parle avec une voix cohérente et puissante sur des sujets politiques critiques.

• Développement et exécution de la stratégie de communication : concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de communication de bout en bout à travers les canaux numériques, le leadership de la pensée et l'engagement des médias à l'appui de la politique de Roche et des priorités d'accès

• Présence mondiale: la présence numérique et physique de Roches lors de certaines politiques mondiales et événements d'accès

• Protection de la réputation : Surveiller de manière proactive les nouveaux enjeux, maintenir la préparation à la communication pour atténuer les risques et gérer les enjeux sur des sujets d'accès et de politique sensibles.

• Mesurer le succès : établir des IPC clairs pour suivre et signaler les résultats tangibles des tactiques de communication externe

Qui vous êtes
Vous êtes un penseur stratégique qui n'a pas peur de vous salir les mains en exécution. Vous vous développez dans des environnements multiculturels et matriciaux et possédez l'aumône d'affaires pour naviguer facilement sur des sujets de santé complexes.
Votre expérience et vos compétences :

• Éducation : Maîtrise d'une université de premier plan dans un domaine pertinent (politique, histoire, affaires, communication, etc.)

• Track Record : plus de 10 ans d'expérience dans les politiques, les affaires publiques ou les communications, avec une capacité éprouvée d'exécuter des campagnes intégrées sur plusieurs canaux.

• Industrie Savvy: Une expérience approfondie dans le secteur de la santé et une bonne compréhension de l'environnement extérieur à rythme rapide qui affecte notre industrie

• Maîtrise de la communication : compétences exceptionnelles en écriture et présentation en anglais ; la maîtrise de l'allemand est un avantage.

• Influence de la collaboration : Compétences solides en matière de mise en réseau avec la capacité d'établir des relations et d'influencer les parties prenantes dans une organisation matricielle mondiale.

• Adaptabilité : la capacité de prioriser une charge de travail élevée dans un environnement en évolution, avec une volonté de voyager jusqu'à 20%

Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature!

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
For over 60 years, Roche has been guided by a profound vision: a future where cancer can be cured. 22.8 million people have been treated with Roche cancer therapy as of 2025. We have had nearly 30 New Molecular Entities (NMEs) approved in our oncology and haematology portfolio. We are committed to developing innovative medicines and diagnostic solutions that help prevent, stop and cure cancer.

Leading with bold moves, while grounded in science and experience, our focus is on turning scientific breakthroughs into better outcomes for people with cancer, healthcare systems and society. We are aiming to deliver seven new transformative cancer medicines by the end of the decade, for those that need them most. To help us achieve this vision we are looking for a dedicated Breast Cancer Specialist Representative to join our dynamic team. If you have a proven track record working in the pharmaceutical industry and a passion for the area of Breast Cancer then we want you to be a part of our success story.

As a Breast Cancer Patient Journey Partner (PJP) , you will play a pivotal role in promoting our exciting portfolio of Breast Cancer treatments to healthcare professionals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key Breast Cancer stakeholders, including oncologist and other respective healthcare professionals/practice staff, to create meaningful solutions that improve patient outcomes.

The territory will focus on key Breast Cancer accounts across NSW and the ACT.

What you will be working on:
You will independently manage territory metrics and targets, showing resilience and confidence when challenging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). You will work with your team to advance customers through the adoption ladder, drive market growth to meet our patient-focused goals, and contribute to the development of pioneering therapies. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive adoption of our Breast Cancer products with healthcare providers across NSW and the ACT.

• Develop and execute territory plans to maximise opportunities to create value for our stakeholders and for Roche to and meet our goals

• Build strong, long-term relationships with oncologist and other healthcare professionals

• Review customer engagement metrics to optimise communication channels ensuring regular engagement with target customers through face to face meetings, virtual calls, dinner presentation meetings, clinic/practice luncheons and participation in industry events

• Provide expert knowledge on the clinical data and benefits of our treatment

• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams (marketing, medical etc) to drive business growth and great customer experience

• Monitor and analyse territory performance, market trends and competitor activity to adjust strategies/tactics to improve outcomes

• Gather valuable insights from customers and effectively communicate them to the internal team to help validate and define our strategic initiatives.

• Adhere to company policies and industry regulations, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and ethics.

Who you are:
You are someone who demonstrates a passion for patient outcomes, enterprise-level thinking, and an entrepreneurial mindset with an excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical industry. You have:

• 5+ years or equivalent level of experience as a specialist pharmaceutical representative or in similar capacity

• In-depth knowledge of the healthcare system

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Medical Enabler is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key customers over a meaningful period of time, the medical enabler will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure increased partnership value in our key disease areas.

What you will be working on:
The role of the medical enabler is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio. As a Medical Enabler you will contribute towards:

Offer Medical Expertise:

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

Proactive Customer Engagement :

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The medical enabler serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging Therapeutic Area Experts, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles

• Medical enablership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations with TAEs. Provide current, high-quality Medical Education and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement based on differentiating evidence and experience.

• Insight Generation: Based on aligned goals of the team, the medical enabler should systematically collect, analyze, and translate external scientific and clinical practice insights (including patient perspectives) into strategic actionable and differentiating recommendations for the team.

License to operate & Operational Excellence :

• Adherence to Standards: Ensure all medical activities, including customer engagements, research projects, and material co-creation, are executed in line with company policies, procedures, and the highest compliance standards. This includes strict adherence to corporate policies, ethical behaviour, local regulatory requirements as well as Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP).

Evidence Generation (Module Evidence Generation):

• Integrated Evidence Planning: Contribute to the local integrated evidence plan (IEP), putting forward a comprehensive local evidence gap analysis of required value narratives for the diverse set of healthcare system stakeholders, patients and

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job
Clinical Trial Document Preparation and Archiving
·Be familiar with the content of clinical trial master file and
investigator site file based on the requirements of ICH GCP, China regulation
and Roche SOPs, guidance.
·Support to prepare site file before study start up
·Review the closed clinical trial documents, support archiving
responsible to arrange and archive them according to related SOP requirements.

Business Support to Department
·Understand ICH GCP, China GCP and related regulation on clinical trials.
·Support SSUS to prepare the essential EC submission package according to
required timeline.
·Support SSUS on site budget and contract preparation.
·Maintains and analyzes study data (metrics) on assigned studies. Support
PDG China to identify opportunities for continuous improvement
·Update and maintain the data in CDE platform according to regulatory and
SOP requirements.
·Support local clinical operation data cleaning and management

General Office Duties
·Provide general office support to PDG China department staff (including
but not limited to photocopying, distributing mail/faxes, scanning, faxing,).
·Organize courier services for documents/ goods pick-up.
·Help to arrange meetings or meeting logistics
·Perform other tasks, as assigned by line manager

Qualification and Experience

Education/
• Qualifications
·Bachelor degree or above
·Major in public health, data science, computer science, pharmacy,
biology or related

Personality
·Good ownership and focus on details
·Logical and efficient with highly compliance
·Be willing to learn, think and practice

Job Required Competencies
·Strong computer skill for Window 7, Microsoft 2010 (PPT, Excel, Word)
·Strong communication skills
·Fluent English written and oral capability

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Wichtig: Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage per E-Mail bei dir. Um sicherzustellen, dass du keine wichtige Nachricht verpasst, bitten wir dich, neben deinem Posteingang auch den Spam- oder Junk-Ordner zu prüfen. Falls du innerhalb einer Woche nichts von uns hörst, melde dich unter basel.berufslehre@roche.com .

Weisst Du bereits, was du nach deinem Abschluss machen wirst? Weltverbesserer oder Lebensretterin werden? Nicht nur Du musst Deine Zukunft neu erfinden. Auch wir. Wir bei Roche arbeiten mit einem Ziel - innovative Tests und Medikamente zu entwickeln und Daten auf neue Weise zu nutzen, um Menschen zu einem längeren und besseren Leben zu verhelfen. Lass Dich inspirieren, wer wir sind, was wir tun und wie wir es tun. Absolviere Deine Ausbildung bei Roche und leiste damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Wohle des Patienten!

Lernen. Zukunft. Roche.

Top Argumente für den Job

• Deine Tätigkeitsbereiche sind sehr vielfältig - du kannst in einem internationalen Umfeld deine Kommunikationskompetenzen und Fremdsprachenkenntnisse erweitern. ​

• Dein top modernes Arbeitsumfeld umfasst neuestes IT-Equipment, dass du auch zum Lernen und von Zuhause aus nutzen kannst.

• An jedem Ausbildungsplatz wirst du von speziell ausgebildeten Mitarbeitenden fachlich und persönlich betreut und gefördert.

• Du erkennst und berücksichtigst die Bedürfnisse der in- und externen Kunden und löst deine Aufgaben selbständig und dienstleistungsorientiert.

• In den Fachbereichen Assistenz, Sachbearbeitung und Finanzen wirst du die erlernte Theorie rasch mit der Praxis vernetzen können.

• Dein Team unterstützt du durch die Organisation von Kundengesprächen, Terminkoordination und mit individuellem Projektsupport.

• Du bist mitverantwortlich für die Organisation von Geschäftsreisen oder Events.

• Du befasst dich mit Themen wie Einkauf, Marketing, Human Resources und Weiteres.

• Im Bereich der Finanzen unterstützt du komplexe Arbeitsprozesse, die in einem global tätigen Unternehmen spannend und anspruchsvoll sind.

Dein Profil

Du hast dich schonmal über diverse Wirtschaftsthemen informiert und bist ein Sprachtalent? Prima!
Du möchtest dein Wissen rund um die Themen wie Finanzen, Kommunikation, Marketing und Human Resources ausbauen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Was du mitbringen solltest:

• Du bist neugierig, kommunikativ und gehst gerne auf andere Menschen zu

• Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenflair und interessierst dich für globale Wirtschaftsthemen

• Du beherrschst den routinierten Umgang mit dem Computer und anderen digitalen Geräten der modernen Kommunikationstechnik

• Zuverlässigkeit, Organisation und Selbständigkeit zählst du zu deinen Stärken

• Als Person bringst du dich gerne aktiv und gewandt in diversen interkulturellen Teams ein und trägst gerne Verantwortung für deine Arbeitsergebnisse

• Mindestens Schulniveau Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), Mittlere Reife (D) oder höhere Schulstufen

• Mündliches und schriftliches Ausdrücken in vorbildlichem Deutsch

• Du hast fundierte Fremdsprachenkenntnisse in Englisch und Französisch

Deine Vorteile

• Du arbeitest in einer internationalen Umgebung und erhältst erstklassige Einblicke in die Unternehmung und den Berufsalltag

• Du besuchst eine praxisorientierte Werkschule

• Du arbeitest mit hochmodernen Anlagen, Geräten und zukunftsorientierten Einrichtungen

• Bei entsprechenden Leistungen besteht die Möglichkeit, dass wir dich nach der Ausbildung bei diversen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten unter
descriptionByLocale.it: A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La Posizione Importante: Dopo la tua applicazione ti contatteremo per e-mail entro pochi giorni. Per assicurarti di non perdere alcun messaggio importante, ti chiediamo di controllare la cartella spam o spazzatura accanto alla tua casella di posta. Se non si sente da noi entro una settimana, si prega di contattare basel.berufslehre@roche.com . Sai già cosa farai dopo la tua laurea? diventare un miglioramento del mondo o salvavita? Non solo devi reinventare il tuo futuro. Anche noi. Noi di Roche lavoriamo con un obiettivo - sviluppare test e medicine innovativi e utilizzare i dati in un nuovo modo per aiutare le persone a vivere più a lungo e meglio. Lasciatevi ispirare chi siamo, cosa facciamo e come lo facciamo. Completa la tua formazione a Roche e fai un contributo decisivo al benessere del paziente! Imparare. Futuro. Roche. Argomenti principali per il lavoro • Le vostre aree di attività sono molto diverse - è possibile espandere le vostre capacità di comunicazione e competenze linguistiche straniere in un ambiente internazionale. • Il vostro ambiente di lavoro moderno superiore include l'ultima apparecchiatura IT che è possibile utilizzare anche per l'apprendimento e da casa. • In ogni luogo di formazione, sarete assistiti e assistiti da dipendenti appositamente formati. • Riconosce e tiene conto delle esigenze dei clienti interni ed esterni e risolve i compiti in modo indipendente e orientato al servizio. Nei settori di assistenza, competenza e finanza, sarete in grado di collegare rapidamente la teoria imparata con la pratica. • Il vostro team vi supporta organizzando colloqui con i clienti, coordinamento degli appuntamenti e supporto individuale del progetto. • Sei anche responsabile dell'organizzazione di viaggi di lavoro o eventi. • Si tratta di argomenti come l'acquisto, il marketing, le risorse umane e altro ancora. • Nel settore della finanza, supporta processi di lavoro complessi che sono eccitanti e stimolanti in una società attiva a livello globale. Il tuo profilo Vi siete già informati su vari argomenti economici e siete un talento linguistico? Fantastico! Vuoi espandere la tua conoscenza su finanza, comunicazione, marketing e risorse umane? Andiamo a conoscerci. Cosa dovreste portare: • Siete curiosi, comunicativi e piace andare ad altre persone • Hai una forte attenzione ai numeri e sei interessato a questioni economiche globali • Si controlla la gestione ordinaria del computer e di altri dispositivi digitali della moderna tecnologia di comunicazione • Affidabilità, organizzazione e indipendenza che si contano sui vostri punti di forza • Come persona, sei felice di intraprendere un'azione attiva e applicarti a varie squadre interculturali e sei felice di assumerti la responsabilità dei risultati del tuo lavoro • Livello scolastico minimo Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), Media maturità (D) o livelli scolastici superiori • Espressione orale e scritta in tedesco esemplare • Hai profonde competenze linguistiche in inglese e francese I tuoi benefici • Lavori in un ambiente internazionale e ottieni informazioni di prima classe sul lavoro aziendale e quotidiano • Stai visitando una scuola pratica di lavoro • Lavori con sistemi, dispositivi e strutture orientate al futuro In caso di servizi corrispondenti, abbiamo la possibilità che, dopo la formazione, saremo in grado di fornire una varietà di opportunità di formazione

L'avenir. Roche. Votre profil Vous avez déjà informé sur divers sujets économiques et êtes un talent linguistique? Génial ! Vous voulez élargir vos connaissances en finance, communication, marketing et ressources humaines? Apprenons à nous connaître. Ce que vous devez apporter: • Vous êtes curieux, communicatif et aimez aller à d'autres personnes • Vous vous concentrez fortement sur les chiffres et êtes intéressé par les questions économiques mondiales • Vous contrôlez la manipulation routinière de l'ordinateur et d'autres appareils numériques de la technologie de communication moderne • Fiabilité, organisation et indépendance vous comptez sur vos forces • En tant que personne, vous êtes heureux d'agir activement et d'appliquer à diverses équipes interculturelles et êtes heureux d'assumer la responsabilité de vos résultats de travail • Niveau minimum scolaire Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), Niveau moyen de maturité (D) ou niveau supérieur scolaire • Expression orale et écrite en allemand exemplaire • Vous avez de profondes compétences en langue étrangère en anglais et en français Vos avantages • Vous travaillez dans un environnement international et obtenez des informations de première classe sur l'entreprise et le travail quotidien • Vous visitez une école pratique de travail • Vous travaillez avec des systèmes, des appareils et des installations de pointe orientés vers l'avenir • Dans le cas des services correspondants, nous avons la possibilité que, après la formation, nous puissions vous fournir une variété de possibilités de formation

The Position
Senior Medical Writer
Roche India – Roche Services & solutions
Hyderabad

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2-office days/week).

The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

Position Summary

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of content creation priorities. As a Senior Medical writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners across various therapeutic areas and play a crucial role in business development and stakeholder engagement

As a Senior Medical Writer, you will be at the forefront of creating high-quality content for medical communications tailored solutions. The Senior Medical Writer is an experienced subject matter expert, advisor and leader within the chapter. Focussing on specific therapeutic areas in dedicated service teams, Senior Medical Writers are responsible for training and mentoring medical writers, copywriters and content editors within their assigned team - also driving cross-team upskilling and knowledge transfer to grow the capabilities of the chapter overall. This critical position has a global scope and a key component of the role involves acting as a trusted advisor and knowledgeable consultant to our business teams on the topic of medical writing and communications.

The Opportunity

• Apply your broad knowledge of medical writing for the pharmaceutical industry, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including medical, scientific, and commercial partners, to understand client needs and develop tailored and effective scientific content for digital implementation

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering on agreed timelines

• Ensuring that the content, format and structure comply with regulatory and other guidelines, as well as with Roche best practices

• Monitor assigned tasks and manage own workload, taking ownership and anticipating capacity issues and potential solutions

• As a trained and experienced senior medical writer you will provide mentorship and technical coaching to other medical writers in the team, as well as new writers joining the team

• As a senior medical writer you will be a subject matter expert in pharmaceutical and medical communications as well as lead the team in assigned, specific therapeutic areas.

Key responsibilities:

• Your role will require taking responsibility and ownership for upholding the highest standards of scientific accuracy, quality and compliance with all applicable industry guidelines, local and international

• Exercise excellent interpersonal/communication skills for effective and professional liaison with the internal team, clients, healthcare professionals and other key stakeholders and to obtain compreh

Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

The Position

Please note that this is a fixed term position with the end date: 31st of Dec 2027.

The Global Learning Services teams focus on executing system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. Global Learning Services provides customer service and advisory support to the Learning Community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.

The Opportunity
As a Learning Specialist you are part of a global, international team and contribute to customer experience directly. Your key responsibilities are performing complete, stringent and timely Training & Learning related administrative and organizational tasks in area and understanding its linkage to Personnel Administration and Organizational Management.

• Providing insight, Tier 2 support and explanation on Learning system (Cornerstone), administering and updating Learning Catalog

• Managing course enrollments for learners, managing invitations, registrations, reminders and follow-up on courses and attendance

• Preparing and providing various Training-related reports and status updates for HR professionals and Training Owners

• Functionality testing of new learning management system and a dvising and supporting business with system / testing / Learning processes

• Providing customer service on Training related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting

• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way and building relationships with other colleagues within the GLS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

What can you bring to our team: ​

• Ideally 1-3 years of experience in the fields of HR personnel administrative or service delivery or customer service with a college/university degree

• Accuracy in record keeping, focus and accountability

• The capability to multitask and handle complex cases

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment and fluent in written and spoken English .

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office day/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Responsable de la implementación y soporte de aplicaciones de soluciones Roche (química, inmunología, molecular, ciencias de la vida y TI) para clientes. Actúa como enlace principal durante el proceso de implementación, abarcando la planificación, coordinación y capacitación de usuarios. Liderando la verificación, calibración y evaluación de equipos y sistemas. Asegura que la solución sea plenamente operativa según las especificaciones y necesidades particulares del cliente, proporcionando retroalimentación técnica a los stakeholders para la mejora de procesos y productos.

La Oportunidad

• Brindar asistencia técnica a clientes mediante instalaciones in situ, resolución de problemas y conectividad de instrumentos y soluciones digitales, garantizando la operatividad de los sistemas

• Instruir a clientes en el uso y mantenimiento de sistemas, actuando como enlace técnico y administrativo en proyectos asignados.

• Colaborar en la elaboración de planes anuales y propuestas de soluciones integrales para laboratorios clínicos.

• Instalar y configurar sistemas de gestión de laboratorio (LIS) y liderar su implementación, coordinando recursos internos y del cliente.

• Gestionar capacitaciones internas y externas sobre el portafolio de productos IT y de laboratorio.

• Interactuar con proveedores de software y hardware según las necesidades de los proyectos.

Quién eres

• Profesional graduado o estudiante en Ingeniería en Sistemas, Bioingeniería, Electromecánica o carreras afines, con experiencia en soporte de soluciones IT aplicadas al entorno de laboratorio clínico.

• Experiencia mínima de 2 años en implementación, soporte o consultoría de sistemas similares.

• Conocimientos en instalación, configuración y soporte de sistemas LIS, así como en integración de infraestructura, hardware y software.

• Habilidades de comunicación, orientación al cliente, trabajo en equipo y liderazgo de proyectos.

• Inglés intermedio.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Responsable de la implementación y soporte de aplicaciones de soluciones Roche (química, inmunología, molecular, ciencias de la vida y TI) para clientes. Actúa como enlace principal durante el proceso de implementación, abarcando la planificación, coordinación y capacitación de usuarios. Liderando la verificación, calibración y evaluación de equipos y sistemas. Asegura que la solución sea plenamente operativa según las especificaciones y necesidades particulares del cliente, proporcionando retroalimentación técnica a los stakeholders para la mejora de procesos y productos.

La Oportunidad

• Brindar asistencia técnica a clientes mediante instalaciones in situ, resolución de problemas y conectividad de instrumentos y soluciones digitales, garantizando la operatividad de los sistemas

• Instruir a clientes en el uso y mantenimiento de sistemas, actuando como enlace técnico y administrativo en proyectos asignados.

• Colaborar en la elaboración de planes anuales y propuestas de soluciones integrales para laboratorios clínicos.

• Instalar y configurar sistemas de gestión de laboratorio (LIS) y liderar su implementación, coordinando recursos internos y del cliente.

• Gestionar capacitaciones internas y externas sobre el portafolio de productos IT y de laboratorio.

• Interactuar con proveedores de software y hardware según las necesidades de los proyectos.

Quién eres

• Profesional graduado o estudiante en Ingeniería en Sistemas, Bioingeniería, Electromecánica o carreras afines, con experiencia en soporte de soluciones IT aplicadas al entorno de laboratorio clínico.

• Experiencia mínima de 2 años en implementación, soporte o consultoría de sistemas similares.

• Conocimientos en instalación, configuración y soporte de sistemas LIS, así como en integración de infraestructura, hardware y software.

• Habilidades de comunicación, orientación al cliente, trabajo en equipo y liderazgo de proyectos.

• Inglés intermedio.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms
Location: Pune

Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud—supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment. As part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we provide the hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support required to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable.

As a Senior Security Engineer , you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor, acting as a trusted advisor across distributed teams to drive improvements independently. In this role, you will navigate the complexities of on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure to ensure our security solutions meet strict regulatory requirements while maintaining a highly responsive service delivery ethic.

The Opportunity

• Engineer Zero Trust Solutions: Design and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions to protect global corporate resources.

• Manage VPN Infrastructure: Administer and support Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including complex policy management and lifecycle operations.

• Automate Security Workflows: Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and ensure consistency across all security configurations.

• Drive Infrastructure-as-Code: Lead the management of security infrastructure using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations within GitHub.

• Ensure Operational Compliance: Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and strict change management adherence.

• Solve Complex Security Incidents: Independently lead the analysis of cybersecurity incidents, defining problem scopes and driving root cause analysis for vulnerabilities.

• Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated capabilities that support a global, regulated workforce.

• Mentor and Standardize: Provide technical guidance to junior team members and contribute to the development of enterprise-wide security best practices.

Who you are

• Experienced Security Engineer: You bring 5–7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, specifically focused on network security and secure access.

• Cloudflare & VPN Expert: You possess demonstrated experience with Cloudflare (Access, Gateway, WAF) and Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN deployment and troubleshooting.

• Infrastructure-as-Code Proficient: You are highly proficient with Terraform and GitHub for version control, collaboration, and automated deployments.

• Regulated Industry Veteran: You have a proven track record working in healthcare, pharma, or finance, with a deep understanding of compliance and audit requirements.

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

• Automation Mindset: You are skilled in building automation (scripts, workflows, or CI/CD pipelines) to support and scale global security operations.

• Strategic Problem Solver: You are a self-motivated leader capable of owning work end-

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term role until the end of 2028.

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and German

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• Your key responsibilities
• ● Supply &Demand Planning :
• Manage supply planning parameters and monitor inventory levels to balance supply with demand.
• Lead regular SOP meetings with Sales and Marketing to review forecasts and mitigate risks such as stock-outs or excess inventory.
• ● Order & Distributor Management:
• Oversee order fulfillment for local distributors and manage end-to-end order-to-cash (OTC) processes.
• Act as the primary contact for 3PL warehouse operations to coordinate inbound/outbound schedules and ensure accurate logistics flow.
• ● Inventory & Data Management :
• Oversee the material lifecycle by maintaining accurate master data in SAP. Monitor inventory health by analyzing slow-moving, short-expiry, and obsolete stock to optimize working capital.
• ● Logistics Quality & Claim Handling:
• Manage logistics exceptions by filing claims for shipping damages, short shipments, or temperature excursions (cold chain deviations).
• Coordinate with global vendors and insurers to resolve discrepancies and minimize supply disruptions.
• ● Procurement & Reporting:
• Execute purchase orders (PO) and monitor shipping schedules from global hubs. Prepare SCM KPI reports, including forecast accuracy, service levels (OTIF), and inventory turnover.

Who you are
• Education & Qualification
• ● A Bachelor or Master Degrees in Logistics or Logistics related subjects
• ● Proficiency in both spoken and written English
• ● Good command of MS office software application
• ● Familiar with SAP system in MM and SD modules

Experience & Competencies
• ● A minimum over 3 years’ experience in supply chain operations & distribution.
• ● SAP experience in operation at least 1 years
• ● MS operation / Presentation skill
• ● Planning, Organizing & Commitment
• ● Customer Oriented & Relationship Management
• ● Communication Skill

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Global Study Lead is responsible for ensuring that all studies are designed, planned, executed, monitored, closed out and documented in an appropriate manner within the planned timeframe and cost; ensuring that the sponsor responsibilities are fulfilled, while assuring compliance to all applicable regulatory requirements. Responsible for the timeline and budget planning and execution of studies. Assigns and ensures delivery of specific tasks to/from other members of the study team. Provides oversight to outside support including CROs, consultants and/or medical advisors

The Opportunity:

The key accountabilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

• Leads the global study team with full accountability for the study deliverables with respect to quality, budget and timelines, in collaboration with the Study Team and ensures the development of high quality study designs for sponsored studies in collaboration with internal and external experts

• In collaboration with Program Leadership, prepares different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g. study, real-world evidence) in cross-functional collaboration (e.g. with Regulatory Affairs, R&D, CDMA Project Teams) to support global strategies and planning of timeline and costs

• Develops key study documents (i.e., Design Validation Plan, protocol, study training materials, study forms and templates, study report)

• Oversees planning and operational aspects of companion diagnostics studies sponsored by Pharma partners

• Accountable for study-level budget of assigned studies.

• Adherence to regulations, guidelines and standard operating procedures, and ensures audit/inspection readiness.

• Execution of sponsored studies for assigned areas of focus for registrational and/or non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up. conduct and close-out). Oversees study activities outsourced to a service provider (i.e., CRO).

• Ensure that study results are published in collaboration with the Publication Team.

• Oversees projects to ensure completion on-time, within scope and budget; and tracks project performance to analyze the completion of short and long term goals.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders, key internal and external stakeholders and other alliance partners, including CROs, in meeting business goals and ensuring operational excellence.

Who you are:

• You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or related field

• You have 5+ years of experience managing the full lifecycle of sponsored studies, ensuring projects meet performance goals within scope, quality, budget, and timeline.

• You have extensive experience in ensuring that study results are published in collaboration with the Publication Team.

• You have in-depth knowledge and experience in the role of Clinical Operations in product development; are aware of Roche’s place in the market and our value proposition to patients and customers.

• You have e xperience with PHCS and Companion Diagnostic trials, specifically within pathology and core lab indications

descriptionByLocale.it: In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per far avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Il responsabile globale dello studio è responsabile di garantire che tutti gli studi siano progettati, pianificati, eseguiti, monitorati, chiusi e documentati in modo appropriato entro i tempi e i costi pianificati; garantire che le responsabilità dello sponsor siano soddisfatte, garantendo al tempo stesso la conformità a tutti i requisiti normativi applicabili. Responsabile della pianificazione temporale e del budget e dell'esecuzione degli studi. Assegna e garantisce l'esecuzione di compiti specifici ad/da altri membri del gruppo di studio. Fornisce supervisione al supporto esterno, inclusi CRO, consulenti e/o consulenti medici L'Opportunità: Le responsabilità chiave per questa posizione includono, ma non sono limitate a: • Guida il team di studio globale con piena responsabilità per i risultati dello studio rispetto alla qualità, al budget e alle tempistiche, in collaborazione con il team di studio e garantisce lo sviluppo di progetti di studio di alta qualità per studi sponsorizzati in collaborazione con esperti interni ed esterni • In collaborazione con la leadership del programma, prepara diversi scenari per la generazione di prove (ad es. studio, prove dal mondo reale) in collaborazione interfunzionale (ad esempio con affari regolatori, ricerca e sviluppo, team di progetto CDMA) per supportare strategie globali e pianificazione di tempistiche e costi • Sviluppa documenti chiave dello studio (ad esempio, piano di convalida del progetto, protocollo, materiali di formazione sullo studio, moduli e modelli di studio, rapporto di studio) • Supervisiona la pianificazione e gli aspetti operativi degli studi diagnostici associati sponsorizzati dai partner farmaceutici • Responsabile del budget a livello di studio degli studi assegnati. • Rispetto delle normative, delle linee guida e delle procedure operative standard e garanzia di prontezza per audit/ispezioni. • Esecuzione di studi sponsorizzati per aree di interesse assegnate ai fini registrativi e/o non registrali attraverso tutte le fasi dello studio (pianificazione, avvio, svolgimento e chiusura). Supervisiona le attività di studio affidate in outsourcing a un fornitore di servizi (ad esempio, CRO). • Garantire che i risultati dello studio siano pubblicati in collaborazione con il team di pubblicazione. • Supervisiona i progetti per garantirne il completamento nei tempi previsti, nell'ambito e nel budget; e tiene traccia delle prestazioni del progetto per analizzare il completamento degli obiettivi a breve e lungo termine. • Costruire e mantenere rapporti forti e collaborativi con leader interfunzionali, principali stakeholder interni ed esterni e altri partner dell'alleanza, comprese le CRO, per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali e garantire l'eccellenza operativa. Chi sei: • Hai una laurea in Scienze della vita o un campo correlato • Hai oltre 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dell'intero ciclo di vita degli studi sponsorizzati, assicurando che i progetti raggiungano gli obiettivi di prestazione nell'ambito, qualità, budget e tempistica. • Hai una vasta esperienza nel garantire che i risultati dello studio siano pubblicati in collaborazione con il team di pubblicazione. • Possiedi una conoscenza ed esperienza approfondite nel ruolo delle operazioni cliniche nello sviluppo del prodotto; siamo consapevoli della posizione di Roche nel mercato e della nostra proposta di valore ai pazienti e ai clienti. • Hai esperienza con studi PHCS e Companion Diagnostic, in particolare nell'ambito della patologia e delle indicazioni di laboratorio principali • Hai esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi utilizzando giudizio analitico e pensiero innovativo per valutare rischi e rischi
descriptionByLocale.de: Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns zu Innovationen antreibt. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Der globale Studienleiter ist dafür verantwortlich, sicherzustellen, dass alle Studien innerhalb des geplanten Zeitrahmens und der geplanten Kosten angemessen konzipiert, geplant, durchgeführt, überwacht, abgeschlossen und dokumentiert werden. Sicherstellen, dass die Verantwortlichkeiten des Sponsors erfüllt werden und gleichzeitig die Einhaltung aller geltenden gesetzlichen Anforderungen sichergestellt wird. Verantwortlich für die Zeit- und Budgetplanung sowie die Durchführung von Studien. Weist bestimmte Aufgaben anderen Mitgliedern des Studienteams zu und stellt diese sicher. Bietet die Aufsicht über externe Unterstützung, einschließlich CROs, Berater und/oder medizinische Berater. Die Gelegenheit: Zu den Hauptverantwortungsbereichen dieser Position gehören unter anderem: • Leitet das globale Studienteam mit voller Verantwortung für die Studienergebnisse in Bezug auf Qualität, Budget und Zeitpläne in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Studienteam und stellt die Entwicklung hochwertiger Studiendesigns für gesponserte Studien in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Experten sicher. • Bereitet in Zusammenarbeit mit der Programmleitung verschiedene Szenarien für die Evidenzgenerierung vor (z. B. Studie, reale Beweise) in funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit (z. B. mit Regulatory Affairs, F&E, CDMA-Projektteams), um globale Strategien und die Planung von Zeitrahmen und Kosten zu unterstützen. • Entwickelt wichtige Studiendokumente (d. h. Design-Validierungsplan, Protokoll, Studienschulungsmaterialien, Studienformulare und -vorlagen, Studienbericht). • Überwacht die Planung und operativen Aspekte von Companion Diagnostics-Studien, die von Pharmapartnern gesponsert werden. • Verantwortlich für das Budget der zugewiesenen Studien auf Studienebene. • Einhaltung von Vorschriften, Richtlinien und Standardarbeitsanweisungen und Gewährleistung der Audit-/Inspektionsbereitschaft. • Durchführung geförderter Studien für zugewiesene Schwerpunktbereiche für zulassungs- und/oder nichtzulassungsrelevante Zwecke in allen Studienphasen (Planung, Anlauf, Durchführung und Abschluss). Beaufsichtigt Studienaktivitäten, die an einen Dienstleister (z. B. CRO) ausgelagert werden. • Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Studienergebnisse in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Publikationsteam veröffentlicht werden. • Beaufsichtigt Projekte, um sicherzustellen, dass sie pünktlich, innerhalb des Umfangs und des Budgets abgeschlossen werden; und verfolgt die Projektleistung, um die Erreichung kurz- und langfristiger Ziele zu analysieren. • Aufbau und Pflege starker, kooperativer Beziehungen mit funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften, wichtigen internen und externen Stakeholdern und anderen Allianzpartnern, einschließlich CROs, um Geschäftsziele zu erreichen und operative Exzellenz sicherzustellen. Wer Sie sind: • Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Biowissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich. • Sie verfügen über mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Verwaltung des gesamten Lebenszyklus geförderter Studien und stellen sicher, dass Projekte die Leistungsziele innerhalb von Umfang, Qualität, Budget und Zeitrahmen erreichen. • Sie verfügen über umfassende Erfahrung darin, sicherzustellen, dass Studienergebnisse in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Publikationsteam veröffentlicht werden. • Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in der Rolle des Clinical Operations in der Produktentwicklung; sind sich der Stellung von Roche auf dem Markt und unseres Wertversprechens gegenüber Patienten und Kunden bewusst. • Sie haben Erfahrung mit PHCS- und Companion Diagnostic-Studien, insbesondere in den Bereichen Pathologie und Kernlaborindikationen. • Sie haben Erfahrung im Management komplexer Projekte, indem Sie analytisches Urteilsvermögen und innovatives Denken zur Bewertung von Risiken und Risiken einsetzen
descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Un avenir plus sain. C’est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé dont il a besoin aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous passons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C’est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Le responsable de l'étude mondiale est chargé de veiller à ce que toutes les études soient conçues, planifiées, exécutées, surveillées, clôturées et documentées de manière appropriée dans les délais et les coûts prévus ; s'assurer que les responsabilités du sponsor sont remplies, tout en assurant le respect de toutes les exigences réglementaires applicables. Responsable de la planification du calendrier et du budget et de l'exécution des études. Attribue et assure l'exécution de tâches spécifiques vers/depuis les autres membres de l'équipe d'étude. Assure la supervision du soutien externe, y compris les CRO, les consultants et/ou les conseillers médicaux. L'opportunité : Les principales responsabilités pour ce poste comprennent, sans s'y limiter : • Diriger l'équipe d'étude mondiale avec l'entière responsabilité des livrables de l'étude en ce qui concerne la qualité, le budget et les délais, en collaboration avec l'équipe d'étude et assurer le développement de conceptions d'étude de haute qualité pour les études sponsorisées en collaboration avec des experts internes et externes. • En collaboration avec la direction du programme, prépare différents scénarios pour la génération de preuves (par exemple, étude, monde réel). preuves) en collaboration interfonctionnelle (par exemple avec les affaires réglementaires, la R&D, les équipes de projet CDMA) pour soutenir les stratégies mondiales et la planification du calendrier et des coûts. • Élabore les documents d'étude clés (c'est-à-dire le plan de validation de la conception, le protocole, le matériel de formation à l'étude, les formulaires et modèles d'étude, le rapport d'étude). • Respect des réglementations, des lignes directrices et des procédures opérationnelles standard, et garantie de la préparation aux audits/inspections. • Exécution d'études sponsorisées pour des domaines d'intérêt assignés à des fins d'inscription et/ou non-inscription à travers toutes les phases de l'étude (planification, démarrage, conduite et clôture). Supervise les activités d’étude externalisées à un fournisseur de services (c’est-à-dire CRO). • Veiller à ce que les résultats de l'étude soient publiés en collaboration avec l'équipe de publication. • Supervise les projets pour garantir leur achèvement à temps, dans les limites de la portée et du budget ; et suit les performances du projet pour analyser la réalisation des objectifs à court et à long terme. • Établir et entretenir des relations de collaboration solides avec les dirigeants interfonctionnels, les principales parties prenantes internes et externes et d'autres partenaires de l'alliance, y compris les CRO, pour atteindre les objectifs commerciaux et garantir l'excellence opérationnelle. Qui vous êtes : • Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe. • Vous avez plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion du cycle de vie complet des études sponsorisées, garantissant que les projets atteignent les objectifs de performance en termes de portée, de qualité, de budget et de calendrier. • Vous possédez une vaste expérience dans la garantie que les résultats des études sont publiés en collaboration avec l'équipe de publication. • Vous possédez des connaissances et une expérience approfondies dans le rôle des opérations cliniques dans le développement de produits ; sommes conscients de la place de Roche sur le marché et de notre proposition de valeur aux patients et aux clients. • Vous avez de l'expérience avec les essais PHCS et Companion Diagnostic, en particulier dans le domaine de la pathologie et des indications de laboratoire de base. • Vous avez de l'expérience dans la gestion de projets complexes en utilisant le jugement analytique et la pensée innovante pour évaluer les risques et les risques.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Solution Architect - Pharma R&D
Preferred Location: Pune

The Opportunity

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical guidance to the assigned product team, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt. You will collaborate closely with the Senior Architect for the area to ensure alignment with broader architecture direction, standards, and roadmaps.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context.
